The food was delicious. I been looking for some good cassava in Chicago. Had some issues with DoorDash but I appreciate the effort she took getting me my food. It truly was so good and exactly what I was looking for!

formatted_address: 6120 N Broadway, Chicago, IL 60660, United States
name: Ethiopian Diamond Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text:
If you’ve ever wished a restaurant could teleport you to another continent without the jet lag or the “Sir, your bag is overweight” lecture, Ethiopian Diamond delivers. I’ve only had Ethiopian food in Africa, so my standards weren’t just high, they were practically doing altitude training. And guess what? This place nailed it.

The flavors? An adventure for my tastebuds. I’m talking full safari mode. Every bite was bold, vibrant, and layered with so much depth I felt like I should’ve taken notes. The injera was perfect. The spices were spot-on. The whole meal instantly transported me back across the ocean, and honestly, I didn’t even need a passport.

Service was great. Vibe was warm. Food was flat-out fantastic.

Five stars without hesitation. If you’re in Chicago and not eating here, you’re doing Chicago wrong.

Went for lunch with coworkers, we ordered our food to go, but it smelled so good we just had to try a bite before leaving—and ended up eating it all right there! I ordered the veggie sampler, every dish was incredibly flavorful and fresh, with perfectly soft, tangy injera and a delicious mix of lentils, greens, and stews. The staff were so kind and welcoming, and the food was absolutely irresistible.
The food is absolutely delicious! I ordered the veggie sampler for one and I loved every bite! The atmosphere is relaxing and the service was great. Highly recommend!

Food was great, although the injera was too sour for my liking. The Ethiopian coffee was fabulous. My only complaint which knocks off a star for courtesy to guests is not mentioning there was a 20% gratuity that was going to be charged, as well as not mentioning it after the charge either. The 6 of us were discussing 20% calculation for tip and as I was writing out the tip, someone had flipped the receipt over to see that gratuity was already charged. Automatic gratuity for bigger parties is 100% acceptable but every restaurant I have worked in or been to has always communicated that to the guests. Not communicating that felt a bit sketchy and didn’t leave us feeling nice but besides that, the service was great. I just recommend mentioning the automatic charge to tables as some guests might get pretty upset with the lack of communication.

I've been to this place five times since 2016, and every single time the food and the service have been phenomenal. They never disappoint on either front. My husband eats meat, and I'm a vegetarian, making this a perfect place for us to choose what we want and still share a single meal together.

Today, for the first time, I tried their honey wine mead, and it's so good! I usually order their coffee, but unfortunately, they didn't have the beans. Also, they didn't have mango for the mango drinks. That's the only reason I'm giving it four stars. Often, your favorite menu items might not be available.

formatted_address: 6606 N Sheridan Rd, Chicago, IL 60626, United States
name: Mama’s African kitchen restaurant bar

reviews.text:
sooooo happy to be having food from my country (DRC) in chicago!!! the hosts were so kind and jovial. the food tasted just like how my mom makes it. great congolese music and drinks like vitalo as well! they do not yet serve alcohol so get your alcoholic drinks before or after if that’s what you’re looking for. i genuinely want everyone to know about this placez whether congolese or not, i can almost guarantee you will find the flavours are rich and delicious. and the price is very decent considering im sure many of these goods are imported from back home! you get that good authentic quality taste. food also came out decently fast - maybe 10-15 mins max which in my experience of african restaurants is very quick. still tasted good though! i got it to take with me to the airport back to toronto, that’s how good it was 🤣

PS the restaurant is now named chez lisa loboka!! i hope they update it on google soon so no one else gets confused bc i was

This was my second time at the restaurant and I simply loved it! I had an incredible experience. The flavors were rich and authentic, the service was friendly, and everything tasted fresh. I’ll definitely be coming back!

The food was absolutely spectacular. My friend and I shared the grilled goat with their légumes verts (which was similar to collard greens) and fufu. The dish was $26 but they served plenty of food, and it was absolutely delicious. The staff were very welcoming and kind. I'd love to go again.

This place is seriously amazing.  Had the dindon with jollof rice and african beans.  Flavors and spiciness were perfectly excellent.  They’re clearly still working towards their stride after recently opening, but the atmosphere and service are excellent and really all they need is some well deserved neighborhood love.  Seriously- get in here.

Unfortunately, this was one of my least favorite meal experiences. I’m a huge fan of West African food and was pleased to see an option in my neighborhood.  I ordered takeout and ended up throwing the food away. I’m being honest about my experience for feedback for the future. I’d love to come back and try again.

Very glad I got to experience such a flavorful and filling meal!

It completely tastes African. It's spicy and delicious. It is well seasoned, and the service was great, they were very nice and friendly. it made me feel home again. As a Nigerian I’m tired of ordering nonsense food from you food vendors, you freaking need to do better. You put normal stew ontop of beans and you call it ewa agoyin. Rubbish

formatted_address: 5844 N Broadway, Chicago, IL 60660, United States
name: Axum Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: We ordered 3 different dishes and had 2 days of extra, the amounts were so generous. The Ethiopian beer was delicious, prices reasonable, cleanliness perfect, and Chef came over to chat. Really great lentil and beef dishes with spongey Injera bread. We didn’t leave feeling overfull and sleepy like with Italian or Chinese cuisine. Loved not using utensils and dipping and scoping with the perfect fluffy bread to savor every bite.

Went for their Sunday brunch buffet. Had a few options available including beef chicken and two sauces. Wished there were more options. But for the food provided, all were very tasty. Owner is very kind and friendly. Loved the coffee which was the highlight of the buffet.

Freakin’ delicious flavor bomb. We got the meat & veggie combo for 3 ppl. Service was great. We left so stuffed, and with leftovers.

Plenty of street parking- paid on main road or free on side streets.

Adding this comment literally right after finishing my dinner because this place is such a gem!
I’ve always loved Ethiopian food and have been to quite a few restaurants in different cities but haven’t tried ordering online. Saw that the restaurant does ubereats and decided to give it a try. I was a little concerned about ordering kitfo (raw beef) via delivery in this hot summer weather but it did not disappoint at all! The portion size is huge (among the most generous I’ve ever seen compared to dine in experiences), very fresh and beautifully seasoned. And, as an absolute meat lover, I must say that there was so much beef (in the best way)!
In terms of the sides, they don’t skimp on the injera either (4 big pieces just for the regular size, no “extra”). Was very glad to see that they use the real injera made from teff, which gives it the characteristic fermented sourness and the chewy texture. (I felt that this is worth commenting on since I was served whiteish “injera” last year at another Ethiopian restaurant and was very disappointed.) The collard greens and misir wot (lentils) as sides were very flavorful too, the spices were bright and balanced.
Overall this was a beyond expectation ordering experience and now I feel compelled to pay them a visit in the near future :) Thanks for the amazing food!

Deki adina , Food is delicious but they run out of enjera, and the base injera we got was old it’s has some white on it. We asked for extra enjera multiple times no enjera at all. They should let customers know ahead of time. One was complaining and canceled the food and left. 😑,

name: Zebda

reviews.text:
One of the best experience I ever had in a restaurant, the guy on the front super friendly with great service, I ordered lump chunk with rice was so tender and huge and delicious.
Very recommended
I will be back for sure

We ordered the meatballs tagine and lamb shank — so flavorful, rich in spices and aroma. They went perfectly with the warm bread. Even the side salads and the olive oil and sesame dressings were great. The gravy from the dishes were so rich and comforting. We also took some dessert home — definitely worth trying. Highly recommend! Great flavors and fair prices.
Really delicious food no matter what you order. Shockingly great prices. Nice service. The chicken tagine was especially good!

A lovely place to eat Algerian food. The staff were very friendly and helpful. They have a good selection of tagines, sandwiches, deserts, salads and pizza. We ordered lentil soup, chicken tagline, lamb shank and kofta sandwich, and it was all great. Good size portions and very reasonably priced.

We ordered to go. I ordered the chicken tagine and falafel. The photo shows my second day serving of chicken, carrots and potatoes and it’s so well seasoned and tasty that I paused eating to write this review. It’s chef’s kiss.

formatted_address: 7118 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60626, United States
name: Oaato African Restaurant

reviews.text: Hit up Oaato African Restaurant for dinner last night—went with Egusi soup and fufu plus a side of jollof rice. Soup was spot-on—rich, spicy, and authentic—just what I wanted. Fufu had a great doughy texture, and the jollof was flavorful and not too heavy. Only downside: staff were a bit brusque at times, but food more than made up for it. Really solid overall.

It was my first time tasting the Nigerian food and they set the bar high for me. The food was delicious. It was flavorful and seasoned well, had a nice amount of spice and kick to it. I had Egusi soup and FuFu. I had goat chicken and fish and it was so good

Yo, if you're lookin' for some fire West African eats up north, Oaato on Clark is the real deal. I grabbed the Egusi Soup with goat meat and pounded yam—rich, spicy, and straight-up comfort food. Also tried the Jollof Rice with goat; that smoky kick? Chef's kiss. Dropped about $40 for both, and the portions? Massive. Staff was chill, and the vibe felt like a home-cooked meal. Definitely hittin' this spot again.
I love the food. Authentic Nigerian food. One of the best in Chicago. Im Ghanaian but I can't stop eating the delicious food from the place!!. I drive from Milwaukee to buy from Oaato
This is nice place to eat  authentic West Africa meal. Service is nice and folfs are friendly.

reviews.text:
The food was delicious and me and my friends ordered a gyro and fries (very well seasoned), jollof rice, plantains, grilled fish, and goat meat (solid Nigerian food).

The service was good and the food came out very quickly. We ordered some food to go and if we’re in the area, we’d come back again.

This place offered me and my family such a beautiful experience for my 21st birthday. The owner and cook of the restaurant and staff created such a wonderful space for us to really feel like we were at home. It was my first time trying African cuisine and I was blown away with the flavor and deliciousness of the food. The Pepper soup and the Jollof rice were so flavorful, and everything else was amazing. Thank you for a wonderful time and amazing food! We’ll definitely be back :)

Was confused when I went in, but it's 2 restaurants at this location. The lady was super nice and friendly. Had their fufu with egusi soup and assorted meat and fufu with stewed spinach and assorted meat. The food was great. I would love to and will be coming back to try the other menu items.

Going from a 4 star to a 5 star

Had their fufu with stewed spinach and tilapia, jollof rice and pepper stew. It was excellent.

reviews.text: Sefa’s hits hard. I grabbed the jollof rice with oxtail and it was bussin’—flavorful, tender, with that perfect little kick. Plantains on the side were crispy-sweet perfection. Super friendly folks behind the counter, too. Food was hot, fresh, and came out quick. It’s a small spot but full of heart. If you know, you know—this place is a hidden gem in the neighborhood.
One of the tastiest food I’ve tasted in Chicago! If you’re around definitely give her a trial you won’t regret it. The packaging and presentation of the food will make you salivate. Highly recommend

Just hit up Sefa’s Kitchen for lunch—dropped around $28 on a spicy jollof rice plate with goat stew and a side of fried plantains. Let me tell ya, that goat was melt-in-your-mouth, spices on point. The server was super friendly, checked in on us, real genuine vibes. Cozy spot, chill neighborhood feel. Totally worth it—will be back soon!
Sefa’s kitchen is the absolute best! I’ve tried her waakye and jollof and the food is always A+ Customer service is also very great. Will continue patronizing.

If you're looking for an authentic African dining experience in Chicago, Sefa is the place to go! Having sampled food from almost every African restaurant in the city, I can confidently say Sefa's offerings are among the best. The food is delicious, well-portioned, and affordably priced."

Very good service, Food was very good quality all around. They know how to prepare home made African food and their fried rice / small chops is top-notch. Prices were reasonable. Thanks Onielbites for your service.

Excellent service and overall high quality of the food. They know how to make authentic African food at home, and their fried rice and tiny chops are excellent. The costs were fair. Thanks for your assistance, Onielbites.
My experience with their foods especially the Effo Riro was such a remarkable one. Every bite of the soup was just delicious. Well done Ma'am.

name: The Mukase Restaurant

reviews.text: We got fufu and egusi with beef here and it was phenomenal!!!! The service was great the man who served us and took our order was very kind! I recommend either the pounded yam or plantain fufu, and be sure to get some meat with your meal as well as it is very tender and soft! The pricing is very affordable and one serving of the fufu and egusi was enough to fill up 2 people from my experience as it is very filling. That would be $10 per person! We will be back!🫶🫶🫶

The food was amazing and the staff were super friendly. Shout out to the man taking our order for recommending egusi with oxtail and fufu. It was spicy and super flavorful. First time did not disappoint! We will definitely be back!

For my first time being here the food was really good. The goat was tender, the jollof rice was amazing,  plantains aren’t my thing but I enjoyed them with others part of the food. My partner got the spinach and egusi stew with fufu and loved it immediately. Overall a great experience. Alittle to much for spice for me to be honest but it was too good to stop eating due to how flavorful it was. I would definitely come back and recommend to others.

I drove over a half hour to try the spinach and egusi soup with fufu. It was so good. I loved the spice and the flavor. The goat meat was tender and flavorful. Service was fast. The man was busy working the back and the front. Everyone who came in he treated with kindness and a smile on his face. I will have to try more food from here

I love the lady that owns the place! Always super friendly! Like an auntie type. My favorite is the Egusi with chicken and fufu. It's enough food to make 2 meals out of it. Flavorful and consistent every time I order. African joints are hard to come by but so glad I live close to this one.

Great price for DELICIOUS food!! The young lady taking the orders is so sweet and helpful. The cooks are also very nice.

From me Kay to you, this is worth every dollar.

formatted_address: 7137 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60626, United States
name: LG Restaurant

reviews.text: This is by far the best Nigerian restaurant in Chicago. All of the food I had was perfectly spiced and the portions are generous. The Amala was tasty. I came for the jollof and stayed for that fish in red sauce!!! I wanted to lick my plate clean!!
Ordered jollof rice and goat on Uber eats and my taste buds were jumping. Haven't had such good jollof in a while. And the portion was great too! Absolutely no regrets on this order

My siblings and I went for my brother's birthday and the food was delicious. We got jollof rice, amala with goat meat and ghost meat prppersoup, the service was very friendly and welcoming, the inside was cute, clean and inviting. I would recommend this place to anyone wanting to try or looking for an authentic Nigerian spot

Placed an order on DoorDash to try out their restaurant for the first time. The order didn’t go through to them, so I went and called them 3 times, it proceeded to go to voicemail. After the 4th ring, someone finally answered and told me, they were just arriving to the restaurant. Mind you, their store was scheduled to open at 11am! It’s been over an hour! Continued waiting just to get a notification that they’ve canceled my order! Never placing an order with them again! Ridiculous
I’ve been looking for a Nigerian restaurant in Chicago that has really good Abula and they do. The Amala is really soft. It’s delicious and will definitely be back

formatted_address: 1504 E 55th St, Chicago, IL 60615, United States
name: MAHARI

reviews.text: The food is so damn good, thank you so much for the experience! Faith was an amazing server, we met one of the owners who was super sweet. The atmosphere is phenomenal and intentional! You can tell that this place was made with love!

The first thing I will say about Mahari is that it’s beautiful. Every detail was thought off when it came to design and presentation. I felt like I was on vacation when I stepped inside. The host and  staff were so friendly, professional, patient, and attentive. The playlist was amazing as well-it sounded like Amapiano which I love. The plating of the food was lovely- I almost did not want to eat my food because it was so pretty. The atmosphere is welcoming for all occasions and groups. This is a nice place for a celebratory dinner, a friend night, a date night, a cute ans calm outdoor patio feel, or a solo working dinner- while I was there I saw all of the above and everyone looked content and happy. Definitely would love to go back.

I’ve been 3 times but this new Suya dish?! Amazing. It usually comes with white rice I think. This had a nice balance with the honey on the naan and the spices on everything else. I fell in love with the Caribbean burger then also the stuffed plantains.

I love the presentation they give for birthday celebrations.

Good vibes and people. It feels like home and the food is great.

From the drinks to the dessert, the Bartender 🍸 Christy, Cashmere the waitress, and Grant the waiter took great care of our family. We were celebrating a cousin who'd passed and the incredible service made our evening that much better. The food was well seasoned and well made, the drinks were good...try the Jorja Peach...it's a great cocktail and the Pineapple 🍍 Wings and Peach Salad with Prawns were on point! For dessert, try the Sorrel Ginger Sorbet 🍨 with the Honey Naan Bread🍯...it's so delish!

My partner and I had the opportunity to dine at this hidden gem in Hyde Park this weekend , my partner and I were celebrating our Birthday’s . The food was absolutely amazing, the atmosphere was fantastic, perfect for a date. The atmosphere was warm and romantic,  the host and waitress provided great service. They were very welcoming, and made us feel comfortable. It’s really a plus, when you can get good food, great service, and a great atmosphere. And you don’t have to travel far, if you live in Hyde Park. The Chef also came out and spoke with us to ensure everything was good, we made sure to thank him for the great food. If you visit, make sure you try the Prawns and Polenta, Stuffed plantains, Pollo N' Frijoles, the Peach Salad W Salmon, Seared Okra, and for dessert the Bread pudding and Sorbet . Everything was delicious!!! We will definitely be returning to try more on the menu.

formatted_address: 5532 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60641, United States
name: Le Jardin: Restaurant & Banquet Hall

reviews.text: Delicious food! The fish, the shrimp and the two kinds of rice we got were very tasty. The clincher was the puff-puffs we got for dessert: fantastic!
The Atmosphere was awesome. The foods was delicious and the customer service was amazing. I was there with my family and we will come back. Try them you won't be disappointed ❤

I was super excited to find this place and get a taste of home in Chicago. This is such genuinely Cameroonian food! It tastes amazing and the chef is super nice and friendly. The ndole was delicious, 100/100 would recommend. Honsstly when i first saw the portion I thought it was small, buy it's deceptive. I was more than full by the ens. They'll surely be seeing me more.

“I arrived looking for copper and found GOLD” first time trying this fusion of African and French food, the best description of what the food seemed to me is that I felt the food was homely but with the flavors of spices that you have not tried but you are delighted. 100% recommended, friendly and pleasant treatment, I will return whenever I can.
Food was delicious. Very welcoming atmosphere and staff.  Great place to have dinner with friends and catch up!

formatted_address: 6319 N Ridge Ave, Chicago, IL 60660, United States
name: Safari Somali Cuisine

reviews.text: Well this is my 2nd time trying Somali cuisine. I went to a different restaurant for Somali a long time ago and I found their food confusing. I would assume they right next to Ethiopia they would eat someone of the same cuisine despite being predominantly Muslim but it's somewhat the same? It's particular restaurant feels more of a hole in the wall for East African Somali. It was like that with the other restaurant I went to long ago. Most people would consider this dirty ambience for it being a hole in the wall. But I decided to give this one up north a try. The menu had very limited selection I ordered one dish which is served with pasta which I thought was weird. I don't know if it's bad authentic? Other than that I'm just waiting for them to cook and I had a pomegranate drink that's halal. Do Note it looks like they don't have air conditioning. So I can't imagine coming here in the summertime to eat with just a fan well. I just learned Mussolini also invaded Somalia also which is why they had assimilated to some dishes especially pasta. The food was actually pretty decent especially using angel hair pasta I was surprised that they had spices to it. Which made it spicy hot. The owner gave a complimentary tea served hot which was good sweet. It has a spicy aftertaste to fight the sweetness. I would have to come here again for the breakfast time to try their version of Somalia injera since they only eat it for breakfast unlike Ethiopia they eat inejera every day when I was there. The only the owner said that Somalian injera taste different. I wonder if they use the same ingredients such as tef grain? Despite their limited dishes do give it a try especially the pasta surprisingly I will come back for goat dish or breakfast Somalian injera

I ordered a goat rice dish and was amazed! Incredibly juicy and tender meat, with generous portions if veggies and side dishes (they go very nice together). The rice was absolutely amazing! And they had complimentary raspberry juice as well!! All for a VERY affordable price. What a gem!

Delicious, beautiful food with a welcoming owner. I had the beef ribs that are fresh and never frozen (only available on Wednesdays) with salad and a side of seasoned rice that came with beans, cabbage, and vegetables. The hot sauce is delicious and Hot! Everything was exceptional. The plating and presentation were beautiful. The ambience was welcoming, crisp, clean, and modern. 10 out of 10. will definitely be back!

Hidden Gem!!! Food lovers alert! This place is simply amazing! Food is authentic, tasty and delicious. Quantity and quality both are great! If you would like to try halal African food then please give this place a try! Also don’t forget to try their black tea! Just amazing!
They have customer parking area as well!

This was such an amazing place! The food is phenomenal! You really do feel like you were eating mom or grandma‘s home-cooked food. It is so homey and the best type of soul food anyone can ever have. The portions are huge the price is so fair and the owners are just so friendly and sweet. We came here and told him just give us a mix of what you have right now and we got the rice, beans, potato, spinach, and beef and goat with the spaghetti noodles and it was soooooooo good.
The owner was so sweet and gave us this spiced tea to end it off and even the tea was delicious!!
Top 5 yummiest meals I ever had in my life. Way better than any $200 steak dinner I ever had. Seriously you need to go here and try it. It will change your life.

formatted_address: 3358 Main St, Skokie, IL 60076, United States
name: Mrskays Kitchen

reviews.text: Mrs Kays Kitchen feels like a true taste of home! The food is rich, flavorful, and freshly prepared — just what you’d expect from authentic Nigerian cooking. The jollof rice and plantain are delicious, the abula too and the soups are full of bold spices. The staff are warm and welcoming, making the whole experience even better. Whether you’re Nigerian or just trying the cuisine for the first time, this place is definitely worth a visit!

it was a culinary experience like no other! The aromas, flavors, and warmth of the space transported me to the heart of Africa. The jollof rice, suya, and fufu were all expertly prepared, and the hospitality was top-notch.

I ordered abula for pickup .
Only for my husband to pick up & come back with amala & red stew or whatever this is. I paid $30 for this. After calling to complain about my dinner being ruined, she denied them giving me the wrong order. After sending her video & pic proof, she then rudely texted me to pack it & bring for a refund. As in? I’m I going to eat it and collect a refund? Then she offered to send uber to my residence to collect the food?? More worried about collecting the plate back than acknowledging my concerns?!? As a restaurant, do u plan to sell the food to the next customer or eat it? I’m truly concerned and would like to know.
Rude & Unruly, clearly an uneducated person claiming to run a business. Cause if you were educated, you wouldn’t be texting me rubbish after SENDING ME WHATEVER IT WAS !! I plan to package it and take it back to her for my money. BEWARE, Hopefully she doesn’t just package it and sell it to the next person.

First timer!
A little let down. 2pm and EVERY pastry (meatpie, eggroll, fishroll ...)on the menu  - not available, moimoi - not available, one spoon to dish pretty much everything! Nevermind cross contamination with fish (allergic to it) and multiple times requested another spoon be used until eventually obliged. Lady was pleasant enough but can serve quicker (glad not to have been the next customer).
I was a to-go, environment however appeared clean enough on first glance while waiting.
Meal was tasty, only portion worth its price in my opinion was the Abula. In addition to not being local, I doubt I will go back even if in the neighborhood.
Mrs kays kitchen is a vibrant hub of community and culture, and I left feeling full and inspired. If you get the chance to visit, don't hesitate - it's a taste of Africa you'll never forget

formatted_address: 3311 W Bryn Mawr Ave, Chicago, IL 60659, United States
name: Chez Adele

reviews.text: We had a wonderful time going for the first time for a friend’s birthday. Our server Micky was so friendly and accommodating! The owner generously comped some drinks for us as first time customers. The plantains with the onion-forward dipping sauce were phenomenal. The Brussels sprouts had a lovely balsamic glaze topped with creamy goat cheese. Several of us ordered burgers with side salads, and the greens were of high quality. The standard vinaigrette offered was a wonderful blend of tangy and subtlety sweet. The smash burger patties were cooked well with crisp edges while maintaining a juicy interior. The garlic parm fries had a crisp exterior and fluffy texture. Everything was phenomenal, and Micky even helped us with the cake our friend made and brought. Do yourself a favor and come check this spot out!

Went for anniversary and staff was so sweet and kind!!! They were so fun and you can tell they care a lot about the food and customers. The food itself was so good- def recommend the burger!
Wanted fried plantains but we went during brunch so it wasn’t available- they were so kind and made it for us anyway :’). It was also delicious! Thank you so much to Bart and the rest of the team for a great start to our day (I will be thinking about that rum cake all year).

The food, service, and everything was incredible! I highly recommend Chez Adele. This was one of the best smash burgers I’ve ever had. We also had the chimmichuri chicken sandwich, which was PHENOMENAL!! The chicken was extremely flavorful and had a great crisp. I will be coming back!!

Went here for Happy Hour on the Thursday. A few of my friend's were there ahead of me and ordered wings. I wanted to order wings, too, but for some reason they didn't have anymore. So, I decided to order the plantains. I was expecting them to be flattened but they were cubes. Regardless, they were plentiful and good. I wanted something else so I asked for the Deviled eggs on the Happy Hour menu. Its two sliced eggs but the flavors were delicious!  Its a must try. The super nice waitress was telling me about the West African spice used and that I need to try it on another dish they serve. Next time!  For drinks I had their margarita, plain and one mango, which were decent. The vibe of the place was also cool: clean and modern. The 90s R&B and Hip Hop Music was bumpin. I plan on returning soon.

10/10 - I definitely recommend.

Bart was extremely welcoming as soon as we walked in. The atmosphere and music were perfect after a long day of driving

We ordered the Brussel Sprouts and Plaintains for appetizers. They came out perfectly hot and absolutely delicious.

I also ordered the house sangria, which was perfectly balanced and refreshing.

I ordered the Mr. Blue burger with a side of fries. The burger was perfectly flavorful and juicy. The bleu cheese was even and balanced with the rest of the toppings, so it wasn't overwhelming.

I can't wait to visit again!

formatted_address: 3933 N Broadway, Chicago, IL 60613, United States
name: Amici-Chicago

reviews.text: This restaurant is excellent. I had the arincini flight and it was amazing. My favorite was the dorotino which tasted great with its sauce. Then the birria had a great chipotle pepper dipping sauce. The jerk chicken one also was great with the dipping sauce. The masala one was my least favorite but I don't think it was bad just not to my preference. Also the veggie bowl was perfect. Very flavorful and well cooked. Would recommend. Next time I come I'm looking forward to trying the other flavors. They also had very great customer service and the workers were very nice.

We drove a long way to find this place! My son found them on Tik Tok and had to try them b4 flying back home for the holidays. They did not disappoint.  He got the flight, while I got their veggie bowl.  We both left no crumbs. Great experience  👍🏾

This was simply amazing, if you're wondering what to get I'd suggest getting the flight which gives you your choice of 4 with two sides. We settled on jerk, original, birria, and doro and all of them were very good. I am still debating which one I liked best. There are more options of sides but I settled with fries and pasta salad which were both delicious. The service was amazing the two gentlemen there checked on me multiple times and also did so to others sitting around. This is definitely a must have.

Wow, this place is great! If you love arancini, you’re in for a treat. Amici serves up delicious Sicilian rice balls in a variety of global flavors. Arancini are crispy, golden-fried balls of risotto, often stuffed with cheese, meat, or other flavorful fillings, making them the perfect combination of crunchy and creamy.

At Amici, you can get a full-size arancini (try the classic Italian arancino) for $8, which comes with a side. Or, if you want to mix and match, go for five smaller arancini with two sides for $20. Sides include fries, house salad, pasta salad, or corn salad.

The atmosphere is small and the service very friendly. Perfect for a casual date night or a relaxed meal with friends. A true gem of a local spot!

SO delicious. When eating here, you will be eating food that is hot and fresh. My friend and I tried the curry and classic arancinis with macaroni salad and everything was so delicious. Owner was also kind enough to give us a try of the jerk bowl which was PHENOMENAL!!!! So flavorful and delicious- will definitely be ordering next time. If you want delicious food that tastes home cooked, this is your place!

formatted_address: 22 S Wabash Ave Ste B1, Chicago, IL 60603, United States
name: Nando's PERi-PERi

reviews.text:
The chicken here is super good 🍗 really fresh and tasty. They’ve got a bunch of sides too and everything I tried hit the spot :) definitely one of my fave spots to eat in the Loop now. Place is clean, service is quick, and they’ve got tons of sauces to pick from

also, didn’t expect the brownie to be that good but wow :0 you have to try it!!! only downside: the kids meal portions are kinda ridiculous, super tiny

Where has this been all my life????
The chicken was excellent. Juicy and tasty.  The sauces were fun to try and Im buying a few bottles to take home. The sangria was also excellent. Tip: get the cauliflower side.

Good casual go-to chicken spot with nice menu options and nice servers. Really enjoyed the nata custard and halloumi. Fries were well seasoned, crunchy, and not greasy. Chicken wingers were good but could’ve used some salt and sauces could’ve had more of a kick. Would like to try more chicken nice time!

Beautiful inside, totally unexpected from the street. Food was fine, especially the specialty, the  chicken and it's house sauce. Loved to find vinho verde, not that common. The service set-up was a bit weird, though: you need to order at the counter or on your phone, although there are waiters bringing your plates or cleaning up the tables. This gives a taste of a fast food restaurant, which it should not be (despite being a chain).
Great food! The chicken had amazing flavor, and you can try different sauces—the spicy one is my favorite. The staff was attentive, and the place was very clean.

formatted_address: 3804 W 16th St, Chicago, IL 60623, United States
name: The Soul Food Lounge

reviews.text:
Yall when I tell you I'm so glad I decided to get up and out on this cold day to have brunch with my friend.  My goodness
It's a beautiful, clean, quaint establishment.  There's good music 🎶 🎵 playing through the speakers that gives it an extra vibe.
We went with the recommendation by our server who was so freaking nice (I can't remember her name) and patient with us.
We had the Creole Seafood Dressing....🫶🏾🤌🏽🙌🏽 it was good.  So sooooo sooooo good.  I mean the greens, sweet potatoes, the catfish, yall just go try it.  Everything was good and they gave nice size portions.  The chefs 👨🏽‍🍳 👩🏾‍🍳Melvin and Shawn yall did that and continue to Keep doing it 🔥🔥we will be back.
Ooh wait I forgot they have the pound cake dessert.... smh smh you smelled the goodness as soon as it hit the table. I forgot to take a picture

The food here is phenomenal. The last time I had a meal cooked with this much love, skill, and talent was Thanksgiving 1984, only my dearly departed Grandmother cooked this well.

The ingredients are top-notch, the food is seasoned at every step of the cooking process (if you know, you know), the atmosphere is great, and the service is exemplary.

I ordered the seafood dressing, which comes with two catfish fillets,real American catfish, either fried or blackened. The yams were perfection with a hint of citrus, and yams aren't even my favorite, but these were exceptional. I could eat a bowl of them. The greens were perfectly seasoned, light, and flavorful. The dressing steals the show: perfectly prepared cornbread stuffing with grilled and seasoned shrimp and crawfish. This meal was like the best Thanksgiving ever.

My companion ordered the fried chicken, which comes with two slices of caramelized pound cake! The chicken is well-seasoned and juicy. The potatoes are seemingly twice-fried and delicious. The sweet and spicy sauce on the chicken is delicate and flavorful.

Speaking of delicate, the mango lemonade was not overly sweet or tart. It's flavored with mango but not overpowered by it.

BEST DAMN BIRTHDAY BECAUSE OF THE SOUL FOOD LOUNGE! The service…the ambience…the music…the presentation A1! But bsbyyyy the servers were the absolute BEST SERVERS I’ve ever had the pleasure of interacting with. Jennifer and Will made this experience UNMATCHED. Jennifer was so fun and guarantee hospitable and Will was a complete gentleman and so charismatic!  Then…came…the..FOOD! THE FOOOOOD!!! Omg. We had the Grand Tasting which is their entree sampler. We weren’t even able to knock a dent in our dishes! Complementary wine or champagne cane with the Tasting. And every single dish was phenomenal!! I have never dined and been this excited about the experience. Listen, this is the first Google review I’ve ever written! The Soul Food Lounge is a gem right in the heart of North Lawndale and if you haven’t been you HAVE TO GO! I’ll be back and I’m bringing reinforcements!! Thank you Jennifer and Will for making our birthdays so special.

The atmosphere was OK. Kind of small, and the decor was drab. The food was tasty. The Creole Seafood Dressing was good, but I think the dressing could be cooked a little longer. While we were there, they ran out of champagne and forgot one of our dishes. The chef was apologetic and made the dish to go. I will try the Beverly location soon.

Jennifer was an excellent server providing insight into The Grand Tasting. The food was better than expected. If you are divided on what to get try the Grand Tasting. A guitarist was playing live. His selections of songs was on point. The price is worth the value. Nothing was disappointing.  Bathroom was well maintained.  Everyone thanks upon leaving.

formatted_address: 1447 E 53rd St, Chicago, IL 60615, United States
name: Nando's PERi-PERi

reviews.text: Food was very good, however, they are severely understaffed. They served half of our food quickly but the other half after 25 more minutes. When asked them if they can replace the cold food they just told they can’t.
I heard about this place but u wasn’t ready for how it exceeded expectations! The food tastes home cooked but better, drinks strong and tasty! Dessert was delicious!

The most horrible peri peri chicken and service I've ever had😔. They served me uncooked chicken twice in the same order. I told u well done chicken, u messed that up. Cone back inside tell u. U cook it again wow go to car check food it's bleeding now I'm late back off lunch and I'm still hungry. Claim to give refund but didn't receive it. Never going back horrible service. Whoever was on duty today at 830pm needs to be fired.
ABSOLUTELY LOVE THE FOOD HERE. Doesn’t break the budget & is so flavorful!! 10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

Just tried for the first time and will definitely be back. The folks at the counter were very friendly, food was ready quickly, and the chicken was delicious. Fall off the bone tender and the sauce was very tasty. Only tiny knock is the X hot was not very hot, not sure if there was a mix up or not but ultimately a non factor. Good food at good price.

formatted_address: 4834 N Cumberland Ave, Norridge, IL 60706, United States
name: Tasty World Restaurant (aka Tasty Savor)

reviews.text: The food was SOO0000000 good and the workers were so nice. The lady that welcomed us was so kind and was very excited to have us there! The portions were so big and the food was so cheap. I got the fufu and egusi soup and it was the most delicious thing I've ever had. The restaurant was very cozy. Overall amazing experience and will 100% go back!!!!! :)

We loved our experience, the owner was so nice and welcoming. My 72 yr old Mexican mom whom doesn’t usually likes anyone’s cooking, LOVED everything that we had. The food is seasoned to perfection and so fresh. We will definitely be back soon.

One of if not the most homiest places i’ve ever aten at, this place feels like a third home and the owner is one of the kindest people ever, it was my first time ever trying Nigerian food, and she wanted that moment to definitely be an experience. Overall was a 5 clean plates out of 5. Would eat again, p.s don’t miss out on the jollof rice.

The owner is literally the nicest person you might ever meet, the hospitality is unmatched the jolof rice itself is one of my favorite things on the menu. I've eaten atleast half the menu and plan to do the rest as well soon.

Much love 🙏

The woman we spoke to while waiting for our food was incredibly sweet and welcoming. Our wait was short AND she gave us a drink during it. 10/10 hospitality The food was amazing, seasoned and cooked perfectly. For my first time trying Nigerian food it has exceeded my standards and I’m excited to have it again.

formatted_address: 953 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60607, United States
name: Nando's PERi-PERi

reviews.text:
Food is tasty and affordable, the price let me think this might be a fast food restaurant, but it is way beyond it.

Chicken is juicy and cooked right on the point
The dining atmosphere is also great, very spacious and I like its decoration
Servers are also very friendly

Highly recommend

Very delicious and fresh chicken. They have a sauce bar with over 10 different yummy sauces to try. They have rotating seasonal sides as well which makes it more interesting for those who like to order and eat the same things frequently. Their mango aqua frescas are to die for!!! Sweet and tart and so refreshing! It’s a good restaurant for take outs and casual dining with no reservations required!

Nando's is one of my favorite restaurants. I don't normally eat red meat, so chicken is a common protein in my diet. I get their medium-level spiciness sauce and their mashed potatoes are AMAZING! I always have my SHAZAM app open in the restaurant too because the music is fun and upbeat. I love the way it is decorated in there too. I have never been to the African continent, but if I ever get to go, Mozambique is on my list of countries to visit simply because of the peri peri spice.
Went to Nando’s today and had the boneless chicken breast with mac and cheese and fries — absolutely delicious! Nando’s never disappoints. Please open a location in Fort Worth, TX!
It's great meal. It is pricey but damn it tastes so good with the hot spicy sauce

formatted_address: 3517 N Spaulding Ave, Chicago, IL 60618, United States
name: Stew Fusion By OmoOba

reviews.text: They are closed and Google needs to update certain locations of businesses as well!! This is last time I let Google map send me off! Make sure u call before you go and damn I was hungry !!

reviews.author_name: Adeola Odudayo Jas kehinde Ajob Odunuyi-berry (Fine Angel No Pimples)

formatted_address: 7600 N Bosworth Ave, Chicago, IL 60626, United States
name: Prince Corner African Restaurant

reviews.text: The best place to order if you’re in Chicago

formatted_address: 7301 N Ridge Blvd, Chicago, IL 60645, United States
name: Ese’s kitchen

reviews.text: Food was very nice exceeded my expectations. At the moment only take out available.

Ese sharwama is sooooooooo nice! I ate all and I’m ordering another set. The zobo drink is so natural and I love how she doesn’t add sugar so it’s super healthy. Thankyou dear! I’m coming for more ❤️❤️❤️💋
Amazing food by Ese.The food was super tasty and the service top notch.One of the best African food vendors in the Chicago land area
Good service and well customer oriented. She keep too time..
Literally the best shawarma place in Chicago!!!

formatted_address: 3001 W Peterson Ave, Chicago, IL 60659, United States
name: Obalende Suya

reviews.text:
I ordered the jollof rice combo with suya, and it absolutely delivered.

The jollof rice was rich, smoky, and well-seasoned the kind that tastes like it was made with intention. Every bite had that familiar homemade food flavor you don’t find just anywhere. The suya definitely standout: perfectly grilled, tender, and coated with teh perfect suya spice. Every food tasted fresh off the grill. Portions were solid, the food arrived hot, and the quality was consistent all the way through.

If you’re looking for real Nigerian flavors in Chicago especially jollof and suya done properly Obalende Suya is a must. This is the kind of place you bring friends to when you want them to understand why Nigerian food is special.

I’ll definitely be ordering again.

formatted_address: 1023 W Wilson Ave, Chicago, IL 60640, United States
name: Michuu Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
First time here, and I wasn't disappointed. I was in need of a new Ethiopian spot in and found Michuu. You are greeted with an Ethiopian coffee set at the front which I would've ordered if I didn't have to wake up early tomorrow.

Got myself the Veggie Platter and 2 lentil Sambusas. The crispyness of the lentils made me devour it before it can cool down, and when the Veggie Platter arrived, I knew I was in for a good time. Of all the toppings on the platter, I am the biggest fan of beetroot, cabbage, and chickpeas.

On a cold afternoon on a day I'm free, I'm definitely taking friends here for some crispy sambusa, delectable platters, and enjoy coffee from its original birthplace.

We ordered 4 dishes.

Yemisir Wot: amazing 5/5

Dora Wat: also amazing 5/5

Yebeg Tibs: solid dish but missing the complexity of the above two. A little flat. 4/5

Zil-Zil Tibs: a bit chewy beef and more like a simple stir fry. Missing all the spices the other first 2 dishes had. 3/5

Service was great.
Delicious, authentic food. A terrific cultural experience. We especially enjoyed the coffee ceremony where she roasted the coffee beans herself and served it with a wonderful incense.
Delicious! Injera was especially good and freshly made. Doro wat was excellent. Clearly a family-run business. Met the chef who takes great pride in her cooking. Highly recommend.

JUST HAD THE MOST TREMENDOUS Ethiopian Food! The place, unbelievable - injera, so soft, so fresh – look at this plate!

Big portions, incredible flavors, truly authentic. The music, not fake music, REAL Ethiopian music, very cool! And food so healthy! This place is a WINNER! GO THERE!

formatted_address: 171 S Schmale Rd, Carol Stream, IL 60188, United States
name: Ethio Beans Ethiopian Restaurant and Cafe

reviews.text:
Dining at Ethio Beans is a warm and flavorful journey into the heart of Ethiopian cuisine. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels inviting, with rich spices and comforting aromas already setting the stage for what’s to come.

The dishes are beautifully prepared, vibrant in color, and bursting with authentic flavor. Each plate is layered with tradition, from perfectly seasoned stews to the soft, spongy injera that ties the meal together. Portions are generous, and everything feels thoughtfully crafted to highlight the best of Ethiopian cooking.

One of the highlights comes at the end of the meal: their delightful homemade tea. Served steaming and fragrant, the tea carries incredible aromatics that fill the room with a soothing blend of spices. It’s the perfect finish—light, refreshing, and deeply comforting—making the dining experience feel complete.

First time trying Ethiopian food. It was an experience of eating food without utensils and new cuisine. The food was really good for its price as well! They shared the culture of Ethiopia 🇪🇹. Very friendly. Would definitely visit again.

Just left the restaurant! I went with my stepmom. This was my second time having Ethiopian food and I am very grateful that such an amazing place is near my home. We had tea and harar beer, both of which were stellar. I don't think I've ever had such good tea. Our server told us that the tea and coffee at Ethio Beans are the best and I must agree. The tea had cloves, cinnamon, and cardamom. I'm not much of a tea guy, especially not a hot tea guy, but I finished all the tea when my stepmom had enough. The injera was perfect, dark and almost like sourdough. I got the beef tebes and it was phenomenal, extra spicy with more powdered spice in a dish to sprinkle on, as well a pea or bean paste on the side. That was really really good. It wasn't too spicy at all! My stepmom had the tegabino shiro and it came out in a stoneware pot, boiling! You can tell they put great care and pride in the food they serve, and everyone we spoke to was friendly and open to chatting with us. The whole experience was great, and I can't wait to come back!
Super tasty food and coffee, I recommend getting a platter or getting multiple dishes to share so that you can try some of everything. Nice environment and seats and very nice staff.

Ethio Beans is a superior restaurant for a novel gustatory and olfactory stimulus. This restaurant has served delicious food to use and the service was outstanding. We got the platter and their menu was very modifiable. We were able to add additional sides to the platter and the host was very kind. Highly recommended!!

formatted_address: 211 W Walton St, Chicago, IL 60610, United States
name: المطعم الصومالي

reviews.text: Great Food

formatted_address: 4807 N Elston Ave, Chicago, IL 60630, United States
name: Zahra's Yemeni Kitchen

reviews.text: Food was super good! There was so much food- and for the price? You can’t beat it! I forgot how much it was but the portion for the chicken was so much you can feed three people. Definitely get the tea because it is a staple- Bring cash! Street parking is available unless you go late at night past the hours of operation (then it’s free!)

Zahra's Yemeni Kitchen is a hidden gem! The food is absolutely delicious and showcases the authenticity of Arab culture in every dish. From fragrant spices to homemade bread, each bite is a delightful journey through Yemeni flavors. The warm, inviting atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to share a meal with friends or family. I highly recommend trying their signature dishes—you won’t be disappointed!

We tried the Chicken Zurbian & Lamb Mutabbaq and it was very delicious and fresh. Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone in the area because the owner is friendly, service is good, and the food is all flavorful and quality!

Good food, orderbonline but did not even prep it. I guess because I  did not orderbin Arabic?!
They CREATION bread stuffed with cheese and Chicken... Just a roll quesedilla, yes tortilla with cheese and spices... REALLLYYYY????
No music no vibe, Pita bread was cold, no salt, lamb was great . recomand only to go if the make your order

The only mildly bad thing I'll say is that the service was a bit lax. Not too much urgency, a bit laid back. But that did make me feel more at home. The vibe was very welcoming and incredibly friendly. We ordered 2 dishes and they were both delicious and very filling. The serving sizes on the Biryani and hummus were more than worth the price. The Biryani especially is more of a serving for 2, no complaints there. Can't wait to go back.

formatted_address: 6258 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60660, United States
name: Laa Mushkila Restaurant

reviews.text: OMG…I’ve never had Somali food until today and   this place has some of the best food I have ever tasted.  Everything is fresh and you can they take pride in their food.  If you’ve never had it, like myself, I strongly recommend this place on the real. Lamb is tender, the rice uh let me quit not a lot of views but it should have more.  Trust me they won’t disappoint.

So good! We had breakfast here and specified vegan/vegetarian. The dish with beans (foul?) and the vegetable dish were both amazing. The bread was thin like injera bread but different, a little sweeter,
The staff person also brought us some oatmeal and spinach to try and that was great, too.

Absolutely delicious. Every single thing we ordered was so good. Felt like a home cooked meal. I don’t think there’s anyone that wouldn’t like Somali food. If you’re with family I suggest doing take out though

Tried Laa Mushkila for the first time and it was fire. Got the beef suqaar with rice and a sambusa on the side—came out to around $20. Portions were big, flavors were on point, and the rice was super fragrant. Place is chill and feels like a neighborhood spot. Only reason it’s not 5 stars is the wait was kinda long, but worth it. Definitely pulling up again soon.

Simple and delicious! It's a modest and simple building so they've put all the energy into the amazing food. They were super friendly and explained what everything is, and everyone enjoyed their food a lot! Goat stew, lamb, chicken... it's was all excellent and we'll be back.

formatted_address: devon and fairfield, #60645, Chicago, IL 60645, United States
name: Desi Boyz Catering

reviews.text: I liked their somali and Indian food specially biryani and the lamb haneeth

formatted_address: 2847 N Oakland Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53211, United States
name: Immys African Cuisine

reviews.text: Hands down amazing. This place has definitely shown me that you can’t perceive taste. My first experience in person and the food was divine. I love the Coconut Chicken Curry and Goat Curry. Each dish is simmered in a flavorful sauce that pairs heavenly with the fufu. The jollof rice was spiced perfectly. Definitely recommend.

Lovely restaurant featuring excellent Eastern African fare 🇺🇬🇰🇪. The Samosas are excellent,  both Egusis, the coconut curry, and the Fufu all very delicious. Uganda is famous for their plaintains, and her they are exceptional.  Very friendly staff, quick service in a nice atmosphere.  Highly recommended! They also have kiosks at festivals such as Bastille Days and Holiday Folk Fair.

Over priced for sure, $70 for mostly chicken parts.  And not full pieces!!! Food is mostly spicy and not much flavor past that. Best item was red spicy beef. Jollof rice was average. Food comes as cups of stew/soup. I can get better value elsewhere. Unfortunate observation.
Tony was very nice and helped me out picking a few foods to try. Got me right with some fufu, chicken egusi, goat curry, and jollof rice. All was very delicious love it
Use to be my favorite egusi spot, but lately their egusi is extra watery and no thickness to it. So I just have a bowl of water and beef. Happened to me twice in 2 weeks.

formatted_address: 908 Ogden Ave Unit A, Lisle, IL 60532, United States
name: LE BON BON GRILL

reviews.text:
Le Bon Bon was absolutely incredible! I went with a large group, and from the moment we walked in, the owners made us feel like we were dining in their own home.

Now, let’s talk about the food. We ordered the beef kabobs, chicken kebabs, whole grilled chicken, fried tilapia, and lamb chops — all served with delicious sides. Every single dish had its own unique flavor and was packed with taste. The lamb chops were tender, juicy, and perfectly seasoned. The grilled whole chicken, topped with a spicy-sweet sauce, was charbroiled to perfection — crispy on the outside and succulent inside.

And whatever you do — don’t sleep on the Bon Bon Juice and the plantains! They’re the perfect sides 😍 and tie the whole meal together.

Each bite truly elevated my taste buds. Huge thanks to the Le Bon Bon team for their warmth and hospitality. Highly recommend giving these guys your support — they’ve earned it!

Food is outstanding. Everything is made fresh and didn’t leave me feeling heavy despite being fried. I appreciate that it’s gluten free. I had the tilapia meal deal and bon bon drink. My friend had the chicken. We all had rice, fries and salad. Everything was flavorful. The owner is extremely friendly. We will definitely return and encourage locals to support this small business.

A halal restaurant. We had dinner there and food was awesome. I really want to mention the staff in the shop, they are amazing and presented very well. There is menu deals available apart from their normal which is a good try. We can get different spice levels with their grilled chicken too. Overall, this place is recommended

The food here is so yummy. My husband brought it home then I had to drive all the way to lisle just to get again the second day lol. The roasted chicken is so good both flavor and texture. My toddler is a picky eater but he will always finish his plate here.

Everything I've tried here has been delicious, but the lamb chops and the plantains are exceptional. The cook does a great job with the meat and is quite liberal in the application of garlic butter. It's decadent in the best way.

formatted_address: 18201 Dixie Hwy ste b, Homewood, IL 60430, United States
name: HOMEWOOD AFRICAN FOOD FACTORY & GRILL

reviews.text: I've been wanting to try African cuisine for a super long time and I think I happened on a gem. I had the goat pepper soup and it was amazing I added fufu and was surprisingly delighted. The service was okay cashier should try to be a little more personable but whatever. The food made up for it

Authentic African Cuisine! As an American, if you have never been to Africa, you can not truly rate this place. I am an American fresh from the motherland, and when I say I found the perfect representation of the food that I ate in Nigeria. Tasty and fresh! My order: Egusi Soup (No Peppe sauce added on top), Cow Leg, Beef tripe, Ofada stew, Chicken fried rice, and Pounda yam. Even had leftovers!!!
Clean environment and excellent customer service! I will definitely be back o 🇳🇬🇺🇸. Bye for now ☺️❤️
It was delicious. However, the 1 piece of goat meat was tuff and undercooked for my 65 yr old teeth. I will go back and try other dishes

No lie I was expecting this for a while always wanting to try it out.maybe it’s the taste expectation I had for the egusi and fufu I know fufu not suppose to have taste but the egusi was bland with just spice heat to it. The beef pie tasted like their kitchen and not the good kind. The food was completely horrible that I had to throw away almost 50 dollars worth of food away. I tried to keep eating it but the more I kept trying to bite into it the more I wanted to throw up just from the smell. The serving size for that was not a good amount. It looked like someone ate half the food and for egusi and fufu and beef pie with a can of soda $45 ? Crazy work idk if yall just played me or what…. But that’s crazy amount for a crazy amount of bad tasting food. The smell the food has lingering on it is just enough to make you want to throw up. Never again, so disappointed in the taste more than wasting my money :(

I came here with my friend a while back and we loved it! The food was so delicious and the two gentlemen behind the counter were both friendly. We both got jollof rice with 4 pieces of chicken and I ordered some puff puff. Every bite was so good and one of the workers was friendly enough to bring me some food I had forgotten at the counter. It was quiet in the restaurant with some sports being played on the TV. Customers going in and out for pick up orders. We were able to stay and talk for a while without hassle, which means a lot to a couple of friends who don’t get to see each other all the time. We will definitely be back.

formatted_address: 2045 Atwood Ave STE 109, Madison, WI 53704, United States
name: Les délices de Awa

reviews.text: Delicious food and amazing service! We had the beef pastels, poulet braise with jollof rice, grilled lamb with plantain and sorrel juice. Everything was amazing, fresh and flavorful. We’ll be back!

Admittedly on a busy Saturday evening, but waited 50 minutes after ordering (at the front counter) to be served. Served us water, but no one ever asked what we wanted to drink. Then our sides had been mis-matched, so we switched them back ourselves. The chicken was OK but the lamb was two thin tough, bony grizzly pieces and one thicker piece, bloody inside. We had to get to a concert, so ate what we could. Plantain and couscous ok, "mixed vegetables" were  chopped and cold in a plastic container. Not the quality we expected for this price level. It was very loud and cramped.  And please fix those 2 tables' legs so the tables stop rockin!

Great, cozy decor. The food was delicious - we started with akara, the black-eyed pea fritters, which were hot, fresh, and fluffy with a mild taste.

I had the Poulet Braise, and a bite of the fabulous and tender lamb. The chicken was bone-in, which is less usual for me but almost definitely more authentic. The spices were subtle but delicious, and the chicken was impeccably grilled: it tasted like the fire, without the meat losing any tenderness or moisture. I had the attieke as my side, because I know I like couscous but wanted to try it made from cassava. Absolutely fantastic, and paired really well with the chicken.

We had the ginger juice, which was lovely, and the tea, which was a bit like Yaupon and earthy so something you definitely need to be in the mood for.

We also went in on a slammed Saturday night, when they were already short staffed, and the service was still great.

We enjoyed a delicious meal provided by a lovely crew of folks! We all ordered the lamb and it did not disappoint. The plantain was perfect, and the beef savory pasties were excellent. Will definitely be back!

This was a very great African food restaurant, I love the hibiscus juice, and the aroma in the air is amazing. I would highly recommend dining in here. But save me a seat haha. The Jollof rice 👩🏽‍🍳💋 there are so many options I have to go back for more. Portions are great, everything great!

formatted_address: Emirates Financial Towers - Zaa'beel Second - DIFC - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
name: KIZA Restaurant & Lounge - Pan African Cuisine

reviews.text:
The place is elegant and welcoming, with a lovely atmosphere and great music that makes you feel right at home.
The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, especially Farida, who greeted us with a big smile and took care of us throughout our meal.
The food was absolutely delicious, every dish beautifully prepared.
It was a fantastic experience from start to finish! we’ll definitely be coming back! ❤️

I had an exceptional experience at this restaurant. From the moment I arrived, the service was warm, attentive, and truly professional. The food was absolutely perfect  beautifully presented, full of flavour, and prepared with great care. The atmosphere was relaxing and elegant, making the whole experience even better.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality, comfort, and outstanding service. I will definitely be coming back.

My friend and I had an amazing time at this African restaurant! The place is elegant and welcoming, with a lovely atmosphere and great music that makes you feel right at home.
The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, especially Farida, who greeted us with a big smile and took care of us throughout our meal.
The food was absolutely delicious, the meat was so tender and flavorful, every dish beautifully prepared. We also fell in love with the non-alcoholic drink they made for us, so refreshing and perfectly balanced!
It was a fantastic experience from start to finish! we’ll definitely be coming back! ❤️❤️

KIZA is truly the heart of African vibes in Dubai! From the moment you walk in, the energy, music, and warm hospitality make you feel right at home. The food is absolutely delicious — full of authentic African flavors, perfectly seasoned, and beautifully presented. The staff are friendly and attentive, always making sure you’re having a great time.

The music and live performances bring such an incredible atmosphere — it’s the perfect spot to relax, dance, and enjoy good company. Whether you’re going for dinner, drinks, or a night out, KIZA never disappoints. Definitely one of the best places in the city for a real Afro experience! 🎶🍹🇿🇦🇳🇬🇰🇪

We were a group of 14 in Dubai for my sister’s 50th birthday. Kiza staff were exceptional. They went above and beyond, the food was phenomenal to the point we made it our mission to come back before our flights, and they even provided a cake complimentary and turned our lunch into a grand birthday celebration. 10/10 would come here again again and again. My personal favs were the pepper soup, the meat platter, kelewele, and the eforiro!!! The grilled tilapia was also delicious

formatted_address: 507 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77006, United States
name: ChòpnBlọk

reviews.text: The place has outdoor seating, they take reservations, parking can be a challenge because it is a little small parking lot. When you walk in you aren’t really greeted but make sure you walk up to the front where the register is and then you will be seated. There’s a bar inside so you can sit by the bar. The place feels very elevated and elegant. You can feel the culture experience just by being inside. They look like they won a Michelin award in 2025 rightfully so because the food was mind blowing! I usually don’t even like African food but this place made me change my mind. I tried the black star which is like a savory creamy vanilla bean soup. It came with some purple rice and shrimp in it and plantains. The flavor was unique as they used different spices that I’m use to and I can’t exactly explain it, but it was good. I also got the coconut fried chicken and they were a nice little appetizer. They were crispy and bite sized and came with some tartar sauce like dipping sauce. The service was excellent they came to check on me multiple times.

Amazing first-time experience with incredible food! Our waiter, EJ, was fantastic and even brought us samples of different rices and curries so we could mix and match. Highly recommend asking for this if your server doesn’t offer it.

We made a reservation the night before for patio seating and were so glad we did. Inside felt a bit crowded and loud, while the patio was more relaxed and felt family-friendly if you’re bringing kids.

We ordered the Golden with the Jollof, and the deviled eggs were phenomenal, nothing like traditional deviled eggs. The banana bread was also outstanding, easily some of the best I’ve ever had.

The steak, shrimp, and chicken were prepared perfectly. You get about 6oz of chicken. Nothing was dry or overcooked.

So delicious. Thank you to EJ and the entire ChòpnBlok team. We can’t wait to come back!

Also, we decided to buy a gift card for winners at our Christmas party this year :)

Absolutely amazing experience! The food was phenomenal:
• Deviled Scotch Egg – flavorful and perfectly cooked
• Ikoyi Shrimp – juicy and seasoned to perfection
• Buka with Jollof – smoky, rich, and authentic
• Oga Palmer – refreshing and balanced
The service was top-notch—friendly and attentive staff who know the menu well.
The atmosphere? A1! Beautiful Afrocentric décor, great music, and an inviting vibe.
If you’re looking for bold, authentic West African flavors in Houston, this is the spot. Highly recommend!

First time at ChopNBlok and we loved it. The space is small but beautifully designed with modern Afrocentric art. The staff, from the hostess to the managers, were genuinely warm and helpful. We booked a last-minute patio reservation and it made for a perfect evening. We tried the Bukka with Jollof and the Golden with shrimp, and both were flavorful and delicious. It’s a no brainer, we’ll definitely be back.

YouTube PreettyP,

Came to ChopnBlok for happy hour and it was such a vibe. The drinks were smooth, the food was seasoned perfectly, and everything came out fresh. The atmosphere was cute but chill—perfect for after work or catching up with friends. Service was on point too. I loved it so much I shared my visit on my YouTube channel PreettyP. I’ll definitely be back.

formatted_address: 3706 S Gessner Rd, Houston, TX 77063, United States
name: Kofoshi

reviews.text: Outstanding experience! the food was incredibly delicious, great portion size very authentic Nigerian cuisine. The owner makes all the food fresh with the help of her daughters and you could tell that so much love and passion goes into their food. The seating and the whole experience was very comfortable and I am so glad we took a chance to try out her food. It will definitely be a spot that I come back to when I am in town visiting Houston.

The food was absolutely delicious! We had the goat pepper soup and the efo riro with pounded yam — everything was full of rich, authentic flavor and perfectly seasoned. The owner was so friendly and welcoming, and the hospitality made the experience even better. You can really feel the love and pride they put into their food and service. I’ll definitely be coming back whenever I’m in town!

Yall when I say this is authentic, this is AUTHENTIC!
The owner is such a sweet lady and she makes sure you love your food! We are visiting from Dallas and will be returning when we visit Houston. From the welcome to the atmosphere to the food it’s a 10/10 🤩🤩
Oh and the jams in there are 💯💯
Ese o 🫶
All the dishes were so tasty 😋

The owner was very nice and attentive!! She’s very kind and helped us out on what we wanted to order. The service is amazing here! The food just makes it so much better. The food was phenomenal, it was so good and I genuinely couldn’t stop eating it. I got the Efo Ruro and it was mind blowing. Would definitely come back! The owner is an amazing person and so is the food.

10/10 experience! The food was so good and very authentic! The owner was so kind and she interacted with every person in the restaurant and asked everyone individually how their experience was! I would definitely come back and look forward to seeing success for Kofoshi. I will recommend everyone I know to go to Kofoshi!

formatted_address: 9801 Bissonnet St Suite C, Houston, TX 77036, United States
name: Sarabell Calabar Restaurant & Buffet

reviews.text: Beautifully decorated,  very clean, nice station to wash hands. We went really late, right before closing and a lot of the food was over cooked and dry. The plantains were delicious,  the chicken stew and Jollof rice were great. The future was good. But everything else was dried out and a couple things we tasted the flavors were off. Service was friendly and helpful. We will have to come back and try it early in the day when the food is fresher.

Service was stellar—especially for a Nigerian restaurant. Rene made us feel welcome, staff were friendly and the restaurant was very clean. The buffet had tons of options and we sampled as much as we could…walking away with a huge food belly. Overall, a lovely experience and worth the price.

I was excited to try this buffet. Honestly most of the soups were okay. Although, a bit more flavor would be nice. Also maybe keep the food a little bit more hot throughout the day. I really enjoyed the pepper soup that was my favorite! 10/10. There is a charge if you don’t finish your plates which I think isn’t fair because you cannot force yourself to eat something you don’t like or overeat. The service was great the lady was very hospitable. I honestly would be likely to return due to the cleanliness and service but if it was just for the food I probably wouldn’t recommend.

🌟 SaraBell Restaurant — A Hidden Gem in Houston 🌟
Dining at SaraBell was an absolute treat. From the moment I stepped in, the warm hospitality set the tone for a memorable evening. The staff were genuinely kind, attentive without being intrusive, and made me feel right at home.
The food? Outstanding. Every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor. You can tell the kitchen puts heart into every plate fresh ingredients, thoughtful seasoning, and a clear passion for quality. Whether you’re craving comfort or something a little more refined, Sara Bell delivers.
If you’re in Houston and looking for a place that combines great food, culture, with even better people, Sara Bell ( 9801 Bissonnet street, suite C? Houston, TX) is it. I’ll definitely be back.

Amazing service. The place was very clean and relaxing environment. It was my first time trying this type of food, so I cant comment on quality of that... also a 12oz can of coke was $2.50 that seemed to high for me. But over enjoyed the experience!

formatted_address: 2923 Walnut Bend Ln, Houston, TX 77042, United States
name: Dakar Street Food

reviews.text: This was by far the best jollof rice I have had by a restaurant in the Houston area! The service was great! The wait time for the food was short but it was hot and tasted very fresh. The grill fish was so flavourful!! I had the ginger beer and it was really good! I felt like I was eating in a local spot back home in West Africa!

I had a phenomenal experience at Dakar. I was immediately greeted upon entering the clean establishment. The food was served fresh, quickly, with generous portions. I originally came for the dibi lamb but they don’t start serving that until 5 PM. I ended up going with the lamb chops and my friend had the fish and both were absolutely delicious. The food presentation was exceptional.  I enjoyed the meal so much  I ordered an additional dinner to go. I can’t wait to return and try more dishes here! Please try the hibiscus juice!  This meal was worth every penny.

Went for lunch with coworker today and the food was amazing!🤩 The service was also great! We got two free beverages and a free chicken dish! Everything was full of flavors and the portion is huge. Will definitely come back again

The outside is pretty sketchy.  I'm sure some would be scared lol.  I was offered weed for sale by a lady, she was friendly about it when I declined. Another guy was sitting in front of the dispensary smoking a huge blunt, old school philly style blunt.  No one bothered me I went and got a tea from the corner store as I didn't care for the hibiscus drink I got at Dakar.

So the chick wanted to try something different.  This place has a great rating on yelp so we tried.  The inside is fine large dining area.  Little cloths rack.  Large tv that wasn't playing much just still shots.

We ordered fish, jerk chicken, and lamb.  The lamb was tough as could be.  You gotta fight that lamb to eat it, he ain't going down easy either.  Jerk chicken, little pieces of chard chicken.  Some were edible, and of that some, some were pretty good.

The winner here was the fish.  It came with some very good carmilized onions. Normally I wouldn't think much of onions but these were very good with the rice.  The fish has like a onion citrus marinade.  Its very good.  You need to watch out for bones obviously. But very good.  I had the drink I didn't care for at the start of the meal before food came.  Very strong hibiscus flavor, not a lot of sugar.  So thats when I went on my adventure to the corner store.  All in all I'd go back for the fish.  Go try it, don't be scared of the corner store folk.  They wont bother you.

I will preface this review by saying that the food was incredible - every item that was ordered had lots of flavor and it was incredibly delicious.

However, they have limited menu options as each day they only have specific items available. We came Sunday evening wanting to try their thieboudienne and their yassa but both items were unavailable on Sunday. They only had chicken dibi and poisson braise so that’s what we ended up ordering. We also ordered the fataya (fish empanada) and the soup.

The fataya came with four pieces. It was fantastic and the salsa they served along with the fataya was incredible too. The dibi and poisson were both well seasoned and were big portions. Perfect for sharing. The soup was very earthy and comes with French bread. It was also a pretty sizable portion and good for sharing.

The food overall was amazing and I think if the restaurant were to expand their menu availability and serve more food items on a day to day basis, that would greatly help their business. Additionally, water here costs $2 per bottle so bring your own water.

formatted_address: 9625 Bissonnet St, Houston, TX 77036, United States
name: Afrikiko

reviews.text: Although this place is nestled away, it is awesomely, overwhelming, and flavors and hospitality! I was treated with a visit to this awesome restaurant by my family as I celebrated my 60th birthday this year. Upon arriving to this place, I had read reviews. The reviews were pretty good. As soon as we stepped through the door, we felt like family. It’s as though we showed up to our family‘s house and were sitting and waiting on the freshest, most amazingly prepared meal ever! The food was absolutely amazing. The meat pies, the food, the stews, the soups, the drinks, and rice dishes were extraordinarily delicious. Although we live over 200 miles away, this is a place that is worth the drive. If you are ever in Houston, passing through Houston, or like myself, you live far away, you will be glad to experience such culinary exquisiteness!
Food was extremely delicious. The service and hospitality was excellent.

My boyfriend and I ordered takeout from here a few days ago and it was some of the best food we’ve had. We typically eat from Nigerian restaurants , so this was our first time trying Ghanaian cooking. We ordered Egusi soup and meat pies , the service was quick and kind. We will definitely be back to try more of their menu items. Highly recommend

Afrikiko

This place serves traditional 🇬🇭 Ghana food seems to be a mixture of other beautiful African countries 🌍.  I was greeted very well as I walked into the establishment.  Reminds me so much of my trip to Ghana, I couldn't do anything but enjoy myself inside.  Food was made to order and as the owner told me remember this is America so some of the spices and the things they use are not in the traditional food.  My overall experience was very pleasing and the jollof rice was delicious.  The fried plantains were the grand finale of this meal 🤩.

Delicious food. Amazing and friendly service! And an excellent place for Ghanaian and other African dishes. This place is family owned and you can clearly perceive their delight when you're excited by your meal. I ordered waakye (rice & peas) with fried plantains and goat meat stew. That was absolutely delicious! One friend ordered banku and okro soup, and the other got beans and fried plantains (red red). Their meals were also attractively served, and they confirmed that they were tasty and flavorful too. Check this place out for a fantastic meal experience.
