Oh, I forgot to mention what I ordered, it was the Egusi w/ oatmeal and turkey, but she blessed me with some assorted meat too. I totally recommend this place. Enjoy

formatted_address: 22224 Northwest Fwy Ste. B, Cypress, TX 77429, United States
name: Bantu House

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying African food, and Bantu House absolutely exceeded my expectations! Everything was AMAZING. The guy at the front who took our order was so kind and patient and really helped us decide what to get, which made the experience even better.

We ordered the puff puff, jollof rice, and chimichurri, and every single dish was a 10/10 — perfectly cooked and full of flavor. I will definitely be recommending this place to my friends, and my friend and I already planned to come back to try more items on the menu. Highly recommend!
First time eating here, I ordered to go. Their Ndole is the best I’ve had since I left Cameroon, Very flavorful. The bobolo was very fresh. The portion was great as well. Will definitely be back!!!

Extremely oily egusi soup. Had to drain the oil into a separate bowl. Super salty soup with very tiny meats. If you’re charging close to $30, at least make it worth it.

I have tried this place a couple of times thinking the food taste will get better on the next visit, but honestly they have a lot of work to do. They always serve their meals with little meats. I mean ALWAYS.

It will be beneficial for the Owner to visit other Nigerian or African restaurants especially on the south west side of Houston to see and have an idea on how authentic African food should taste. Some key binding ingredients are missing, which makes the food taste to be off.

Absolutely 5 stars!
I ordered the tilapia and jollof rice for delivery.
The food was incredibly delicious, and the prices are reasonable!

My family and I dined here, and the food was superb, Fresh and perfectly seasoned. The ambience is always welcoming, and the staff answered all our questions. We will definitely be back soon!!

Came back last week, and the food was great! I cannot have enough of their grilled fish and egusi!!

formatted_address: 10571 Synott Rd, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: EJIDE AFRICAN RESTAURANT AND BAR

reviews.text: The truth. Real authentic Nigerian food. If you’re looking for flavor, vibes, and hospitality this is the place. I recommend the catfish pepper soup, efo riro, and designer stew. Honorable mention is their suya. I have a lot of pictures of this place because I’ve been here so many times. That’s how good it is.

I visited Ejide African Restaurant while traveling from the UK, and it was truly one of the highlights of my time in Texas. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with staff who made me feel right at home. The menu offered a fantastic range of authentic African flavors, and every dish I tried was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of taste.

What impressed me most was the attention to detail—the service was attentive without being intrusive, and the team took time to explain dishes and make recommendations. As someone visiting from abroad, I really appreciated that extra touch of hospitality.

The restaurant itself has a vibrant yet relaxed vibe, perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. I would highly recommend Ejide to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in Texas. It’s a place that blends great food with genuine hospitality, and I’ll definitely be returning on my next visit.

O m g I ordered goat meat pepper soup. Wow, tasteful, awesome. I couldn't stop eating.  Customer service is 10 over 10. Prices are very affordable. All sorts of options of food and drinks to pick from. Congratulations, this is perfect. Ambiance is incredible.  Very clean, classy, rich.

My first visit to Ejide was an excellent experience. From the warm service to the flavorful amala and ewedu, everything exceeded my expectations. I even had the chance to meet the owner, who kindly came over to greet me. I’ll definitely be returning!

First time visiting. By far the coolest hostesses I’ve met in Houston thus far. They’re older and very surprised that I spoke Yoruba. As soon as I started teasing them about it taking forever for my catfish to come out they teased me right back and we all laughter together. One of the hostess did Naija style and sold me different necklaces and earrings. I wasn’t offended, I thought it was funny and different vibe in a cool way. Ohhh and the fish was absolutely delicious! I also got the Ayamase (designer stew). I highly recommend and I’ll return.

formatted_address: 16805 Bissonnet St, Richmond, TX 77407, United States
name: Rodo Nigerian Cuisine

reviews.text: THE best Egusi and Efo Riro soup i’ve tried. I’ve had many soups from all sorts of restaurants but none compare to Rodo. The meat is so tender and flavorful. The service is great, everyone is so kind and in a positive mood. If this is your first time trying nigerian food, I recommend coming to Rodo because they will inform you on how to eat the soup. The art and decorations are BEAUTIFUL and the music is amazing. The cleanliness is top tier and it always smells clean in the restaurant. I come here at least once a month despite living far from the area.

First time placing an order and everything went smoothly.  Great customer service and inside the restaurant  is very neat. Picked up my order and the jollof rice was very good, made the way I requested it. Will patronize again,please keep up the good work. You're doing well 👏

I recently visited this Nigerian restaurant in Houston, and my experience was absolutely delightful. The environment was warm and welcoming, with a clean and cozy atmosphere that made me feel right at home.

The food was delicious with authentic Nigerian flavors cooked to perfection. Every dish tasted fresh and well seasoned, truly capturing the essence of traditional Nigerian cuisine.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure customers felt comfortable throughout the meal. Their great customer service added to my overall positive experience.

If you’re looking to enjoy genuine Nigerian food in a pleasant setting with excellent service, I highly recommend Rodo Nigerian Cuisine, Houston Texas.

I have visited a few times, and each time, the food is amazing. I'm very picky about my egusi soup, but theirs didn't disappoint. It was the right level of spicy, and the meat was tender and succulent. The restaurant is always clean and the staff is always pleasant. The food also doesn't take long to come out whenever I place my order.
I am definitely going to be a repeat customer. Very well done!!

This was my first visit I must say everything was great! The restaurant is clean with a nice atmosphere! Ms Elizabeth was kind and helpful! The food was so so so delicious! I ordered the Egusi soup with fish!! 10 out of 10!!!!! I will definitely be going back there! Rodo is my new spot!!

formatted_address: 7035 W Grand Pkwy S #90, Richmond, TX 77407, United States
name: Zongo

reviews.text:
I hadn’t had Ghanaian food like this since high school, and let me just say it was well worth the wait. Every bite brought back memories and then took it up a notch!

I had the waakye, the flavors were rich and deeply satisfying like something straight out of a Ghanaian home kitchen. You can tell the food was made with love and tradition.

The service was just as impressive. Our waiter “Olowodollar” 🌺🤩 was super attentive and made sure we had everything we needed without ever hovering. It’s rare to find that kind of genuine hospitality these days.

If you’ve been craving West African cuisine or just want to try something incredibly flavorful, Zongo is the place. Next time I visit Houston, I’ll definitely stop by.

Traveled a long distance to enjoy this restaurant and it was so worth the drive. Can't recommend just one dish, but the suya meats (goat and chicken) were fabulous.  The flavors made my mouth and soul happy. This is not a place for rushed dining. Ask for Jongo juice too! Music and atmosphere are a relaxed vibe. Thank you to Alex and Laurette for a blessed meal 😉

My niece wanted to try fufu so me and my sister brought her here. What an experience! Food was fresh, homemade and made to order. The plantains were the best any of us had ever had and that’s saying a lot bc we were raised around many islander friends. The owner was so much fun and spoiled us silly. If you’re looking for authentic Ghanaian food that will make your taste buds dance, this is the place!

Man. I was BLESSED to be in the presence of this amazing food. All of us ordered different things and we all were very happy. The flavor profiles of each dish were so deep, simple, yet complex. Special shout out to the greens. I've never had greens taste like that. They were SO good. The steamed rice was amazing. The plantains were amazing. The egg appetizer was amazing. The okra stew was amazing. The tilapia was amazing. The stewed chicken in tomato stew was amazing. The owner came out and made sure we were happy. You can tell she cooks with SO MUCH LOVE. I told my sister "We now know what love tastes like." We were just so pleasantly surprised. Also, Alex was our server. He was sweet and helpful and attentive. I will say, be prepared to wait quite a while. But I feel like she knew the food wasn't perfect yet and she wasn't going to send out the food until it was. Order appetizers to hold you over until then.

Fresh food, clean restaurant, good service. The owner is so sweet and hardworking. Alex was our server and gets better each time. I come once a week with my daughter. We like the atmosphere. The wait times are long but that’s expected with made to order food.

formatted_address: 9435 S Texas 6, Houston, TX 77083, United States
name: Gifted African Market and Restaurant

reviews.text: I never have an opportunity to take a picture because the food doesn’t last long enough for me to pull out my phone. Great service, warm atmosphere and delicious food. Just enough spice to make you feel nice.

Today is my first time here with my young niece who is recuperating, with joy I saw her mouth opened as she ate jollof rice well with 3portions of plantain because of how tasty and good the food is. And for me the Akara & Pomo is just perfectly succulent. The Efo riro, assorted meat & Moin-moin elewe just compliment my foodieness for today. Also, thanks for your great hospitable services💯
Ordered from UberEats. Too much oil in the stew and I asked for no meat in the stew and they still put meat anyway. Other than that, the food tastes good at least.
the service here is top-notch, the staff is so welcoming and attentive, making you feel right at home from the minute you walk in.
This place is a hidden gem. Sweetest and sumptuous Nigerian delicacies and snacks. Customer service, EXCEPTIONAL!!!!! Will come here over again and bring my friends too to enjoy this feeling🤗🤗🤗🤗

formatted_address: 401 Franklin St POSTHTX, Houston, TX 77201, United States
name: 2 Phat Bastard Pies

reviews.text:
We tried the pepper steak pie, one of the chicken pies, and chicken samosa.

I have to say, these are some insane meat pies. The pepper steak pie was so well seasoned, and had that nice peppery taste. The chicken pie was also very well seasoned, almost like a curry. Both pies were stuffed to the brim, and mostly meat.

The chicken samosa was ok, but honestly the spices over powered the chicken flavor there so it just tasted like a veggie samosa.

They literally prepare each pie from scratch. You can watch them put in the finishing touches yourself, but expect to wait 15 to 20 minutes. Love the mini pastrt initial they put on each pie so you now which pie is which.

Not sure if everything in Texas is bigger—but this pie DEFINITELY is. 🤠🔥
The Steak & Mushroom pie from 2 Phat Bastard Pies is an absolute beast: handmade to order, piping hot, overflowing with filling, and ridiculously good. Found it during a 3-hour Amtrak layover at POST Market Hall in Houston and wow… what a discovery.
At $12, it’s a steal—easily a $20+ pie back in Brooklyn. Fresh out of the oven, hearty, flavorful, and deeply satisfying. This is comfort food done right. Would 100% go back.

A must try at POST food hall! 2 Phat Bastard Pies make their savory pies as soon as you order them, so they come out flaky and hot. The spinach paneer and steak & mushroom pie are my favorites, but honestly all of them are so delicious. Absolutely love this place.

literally, the best pot pie that I’ve had Ever!  flavors are amazing. It was super fresh. You gotta get the lamb pot pie and the vegetable samosas hands-down some of the best samosas I have yet tasted.
Our first time trying savory pie such as this. Absolutely phenomenal. Baked fresh to order. The pastry is flaky with savory, flavorful fillings. What a unique halal option!

name: Dakar Street Food @BLODGETT

reviews.text: O I have to edit my review cause the first time I tried this food it was really good , so I tried it again I was very disappointed the meat was really dry and tuff.  I gave them the benifit of the doubt and tried it again still the same dry and tuff the only thing good was the onions on top the meat . $40. Down the drain

Dakar Street Food @ BLODGETT: A vibrant spot offering authentic West African street food with bold, rich flavors. The menu features favorites like jollof rice, grilled suya, and flavorful stews that capture the essence of Dakar’s street eats. Portions are generous, and the spices are well-balanced—not too overpowering but full of depth. The casual, friendly atmosphere makes it perfect for a quick, satisfying meal. Great for those craving something different and authentic with a homestyle touch. Good value and fast service round out the experience.

I’ve had my fair share of Senegalese food, including straight from the source in DK, and this my friends meets all standards. The flavor was everything and hit the spot. The ginger juice was amazing and had just the right amount of kick!

Jollof rice was amazing so was the stew on top.

The lamb was extremely dry and overcooked almost inedible.which sucks.

Plantains were not ripe.

I have had the other location and it was amazing, I am disappointed but the Jollof rice is why I can’t give below 4 stars.

@the Blodgett food hall / fish was over-fried. Hardly any meat. Flavor was spotty (good in few places, tasteless in the others). The oxtail stew had no flavor whatsoever. I would’ve traveled the extra distance for a better experience had I known. The drinks (ginger and passion fruit) were amazing! Sadly, they were all we enjoyed.

name: Signature

MIND YOU ALL I DO IS PRESS THE "REORDER" BUTTON ALL THE TIME AND ALL OF A SUDDEN I'VE ADDED EXTRA THINGS. I'VE ORDERED FROM HERE MANY TIMES. IM VERY DISAPPOINTED. 1st timers. I had grilled fish & jollof-rice. Husband had stewed chicken, plantain & rice. He finished his food. My fish wasn't freshly fried  ( my husband opinion) but I enjoyed the rice & veggie.  Inside could use a coat of paint & air freshener. Kool for takeout 🥡 orders.
The food and staff are always good to me. The atmosphere could use a remodel. However, I will still l continue to frequent the establishment.
the jollof rice here is truly top-notch, bursting with authentic flavors that transport you straight to west africa - a must-try!
Very mediocre. Not good vibes.

formatted_address: 2616 Blodgett St, Houston, TX 77004, United States
name: Dupsy's Kitchen

reviews.text:
Food:
I researched various West African Restaurants in the Houston area that offered Egusi soup with decent reviews and could deliver. I’m swamped with work and cannot leave my home since the commute to the restaurant and back would be time consuming. I found Dupsy’s and figured I’d give them a try. My food arrived hot, neatly and safely packaged and it was so delicious. I ordered the nicely spiced Egusi w/beef and pounded yam. OMG! I was able to eat 3 meals from 1 order!

Service:
I called the restaurant to make several inquiries and one was to ask about packaging. I’m not too trusting therefore, I want my order packaged safely so no one tempted to open my package and “snack” on or touch my food. I was assured that my food would be securely packaged and the bagged secured. This is EXACTLY how my order was delivered to my home! EXCELLENT Customer Service!!!!

Atmosphere:
This was a delivered order however, I plan to visit this restaurant in person soon.

Thank you Dupsy’s and Chef’s Kiss!

UPDATE:
I was finally able to visit this restaurant in person. I read the reviews but wasn’t deterred by the negative comments since my food delivery experience was positive.

I walked in and felt completely lost. I had no idea that it’s a contactless experience. The order must be placed electronically prior to arriving or at a kiosk upon arrival. Once you’ve placed your order and paid for it, you take a seat and wait to be notified via text message. When your food is ready, your text message will direct you to a locker number which will go to and unlock by clicking on a link provided in your text message.

Thankfully, there was a kind Harris County Deputy who was also visiting for the first time  and patiently worked with me to make sure I was able to place my order. I think the concept is innovative here in the U.S. (been going on in Asian countries) and could really take off. However, there should be available signs with directives posted both outside and inside of the building.

The food was just as delicious as it was the first time. Please don’t let the negative reviews deter you from giving this restaurant a try.

I have had their food several times before via online order, today was my first time coming in. They’re located within a food hall, and you place orders on a touch screen. The food is good, however, I wish they had someone who is available to answer the phone about catering orders.

Okay so update to my initial review. I hadn’t ordered from here since my last review because of my complaints and decided to give them another chance and it keeps getting worse. They have increased their prices but keep reducing the portions. It also seems like they are adding water to the “stew” after making it. Will not be seeing me again. Added pictures for reference

So I order from here a good amount of time and the portions are so inconsistent. The food itself is decent, but again the taste is also not consistent. Anyways I ordered chicken stew last night and I basically got 3 pieces of chicken with a drop of stew, wasn’t even enough for one meal.
Will stop ordering till you get it together

This was the WORST peper soup. I’ve has in my life. When is pepper soup orange. A COMPLETE waste of money. Please do not order from them. I wish I could give them zero stars. Asked for beef instead of goat and still got goat. 0/10 would never recommend!! Look at the picture from their site and the picture I snapped. Looks NOTHING ALIKE!! 😡

I ordered vegetable soup with beef.  I barely had any red stew. The beef was soooooo tough. My gums are still sore from trying to chew it honestly. And the food just had NO flavor. They usually do a great job but this time I was really let down

formatted_address: 8637 Richmond Ave., Houston, TX 77063, United States
name: Dibi Rapide (Food Truck)

reviews.text: Got the dibi lamb, brochettes, and fataya. The fataya was my favorite. The lamb was very tender and had great flavor with the seasoning. The jollof was very oily. The parts that weren't were good. The brochettes were a little chewy, but the portion sizes were good,

Was out and about with the family and we decided to stop by and grab some dinner . We ordered a variety of dishes :dibi lamb/ plantains and vermicelli , shawarma, 5 news or egg rolls ,dibi chicken served with Fries which was one of the best chicken I have ever eaten . Meat was tender and marinade was on point !!!!!!
We also enjoyed all three drinks however the ginger was our favorite .
We will definitely come back and refer friends because it's a hidden gem in Houston and more people need to taste that Senegalese goodness
Ps: thanks for the maad, awesome threat!!!!!

Came to Houston for NYE weekend and stumbled upon the amazing food truck. The dibi was delicious! Everything we had was amazing. The ginger and hibiscus drinks are a must! We came back later at 2am after hitting the clubs. The owner was so nice, we will definitely return whenever we are in Houston again.

First time trying Senegalese food. I had the Fataya and the owner had the sweet gesture of giving me a little rice with a sauce to try. It was DELICIOUS!

The Fataya were also great along with the hibiscus juice. The Fataya reminded me of our Empanadas.

Excellent and kind service. Def coming back for that rice dish.
If you want authentic dibi just  like the way they make it in Senegal,  this is the place to be. The lamb was tender, juicy, and well seasoned.  I will definitely be back God willing.

formatted_address: 14165 Bissonnet St Suite P, Houston, TX 77083, United States
name: Cafe De Vivre

reviews.text: Honestly so so disappointed. I’m a long time customer and I’ve always loved the suya and Jollof rice at this restaurant. But things have changed lately. The last two time I ordered suya and Jollof from here I have been extremely disappointed. The last time I ordered the beef suya it tasted spoiled, I didn’t say anything because I was hoping it was a one time mistake. Fast forward to today, I wanted to give this place another try but not only can I not eat the beef suya but the Jollof rice is also not good at all. I don’t know if they changed the recipe but y’all need to go back to the original because this isn’t it AT ALL. I just wasted my money AGAIN.

The suya was just like we have in Nigeria, fresh,  juicy and chewy. I'm impressed. Very very nice. Their pastry though much more expensive than elsewhere is worth every penny and every bite. I will visit again when I come back to Houston.
Hands down the best sausage rolls, meat pie and chicken suya in Houston. Suya is also good, it's so good I've heard he supplies other Naija restaurants.

The food here is nasty. I ordered from here via grubhub and i was utterly disgusted. The meats were almost spoilt and was past their due date. Everything smelt bad, which causes one to subconsciously question the hygiene of the kitchen it was made in.

I couldn't eat the dodo as it smelt like it was fried with oil that hadn't been changed for 7 days. Their food is not cheap either, so one wonders why they have to re-use 7 day old oil to fry things.

I will never eat food from here again.

Food was bomb! I’ve tried many African cuisine restaraunts but as humble as this one is in size and exposure , it makes up for in taste and quality of food! Closest thing to home cooked !! And very down to earth people !!  MUST TRY!!

formatted_address: 10010 Bissonnet St, Houston, TX 77036, United States
name: Chef Benny

reviews.text: chef benny's west african dishes are a culinary delight! highly recommend trying the jollof rice and suya skewers for an authentic and flavorful experience.
I doordashed some Designer Stew with Rice and Goat Meat Pepper Soup yesterday omg food was delicious like i have no other words than it was delicious i couldn’t even stop eating for a sip of water

The first time I was here I was over charged. I complained the waiter told me it was a mistake. Second time I was over charged again. And rude lady said it was a mistake from same waiter. I asked why should I over pay for there mistake. I also explain that same happened the first time I came. The rude, badly behaved lady said i should bare it. I’m sure they know exactly what they’re doing. Never again.

When i first started ordering from here, the food was great. However, lately the quality of the food has been unreliable. When the food is fresh (made the same day and refrigerated), it is delicious, but there are times i can tell the soups and meat are either old or have been sitting out. I guess I’ll have to specify that I’d like the food fresh from now on.

Ordered this on Uber Eats
It was quite literally the worst Uber eats order and African food I've ever had. And it was way overpriced.
The texture and taste of the food seems like it's a few days old. Definitely not fresh food.

The grilled chicken was very dry, same for the suya.
the order of plantain was $3.5 and only had about 5 slices of plantain.
horrible food. never going back, and I do not recommend it.

formatted_address: 18311 Clay Rd Suite A4, Houston, TX 77084, United States
name: African Food Embassy

reviews.text: I’ve been to multiple African markets around the city, but these guys probably have the best cuisine by far. They’re quick, responsive, and you’ll savor the food every time. If you’d want the ingredients to some authentic African cuisine, try the market store section of the establishment. They have nearly everything! I recommend trying this joint out!

soo this my first time trying a nice African place  i had got egusi soup which has a lil mild kick to it but it’s tolerable it’s a nice full big bowl for 13.99 /with , without protein ,. pounded yam is 3$ and it’s a nice big portion of pounded yam i paid 16.89.. the chicken is extremely hard lol (i won’t get the chicken)but overall i rate it a 8 1/2 .
Best african store in the city! Came and had a great time from the music down to the groceries and don't also forget they have food!!! Customer service top notch. Definitely a place to stop by!!!
The fufu & egusi is so good here, the people are so nice and respectful, victor is a kind man that helped us get out order, and i order from here every time in never disappoints me!
I ordered some Egusi Soup with Goat meat and one with Beef. 2 orders of fufu.  The food was great and the customer services were excellent.

formatted_address: 9755 S Kirkwood Rd D, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: Alief African Kitchen

reviews.text:
I ordered yam porridge because I've had it here before and it was decent. I came in to pick it up and decided to order fried yam.  However,  the empty restaurant should have told me to keep it pushing.

I'm pissed because I ordered the fried yam and stew and got 6 pieces of semi-burnt, bitter, new yam! It's clear they don't know how to fry new yam... brine it in salt and SUGAR. The stew is sour... tomatoes not cooked properly.  I'm very annoyed because I wasted $15.

Yup, my total I spent is correct.  Don't waste your time,  money or effort!

Update: I tried the yam porridge. It was a 3 out of 10. Y'all hire someone who can cook!

I don’t review places but this one had me very pissed. So I came in at lunch time to grab a to-go bite and was graced with the stench of hookah, I looked around and no one was in there. I met a lady that I asked what menu was available and she did not make me feel like she had stuff to offer me unlike the times I usually come here( a young lady was always there with a nice smile) used bottles of beer was lying around, chair was broken and dirty(mind you she told me to sit down) I was standing the entire time cause heck No! The floor was dirty and to paint a picture of how dirty it was if my wallet fell down by accident I would need Clorox bleach to clean it. IT WAS BAD! I really wanted to give the food a chance but I thought since the place is like this how will inside where the food is being made be. SO I WALKED OUT! This place had turned into a nightmare! And to think it used to be a place I liked getting my food from that was above average.

I ordered some food today. I was so so hungry and I ordered. I waited for more than an hour for my food and when I finally got home to work to eat my food. There was so napkins or forks. ( to move on from that ) ordered multiple things and I didn’t like how the dishes tasted. The pepper soup is the most flavorless I’ve had in Houston and I love trying it from every location. The two other dishes didn’t help as well. Please read reviews before buying food for the first time 😭😭

I would give them zero stars if could.  I came on order my food and half the people in there were drunk .  They started arguing and were loud and I felt unsafe after waiting and asking for my food 5 times for 30 minutes , I left and was pissed .

Please find a Cameroon recipe for your food. It’s doesn’t taste good. Palm oil doesn’t serve this economy any good. There’s are different kinds of oil, canola, Canola.
Corn.
Olive.
Peanut.
Safflower.
Soybean.
Sunflower.
Vegetable.

The pumpkin seed used, could it be bought in the United States. And the fufu isn’t the proper fufu quality or portion size. I feel asleep after. Very troubling. What if I was at work. That’s not a good lunch to service. Honestly it’s not a business that can last for a long time. It doesn’t address the masses. No way to scale it. I had to advise my African American not ti come close, the smell and only God knows why you didn’t use a little virgin oil lol.
Sorry - this should be recommended as needed. Use spices from a particular store and ingredients for the seed should be from the Halloween pumpkin seed.
That’s why African American accuse African born origin for lack of cooperation.
The same goes for the Mexican culture. We could all use one old school beautiful restaurant that truly shows are traditional food in the best light. The Uber delivery driver requested an additional tip, that’s how I know he didn’t like the delivery smell of the food.

formatted_address: 315 Travis St, Houston, TX 77002, United States
name: B's African Kitchen Curbside Only

reviews.text:
PLEASE READ🚨 !

My first time at this location which is located at 315 Travis st (it’s curbside only and you will park In front of the HOUSTON painting to wait on your food) was nothing short of AMAZING when it came to the food (beef Egusi and pounded Yams) I’ve ordered this literally 5x in the last 2 weeks . Being that the food is made to order I suggest you don’t order if you are on a time sensitive schedule . I show grace because I know it’s one person cooking and ideally I don’t like rush food so I ALWAYs choose a time frame where I’m able to wait on fresh food . I see the other reviews and can understand some of you all frustration but let me tell you that the food is really Good and flavorful and hope that the cook can redeem himself to those who were disappointed. But I can only speak for me when it come to the food it’s a 10/10 highly recommended 🙌🏾

I order from this restaurant once a day and I am completely obsessed. The food is always made hot & fresh and my order is always made within 5 minutes. The meat is plentiful as well, and I always get more food than I can finish. The turkey comes stewed on top and the plantain is soft as well as the rice. I would recommend this place to anyone that lives in Houston as a choice for Nigerian Cuisine. You will not be disappointed.

On two different occasions this business has exhibited unprofessionalism and true lack of customer service.

June 23rd-I’m extremely disappointed with the experience I had today. I placed a simple food order well before my lunch break, expecting it to arrive in a timely manner. Instead, it took 2.5 hours for the delivery to be completed with no communication or updates about the delay until I reached out myself.
Because of this, I completely missed my lunch break and didn’t even get to enjoy the food I paid for. To make matters worse, after keeping a customer waiting that long, there was no apology, no complimentary item, or any gesture to make up for the inconvenience. This is unacceptable and shows a clear lack of regard for customers’ time and experience. I hope you take this feedback seriously and improve your communication and service recovery forward.

On August 6th-
I placed an order at 6:35 PM and by 9:46 PM, I still had not received my food. When the DoorDash driver finally arrived, a verbal argument broke out between the driver and a representative from this business. Shockingly, the rep refused to hand over the delivery to the driver — but did call me to inform me of the situation.

Despite multiple attempts to contact the business and get an update, I received no clear answers for nearly an hour. This is not just poor customer service — it’s completely unacceptable. I spent over three hours waiting with no resolution. I will not be ordering from here again, and I strongly urge others to think twice before doing so.

Terrible experience. I was charged twice for my meal, and even after providing clear proof, the staff refused to correct the mistake. This is unacceptable customer service and extremely unprofessional. I will not be returning, and I’d strongly recommend avoiding this place until they learn how to treat customers fairly.

I purchased this yam chips and to my disbelief, this is $15 plus tax nearly $20 at a gas station plus it was burnt and the most upsetting thing I also purchased soup with no chicken and it the soup came with all chicken. The ticket pacifically said no chicken and he recommended beef or fish. I called and the person I spoke to said that he wasn’t the one that did the food but he will send me my refund. I’m waiting to see if it comes if it doesn’t I’ll have an updated review.

formatted_address: 5930 Renwick Dr Suite B, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Horn of Africa

reviews.text: Walked in and tried to order from the menu but lady at the front rudely said there’s nothing but one dish. So we ordered that since we drove far to come here. Food was fresh and delicious even though it wasn’t what we wanted. Customer service was terrible. Not a single smile or warmth or checked if we needed anything. 5 star food zero star customer service. I’m Ethiopian so I know what our service should look like, she’s misrepresenting us and it’s disappointing. Please do better.

The food was amazingly fresh and tasty. They also have habesha supplies including teff flour although the price is a bit higher compared to other places in the area.

The store is located in a very convenient location with plenty of parking spaces.

I just got some food here today and omggggg how much I just miss eating my food. The taste flavor the meat injera everything is just so good, if I can rate it it’s 💯. I will definitely be back . This place is my usually go to beside Lucy but I will always drive even if it’s an 45 min to get some sebhe from here.
I went to this place twice, and it was closed both times, even though it shows on Google Maps that it’s open.
Try the sambusa first time having Ethiopian food oh and the Lamb with yellow rice goes hard. Must try amazing service the people here are very welcoming. 😌🫶

formatted_address: 11810 Bellaire Blvd A, Houston, TX 77072, United States
name: FuFu Café

reviews.text: This used to be my favorite place for peking duck until they started charging extra for the soup made with the leftover duck pieces. It’s a shame because the portions used to justify the price.

This is a late night staple for us. Considering their hours, we always come here when we’re having an extra late night dinner. Food has been slightly inconsistent over the years, but delicious nonetheless. If you’re dining at a normal time, there are other better options in the area at similar price points. But for late night dining, nothing I’ve found thus far comes close.

The food was incredible. If it was solely based on that then the place is a 5 star, through and through. The service, however, was terrible. It took me stopping the host 3 times to get someone to: bring me a menu, ask for a server, then ask for someone to take my order. There were parties larger than mine that arrived after I did getting their food ordered and served before my food order was even taken. At some point I asked for a clean plate, only to be given another dirty one. Towards the end, someone finally did attempt to provide better service . . . just in time for the check.

This restaurant is spacious and has a great atmosphere, perfect for both formal dinners and spontaneous visits. The decor is modern and relaxing, making it a great place to unwind. They also offer a large private room, which is ideal for special occasions or group gatherings.

As for the food, we enjoyed a variety of dishes, including Hot Spicy Chicken, Sizzling Beef with Black Pepper, Sizzling Beef Short Rib, and Pan-Fried Pork Buns. Initially, We were concerned the Hot and Spicy chicken was just Kung Pao chicken rebranded but the server assured us it was a separate dish.  Also, I somehow ended up with a fork…thanksfully I was provided with a fresh bamboo chopsticks before the meal was brought out! Overall, a great experience with delicious food.

The restauarant atmosphere was modern, warm and welcoming. We were disappointed that we were seated and given forks but they made up for it with the delicious food. We ordered Pan Fried Pork Buns, Sizzling Beef Short Ribs, Sizzling Pepper Beef, and Hot Spicy Chicken. All four of the dishes were delightful. Most restaurants will have at least one of the four that are just OK but Fu Fu Restauarant hit the spot with all four dishes. The experience was excellent and we will be returning. P.s. They did bring us chopsticks upon request 😉

formatted_address: 9051 W Bellfort Ave, Houston, TX 77031, United States
name: Makola Marketplace

reviews.text: The kitchen staffs were extremely rude, and I would not recommend anyone to get food from there. I waited in line for over 15 minutes, ringing the bell, but no one came out to ask what I wanted. After ringing the bell again, they simply closed the window, which was very disrespectful. Because of the rude attitude I experienced today, I will not be recommending this place to anyone, and I will not be getting food from there again.
There was lots of variation of seasonings and produce. Everything was organized. I was able to get the seasonings, except for African basil, and lemongrass. Great in and out store.
Cleanest African Market I have ever gone to. Please keep that way. Very encouraging. Food portion quite small, especially with about no protein. Some items are very pricey
Very clean and organized, Good prices etc..

It was so clean!! They keep a lot of things like egusi seeds in proper climate controlled glass coolers on the walls!! Their fresh meats are over $2/lb less expensive than their competitors. That alone brings me back over and over.

formatted_address: 10834 Beechnut St, Houston, TX 77072, United States
name: Wazobia Kitchen

reviews.text:
Upon entering the restaurant, it was clean, which is the reason for the two stars. I stood in the clearly marked pickup area for to-go orders with my daughter and was not acknowledged at all, despite multiple employees being present and available. Instead, staff continued taking new orders from customers entering the restaurant and completely ignored us.

Because of this lack of direction, another customer whose food was being prepared stepped into my personal space and said, “I need to pay for my food,” moving closer as if expecting me to move. Not only was this uncomfortable, but it could have been avoided if the staff had simply acknowledged me in the first place. The employees’ behavior set the tone for the entire interaction.

After standing there for approximately seven minutes, I finally received my food—which had already been prepared and was just sitting there waiting.

I ordered pounded yam and egusi, which I’ve had at many restaurants. This was the first time I’ve ever received egusi with so much oil that it was overflowing out of the container. The food was bland, the spice level was very weak, and I could not finish it because it simply did not taste good. I have never left a bowl unfinished before.

Overall, I feel like I wasted both my time and my money. The entire experience was disappointing and unnecessary. This was my first visit to this restaurant, and unfortunately, it will also be my last.

1000000/10 place! My friends and I came back three times in a row! That’s how amazing it was! Raymond and Chinemerem were absolutely lovely and the food was amazing!!!!! Don’t hesitate to come here guys! Deadass

They have good food, but I have an issue with the sizes of their pap (even though I specify, they don’t fill up the container) and the fact that my pap came with a flu in it.
Besides that fact that they never fill up the pap container until the other Wazobia location, my pap also came with a nasty fly in it! 🤮
For the price of your food, Do better please!

Decided To Update My Review - I Am Now A Regular Customer. I Always Get The Same Thing. Goat Pepper Soup With A Order Of Jollof Rice. It’s Addicting And Always Good Each Time I Get It. I Have No Complaints About The Flavor Everything Is Perfect. Thank You So Much !

I love Wazobia Kitchen! The food is always delicious, portions are generous, and the staff are consistently friendly. It’s my go‑to spot whenever I want a great meal. The flavors are authentic, the atmosphere is lively, and every visit feels welcoming. The setting is family‑friendly, creating a comfortable space for children. Absolutely fantastic experience!

formatted_address: 16203 Westheimer Rd #104, Houston, TX 77082, United States
name: Wazobia Kitchen

reviews.text: Your grocery store is exceptional, clean and full of friendly staffs. But your restaurant though food is very good. But, the staffs at the restaurant are either not enough or mostly inside the kitchen while only one or two people serving people. Out of that one or two people attending to a long line of people waiting to get food, will leave the long line of people and be serving food for Uber eats while abandoning those in line. Also,the one or two people serving and attending to people are so slow, taking their sweet little time. The guy (wears face cap, not slim, has facial hair) has a bad attitude, in my opinion should not be attending to people. He will be talking to you with his brows high up there. Please train your staffs in the restaurant in customer service and add more staff to serve and attend to people who are buying food in the restaurant. I like Wazobia and I will always refer people to this place but please attend to this matter. Thanks

I went there with my family last week and we ordered 4 different meal. All the meals were 10/10 delicious and topnotch. We don't live in Houston but we will definitely be going by there anytime we are in Houston. Excellent,  excellent food.
I went there and the customer service was great and the atmosphere was welcoming. What's more, is that the food was delicious and packed neatly. I will definitely be coming here often

Update: 09/24/25
After seeing the review, I got a call from a wazobia representative apologizing for the poor service, promising to do better next time.

Very BAD, Disgraceful and Disappointing experience
I placed an order for almost $500 worth of food and I regretted it.
Although this is not my first time ordering large amount from wazobia (it was a much better experience the year before), this time around it was abysmal.
As agreed, my order of several coolers of rice, pastries, and protein was to be picked-up on Sunday, July 27th at 1pm. This was for a very special event. I even delayed in picking it up because of last minute preparations for the event. However, at about 2:30pm when I was on my way to pick up the order, I got a call from a lady at wazobia telling me that the jollof rice wasnt ready and it would be ready within one hour. So I decided to pick up the ones that were ready. They promised to deliver the jollof rice to the event location by latest 4pm.
To cut the long story short, the rice never came until past 6pm, when the event was already over. While the event was on, we had to quickly supplement with other foods, just to avoid the disgrace.
I rejected the rice that arrived late because there was nothing we needed it for at that time.
In all this experience, I never got any apology nor compensation from wazobia up till today, 09/10/25. They only processed a refund for the jollof rice and that was it!
And by the way, the food that was picked-up, was below par (the protein was too dry and not properly seasoned).

If you want African food items packaged into neat branded easily accessible containers,  this is the place to go.  It's a clean one stop shop for your African needs. Feels very upscale with an experience similar to any American store. I also love that their space for cutting meat is spacious and clean.

formatted_address: 7303 S Peek Rd, Richmond, TX 77407, United States
name: MeeMee's Bites

reviews.text: Food always tasted scrumpdelicious!!! Service is top notch too. Would definitely keep ordering

I love her food. Such a nice and respectful person with a talent for cooking. Just the right amount of spice in every dish, the gizdodo is always my favorite go to. Can’t wait to try the fish rolls and meat pie next!
Food tasted amazing and the customer service was top notch!
The food is delicious and the quality is top notch.
Order was delivered on time. And the food was delicious.  Will definitely order again.

I usually get a small party tray($60)  but decided to get the large party tray ($120 with tax); And It Was The Same Amount Of Food!! And when I called the owner said that was the actual amount; no accountability. I was Scammed!

Honey Kaz almost always is a miss. I dont know which time to share. Should I share the time they gave me burnt food, the time they had a rude person at the front desk, or the time I received cold food and the wrong order. The only time I went back because my friends chose to visit. I was done after the first disappointment. If you're not ready to hire serious people and give food worth eating then why open an establishment just cook from your house and have your friends tast it. Do not recommend.

With an upcoming special event which we plan to shop around for a great african cuisine looks like this place absolutely would not be it !
Just happened to move near this eatery place next to Kroger passing by it was after hours outside the parking lot early Friday morning several people outside looks like they're off work from the club eatery one guy was actually Peeing passing outside his car other standing outside with a drink looks intoxicated when asked is this a club or whatever??
