Agitated If this is how they treat its patrons or passers by like  garbage then the management needs to do better then this ! Beware !!!!

Make sure to LIE about when you need your catering order. Minimum 6HRS before you need it and it will still not be ready. The owner is never accountable and won't apologize for messing up. Peak clownery 🤡🤡🤡
The crazy part is their small chops is one of best anywhere but their service is a solid zero

A lot of the foods here are fried so not on the healthy side BUT very much on the delicious side. My boyfriend love's this place and wants to make eating here a monthly thing. The owners are super nice.

formatted_address: 16203 Westheimer Rd #106, Houston, TX 77082, United States
name: Wazobia Market

reviews.text: When you come here, be prepared to have your time wasted. I came in just to grab some groceries and ended up standing in line for over 15 minutes. After all that waiting, I was told the register was acting up, with zero empathy. I switched to another line, which took another 10 minutes before I was finally checked out. Very upsetting and disappointing experience.

Wazobia Store is an excellent place to shop! The store is well‑organized, clean, and stocked with a wide variety of authentic African products. The staff are friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist, which makes the shopping experience smooth and enjoyable. Prices are fair, and the quality of items is consistently high. I highly recommend Wazobia Store to anyone looking for great service and authentic products.

Great initiative on the expansion. My family and I visited on its relaunch and we got free food! All four of us! The staff members wore smiles on their faces despite the harsh Houston weather. Professionalism is absolutely top-notch

Wazobia Market is one of the best spots in Houston for African groceries. The place is well-organized, prices are fair, and they always have fresh items you can’t find in regular supermarkets. Staff is friendly and helpful, and the meat section is always clean. If you want real African ingredients without driving all over the city, this is the place to go.

If I could give zero stars I would! ALL of my food is cold; and the fact that I paid EXTRA for Turkey and Goat because I didn’t want pork or tripe, I’m soooo mad!  I had to pay a la cart because the “assorted meat “ had a bunch of stuff I didn’t want and they gave me 2 and 1/2 pieces of meat… and STILL gave me the vegetable soup with the meat I didn’t want is blowing my mind!!! Then as you can see by the little canister I placed for context, that chicken with, instead of turkey!! I also requested fried rice!
So disappointed!!  Do better!

formatted_address: 6788 Synott Rd, Houston, TX 77083, United States
name: Glam Divine Treats

reviews.text:
**MOVED TO NEW LOCATION:
6788 Synott Rd, Houston, TX 77083
The food is amazing!! My favorite is the gumbo and fried fish.  Everything I've tried on the menu is delicious: The Collard greens, oxtail egg rolls, macaroni & cheese, Fried shrimp, the Turkey legs all delicious.

This place has the absolute best dishes!! The food is amazing and prepared properly...
I brought my family of 6 and we all enjoyed the complete experience....I have a autistic stage 3 child who is soo picky about food and environments and she was having a great time eating and enjoying the decor...She ate ALL her food and that says Alot!! We met the cook and had the dishes explained in depth as to the  ingredients and procedures to make these wonderful tastes!! Complete comfort!! Genuine appreciation of our service and authentic warmth radiated from the hostess/owner which made the experience unforgettable!!! The oxtail egg rolls...the jollof rice...the crawfish fried rice... everything was perfect...We left full and so happy...I stand behind this being a diamond among Houston eateries!! You won't be disappointed!!!

If you want authentic soul food! Looking no further! I tried the fried catfish, grilled pork chop, turkey necks, greens, cabbage, mac n cheese with shrimp, sorrel & a conversation that I needed from the owner Christina herself! When I tell you I am satisfied! I am full! I am grateful for being here in this moment! Come get you some food from the soul! You might see me eating when you come in......lol. Ms. Gloria & Ms. Christina have a heart of gold! Thank you for everything.

As of yesterday, my bday!, Aug 11...that was visit #4! I absolutely love the food!! Always fresh and delicious!! The grilled chicken, joloff rice, plantains, greens and cabbage are DIVINE for sure!! I told the wonderful lady who's been there every time, was nice enough to gift a cheese cake Brownie topped with warm caramel 🤤🤤🤤 was also DIVINE!! YOU MUST HAVE THE EXPERIENCE HERE! You will most definitely enjoy it 👍🏽👍🏽

I had the grilled shrimp, jollof rice, green beans and mac and cheese. The food was insanely good, and the service was sweet, friendly and caring. I came here by chance but when I'm in the area you better believe I'm coming back!
EDIT: Get the lemon cake for dessert. Trust me you will NOT regret it

formatted_address: 1903 Blodgett St, Houston, TX 77004, United States
name: Afro Caribbean Grill (Food Truck)

reviews.text: We got the jerk chicken and the jerk wings with Jollof rice and it was incredible! This is a true hidden gem in Houston and worth dropping by! All the food is freshly made, is super delicious and service is great!👍🏽

I loved the jerk chicken but if you order it, you better be ready for some heat. The chicken fat Taya was also amazing. You have to try the sauce it comes with. My husband’s favorite thing on the menu is the pineapple ginger juice. This is a great little spot, The people who run it are super friendly and they serve great food. Give them a try.

Amazing food bursting with authentic Afro-Caribbean flavors! The vibrant spices and soulful dishes make every bite a delight. Cozy vibe, friendly staff, and a true fusion of culture. Highly recommend!

This place is a cultural explosion of taste! The curry goat melts in your mouth, and the sides are perfectly seasoned. Love the vibrant decor and welcoming staff. A true Afro-Caribbean experience. 5 stars!

The Afro Caribbean Grill is a gem! Every dish is packed with bold, authentic spices that transport you straight to the islands. The jerk chicken and plantains are a must try. Warm atmosphere and top-notch service. 5 stars!

formatted_address: 11965 Bissonnet St STE 110, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: Remmy's Eatery

reviews.text: This is the place to go if you want authentic Nigerian cuisine. She does personal and  catering orders and also you can shop for small things inside the store. Great experience and wonderful customer service. I would highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great Nigerian food

I’m Nigerian so I know when a place has good Nigerian food. The customer service is A1, Waiting time is not long at all, food was overall a 9/10. Thank you guys so much for a pleasant meal, I will be sure to recommend to all my friends and family.

Best place for OFADA and Yam Porridge EVER and currently topping the Chicken hen Suya list.

Her soups are so good as well. Gotten my whole family addicted.
Everything is good here. Great Jollof rice and stewed meat, plantains also delicious. Tastes like how my Nigerian mom makes it.
The jollof rice is like no other I have eaten. Its soo good....add the beef with that...oooweee. Even the plantains were on point. I'll definitely have to use them to cater for me.

formatted_address: 7039 FM 1464 Suite # 110, Richmond, TX 77407, United States
name: Supreme Seafood & Suya

reviews.text: I decided to reach out of my comfort zone and try some authentic African cuisine and let me tell you I was not disappointed at all my taste buds were very happy and pleased. I started with the two plates of turkey wings that were so huge they were like longer than my face full of meat tasted like jerk seasoning all over and in between, I paired it with the rice and peas which were so so good. I never tried those before but I'm definitely going to get it next time I come back. I also got the fries that were perfectly fried and seasoned.The menu inside was very easy to understand and read the staff was very friendly and helping. The environment was chill and laid back so if you want to come and get you some food and relax and even get you a hookah they provide that too. They have tvs for sports games, they also have family games as in Uno connect 4 pretty much all the originals. So stop on by and try it out it's in the strip center next to McDonald's and Starbucks.

The food was perfect. Delicious and served steaming hot. Every single bite took me to Nigeria and my younger days there. Rice was soft and cooked through. The meat was seasoned perfectly! Service was friendly and top notch. You will love it. Just go.

Super cute restaurant! Clean and the restrooms are neat as well. I got the ribs Suya w jollof rice. My food came out piping hot and I was digging in!! So yummy; the only reason I can’t give a 5 because the ribs were a little salty but not inedible at all.  Nice service too! I will be back for sure & letting my friends know about this place too

I enjoyed my visit here today! I came for the Happy Hour special Catfish was $10 and got a nice size portion. I literally have been thinking about this fish all week lol happy i was able to make it! Food was freshly prepared. Charles was great excellent customer service. The vibe here is super chill tvs, music and games. I appreciate the ladies rest room being cleaned since thats always non existent at alot of places. Definitely would recommend checking them out!

UPDATE: I want to commend Olamide for his prompt and professional response to my previous review. After sharing concerns about my recent experience, he reached out quickly, took full accountability, and offered a resolution to make things right. I am glad I was open to his offer because he redid my order and the food was DELICIOUS! It was just what I hoped for. My spirit is lifted and my belly is full and happy.  Thank you again Olamide for your genuine effort—you turned a disappointing experience into a positive one and thus gained a repeat customer. Blessing to you and your business.

formatted_address: 9020 S Texas 6, Houston, TX 77083, United States
name: Dsnailspot

reviews.text: Placed an order around 11:am it took them more than 20minutes to confirm my order. Called their number and nobody seems to be picking up to tell me how much longer I have to wait. Incredibly poor service. Take that phone from whoever has it and give it to someone competent. I finally got my food. Ordered for bangs soup starch and white rice. They gave me only banga soup and white rice. Very disgusting customer service

Amazing!! This has to be the best African food that I have ever taste!! The food is perfect the favors are so on point.... and the customer service is amazing!!
I would definitely be going back!!
The address given is inaccurate. Brody Lane is in the middle of a residential neighborhood. There are no businesses.
Dsnail spot! The best Service in Houston Texas…. You don’t want to miss the services…. You need to holla and see the difference.. there services are on time, clean and taste very good…!!👍👍
The food was delicious and customer service great. Highly recommend

formatted_address: 11420 Dairy Ashford Rd Suite 104B, Sugar Land, TX 77478, United States
name: JollofBeans LLC

reviews.text: Super clean, friendly staff, wonderful dishes and the food was really really good spicy 🔥 🔥  IF YOU WANT SPICY WITH GREAT FLAVOR .. 👍 this is the place to come and give your flavor on.

The seafood okro was one of the best I've ever had. It was filled with all sorts, and the portion was large. It would be hard to finish the soup in one seating. The pounded yam was soft and bellowy. Very helpful and humble staff, and the restaurant had a nice ambiance.

Ordered from this restaurant for the first time through Ubereats because I was craving seafood okro and it did not disappoint at all! The okro was packed with shrimp, fish, and lobster. Also got the native rice which was delicious. The price may seem high but the portion sizes are definitely worth it.

A SINCERE AND UNPAID REVIEW. First and foremost, the food is excellent, and maybe the best hands down in Houston. It tastes like it was cooked in a clean and good environment- and yes! I know the taste of dirty food. You can just taste it. Their meals are always warm and tantalizing.

Now, as for the commenter that went complaining about their address. My guess is that you must have ordered on Uber like most people like myself. You NEED to seek help and immediate deliverance for spirit of ‘bad belle’. You may ask someone to interpret for you. What are you looking for? You intentionally gave them a 1 Star for rubbish. Shame!

Definitely one of the undiscovered African restaurant in the Houston area. Not a restaurant, actually found this vendor on DoorDash. Food is very authentic, tastes great and has been consistent.
Their smoking Jollof is the best.
Found out they offer catering services. Ordered for Mother’s Day and I and my guest were very satisfied with the food- taste, texture, spiciness, salt content, presentation were all actually on point.
Cook whom I’ve never met nor know her name is very polite and professional both via text, and call. Very responsive.
And price is very reasonable.

formatted_address: 5007 N Shepherd Dr, Houston, TX 77018, United States
name: Esther's Cajun Café & Soul Food

reviews.text: I went to ESTHER'S on July 31 (sorry so late with this). This was my first time visiting. The decorations were appropriate and decent. The restroom was clean as well. Now, I wanted beef tips or turkey necks [imagine my surprise at the food prices...] I was informed that they don't serve many things on the weekends but THEY DEFINITELY serve OXTAILS. Problem is, I don't care for ooxtails. I winded up getting the fried chicken, cabbage and Yams and I got hubby the oxtails, beans and cabbage. My chicken was very tasty. The other food was OK. The cabbage was not fully cooked so it was sort of crunchy and the beans were SALTY!!! BE WARNED...THE OXTAIL PLATES ARE HIIIIGGGGHHHH -$30.95 and he got 4!!!! My total was $64.92 for 2 plates. I had a cooler soda [16oz]  too ($4.99)! My plates were fixed and placed withthe Door Dash orders.  I had to ask for them, smh. The staffer was not so nice. The sides were limited as wrll, so read the menu CLOSELY. Certain foods are served on certain days. All in all the food was ok but use caution when going! Hubby also visited bar and got a bucket of beer and a small margarita, and that was $42.46. Not very much for the money spent. I MIGHT go back, idk. They also had a live band that day, which i really enjoyed!

First time eating here and the food is mouth-watering delicious! I would’ve licked the bowls and plate if I could, but not trying to get stares lol. The price for the portion and quality of the food is reasonable. Love the service and the staff were incredibly sweet. Really like the ambiance of the restaurant too. Will definitely come back; Esther's got herself a repeat customer here :)

Been really craving cajun food and decided to finally come try out Esters. I've passed by plenty of times and today was the day. My bf and I had walked in not knowing what to expect. Mannn, when I tell you everything slapped, it did. My expectations were EXCEEDED. The crawfish and shrimp étouffée was the savory and spicy. The ox tails were cooked perfectly and the greens were just right. EVEN THE SOFT CORN BREAD had me on the floor. The mac n cheese is the only thing I will say needed a little more love. Other than that 10/10 and I will be back for more.

We were told that when we go to Houston we had to eat at this place. It had a great appearance on the outside and inside the young lady Kind of light skinned appeared youngish wore hair pulled to the back. Had a funky attitude. Everybody else was nice. Food was expensive but tasted good.

Why can yall never get the DoorDash orders right?????? EVERY time I order from here something is ALWAYS wrong. Like can somebody not read????? It’s more convenient for me to order due to me working from home and the restaurant is usually closed by the time I’m off. My order is hardly ever correct and it’s concerning. The stuff is decently priced and good but how do you expect to keep customers if you can’t put the correct items on the plate. Where on my receipt you see I ordered two sides of yams??? This happens. Every. Single. Order!!!!!

formatted_address: 4819 Canyon Lakes Trace Dr, Humble, TX 77396, United States
name: Jummy kitchen

formatted_address: 4710 Lillian St, Houston, TX 77007, United States
name: ZOA Moroccan Kitchen

reviews.text: Food was great, location was inviting and intimate. There isnt a ton of seating inside but they do have additional seating outside to accomodate more guests. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful. They walked us through the selections and offered samples based on what we thought we were leaning towards. The food tastes fresh, flavorful, delicious. Both my wife and myself made our own bowl and we made a mini bowl for our daughter. I look forward to coming back for our next visit to Zoa Moroccan. It is definitely worth your time and money to stop in.
I ordered Casablanca bowl and Tanger bread, both are delicious. Food quality No complain, the only thing this restaurant miss, is moroccan tagine and couscous.

Husband and I just tried it for the first time tonight. A make your own bowl and a make your own pita.  So. Good! Portions were generous, flavor was impeccable and so many diverse combinations possible. Pita was much larger than I expected albeit slightly dry. We're already excited for the next time!

I visited with my dining out club FEAST.  We called in advance because we were a bigger group and the staff were very friendly and directed us to this location for our club dinner.  The restaurant was clean and cozy. The staff were very friendly and helped us put tables together for our group.  Rojilio(sorry if I butchered the spelling) was so friendly and helpful.  He made it a stellar experience.  He answered all our questions about the food and made helpful suggestions. And the food was delicious!  Everyone loved their meals.  The price is great too.  I loved the tumeric cauliflower and the spinach!  One of our group eats plant based and said the potato cakes were great. Everyone in our group thoroughly enjoyed the meal both for the taste of the delicious food and for the friendly staff.  I can't wait to go back and try other dishes.  I highly recommend giving them a try!
The sandwiches were disappointing. There was very little meat inside, and the taste was not good. I expected better quality for the price.

formatted_address: 3250 Old Spanish Trl, Houston, TX 77021, United States
name: Creole Kitchen and Daiquiris

reviews.text: The food was very good and served hot. I had the catfish, fries, hush puppies and greens. They get extremely busy around lunch time so prepare to wait. They left the hush puppies out of my order and I had to wait a very long time to get them.

Great experience and great food. The catfish pieces are HUGE!!! We could of shared a plate. The shrimp was a decent size as well, hushpuppies were good as well. The red beans and rice is full of turkey meat just like I would cook it! Meat and beans in every bite. 😋Very good, seasoned and came out hot. The kool aid was perfect, highly recommend! Small spot but food and atmosphere were excellent.

If you haven't eaten here before, please do! The food is amazing; it's hot, fresh, and wonderfully seasoned! I had the Cajun butter salmon, and omg, it was tender, well-cooked, and the flavor was out of this world.  The green beans were also excellent; if you don't like green beans, this will change your mind. I drove almost an Hour to get here and I Definitely would do it again.

My girlfriend recommended this place, and she made a great choice. I enjoyed the food that I got, and couldn't decide what I wanted to try on the menu for a while. The food was well-seasoned, tasty, and the environment felt like I was at home. Great service and nice, courteous employees. I would definitely recommend if I'm on this side of town and looking for Cajun food with a kick and hospitality! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Hubby and I decided to drive to Houston to eat here and we weren’t disappointed. Food was fresh and hot and service was great. Daiquiris were amazing. We definitely will come back again

formatted_address: 110 Vintage Park Blvd Building J Suite P, Houston, TX 77070, United States
name: The Chefs Table

reviews.text: Service was so great. It was our first time and our waiter answered all.of our questions honestly and gave us suggestions. The food would have gotten 5, but the Mac and cheese could have been more cheesy and the veggies has this sauce that was ok. Maybe get them with out it. However the lamb, clamp chowder, lobster pasta, 5 cheese potatoes were sooo delicious. This is definitely a place to go in Houston.  OH the spiced budding for desert was everything. The dessert is the birthday portion size not the paid for dessert.

The food here was absolutely amazing! Our server Daniel took great care of us as well, and was an absolute delight to talk to. He even ran after us after we had left to return an item one of my friends had accidentally left behind. Very fancy atmosphere, and once again, the food was delicious, well made, and absolutely worth the price you pay for it. 11/10 would go again. 🙏🏾

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Beautiful restaurant, awesome service from hostess to waiter! The food, OMG, EVERYTHING WAS DELICIOUS!! We had the Six course journey with wine pairing and it was definitely a journey! A huge thank you to Chelsey who answered all of my questions with patience and kindness!

I had an amazing lunch today. I told my server Brittany what I was feeling like having let her do the rest. She did not disappoint. The food was flavorful without being overpowering. Even the strawberry on the prosecco. It added such a delicious layer of aroma to get me started. I had the lamb with brussel sprouts to eat. The sweetness of the brussel sprouts combined well with the savory of the lamb. Just a touch of the mint sauce brought elevated the combined flavor so well. The chocolate cake is difficult to describe. Cloud of cocoa maybe? It was rich without feeling sugary sweet. I get overwhelmed easily and I loved that these flavors all were so good and took me to new limits without overwhelming me. I will definitely be leaving it to the professional Brittany to surprise me again in the near future.

We tried the 6-course tasting menu (Che’s Dinner) at Chef’s Table for our 20th anniversary. It was a beautiful experience overall. The food was amazing, loved all the surprises one dish at a time! Daniel took the time to tell a story and history behind each dish which made the experience even more memorable.

formatted_address: 12825 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77077, United States
name: Glozi Calabar Restaurant and African Cuisine.

reviews.text: It's a very cozy place with good palatable food. The place is an ideal venue for intimate events - meetings, birthdays,babu shower, wedding events etc
Great team and nice food. I really enjoyed the food i bought. I recommend this place for anyone.
Food was so so good and freshly cooked! Reasonably priced too! Please move to Katy….
The food was very delicious and the staff were very friendly!
I enjoyed their afang soup,  with good African music that comes with awesome customers service.

formatted_address: 12647 Bissonnet St, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: Olachi´s Place

reviews.text: She made me feel like family and she fixed my dish the way I like it

My first experience was great.  My mom and my son was with me and we had jollof rice with chicken, vegetable soup, and Oha soup.  The food was amazing and the people were nice.  I will definitely be back.
It was the best food ever.  I drove from Katy TX just to eat here.  The food was great and the service was excellent.

It was a very great experience at Olachi's Place,The enviroment was well in order,The service was prompt with smiles from the attendants,The food was so delicious.I ate okro-ugba,it was just home made.As a customer i must say i was satisfied and would always recommend Olachi's Place to anyone craving for home made food.
Food was amazing

formatted_address: 1590 S Mason Rd, Katy, TX 77450, United States
name: Astor's Table

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Astor Table during our New Year’s Eve dinner. From start to finish, everything was exceptional.

Chef Casey is incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive, and the entire customer service team reflects the same level of professionalism and warmth. You can truly feel how much they care about their guests.

Our server, Santiago, was outstanding—very friendly, attentive, and made sure our family felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the evening.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish we ordered was beautifully presented, well cared for, and full of flavor. Everything shown in the photos is exactly what we enjoyed—divine from beginning to end.

It was the perfect place to celebrate a special family moment, and the attention to detail truly stood out.
We will definitely be coming back without a doubt. Highly recommended!

I had an incredible dining experience here! The menu features a unique and delicious fusion of traditional dishes from South Africa and Latin America that you won't find anywhere else. The flavors were bold, authentic, and perfectly prepared.
A huge thank you to Chef Casey and his staff for their exceptional hospitality. They made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in and provided attentive service throughout the meal. If you're looking for great food and a warm atmosphere, this is the place to be. Highly recommended!

Upon arriving, we were warmly greeted outside by the owner, who was absolutely amazing! Our server, Lowa, was outstanding super attentive and friendly. Definitely check out the 1¢ mimosa brunch deal! You pay regular price for your first one and get five more for just a penny each.

One thing I really loved was that during brunch, we still had access to the full menu. I’m not much of a breakfast person, so that was a big plus! My husband is from Africa, and I’ve had plenty of authentic home-cooked African meals from my in-laws  this restaurant was right on point!

As a young African American couple, we felt very welcomed, and the food was full of flavor. We’ll definitely be back. I ordered the oxtails (I’d rate them a 6/10 — good, but could be even better), and my husband got the Peri Peri chicken with jollof rice, plus beef and African spicy chicken empanadas. Everything he ordered was outstanding — so much so that we ended up getting another plate to go!

Astor’s Table is a great spot! The vibe is casual but classy with white tablecloths, and the place was spotless and busy. The staff is super friendly, attentive, and well-coordinated, using a radio communication system to stay in touch. They even open doors for guests and provide bag hooks at the tables.

I ordered the lamb curry, and it was fantastic. I love spicy food, and this dish had just the right amount of heat to satisfy me without making me sweat. The flavor was rich, and the portion was generous with plenty of tender meat and just the right amount of rice.

Parking was a little crowded since it is in a busy shopping center, but it was not too hard to find a spot. The chef also came out to chat with guests and make sure everyone was happy, which was a nice touch.

Even though it is a bit of a drive to Katy, I will definitely be back to try more of the menu. The food is excellent, the service is outstanding, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Highly recommend!

Edit: came back and got the oxtails and wings. Super yummy. Oxtails were tender and flavorful, not greasy like some versions can be, plantains were my favorite. The wings and fries seasoning was also delicious.

Astor’s Table absolutely blew me away! The food was incredible from start to finish, and the mystery mimosas were such a fun and delicious touch. The service was top-tier—every staff member was warm, attentive, and welcoming. The highlight of the visit was Chef Casey personally coming out to sit with us and chat. That level of connection and hospitality made the entire experience unforgettable. Everything was amazing, and I’ll definitely be back!

formatted_address: 2703 S Texas 6 Suite #127, Houston, TX 77082, United States
name: Vioni Grill

reviews.text: Ijay you food is wonderful, home cooked, excellent service. Anyone reading this review, i leave in Boston and she sends to me from Texas. This is how consistent she has been and always been. I love your service Ijay! You killed me the first day i tasted your food , you cook like me correct igbo anambra woman.

The food is just disgusting. I ordered seafood okra soup and let me tell you to same your time and hard earned money. I don't think I ever tasted food this disgusting in my life. And they are so unprofessional. I called to complain and they were just giving excuses. Horrible service and food. This food is unbelievably bad. Absolutely do not recommend this place

I'm so glad I found this place. Her  Customer service was wonderful and food was delicious. We ordered the catfish and got a huge fish, we also got a bowl of assorted meat, reasonable prices, right amount of spice and well seasoned. This will be my goto henceforth. I highly recommend

The lady at the counter had no customer service & didn’t not give me all of my food according the Uber app. She wasn’t friendly, the food took 45 min to be ready. But the food is good! Service is terrible

I took my father-in-law to the restaurant to try their Fisherman Soup for sentimental reasons and the soup didn't disappoint. My son had their vegetable soup and both were top level. I tasted some of my son's soup and I can tell you it was the best vegetable soup I've had. We tried their Nkowbi and it didn't disappoint. Everything tasted like your grandma's village cooking. If you go, call then ahead of time because they prepare everything from scratch.

formatted_address: 14097 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77082, United States
name: KFFO Afro Steakhouse

reviews.text: Great customer service from everyone I encountered (2 men), they were friendly and one of the Guy explained the entire menu since I wasn’t familiar with anything on the menu. I went with the J luv And it was 10 out of 10!! Very good food and customer service was great. I will definitely be returning

Not the most ascetically pleasing inside lol but the food is 10/10, my favorite and only things I’ve tried are the suya noodles and the shawarma. The noodles are steep $30 but soooooo yummy. As in it’s taste like its from naija. The shawarma i recently tried too was great. Love how they seasoned it. I’d be back.

We love this place!!
We eat here probably AT LEAST once every week or 2...at least.
The food is always always fresh and delicious.
They are open late most nights so sometimes we will even get it a 1 a.m.

Best fried plantain ever. Great Suya. Coconut rice is everything. Mixed veggies are a yummy healthy addition.

Had the munchies late at night so I went looking around for some food and found this nice West African restaurant. The images of steak and lamb chops pulled me in but then I reminded myself that I didn’t want to go broke that night, so I went for their Suya and Jollof Rice. It was my first time trying suya and man, was it delicious! The spices were hitting right and the rice complimented the meat well - both great on their own but amazing together. I had to pull over and finish it, it didn’t even make it back to the room!

Great stuff from those brothers in there, good hospitality as well, plus the interior of the restaurant is beautiful. I’d recommend checking this place out for sure, I’ll definitely be back to try some more of their menu.

I came in this Sunday and purchased three packs of Jollof for $85, and I can’t express how disappointed I am. There were only about 10 pieces of suya and about 4 of then were burnt on the plate, and the rice on all three plates was burnt as well. This is extremely disappointing, especially since this is a place I come to often. Unfortunately, after this experience, I will not be returning.

formatted_address: 5800 Bellaire Blvd #102, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Adulis

reviews.text: Recently went to Adulis with ~25 people with no reservation. We were immediately told by the owner that it was just he and his mom and if we wouldn't mind being patient. We were happy to wait of course as we had seen the 4.9 star rating. My table ordered the veggie platter, doro wot, lamb tibsi, and awaze tibs. Each dish was incredible. Our table fell into absolute silence as we shared the meal. We also ordered honey wine which was delicious. We were given as much injeera as our heart desired. We were offered traditional coffee and tea after our meal. They also presented a pan of smoking coffee beans to us as a sign of hospitality. We were welcomed with such love and care it was truly an unforgettable experience that I will keep with me for a long time. And I will most certainly be back!

Great food and absolutely the best service. My wife and I came here for our first anniversary and we were glad we did. Definitely coming back with my siblings and friends. The mother and son duo were very friendly and accommodating

This was my second time at Aduli’s and I came with the rest of my housemates. I thoroughly enjoyed my first dining experience with this establishment. The owner’s mother was incredibly kind and offered us a free drink. I decided to recommend this place to my five other roommates, and we came by for a House dinner. The ambience was very inviting and warm, and the owner tailor the music to our taste. The food was prepared to our liking and the owner constantly checked on us to make sure we were satisfied. He was incredibly accommodating and told us about his journey starting this restaurant.

A Warm welcome to Authentic Ethiopian Cuisine TEXAS!!

I recently had the pleasure of dining at this Ethiopian gem, and I was blown away by the exceptional service and mouth-watering dishes. From the moment we arrived, the owner greeted us with a warm smile and took the time to understand our preferences. Their personalized recommendations were spot on, and we thoroughly enjoyed every bite.

The veggie platter was a highlight, featuring an array of flavorful dishes like ades, elicha, goomen, and more. The presentation of the injera was impressive, and the chicken version was delicious. What struck me was the familiar taste, reminiscent of Kerala cuisine back home in India.

The owner's mother's recipes truly shine through in every dish. I'm already planning my next visit and highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for authentic Ethiopian cuisine. The hospitality, flavors, and atmosphere all come together to create a truly unforgettable experience. *Will definitely be back!*

We’re big fans of Ethiopian cuisine and visited with high expectations. We ordered the vegetarian platter, but unfortunately the flavors were underwhelming and didn’t feel authentic. The ambiance also lacked the atmosphere of a fine dining experience. Overall, it didn’t meet our expectations, and we wouldn’t plan to return.

formatted_address: 7627 Cook Rd, Houston, TX 77072, United States
name: Nini Kitchen

reviews.text: Will not recommend. Disappointed in the food as well. I spend $65 for two orders of okra seafood soup but they only had shrimp and tripe and one order of goat soup. The okra was not cooked well/ watery. I couldn't enjoy the goat at all. The meat was so hard which I couldn't chew. The goat soup was actually good with a nice flavor but the goat wasn't properly cleaned and had some weird stuff on the goat which should have been removed prior to cooking. The fufu was terrible. I wouldn't recommend. Plus I had to ask for my bowls to be filled some more due to the small portions. Customer service was welcoming and everyone was nice. I only came because where I normally go was closed. I found the restaurant on google.

This feels like grandmas home the lady was super nice and so was the guy as well any questions I had were answered and we dined in and we got to wash our hands in bowl which served to me as a really authentic experience all in all my food was delicious and flavorful.
Great Food Great Service the staff made sure everything was to my liking. Feels like a family atmosphere

I love love love this restaurant. We ran across it by mistake BUT I’M SO GLAD WE DID!!!!! The food was delicious, the service was incredible and Ni Ni herself came out and went over the menu with us. She was so patient and suggested what we should have individually. She’s the best!!!!!! I’ll definitely be going back….
Me and my sisters had an Awesome first time experience @NiNi's Kitchen. Great Customer Service and Delicious food.

formatted_address: 13151 Bissonnet St ste 400, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: CK Shows

reviews.text: I recommend this African restaurant for me is the best the place is clean , customer service is good, they really pay attention , I order tilapia plantain and soya beef is amazing, good taste will come back
Awesome  food , good  service,  clean place,good vibes
This is The Best African Restaurant in HTX. Welcoming atmosphere and the food is great.

The best African Restaurant in Houston. If u are visiting Houston for the first time or u live in houston please don't hesitate to visit CK she has the best roasted Fish and best African food. We came next door for weekend but due to the delay and we decided to get some food from here.  It met our expectation and we were pleased.  They serve authentic African dishes.
The food is decent for a good price.. However, the restaurant itself is not that nice. Probably a better place to get takeout.

name: Kes Spicy 9ja Suya Spot (Food Truck)

reviews.text:
Have a friend who purchased from them and I tried the beef Spicy Suya OMG!!! Delicious 😋 😋 I had to get my own. Servings are great I plan on returning soon for the Lamb version.
My compliments to the cooks.

If you like savory and spicy food this is the place. I tell everyone I  know now about them it makes my mouth water just typing this review.

This restaurant exceeded my expectations in every way. The ambiance strikes the perfect balance between cozy and elegant. Service was prompt and courteous, with the staff offering helpful recommendations. Each dish was well-seasoned, thoughtfully prepared, and beautifully plated.

I went to the Katy location to pick up an order for my sister cos she won’t let me rest with how amazing the suya is. Let me tell you, this is the best suya I’ve had in my over 15 years in obodo oyibo! The customer service was top notch and the beef suya was delicious and as amazing as the review that made me take the trip. The store was neat & located in an easy to find spot.  Give this suya a try, thank me later and spread the word! 🫡
My favorite Suya spot. Food is always fresh and friendly staff.

The beef suya is tasty but recently been mostly fatty so much that a third of the plate is pure fat. The people especially the Ghanaian man seem nice. Often times, they struggle to balance the requests. Perhaps a ticketing system would help?

formatted_address: 11420 Dairy Ashford Rd, Sugar Land, TX 77478, United States
name: All Seasons Cafe

reviews.text:
I ordered egusi, efo riro and okro soup with pounded yam. The food tastes good however the soup portion is ridiculously small; I barely had enough soup for the swallow. Each soup was almost $20each.
Additionally I could not eat the meat in the egusi or efo riro; the meat/tripe and cow skin was rock hard . Please look at pictures for portion size. If you are ordering food from the restaurant just beware…

I used them to cater my Friendsgiving in Houston and it was a hit. All my friends wanted to know where we got the food. I also like to add that Elohor’s customer service is unbelievable and the best I’ve experienced since I’ve patronized any restaurant

Came here for lunch yesterday, 1PM ish. Not a single person was in this restaurant, I mean not even a worker. I walked around the restaurant and even peeked into the kitchen. Their staff was just gone? Also recorded it since it was the first time I’ve ever been at a restaurant where apparently I’d have to cook, service and ring myself out.

If I could give this place zero stars I would, 1 star is too much! I arrived at this restaurant along with 15 other persons. We all came together for a reunion and we all stayed in Sugarland. We decided to visit this restaurant due to the high rating but were all disappointed. The egusi was sour and bitter and tasted like they used stale egusi to make the soup, the efo riro was bland, everyone complained. The only food that made small sense was the catfish peppersoup and eko, I was beyond disappointed. Woke up this morning with troubled stomach, I wouldn't have left this review but the way my stomach is hurting I had to say something. I caution people to be careful and not be deceived by High ratings, some of these restaurants might have their friends giving them 5 stars which are lies. How can about 15 people all have complaints about their foods on a Sunday? Food here is pure trash, highly not recommended. The owner was saying something about either relocation or renovation I don't remember but what has that got to do with the quality of food? Never again!
Food is delicious and the owners are kind and take good care of their customers!

formatted_address: 3300 Business Center Dr Suite 150, Pearland, TX 77584, United States
name: Aria Nigerian Suya Kitchen

reviews.text:
I’ve been to this place a few times just never posted a review. However it’s decent. I do think often times the food is old. My kids “tolerated” the Egusi Soup but we’ve had way better. When we asked the clerk if tripe comes with the assorted meat she mentioned she didn’t think so. Only to get home and tripe was inside. She also said there would be goat meat inside but there wasn’t and we paid $2 extra.

Anyway, if they could be a little more consistent and prepare “Fresh” food it would make a difference. The tripe and beef tasted as if it was part of another soup that they simply “added” !

The food has been great every time I’ve visited. I’ve been to both the Westheimer and Pearland locations, and the experience has been consistently good. The customer service is solid, and the food is flavorful and satisfying. At the Pearland location, the food isn’t quite as spicy, which I understand may be based on the customer base, but when I asked for my food to be cooked at its normal heat level, they were more than happy to accommodate.

I absolutely love the beef suya, as well as the shrimp and crawfish dish. The plantain chips they bring out at the beginning are a really nice touch and always hit the spot. One of our household favorites is the okra soup with pounded yam—it never disappoints.

Overall, this is a really great place with a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. I definitely recommend both locations. They also have a great happy hour, making it an excellent spot to bring guests. I’ve had friends visit from out of town who absolutely loved it, and now every time they come to the Houston area, this is where they ask to go.

Authentic restaurant quality Nigerian food. Wait staff was patient and helpful, as we had never been there before. Decor and music set the vibe with comfortable raised sofa seating, with black and gold accents. We will be back!

Food was delicious! Decor and vibes were neat as well. Very flavorful food and some dishes even offer a sample to try before you choose to order it. Would definitely recommend. The beef suya was our favorite, but the catfish egusi was really tender and the jollof plate was worth every dollar!

Loved the experience! I went in without any expectations as this was my first one at a Nigerian cuisine restaurant. I was pleased with the food and service.

Food is amazing! I loved the rich flavor. We ordered the Suya Wings, Suya Wrap (Beef), and Suya Meat (Beef). Each of these had a distinct rich flavor. We were given plantain chips as a free starter. I've read in other comments that the plantain chips come out of a bag. Big deal! It still tasted good to me, especially with the sauce it came with. I loved the wings! The sauce with it was spicy and delicious. 😋 A couple of things I wish were different - (1) Suya Meat beef was quite tough. Must be with the long cook time. More tenderness to the meat would have been nice. (2) Jollof Rice could have been more flavorful. It tasted bland.

The one gripe I have about the place is the time it took the food to come out. We went in when there wasn't much of a crowd. It took about 15 minutes for the appetizers to come out and close to 35 minutes until the food came out. I'm not sure how they would fare if the restaurant was really busy.

formatted_address: 3306 S Texas 6 Unit 100, Houston, TX 77082, United States
name: Osuma Suya

reviews.text:
Got a chicken shawarma and small portion of beef suya via delivery app. The shawarma was stuffed with chicken, coleslaw, sausage and a very spicy sauce. If you don't like pepper, skip the sauce. It's more than enough for two people to eat.
The beef suya is cut into bite-size pieces, spiced well and is tender. This is definitely one of the best suya spots in Houston.

It’s  not a question. Don’t even think about it or consider going somewhere else if it’s Suya you’re looking for. As someone who grew up in Lagos on Ikoyi Club Suya and Glover Court Suya, this is absolutely hands down the best Suya I’ve had in America and I’m willing to bet on it. Not to mention and nice clean restaurant space and great service. Oh and the portion sizes are insane. One order of beef Suya can literally last me two days or at least 2-3 meals. They also have a Suya box that comes with Jollof rice and plantain and coleslaw. Insane value for your money. Lary took great care of me at the houston store. LOVE IT!

Absolutely amazing experience! The food was authentic, flavorful, and tasted just like home. Every dish was perfectly seasoned, fresh, and served hot. The cashier Tolu was so warm and welcoming, making you feel like family from the moment you walk in and was very helpful with choosing what to order. The atmosphere was clean, vibrant, and inviting. If you’re looking for real Nigerian cuisine done right, this is the place to go. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this spot to everyone!

I wish there was inside seating other than that the food was quality along with the service. It took maybe 10 min for the food to be served and for made to order food i can’t complain. I got the shawarma with chicken and beef with no sausage. I shared fries with my friend with the shawarma sauce and it was fire 🔥🔥🔥. The Chapman drink was so refreshing i do wish it was colder though. Appreciated the fact that while waiting we even received a sample of the suya which was very unexpected but very tasty. I will definitely be back again. Also the art on the walls are a nice touch and my friends and enjoyed figuring out the portraits were. I do wish they could be open longer as an after hours spot that would be soooooo clutch!!!!

I was craving chicken suya — something spicy, tender, flavorful, and satisfying. What I got from Osuma Suya was nothing short of a tragedy on a plate. It wasn’t suya; it was a burnt sacrifice that even a stray dog would turn away from. Charred beyond recognition, dripping with thick black grease, it was an insult to both taste and craft. Whoever manned that grill showed no respect for food, customers, or the name of the establishment. That person needs to be replaced immediately. I couldn’t even bring myself to take a second bite.

The food was amazing here. It’s one of the most authentic Nigerian food I’ve had since moving to Houston. Definitely a 5 star from me!

10/10 from the food to the customer service. They have a variety of delicious dishes. The best Suya and Jollof I’ve had in a long time.

formatted_address: 13905 Westheimer Rd, Houston, TX 77077, United States
name: Sauce Queen (Food Truck)

reviews.text: I have been in the US for over 15 years and had Nigerian food from several places across the US, SauceQueen LLC serves the best and most authentic Nigerian food I have ever had away from home! I became a big fan after trying their food the first time. We came all the way from Austin the second time and would be coming again. We wish we could take them to Austin with us! Amazing food, wonderful service - simply the best! The flavor is remarkable! I can keep going - what an amazing experience!!

I ordered abacha and nkwobi and when I say it’s the best I’ve tasted in houston hands down, I’m not lying!!! The complimentary ponmo was juicy and tasty and  well received. It reminded me of a abacha joint restaurant in Enugu, Nigeria near my grandmother’s house. The food was worth the price. I had leftovers for lunch the next day. The nkwobi was flavorful and actually had decent amount of meat and not just filled with bones. I will definitely be ordering again! I ordered through Uber Eats so I don’t know about the atmosphere there.
The only concern is how long it took for the food to be picked up. I’m sure it has to do with it being freshly made so you have to be patient for quality meals.

Terrible food. Shouldn’t even be called Nigerian food. No flavor. Jollof rice was still wet. Chicken was dry and did not taste like suya. Just spicy and no seasoning at all. If you want rice that you will have to go cook again till it’s done you can go here. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE!

I ordered the abacha/fish and it was AMAZING!!!!! A good 10/10. The food was extremely amazing and everyone that tried it with me, loved it. The abacha was so perfect, the fish was well fried and the complimentary ponmo was so delicious as well. The chef was also very nice and welcoming. I cannot wait to try other items on the menu.
Jollof rice w/turkey jollof spaghetti w beef excellent service fresh dishes cooked to order.  I eat here regularly.  Cleanest food truck I’ve seen in Houston…

formatted_address: 23010 Highland Knolls Dr Ste C, Katy, TX 77494, United States
name: Royal Arm

reviews.text:
The wife and I were looking for some good African food and found this place because it was one of the two closets places. The other place we'd tried to go to a couple of times was either never open or closing when we got there despite having hours that stated otherwise.  So Royal Arm it was even though it was 25 minutes away. But I'm GLAD we made the trek because the food was amazing!

Nothing is under a heat lamp and it is cooked right when you order it. The food was so good, I was eating off my plate and my wife's plate! And somehow, 15 minutes in, my food was STILL hot enough to burn my mouth. Everything was seasoned just right and cooked to perfection and the service was great! If you are craving some good West African cuisine in Katy (or anywhere in the Houston arwa), you can't miss coming here!

Jollof rice is amazingggg

Red stew with rice was sooo freaking good i just want moreeee the best thing ive tried !
The Egusi soup was sooo.. delicious. The service was fantastic. The ladies are so sweet!!! Thank you I’ll be back .. soon.

This is an edited review. I went 4 years ago it was wonderful. I went today ordered jerk chicken
Goat and rice. Chicken was OLD like day old. The goat was old and really just bones. God requires a reasonable service. Really disappointed. Spent $50 two dishes both unedible. Old reheated food with sauce someone could get sick. Waited 30 mins.

reviews.text:

Someone finally gets it!! Presentation, give them! Taste of the food (made with a request), PERIOD. 10/10. I’m pleasantly surprised by this restaurant and will 10000% be back. I’ve been scratching my head trying to understand why the other Nigerian restaurants struggle to deliver. Finally. Someone came through with the professionalism and the deliciousness we deserve. Photo is mid bite with some of my sister’s jollof (bomb!!!!)

Best african food ever! We were visiting from out of town & wanted to try out the Cafe near our hotel. My picky eater kids loved the chicken & Jollof, I got a stew & and egusi as well. Will be back, the lovely young lady was the cook, cashier, waitress, & DJ & I asked her...did u make this? She giggled & said yes. We will stop by every time we're in town. Thank you Afri-Cafe for making our family african dining experience wonderful.

I was sold some burnt meat pies and fish rolls. Meat is clearly dark brown, as you can see, while the dough was hard and crunchy from frequent reheating.

Someone in that kitchen ought to be ashamed of themselves, and I hope yall step your business game up.

Unbelievable.

reviews.text:

The portion I received was the same as shown in the picture, but the price was $12, which felt too expensive for what I got. In addition, the rice was cold, very hard, and tasteless.

I was really hoping for improvement after two years, but I left disappointed once again. I hope the restaurant considers feedback seriously and works on improving food quality and value.

My 10 year old and myself wanted to try Fufu for a very long time. And unfortunately we choose this spot for experience. Horrible. Place is to close for 10pm; went in around 815pm. And I wish she would've just closed early because NOTHING on that BUFFET Style service was appealing. Everything looked dry and old old old. Asked about something I saw on the menu which I thought was Gumbo from the advising; only  to find out it's actually okra.
Okay that's the start. I okra had 1 piece of FROZEN crab claw and 1 shrimp. The smell of shellfish was so pungent I refused to eat it. Just a sample was ok. And let me state.. Just AWFUL!!. a bunch of slime! The lady that prepared this foolishness stated they were out of crabs so she offered me a placement meat in which I asked her what paired well with the "okra" and she just slaps 2 pieces of meat parts on top! Like, ok??!
She shouldn't have sold me that bowl of slop! She wasn't inviting at first, to which my daughter even mentioned it to me. Let's continue the Fufu was ok . I'll give another spot a try. Won't let this first-time bad experience detour us from what may be delicious. Just won't go here again. Nothing on that BUFFET looked like it ever tasted good. No seasoning just a bunch of greasy dry meat. At least an HOUR AND HALF until closing. She couldn't cook fresher food for the evening rush?!. Maybe that's why no one was there!
SIDE NOTE>>> Sometimes you must lose to gain!!
30 bucks trashed

My family had a great experience at Lagos Buka! The owner was great, she was hospitable and friendly.  The assortment of food was vast and everything look delicious... We tried the Nkwobi, Asun, white rice with Goat Stew, jollof rice and Catfish Platter(call at least an hour and half ahead to order). Everything tasted good.  Also had the Chapman slushy-- also delicious!

Visited today and it was so welcoming!
I have wanted to try Nigerian cuisine for years and the owner was extremely warm and friendly. She gave us some tasters of a few different dishes available and they were all absolutely delicious! Very helpful and even talked us through the health benefits of a few different soups!
We tried the beef stew and the Egusi soup alongside the poundo... it tasted absolutely amazing and I can't wait to visit again to try more of the tasty dishes available! Thank you so much!

Ordered Designer stew “ofada”  today but for got red stew delivered. No big deal mistakes happens. Called the restaurant to confirm if their designer stew was supposed to be red stew just so next when I place order I can be sure. She said nope your stew isn’t red stew it’s supposed to be black. So I ask her are you saying I’m lying ? Her response was “oh well I’m just telling you there’s no way you would get red stew well im not the owner so” when I tell you I was so shocked I just hung up and door dash refunded me. Attached is the picture of the red stew I got. Which she never agreed to.

formatted_address: 6509 Chimney Rock Rd, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Bahel Ethiopian Mart and Dining

reviews.text:
I’ve tried Ethiopian food in several states, and this spot easily takes the crown. Everything hits — the flavor, the huge portions, the chill atmosphere, and the insanely kind staff.

I’ve been here twice while visiting Houston and both times ordered the Vegan Combination (12 different veggies — every single one packed with flavor). For just $10 more, you can add Doro Wat, which is a must.

The quality, taste, and quantity you get for the price are unbeatable. The platter could easily feed four people, but we’re total foodies and finished it b

Bahel Ethiopian Mart  is an unassuming location with incredible food. We started with sambusas and an Ethiopian beer, and then shared a specialty plate with chikina tibs, doru, collard greens, and spicy lentils served with injera.  Injera is a fermented flatbread that is used as the utensil. No forks or spoons. You use the bread to dip and scoop the food.  The warm spices rich flavors, and perfectly cooked meats were absolutely fabulous. I understand why this place is on the Houston Chronicle's Top 100 restaurants. I wish we lived closer so we could go more often. If you live in Houston and like to try new cultural cuisine, check this place out. You won't be disappointed.
Miron and his family run this food mart and restaurant. The meat is butchered right on the premises. Miron spent a lot of time with us explaining their culture and food. He had no idea they were listed in the top 100. He even convinced us to buy some fresh Ethiopian coffee beans and try roasting it ourselves. I LOVED this place.

Its my first time trying ethipoian food,ordered the mushrooms stir fry and chickpea gravy (shiro)
Loved the flavors with fresh vegetables.
Highly recommend to anyone who wants to try ethipoian food.

Incredible dine in experience! Came for my good friend’s birthday and they were happy to accommodate us. The server was amazing, provided excellent suggestions and supportive in our choices.  We ordered a good amount and balance between meat and vegetarian options. Great quality food, i didnt do the ordering but the cabbage and chicken dishes were my favorite. They were pretty busy from what I saw, on a Sunday evening which is always a good sign. I highly recommend!

I recently had the chance to dine at an Ethiopian restaurant, and it was a truly memorable experience. From the moment I walked in, the warm, inviting atmosphere set the tone — soft traditional music in the background, earthy décor, and the aroma of spices that immediately made me hungry.

The highlight, of course, was the food. I ordered a mixed platter served on injera, the spongy sourdough flatbread that doubles as both plate and utensil. Every dish had its own distinct personality — the lentils were rich and comforting, the greens had just the right balance of flavor and spice, and the beef tibs were perfectly seasoned and tender. Eating with my hands, tearing the injera to scoop up the stews, felt like such an authentic and communal experience.

The staff was incredibly welcoming and took the time to explain each dish, which I really appreciated since some of it was new to me. They also made sure my water glass was always full and checked in just enough without being intrusive.

Overall, it was more than just a meal — it felt like being welcomed into someone’s home. If you’ve never tried Ethiopian cuisine before, I highly recommend it. The flavors are bold, the experience is unique, and this restaurant in particular made it all feel special.

formatted_address: 5506 Bellaire Blvd ste c, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Harar Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: I really enjoyed my experience at this Ethiopian restaurant. The food was delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. The service was excellent — very friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Everything was well prepared and satisfying. I hope this restaurant continues to grow and becomes even more successful. Highly recommended!
Delicious food, beautifully presented, shared with great friends.  The owner and servers were wonderful. Enjoy!

I met up my friend so she could try out different style food. It was very hard meat and veggies and didn't taste good at all. I will not be returning here. I typically love Ethiopian food, however will revisit Blue Nile instead next time since I never had an issue there.
Really great food. Top-notch service and staff.  Easy to get to off of 610. You definitely want to come here.

Typically restaurants that are new try to push new customers to give them a 5 stars. Not at HARAR they were very laid back check on us regularly and wanted an honest feedback back. Very friendly atmosphere.

On top of that the food is super delicious. They have vegan options and you can customize your food to your liking. This is a new Ethiopian restaurant in town and so far the best Ethiopian food I had in Houston.

formatted_address: 6121 Hillcroft Ave c1, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Kenna

reviews.text: I've enjoyed international cuisine in many countries. Finding consistently high-quality dining experiences can be a challenge in some regions. Texas, in my experience, presents such a challenge.  While there are certainly exceptions, discovering truly exceptional restaurants requires more effort.  I personally would recommend visiting this restaurant for out of this world Ethiopian coffee, food, and hospitality. I hope to be back very soon with new friends so they can enjoy your great Ethiopian food to.
I love coming here. Their food and service is top notch. I love the coffee ceremony too. If you are in Houston and want to try a good Ethiopian place Kenna is the right spot.

Kena Cafe never missed with their Kitfo, Shiro, Shefinfin, and Awaze Tibs. Every dish was flavorful, comforting, and tasted like it was made with real care. Simple, authentic, and unforgettable. They have also a unique taste  Sambusa and coffee for breakfast, among other varieties of food.

Enjoyed the food from Kenna.

The injera is not as sour as other injeras I’ve had. Very good, comes down to a personal preference.

Kenna includes tables for eating as well as a small shop front to purchases spices and other traditional ware and needs.

Many Vegan / vegetarian options exist

Eveytime we come to this place we feel right at home. Very welcoming service. The food is never disappointing. The owner has amazing talent with evert meal that comes to your table. Always ready to attend to the customer’s needs. Whether you’re a lover to Ethiopian food or wanting to try something different, go to Kenna Cafe. You will not be disappointed.

formatted_address: 6121 Hillcroft Ave Suite N, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Sheba

reviews.text: We love love love the Lamb Haneeth, the chicken mandi is really good as well. The sauce that goes with the food is amazing, chef kiss, we love it!
The food was absolutely delicious!  The chicken was soooo moist and tender.  It looked like it might be very spicy but it wasn't.  It was very flavorful!  We will be back!

We got the chicken and rice platter to go, but I actually did not go inside, so I cannot attest to how the decor looks inside.

I'll start with the good.
The chicken has a great flavor and even about 45 minutes later, when we started eating it, it was still juicy and not dry, which is great. The rice was fluffy and not mushy, so that's good as well.

I will say that I was disappointed that the tray seemed like it was half empty to begin with. If they put it in a smaller dish, perhaps it would look more full, but I really wish for the size of dish we got about a half tray would be at least half full. It looked scarce. At least it tasted good.

Honestly, the food has nothing to do with authentic Yemeni cuisine. The flavors were bland, completely lacking the rich spices and taste you’d expect from real Yemeni dishes. Even the bread was cold, like it was made yesterday. I was really let down, and I’m definitely not coming back here again.

Best Hanith lamb and Grilled fish w/ rice in Houston. This is authentic Yemeni food! It was flavorful, tender, and packed with different spices. The aroma of the restaurant was very nice. The place itself was very clean and tidy, and a very relaxed place that you can come and dine with your friends. The atmosphere was very welcoming, the guy said Salam to us as soon as we walked in, and it just felt like such a nice place.

formatted_address: 6617 Chimney Rock Rd, Houston, TX 77081, United States
name: Nazareth Cafe

reviews.text: Nazareth Cafe is the perfect late-night hangout! Great atmosphere, chill vibes, and the ideal spot to unwind on a Wednesday night or early Thursday morning.

The location is definitely not great, the parking is horrible and the maximum capacity is probably 30 ppl.  But the service and food both make up for everything else.  Our waitress had difficulty answering our questions due to the language differences so she called some one on the phone to help (great idea, very nice of her) so after speaking with a women on the phone, we ordered exactly what we were looking for.  The Tej, Honey wine was amazing (the best I have ever had) my husband about finished an entire bottle himself. We order the vegetarian platter and some beef tibs both were delicious and the portions were very generous.  We will definitely be going back and taking friends.

This is a shady place that needs to be investigated. They stay open until sunrise playing LOUD bass music even though the city passed a new ordinance for bar music within 300 feet of a residence. The other day the cops showed up in the parking lot nearby and this place turned off their open sign and closed the blinds while they still had late hour customers inside. Must have something to hide. This place will be sued really soon if they keep it up.
Best experience and best owner,he has best customer service with a smile well established and cozy spot to relax and smoke some hookah and watch games.Fetwi so cool owner

Just walked in to order the Vegetarian Combo the lady tells me "No they don't have" 😆 wow safe to say I won't be revisiting. Pretty trashy on the outside probably saved my life 😅. Thank God for small miracles.

reviews.text: This place is fire🔥 besttt food I had in Texas. reviews.text: 10/10 experience. Some of the best food I’ve ever had, period. The malai kofta, kebabs, and chicken appetizer were TO DIE FOR. Every dish you recommended was phenomenal - we wish we had taken photos of everything, but suffice it to say that the food was consistently delicious. The ambiance, as always, was great.

While there are many popular catering options that people usually go with, most guests are honestly tired of the same repetitive flavors and predictable menus. Lasbela was a complete breath of fresh air and truly became a showstopper at our events.

The food was outstanding rich in flavor, perfectly prepared, and beautifully presented. Guests could not stop talking about it, and we were repeatedly asked where the food was from. It left a lasting impression and elevated the overall experience of our wedding events.

What truly sets Lasbela apart, however, is not just the food but their end-to-end service. From the moment preparations began in their kitchen to the very last minute of the event, everything was handled with absolute professionalism. We did not have to worry about logistics, timing, or execution they took care of every detail seamlessly, allowing us to enjoy our special moments stress-free.

A very special thanks to Aziz Noorani, who was an absolute gentleman throughout the entire process. His attention to detail, responsiveness, and genuine concern to make everything perfect truly stood out. He went above and beyond to ensure that the service and quality were up to the highest standard.

I highly recommend Lasbela Restaurant to anyone planning a wedding or any catering event. If you are looking for exceptional food, flawless service, and a team you can fully trust, Lasbela is the right choice.

This restaurant exceeded expectations with its outstanding cuisine, including irresistible Munfarid Chicken Chargha, Bhunna Gosht. Malai handi,  & Chapli Kabob was a particular highlight. Furthermore, the service was exemplary, thanks to Owner personalized attention, embodying the lofty service standards set by Manager and his team, making this eatery highly deserving of praise and endorsement

Labella, despite being highly rated, turned out to be a very average experience. At first glance, the ambiance looked very nice and the service was good too, but the main factor—the food—was disappointing.

Even though we were the first ones to start brunch, the food was not served hot and looked like it had been kept for a long time. The puris were hard and not as they should be. The Chana, aloo tarkari, nihari, and kebabs all lacked flavor.

Ambiance does matter, but people will only return if the food is delicious. At $30 per person, it simply wasn’t worth it. Labella really needs to improve the taste and quality of their dishes for returning customers.

reviews.text:
Mai Colachi Sugar Land delivers a very enjoyable dining experience overall. I tried their steak, chops, and garlic naan, and the food quality was excellent. The service truly stood out attentive, courteous, and efficient throughout the meal. The ambiance was also quite pleasant, making it a great spot for a relaxed dinner with family or friends.

That said, Mai Colachi Sugar Land is still a solid choice for quality food, excellent service, and a comfortable atmosphere. With a broader selection of classic steak sides, it would be an even more outstanding dining experience. 😋

Arpi’s Phoenicia Deli – A Decent Stop, But Not For Me

I recently visited Arpi’s Phoenicia Deli after hearing some buzz about it, and while I can see why others might enjoy it, it just wasn’t the spot for me. The food was good—not bad by any means—but it didn’t blow me away either. I sampled a few different dishes, hoping something would really stand out, but unfortunately, most of them just didn’t hit the mark for my personal taste. And that’s coming from someone who loves Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine. I’ve had similar dishes at other restaurants that were more flavorful, better presented, and even more affordable.

One thing I will say I was pleasantly surprised by: they had sugar-free baklava, which made me so happy! That was probably the highlight of my visit. It’s not often you find sugar-free options for desserts like that, and it was a nice touch for someone like me who tries to be mindful of sugar intake. So, kudos to them for that!

The atmosphere of the restaurant, though, left a little to be desired. It wasn’t as clean as I would have liked—tables had leftover trays and trash on them, and it seemed like things weren’t being cleared promptly. That really impacted the overall experience for me. The customer service was okay—not bad, not great. The staff were polite enough, but nothing really stood out in terms of hospitality or attentiveness.

All in all, I think Arpi’s has its place and could be worth checking out if you’re curious or if this kind of food is new to you. But for someone who’s had a lot of experience with Mediterranean food, and who knows what they love, it just didn’t leave a lasting impression. I’m glad I gave it a try, but I wouldn’t personally go back.

reviews.text: I heard about this Bosnian restaurant on Nextdoor app and decided to try it. Never had Bosnian food before. Actually, Bosnian food is an amalgam of many different regions such as Middle eastern and Greek to name a couple. The restaurant is very simply decorated but comfortable and not loud. We had the Greek salad which was among the better ones I’ve had. I had a grilled chicken sandwich in a baguette and I don’t know what the various herbs/spices they used but I have been craving it ever since. It seems simple enough but I found the flavor to be really delicious. We had their homemade Turkish coffee. It is not for everyone but I appreciated the abundance of flavors and aromas that were present. We tried the fried anchovies and I have to say I really enjoyed these much more than fried calamari which derives all of its flavor from the batter. With this item, the anchovy flavor was very present but not as salty as anchovies that you typically find in salads and other fare. Of course, if you do not like fish and specifically the strong flavor of anchovies this will be an item for you to avoid. Finally, the baklava was more hearty than most and not as sweet but it was to my liking. Additionally they have a boiled peeled whole apple stuffed with walnuts and topped with a cream which will be liked by anyone loves desserts such as apple pie. Very different and captured a strong apple flavor. The staff is perfect and the prices quite reasonable.

First time here and absolutely loved it! The food was amazing and full of flavor. Our server, Yosmery, was fantastic super attentive and always made sure my friend’s Stellas came with a chilled glass every single time. Excellent service and a great experience overall. Highly recommend!

All of the meat we serve (including pepperoni) is halal, except for prosciutto.

Great Bosnian cuisine.  Try the Sakavci....Bosnian meatballs served over pasta.  The Cevapcici sandwich, I got the large, traditional Bosnian style grilled beef links served on a tasty lepinjas bread...yum.  The Turkish style coffee is great and don't forget to try a dessert.  Amazing people work here, we enjoyed visiting with the owner, Kamal.  they made us feel right at home.  We visited with the owner for a bit, super nice guy.

I believe my server was Maria, she explained the menu to me and what were the most popular items and checked on me many times. I order the margarita pizza and a latte, both are wonderful. If you’re tired of fast-food and want a nice meal this is definitely the place to go to. The prices are not crazy for the quality of food and service. Will definitely be coming back
