It was like home again. We ordered almost everything the beef and chicken suya, Peppered goat, The noodles and Zobo. Everything was so good we are planning our next trip back. Thank you.

The best mobile food service I have seen currently in Houston, so it's not just the regular food truck because they do out do events and make your food according to your taste and request leaving you with a continuous unique taste every time you meet them at an event, as you never know what tobexpect. Their pepper goat meat suya and sause was simply mind blowing and at a very affordable price in my opinion with lovely and friendly staffs

The suya is absolutely mouthwatering, and the menu offers even more delicious options! The staff is warm, friendly, and exceptional. Plus, they cater for events! This has quickly become my new favorite spot. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 2352 Cypress Creek Pkwy, Houston, TX 77068, United States
name: La Belle Etoile African Kitchen

reviews.text: I'm very disappointed 😞 we arrived at the place at 5:00pm, the main door was closed,  and the phone number displayed on your website page doesn't work. Coming from the hotel, both my wife and myself, wasted our time and our money. It was very frustrated 😠 When you closed your business, please let inform the potential customers in order to avoid what we have today.

formatted_address: 11919 Bissonnet St, Houston, TX 77099, United States
name: Osite African Hot Pot

reviews.text: Ordered the Abacha for takeout! The food was made on time and the flavors were immaculate! I will be back, so thankful to have found authentic African food!
Great customer service & the food tasted so good! The afang soup was very tasty . I would highly recommend this place & i’ll definitely be ordering again
Great and authentic African food. Hmmm yummy. Excellent customer service.
The Abacha in this restaurant hit 😋 different, delicious meal and they serve a nice portion too. This restaurant is a hidden gem. 👍🏽 I Stamp!.
Great ambience, delicious meal. Felt just like home. It’s really home away from home.

formatted_address: 5525 Harford Rd, Baltimore, MD 21214, United States
name: Diasporan Soul Jamaican & American Fusion

reviews.text: Wow oh wow, what a treat I just experienced.  From the moment walking in I felt the good vibes. Greeted with a wall of books and great tunes playing throughout the place. I was welcomed pleasantly, allowed to even sample some dishes I was not sure about, and served timely. While waiting I browsed the shop and got some great finds as well. They even support local entrepreneurs products.  Now the the vibes were too good to leave and I sat and ate my to go meal here! The food didn't disappoint one bit. Oh my im so stuffed and satisfied while I type this. Please come through and support this local gem.

PRO: customer service and atmosphere is great
CON: This is by far the most tasteless Jamaican food I have ever eaten. It is very bland.
Plantain: thin, over cooked and mushy
Stew Chicken: taste like plain chicken even with the sauce
Rice and Peas: just rice

Cost: over $30
This place is fire!!! From the wellness to the herbs and spices to the books and the FOOD! The prices were great and the portion was huge! One of the best tasting brown stew chicken I’ve ever had

I've never had a bad meal or a bad time here. I've been here often and enjoy all the food. Jerk chicken is one of my favorite foods, and theirs is on point! The flavor is great, and it's tender and juicy. I got an order of plantains the other day, and they were honestly the best Ive had at a restaurant. I like my plantains a certain way, not cut too thick, not slimy, and a little crisp around the edges... they got it perfectly. Their veggie chunks and curry chickpeas are great, even for the non-vegans. Service is impeccable, and I've always been treated well, with prompt attention. Even when it's busy, the staff maintains great service. The dining area is clean and well decorated, and is great for a solo visit, group trip, or even to host/attend an event. I've done them all. The dining area also serves as a retail space with plenty of books, herbs, incense, etc. It's always a pleasure.
I use to drive across town to Park Heights to get my Jamaican food fix.. Not after today! Season very well and great portions. Im hooked . Thanks

formatted_address: 2905 Campbellton Rd SW suite c, Atlanta, GA 30311, United States
name: Nema Kitchen

reviews.text:
What a great find on Google.  The reviews are truly correct. Great food, good customer service and definitely authentic 👌 🙌 👍 😀 😉 .

I had the Lamb Chebb , it was my first time and I  was beyond well satisfied.

Definitely recommended.

Parking is tricky but once you get over that , then you can enjoy 😋 😋 😋 😋 😋 yumminess.

The food was awesome. They even give samples out to make sure you like what you are ordering. My husband had chicken yassa, I had okra with fufu, my daughter had grilled snapper, and my son had the lamb. Everything was cooked to perfection. The atmosphere was cordial to say the least. Not very welcoming. At least the young lady that took our order wasn’t rude. The location, I’m not sure of, we’re not from the area.. but my son was outside throwing something away and these two young men started running towards him from behind, and they stopped suddenly when they saw my husband walk outside towards my son. Thanks Nema for the food.
Food was absolutely amazing. Service was even better. All the ladies at the store explained what everything on the menu was and also blessed with the portion sizes

I come here all the time the food is always plentiful and delicious however whomever the 2 ladies working this Saturday bad attitude and tried to give me and my friend 1shrimp and 1 grab with the order as we watch her fill up 2 plates for an African guy that walked in and then tried to say that’s how it come not knowing I’m a regular and never seen them before

I come here very often but some days the younger employees really are
Messing up the orders and cheating the customers out of their money.. it literally looks like they chopped pieces of chicken up and threw it on my plate. Also the food was Luke warm not the chicken but the rice and sides . The last few times I have came my plate didn’t look like this at all. I do recommend this restaurant they do have great food but seems like every time the younger employees are there it’s like you don’t get the same service

formatted_address: 6065 Mableton Pkwy SW, Mableton, GA 30126, United States
name: FAD African Fine Dining Nigerian Restaurant

reviews.text:
I've been a loyal customer of FAD for the past 7 years, following them from Austell to their new location in Mableton. My go-to order is always their delicious goat meat pepper soup - I've tried other dishes, but this is always a winner. I've even ventured out to try other African restaurants, but FAD has always been my favorite.

My visit to their new Mableton location on 10/31/2025, was a great experience. The goat meat pepper soup was just as good as I remembered, and it really hit the spot. The owner is super welcoming and talks to you with such kindness. Overall, I really enjoyed my meal and I'm glad they're still serving up amazing food in their new spot.

*edit 9/26/25* The response that you were swamped with online orders when we were your only customers(2) and only one other man came in during the time we were seated and his order seemed pretty regular is even more reason we will not return. Not to mention we had to continue to yell to get any service. Very unhappy this was your stance.

My husband and I strolled in here close to the opening time. We entered and stood around for what felt like 15 min. We finally decided to walk out and heard a woman's voice calling to us. Now usually for me its a no but my husband said come on let's go. Not the best decision but definitely not the worst. We sit down and it doesn't get any better. We get bottles of water. And stare at them menu. We ordered jolof rice fish soup and some beef appetizer. All we can say is the food was hot. Hot hot hot hot. The services was non existent and we have now concluded that it was an experience and we will not do it again.

I can’t say enough positive things about FAD African Fine Dining! From the moment we walked in, the ambiance felt warm and elevated, with an attention to detail that instantly set the tone. The menu offers an impressive variety of authentic Nigerian dishes—everything we tried (especially the suya and egusi soup) was cooked with precision, full flavor, and real heart. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable about the cuisine, and committed to making our experience memorable. Whether you’re looking for a special night out or just exploring West African cuisine for the first time, this place absolutely delivers. I’ll be coming back again and recommending it to everyone I know! Don’t judge my picture I tore it up lol
Wonderful food as a Nigerian born American, who was raised in New York.. that just moved to Atlanta, GA. The food was *chef’s kiss” Jellof 10/10, assorted meats 8/10, plaintain 2/10. Suya 8/10.

They served me the best jollof rice special, it was the best, very tasty and delicious. I tried their suya and it was the best I’ve ever had. Their Ayamashe was nicely spiced, it had a lot of meat in it. The owner was really nice, friendly and very helpful.

formatted_address: 2566 Briarcliff Rd NE ste 101, Atlanta, GA 30329, United States
name: Desta Ethiopian Kitchen

reviews.text:
Absolutely outstanding experience! As out-of-town visitors, we were blown away by the authentic flavors and warm hospitality. Our group of 4 shared a huge family-style platter with both meat and vegetarian options.

A huge shoutout to our waiter Yohannes, who was exceptional! He patiently guided us through the menu, recommended the perfect combo for our group, and even shared great tips on local spots to check out around Atlanta since we were visiting from out of state. Highly recommend

Lovely experience at Desta! The restaurant decor is tasteful, good for a lunch or dinner with family or friends. You could also have a date night here. I dined in for lunch. The portions are generous. We ordered the meat plate and chose three meats and also got side vegetables (gomen, cabbage and lentils) and ingera. All were very well seasoned. The gomen was a little  spicy.  We had lamb, ribeye, and salmon.  This a great option if you like variety.  We ordered the hot tea and honey wine. The hot tea has spiced water and is delicious. The honey wine was sweet and paired well with the meal.  Highly recommend Desta!

This location was very busy on a week night and for good reason! I sat at the bar, although they had a small table for two available near the door.

The bartender was very knowledgeable about the food and recommended a few dishes since it was my first time there. He even explained Ethiopia's history with Italy after I questioned the pasta dishes. I decided to try one.

The pasta dish I ordered was prefect on every way! I am very particular about my pasta, but they exceeded my expectations! The noodle was cooked al dente, the sauce was tasty, but not overbearing, and they brought the food out piping hot!

The atmosphere was family oriented. It was loud but you could still have a conversation Everyone was very cheerful and the staff were all pleasant.

I would definitely return!

This is truly one of the neatest and cleanest restaurants I’ve ever visited. As a vegetarian, I tried their vegan plate, and it was delicious — beautifully balanced spices that bring out the flavor without overwhelming the palate. I can’t say how close it is to traditional Ethiopian food, but it felt thoughtfully prepared and perfectly suited for anyone who appreciates clean, comforting flavors. And their Ethiopian tea — wow. Fragrant, soothing, and perfectly balanced — such a treat!
The staff were genuinely kind and friendly, which made the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be back

We've been coming to Desta for years. I'm loving the new location. It feels so much cleaner and upscale than the old house.  Injera is such a treat of you've never had it before. One of my favorite types of bread.  Both chicken and steak are delicious and seasoned perfectly.  Can't recommend this place enough. They're always amazing every time we go.

formatted_address: 6470 Spalding Dr suite b, Peachtree Corners, GA 30092, United States
name: Fly Chef Restaurant

reviews.text: My experience was fantastic! We traveled from McDonough Ga and was not disappointed. The food was delicious and authentic. The atmosphere was inviting and family friendly. We enjoyed the diversity of customers. Our waiter and host was Tyrel and he was very attentive. We met the owner and he is a first class guy.

Upon Arrival Tyrel handled us with care and kindness. He greeted us, allowed us to make ourselves comfortable. He was informative with his answer about any question we! It was my dates first time trying Fufu! She enjoyed every moment. Thank you the staff and Tyrel for helping me create a lasting memory with my partner ! Now let’s talk about food! The fufu had the perfect consistency ! We opted for the Shrimp Egusi soup. My goodness Flavor all up and through the dish! It was just the right amount of palm oil ! We had the tropical rhythms mocktail! Perfect balance of Pineapple and ginger. I think I’ll add some cherry juice next time
We will be retuning and sending  our friends

everything was delicious. i took my husband for his birthday because he has been craving some african food & they did not disappoint. we had the meat pies, suya, jollof rice, plantains, okra soup with shrimp, & egusi with beef. literally everything was great. our server tyrel was great and friendly. & restaurant was beautiful in the inside. we will be back.

Picked up some African food from this spot over the weekend. The food was amazing! Hot and fresh! I really loved that the plantains were not dripping with oil, they were prepared very nicely. I've been trying to introduce my son to African foods and he truly enjoyed this meal. Made me wish I had ordered more for the week. Lol. Would definitely order food from here again. Also inside looked inviting and like a place you would dine with a friend or two.

Some of the best food and service I have had in a while. My wife and I called in to make reservations and Evelyn spoke politely and told us to show up. From the great service from Evelyn again to the Pepper soup which reminds me home. The chef also introduced himself. Always proud to see a fellow Nigerian prioritize service and great food over glam.

formatted_address: 4452-4454 Jonesboro Rd, Forest Park, GA 30297, United States
name: Boniks African Cuisine - Nigerian Restaurant

reviews.text: THE FOOD WAS DELICIOUS! It was my first time trying this plate because I had seen it on social media before and it did not disappoint! Just be careful when eating because there is some fish bones in there but other than that the food was delicious!

I can’t express how happy I am to happy to have found this African restaurant — it truly cured my homesickness from Sierra Leone. The moment I took my first bite of the egusi and fufu, I felt like I was back home. The flavors were rich, comforting, and absolutely delicious — everything was cooked to perfection.

My wife and friend joined me, and they had the jollof rice with beef and plantains. They couldn’t stop talking about how fragrant and flavorful the food was. Every dish tasted authentic and made with love.

The lady who served us was so hospitable and sweet — her warm smile and kindness made the whole experience even better. We’ll definitely be coming back again soon, and I highly recommend anyone craving genuine African flavors to give this place a try. You won’t be disappointed!
Great food! Me and my girlfriend were greeted with so much kindness! Food was amazing!

This is my second time using them for catering. She catered jollof rice, egusi soup, vegetable soup, fried fish, fufu balls, and moi moi. Everything was delicious and ready on time. My guest enjoyed the food.

I’ve eaten here at least four times now and the food is always solid. I always get the jollof rice with the beef. The jollof rice is always flavorful and while the beef is not necessarily bad, it is always tough. I will say that the service here could be much better. It is important to give the appearance that you are eager to please and listen to a customer.

formatted_address: 420 14th St NW, Atlanta, GA 30318, United States
name: The Greedy Bunch

reviews.text: The guy taking our order was very helpful with giving his opinion of what was good. I ordered the Benachin (Jollof Rice) with a side of Plantains and fries. My friend ordered the Chicken Schwarma. The food came out fast and was very good. Great flavors and spices. Only bad was that the fridge was down so there were no options for drinks.

Ordered online after seeing photos and reading reviews. Absolutely delicious and great portions. Deff have two-three meals depending on what you order. Highly recommend the full meals with jollof and plantains. Wings were a little small but the house bbq was unique and delicious.
A hidden gem in Atlanta since it's hard to find Gambian restaurants in the United States. The peanut butter stew with lamb was pretty good. The rice was alright, but the plantains were delicious.
Food was ready quickly and service was good. Ordered the Domoda w/ Jollof rice and a chicken shawarma wrap. Both were great

🇬🇲 Greedy Bunch: Gamiban Flavor, Generous Hearts, and Fresh Spice! 🌶️🍚

Let's be clear: I don't go to Greedy Bunch for fancy décor or white-glove service. I go because the food is amazingly, reliably different and always fresh, hot, and ready! This is a quick-in, quick-out spot that delivers authentic, powerful flavor you simply won't find anywhere else.

🍛 The Flavor Revolution

This kitchen takes dishes you might know from other cuisines and translates them into something uniquely Gambian—and it works every single time. My favorites are the DOMODA Lamb over rice and the Domoda Chicken over rice. The sauces are rich, comforting, and deeply satisfying. If you're feeling adventurous, the Loaded Fries (built exactly how you want them) and the perfect Chicken Shawarma Wrap and Fries are must-haves.

But the drinks deserve their own shout-out: the Hibiscus Tea and that extra, extra spicy Ginger Juice are exactly the kick I need. 🔥

🤲 Generosity That Returns

What keeps me coming back isn't just the delicious Domoda; it's the beautiful, unexpected generosity they extended to me when they didn't even know I was in need. I truly believe that Allah (SWT) was pulling at their hearts to say yes when I asked. That combination of incredible food paired with the numerous good deeds and kindness they showed is why I am a loyal customer. It felt like a gentle reminder from my Creator: "I see you trying to keep it Halal, and I will provide."

⭐ The Verdict

If you love unique, flavorful cuisine and appreciate good people running an honest, generous business, make Greedy Bunch your next stop. It’s an easy five stars for food and heart. Go for the Domoda! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

formatted_address: 5651 Memorial Dr, Stone Mountain, GA 30083, United States
name: Le Nouveau Maquis

reviews.text: Sephora was our server and she was absolutely amazing.  She was so kind and patient.  The location is right off Memorial Drive in Stone Mountain; close to the highway.  There isn’t much parking in the lot, but they are in front of a building that has a huge lot and next door to another restaurant with a small lot.  If needed you could park in either of those places.  I’m not sure it is okay to park in those places, but I saw people parking there also.  The space isn’t big either. There might be 8-10 tables total, but there wasn’t a wait when I dined.  I arrived before my friend and was greeted immediately and sat immediately.  The restaurant was clean and beautifully decorated with artwork on the walls.  There was music playing and it was at the perfect volume for me to enjoy but still hear myself talk.  From the time we placed our orders to when the food arrived was probably 15-20 minutes.  I had egusi with chicken and fu fu.  It was so good and hearty.  I also ordered sorrel and plantains.  I enjoyed all of my food.  It was flavorful and filling.  I paid $46 for my entire meal which also included a bottle of water.  I will definitely go back.  Our server handed us a loyalty card at the end of our meal.  She was so amazing!!!

5 star food hands down. The best African food I ever tried this far. Egusi was super flavorful and the side of sweet/spicy sauce gave it a nice pop. Plantains cooked just right and not greasy. Jollof rice with lamb and onion sauce was excellent.

Customer services was excellent and the restaurant was very clean. The food a was was just average. The Jollof rice was good but the lamb was not tender. It was not tough, but it wasn’t tender either. There are other menu items I would like to try. I still recommend that you check this place out.

This was my first time visiting this restaurant, and the entire experience was a 10/10!! The staff was incredibly sweet, welcoming, and attentive. I ordered the Debe lamb with jollof rice, and it was absolutely amazing!! Perfectly seasoned with generous portions. I highly recommend this spot! I’ll definitely be back to try the suya!

Le Noweau Maquis is hands down one of my favorite spots! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection every time I dine in. You can really taste the authenticity and love put into each dish. If you’re looking for amazing West African cuisine, this is definitely the place to go!

formatted_address: 3979 Buford Hwy NE, Atlanta, GA 30345, United States
name: Little Lagos

reviews.text: Absolutely terrible experience at Little Lagos in Atlanta. I ordered sushi and rice — the rice tasted burnt, and what they called Suya was nothing but tiny scraps of meat with a few onions thrown in. It looked nothing like authentic Suya and was completely unacceptable, especially for the price. I spent nearly $50 for something that looked and tasted like leftovers. They clearly cut corners, especially on late-night orders. Don’t waste your money here — this was a total disappointment.

DO NOT ORDER HERE! A WASTE OF MONEY! They Used to be good now not at all they just want to over charge and gone no quality food there are many other African restaurants that will accommodate better I’m warming DONT SPEND YOUR MONEY HERE !!

After a long day of not eating, stumbling upon Little Lagos in Atlanta felt like a blessing! The smoky rice, tender fish, and rich flavors instantly transported me back to Africa. So good to finally find food that truly hit the spot👌🏽

Disappointing Takeout from Little Lagos
My recent takeout from Little Lagos in Buford was pretty disappointing. I ordered the Jollof rice with goat meat, which came out to a steep $34. For that price, the Jellof tested off in so many ways i couldn't wrap my mind around it. The goat was plain but it has the texture I like in goat just too plain. the portion was small, and the packaging was nothing special just a regular cheap plate. To top it off, they automatically apply a 10% gratuity on all takeout orders (20% for dine-in). This felt like a hidden charge and, combined with the high price and small portion, made for a really poor value. The "smooth dining experience" promised on their website definitely didn't extend to my takeout. I think this is more of a night bar/club than more of a restaurant.

Ordered with Uber eats,  ordered  sprite with my order and they did not include it in my order but they charged me.
I  asked for utentils and it wasn’t included either . I wonder how they expected me to eat and drink.
Very tasteless food coupled  with poor service.
Please do a better job, I would have over looked the missed items but the food wasn’t good.

formatted_address: 5150 Austell Rd, Austell, GA 30106, United States
name: Ayo African Restaurant bar and lounge

reviews.text: The atmosphere was very homey. My 1st time having African food and I was amazed at all the flavors that danced in my mouth. Fish was smoked and goat was perfect. Healthy choice to any culture!!!! I’ll be back!!!
First time trying Ayo and the food is very delicious. I would 100% recommend this spot to all my African food lovers and for anyone that wants to try African food.

The suya meat is tough. To eat am be like fight. And how the heck is this $15? For a “half box”? And the meat is so tough?

Abeg, if you wan suya, you fit go cayce foods or even go up to kennesaw to get some decent quality and decent size.

My fault for not asking how big the box was. Thank good I didn’t order the dodo or I would’ve gotten like 2 pieces for whatever they’re selling it for…

Tufiakwa!
Emeka’s Turkey suya at Ayo’s restaurant was absolutely delicious. It was the right amount of smoky, full of flavor, seasoned well, and so unique. We kept making orders. You can’t miss out on this.

First time here. We chose due to the good reviews.  Had to return the efo riro due to unchewable quality of the beef! Tried 2 different sharp knives to no avail! Owner did replace it with 2 pieces of fish, didnt say what it was 🤔.  She just mentioned Americans like their meat softer, but we like to be able to eat what we order. (SMH.)
She gave us extra greens AFTER I mentioned we had to drive back 30 mins, etc. The greens were fine! The fish was dry (kind of like the owner's response to our disappointment), but it was edible. We were sincerely hoping we found a new eatery, but sadly 100% No!

formatted_address: 585 Franklin Gateway SE, Marietta, GA 30067, United States
name: African Soulfood

reviews.text: Our first time trying African food. Customer service was great with Faithful. Food was served hot. Atmosphere was inviting. Enjoyed the suya, beef samosa, egusi and fufu. My husband loved the goat and lamb with cheb. Worth the hour drive. Our kids also tried and like it.

Had a great time at this restaurant! The food was delicious and the service was great, our server, Rae, was very attentive and the owner came by to make sure that we were taken care of. We were pleasantly surprised by how good the food was, and the DJ/music was a nice vibe! All the meat is halal with the exception of the sausage there are vegetarian options!

I ordered a small assortment of different foods to try and was not disappointed. Everything was fresh and delicious. They now have a new customer. Really really good food!! And the staff was super helpful and nice. Thanks for everything!!

This was a very nice restaurant. The food was great. The aviance was very nice. The waitress, Rae was very kind and was willing to explain the menu to us. And was willing tell us what each meal had in it or was made with. This was very different for us. We will do it again. This was a very unique experience and we loved it.

The food was amazing!! The people were great the waiter was so nice and amazing!! They allowed us to try the food before we got it just in case we never had it before and it was great!! Also great portions to price ratio!! The music and the decor was amazing as well as the vibe!

formatted_address: 3700 Campbellton Rd SW suite1, Atlanta, GA 30311, United States
name: Bamba Cuisine

reviews.text:
Wow the flavor of everything is just perfect and tasted so good! The portions are big too! Definitely a hidden gem that deserves more attention!!!
Highly recommend the chicken curry and Egusi
Every time I visit Bamba Cuisine it’s a hit!! The food is absolutely DELICIOUS. The lamb is slow cooked and soooo soft. I frequent here often. I drive from Locust Grove just eat here 🤤🥰

The food is delicious, the jambalaya is the best!!!! The rice is full of favor and the lamb is cooked to perfection. The disk is lamb and rice with scotch pepper with an onion gravy on top!!! I eat there every Friday. The dish cost around $22. Great customer service and friendly people. I love the food and the veggies plates is excellent too!!!
Ms. Darlene

One of my favorite African restaurants to go to. The food is good and get really good portions as well. I love the customer service as well. They are always very polite and make sure that you are satisfied with your service every time you come. The pricing is also very affordable for the food you receive. I will continue to be a long time customer bcuz they are absolutely worth the drive to visit.

Small family vibe restaurant. i smelled everything first like a grandma or auntie was in the back. Large variety of food. Portions were healthy and seasoned great. Loooved the juices! It was a year ago and I hope they are doing well!

formatted_address: 4897 Buford Hwy NE Suite # 113, Chamblee, GA 30341, United States
name: Faaji Restaurant and Lounge

reviews.text:
I have been going here for about 2 years and the service just gets better everytime.
Imani is a great hostess by far. Very hospitable and diligent, she never lost a smile all evening.
The music and ambiance here is perfect!
Will always return.

This little gem was hidden. After a wonderful evening we stumbled upon Faaji for a drink. We arrived pretty early for the lounge scene at 8:30 in the evening but the staff was very accommodating with what they had available. The angel wing selfie wall was a hit with my party of 8. We were out for book club and were lucky to find such a friendly place to hang out. The booth size was perfect. It felt like a little bit of Vegas inside the perimeter. They have a live DJ, full Cocktail Bar, Hooka and a entree menu and also small bites. If you are looking for the best new place to hang out with your crew this is the spot, but maybe just arrive later…

Went here for an event and the service was rather slow. We eventually got our drinks but the drinks seemed to have been watered down. This place could be a really big hit but seemed average when we went. We’ll give it another try but it’s not the top of the list unfortunately. I will add, some of the food was fantastic and some of the others were average

Stepping into Faaji is more than just going out to eat; it's an immersion into a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere that lives up to its name (meaning "fun" in Yoruba). Our recent visit was truly exceptional, leaving us already planning our next return.

From the moment we walked in, the energy of the place was infectious. The music created a lively backdrop without being overwhelming, and the decor hints at a rich cultural tapestry. But it was the food, and the incredible service, that truly stole the show.

The chef at Faaji is a culinary maestro! Every dish we sampled was simply awesome. The Suya was perfectly seasoned and incredibly tender, delivering that authentic, smoky kick we crave. The fries were crispy and golden, the chicken wings were juicy with a fantastic crust, and the shrimp were cooked to perfection, plump and bursting with flavor. It was clear that each component of the meal was prepared with care and expertise.

Equally impressive was our server, Jessica. She was truly phenomenal, embodying the ideal of hospitality. Jessica was incredibly attentive, always there when we needed her without ever feeling intrusive. Her sweet and kind demeanor made us feel genuinely welcomed, and her expertise in crafting mixed drinks and cocktails was truly a highlight. Each drink she recommended and prepared was a masterpiece, perfectly balanced and refreshing.

Faaji delivers on all fronts: incredible food that satisfies, a lively and inviting ambiance, and service that makes you feel like a valued guest. If you're looking for an unforgettable dining experience where every detail is handled with excellence, from the chef's culinary prowess to the phenomenal service of staff like Jessica, then look no further than Faaji.
Really Really Enjoyed My Bday Here I Would Definitely Come Back Food Great Parking Is Free And Service Is Amazing Thank You.

formatted_address: 56 E Andrews Dr NW Unit 7, Atlanta, GA 30305, United States
name: Yebo Beach Haus

reviews.text: We had our anniversary dinner here! It was exceptional 😍 Definitely come here! We had mushroom soup and their specialty crepe for appetizers. 100% recommend. For entrees we had sea bass and short ribs. Both were delicious but especially the sea bass 😍 At the end they even brought out a celebration dessert! Reggie was a great server 👍

I was a little nervous about trying Yebo but I’m so glad I did. The entire experience was excellent! The courtyard was beautiful, the service was impeccable, and the food was just the icing on the cake! My server talked me into trying the crepes which were amazing and very filling for an appetizer. The mussels appetizers were just as delish! I got the scallop entree which was fantastic even when I warmed the leftovers later. I highly recommend giving this spot a try.

It’s a nice date night spot in Buckhead. We enjoyed the haus fondue appetizer. I hate brussel sprouts and I found it odd that they couldn’t just substitute another item on the plate. Hubby had to eat them.

He got the lamb and it was nicely cooked, just not one of the top ones he’s had. I enjoyed by seabass and leek risotto. It has a nice flavor to it. We liked our flourless cake as well. It was rich without being overly sweet.

It gets busy in there so service was a little hit or miss. We had to wait a while to get our check.

Overall 5 stars for atmosphere, 4 stars for service, 2 stars for food

First of all, the place is absolutely beautiful! perfect for couples or a small group of friends.

Service was generally good. The missing star is only because we were seated at a small round coffee-style table even though several larger square tables were open. They did move us after we asked, but it shouldn’t have been an issue in the first place.

Food, however, was the biggest disappointment. For such a great location and stunning space, the menu and kitchen execution really need more attention.

My wife ordered a sushi roll, which I know is a bit unusual for this type of restaurant, but it was surprisingly bland. The rice didn’t have enough flavor, which threw the whole roll off.

The Frittura Mista was supposed to be lightly breaded, but it was pretty heavily coated, though the flavor was okay.

The tuna poke had tasteless rice (similar to the sushi roll) and soggy seaweed. I’d honestly recommend they look up a better rice seasoning ratio — more vinegar and sugar would help a lot.

The smash burger was just okay. Not very juicy, and the special sauce didn’t add much.

The best dish we had was the Sosaties. Personally, the filet mignon was slightly over , but still tender and juicy. The rice was flavorful, with hints of lemon and herbs, plus a sweet glaze on top that gave a nice balance. This dish showed what the kitchen can do.

Overall, it feels like management created a menu first and expected the kitchen to figure it out, rather than designing dishes that match the chef’s strengths. The atmosphere is fantastic, but the food needs a serious rethink to match the quality of the space.

A mixed review…

It took the wait staff 27 minutes after my scheduled reservation time to seat me. I arrived five minutes early.

After I was seated, things improved - somewhat. For a restaurant with these prices and this many waitstaff (easily 15-20 staff within a relatively small dining space), you would expect a lot more in the way of attentive service.

A positive note - the food I enjoyed was delicious. The Smoke & Mirrors mocktail? Sweet and tangy. The duck confit tart? Exquisitely rendered. The Chilean Sea Bass? Smothered in a mouthwatering sauce atop a sea of risotto. The pumpkin cheesecake, however, was a disappointment - tasted like a frozen dessert delivered by Sysco.

To give this restaurant some grace, I visited on NYE, but not at a busy time (4p). Just bizarre that some people choose to spend their money here.

But then again I remember I am in Buckhead, a place where conspicuous consumption is commonly paired with a remarkable lack of discernment. Alas.

Please also note they added an automatic 20% gratuity to the bill, perhaps anticipating they would otherwise be prone to receive smaller tips.

formatted_address: 5436 Riverdale Rd, Atlanta, GA 30349, United States
name: Buka 2 Restaurant

reviews.text: I had doubts due to some of the reviews, but I’m happy I trust my gut and gave Buka a  chance. I visited this afternoon, and the food, customer service, hookah, and atmosphere were all exceptional. A special shoutout to the waitress, Dora, who was incredibly sweet and attentive. I’ll definitely be back!

I wanted to try a side of jollof which is priced at $7. The cashier refused to sell side orders alone and all their meals are $25 and up. The price is too high for the amount of food you receive i dont recommend to anyone.

The waitress was extremely rude. When we walked in no one greeted us or even told us to seat ourselves.  The real highlight, though, was the roaches chilling behind the seats like they paid rent. Would not recommend unless you’re into being yelled and possibly have roaches in your food.
Decided to try an authentic Nigerian meal this week — and boy, did I clean up my plate! Definitely a 10/10 for taste!
Food and restaurant is perfect and the 25$ hookah was perfect with the vibe thank you Buka may you live long

formatted_address: 1825 Rockbridge Rd SW Suite 10B & 10C, Stone Mountain, GA 30087, United States
name: African Palace Bar And Grill

reviews.text: The Food is DELICIOUS DEFINITELY AUTHENTIC EXTREMELY FRIENDLY AND PLEASANTLY TAKEN CARE OF ! My husband and I was just driving by and was like dang we haven’t went on a date in years! Finally we was like you know what let’s go just you and I & they made us feel so good and comfortable THANK YOU FOR THIS EXPERIENCE

First time at the West African restaurant and eating West African cuisine. We had the Egusi Fufu with Jerk Chicken and I had goat with jollof rice and assorted meat that contained the cow skin, belly, and foot. It is spicy but full of flavors. I’m a mild spicy type but I couldn’t resist the flavors which took my mind off how spicy it was for me lol. I Highly recommend this restaurant. They have locations in St. Louis Missouri, Stone Mountain Georgia, and Jacksonville Florida.

Wow! This was my first time here and I will be back. The jollof rice was perfect. Never have I ever had spinach so flavorful! It was spicy and delicious. The jerk chicken was good too, but the spinach was the star of the show, for me. The portions were big enough for me to enjoy the other half of my meal tomorrow. Also, Francis was very friendly and helpful!

Delicious rice and plantain with beef and a beef pie! Delicious everyone was super nice and even though we asked a ton of questions they were super patient :-) the food was great! They have live music on Sunday nights as well.
Lol I almost didn't get the picture because I was tucked into the plate so quickly haha 🤣
Francis was the best! Totally enjoyed the best whole fish (red snapper), jollof, spinach and yummy plantains! The ambience was so nice..it was a vibe! Enjoy every time I come. Highly recommend.

formatted_address: 2250 Marietta Blvd NW Suite 206, Atlanta, GA 30318, United States
name: Desta Ethiopian Kitchen Westside

reviews.text: My first time trying Ethiopian food. The food was savory. We had the Meat Lovers: fillet mignon, salmon, and short ribs. We also had mushrooms, lentils, cabbage, and rice. The short ribs were rubbery but they allowed us to swap out for Ribeye. Some of the furniture needs updating. We were in a booth and I could feel every movement of the person behind me.

10/10 recommend. The food was flavorful, tasty, fresh, and satisfying. It was all my vegan dishes on one plate. We weren't sure what everything was, so the waitress took the time to explain things to us. My go-to was the vegan platter. The mushrooms, lentils, chickpeas—everything was excellent! My husband had the grouper, and he said it reminded him of his childhood.

I’ve always had a soft spot for Ethiopian food, and Desta reminded me exactly why. From the moment I walked in, the warm, aromatic notes of berbere and sautéed onions filled the air—an unmistakable welcome that tells you you’re in for something special.

The menu itself is thoughtfully designed, guiding you through the experience based on how adventurous you’re feeling. It’s the kind of place where first-timers can explore with confidence, and seasoned fans can still find something new to savor. I sampled a few dishes that beautifully balanced earthy lentils, spiced meats, and tangy injera—that soft, slightly sour flatbread that ties every bite together. Each dish felt like a conversation between flavor and culture.

Desta delivers not just a meal, but a moment—one that feels both global and familiar. And now that I’ve discovered there’s a Desta in Dallas, I can’t help but wonder if it shares the same spirit as the Atlanta location. Either way, I plan to find out firsthand, fork (or injera) in hand.

My wife and I showed up and while it.took a moment to get seated because the staff was busy, a table was easily available, even on a Saturday night.
We ordered the Sambusas, Foul, and Vegan Platter. Not only we're all of these very tasty and filling (way too much food for 2 people to finish), but they came out quickly. The staff was courteous and helpful and everything was great. We will definitely come back.

First time here and so happy we chose this spot to try out.  Such good food, flavorful, good portions for the price. Great selection and clear menu how to order.
Mary,  served us and she was wonderful! Very efficient, courteous,  and helpful.  Highly recommend this place

formatted_address: 1482 Roswell Rd, Marietta, GA 30062, United States
name: Mama J Nigerian Restaurant

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
WOW!!!!!! Mama J Restaurant

Hands down the best Nigerian food I’ve tasted since moving to Atlanta! The flavors are authentic and absolutely delicious. The owner, Mama J, and her amazing staff make you feel right at home — warm, friendly, and full of joy. The restaurant is clean, inviting, and has a fun-filled atmosphere that makes every visit a true delight. Highly recommend to anyone looking for great food and great vibes! 🇳🇬✨ I bighly recommend ❤️🙌🙏🏾

Last time I ever go back. Food is good but portion size seems to be determined on how they feel that day. $18 for Suya and you get half a scoop. $5 for beef and get 3 nuggets. It took 30 minutes to get the food and they’re giving out kiddie meals for adult prices

I ordered ewa agoyin and bread, but when I got home and started eating the beans, I noticed small insects (kokoro inu ewa). The food itself tasted good, but seeing those bugs made me stop eating. If you’re Nigerian, you’ll know exactly what I’m talking about when it comes to beans. Please check your beans—or maybe it’s the sauce on top—but this isn’t acceptable. We’re in America, not Nigeria.

I came here with my boyfriend and we've never had Nigerian food and I will just say this was the most delicious thing that has ever been put in my mouth 😩 Also, mama J was there and she was so sweet and made us feel welcomed and at home! 1000/10  in every aspect. We will come again

Everything was delicious when it comes  to seasoned. The Jollof was on point. I have tried the beef and goat,  and the tender was off for me. Jamaican style is tender falling off the bone. It's more of a culture thing i guess. But please check it out.

name: MAKAY CHOPBAR - Pre-Order Food in 1/2 Pan, Full Pan & Big Bowl Only. We ship to all other states. Please Call Before

reviews.text: MAKAY Chopbar never disappoints! The food is delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavors. Portions are great, and the quality is always consistent. Ordering ahead is easy, and the service is friendly and professional. If you’re looking for tasty, well-made African dishes, this is the place to go. Highly recommended!

The food we had catered was amazing! From the Sobolo drink to the beef kebobs jelloff rice and fried fish.
Pickup was fast and easy, I was so grateful he was kind and strong to help arrange all the food in the car nicely and even allowed us to borrow the igloo freezer until we could get it back to them.

Makay Chopbar catered my wedding last weekend and everything was a hit! Our menu included jollof with veggies, spring rolls, plantains, meatpies, grilled chicken, tomato goat stew, beef suya, and egusi!  We barely had leftovers and all the guests raved how flavorful, tender, hot, and delicious the food was to honor my husband’s culture.  It was a joy to see folks who never had this food going back for seconds and even grabbing to-go containers.

The communication was impeccable and the chef accommodated special requests for food preparation to use traditional ingredients.  The team arrived on time, created a lovely display, and the servers were so friendly.  They also cleaned the area very well before departing.

Next time we’re in town we’ll definitely order food and even try the their shipping option to VA! Paul runs a honest and affordable catering business.  We greatly appreciate the entire staff for making our wedding day extra special!

formatted_address: 3202 Northlake Pkwy NE, Atlanta, GA 30345, United States
name: Southern Suya

reviews.text: Best Suya I ever had !! I had the beef suya and sautéed spinach side , I'm really impressed. I've been passing this place by for months and finally stopped. Definitely a hidden gem. I took my food to go but it came out pretty quick and the service was great. It's really cute inside as well... don't keep passing this place up ; you're missing out.

This seems like it must be a fun place with life music at night but we went for lunch so I can only speak about the incredibly tasty food!!! I tried the pepper goat with coconut rice and fried sweet plantains and it was amazing, if you enjoy spicy and really flavorful dishes this is for r you, I know I love it, we also had the Egusi soup (is very earthly stew made with ground melon seeds, leafy vegetables, and various meats and fish) we accompanied that wit Fufu (a starchy ball of dough made with casava), incredible, we really enjoyed.

This is my first time trying African food, and it is soooooo good! My Asian taste buds loved everything I tried. My favorite is the ox tail. So rich and flavorful and tender. They use spices so well. Jollof rice is also a must! Even though the food takes a while to come out, it is surely worth the wait.

Food is delicious. I really enjoyed the egusi with talapia and fufu. However, the service is SLOOOOOOW. I placed a pickup order an hour before I went to pick it up since it took a long time to receive my previous order. The pickup order still was not ready when I arrived. I had to wait an additional 20 minutes for my order.

I had the beef suya with jollof rice and fried plantains. and I also tried the shawarma with everything in it. All of the food was really good the Jollof rice is very unique but I loved it! Will definitely be back

formatted_address: 5291 Memorial Dr, Stone Mountain, GA 30083, United States
name: Madina Restaurant

reviews.text:
I came here on Sunday evening with my family, and it did not disappoint.  The food came out quickly, the food was delicious, and the service was exceptional.

Don’t let the neighborhood scare you or the fact that it looks like a little hole in the wall, Because it was well worth the drive and I would certainly come here again.

Thank you for a fantastic meal

The plate of goat with rice and spaghetti was delicious, but the soup was alright. The hot tea was also good. However, the service was a bit disorganized since the staff appeared to have lost track of orders so they had to ask me again. Regardless, I enjoyed the meal.

A friend recommended this spot, so I decided to check it out—and I’m glad I did. I ordered the Chicken Zuqaar, which had a pleasant hint of spice and came in a generous portion. It wasn’t overly salted, and the red sauce over the rice packed the most flavor, adding a nice kick to the dish.

The service stood out the most. The owner personally came around to chat with guests and made sure everyone was satisfied, which I really appreciated. It gave the place a warm, welcoming feel.

Vegetarians might find the options a bit limited, so that’s something to keep in mind. While dining in, we were also served a complimentary orange drink, which was a nice touch.
I love this place I drive a whole hour to get here I just wish they had some closer to Marietta Georgia I would eat their much more often
Always going for the fried goat! The rice is 😋! Plenty of seating!

formatted_address: 4285 Buford Hwy NE Ste. D3, Atlanta, GA 30345, United States
name: Smokin Suya

reviews.text: I got the Efo Riro & peppered turkey. The peppered turkey had great flavor but it was way too dry, I had to simmer on my stove with water to make it more tender and the efo riro was tasty.

I ordered the lamb fried rice and suya tonight since I was in the mood for Nigerian food but to my surprise the rice was unbearable spicy. I’m not new to Nigerian spices at all but on a scale from 1-10 it’s at a 10! Like literal heartburn after one bite so I turned around and told the lady in there she could’ve told me it’s very spicy because I vent tolerate this and spent $40. All she had to say was that it’s Nigerian food like as if I don’t know Nigerian food. I told her I’d appreciate if she could make a new rice less spicy or atleast provide a different rice and she said there’s nothing she can do and I should call management or go on the “website”… anyway the rice was inedible for me though the flavor is good, the heat is just too much and that’s coming from someone who likes pepper. I wasted my money and she was of no help. I just took 2 bc powders hoping this thing don’t make me sick!

Very nice young ladies and the atmosphere was small and intimate. I ordered 2 turkey combos for 25$ each.  Luckily I checked the food prior to leaving and to my surprise I was given turkey bones. The young lady apologized and remade the turkey, and it was still a very small portion. The food lacked flavor and the rice was dry with like 8 bay leaves in it.. We will not be returning.

I didn’t initially plan to write a review for this restaurant, but after tasting the food, I felt compelled to share my experience. I'll evaluate this restaurant based on six factors: Quality of Food, Price, Ambience, Service, Location, and Parking. Let’s dive in:

Quality of Food
I only ordered one meal—the Jollof Rice and Suya—and it was exceptional. Based on this dish alone, I would give the food 5 stars. If the quality of the Jollof Rice and Suya is indicative of their other offerings, then I imagine the rest of their menu is equally delicious, if not better. A few highlights: the food was served quickly, tasted fresh, and the Suya was particularly outstanding. I'm very discerning when it comes to Suya, and this restaurant did not disappoint. It's clear they know what they’re doing, and I can’t wait to try more from their menu.

Price
The prices here are quite moderate, though I understand this can be subjective. Considering the quality and quantity of food, I find it reasonable. I ordered Jollof Rice, Plantains, Suya, and a bottle of Voss water, totaling around $35. For the experience and food quality, this is very reasonable in my opinion.

Ambience
As you'll see in the pictures, the restaurant is cozy and nicely decorated. It's not a large establishment, but it can comfortably accommodate most parties. The atmosphere is inviting and pleasant.

Service
The service was excellent. The lady who attended to me was respectful, polite, and prompt. My food arrived on time and tasted fresh. The staff’s professionalism added to the overall positive experience.

Location
This restaurant is conveniently located on Buford Highway, directly opposite Ace Lounge and Living Room Lounge. They stay open until 3 AM on Fridays and Saturdays, making it a great spot for late-night dining after or before partying.

Parking
Parking is free, with additional parking available across the street at the Ace and Living Room Parking Lot. However, parking can fill up quickly, especially on Saturdays, so it’s best to arrive before the clubgoers.

Overall
I appreciate the coziness and personal touch of this place. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the overall experience is wonderful. I will definitely be returning.

I enjoyed eating here. Their suya is quite good and  I like how they package their turkey. You get a side of turkey cut into separate pieces when you order it with the rice and plantain. The prices are also quite reasonable and the owner Wale has good customer service.

formatted_address: 2579 S Cobb Dr SE, Smyrna, GA 30080, United States
name: GOLDEN LOUNGE ATL ( Formerly Naija Cuisi

reviews.text: The food is terrible! The okra soup was tasteless, no flavour at all. The pounded yam smells bad like it was made a day or 2 prior.

Absolutely disappointing experience.

I went in today and was charged $20 for a small container (about 12–13 ounces) of soup with no meat. That’s absurd. The owner even doubled down, saying he gave me “an extra ounce of soup” — as if that makes it okay.

What makes it worse is that just last week, I was there and got fried rice, two meats, and stew for $25. How does soup alone now cost almost the same?

I understand that running a Nigerian restaurant in the U.S. isn’t easy and costs have gone up, but this pricing is just wild and unfair. The service was poor, and the justification made it worse. I genuinely can’t recommend this place after this experience.

Well, first, I will say the food was decent. Unfortunately, the inside was dark, with no paper towels in restrooms. The server was nice but didn't really engage with first-timers with the new food experience from another country.  Not sure what I expected, but it wasn't bad.

I can say that this is the most authentic Nigerian restaurant in Atlanta. I was pleasantly surprised as this was my first time here and I had the egusi with beef and pounded yam, and took home rice and stew for my wife. It reminded me of my mom’s home cooking as it was very tasty and spiced just right.

The food was freshly cooked for me and not scooped out of some old batch of food.

The restaurant was very clean and the gentleman who served me was very courteous and cared about my satisfaction so, we will be going back very often.

This food is terrible.  You can have your 2 year old make better food for you! They charge $2-$3  more than what's on their menu. Since eating this I don't feel well. My chest is burning and NO, I didn't get anything spicy!! I cannot stand getting sick after I eat something.  It makes me wonder if the cooks ppl washes their hands. Especially after touching their dirty phones. I will never come back!

formatted_address: 1250 Tech Dr, Norcross, GA 30093, United States
name: Ike’s Cafe and Grill

reviews.text: We drove an hour to patronize this establishment. We saw alot of hype on social media about the place. We were warmly welcomed and seated immediately. We ordered a drink and questioned if there was alcohol because it tasted like fruit juice. I believe they charged us for an alcoholic drink when there was none added. The chicken suya and coconut shrimp were good. However, the Jollof rice tasted burnt and the beef suya was very dry. We also ordered the okra and seafood. At first they said they didn’t have anymore then they said they had enough for one more. It was not good at all. It tasted old. Once we received our check, we saw they added a mandatory gratuity for two people. We weren’t happy with that. Not sure if this was an off night for the food, but we’re glad we experienced it.

I was really looking forward to trying this African restaurant, but unfortunately it didn’t meet my expectations. The food was disappointing — it had an overly fishy taste, and the chicken was quite dry. On top of that, they automatically added a gratuity to the bill and I was expected to tip again, which felt unnecessary.

The atmosphere wasn’t bad, and the service itself was actually good, but overall it just wasn’t worth the price. We ended up paying about $115 for two people, and for that amount, I expected a much better dining experience.

Traveled from the North to try this famous African restaurant. First time dinning here and the food was amazing and well seasoned. Not too spicy (as in pepper) for someone that can’t handle pepper. Will definitely recommend if you travel from out of state and looking for an African restaurant.
I took a few of my friends that wants to try new food so we went to Ike's Cafe and Grill.  The food was delicious and the palm wine ( Jungle Juice) so good.

Victoria was our waiter, such a sweetheart, tended to us frequently, lovely service, the food was amazing! The live music was so admirable, engaging and fun! Best time i had all week honestly, can’t wait to come back!!
