reviews.text: I always support small businesses. This was my first time eating African food. No one was in the restaurant except for the staff/owner. The person who took our order was nice.. BUT after we paid for our food we waited for 48 minutes before she brought our plates.,(a family came in and placed an order, when she told them that it would be 20 minutes the family canceled their order and left). My plate cost $25.00 because “ it comes with a big piece of fish”.  I wish them well, but I will not be returning.

This is most disgusting restaurant I’ve ever been too. WARNING!!! Do not ever come here, even for emergencies. I was craving a late night taste for African Food and this food completely ruined my appetite.  The Egusi is disgusting. It literally taste like chicken stew. The jollof rice was plain white rice with noodle seasoning thrown on top.🤮 I returned the rice. He gave me a dirty plastic spoon, I’m not even sure he washed the container he put my food in.(It was in a dish container😐) His credit card machine was down, so he told me to cashapp him. And he put my food in a Walmart bag. Like this is a complete disgrace to the African Community and they need to be shut down. Edit: Also there was black stuff in my fufu. He said it came from the pan. I’m just completely disgusted.

Tried Egusi soup & fufu for the first time last night, and y’all… NEVER again from this spot! Paid $20 for the worst soup ever—smelled worse than a dumpster on a 103° day. Even my furry friends wouldn’t touch it! The fufu was fresh, but that soup? Thick like wet dog food, and the meat was bad bad. Stomach did flips before Asia trashed it. 9 years in the community, and this is what they serve? Never again!

And what’s worse? They could’ve just said they were closed instead of serving that mess. Just say you’re out and let folks know when you’ll reopen!

Would I try Egusi again? Yes. Just not from here.

#FoodFail #NeverAgainEats #EgusiGoneWrong #TrashCanWorthy

BN

The atmosphere is comfortable and makes you feel right at home. The service is excellent and everyone who works there is very polite. And the food is absolutely delicious. Cassava leaf soup and fufu is my favorite dish to order❤️❤️👏🏼

I’m so glad that there’s a spot that sells okra soup and egusi that’s affordable and delicious! Absolutely love love love, this is my third time eating from this restaurant and they are lovely people.

Great, clean tasting food and clean restaurant. I had the okra stew and it was the best I've had. Her prices are reasonable and not over-priced, about 5 dollars cheaper compared to other West African restaurants. I didn't get her name but the lady behind the counter was polite, I got a vibe from her similar to that of a caring mother.

formatted_address: 101 Kenwood Rd #28, Fayetteville, GA 30214, United States
name: Mama Put Restaurant

reviews.text: I try the pounded yam and egusi soup combo and the suya. It’s my first time trying this and it was incredible. The fufu and the egusi soup go so well together. Suya was also very well season and nice texture. Definitely a must try.

reviews.author_name: Sugrbox Chef Dolie of Dolie’s Vegan Cuisine Sugrbox
reviews.text: I honestly don’t understand any of these negative reviews. I guess you can say that I am a fairly newer customer. But I’ve been going to the restaurant faithfully now for the past several months. Each and every time I am greeted with a big smile!! The women behind the counter (there are two different ones) they smile and immediately make me feel like I am family. Most often when I come I get the egusi (prepared with no meat/dairy products as I’m vegan. Don’t judge me. This is my cheat meal.) it’s always absolutely delicious. If I ask to taste something they do so without hesitation. Very patient too I might add because sometimes it takes me time to decide what I want. I often call my son to show him what they have on the menu for the day. I am Haitian. And while Haitian cuisine is my favorite, I am no stranger to a plethora of different African cuisines. Mama Put always has me licking my fingers and elbows. This is why I’m so confused by some of these reviews. And when I say delicious, I mean I can’t even wait til I get home. The food is eaten completely in the car and I am wiping my mouth before I pull up to my home. And I live nearby!! The egusi is my favorite. But the spinach she makes me is omg too!! I have taken my very American friends and they loved it all too!! Food on point. Warm and welcoming environment. No issue when we dined there and asked for take out containers as another reviewer complained about. Very sweet. Very kind. And no one is paying me for this review. This is just my experience and I’m being truthful. If they tried to pay me though I’d take the food instead!! And they give a good amount of food. Not skimpy. I’m greedy and eat a lot!! Lol Thank you Mama Put for always making me feel like family when I come visit. Asé!!

The way this food has never failed me!!! I get the same thing almost every time egusi and spinach with cow skin and cow foot🤩🤩 my daughter got me hooked on the boiled egg It’s so spicy and so good 🤤 although I didn’t get it this time the okra soup is amazing

I’m sorry, the food was horrible. I ordered egusi and fufu with goat meat. The owner gave me a very small portion. The soup was so nasty. I didn’t finish it. The fufu still had powder spots from not being mixed well. I ordered jollof rice and chicken for my 9 y.o. The rice was only spicy. No flavor. The chicken was humongous with little flavor. My adult daughter ordered pepper soup. Everyone had finished eating the portion we were willing to eat and my daughter STILL hadn’t received her food. They gave her money back because we came to eat together. If you want to dine-in you have to pay an additional fee, just to eat there. I will never return to this place. I live in locust grove and was looking for African food closer to me. From now on, I will take the drive to Bamba or Ike‘s. I was very disappointed. What a waste of money.

The ogbono, egusi, jollof rice, goat, cow, turkey, and the moimoi was good; the spice was perfect. Reminded me of home. The meat pie was dry. Service was quick. Jollof rice was a bit over priced for one meat. Maybe some plantain would've made it worth it. They have a market next door which I also liked.

formatted_address: 1594 Woodcliff Dr NE, Atlanta, GA 30329, United States
name: Sheba Lounge

reviews.text: My wife ordered some food from here last night off of uber eats and found a razor blade and paper clips👎🏾. I would not recommend eating or ordering food here🤦🏽‍♂️👎🏾.
Baby when I tell you this food never misses!!!! So good! Flavor is always on point! Tonight though…. Hand claps for the Chef! These lobster tails are everything!!!!
I ordered my food and waited. And waited. And waited. Only for them to come back and cancel my order and it was too late to go anywhere else to get something to eat. Evil. Shut this place down.

I am giving the place 3 stars because the music was dope but we had to wait for our wings over an hour which was fine but one make you wonder if they had to go and kill the chicken, clean it up and then prepare it. Again great music and very young crowd.

Skal,

BN
I used to LOVE this place. The food takes too long. The dj isn’t fun anymore. Still nice looking! Went to blue lagoon instead for music.

formatted_address: 1800 Peachtree St NW #103, Atlanta, GA 30309, United States
name: Irie Mon Cafe

reviews.text: Food was so dam good. Had to come down here to take care of some business got me some oxtail Rasta pasta and tore it up, 33 bucks but worth it because it’s about two or three meals in one bowl. Great flavor didn’t have to put a whole bunch of cheese or pasta sauce in the noodles for it to take good more of a soupy consistency but in a way that makes the flavor in the noodles pop. 5/5

There are a few tables inside and scattered seating outside. But you need to come to this place for the food! Outstanding Jamaican food.  I come here whenever im in Atlanta. and it doesn’t disappoint.  Goto items must be the oxtail and the curry goat

The food at Irie Mon Jamaican was underwhelming and lacked authentic Jamaican flavor. The dishes tasted more American than traditional, and the plantains were bland and undercooked. The oxtails were decent, but the rice needed more peas and seasoning. I ended up adding my own seasoning to improve the taste. Overall, it didn’t meet expectations for authentic Jamaican cuisine.

This was our first and unfortunately last time dining at this restaurant. Upon entering, my husband and I noticed several customers already waiting for their orders. We approached the counter to place ours but were not greeted or acknowledged by either employee present. Both the male and female staff members walked back and forth between the kitchen and front area multiple times without saying a word. After standing there for approximately 6–8 minutes, one of them finally addressed us, and it still took several additional minutes before our order was taken.

My husband ordered the oxtail with rice and peas, mac and cheese, and two veggie patties, totaling just over $50. We waited another 10–15 minutes for the food to be prepared. Before leaving, we checked the order and realized we had been given brown stew chicken instead of oxtail. When we returned to correct the mistake, the female employee initially insisted the order was correct until I showed both the food and the receipt (which I had to request). The male employee then apologized and corrected the order after taking back the incorrect meal. I sincerely hope that meal was discarded and not served to another customer.

Being of Jamaican background myself, I can confidently say the food lacked authentic flavor and did not represent true Jamaican cuisine. Overall, the experience was disappointing — from the lack of customer service to the long wait time and poor food quality. It would be beneficial for management to improve their service and system for handling both walk-in and online orders to reduce delays, especially when customers are paying over $50 for a meal.

Also the customer should not have to ask for  their receipt, on top of paying for parking.

A LOT of food for the price and absolutely some of the best in Atlanta! Period! And GET THE RUM CAKE (thank me later)!!!!!! I have been to this place on several different occasions. But the food tonight was outstanding. We had the jerk chicken, cabbage (some of the best I’ve had), and rice and peas (very large portion). Staff was (on this shift) was friendly! We value great customer service and this placed delivered. 10 out of 10! Will order again for sure! Sorry we forgot to take photos before we ate the food :/  Paid parking but first 15 mins free.

formatted_address: Northside Dr SW, Atlanta, GA 30310, United States
name: Breakfast (Deola Cuisine a.k.a. SS Express)

reviews.text: All truckers that love African food, here’s the place. Delicious food and wide menu you can choose from, they will get it delivered to your location. As OTR, I ordered for Jollof Rice, Assorted Stew and Egusi Soup with FuFu/P-Yam… I was impressed, 48 miles away and got my order delivered to me while waiting at the Truckstop. Nice & great services and good taste meals. I recommend 100.

I'm extremely pissed off. I ordered egusi my bowl isn't even halfway full. I won't be ordering from them again. I definitely don't recommend. My beef is touching the bottom of the bowl and my soup only halfway touches the meat.

I ordered Waakye and I was very disappointed in the amount of meat, sauce and spaghetti given. This meal normally is my favorite but this meal was so DRY, I couldn’t even eat it! I wasted $28.76 having this meal delivered via uber eats! The spaghetti was a spoonful like they ran out of it, I had more beans & rice than anything else and I’m used to this dish having a perfect ratio, with red stew sauce for moisture. The fish given was so small and overcooked. Not sure if I’ll order from here again…

I called restaurant before I ordered to ask if I could get extra red stew with Egusi Soup because there wasn't an option on Doordash. The lady said sure. Okay, so I placed my order: Egusi Soup with Red Snapper and Shrimp with extra Red Stew. I received oily and uneatable Egusi Soup and no red stew. The oil was literally dripping from the spoon. Ugh 😩 So I called the restaurant again I was told they would replace my entire order the next time I ordered. I have called for 2 days now each time I'm told to call back in a minute the owner is on the way to the store or the owner will call me when she arrives so she can cook my food.  Now I'm calling and no answer. I want my food. This is ridiculous.

I had the SS Express Vegetable Vermicelli Noodles (no meat/no seafood). It was really good. The seasoning is on point. The ingredients are fresh. The food here is very clean. Not oily. And great customer service.
Guys!  There are so many vegetarian options! Don't hesitate to ask if some of the entrees can be amended to vegetarian options.

formatted_address: 5065 Memorial Dr, Stone Mountain, GA 30083, United States
name: Somali

reviews.text: Delicious food spinagati with goat meat
Delicious. Nutritious. Spicy. Juicy. The best rice. I crave this place til I can’t take it anymore. On my way. Someone update the phone number.
Very delicious food n good people
Good was good I can’t say anything else
This was a amazing experience the good was authentic and I was all for the atmosphere!

formatted_address: 1583 Virginia Ave, College Park, GA 30337, United States
name: Bole Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
This was my first time eating Ethiopian food. I really enjoyed it! The service was a little slow but the server was so sweet. We ordered the sampler and it was a great way to taste a little bit off everything. Meat was tender and I really liked the flavors. My cousin loved the wine.
The decor of the restaurant is Beautiful, very authentic feel. I will definently go back!

The inside is so cozy, it feels like the inside of someone’s house,!which elevated the coziness of the atmosphere more.

Very nice waitress, attentive. I usually order Alicha Wot at Ethiopian restaurants, which I didn’t see here, but I decided to venture out and get the platter. And I’m so glad I did! It was one of the greatest meals i have ever had in my life, absolutely delicious and beautifully crafted. Plenty of injera! 😋

Affordable prices, and I recommend to locals and visitors of Atlanta🩷

Will be a permanent spot every time I visit
Love, love, love the injera and sombusa. The lamb wasn't my favorite but it's my fault for wanting to try it when I don't eat much meat. I'll definitely be back to try their vegetarian dishes.

So delicious!!

I live in VA and only have one place (in VB) that I know of (Mesob cafe) and am loyal too which I love, but working out of town I was hoping to find a great place as well! (I am vegan so traveling and eating is difficult at times.)

Bole was delicious! the restaurant is pretty, open and clean, service was great, and the  food was delicious! I ordered  for myself and also ordered a to go for a freind to try, I’m hoping they loved it as much as me!

Thank you for your great service and food! 🙏

I ordered the veggie sampler, a Sambusa and a salad 😋

Everything was flavorful and tender! Very delicious!

food was pretty good.  first time trying authentic ethiopian. loved the rice, not a huge fan of the injera. i love the atmosphere though, very cultural with the baskets and the tables they eat from. customer service is excellent

formatted_address: 2055 Flat Shoals Rd, Riverdale, GA 30296, United States
name: Tropicana African Restaurant

reviews.text: This was the best Red Snapper I’ve ever had. I also got to sample the lamb. Everything is full of flavor and the homemade juices were good too!
Snapper was delicious! Whole fish fried & seasoned to perfection, homemade hot sauce, fried sweet plantain, salad... I left full! Worth the price.
Wonderful place and great customer service. The atmosphere is the best of the best 😍❤️😍
Food was AMAZING best grilled tilapia I’ve ever had. Salad was crazy good. Great service. Unorthodox restaurant but worthy experience

I visit this place very often. The atmosphere is always very pleasant and wonderful. The menu items are really affordable and the customer service is great. The family loves eating here. Great dine for African foods. Unfortunately looks like I forgotten to take any recent pictures.

formatted_address: 1241 Indian Trail Lilburn Rd NW Ste N, Norcross, GA 30093, United States
name: Jollof city

reviews.text: One chef. Two different restaurants. Great meals! I was in Chamblee when I googled “Nigerian restaurants around me” and found Jollof City and it so happened that the chef who makes the meals there is the same one that made the meals in another restaurant (Fly Chef) I had written a nice review about a couple months back. I was happy to order as much as I could knowing there’s no way I’d be disappointed and I wasn’t. The only pain point is I live about 1hr away. Id have visited regularly. It was great to strike up a conversation with him too. Great guy, great place, you should visit ✌🏾

This place is a 10/10!!! As a Black American i have been eating Nigerian food for many years. This is by far the best Suya and Jollof I have ever had. Typically Suya can be very tough to eat as it is a well done beef. This Suya was so tender and full of flavor. The smoke flavor on the Jollof  along with the perfect amount of heat(spice) was perfectly balanced. Kamsey's customer service was top tier. He greeted me promptly held a brief but informative conversation. Needless to say I will be back and will be posting on my TIKTOK.

Kamsey was very welcoming and informative, gave me a background of the establishment and made suggestions to what I should try. I am American but of Nigerian decent and have never tried jollof rice, paired with chicken it was delicious and a reasonable price will return and highly recommend this establishment. Thank you for your kindness and hospitality when other popular nearby African restaurants were very rude. Would recommend some native decor to enhance the visual aspects but overall excellent.

The meat pie was flavorful, the crust was soft and had a sweetness to it, they filled up that meat pie well and the filling is absolutely delicious!

I had the Suya with jollof and that was the best jollof I’ve had in Georgia!!! The suya was just as good and a decent amount of spice!

Service was very friendly and welcoming and will be returning!

My first time eating at this establishment and Kamsey (the guy that took our order) was very friendly, polite and answered any question we had.  I ordered the egusi with assorted meat and the meat pie.  Everything was absolutely delicious and flavorful!!!  I’ve eaten at a couple other African restaurants in the past and I must say that Jolly City is by far the best I’ve ever eaten !!!

formatted_address: 670 South Gordon Rd SW Suite 5, Mableton, GA 30126, United States
name: Kays Cuisines @ Mableton

reviews.text: Best place to get authentic Nigerian food in Atlanta.. it’s homey and the staffs treat you like family. The aesthetic is awesome and the food is mouth watering. I will definitely be going back.
They’re in a pizza shop and it’s some of the best nigerian food I’ve had. The customer service was great too. I would highly recommend.
Love this place! The puff puff and red sauce.. My God!
Tatsed and Trusted. This place is good,good meal.excellent customer service.Thanks for feeding our stomach.
The pizza was rich and well flavored.

formatted_address: 2628 Piedmont Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30324, United States
name: DANGI KITCHEN

reviews.text: This was my first time ordering at Dangis Kitchen. I ordered the pepper rice and asun. These meal was delicious. The service was amazing, and the location was top notch. I love how clean the place was and the fact that there was parking space. I will definitely be going back and I recommend 100%.

I’ve tried this place three times through Uber eats! It’s better than the other 4 places I tried about 6 different dishes but I’m looking for the best egusi in Atlanta has a lot of palm oil and less flavors. I’m on the search for my new spot since my place
Closed.

I’ve ordered a few times from DoorDash and I haven’t been disappointed. My kid loves the jollof so it’s a win! We’ll be ordering more. Thank you for making great Nigerian food! Pls keep up the great work.

I decided to have jollof rice, ram suya, and peppered turkey with peppered rice today. Since it was a leisurely Saturday, I placed an order for delivery. Dangi's Kitchen delivered on its promise. Everything tasted great, and I'm currently curled up in bed watching  Nollywood  movies . 10/10 for food and 10/10 for customer service. You can taste the love and care that went into making the dish

Dangi Kitchen is my sole option when I'm craving real Nigerian food that takes me back to my trips to Lagos. Every time, the food is consistently delicious and served to absolute perfection. This is your greatest option whether you're traveling or just want something homemade to eat.

formatted_address: 800 Forrest St NW K13, Atlanta, GA 30318, United States
name: Tribal Pot

reviews.text:
I was craving some yummy African food but didn’t wanna drive up to the Liberian restaurant I usually get my African food (the Liberian restaurant isn’t available on Uber eats nearby), so I decided to try out the Nigerian food instead. BIG MISTAKE EVER!
First of all, this so-called Nigerian restaurant is pricey compared to other Nigerian restaurants. The food was half empty and absolutely no taste. The price paid for the food wasn’t the food received, complete rip-off.
I asked them for extra spicy hot pepper sauce but guess what, they sent me some kinda of hot sauce that was not spicy and with no taste. This should be an African restaurant with good tasty and spicy and yummy food but NO, this is the worse nigerian food I’ve ever had. The fish was a separate dish but they put the fish together with the tasteless jollof rice…..very poor presentation. If you’re reading this review and thinking about ordering from this restaurant, save your money and time…DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THIS RESTAURANT! I wish I had read the reviews prior to ordering but oh well, I definitely don’t recommend this business.

If you are a Nigerian or want to have a feel of Nigerian food in the Atlanta area just look elsewhere because what they sell as Nigeria Jollof, fried, efo riro at this restaurant is GROSS.

Fried rice is just half cooked curry rice mixed with mixed vegetables literally, no oil,no salt nothing

Moinmoin is stale and slimy

Efo riro: made with uncooked palm oil and spinach plus maggi

Dodo/plaintain: fried in a very hot oil for one sec. So it black on the outside but not cooked in the inside

No, am not trying to spoil anyone’s business.I just don’t want anyone visiting Atlanta like to get robbed of their  money and go to bed hungry like I did.

FYI: Don’t buy a Nigeria meal at a restaurant that doesn’t have a eat in option. If I was served that in a physical restaurant I would have walked away and not pay for that nasty meal. I learnt that the hard way. Just eat McDonald’s instead.

DO NOT I repeat DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE. This is not authentic Nigerian food. The “pounded yam” legit tastes like and had the texture of instant mash potatoes. The “Efo Riro” aka “Nigerian stew” which was suppose to and normally comes with assorted beef meat came with all bone and fat and a clump of spinach really a disgrace. I should’ve known when I asked for the total over the phone and whoever told me $25.. now that I’m looking at the reviews which is pretty mixed but most are saying the same I don’t know how this spot is still open it’s insane. They must have people they know leaving reviews please do not waste your time or money here.

If I could give no stars I would. You should be ashamed of the food you serve people. The egusi soup was terrible and oily. I asked for no meat and I got nothing but meat and barely any soup. I attempted to eat it and the fufu was made wrong to. It was eating pressed nasty mash potatoes.  I will not be ordering anything else from this nasty restaurant.

1st of all, the flavor is so tasty. They give ample portion sizes. However, I picked up my food and it was a little cold... nothing a microwave couldn't fix. But still disappointed that it wasn't piping hot as expected. I ordered the Efo Riro with pounded yam. So flavorful! I will be back.👍🏾

formatted_address: 235 Peachtree St, Atlanta, GA 30303, United States
name: Flavors of Africa Food Cart at 235 Peachtree Street 30303 outside of CVS

reviews.text:
Review by @SoldByMarvin on All Social Media

Hands-down the best option for African food in all of Gwinnett. We are a 100% strict vegan family so upon moving to Atlanta a few years ago we were disappointed that we could not enjoy some of the west African food we grew up on because often times many traditional west African dishes contain some animal byproducts even if it appears to be a vegetable dish. This restaurant has changed that narrative by offering a separate 100% vegan menu of African dishes reimagined. The owner is incredibly nice and patient and will help you pick from their numerous menu offerings depending on what your palate is interested in.

“Disclaimer alert” we are vegan as I mentioned early in this review so we cannot speak to any menu item outside of the ones that are 100% vegan.

She offers every menu item in a pre-packaged to-go fashion so You can re-create the delicious dishes on the menu from the comfort of your home with easy to understand instructions.

I love that this restaurant also offers a Seamoss smoothie and you can purchase many other wellness items as well. So whether you’re palette enjoys traditional African dishes like goat meat or beef stew or you follow a “strict vegetarian” aka vegan lifestyle. The entire family can enjoy this Restaurant. We highly recommend the items in the photo posted if you are a first time visitor. Nothing that we tasted was overly spicy so that was a great thing but the flavors were still there for sure and it took us back to the motherland.

Please call ahead before you visit as she often times caters events so it’s best to call the restaurant number to verify her hours of operation the day you plan to visit.

I love this restaurant I go everytime I am in the stone mountain area! I always get the egusi with chicken quarters and white yam fufu. I also get her seamoss gel which is great quality! She is very nice and friendly everytime I go. I recommend her to anyone that wants to try Africa food I even posted her on my Facebook with her number so more people can try it and have it delivered to them!!

I saw your reply to my review earlier. I am only replying to this because I would never want to be viewed as a vindictive person or someone who just sits behind a keyboard just to tear people down. I apologize for the manner in which my review came across, but I don’t apologize for my stand. The food tasted bland and just wasn’t cooked right, I don’t know if maybe it had something to do the person that prepared it or any unforeseen circumstances. The point of the review as harsh as it may have come across, was for you to basically do better, and not an avenue to hurl insults at a customer just because they were displeased with your service. Again, I apologize for the way the comment came across, it was written in the heat of the moment as I was very dissatisfied with the service. And yes I did make a purchase with ubereats under the name “Utibe”. From your response, I can see you’re very passionate about your business, and I would just take it that the day I ordered was a bad day.

I absolutely love this place.  The food has the right amount of spicy and the young lady greeted me with greatness. I also loved the fact that there was music playing. This will be my go to slot for my African cuisine. Egusi and Fufu and jersey wings were great!!!

Love the oxtails w rice!! It’s my favorite dish and this place definitely does not disappoint! The sauce and flavor is so good!! Just ordered today for the second time and my food was delicious. I like how my food comes all wrapped up so no spilling and I can trust it came straight from the restaurant to me!  I even tried the Egusi with fufu for my first time and it was amazing! Customer service is great! I was missing my coco bread from my order which wasn’t a big deal but I was immediately refunded without asking! Would definitely recommend!!

formatted_address: 477 Flat Shoals Ave SE, Atlanta, GA 30316, United States
name: Yen Kitchen at The Global Grub Collective

reviews.text: Their food is absolutely DELICIOUS!!! My friend and I stumbled upon this little enclave accidentally on a Friday night and ended up eating here. We were delighted with the staff (they're so sweet!) and the AMAZING food! I had jollof with greens and a yam pie, and I HIGHLY recommend it!
Vegeterian. Bursting with flavor. Absolutely delicious!
Food was great service was great

formatted_address: 2100 Cheshire Bridge Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30324, United States
name: Embilta Cafe & Restaurant

reviews.text: Walking into this Ethiopian restaurant, I felt like I’d been instantly teleported out of Atlanta! The tablecloths under clear plastic and cozy curtains gave the place a warm, authentic vibe. The food was delicious, the service was great, and for a little while, I really felt like I was somewhere far away. Highly recommend!

Couldn’t imagine a better experience. First time ever having Ethiopian food and I absolutely loved it! We got one platter for 2 people and it was more than enough food, it could have fed 3 hungry people. Half the time we were there we were the only people dining, with the owner being the only cook. The owner was very sweet and we talked with her for a while about her restaurant and background; she even should us videos on the TV of what Ethiopia looks like! That being said, every item on our platter was perfect, i ate every part and had no complaints with the taste. That is definitely saying something  since i’ve never had this kind of food before. But we both loved it. Highly recommend!

So there was no lamb today, I will definitely be back. I opted for the veggie special ans I was not disappointed.  This was my first Ethiopian restaurant and im so happy it was this place. After reading all of the reviews, it was so hard to decide on what to eat, everything looks so good on the menu. I love supporting small businesses.

We got this to go and wow, so delicious! We ordered the “little bit spicy” Embilta Special Large and it was delicious! Although I would call it more of a medium/mild spicy so if you don’t like spice just get none! I think it could feed 2-3 people. Soooo yummy!!

Embilta is one of my favorite restaurants of all time. Very small hole in the wall, but the food always delivers and is the best Ethiopian food I’ve ever had. We always come with a group and get the Embilta special large, and it NEVER disappoints. Can’t recommend enough 👌

formatted_address: 3761 N Druid Hills Rd, Decatur, GA 30033, United States
name: Ghion Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Food is amazing! The vegan options are sooooo delicious.

The service was great and the atmosphere soooooo good.

I ordered vegan platter and vegan beef tips.  Lentil samosas.

I came after 2 on a Sunday and they have fresh roasted coffee.

Lawd I’ve never had such good coffee in my life!

This was some of the BEST Ethiopian food I've ever had. And I've dined at Ethiopian restaurants all over the country as its one of my favorite types of cuisine.

This spot blew away my expectations. I always worry about trying new Ethiopian places because they can make hit or miss, but I am glad to have ordered from Ghion.

First off the vegan meat options are WONDERFUL. I love the traditional plant-based dishes that come with platters, the greens, lentils, cabbage. Delicious. But I've always wanted to try vegan versions of Ethiopian chicken, beef and fish dishes. This is the first time I have been able to do that and it did not disappoint 🙌🏾.

Everything is so flavorful, fresh and delicious 😋.  I have absolutely no complaints. Definitely try the platter that comes with ALL the vegan options!

We had an amazing experience at Ghion last night!
The food was outstanding, the staff was so accommodating, the portions were large and the prices were excellent.

I even took a picture of the bathroom, because it was perfectly clean and great, which is a sign of a clean restaurant.
Lots of parking, but careful if you are turning left into the drive.

Will be back soon, and next time to enjoy the freshly roasted coffee!

We live in the neighborhood behind here and watched the progress on the restaurant and couldn’t wait until they opened! Well I’m here to tell you it was worth the wait! It’s fabulous inside. So authentic. They play music in the background so softly. The staff are so friendly and welcoming. They take the time to talk to you about each dish you order. Everything we ordered was so delicious. The spices are amazing.

I’ve had Ethiopian Cuisine at many different restaurants, and Ghion is by far my favorite.
Immediately the energy of the space was welcoming. My entire dining experience was comfortable from beginning to end. Information was shared with us about the process of adding vegan cuisine to the menu, and how close to home it is for the restaurant.  This shined through every dish .

We had the Vegan Sambusas ( not pictured because by the time we thought about it they were gone lol) and the Vegan Ghion Special ( pictured ). The vegan protein texture and flavors were done very well. Everything was a 10/10 and very satisfying.

formatted_address: 4975 Memorial Dr, Stone Mountain, GA 30083, United States
name: Ledet Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
We have been wanting to try Ethiopian food but wanted to make sure we went to an authentic restaurant so my husbands coworker who is from Ethiopia brought us to his favorite restaurant.

We told him what kind of food we like and our spice levels and he ordered everything for us. I got the Doro tips (chicken tips) with rice, my husband got the Shekla which was beef or steak and his coworker got the Shiro (fish & salmon). I don’t normally eat Salmon but the Shiro was really good. It had a-lot of flavor to it. We shared everything and got to experience eating the Injera that is used as a plate and utensil. Everything was delicious.

The customer service was superior. We could tell his coworker comes here often as everyone was friendly towards him and the owner even came over to our table so we were able to share our first time great experience with her.

My husband’s coworker wanted us to try some tea/coffee after our meal but we were both stuffed. We look forward to coming back and will hopefully save room for tea to conclude our meal.

Came in to try this restaurant after wanting some Ethiopian food besides going to the city.

Ordered the ledet special with the spicy beef, lamb and regular beef ribs (didn’t want the tartar) with collards, split peas and shiro

Spicy beef and lamb great! Regular beef ok not nasty just not seasoned like the others. Loved the shiro and the split peas and collards were good as well especially paired with the meat

The injera had a lemony taste not bad but never had it that way before

Finished off with the Honey Wine which was good as well

Will be back to try more

Ledet Ethiopian Restaurant offers an outstanding dining experience. The food is authentic, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. My server, Yara, provided exceptional service: attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming. Her knowledge of the menu and thoughtful recommendations made the evening even more enjoyable. Highly recommended.
If you want yummy Ethiopian food come here! It’s really nice inside, has a full bar and delish food! Lily was also the best and took great care of us!

Nice, very welcoming restaurant with lots of large tables for friends and family. I enjoyed the food very much and will come back. Everything was well seasoned. I do wish they had more refillable soft drink options as the other diner with me, had to order individual sodas. I did not like that the extra door near my table kept being opened and closed by children running out to the parking lot and back to their table, but I understand parents wanted to keep an eye on their children as they went out to the car. Next time, I'll ask to sit somewhere more private or less distracting. The waitress was kind and attentive, she did refill my water and ask if I wanted more injera, which of course I did.

formatted_address: 3654 Clairmont Rd, Chamblee, GA 30341, United States
name: Jebena Bistro

reviews.text: The first thing I noticed was the service. There was only one person working when I went and the place was not packed but the experience felt like going to a family member’s house for lunch as it was so hospitable. The lady was kind and she made sure we enjoyed everything about the restaurant. The food just took the whole experience over the top as it was tasty, fresh, and colorful. Could not recommend this place enough, will definitely be going back!

Super cute bistro with a different cultural influence. Great quality Ethiopian food. I ordered the traditional Tibs, it was delicious. The bread they baked was clearly fresh and so soft and spongy! They have a breakfast menu and a lunch/dinner menu. They serve coffee and alcohol. I love the aesthetics and vibe with incense burning and framed art around a high top bar, plus dining room and patio seating.

You can tell a lot of thought and care has been put in to this business and the person who prepared my food was very kind as was the rest of their clientele.
Absolutely delectable! Love Ethiopian food and this restaurant blew me away. The owner was so sweet. That honey wine is chefs kiss

I recently visited Jebena Bistro I ordered special foul and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with a modern design that still felt comfortable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu without being overbearing.

I tried vegetarian food which was cooked perfectly and full of flavor. The side dishes were fresh and well-seasoned, and the dessert was an absolute highlight—beautifully presented and delicious. Portion sizes were generous, and the pricing felt fair for the quality.

Overall, Jebena Bistro is a place I’d highly recommend for anyone looking for great food, great service .  thanks Mesay
Amazing experience for my first time! Everyone was welcoming and cool with sharing their culture with me! Food is amazing! The eithopian bread is amazing! 10/10 on the chicken tips!!!

formatted_address: 3675 Clairmont Rd, Chamblee, GA 30341, United States
name: Wehemia Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: I love spicy food but this was spicier than dishes I’ve had in Ghana haha. I wasn’t expecting the awaze tibs to have jalapeños but otherwise it’s great. Very tiny place and it was hard to find at night because the sign on the building does not have any lights.

The kindest people you’ll ever meet! I’ve been coming here since the day they opened, and the food is always incredible, made with so much love and care. Both owners are from my mom’s ethnic group, so every visit feels like a trip back home with my family in Ethiopia.

My best friend and I hosted our joint birthday here this past Friday, and it couldn’t have gone more perfectly. Thank you both for hosting us and making it such a special night! 10,000/10!

My first time to this Ethiopian Restaurant. Absolutely the best food I ever had in a very long time like this . Very delicious food! Ordered Tibs and Salad , and was blown out by the taste and quality.
I will go again and again and again.
Please Keep it up !

Decent authentic Ethiopian food. The veggie platter was ok, I expected more flavor. They were out of a couple items I asked for so I settled for the veggie platter. They make their honey wine, my friend said it was really good. The coffee at the end was super strong with grounds in it.
Wow, exceeded expectations. Great flavors, good presentation and very attentive service. Highly recommended.

formatted_address: 1651 Roswell St Suite F, Smyrna, GA 30080, United States
name: Gursha Ethio Catering

reviews.text:
Lovely food. Very courteous staff.

Gursha was handling our order alone and we expected some delay, but we were amazed because in fact, she was very quick too.

Ordered a plate of sambusa, veggie platter and one fish platter.

Very homely taste.
We just loved it. Thank God the Injera was not too sour.

Will visit it again.s

If you’re craving bold flavors and authentic Ethiopian cuisine, look no further—this spot is a game changer! Ever since I heard they were opening, I’ve been counting down the days, and let me tell you, it was worth every minute of the wait.
Their takeout-only menu is packed with vibrant dishes that will leave your taste buds dancing. Whether you’re vegan or not, they’ve got incredible options that’ll satisfy everyone. Don’t sleep on this place—call to order, and trust me, you won’t be disappointed!
Great take out restaurant, great service, family owned. food is made fresh from scratch and the owners are very thoughtful and kind. Highly recommend!!!

I really had my normal craving for some Injera and I now live too far from Desta’s and I found this lovely couple running this business. I ordered my usual veggie platter and it was so good. So much so I went back the following week. The man who takes care of the front was so kind and sweet just reminds me of my friends parents. This last time the woman cooking gave me some beets which was also amazing and I love beets so that was a plus. Everything is made to order and that makes it that much better. I recommend this place 10/10.

Fantastic Takeout Experience from Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant

I recently ordered takeout from Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant, and I couldn’t be more impressed! The food was authentic, fresh, and full of flavor. Their injera was perfectly soft and spongy, and the various stews (like the doro wat and misir wat) were rich and deliciously spiced.

The portions were generous, making it a great value for the price. The packaging was neat and secure, keeping the food warm and intact during transport. Ordering was straightforward, and the staff was friendly and attentive when I picked up my order.

I highly recommend Gursha  for anyone craving authentic Ethiopian cuisine,  This place is a hidden gem!

formatted_address: 4144 E Ponce de Leon Ave, Clarkston, GA 30021, United States
name: Addis Ababa Ethiopian Grocery & Café

reviews.text: I’ve even at many Ethiopian places, this has got to be one of my favorites in terms of flavor and spices!! Right amount of spicy and salty. We got the veggie platter and awaze tibs. Some outdoor seating where we were able to enjoy the food on a nice day with the dog. Service was great too!

The food is very delicious. Veggies Adds Abeba special kifo Breakfast . Coffee ceremony. Friendly service. Also if you have any occasion they do catering. The owner is very nice she makes sure everyone leaves happy. Believe it or not we have been eating this place every other day. Very cozy. You must visit. I highly recommend.

One of the best Ethiopian veggie plates in the city.  And probably the best lentil samosa!  Tiny little spot with a small kitchen and grocery selection.  Super friendly.  Grass fed beef, in house made injera.  Excellent!

I love Ethiopian food. Been eating it for 25 years.  Some of my best friends are Ethiopian. This is the WORST beef Tibs I’ve EVER had!!!!! I’m from Ohio. Our worst is better than this garage.  No flavor, no spice.!!!  Dry hard old reheated meat!!!
Tried Ethiopian food for the first time, and it was absolutely delicious! The server was amazing sharing us about the food. Would definitely recommend!

formatted_address: 3680 Clairmont Rd, Atlanta, GA 30341, United States
name: Shoa Restaurant

reviews.text: Very clean and spacious restaurant with an extensive bar area (compared to other Ethiopian restaurants I have frequented). The service was pleasant, although there was a mix up on our food being served to the wrong person (still within our party of 6), who devoured my meal before we realized what happened. The waitress was kind and patient with us as we had many questions about food items on the menu. The menu seemed limited compared to what I am used to, but I definitely could not complain about the taste of the food. Everything was savory and well seasoned; it was fragrant. My tongue, stomach, & nose we're doing happy dances because the food tasted/smelled sublime. My daughters aren't big fans of Ethiopian cuisine, but I told them to split the spaghetti (it was a large portion) & they loved it. The main complaint was they didn't have any more honey wine/Tej and were waiting on the next shipment. Also, they had run out of the Gomen Besiga (my original order). Plenty of injera bread was served with each food item (I have seen where that's a rarity & you have to order more injera).

First time eating Ethiopian food and it is different but good. Came here with my Ethiopian friend, she said it’s an authentic restaurant. The waitress’s greeted us with a smile and was super nice and not over attentive. Parking can be tight if you come when it’s crowded. Was a bit timid since I’m trying cuisine outside my “comfort zone”. But everything was fine and the other parties just keep to them selves and nobody stares at anyone. Really a chill nice date spot if you choose. Will like to visit again.

Shoa Restaurant (Bethelhem Market) is the best Ethiopian restaurant in the Atlanta area. From the very authentic Ethiopian cuisine to the excellent service, everything is par high standard. I always feel like I am eating a well cooked, home made Ethiopian food when I dine at Shoa restaurant. Kudos to the owner, Ato Aklilu, and all the staff!!

My family and I visited for a late lunch today and had a wonderful experience. This was my first visit, though my husband had dined here before and spoke highly of it and I can see why. The restaurant is beautifully maintained, and the restroom was exceptionally clean.

Our server provided us with outstanding service, it was both professional and genuinely welcoming. The food was delicious, and even my daughter, who is typically a selective eater, enjoyed the meal. We ordered the Meat Lover Combo, and the cappuccino was excellent as well.

I highly recommend this restaurant and look forward to visiting again soon.

Amazing Ethiopian food! Definitely worth trying and you will not regret it. Tried the veggie combo and meat combo - they were delicious! Elsa was the server and she was amazing- very helpful and walked us through on what to get for someone first time trying the food here!

formatted_address: 4746 Memorial Dr, Decatur, GA 30032, United States
name: Darussalam Mediterranean & Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: Food was exquisite, well seasoned, and visually appealing. We ordered something spicy, forgot what it was, but it hit the spot as far as taste was concerned. The coffee was everything I would expect from an Ethiopian restaurant. Went for my birthday and was a pleasant surprise. Hardly any patrons were present. There was a homeless man who kept trying to enter, the waitress eventually gave him a plate. That speaks to character. It took a little while to pay and leave as it was only one waitress.

The food here was sooo good. Cafeteria style set up, great customer service, great portion sizes and a nice selection of foods to choose from.  I was quite impressed by how good this food was, but will definitely be back.

I was told the restaurant is open so I decided to visit... Inside the restaurant looks beautiful... (lots of upgrade)... smell good and neat... the food is attractive and taste so good... you can also make options of what you want.. I promise it always a wow experience whenever I visit this place! I Love it and will recommend everyone to visit.

The restaurant had the lights on as well as 2 open signs lit up in the window but the doors were locked.  I could see an associate working right there but they didn't acknowledge me at all.  Before I left I called and didn't get an answer.  If you're going to advertise being open with lights on and all then be ready to accept customers.  Such a waste of time to park, hungry in the morning , get out in 30° weather just to find the door locked.
Not the fanciest place and it wasn't super fast (they made it to order), but my medium spicy food was fabulous.

formatted_address: 1172 Bodega Lp, Locust Grove, GA 30248, United States
name: K.K. African Cuisine

reviews.text: I was craving some egusi soup so bad today. I stumbled upon her restaurant. I couldn't wait to get home. This was the best egusi I've ever had and didn't have to leave Henry County! We're fortunate to have food this good so close. Thank you so much for the love you put in your food! Definitely going to be a repeat customer!

KK African Cuisine exceeded my expectations. Chef KK is an amazing chef who clearly pours passion into every dish. I especially enjoyed the pepper soup; it was perfectly spiced and absolutely comforting. The snacks were just as impressive, particularly the meat pie and the fish pie, which were fresh, flavorful, and well made. Everything tasted delicious and was delivered in a timely manner. I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

KK has great customer service. Moves with a quickness and accuracy. Her business is what Henry County needs. In a county of fast food the diverse and goodness of her food will keep you coming back. I certainly will! She is a staple to the community and the food is awesome and filling!

The food at K.K African Cuisine is nothing short of magical. You can taste the passion and tradition in every incredible bite🤤🤤t his is top-tier, heartfelt cooking. And the atmosphere!!! It radiates a warm, joyful energy that makes you feel instantly at home. It’s clear this comes from a place of love, not just a kitchen. It is an absolute treasure and I'm glad i got a taste of magic💖💖

Oh my goodness the food!!!!🤤🤤 A wonderful lady who you can tell puts her wonderful energy into the food she prepares cuz you just feel the love in every bite! Every single dish I have had from them has been amazing.

formatted_address: Inside Nations Cafe, 5929 Jimmy Carter Blvd, Norcross, GA 30071, United States
name: Iman West African Cuisine

reviews.text: The fish was super big it was gorilla red snapper fish .   It tasted like my grand mother use to make me.  The beans 🫘  were awesome.  I will definitely be back soon .  I was treated like a king the atmosphere and ambiance was spectacular.   I left in high spirits and vibration 📳  the ginger 🫚 juice and pineapple 🍍  opened up my lungs 🫁 and my cough went away .

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

From the moment I walked in, the energy of this restaurant was incredible. The owner personally welcomed me and introduced me to dishes that expanded my palate in ways I’ll never forget. The flavors were bold, fresh, and crafted with genuine love — every bite felt like a lesson in culture and care.

The ambiance was just as impressive: spotless cleanliness, beautifully curated aesthetics, and a warm atmosphere that made me feel at home while still transporting me somewhere extraordinary. The smells alone were enough to build anticipation — rich, inviting, and absolutely mouthwatering.

What sets this place apart is not just the food, but the personal touch. Being guided through the menu by the owner herself made the experience deeply personal, almost like being invited into a family kitchen where tradition and creativity meet.

This is more than just a restaurant — it’s an experience. A gem that deserves recognition for excellence in food, service, and atmosphere. I’ll definitely be returning and highly recommend it to anyone who values quality and authenticity.🧩

Farid and Jamil were unbelievably accommodating and helpful. They have a Nigerian and a Ghanaian menu, which was perfect.

We were aiming for some egusi, but told Jamil we were open to try new things. He suggested the peanutbutter soup with a rice ball.

The soup was perfect. I was a bit worried it would be too “peanut-buttery”, but it was balanced and had an amazing blend of spice and oil throughout, that somehow didn’t leave us feeling weighed down.

I have a fair amount of west African food experience, but for anyone else on a new food adventure, they were one of the more accommodating and helpful restaurants that would be perfect for a first-timer.

We will be back, 100%.

Hands down one of the best West African meals I’ve had. The food was packed with bold, authentic flavors and cooked with real love and tradition. Every bite told a story—comforting, rich, and deeply satisfying. This place represents the culture beautifully. A must-visit if you appreciate great food and authenticity.

The suya, Ghanaian jollof rice, and egusi soup were absolutely delicious in flavor and cooked perfectly. Everything tasted fresh and well-seasoned. The service was fast, friendly, and welcoming, which made the experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this place to anyone craving great West African food.

formatted_address: 3721 Crawfordville Rd, Tallahassee, FL 32305, United States
name: OMEGA AFRICAN CATERING AND FOOD SERVICES

reviews.text: The egusi was alright. The goat was a bit tough. I felt as if the chicken and jollof rice was a bit over priced seeing how the chicken was smaller than expected with mostly rice and a can of veggies. The lady was nice though.

HIDDEN GEM!!!!! Tina is the most sweetest person you can come across. The food is AMAZING. I always get the Oxtail Egusi but I’ve also had the chicken one. They both are delicious! Please go check it out! You WILL NOT be disappointed!
I ordered the fufu and egusi with chicken and it was incredible. The chicken was full of flavor and the hospitality from the ladies working made it even better. 10/10, we will be back.

I wasn't sure what to expect but this was great; to my barely-educated palate something like some Jamaican food I've had but obviously with a different flavor profile. I was a bit disappointed to get what appeared to be frozen mixed veggies, instead of the greens I thought were pictured, for my side veggies but the amount and type of flavor in them made me change my mind. The goat curry was cooked just enough to be very tender while still retaining some texture and the flavor was excellent although a little too salty without the rice. The rice that came with it was flavorful enough to eat on its own but was great with the goat and veggies mixed in also. I can't remember the last time that I had new-to-me flavors but I've never had anything quite like this. I'd quibble with their recommendation to sub their puff puffs for the meat hand pies they were out of, as they are nothing alike and I don't like sweet stuff, but even those were good for what they are, like a spiced cross between a donut hole and a fritter. Anyway, definitely trying them again, especially when they have the meat hand pies.

Small little hidden gem! We will definitely be back. Don't be shy, it is worth it! Once we settled in the ladies were a hoot!
Cheers to food we cant find in the panhandle!

formatted_address: 350 Northridge Rd, Atlanta, GA 30350, United States
name: Zanzi Bar Cuisine & Lounge

reviews.text: Highly recommend Zanzi Bar. Complimentary valet parking, great afrobeats, decor, and ambiance. The food was delicious. From the hot, well seasoned crab fingers, cajun pasta, and lamb chops, to the old fashions and hookah. Definitely a nice, chill vibe. And if you get Princess as your server, you're in for A1 stellar service!!

Every thing we had here was delicious. Lively environment. Service was good and on time. They were fully prepared for us. Servers were polite and active too. Space is a little small but who cares ..😆they have good service and the food is good….attached are some of the variety of foods we had 😆😆😆was a large gathering
Super clean restaurant. The food was amazing. Our server Kiki took great care of us and introduced us to the owner. I’d definitely come back to try a few other dishes from there menu.

I enjoyed Zanzi Bar for the most part. The DJ might’ve been the best part. The food was pretty good, some things left me unimpressed. Service was slow. Hidden charges (they didn’t tell us gratuity was included, didn’t tell us there was an extra charge on a credit card) It was a cute environment. However, a lot of faux plants ; to each their own. Had to deal with some very rude fellow patrons but that’s not Zanzi’s fault. The drinks were great.

I had the Snapper with Brussels sprouts and coconut rice. The Snapper was amazing, the Brussels were really good, the rice was disappointing. My partner had the Jerk Chicken, Rice and Peas and Yams.
He was disappointed with his sides and the Jerk Chicken was Decent.
We spent $175 for one app, two entrees, two drinks.

I've taken my wife to this location twice ... and both times: the vibe and food was AMAZING!  The Service was FANTASTIC! the  only reason I didn't give a 5 STAR rating is because: i was NOT informed that an 18% gratuity was automatically added to my bill... and added an additional 20% because the overall experience was great... only to realize I paid a total of 38% Gratuity. 😮‍💨  So I wasn't happy about. I later referred a friend to attend a few weeks later and the exact same thing happened to her.  Conclusion make it a standard practice to inform the guest that gratuity is automatically included.

formatted_address: 3115 Piedmont Rd NE ste d202, Atlanta, GA 30305, United States
name: Foodzone Bistro

reviews.text: Restaurant doesn’t exist. Don’t bother to call

I had an amazing experience at Foodzone Bistro! The cozy atmosphere set the perfect tone and the African dishes were very tasty especially the Asun and Jollof Rice were both delicious and expertly prepared. The staff was attentive and friendly, making my experience even better. It's a must-try! Highly recommend this place for a delightful pick up meal.
Can't find the restaurant anywhere and the phone number of the restaurant don't even work neither does their email.

Restaurant does not exist.

Don't bother.🤨
Best suyaaaa & great service! Authentic Nigerian food

formatted_address: 1440 Chapel Ridge Rd ste 170, Apex, NC 27502, United States
name: Yagg Sii Tenn Authentic African Cuisine

reviews.text:
We had our girls’ dinner at Yagg Sii Tenn yesterday and it was absolutely AMAZING! The food is authentic, flavorful, and truly delicious. We each ordered something different, plus appetizers and desserts, and shared everything. Not a single bite disappointed.

If you love hot and spicy, the wings appetizer is a must-try, and the Tajine dish was incredible. Don’t forget the fried ice cream croissant for dessert. The portions are very generous, so you definitely won’t leave hungry. Having traveled to Africa many times, I can say this restaurant captures that same spirit of hospitality, where feeding people well is a priority. I left both stuffed and completely satisfied.

I also loved that they display photos of the dishes around the restaurant so you know exactly what you’re ordering. Papa and Yagg are such wonderful hosts. Their hard work, warmth, and generosity truly shine through.

We all drove over an hour to get here, and it was 100% worth it. This is a 10/10 dining experience, and I’ll be telling everyone about this gem. I’m already looking forward to coming back in a few weeks. Thank you, Papa and Yagg, for such an incredible food journey through Africa!

Very creative menu and excellent self-bottled  juice drinks. I love finding new menu ideas and this place has an overwhelming menu of delicious looking food, representing the cuisine of different African countries you won’t find elsewhere in the area. I had the lamb wrap and my wife had the curried vegetables. Both were excellent. I got one of their $6 self-bottled juice drinks (Moringa lime mint) and it was the surprise delight of the day. We will be back to try some different dishes. Highly recommend.

Every city needs a restaurant like this. We had the peppah soup (so spicy! so flavorful!), mbuzi with goat and fufu, carrie and jollof rice, plantain soup, piri-piri wings, maffé, and jolof eran. So delicious!

This is such a cool concept where they are trying to represent the food across the entirety of Africa. Capturing the food diversity of such an enormous continent is not easy but this is such a wonderful tribute. The food is so delicious and the folks very kind and gracious! Loved our first time here!

This was our second time dining here, and it was just as wonderful as the first! We first came to celebrate my husband’s birthday, and this time we came back for my daughter’s birthday, both experiences were absolutely amazing. The staff is always welcoming, the atmosphere is full of warmth and culture, and the food is simply delicious. As a seafood lover, I ordered the Riz Gorée again, and it was bursting with rich flavor and perfectly cooked. This place never disappoints! Definitely one of our favorite spots!

formatted_address: 2701 Candler Rd suite b, Decatur, GA 30034, United States
name: Hungry AF Decatur

reviews.text: Leaving my hair appointment I wanted to see what restaurant was around for a quick bite. This place came up and was 7mins away. I'm so happy I tried this spot. I got the Philly Steak Cheese and Wings combo. My god, every was absolutely delicious. I sat there and ate my fries but took away the rest. I guess, I now have a spot to look forward to when I get my hair done. Check them out ya'll. You will not be disappointed. Very good portions!

Service was awesome! Food was good no need for extra seasoning!!!! The chicken Philly could use more chicken than cheese.
The shrimp rasta pasta is ok, the sauce is a little to thick for me. The rasta Philly is good. Fries are always fresh and will never make the photo!

I have had some great food while visiting Atlanta and the surrounding areas, and this place is one of them. Hungry AF (love the name, btw), servers up delicious American food like Philly cheesesteaks, wings, salmon bites, pasta dishes, fries, etc. I ordered 3 Philly cheesesteaks with wings and fries, and as you can see in the pictures the Philly was stuffed with meat, which was tender and seasoned nicely (a tad too salty for me but my mom and brother didn't think it was). Anyway, it had a perfect amount of peppers and cheese. It was one of the best cheesesteaks I've had in a very long time. The wings were a nice size and cooked nicely. Not too hard/not too soft, and the flavors included buffalo,  lemon pepper,  hot honey, and many more, even some signature flavors. The food was beautifully plated (boxed) and definitely had the WOW factor when opened!! If you're in the area, please visit this place. You won't be disappointed.

This was my first time eating care trying to get some food before my hair appointment and I got the pasta and wings. The pasta was so salty. I could not even bear the taste and I got extra protein. I asked for hot honey lemon pepper. I just got barbecue wings. I didn’t have time to go back and I don’t think I will. I cannot eat the pasta and barely ate the wings a waste of $30.

AMAZING FOOD & VIBES!

Hungry AF Food Restaurant is EVERYTHING! The food is fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection — every bite was packed with seasoning and love. The portions are generous, the presentation is on point, and you can tell they really care about quality and customer satisfaction.

The atmosphere is fun and welcoming, and the staff is friendly, fast, and professional. Whether you’re super hungry or just craving something good, this place does not disappoint. I’ll definitely be back again and again — Hungry AF truly lives up to the name!

formatted_address: 2480 Windy Hill Rd SE Ste 204, Marietta, GA 30067, United States
name: Small Chops & Grills ATL

formatted_address: 2127 Liddell Dr NE, Atlanta, GA 30324, United States
name: Daily Chew

reviews.text:
Wow! The food here was amazing, the latke stack was cooked perfectly and crispy. The sauces in each dish are paired well together. The sausage was different for me but something I really enjoyed it. I loved everything I tried and will definitely be coming back!

Harlow was also our server and 10/10 great vibes and energy.
Truly excellent eggy avocado toast. Lovely outdoor seating area, wonderful coffee and espresso options, and very welcoming service. Absolutely outstanding. Will be back.

Food and drinks were fantastic! The vibes are so great. Lush and green. I had the latke with a mushroom schnitzel substitute for the salmon, a pita sandwich, and shakshuka. I loved the mushroom schnitzel in my pita sandwiches and the shakshuka was very flavorful too. The spiced rooibos latte was so special. I will definitely be coming back again.

Very vegetarian friendly!

This place is absolutely amazing! From the lattes to the food, it was all so delicious (highly recommend the mushroom schnitzel).
Everyone was so kind and friendly!
Definitely coming back here

Daily Chew is great on a day that’s mild enough to sit outside. Inside on a Monday lunch? Loud. So loud. Even in the bathroom I couldn’t get away from the conversation at the table just outside. The tall ceiling is an echo chamber. I want to say the beautiful grains bowl was worth the sacrifice of conversational clarity  but…  I really love the friend I lunched with so no. Next time will be a mild day. Outside table. No shouting.

formatted_address: 1235 Chattahoochee Ave NW Suite 130, Atlanta, GA 30318, United States
name: Chattahoochee Food Works

reviews.text: What a fun,  funky place to sample a taste of Atlanta! A close knit,  but organized for court with a variety of options including Thai, Vietnamese, NC BBQ, seafood, Bubble tea, ice cream, mochi donuts and Korean hotdogs, ramen, soul food and Latin, you will surely find something for anyone in your party... we did! There are  multiple places to sit,  and even some great non food vendors for clothing and home decor/furniture, if you want to add shopping to the day out. We smoked a variety of food,  and loved it all.

I stopped by Chattahoochee Food Works recently, and it ended up being one of those places where you go in thinking you’ll grab something quick and end up staying way longer than expected. It’s not a single restaurant — more like a food hall with a bunch of local vendors — but the setup feels really welcoming and laid-back. The space has that open, industrial feel that’s common around the Works, but it doesn’t feel cold or echoey. There’s a good mix of families, people grabbing a casual drink, and groups hopping stall to stall trying different things.

What I liked most was the variety. You can wander around, check out menus, and literally build your own meal from different stalls. On my visit, I ended up getting ramen from one place and then circled back for a small lobster roll from another vendor because the smell was too tempting to ignore. Both were surprisingly good — fresh, flavorful, and not skimpy on portions.

The vibe is easy and unpretentious. Even when it got busy, it didn’t feel chaotic. Vendors were friendly and answered questions without rushing you along. Seating can get tight depending on the time, but it’s manageable, and the outdoor area is a nice bonus when the weather cooperates.

Overall, Chattahoochee Food Works is a great spot to bring friends, especially if no one can agree on what to eat. It feels local, relaxed, and full of options — the kind of place you can revisit without getting tired of it.

Unbeliebubble boba was so good! I got cold oolong with Boba, 50% ice and Sweet. My favorite! I wasn't super hungry so I just got some Tostones to snack on from LA Tropical. They were yummy! I really loved the location and atmosphere. Very cozy and classy. Great spot.

Loved everything about this place. Reminds me of an upscale Ponce city market as is Ponce isn’t upscale enough (:
Had some lunch from WTF (what the fry) wings were AMAZING. I liked that the first two hours of parking were free as well.

This was our first time visiting this place. We chose here because we like variety. There are many food options so we got something from several restaurants. We had shrimp rolls, birria tacos, honey wings, chicken hibachi, loaded tots, cookies, and ice cream. Everything was good!👍🏽 Oh and the best thing to me was the frozen drink from Fuzzy's. This is a must visit in ATL.

formatted_address: 1401 Moreland Ave SE, Atlanta, GA 30316, United States
name: Red Rice Restaurant & Catering

reviews.text: First heard about this place via Mr. Chimetime’s YouTube video and I wanted to try it. I finally got that opportunity several weeks ago and it certainly lived up to its name. I ordered a smothered Turkey wing which came with red rice, collard greens and garlic green beans for myself and for my dad, I got him the lamb chops with the same sides. Atmosphere inside was good with many others like me ordering food to go and the service was also just as great. The Turkey wing was a guilty pleasure for me with the gravy giving lots of savory flavor to the juicy Turkey. As for the lamb chops, my dad enjoyed them noting the good seasoning placed on them. The 3 sides were fantastic. I agree that this place is a hidden gem for soul food in the Atlanta area. Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting.

I was finally able to make it to the restaurant from watching Mr.  Chimetime's great video review and I was not disappointed! Food here was AMAZING! The Red Rice reminds me of Jellof Rice. The sides... DELICIOUS... cornbread... fantastic. The 1st day I bought the Turkey Meal. I came back the next day and got another turkey meal and got the jerk wing meal.  Staff was very friendly and service was fantastic. Next time I'm in Atlanta I'll definitely be back!

I hate to give them a bad rating, but I just wasted my money. Everyone was friendly, and offered to make me whole... but my food was cold and bland, except the green beans (excellent), yams and collards (pretty good)... Protion size was GREAT, but..... Oxtails were ordinary and Luke warm.  Turkey wing and lima beans were bland and cold... cold like it was refrigerated,  and then sat on the counter til it reached room temperature... I had high hopes... drove 4 hrs... UGH

Phenomenal!!! Came for a New Year’s Day meal and was greeted with a great experience and delicious food. The sides are dietary inclusive. The beans and greens are made with turkey instead of pork. Truly enjoyed our meals, will be back!

Where do I start! This place is about 45 minutes from my house(if there's no traffic). I finally made the drive and boy was it worth it! I got the oxtail with collard greens and candied yams plus a turkey wing on the side. The hype was real! Everything was delicious! Very flavorful and and big portions. I also got a red velvet cake and lemonade. The cake was really good and the lemonade might be some of the best I've ever had. Imani was also very friendly and helpful. I will definitely be making this drive again in the near future so that I can try their other items. Definitely a must try if you live in the A!

formatted_address: 1110 Vermont Ave NW, Washington, DC 20005, United States
name: The Continent DC

reviews.text:
Late review from visit in April.
We visited for an early dinner…right before the big dinner surge. I loved the atmosphere & our server was very attentive.

I ordered the shrimp appetizer & snapper for main course. The shrimp was tasty. My snapper wasn’t bad but I wouldn’t order it again, I would try something different next time. The music was nice & not too loud. Our server recommended that we come back for happy hour. Overall, a good experience.

Sunday Brunch Buffet
The brunch buffet offered a wide variety of options, particularly appealing if you enjoy a blend of West African and American cuisine. The ambiance was clean, stylish, and inviting, complemented by a well-kept bar area. Service was friendly and attentive throughout our visit.
Parking on Sundays is convenient, with both street and garage options available. The garage fee was $13, but it provided a sense of security for the vehicle.
I sampled a range of dishes for variety. I didn't care for the tilapia, the spice-grilled chicken, or the rice, which I found a bit too dry for my taste. However, the chicken red stew and the catfish were standout items, and all of the American offerings were delicious--especially the salad, cold grilled shrimp, carved turkey breast, and made-to-order omelet. The omelet station, though, could benefit from a few more ingredient options.
One note: the music and DJ can become quite loud and overpower conversations, so I recommend visiting before 1 p.m. if you prefer a quieter dining experience.
Overall, it's a solid brunch choice with a diverse menu and pleasant atmosphere. I don't have a need to drive to dc to go back .

Went here on a Saturday night to try the food and it was PACKED. The hostess found room for my wife and I which was so nice. My wife and I ordered a couple dishes. The food was for the most part delicious. The prawn and fish were so good. The goat was good too, but it was kind of chewy. Thing I did not like was that they charges us $9 for "still" water (saratoga bottled water) and never refilled our glasses for us?? They could have at least left the bottle at our table! Also out server never checked in on us once but we still got charged a 20% gratuity. These kind of ruined the experience. In addition, it was way too loud in there with the DJ, they should decide if they want a club vibe or a restaurant vibe, can't have both. The prices are very high, $22 for one tiger shrimp is too much. It was a meh experience all things considered, im sure you can find a better African restaurant in the area.

Stopped on a Saturday evening for dinner. Vibes 10/10. Real cutesy. Great music they played new & old classics. They also had a dj that was going to come on as we were leaving. Good customer  service.

Food
Red snapper plater 4/5 - really good, beautiful presentation. Fish, was fried and seasoned well.  It didnt have a heavy breading so it was light in texture. Jollof- cooked well, flavor profile more tomatoe fwd vs spice & flavor.
No drinks- we were coming from spitit and wine festival and needed to eat & hydrate.

They have traditional dishes as well. I'd definitely recommend if you enjoy African food and are in the DC area.

First let me start by saying our waiter Will was very good. The food was also good but there were so many things they did not have. We had reservations for 7 pm and there were 14 of us. Although we were there early, they did not have shrimp for the samosas, no apple juice, and they were out of the yam fufu and had to make more but it never came. I expected much better due to the reviews and a bill over $2000.

formatted_address: 2208 14th St NW, Washington, DC 20009, United States
name: Elmina

reviews.text:
We visited Elmina for dinner with reservations for two. Even with a reservation, we ended up waiting a bit for our table, which was not ideal. However once seated, the space itself definitely impressed us. The restaurant is huge, spanning three floors, and the atmosphere is beautiful, lively, and full of energy.

Our server was great. He was friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and happy to share his personal favorites. However, our food took around 30 minutes to arrive, which was disappointing. It was especially noticeable because the table next to us was seated after us and received all of their dishes before we got even one.

Overall the food was good. The plantains were perfectly cooked and delicious, and the pork belly was grilled well with a great sauce. Our favorites were definitely the crab fried rice and the grilled chicken, both incredibly flavorful. My cocktail was also fantastic.

Overall, Elmina has a stunning space, great vibes, and good food, but the pacing and wait times could use improvement. We’d return, but hope for a smoother dining experience next time.

A mix of great and meh. The smoked plantains were fantastic and the okra fries were delicious as well. The other food we ordered such as the Tina tartare & Crab Fried Rice were well prepared but we didn't feel like it warranted the price point. Service was exceptional but I ultimately would choose to go somewhere else for a full dinner. I think Elmina would be a great date spot or place to stop with 1-2 friends for appetizers.

I ordered one cocktail which was fine, but again I don't think it was worth the price. It was Old Fashioned adjacent and came with tiny ice cubes which melted quickly. I may be a large clear ice cube snob, but still...

I am so glad we were able to get a reservation here. After returning from a trip to Ghana with a newfound appreciation for the food and culture, Elmina is a fantastic sequel.
Our eyes were larger than our stomachs, but that didn't stop us.
We started our meal with a hearty helping of kelewele, which was well-spiced with plantain that was not overripe. We followed that up with the tasting menu.

-Hamachi Crudo was refreshing, and the added texture from the corn nuts was appreciated.

-Zaalouk Dip was delicious, and the roti was perfect.

-Fufu was a standout. I wish we got more, but gluttony is a sin 😭The peanut sauce was 🔥

-Braised lamb shoulder was excellent and tender! The whole dish was well-balanced.

-Jollof duck pot was our main, and while I definitely enjoyed it, I was overwhelmed by the strength of the fish in the shito. This dish had many elements of the duck. The breast was medium (succulent and robust), the leg was tamarind-glazed (super savory and bold), and a fried duck egg accompanied the rice.

-Malva Pudding Cake and corn pudding were a scrumptious end to this lovely dinner.

It was a privilege to dine at Chef Eric Adjepong's restaurant. He was gracious and active throughout dinner, even asking us how the meal was when we were literally rolling ourselves out of the door.

Lastly, and the heart of our experience, the service was phenomenal. Special thanks to Felipe (sp), who helped make my day more special!

Our first visit here after hearing about from the Michelin guide. I was a little surprised and felt like it was not the same place like in the photos.  Michelin guide posted beautiful pictures of
The food and the place but I felt like it didn’t match my experience.

I wasn’t interested in tasting menu as it’s a lot of food and unfortunately one person cannot do tasting menu and another à la carte. We ordered drinks and before drink order came in our server came back and took our food order (our server was wonderful! ). Pacing was really bad with the food and drinks. I think our server came by several times but an entree and most of the food came out even before drinks. Drinks came later and then dishes kept coming. I think they do a better pacing with the tasting menu than what I had and it was a bit disappointing.

Octopus kabob was the best! Smoky and very flavorful. Their dip is my next favorite and I would say spicy chicken was next - nice and spicy with a kick and good for 2 people.
