name: Kulan Cafe

reviews.text:
This place is a must visit. Outstanding food, the fish, chicken, and lamb were flavorful and tender. The pasta and rice were delicious and really paired well with the meat and green sauce. We also received some stewed potatoes in a tomato sauce that really balanced out the meal.

Finished our meal with tea and I have to say it’s an essential order if you like spiced teas. It’s perfectly sweet, warm, and has a strong ginger and spice flavor.

The service and ambiance were also great. The servers and hosts took care of our party and all of us can’t wait to return. Overall this is a great restaurant and well worth the visit!

First visit  of many for sure! I ordered the chicken and lamb over pasta with side salad to go( I think you get more salad if you dine in. The food was very YUMMY, and flavorful! The hot pepper sauce gave it that umph! Took me from like to love!! I would definitely recommend the lamb so very tender! (ALTHOUGH, I can see me ordering this again and again)

I gave it 4* on atmosphere because of all the construction going on outside, but the inside was clean and organized.

I was looking for Somalian food as I heard from my sister about it. I loved it.  Each and every item was so delicious. Perfect Somalian authentic cuisine. I will come again for the rice and lamb.  Everyone working in the restaurant is so kind. They are very generous with quantity of food. Don’t judge the book by its cover. The restaurant look and atmosphere is not good but do not miss thew delicious food for that reason. If you prefer fancy restaurant, then go for take out.

I visited Arlington, VA today and had an incredible experience trying Somalian food! The lamb and rice were simply delicious, and the hospitality was warm and inviting. It's a great local find and a must-try if you're ever in the area.

We had a great experience here trying Somalian food for the first time! Our entries came with a simple Italian salad (nothing to write home about) but also included a free drink. We chose the tea, which was sweet and had plenty of Somalian spices. The fish sandwich was simple but very tasty. The spaghetti and chicken steak came with a spicy sauce, and was surprisingly tasty. The main highlight for me was my sabayad (a Somali bread that reminded me of Indian roti) with chicken saqar. There was plenty of chicken covered in a nice blend of onions, pepper, and spices with enough juice to dip the bread in. It almost reminded me of fajitas. Everything was delicious, and the customer service was great as well. The staff came over to ask about the food and answer our questions. We would definitely come back!

formatted_address: 4936 Edgewood Rd, College Park, MD 20740, United States
name: Koité Grill

reviews.text: Once of my friend took me this spot. The food here is amazing... I got my self vbw chicken. And lamb. It was so good. The flavor on the meat was on point. The workers were super nice. I highly recommend this spot!!!

Wow! This place really surprised me. Was looking for a great lunch and it did not disappoint. I kiked it so much I ordered a plate to-go before I even left the parking lot.

The lamb, goat, and rice were all cooked to perfection. Omar, the gentleman who took my order, was gracious and kind as I asked questions about the menu. I wished they had more veggies in the menu, but regardless - if I lived in the area, this spot would definitely be on my list for tasty takeout!

This is A hidden gem. There isn’t a sign up to show they are in the shopping mall but it’s worth a visit. They’re sandwiched between to churches. If you go in a weekend you may get some great food and a good sermon from the churches. The portions are large and the meat is very flavorful. I prefer my meat a little more tender but the other family members liked it as it was. The goat was great as well as the lamb. The Mac and cheese very very cheesy. I added a little salt to make it perfect for my taste but overall I give this place a 9 out of 10. They have a store as well. Check out the pics

Granted I haven't been to their restaurant locations, their pop-up location that features their food truck in Forestville Plaza is where my mom was blessed to bring some of their food home for the family to try. Quick story, one weekend I was driving by with her in my vehicle and suddenly we smelled a delicious aroma as well as saw smoke coming from the grill. She noted the place in her mind this weekend she was able to venture there. She relayed that they had a good amount of customers ordering food but the personnel was so patient, kind, and helpful. She brought home some grilled chicken, lamb, jollof rice, macaroni and cheese, and green beans. Majority of the meat and jollof rice was in one container, but altogether enough to feed a family of three people with huge appetites. Everything was delicious, but my favorite was their grilled chicken! It paired nicely with their mustard sauces, especially the hot mustard sauce! They also have The most unique and delicious joloff rice I've ever tasted in my life! The taste of Senegal cannot be compared! I've tried other West African food, but Senegalese food stands out like no other! Originally, Ivorian food was my favorite, but now I can add Senegalese food to my new list of favorite West African food! You have to try it - you won't regret it! I look forward to going to one of their restaurant locations!

Excellent food and excellent service. The portions are very large which is good. You have enough for your dinner and some leftovers. The fries were also very good. The food came out relatively quick and was very hot and delicious.

formatted_address: Old Silver Hill Rd, Hillcrest Heights, MD 20746, United States
name: Sun Bim African Carribean & American Cuisine

reviews.text: Really mad and disappointed. And I never got treated bad there always nice and welcoming. But I guess when you say something wrong with the food it’s a problem. I got goat peanut butter stew. Opened it up 3 big pieces and a lil one with all bone no meat. I then called to ask how many come in there he said six depending on sizes I told him I had 3 big ones and a lil one he said WOMEN I COUNTED MYSELF I PUT 6!! At that point I’m not arguing with this man who raised his voice and I paid $30 cause I got a side of jollof rice too. Smh this was my worst food from there everything normal is so good. But that customer service really has to get better. Wasted $30 to just eat the rice 🙄 I JUST SAID ILL WRITE A REVIEW IM NOT YELLING ON THIS PHONE.

I'm very disappointed about the service I received,such the way my food looked and taste and the response I gotten after complaining. I've eaten there many occasions and never had a problem with food or how I was treated. Things happen, we are not perfect. My daughter asked what I wanted to eat for lunch (it was my 🎈 🎂 I was excited and said African from my favorite place. I went to eat.. but it didn't look the same. It looked so oily and old.. the taste .. I just couldn't, something was off. I love me some African food.. you hear me😂 like I said,I've never had a problem with them and would always bragg about food and how they treated me, especially the man(owner) this was until I complained. He was so rude to me,kept hanging up on me.. Saying he was in a meeting.. No apology for the food not being up to par.. All he kept saying was his wife just cooked. Not true.it was different. I was surprised how he acted. Guess people only nice long as you spending money and giving great reviews. I'm really surprised how I was treated. It wasn't about the food because like I said things happen. I just couldn't eat that. It was the response for me. Not feeling comfortable after being treated like that, I just told him didn't worry about it. I was just going to take a lost. He did give me a refund, that was the only positive outcome. Anytime I throw away some, you know it's a problem. All of that oil was going to make me sick. I even offered to show him videos of food and that I threw it out because he acted like he didn't believe me. But he refused to look at. I have to find me another restaurant.. recommendations please
Tasty Egusi Stew with chicken and beef meat. The stew just needed a little more palm oil. Otherwise, my dish was yummy.

The Worst food I ever had. I ordered the oxtail wt Jollof rice the menu price said $16.99 when the lady rang me up she told me it’s $25.99 I asked her for the menu she gave it to me and I showed her that the price says $ 16.99 she said the price changed. I gave her cash and waited for my change she told me she didn’t have any change. I waited  over 1.5 hrs for my order. It was a plate of rice no meat ,she just put bones on top the rice .NEVER AGAIN!!!!

Best african food I've had on DC so far. I got jollof cassava leaves and fish. I wish it were spicy and its a liiiittle salty but not too overwhelming that its inedible. Thank you for ending my night well. I ordered from Rahama silver spring earlier and they sent me the wrong food. I used to eat from the Woodbridge location when I lived there but I don't drive and live on dc now. I'll be ordering from yall again!

formatted_address: 7241 Landover Rd, Hyattsville, MD 20785, United States
name: Obalende Kitchen

reviews.text: My Go To Place When Am In DMV Is Obalende Kitchen OMG I Can’t Get Enough Of The Food💯❤️❤️ From Las Vegas To Obalende Kitchen❤️❤️❤️

I have been looking for Nigerian food that could rival my mother’s cooking. I didn’t think it was possible for a place like this. The Suya is amazing and the service is wonderful. So proud to support this local business with such hard working people… you have to try the food here 10 out of 10

Obalende Suya is not only a hidden gem, but the service is top-notch too! The owner's humility and kindness truly make the experience exceptional. The suya is mouth-watering, and the portions are generous. What impressed me most was the owner's dedication to ensuring every customer leaves happy. He takes the time to greet, listens to feedback, and even offers recommendations with a smile. His humility and passion for his business shine through in every aspect. Don't miss out on this amazing spot! Highly recommended!
The best you will find in the DMV area.

The food was good however service is not so good. I drove there a couple times when it said open on Google but it was closed. I then reached out a couple times to find out and I’ve been left on read both times so
One of the best suya I ever had  ! Reminds of back home.  The variety of meat , the flavor! Omg best suya hands down. I travel 2 hours just to get this suya because it’s so good.  !

formatted_address: 8738 Richmond Hwy, Alexandria, VA 22309, United States
name: Rahama African Restaurant

reviews.text:
This restaurant used to be small, but now they’re expanding—and the food has gotten even better! I’ve eaten fufu here before, and the quality has really upgraded. The prices are perfect, the food is amazing, and I’d love to keep coming back.

For anyone who loves African food, this is a Ghanaian restaurant and probably the best in the DMV area. It has quickly become one of my favorite spots.

Went to pick up the food but they closed 15 minutes early and charged us still (they were supposed to close at 9 and orders stop at 8:40). We even had called ahead to ask for recommendations right before ordering at around 7:50. I’m not sure why they would close when they had more order ready for pick up. We were not the only one there waiting for an order that we couldn’t get. I attached an image proof I took as we were leaving. We were really looking forward to trying their food. Hoping this was a one time mistake but this was not cool at all.

Great store and staff! Visited earlier to get someone some traditional Ghana 🇬🇭 food. The guy in the line in front of me was super nice and explained some food items to me like: corn 🌽 mixed with peanut 🥜 butter 🧈 and ginger. 🫚 If you don’t like ginger 🫚 you probably won’t like some of the items. The wife wasn’t a fan. I thought it was delicious and much better than the lemonade we made at Deliver Lean; that was the most ginger thing I have ever had 😂 it burned to drink that stuff. Anyway, great staff, great food, smelled amazing!!! Wish I had tried more stuff cause the meats smelled amazing. Muslim friendly as it had a sign praising Allah. I’m a barefoot 🦶 servant of Lord Jesus and know that The Holy Spirit watches over all the children of God Almighty no matter what name. Also, the cops posted outside made it feel more safe and secure. Wish I’d take more photos. The music was awesome!! Wife had to made me stop snapping 😂

The food is amazing and very good for your money. They serve in large portions.

The tuo zaafi is great, the banku with tilapia (very well seasoned and grilled). The jollof is great even my Nigerian friends agreed Ghana jollof has won this round.

The koko and burkina are also great especially with the groundnut.

I really enjoyed the food and I plan on returning soon.

When calling feels like you've been Rush
The food is really good. Really good. The people's personalities are completely different when in person they're way nicer and the price is pretty good for the amount that you pay for and the quantity of the foot is a lot. You got your money worth

formatted_address: 5621 Belair Rd, Baltimore, MD 21206, United States
name: Shekinah Glory African Restaurant

reviews.text:
I wish I could give this place zero stars. I ordered the beef with rice and fried wings with fries, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The wings and fries should be described as cold, burned wings and fries. To say the wings were overcooked is an understatement — they were nearly inedible, dry, and absolutely unpleasant to eat. The fries were just as bad, limp, and cold.

The beef and rice were average at best, but after biting into those wings, I lost my appetite altogether. This was not worth the money, and honestly, I feel like I deserve a refund.

Shekinah Glory needs to seriously step up their food quality if they want returning customers.

I’m having to trash 30 dollars worth of food
This is the worst jellof and fried rice I’ve had in my life and I definitely do not recommend

Worst oxtails I’ve ever had rip off literally 3 small pieces of oxtail with little meat a lot of fat and the plantains are super dry don’t waste your money on the oxtails smh I have to order some more food because I’m still hungry smh really am disappointed in the oxtail platter with plantains 👎🏾

Lousy service and customer service. Ordered Gbegiri and ewedu  through Door dash and specifically requested for a beef and fish. Then I called to confirm the details of the order to avoid issues.First the stew was more of oil than Gbegiri and I was given turkey ( which was mostly bone). This was after calling to confirm the details of my order. The customer service actually told me there were other stores I could order from if I did not like the food.
Man was very rude to me , but food was okay.  Don't prefer food to be placed in microwave to be heated when you have hot wells to hold food. The  heated table must Don't work properly 😒.

formatted_address: 1500 East Capitol St NE, Washington, DC 20003, United States
name: Capitol Square Bar & Grill

reviews.text:
Absolutely LOVE this place! Have driven by for years and finally stopped in for a Friday night date night during happy hour. My husband and I love Washington, D.C. happy hour options and theirs were pretty good either way gluten free and vegetarian options.

Started our dining experience with a vodka cran for myself and the house red for my partner. Then we ended up splitting the amazing plantains nachos, strawberry feta and blueberry salad and the most delicious mashed potatoes I think I’ve ever had. Our waitress was super helpful and nice while helping me navigate my gluten free options. We got to meet the chef too and he was so friendly. Can’t wait to come back, especially for their brunch deals and specials.

We made a reservation for 12:30 on a Sunday and the table was ready with menu opens as soon as we arrived.

We ate and had paid our checks by 1:40, just illustrating the quick and efficient service Freddie provided.

We had French toast, catfish, oxtail, wings, salad and other items.   Everything was well seasoned and delicious.

Definitely take a moment to stop and enjoy this neighborhood gem.  Street parking on E Capitol was pretty plentiful, especially when the school is not in session.

Great atmosphere, very instagramable. We tried the African Mama cocktail (frozen), for apps we had the Oxtail spring rolls and the cream of crab—both super tasty. For my entrée I ordered the lamb chops, absolutely delicious . Chef Fredy made the overall experience delightful.

We had a wonderful experience at DC Capitol Square Bar & Grill.
The service was outstanding and Chef Fredy personally made sure everything was perfect, which truly elevated our visit. The food was exceptional, started with the creamiest, most flavorful cream crab that was chef’s kiss!

The lamb chops were tender and flavorful, the sides were fresh, and the presentation was beautiful. Highly recommend this spot for both the amazing food and the warm, attentive service.

This bar and grill is a very nice spot in Capital Hill, adding good food and good vibes alike. The food is something to write home to mom about. It serves African and Latin fusion flavors, full of spices balanced just right.  I had the Capital Square chicken and it was delicious. It turns into a lounge at night with live entertainment. Definitely worth checking out!

formatted_address: 1529 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC 20007, United States
name: Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: This place is a hidden gem in a cool neighborhood in Georgetown. The service was friendly and warm. The place felt welcoming and like you’re dining at your families house. The food was outstanding with a perfect blend of flavors and spices. The smell of Ethiopian coffee in the air while sitting in the dining area was awesome. Loved everything about the experience at a very reasonable price. Well done, I’ll be sharing it with friends, and will be back when  I‘m in town.
Went with our 15 month old and we all enjoyed the food. Ordered the lamb derek tibs (came out sizzling) and veg combo. Everything tasted fresh. Great little new spot in Georgetown.

On a cold Georgetown night, my cousin and I were out walking and decided we needed something warm — so we ducked into Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine for a cup of coffee… and what an unforgettable experience it turned out to be!

This beautiful spot is the only Ethiopian restaurant in Georgetown and such a warm, inviting addition to the neighborhood. The atmosphere inside is gorgeous — cozy yet elegant — and instantly made us feel welcome.

I ordered an authentic Ethiopian coffee, and they didn’t just serve it — they presented it with a traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony, right there! They explained how coffee has deep cultural roots and is widely believed to have originated in Ethiopia, where the coffee plant (Coffea arabica) grows wild and where the legend of its discovery by a goatherd named Kaldi first began.

The ceremony was beautiful: from freshly roasted beans to the fragrant aroma as they prepared the coffee, every moment felt like a cultural celebration — not just a drink. Ethiopian coffee ceremonies are rich in tradition and hospitality, symbolizing connection, respect, and community.

On top of that, I had the pleasure of meeting the owner, who was incredibly welcoming and passionate about sharing this cultural experience with us. That personal connection made the visit even more special.

While we only came in for coffee this time, I already can’t wait to come back — not only to try their Ethiopian cuisine but also to enjoy the patio area when the weather warms up. Cottage House Ethiopian Cuisine is destined to be one of my favorite Georgetown spots!

Highly recommend stopping by — whether you’re craving great coffee, authentic culture, or just a cozy place to unwind. ☕✨
Restaurant is very clean and organized. Great costumer service. Ordered Awaze Tips and it tasted great very fresh and homemade. Dessert was great too I got tiramisu.😁
We went for dinner and it was amazing! So reasonably priced and Rachel gave us incredible service! All the food was delicious and well-portioned. A must try!

formatted_address: 1128 H St NE, Washington, DC 20002, United States
name: Feru Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: Enjoyed a wonderful lunch with family at Feru yesterday and was impressed enough to leave a review.  We had Feru Special Tibs, Derek Tibs and Veggie Combo along with Coffee and Tea afterwards.  The food was delicious and service was excellent (shout-out to our host BeTselot ; ).  The Derek Tibs was one of best I have ever had and will highly recommend it if you like that kind of Tibs.  Feru's decor both outside and inside is warm and inviting.  Especially mention for Feru's elegant, modern and clean bathroom.  May take is, if  restaurateur pays good attention to their bathroom then it gives me confidence that it does the same and even more to their kitchen so kudos to Feru.  Bottomline, definitely recommend Feru and will make an effort to dine at Feru again.

While on a lunch crawl along H Street NE to support new local businesses, a friend and I popped into Feru for their veggie combo for $19.99. Within minutes, it came out with lentils and other goodies. There's great Ethiopian food in D.C. thanks to the large diaspora here, but Feru can hole their own. Each dish was flavorful and delicious. The server was very kind and proud of the place she helped build. The chef is a mother with decades of experience in hospitality. If you love Ethiopian, give Feru a go!

I have recently visited Feru Ethiopian Cusine with my good friend and had a really enjoyable experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a good Ethiopian meal. Knowing the owner manager Feru for some period of time, the hospitality was not a surprise to me. The staff were friendly and attentive, and our food arrived on time.

The menu had a good variety of options, and the dish we ordered was "Kitfo" and "Tibis" the food was flavorful and well presented. The portions were satisfying, and the ingredients tasted fresh. Prices were reasonable for the quality of food and service.

Overall, Feru Ethiopian Cusine is a great choice for a casual meal or a night out with friends or family. I strongly recommend the restaurant for dinning an Ethiopian traditional food.

This has quickly become my favorite place in the H St corridor. It has a cozy, atmosphere with an intimate vibe enhanced by the charming exposed brick and rustic modern decor.

The service is incredibly warm and welcoming. The cuisine is as authentic as it gets—the Kitfo and tibs are absolutely spectacular and a must-tey.

During warmer weather, their patio adds another wonderful dimension to the experience. It's a gem that exceeded all my expectations.  for an unforgettable meal!

Great experience. It was Sunday afternoon and calm, so we had the pleasure of chatting with the owner about her new place. The food was excellent, with a unique twist from the average Ethiopian places. I would recommend asking for additional hot sauces and spices on the side as they were another unique touch. I can't wait to enjoy their huge patio as well!

formatted_address: 1824 Benning Rd NE, Washington, DC 20002, United States
name: Shewa Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: I love getting Ethiopian food in DC and this place 1000% satisfied my craving! I got the meat and veggie combo to share with my parents and fiancé and they even provided gluten-free injera. Everything was excellent. Definitely found my new go to spot.

My friends who live nearby rave about this place. Maintaining a top rating on Yelp and Google, I had to go. A friend and I showed up around 1:30pm on a Friday for lunch. The owner greeted us and quickly took our orders.

The Deluxe Meat Combo generously fed two men. Every dish on the injera was tasty, but our favorites were the Shewa Doro Tibs, Shewa Alicha Wot, Shewa Doro Wot, and Shewa Bozena Shiro. The portions are generous that we had to ask for more injera.

The space is no-frills, but comes with a few small tables. Street parking is nearby.

A friend recommended this Ethiopian spot and the food was incredible. The owner came out to greet us and gave a great recommendation for which dishes to order. The sambusa and the short ribs were delicious. 100% would come back to try more of the menu!
I had the meat and veggie combo and it was delicious.  The lamb tibs and awaze tibs were flavorful. Service was great. I recommend this restaurant and it was worth my 45 minutes trip.

I can’t say enough good things about this little gem! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and genuine hospitality. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting — perfect for a relaxed meal with friends or a quiet dinner for two.

formatted_address: 1920 9th St NW, Washington, DC 20001, United States
name: Asefu's Palace - Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text:
Popped in here after being disappointed by the African food place next door. Service was excellent and food was great!
Will definitely be back. The place was also nice.

Asefu’s Palace is nothing short of DIVINE!!!

The atmosphere is flush with iridescent floral accents and purple and gold seating that is regal in every word.

Mrs. Hannah is truly gifted in the kitchen and blessed with commodious hospitality. I had the opportunity to indulge in the Goden (Marinated short ribs sautéed with onions and jalapeños served with injera) and I must say that there was not one bite that I did not like!!!

The short ribs were tender, juicy, and seasoned to perfection. Likewise, the flavor of the injera was balanced; not too tangy and the texture was soft to the touch and palate.

If you are every in DC, I implore you to visit this oasis of flavor and flare.
The food was great and the service was amazing. Come eat here!
The food was so fabulous and the service was top notch. Highly recommend this to anyone for an amazing experience!
the food was absolutely incredible. best ethiopian food i’ve ever had. service was fantastic as well and atmosphere very very beautiful. cannot recommend enough!!!!!!!!

formatted_address: 1195 20th St NW, Washington, DC 20036, United States
name: Gursha Ethiopian cuisine

reviews.text: I was in DC with a group searching for a place to eat at night, and decided to give this place a try.  Never tried an Ethiopian restaurant prior, and I’m glad I did.  Upon entering we were warmly greeted by staff and got seating.  They gave us plenty of time to order.  The food took a little while to come out, that’s my only complaint.  The food itself was amazing and I hope I can stop by again in the future.  I strongly recommend giving this place a try, will not disappoint!

The best food so far in dc.. The decor is very nice and comfortable. Nice vibe in the place. The service was great, the staff was all so kind, let us taste some wine before purchasing and gave us a complimentary appetizer. The food was all delicious. The folks I went with had never had Ethiopian food before, and they enjoyed their experience and felt 100
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Delicious food, warm atmosphere, and amazing service! Everything in point.can’t t get over of the beautiful ambiance in every corner ,even the restrooms are so clean . The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the experience even better. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic Ethiopian cuisine in DC area!

This was my first time eating Ethiopian Cuisine. And to be honest I absolutely loved it. Secrecitly the best food I have ever had, but don't tell my mother that!!! Deffently would recommend going here. Good service and very quick.

I went into this restaurant out of pure luck as I was studying in the local MLK library and let me just say the food was top notch! I got the quanta firfir and the single sambusa. The sambusa comes with a delicious savory and mild sauce that is vegan (🔥🔥🔥🔥). The quanta firfir had great portions for two so I had to ask for a box! The meet is chewy and savory as it should be and they had a great portion of meat (quanta) and firfir. I got a chance to speak with the Owner Endale and definitely impressed by everything his family was able to build here. Will be coming back every time I am in the DC area! Oh and the food was soo good I got the combination special for my family to take home.
Loved it! My favorite was the beef. The staff is  super friendly and helpful. The place is also super cute and relaxing

name: Deset Ethiopian Restaurant

We had Chicken Awazi and fish Gulash with rice and salad. Both were very delicious. I would love to come back here try other dishes. The service was very nice and staff were very friendly.

I was waking down the street from my AirBnB actually looking for Chinese food. I stopped a young couple and they actually said none in the area but pointed out Deset which I had passed a few times.

Wonderful Chicken Tiba dish and salad.. I was in the back by the stand where they poured on the incense which I Love but many people may not enjoy the heavy smoke from the burning. I had no issue. Would definitely come back on my next trip!

I came last night and was blown away by the food and experience.
I tried the fish asa gulash. And it was the best I had in the d.m.v. and the customer service was the best 💚💛❤️ also this is a great spacious place to have parties and to invite family
Delicious food and excellent service in a laid back atmosphere. I want to come back on the weekend when there is live music and buna ceremony.

formatted_address: 2420 18th St NW, Washington, DC 20009, United States
name: Elfegne

reviews.text: Sorry to say, this place disappointed on all fronts. The service was slow, the decor was hit-or-miss, and the food was not up to the high standard for Ethiopian in DC.

I eat here every 2 weeks or so, I love their Beef and Lamb Tibs and sides. Always get carry out so can’t comment on eating in the restaurant. It’s delicious and always tastes fresh. Highly recommend the Lega tibs over the Derek tibs. Taking off one star because the meat does tend to be SUPER oily compared to some other places. I love the flavor so I keep coming back, I just wish it were slightly less oily.
So good!! Tonight was my first time trying Ethiopian and it was delish. My server Hermela was so sweet. I’d definitely recommend coming here and can’t wait to come back soon!!

I absolutely loved my experience here! The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. you can really tell they put care into every dish. The atmosphere was cozy and the staff were so friendly and attentive. Everything from the service to the presentation was top-notch. Definitely a place I’d come back to again! Highly recommend if you’re looking for great food and good vibes. 💛

Warm, welcoming space with friendly service. It’s not fast food but our scrumptious sampler platter of 4 meat and 4 veg dishes was worth the wait. My usual benchmark for Ethiopian food is misir wat (spiced red lentils), and here it’s as good as anywhere, substantial and full of subtle flavors. The shiro (chickpea puree), gomen (collard greens), and tikel gomen (carrots, cabbage and potatoes) were also delicious. Next time I’ll need to make room for kaye sir (cold beet salad). And there will absolutely be a next time.

formatted_address: 5700 Columbia Pike A, Falls Church, VA 22041, United States
name: Meaza Restaurant

reviews.text: My family and I had this restaurant cater my graduation party, and I truly can’t say enough good things about them. From the incredible food to the exceptional service, everything exceeded my expectations. Throughout the event, they were attentive and proactive, making sure the food stations stayed full and replacing items promptly as needed. The staff was polite, communicative, and always willing to help in any way possible. Their professionalism took so much stress off both me and my family, allowing us to fully relax and enjoy the celebration. At the end of the night, they handled all cleanup, washed and packed everything, and left the venue kitchen spotless. I’m beyond grateful for their outstanding service and would highly recommend them to anyone planning an event.

I continually find myself returning to Meaza for the absolute best whole fish in the region. Each time, I'm greeted by a dish that’s perfectly cooked, showcasing the freshness of the ingredients. And the salad—oh my goodness! It's a delightful medley of simple yet vibrant flavors; fresh greens that are crisp and light, combined with just the right dressing to elevate the entire experience. The service is consistently excellent, and the atmosphere is warm and inviting, making every visit a pleasure.

This is my go-to Ethiopian spot for everywhere north of Richmond. I get the vegetarian special combo for takeout everytime & the food always tastes so fresh. The owners are super friendly, relaxed folks, always giving honest recommendations. I’ve never taken the time to dine in but maybe one day I will. Also the price-food ratio is very good, I spend Like $20 after tax to get a box filled to the brim with food that lasts me 2-3 meals. I also got a good cookbook from the grocer side of this place. 10/10 would & have already recommended to a friend

"Meaza Restaurant is hands down the best Ethiopian dining experience in Virginia! From the moment you step in, you're greeted with exceptional customer service and a spotlessly clean environment. The historic pictures of Ethiopian kings add a charming touch to the already inviting ambiance. The food is absolutely delicious, authentically prepared, and served with care. Whether you're a seasoned Ethiopian cuisine aficionado or trying it for the first time, Meaza Restaurant will exceed your expectations. Highly recommend!"

Food is excellent, service is good, gets very slow towards the end of the meal which is totally opposite of what you would expect. I’ve dined at Meaza’s for several years, on July 4, 2025, they now add gratuity and this was just for a party of two, my son and I.

formatted_address: 6040 Baltimore Ave, Hyattsville, MD 20781, United States
name: Shagga Coffee & Restaurant

reviews.text: This was the first Ethiopian restaurant I tried after coming to the U.S. years ago, just days after I arrived. I still come back every now and then because it brings back memories of my early days and feels very nostalgic. The atmosphere is different from most Ethio-Eritrean spots, with a crowd that’s usually not primarily Habesha. The food flavor and portions aren’t standout, especially compared to the many options in the DMV area, but I still stop by because of the sentimental value it holds for me.

Absolutely loved my experience at Shagga Ethiopian Cuisine! From the moment I walked in, the customer service was warm and welcoming…truly some of the friendliest staff around. And the food? Even better! Every dish was packed with authentic, delicious flavors that kept me coming back for more.

As someone visiting from Bowie, I can confidently say this place is worth the trip. I’ll definitely be returning soon. I highly recommend giving Shagga a try if you’re craving amazing Ethiopian food in a great atmosphere!

Food was ok, small portion, they give you LOTS of injera bread, which requires the palate some getting used to.  Atmosobere was a bit annoying because there was this family w/ kids running all over the restaurant and family did nothing to bring the situation under control. Service was GOOS because I told them I didn’t have a lot of time (I had a flight to catch) and she brought my food quickly. Their Samoas were good.

Came here unintentionally. When we first saw the restaurant, we were hesitant as the place did not look the best. So glad we tried it. The food was fabulous! Everything was so good. Definitely will be back again soon!

If you haven’t tried Ethiopian food yet, Shagga Coffee & Restaurant is the perfect place to start. This spot combines delicious flavors with excellent service, all at a very reasonable price. Every dish here feels like it was made with love—think of the comforting taste of a meal crafted by grandma herself.

For our entrée, we went with a combo that included three meats and four vegetable sides, giving us a great variety of flavors and textures. Every bite was outstanding, and trust me when I say there won’t be anything left on your plate!

If you’re looking to experience authentic Ethiopian cuisine, add Shagga Coffee & Restaurant to your list. You honestly can’t go wrong with any choice on the menu.

formatted_address: 6204 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC 20011, United States
name: Maleda Ethiopian Cafe

reviews.text: Friendly people and delicious food. This was our first meal during our short DC weekend and I’m so glad it was. We had the veggie combo + tibs and it filled 4 of us. Highly recommend!

This has become my go to place for delicious Ethiopian food and a premium coffee. The owners are kind, wonderful and welcoming. Breakfast kince and the vegetables combo is to so delicious we kept coming back for more. Even my 8 year old picky eater devour the food.I highly recommend this place. It is a great addition to the block.

A wonderful, authentic Ethiopian restaurant/cafe with great service. I had the vegetarian platter and it was delicious. I was very touched because I accidentally left a small thing on the table and the owner had a customer rush after me to return it (I had already crossed the street and was halfway down the block). I’ll definitely eat here again and recommend it to anyone who likes delicious Ethiopian food.
Excellent local Ethiopian spot. Great coffee. Owner is super friendly - and was sweet with our toddler. Full bar too!
Amazing atmosphere everyone was so nice and the food was amazing will definitely be recommending to friends and family

formatted_address: 4913 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC 20011, United States
name: Melkamu Abegaz

reviews.text:
Super good Ethiopian food at an affordable price, we were greeted as we entered and sat down at a table.   The owner spoke great English and asked if we wanted beef or lamb (for our protein).   We asked for the beef and they started to prepare our food.   We helped ourselves to some drinks from the cooler.   About 15min later our food was ready and was served family style.  The beef was spread out in between the vegetable dishes including hummus, lentils, chickpeas, salad, cabbage, and a few other things we didn’t recognize.   We were so hungry and the food looks so delicious. We forgot to take time to take a picture, but I would give the food five out of five stars as well.

The total bill with drinks and for four people came out to be $48 which seem very affordable to me.

I would not recommend this place for a romantic date but if you’re looking for high-quality affordable Ethiopian food, this is a place to be.

Next time we’re in DC we will return here for sure

Oh, and it was also served traditional style with no silverware, you use your hands to break off the bread and eat each of the items

Gem of Washington DC when it comes speciality Ethiopian food!  This is like the Lions den if you love high quality meat!

It's family owned joint that makes everyone feel like family.

If you are a vegetarian that needs rehabilitation and reintroduction to society ... This is where you should taste your first meat dish.
Small amazing mom and pop restaurant and   ethiopian grocery store.
The raw meat (Kurt siga) is amazing! It is very fresh melt in your mouth. I buy here all the time.

Excellent Ethiopian Restaurant.
Serving delicious fried meat , drinks and great customer handling.

Keep the good work Abegaz!!!!!

formatted_address: 8201 Georgia Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Beteseb Restaurant

reviews.text:
Beteseb Restaurant truly makes you feel like home! The waitresses are warm, attentive, and always smiling, and the kitchen staff does an amazing job — every dish is full of authentic flavor and cooked with love. The manager is one of the friendliest people you’ll meet; he goes out of his way to make sure every guest is happy and satisfied. He even helps you try different dishes and explains them in detail.

If you’re looking for delicious food, great hospitality, and a cozy family atmosphere, Beteseb is the perfect place. Highly recommended!

Wonderful veggie combo! Very flavorful and enough for two people to share. Injera was fluffy and a perfect compliment to the food. Restaurant was bright and clean. Ate there on a Thursday at 5:15. In and out in 45 minutes!

Service:
No reservation needed when we arrived, and we were seated and attended to right away. The staff was friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. As the evening went on, it started to get more crowded around 7 PM, so if you’re coming during peak dinner time, a reservation might be a good idea.

Taste:
We were in the mood for Ethiopian food and decided to check out Beteseb based on the great reviews—and it didn’t disappoint! We ordered a platter with extra tibs, and it was more than enough for the three of us. Every bite was flavorful, fresh, and perfectly seasoned. You can really tell the food is made with care.

Ambiance:
The space is cozy and welcoming, and we loved the creative presentation of the dishes—it added a fun and modern twist to traditional Ethiopian fare. It’s a great spot for both casual meals and special gatherings.

Recommendation:
Beteseb is definitely a gem. If you’re looking for delicious Ethiopian food in a comfortable setting with great service, this is the place. We’ll definitely be back!

The food here was decent but nothing so exceptional that it would merit a swift return. I had the veggie combo with the doro wot, beef tibs, and the beef kifto. Nothing stood out in particular, nothing really popped and stayed with me, but it definitely wasn't bad either. Service was solid and place was clean and well layed out.

Some of the most delicious food I’ve ever had. This is my first time eating Ethiopian food and I can’t recommend it enough! The flavors are amazing and I loved getting the beef and veggie combo so that I could try a little bit of everything! The servers were very nice and welcoming as well. Definitely give this place a try!

formatted_address: 1907 Seminary Rd, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Meleket Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Wish there were pictures of the dishes so it was easier to order.
We went for lunch on a Thursday, and there was no parking available. A huge problem.
We ordered the three meat and three vegetable platter and it was enough for two people.
The grilled chicken and beef were amazing. It was served with jalapenos and grilled onions.
The sauce on the lamb dish was delicious, but I didn't care for the rolled up bread underneath the sauce.
The cabbage was amazing. Would definitely order again. The chickpea option was not good, and lentil option was mid.
Service and food was very slow.
I wish they served the food with utensils as well. I prefer to not eat with my hands, even though I know that's part of the cultural experience.

Dang I was recommended this place by an Ethiopian I met out and said it was the best in the area. I named some spots and she was like yup way better. I was super excited to come and eat this food. When I got here I sat at the bar and no one said anything to me for 10-15 minutes. The food came out late and was not hot enough and the flavor was great but very dull like it wasn’t seasoned enough. I know other Ethiopian places will make an American version with less seasonings., not saying they did but it ok at best. I was super disappointed with the whole experience. They didn’t even refill my water at all and asked me how it was and then ignored me for 10 minutes. Not sure I’ll be coming back but we’ll see.

We just ordered delivery from this restaurant for the first time, and we are so glad to have found a solid local Ethiopian place.  The portions were generous.  The injera was light and plushy, and the stews really hit the spot.  Much of the baklava around DC is so similar that I think it must be made somewhere centralized and distributed.  If I'm not mistaken, this baklava tasted like it must have been made in house.  I got the veggie platter and my husband got the meat and veggie platter, and he was very impressed as well.  Let me tell you, if you're interested in eating more vegetarian food but want something filling and hearty, I give Ethiopian food a shot.  And for you local Silver Springers, this is a great place to try it.
We love this Ethiopian restaurant! The food is wonderful. My college aged son always requests a meal from here when he is home. We dine in and take out. Highly recommend!!

Having grown up with the rich flavors of Ethiopian traditional food, I can confidently say that Meleket Restaurant is one of the best places in the DMV area to experience and truly savour the authentic taste of Ethiopia. The dishes are prepared with care, bringing out the depth of flavours and cultural heritage that make Ethiopian cuisine so unique. Beyond the food, the warm and welcoming hospitality made the experience even more memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who wishes to enjoy genuine Ethiopian traditional dishes and a heartfelt atmosphere. Thank you, Meleket, for such an outstanding experience. Feleke M,

formatted_address: 5320 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC 20011, United States
name: Gueny’s Cafe & Market

reviews.text: Visited for breakfast after seeing the great reviews. Had a wonderful coffee experience where the owner lit incense and brought out coffee and popcorn. Ordered 4 traditional breakfasts which was great for our group of 5. Also ordered two fruit smoothies which were super fresh and large, great meal overall. Everything was delicious and made fresh by the owner who was incredibly kind. Very affordable and large portions. Definitely recommend this restaurant and look forward to coming back.

Absolutely amazing experience of having the authentic Ethiopian food in DC. Owner Guenette is the most welcoming and pleasant host. Food is top grade. We got tibs combos(veggies and beef) which was amazing. It was so nice to wrap things up with a cake and an Ethiopian coffee pot that comes with incense. A very relaxing culinary experience. We will come back in a heart beat.
Best service and the owner made us feel like we are having a homemade breakfast. Definitely worth trying this local business your support

★★★★★★ We were in town visiting and are super happy we found Gueny’s. I’m a big fan of Ethiopian food and this was some of the best that I have had. The owner was also super kind and you could tell she puts care into her cafe and her food. The experience was wonderful and if I make my way back to the area I am 100% gonna visit her again.

If you go there for breakfast, I really liked the “Traditional Breakfast” shown in the photo.

Such a delicious meal we just had! We. Hose the tibs special and the 7 veggie combo! The coffee was a real experience. Guennette the owner is such a sweet and caring person. Strongly recommend. Such an intimate place.

formatted_address: 4921 Bethesda Ave, Bethesda, MD 20814, United States
name: CherCher Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: I had a delicious meal at CherCher! Super hearty and flavorful. I’d definitely recommend stopping in if you’re looking for a nice warm meal. Their ginger tea paired so nicely with the sampler plate.

The food is AMAZING. If you eat meat. I ordered a chicken dish—the meat was so tender. The spice is more than just heat—it’s pure flavor. I ordered the chicken dish with a boiled egg, and the curry has just an unbelievable aroma to it. Love the texture of the injera (the spongy bread). The reason I rated it four is because I did feel like the vegan options fell a little short. There was ten sides offered in the vegan platter, but I felt that they were significantly less flavorful than the chicken dish. Overall, would 100% recommend if you’re looking to eat meat.

Had such a great meal at Chercher Restaurant! The food was fresh, flavorful, and authentic, every bite was amazing. The staff were super friendly and made the experience even better. Definitely one of the best spots in town for Ethiopian food. Can’t wait to go back!

My family and I come here on a regular basis and the food never disappoints, we absolutely love this place! The vegan options are amazing, we always get the vegan delight delux, and the meat options are also great (my boyfriend loves them).

I came with my family of three early for dinner, at around 4pm. It was not busy at that time. We had beef tibs, chicken tibs, and another dish. The food came quickly and was presented beautifully. It was delicious, and we also enjoyed the tray of sauces to use. Our server was very friendly and told us a bit of Ethiopian history. The dining room is nicely decorated and the lighting is pleasant. We were delighted with our experience at Chercher.

formatted_address: 7849 Eastern Ave NW, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Enebla Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: We used to stop by here occasionally with friends, especially for their combo meals. However, the place is now under new ownership. When I visited recently, I ordered the special kitfo. While the portion was generous, the flavor was disappointing, and some items like the minced collard greens and cheese didn’t taste fresh. On the bright side, the customer service was excellent, and the server was very polite.

The restaurant catered our wedding, and the food was absolutely fantastic. Our guests told about the delicious flavors and presentation. Thank you for making our special day even more memorable thanks  enbela.highly recommended to events!

We decided to try Enebla for the first time and were not disappointed.  We ordered tibs and  veggie combo for takeout.  It was delicious,  and a lot of food for the price.  We'll definitely add it to our rotation of Ethiopian restaurants.
Update: We went back for lunch and were not disappointed.

To be honest, the food is pretty good. But…

1. Service is non-existing. My baby dropped some juice on the floor and I can’t get anyone , so I had to go to the bathroom and get toilet papers and clean it up myself.

2. I told the waiter that I don’t eat spicy food and the food was so spicy I can’t eat it.

3. Food was decent though, I might go there again for the food and put up with the non-existing service.

I have to say, I enjoyed every single bite of the dry tibs in enebla Ethiopian restaurant.I had dry tibs with the side of collard greens,with mitmita powder Considering the quality, the price is reasonable. Ideal for those who want ethiopian flavored tibs.

formatted_address: 5037 Columbia Pike, Arlington, VA 22204, United States
name: Meda Coffee & Kitchen

reviews.text: Delicious food with generous portions and friendly service! The veggie combo had such a tasty variety of classic dishes and the kitfo was perfect! They serve Ethiopian beers as well which pairs nicely.
The best in DMV! The awaze tibs and shekla tibs are great together with the combination platter. It’s amazing they can cook beef in many delicious ways!

Very delicious food — the best Ethiopian we've had in the DMV so far. We had the vegetarian combo and the awaze tibs with injera. There was so much food. We also did a coffee ceremony which was delicious.

Food does take a while to come out of the kitchen, but it's well worth the wait.
Ordered the ethiopian vegetable platter, and the awaze tibs. It was the best ethiopian food we ever had! We enjoyed the coffee ceremony afterwards.

I had the best experience at Meda Coffee & Kitchen. From the moment I walked in, the vibe was warm and welcoming, the service was attentive without being pushy, and everything came out fresh and fast. The star of the show for me was the Meda Special Tibs—perfectly seasoned, hearty, and absolutely delicious. The one drink you have to try is the Tekesheno drink; it’s honestly the most delicious alcoholic drink I’ve ever had—smooth, balanced, and so memorable.

formatted_address: 1125 Queen St, Alexandria, VA 22314, United States
name: Hawwi Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: Local hole in the wall place run by seemingly husband and wife. Amazing food - where else can you get to try 9 dishes for under $20. Highly recommend vegan sampler. It’s two meals worth of food and everything has its own flavor profile and is delish. Quick service and yummy food. Not a fancy sit down restaurant, but a great place for a person just interested in good food and supporting local business.

The woman who provided service to me was very warm, polite and accommodating. I recommend others get the spicy tea along with your meal, as that is very nice. I ordered Combo 2, which comes with Doro watt (chicken stew) and key watt (beef stew) and two of their many vegan options. I chose yellow split peas and collared greens. The food was really good and I enjoyef it and the atmosphere a lot. My only slight issues is that I felt the beef in the key watt could have been stewed longer to make it more tender and allow the spices to penetrate into the meat a little more, and in my opinion the collared greens could have been slightly saltier. For dessert, I had their rice pudding and it was quite nice and subtle.

My friend and I popped in here after seeing in walking around. The food was amazing and the service was too. Cannot express how much we liked this place. They were also very accommodating with food allergies/preferences. Several option were gluten free and/or vegetarian. Potions were huge. I literally got 4 meals out of mine.

Just tried and love this place - food came out INCREDIBLY fast and was delicious. I enjoyed the Awaze Tibs!

SPICE LEVEL- If you can’t handle spice they have a ‘no spicy’ option too. I personally love spicy food and got the spice option, but it was not hot at all (although I probably could’ve asked for them to make it spicier).

Overall good atmosphere and seems like a great family owned atmosphere. They contribute and take part in sponsoring the Global Ethiopian Diaspora For Prosperity and Diversity (GEDPD) which is awesome, and were recognize as a Top 3 Ethiopian restaurant by BusinessRate in 2025!

This place was great their food, service and atmosphere was very relaxing.  We tried their vegetarian and vegan plates and were impressed by the flavors.  We are not vegan or vegetarian however we try to give each food a try and mix it up often.  The baklava and their coffee excellent choices for dessert.  Overall a nice experience and a delight to the senses.  This type of food is delicious and simple looking but packed with all the nutrients you need. We highly recommend this location for the whole family.

formatted_address: 7833 Eastern Ave NW, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Rohobot Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: We’ always ordere carry-out from Rohbot Ethiopian Restaurant several times now, and it’s always a fantastic experience. The food is fresh, flavorful, and perfectly packaged for takeout. My wife absolutely loves it  the veggie combo Doro awaze Tibd is her favorite, and I’m a big fan of the lamb tibs. You can tell everything is made with care and authenticity. Easily one of our go-to spots in Silver Spring. Highly recommended!

Came to pick up food, no one was at the counter for a long time, the man didn’t greet any of the delivery drivers. We all asked when the orders would be ready and he said “I can’t tell you” which makes no logical sense. You need better customer service. You had drivers waiting for over 20 minutes with no communication.

This was my first time trying Ethiopian cuisine, and after eating this dish, I am hooked. I can't wait to come back and try the other items on the menu, and the staff was incredibly friendly. Highly recommend
I came because two people recommended this place and it did not disappoint! The food was so delicious and the restaurant owner was so kind. I’ll definitely be back many more times.
Incredible Ethiopian platter so vibrant and full of flavor! Everything was perfectly spiced and beautifully presented. A must visit spot for authentic Ethiopian cuisine!

formatted_address: 952 Sligo Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Nazrawi Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: I had my birthday dinner here for 15 people and it was absolutely fantastic. I called them a few days before to confirm a time and number of people and when we arrived, the table was beautifully decorated and ready for us. The food itself was so delicious and we all left stuffed! We split three vegetarian platters and three types of meat - they were very accommodating for our vegetarian friends too. The servers were so kind and made our whole group feel special and loved and even played brought out a birthday treat for me. This was such a memorable birthday dinner and much love to the Nazrawi folks for making it a great one!

This is a cute little place right in downtown silver spring. I decided to try this one because of other reviews. I went around noon with a friend. We ordered the vegetable platter to share as  well as the spicy beef. Everything was absolutely delicious! The service was pretty good. The only word of caution I would have is to pack your own food if you're taking it away. The way the lady threw the food in the container was pretty gross. Other than that there is a bar and lots of seating available?

Get the tofu tibs. The server recommended it over tofu firfir and she was right. So good. The tofu was crispy and covered in tibs sauce. We also ordered special kitfo (cooked medium) and the veggie platter (2 types of lentils, peas, cabbage and collards). My husband, son and I all agreed that the tofu ribs won best dish.

I found this restaurant after doing a Google search because I wanted authentic Ethiopian cuisine. The 5 star reviews were the truth! From the time I walked in for late lunch, the host and I believe manager, welcomed me to their restaurant. I had an appetizer and a main dish (vegetarian), all of which was absolutely delicious. This was more than enough for one sitting so I have dinner or lunch tomorrow and priced nice.  Shout out to the entire ladies in the kitchen,  at the bar and serving...

By a far landslide, this is the best Ethiopian food in the area. Whether you’re vegan, gluten free, carnivore, etc, all the options are top tier. My favorites include the Asa goulash (fried fish in stew), beef tibs and special kitfo. I also recommend the veggie platter and veggie sambusas. If you’re into unique alcohol, try out their Ethiopian beers. The staff are kind, knowledgeable and so accommodating. Perfect place for dates, family dinners, birthdays, or just a chill vibe.

formatted_address: 4811 Columbia Pike, Arlington, VA 22204, United States
name: AT Ethiopian Market & Restaurant

reviews.text: A new restaurant in town at Columbia Pike. Offers veggie combo and meat. Spicy chicken stew and kifo are also served to lead you truly Ethiopian taste!!!
Come visit you will be get the best food and drink with. nice friendly service .

Ordered the Goden tibs and it was definiteñy not goden meat. It was neither grilled or roasted as the choice they suggested, just boiled and it is the toughest meat I've ever seen in my life. It was so inedible I had to throw it all out. Don't waste your money, there are plenty of other places that offer edible decent food. I just wanted to try this place and never again!
Top-notch delicious food at this hole in the wall Ethiopian spot. Great, friendly service. Not expensive at all. I always take friends who visit me and everyone is always blown away.
Excellent food taste and quality

formatted_address: 5709 Center Ln, Falls Church, VA 22041, United States
name: Birndo Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text: I had never been to Birndo before, even though I’d always wanted to try it since it’s known as a popular Ethiopian restaurant in the DMV area. Unfortunately, my first visit a few weeks ago with friends was disappointing. The service felt unprofessional, with servers not even once checking on us after the food was served and taking a long time to bring the bill once we were finished. As for the food, the tibs were overly oily, and the kikil had very few pieces of meat, which made the overall experience even more underwhelming.

Amazing food and great service! The place has a warm, welcoming atmosphere, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Prices are fair for the quality, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. Definitely coming back soon! ➡️ Alulla- really appreciate your service also thank you for looking out for us.

Hands down, this is the best Tere Siga in town! While it’s on the pricier side and you definitely need to order ahead, the quality makes it worth it. The service is top-notch with a very well-trained staff. Also, a huge plus: I finally found an Ethiopian restaurant with a truly clean bathroom!

I had a wonderful experience at Brindo Restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious — full of rich flavors and made with fresh ingredients. The service was friendly and attentive from the moment we walked in. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. I highly recommend Brindo to anyone looking for a great dining experience. Can’t wait to come back!

As a pescetatian I wanted to try the Ethiopian Restaurant that was recommended most and as the best in town during my visit. I learned that they only serve yhe veggie platter on certain days of the week, which seems like a strange practice. However, my server was accommodating enough when she was available during their busy dinner period.

formatted_address: 1934 9th St NW, Washington, DC 20001, United States
name: Axum Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
The food and service was excellent. The server helped us out with ordering our food so we didn't over order. Her suggestions were spot on. At the end of the meal, coffee was freshly roasted and served piping hot
It was a wonderful treat after indulging in such delicious food.

It’s rare to find the quality Ethiopian food in DC, but finally this guys open right up on 9th street NW. Axum has been here for a very long time but through different owners. They have a new owner who has the right food, to be honest it’s that authentic Ethiopian food. Their veggie combo was top notch and flavorful with some good spices. I am not a big fan of Meat, but their Geba was one of the tenderloins that so soft beef. When I say that you should give it a try and blame me if it isn’t worth trying.

We wanted to experience authentic Ethiopian cuisine. This restaurant did not disappoint! We were welcomed with open arms and the gentleman was very nice and helpful in helping us decide what to order.

We tried the axum special which was steak (well done) and the fish dish. They served both our meals on the same plate which was a nice experience to share and eat together. Of course this was full experience, eating with our hands. Nice!!

We will definitely visit again!

Excellent injera, we had meat cubes and vegetables on top of it and it was fantastic. Ethiopians were here which made us feel as if we found the right place. Michael's service was excellent and warm. Really tasty, highly recommend.

10/10!!

Amazing food, service, and great prices for DC! Idk what time their kitchen closes, but I walked in at 11pm on a Thursday and they were happy to serve me. They were super attentive and gave me everything I asked for. I will definitely be back!

formatted_address: 8113 A Fenton St, Silver Spring, MD 20910, United States
name: Zene's Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text:
I had one of the best dining experiences ever at Zene’s Restaurant & Bar! The customer service was absolutely amazing — the owner is incredibly welcoming, cheerful, and always smiling. She personally came over to ask how my food was and did the same for other customers, making sure everyone was enjoying their time.

The food itself was outstanding — full of flavor, beautifully presented, and the portions are huge (definitely the biggest I’ve seen in Maryland!). The restaurant is clean, including the restroom, and the atmosphere feels warm and inviting.

If you’re anywhere near Silver Spring or Maryland in general, you definitely need to check this place out. I’m very satisfied and will 100% be coming back!

Incredible experience! The food was delicious and authentic. The service was beyond. The atmosphere was relaxing, clean and the price was just right!! We will be back
Update: Went back two weeks later—total game-changer! Met the owner Zene who was super friendly, and our server Selam was Amazing.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Amazing Experience at Zane’s!

Zane’s is a truly beautiful Ethiopian restaurant — the moment you walk in, you can feel the warmth and culture in the air. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with vibrant decor that makes you feel right at home. The food is full of authentic flavor, fresh, and beautifully presented — every bite feels made with love.

What really stands out, though, is the people. The workers are incredibly kind, attentive, and always smiling. The owner is especially welcoming and makes you feel like family from the moment you arrive. It’s rare to find a place with such genuine hospitality and heart.

If you’re looking for delicious Ethiopian food and a wonderful dining experience, Zane’s is the place to go!

I ordered godine tips and qiqile I’m not sure I spelled it right or not. food is very testy really good I’m kinda give it 3 stars for godin tips no side 26$$ and qiqile have to much fat on it.that’s kinda a lot comparing to other Ethiopian restaurants near by and 18% suggestions for tip I’m kinda order on phone and take it home.it’s kinda high personal opinion!!

Zenes Restaurant in Silver Spring is an absolute gem. Every dish we ordered tasted incredibly fresh, full of flavor, and clearly made with care. The shiro especially was outstanding: rich, perfectly seasoned, and comforting in that way only really good home cooking can be. You can taste the quality in every bite.

I have been coming to Zenes for years, and it has become one of those rare places I always look forward to returning to. The consistency of the food, the warmth of the welcome, and the feeling of being genuinely cared for keep bringing me back again and again. It is the kind of restaurant you recommend to friends without hesitation, knowing they will be in good hands.

What truly makes this place special, though, is Zene herself. From the moment you walk in, she greets you with such warmth that you immediately feel like you are visiting family, not just dining at a restaurant. She takes the time to check on you, explain dishes if you are unfamiliar, and make sure you are happy and well fed. There is a kindness and generosity in the way she hosts that you simply do not find in many places anymore. By the time you leave, you do not just remember how good the food was, you remember how good she made you feel. Zenes is not only an incredible spot for Ethiopian food, it is a place that truly feels like home.

formatted_address: 516A S Van Dorn St, Alexandria, VA 22304, United States
name: Makeda Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
my experience at Makeda Ethiopian restaurant in Alexandria was genuinely disappointing from start to finish.

Atmosphere & Service:
The moment we walked in, the energy felt unwelcoming. No smiles, no “welcome,” no friendliness just a blunt “how many people?” before being sat. People were staring, the atmosphere felt rude, and there was no warmth at all. Our server had earbuds in and looked like she couldn’t care less about us being there. The attitudes overall were terrible and made the whole environment uncomfortable.

Food:
I ordered the Doro Wot expecting a proper portion for the $20 price, especially since the menu mentioned $20–$30 dishes. What I got was disappointing: one very small chicken leg and one boiled egg that’s it. For that price, it’s absolutely not worth it.
We also ordered the mixed vegetables with injera, which was the one decent part of the meal. The food overall was fine typical and a bit greasy, which I know is normal for the cuisine. but nothing that made up for the poor service and atmosphere.

Pricing & Charges:
This is where things got even worse. Our food total was $47, but when the bill came, it shot up to $62 because they added an $8 “service fee” on top of tax. Who charges a random service fee without telling customers? Tips are one thing, but adding a fee like that with no explanation is ridiculous. I’ll be attaching the receipt when I post this because people need to see it.

Final Thoughts:
The atmosphere was uncomfortable, the staff was unfriendly, the service was careless, and the pricing was misleading. The food alone wasn’t good enough to justify any of it. Between being stared at, ignored, upcharged, and served tiny portions, I would not recommend this place to anyone. By the way if it means anything my mother and I went and we are Eritrean Muslims. Not sure if they treated us differently cause of that or not. But I’ve not had a problem like this at any other place. I usually go to Nazret Ethiopian restaurant in falls church Virginia near skyline towers. But I was far at the time and I wanted to try this place out.

5 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Rozina went above and beyond with her service — so kind, attentive, and welcoming. The vegan and vegetarian options were some of the best I’ve ever had, full of flavor and creativity. And the fish dulet? Absolutely top-notch — fresh, perfectly spiced, and unforgettable. Highly recommend this spot for anyone who appreciates great service and delicious food!
We mourned the loss of our neighborhood Ethiopian restaurant, so were happy to get a recommendation to try Makeda. It did not disappoint.  An excellent dinner an we will definitely be back.

We’ve been coming to this place for years, and tonight was honestly the worst experience we’ve ever had here. Our waitress was incredibly rude from the moment we sat down. If she was having a bad day, she should’ve stayed home instead of taking it out on customers.

The veggie combo was also terrible. We let her know politely, and she clearly didn’t care. No apology, no effort to fix it just attitude and zero interest in listening to us. That’s not how you treat guests, especially people who drove 40 miles to eat here.

Customer service matters. The way we were treated tonight was completely unacceptable. Management really needs to look into what happened and check who was working on the evening of 01/04/26. We’ve supported this restaurant for years, and this experience was a huge disappointment.

We had a great evening last Friday at Makeda Restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing, awesome old music selection and along with the overall vibe, made the night even better. Special thanks to the owner, Dani, who is truly wonderful. Even though it was a very busy late evening, we asked him for a cup of coffee and without hesitation he said “OK” and made it himself. It was such a pleasant surprise and the perfect cherry on top of an already great night.

I highly recommend Makeda Restaurant for its excellent service, delicious food, and great vibe especially on Friday nights. Thank you, ዳኒ! I will definitely be back.

formatted_address: 703 Kennedy St NW, Washington, DC 20011, United States
name: Mita Ethio-Japanese Cafe

reviews.text: It’s so easy to give this place 5 stars!! The service and staff running this place are the sweetest, most helpful, and accommodating ever

I hosted my birthday party at Mita Ethio-Japanese Cafe and I could not have been more pleased with the experience! As anyone can tell you the food is amazing, delicious, high-quality ingredients, and made with LOVE. What made this a great place for an event is that the mix of Ethiopian food and Japanese food was perfect for hosting many people because we were able to get a wide range of items off the menu: I got a large Sakura Platter; 4 paninis that were split into 4 bites; and the "Ingera Sushi" rolls of spicy lentils, yellow peas, and collard greens! Everyone ate to their hearts content for less than $10 per person.

What really impressed me was how we were able to use the space to make it feel like I was hosting folx in my Home. We put the tables together to make 1 long table. There were little nooks for people who wanted to have more intimate conversations. We used the market space for more seating and art activities. It was perfect! Would highly recommend you stop by or give them a call to host your next event here!

First Ethiopian restaurant I’ve tried in DC and it was so good. We went around breakfast time, so I ordered the Ful and it was so phenomenal. That with the Ethiopian tea was a great start to the day. My friend ordered the peanut infused tea (best for the cold weather) and the turkey panini (and of course the lentil sambusas were also a great experience). 10/10 would recommend

This is the most unique blend of cuisines in the city! Both the Ethiopian and Japanese dishes here are amazing. Really kind and accommodating owners too. Make sure to try the Tokyo sushi and an Ethiopian food platter if you visit for the best of both worlds. Will definitely be back.

Amazing service and delicious food!!!! Feels very homey and welcoming. I got the veggie injera platter and Tokyo Papa sushi combo with extra ginger and shared with my friend. We also had the Ethiopian tea and it was lovely. 🇯🇵🇪🇹🤍 The Mita Market also has a large selection of items.

formatted_address: 7815 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC 20012, United States
name: Nile Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
We went to Nile Ethiopian Restaurant for the first time, and it was also our first time trying Ethiopian food. The experience was fantastic! The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, perfectly spiced, and served in a way that made the whole meal feel unique and authentic.
We actually walked about 1.5 miles (around 30 minutes) to get there, and it was totally worth it. The injera was fresh and paired beautifully with the different meats and vegetables.
The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the staff made us feel comfortable as first-time diners of Ethiopian cuisine. We would definitely come back again to enjoy more of the menu and keep exploring Ethiopian flavors.
Amazing food with a sweet host. Never had Ethiopian food before but i do feel this was super authentic. Pretty chill vibe as well

This place is so delicious! Whenever I am in the District, this is my go-to for Ethiopian. Got take out just a few days ago (combo sampler) and shared with my family and we were all full and happy. I wish I had taken pictures but we devoured every thing so fast there was no time! If you want good, authentic Ethiopian food that won't break the bank, this is your place.

During my recent visit to Nile Ethiopian Restaurant, I was greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere that instantly made me feel at home. Getu, the owner, was incredibly hospitable and passionate about sharing the rich culinary heritage of Ethiopia. His enthusiasm was evident as he guided me through the menu and provided insightful recommendations.

The highlight of my meal was the traditional Ethiopian platter, beautifully presented on a large injera, a spongy sourdough flatbread that serves as both the plate and an edible utensil. The injera was perfectly fermented, offering a delightful tang that complemented the array of vibrant and flavorful dishes arranged on top.

Among the standout dishes were the Misir Wot, a spicy lentil stew with a robust depth of flavor; the Atakilt Wat, a deliciously spiced mix of cabbage, carrots, and potatoes; and the Gomen, tender collard greens simmered to perfection. Each bite was a harmonious blend of spices and textures, showcasing the complexity and richness of Ethiopian cuisine.

Accompanying the platter was a side of perfectly fried fish, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, served with a wedge of lemon for a refreshing zing. The fresh tomato salad added a burst of freshness, balancing the rich and hearty flavors of the other dishes.

Overall, dining at Nile Ethiopian Restaurant was an exceptional experience, thanks in large part to Getu's dedication and passion.

Recommended to me by a friend of mine, I was delighted to discover this gem. I highly recommend visiting Nile to anyone looking to explore authentic Ethiopian flavors and enjoy a meal that is both satisfying and memorable.

I tried this restaurant out because I was in the area and needed to get breakfast. This service was amazing and I had a chat with the owners son who was very helpful in choosing my breakfast option. This was also my first time at an Ethiopian restaurant. Loved it and would go back again soon.

formatted_address: 5333 Georgia Ave NW, Washington, DC 20011, United States
name: Hiwot Ethiopian Restaurant & Dream Lounge

reviews.text:
Great atmosphere, great service, bring some money to get the full experience! Shisha excellent, food excellent, Owner is awesome! I get great treatment here and always leave with great memories! No drama, no trouble, safe environment, great music. I hope to return again as soon as I can! Go there this evening and Enjoy!
Tiffany Lancaster -
(1st Ethiopian To be Elected to DC Official Office)

Just left this restaurant. I ordered from a new app called wonder . I was notified that my order was received and was ready for pick only to be met with we don’t use this app . The owner I’m guessing was Sarah G responded to use with a major attitude instead of accommodating its patron who frequent this restaurant. They are listed on grub hub and this brand new app Wonder .  This situation got worst as we had to call the police to try and fix this situation because this janky spot did not want to accommodate us she even with on to say that we wanted free food . You can look at us tell we don’t need your free food we have been frequenting this spot since 2021 we will NEVER PATRON THIS RESTAURANT AGAIN .

I ordered takeout from this restaurant. I loved the vegetarian platter. One of the best I’ve had in DC and I order takeout Ethiopian food often. I wish It was in my DoorDash catchment area so I could have it delivered frequently.
A bar vibe with authentic Ethiopian food and hooka bar. Food is to die for if you’re craving for Ethiopian food  and it’s worth it. So good. 😭
Great food and friendly service and

formatted_address: 3821 S George Mason Dr, Falls Church, VA 22041, United States
name: Skyline Cafe-Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: The food here is great but the service is a complete hit or miss. I’ve been here a few times now and while I enjoy eating the food here my last visit left me feeling scammed and disappointed. I was charged 2.5x the regular price for a plate of food and had a 20% tip automatically added to my total bill. I tipped an additional $20 thinking there wasn’t a tip already included. In my past visit this wasn’t included. Avoid the lady with the tattoos on her face, she tried to take my copy of the receipt while signing.
Decided to try a new Ethiopian restaurant & this place didn’t disappoint. Tasty dishes just wish the portions were more generous bc it was so yummy.
