We came from other state to visit Dallas and was recommended to go to City Cafe. Tables were not clean, no one told us where to sit, the chechebsa was not that good. They had enough staff but not as attending as they can be. The waitresses once they came, they were sweet and helpful. The cake was not as tasteful as I hoped it was like back home.

There are many bakeries in the Dallas Metropolitan area. This bakery was next to a restaurant that we ate at for lunch so we decided to try it. The bakery was nice. There is not a lot of seating so beware if you are with a large group and/or family. The desserts looked good. I chose an Oreo cheesecake and a coffee cake. They were good but the other bakeries that I have been to are better. The Oreo cheesecake didn't taste like the traditional cheesecakes that I have been accustomed to having. They were not overly sweet and plenty moist. The coffee cake which had a mild coffee flavor melts in your mouth.

Top notch breakfast experience! Clear and concise menu with unique recipes. We ordered one of each item, which came out prompt, fresh and full of flavor. The Bakery desserts is where they excel!!  Clearly possess decades of culinary experience with everything made in house.

BEST Tiramisu I have ever had in my LIFE!

formatted_address: 6710 Virginia Pkwy STE 210, McKinney, TX 75071, United States
name: Honey-Dip Fingerz

reviews.text: I ordered a goat dish with jollof rice. The flavors were good and I really appreciate how clean they are. The kitchen looks SPOTLESS! ✨But the goat meat was so chewy and portion was tiny for the price. I’ll have to try another dish and maybe order fish or beef instead of goat.

It was my first time trying Honey-Dip Fingerz, so I needed help ordering because I didn’t fully understand the menu. I’ve had African food before and really enjoy it, but I wasn’t sure how their ordering worked. The menu said the dish came with meat, but when I ordered from a young girl at the counter, she asked if I wanted meat for an extra charge. That confused me, so I said no. She mentioned it came with fufu, which I was happy about.

I ordered it to-go and got egusi soup with fufu. I know African food can be a bit expensive, so I wasn’t surprised the total was about $35. However, the meat was very tough and inedible, so I ended up throwing it away. The egusi soup had good flavor, but overall, I’ve had a better experience ordering egusi from other African restaurants through Uber Eats.

We wanted to try Nigerian food for a very long time and we noticed a spot was nearby so we stopped by! Awesome customer service! When it comes to the food, amazing! We had Smokey Jollof Rice, Pepper chicken, and pepper goat. God willing we’ll be returning to take more of the menu! You will not me an ex customer! Thank you for bringing the taste of Nigerian cuisine! Blessings to you all and your endeavors!

We have a strong Nigerian-American presence in our church, and we wanted to highlight their culture for our congregation during World Communion Day, so I reached out to Honey-Dip Fingerz to see if they would cater lunch for us. They were extremely communicative -- following up quickly with great food recommendations. We ended up with spring rolls, puff puff, jollof rice, and chicken wings to feed 150 people, and everything arrived hot and filled the entire sanctuary with the most delicious aromas. The food was beautifully prepared and packaged for easy transport, and everyone had the most wonderful things to say about the food. I will absolutely be ordering again from them and I look forward to the next event we can cater with them in the future. Top notch all around -- service, communication, food, and overall experience. Highly recommend.

Ordered the goat, chicken gizzard, plantains, and one chicken thigh to go.

When I arrived, the door was locked—seemed like they were short-staffed that day, and a young child ended up taking my order.

Goat: Completely impossible to chew. I literally had to cook it down for another hour at home just to make it edible.
Chicken gizzard: Also very tough and rubbery with almost no flavor. I had to cook these again along with the goat.
Jollof rice: Undercooked.
Chicken thigh: Small for the price. I don’t care if it’s organic or farm-raised—still not worth it.
Plantains: Not the sweet, caramelized kind at all. These were dry and almost cardboard-like. If that’s your preference, great, but it wasn’t mine.

For the price I paid and the extra time I had to spend re-cooking most of the food, it was unacceptable.

Honestly, I’m glad we grabbed a gyro from another spot in the same plaza while waiting, because otherwise we would’ve been starving with a box of rubbery food.

formatted_address: 2985 TX-360, Grand Prairie, TX 75052, United States
name: Mama B'S International Kitchen

reviews.text:
Our first time trying African cuisine and Mamma B's did us right. I had the goat stew and rice. Love it!!!!

People were very friendly. We came in while they were doing a big order and it took some time for our food to come out, but we will go back again. Thank you!!!

I just wanted to say my babe and I went to Mama's B restaurant Nigeria omg the food was magnificent 😋 delicious you would definitely has to go try the food amazing the staffs was very friendly, polite and wonderful  ,we talked to one of the waitress and her named was Bola was so awesome and nice I truly enjoyed the atmosphere..I will definitely recommend my family and friends to this wonderful restaurant 😋...
I was told to try their okro soup... They didn't disappoint.... It was finger licking😀

Absolutely love this place. Mama B is so kind and welcoming to me and my family. They make some really yummy food and we always enjoy chatting with others while there. Is a positive happy family oriented social environment to enjoy! Food is great. My favorite is the fish with the red stew! Love it!

I came in 15 mins to closing. They still had some Jollof rice and meat pie left. The stewed chicken was really great. I has been craving Nigerian food for some weeks, being 9 months pregnant is pretty difficult trying to cook at home. My son loved talking to the grandma that was there. They are very nice and respectable people. The Jollof rice was good as well and very seasoned.

formatted_address: 4413 W Walnut St, Garland, TX 75042, United States
name: Kezira Cafe and Restaurant

reviews.text:
Really delicious Ethiopian food! (We’ve tried many places in DFW and this was by far the tastiest)
The vegetarian combo had 11 different offerings - each unique and savory and complex.
The atmosphere was a bit more karaoke bar than restaurant but who cares when the food is this good.
Got a togo order, amazing lamb. I wouldn't advise dinning in unless your a regular, but I will definitely go again delicious and spicy. First time order

Best customer service i’ve had in all my 3 years of being in dallas and even tho i showed up after their kitchen had closed for the night i sat down for a beer to get a feel for the place an i was not disappointed. the employees were nothing but smiles and the manager was very polite and induced himself with every bit of genuine kindness. half way through my beer i was approached by a staff member with a tray of what looked like spanakopita to me and was very impressed with the unique flavors and contents of the filling! not only did i enjoy every bite but that sort of hospitality spoke volumes. 100% worth the try. most definitely will be back to really sample and discover the flavors of authentic African culture. I’ve heard nothing but great things about the people and genuine love out into every dish. all i can say is im very excited to explore their menu and get a true ethiopian experience!

Food and atmosphere is excellent. The workers here treat you like family. Food times can be long around 30 mins but the food is worth it and my wife loves their salad choice. Highly recommend this place if you’re in garland area.

Wonderful restaurant delicious food and quality! The location is easy to find and park. The interior needs updating but over all it’s safe and well lit and bright. They have a full bar also and TVs to watch games. Love there Shekla Tibbs!!!

formatted_address: 3636 McKinney Ave #160, Dallas, TX 75204, United States
name: Baboush

reviews.text:
This was easily the best meal I've had in Dallas, and certainly the most imaginative and well-executed Mediterranean food I've had in a long time.

From the moment we walked in, I knew this place would be special.   Staff absolutely doted on us from the moment we sat down until it was time to leave.   I felt like I was being taken care of by family.

My cocktail was delightful.   I wish I had ordered a second one.

The menu is mostly small dishes, and they were all excellent.

If you have a good taste for food (better than what Dallas usually has to offer), and you want to be well-taken care of, I highly recommend Baboush.

This place was so good!!! The chicken shawarma was amazing (very generous with the pita) and we were totally surprised by the cauliflower too. Would 100% recommend. They also take payment in the inKind app which is great. Probably one of the best places we have tried in Dallas.

Went here for lunch with coworkers just to try something a little different. This is only my second time trying Mediterranean food. I ordered the Chicken wrap without pickles and I thought it was pretty good. Good portion size as well. The service was excellent and appreciated all the employees being kind people. I would definitely return in the future.

The food and service was amazing!  We were the only people there so i was a little concerned, but I'm so glad that we stayed.  The wait staff catered to our every wish! The chef's hummus had a Mediterranean salad in the center and was the best that I've ever eaten (center pic).  I wish that I was in town longer to go back on this trip.  I'll definitely eat there again when I'm in Dallas.
I was so surprised just how good this place was!! Two of us shared the mezza plate and one entree, and we were stuffed! Everything was delicious and the service was wonderful! Definitely recommend!

formatted_address: 6401 New York Ave # 149, Arlington, TX 76018, United States
name: Fufudelight& Suya Kitchen

reviews.text:
The food was so delicious, made at the spot for us, it felt like home. I had to do To Go.
Service was great. I highly recommend

Man listen. Their food is delicious. I’m vegetarian and I get the egusi, fufu, and plantain on the side. It’s very flavorful they don’t make it too spicy. I know it’s made fresh because it stays hot the whole drive home. They have amazing customer service. The people taking orders are so sweet. I love this place and plan on ordering the same thing at least twice a week🥰

If you like different types of food.
And get tired of eating the
same old same.
Please come and try the food here the flavor.
Omg!
Now for those of you who cannot indulge in spicy.
Some of the food here packs the punch.
So please let them know your level of spice.
The dish I like.
Most here is the moi moi.
I put a few pictures of the menu up.

Very clean.
Nice atmosphere.
Nice location
Near tcc southeast
Very friendly staff
Be sure to like and follow.

Food tasty
Service was cordial and respectful
Food took its time coming out
Not a place you wanna go when in a hurry
2nd time there Food took about the same time to be ready!

The service was very good. My husband and I came almost closing time..but the owners were very nice in helping us figure out how to order. Family run business. We didn't get to see the day time atmosphere but this seems like a hidden gem.

formatted_address: 1820 Valley View Ln, Irving, TX 75061, United States
name: Cafe Madina

reviews.text:
Cafe Medina offers an authentic taste of Somali cuisine with a warm, homely touch. I had the pleasure of trying their mixed plate, which included a delightful variety of beef, lamb, and chicken. The portion sizes are incredibly generous – our group of four shared a single plate and still had leftovers to take home!

The food is absolutely delicious and earns a solid 10 out of 10 from me. Additionally, the cafe has a dedicated prayer space, making it a welcoming spot for everyone.

Highly recommended!
Any time I drive around Dallas I try to avoid cafe madina but this delicious food takes me as hostage every time If you madina you can’t go back

Was only in town for a week and decided to try this place because it was close to my office. Food was excellent and will definitely be back when I'm in town again. I had the rice with lamb and it was the best meal I've had in a long time.

expect an ambiance of elegance matched with impeccable service. The menu boasts exquisite dishes prepared with fresh ingredients and innovative flair.. From start to finish, the experience is nothing short of exceptional. Highly recommended for unforgettable culinary indulgence.
That's the magic right there. 😋 Try the lamb shank, it's well worth it. The rice is really good also. I don't think I've ever said that about rice before.

formatted_address: 412 Payne St, Cedar Hill, TX 75104, United States
name: House of Blessing Suya Palace

reviews.text: The best suya ever. My wife and children also testify to this. I got a tray and the portion size is amazing. Will be back immediately I am done with the first tray. Packaging was very clean.
The beef suya was very delicious! Spicy! You can tell it was prepared and made with love. I enjoyed!

There is suya and there is Suya!

House of Blessing Suya is undoubtedly the best Suya I have had. The seasoning is consistent and the Suya is not too dry. The meat is real lean meat and not fat. All round 10/10 in taste.

I will definitely be ordering a tray to entertain my guests.

This suya is an absolute gem! The flavors are incredible, the service is top-notch, and the authenticity is unmatched. The suya is grilled to perfection, with tender meats and a tantalizing blend of spices. If you're looking for an unforgettable taste of Nigeria, this is the place to be!
Best suya in DFW área. They have different sizes and price ranges. The suya tasted delicious and packaging is neat and well organized. I will definitely be buying this again.

formatted_address: 720 E Campbell Rd #430, Richardson, TX 75081, United States
name: The Icon Restaurant and Lounge

reviews.text:
My friends and I came to Icon Restaurant for Sunday brunch to celebrate my birthday, and it was an amazing experience! Our server, Brenda, was outstanding and went above and beyond—she even had the DJ give me a birthday shout-out and the staff surprised me with free cheesecake and a signed birthday card, which was so thoughtful.

The food was a 10/10. I had the “Cakes and Tenders” (pancakes with chicken strips) and everything was delicious—perfectly seasoned chicken, fluffy pancakes, and great toppings like honey, butter, blueberry compote, and warm syrup. The breakfast potatoes were also excellent, well-seasoned with fresh bell peppers and onions.

Great food, great service, and an unforgettable birthday brunch. I’ll definitely be back!

This is a rare treat.  We stumbled across it and didn’t know what to expect.  We got the opportunity to meet Chef Craig - Jamaican born and trained.  He’s a true innovator of Jamaican/African/Cajun cuisine.  Dora the bartender is a delight!  Talented and full of positive energy and pours happiness in every glass.

I brought my corporate team here on a Tuesday at 6:30pm. We had about 40 people. TK was our server and she was amazing! It was a lot for one server but she was so pleasant and ready to serve. Food was a masterpiece. TK answered questions about all the options too and was very knowledgeable on each item. My whole team loved the food, music and relaxed yet elegant atmosphere. It was such a great vibe with and different than the typical steakhouse venue. Thank you for making my choice to go against our norm, a real WIN! Highly recommend.

We left before 10pm and it was filling up and getting more lively. So for corporate I think we had a good balance, but just noting that I did not experience the liveliness that may have developed. Looks like a fun place for the weekend with DJs and stuff!

Great dinner experience. Food was delicious, drinks were perfect, and the ambiance/live music was top notch. We had the chicken periperi and the soya accompanied with ripe plantain and coconut rice. Will definitely visit again.

Saw this spot on Tik Tok and wanted to support a local black business. We were sat right away for brunch and the music was really good. My only downside was majority of our food  didn’t come out how it was described on the menu. Like one egg instead of two and no peppers and onions on our hash. The waitress did go grab the cook and he came out to see how he could fix the dish so that was appreciated. The flavor was really good in the hash. My friends said the pancakes were fluffy and really good. Catfish and grits was a table favorite. The drinks were tasty as well.

formatted_address: 17194 Preston Rd suite 115, Dallas, TX 75248, United States
name: Shebelle Bar & Grill

reviews.text: The food was enjoyable, and we appreciated the freshly made injera. However, some of the dishes were served cold, which affected the overall dining experience. Additionally, the atmosphere felt more like a bar or nightclub, making it less suitable for family visits. I would not recommend this location for family outings.

Interested in trying foods of east and west African, Ethiopian, and Jamaican flavor? Shebelle Bar and Grill is a suburban gem offering a welcoming atmosphere, music (R&B and other club bangers), and good vibes.  The service was superb and the food was tasty.

Shebelle Bar and Grill is the spot to venture to on a Friday and Saturday night. I recommend you try the Injera, salmon teriyaki, fish, wings, lamb, catfish, and a variety of cocktails.
The food was delicious! The atmosphere was very laid back! Here are some of the pictures from what we ate!! The wings were so good! The steak was delicious as well!! Come on Fridays for the special!

Stepping into Shabelle feels like crossing the threshold of a secret Parisian salon reimagined for the modern palate. The decor strikes an exquisite balance: a honeyed glow, and off white walls . The music, a curated playlist of African music  drifts at conversation-friendly volume during the day that increases as the evening wears.
But the true sorcery begins when the menu arrives with a vast selection of Ethiopian and Kenyan dishes. Great job.

This was first time dining at Shebelle. Most importantly ever experiencing Ethiopian Cuisine. They made such an impression on me that I will most definitely return. It was not too crowded, they gave instructions for first timers on how to eat Ethiopia food, the staff was very knowledgeable, answered all of questions and gave fast and friendly service with a smile. Beautiful people!!

formatted_address: 4425 W Walnut St STE 301, Garland, TX 75042, United States
name: East Soul Restaurant and Lounge

reviews.text:
We visited this restaurant last Saturday after noticing it while driving by earlier in the week.
It was our first time in an African style restaurant, so I asked our server for suggestions. Our server was happy to oblige. We had suya, a spicy grilled meat as an appetizer., and I had egusi soup with fufu and grilled mackerel.
I enjoyed it so much, delicious!
My table mates enjoyed their dishes also. I look forward to dining again and trying some more new to me foods. I highly recommend!.

I am so glad to have Igbo, Nigerian food near me. Very nice set up inside. I have tried other restaurants and decided to give this location a try. I went with my kids and needed to know if they like it so I can return. While we waited we were given a plate of very fluffy puff-puffs. Delicious! We all enjoyed our well-seasoned, well-portioned food.

This place is absolutely amazing! From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with genuine smiles and great service. The food was bursting with flavor — every bite felt freshly made with care. The atmosphere was peaceful and clean, perfect for relaxing after a long day. Big shout-out to Chiamaka for her  kindness and professionalism . they truly made my dining experience special. Highly recommended!

Great place to dine and cater for your event. Catered for a bridal event and had eight (8) people call the next day for contact info. Nice environment to dine as well. Want a taste of African delicacies? Stop by East Soul Food.
Home food in a retail establishment, just like Mom will make it at home. Thanks for making delicious meals all day everyday. Prompt service, pleasant staff.

formatted_address: 1499 Regal Row Suite 107, Dallas, TX 75247, United States
name: Finesse Touch African Restaurant

formatted_address: 1350 E Campbell Rd, Richardson, TX 75081, United States
name: Tropical Finger Licking Restaurant

reviews.text:
Tropical Finger Licking is a true gem! I’ve had the privilege of tasting nearly everything on their menu, and each dish is a delicious tribute to both tradition and innovation. From ethnic favorites like eru and njamanjama to contemporary comfort foods like pizza and chicken wings, every bite is perfectly curated to satisfy a wide range of cravings.

The flavors are bold, the portions generous, and the quality consistent. Whether you’re in the mood for a nostalgic taste of home or something modern and indulgent, this spot never disappoints. Highly recommended for anyone who loves food that’s made with heart and soul!

🌟 5-Star Review: A Taste of the Tropics Right in the City! 🌟

Tropical Finger Licking Restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm hospitality and the irresistible aroma of authentic Caribbean and African cuisine. The ambiance is vibrant and inviting, with island-inspired decor that makes you feel like you’ve taken a quick trip to the tropics.

Now, let’s talk about the food — incredible! Every dish is full of rich, bold flavors that clearly come from fresh ingredients and a lot more. Their jollof rice, rice and beans, pork meat and soya were golden and sweet . Don’t skip the house-made sauces — they add a delicious kick!

Service was attentive and friendly, with staff who were happy to offer recommendations and check in to make sure everything was just right. You can tell they take pride in what they do.

Whether you’re craving a flavorful escape or just want a satisfying, home-cooked meal, Tropical Finger Licking Restaurant is the place to go. Highly recommend — I’ll definitely be back!

Appropriately named takeout restaurant! The well seasoned ox tails had us licking our fingers. I wanted to try the goat surya but got there too late (around 3pm) and it was already sold out for the day. Snooze I lose. The jollof rice was flavorful. We also had a couple of the sandwiches, both chicken and beef. Both very good. It's inside a Valero gas station, there's a bench outside to sit on. There's no doubt this place is better suited for take-out, but it's definitely worth a stop. We'll be back :)

Once you walk in, you are welcomed by the friendly staff. This alone says you are in the right place. Then the food is really good. Very tasteful and flavorful. Their suya is very tender and is a burst of flavors when you get a taste. Just like the name, their food is finger licking good. The service here is really good and I can't wait to return. I will highly recommend Tropical Finger Licking restaurant.

Nothing like I have had in a while considering that I’m a good cook myself! I had the best food experience with tropical Finger Licking Restaurant. I had my order in time and savored every bit of it. My friends and I couldn’t get over your flavors and they haven’t stopped commenting on it.

formatted_address: 920 S Harwood St, Dallas, TX 75201, United States
name: Caribbean Cabana

reviews.text:
Updated review: went today Saturday 11/1 to try the doubles worst ever it tasted stale  and frozen and was hard at the ends and the chickpeas tasted undercooked and tasted like just masala and didn’t have any pepper sauce! A different  girl who was there today said her dad  is making it the pepper sauce that  his restaurant. So keeping that in  mind there’s a halal sign I was happy about but now got me rethinking it all! So when I had visited couple  days before I was “told only the chicken patties not the beef and only certain things on their menu is halal. I wanted to try the chicken patty that that day when I went couple days ago but they had ran out. So today when I was double checking about the halal stuff and saw there was chicken patty the owner daughter told me neither the chicken or beef patty  is halal. So seeing another Muslim couple went to buy chicken and beef patties I went back to ask her  (3rd time ) then she changed her mind  said that oh yeah  it is hmmm after that I’m not trusting it.  Went back to her  with my hard and stale doubles and told her about it. Don’t recommend save your trip only frozen stale food and lies serve here!

On 10/29/
Excited I ran into this spot that has Caribbean halal food. Was craving doubles and cream soda but couldn’t have it this time cause the chef was away but the young girl at the counter was really nice

I visited this restaurant many times. I had the jerk chicken, curry chicken, oxtail, and curry goat. One cannot go wrong with any dish offered here. The portions are massive and one will not leave hungry or dissatisfied. I highly recommend Caribbean Cabana .

The flavor of the food is decent but this is by far a long way from real Caribbean food. The oxtails are tender but way too much garlic. My rice and peas  looked like mashed potatoes. Cabbage had no flavor. Nothing was jerked about the chicken. As a chef I don't want to down the restaurant but that's my first and last time going. Cashier wasn't the friendliest either. But if your looking for real Caribbean food this is not it!!

Visiting Dallas Farmers Market food hall and saw Trini flag. Ordered jerk chicken, rice and peas, macaroni pie, and coleslaw. 10/10 THE CHICKEN FELL OFF THE BONE. It had a smoky taste. The plate $18 and came with FIVE pieces of chicken. 3 legs 2 thighs. The macaroni pie was the BEST I’ve ever had. It was soft, cheesy, and melted in my mouth. The rice and peas were seasoned and didn’t need any gravy. I will be back.
The food was good. It just tastes like it was from a conventional oven. I want them real outside tasting jerk chicken but the food was good. I give it a b+

formatted_address: 1900 W Arbrook Blvd #116, Arlington, TX 76015, United States
name: ChefTemii - Nigerian Restaurant & Catering

reviews.text:
WOW..... I know Chef Temii is Nigerian but dammit man she's "Flexin like a Texan" with this meal.... The chicken had a crisp to it as well as a nice spicy kick. The rice was flavorful, had a hint of sweetness and the coleslaw complimented the dish bringing the spice and sweetness together putting my senses in a flavorful, harmonious dance, causing my feet to shuffle like an adolescent teen eating her favorite childhood meal.... The family will be making a return trip very soon.... Go try this place.

*UPDATE**
As stated, I returned, and again, I wasn't disappointed.... Keep it coming; I eagerly look forward to tasting what else you have on the menu. Thanks Chef Temii

Owner and her son were extremely sweet and welcoming. They took the time to explain all the dishes I inquired about since I’m new to Nigerian food. I had the Goat pepper soup and jollof rice, WHEWW! I’m ready to come back 😋! Also had a taste of the Egusi soup & fufu, it was delicious !! In my opinion, the menu was affordable. I’m happy to have chosen this place & I can’t wait to try other things

Hands down the best African dining experience I’ve ever had!
From the moment we walked in, the warmth hit us like a Lagos breeze. The lady that received us was so kind and helped us with our order, explaining every dish. The owner (I’m assuming the legendary Chef Temii herself) greeted us with the biggest smile and treated us like family returning home after years away. That level of genuine hospitality is rare these days.
Now, the food… oh my goodness. Where do I even start?
•  The jollof rice is straight-up sorcery: smoky, perfectly spiced, with that irresistible bottom crust (pot of gold). I could eat buckets of it.
•  Egusi soup with pounded yam? Life-changing. Rich, nutty, packed with flavor, and the pounded yam was silky-smooth, like it was made by angels.
•  We also tried the puff-puff for dessert and they came out piping hot, fluffy inside, crisp outside, dusted with just the right amount of sugar. I almost ordered a second plate to take home.
Portions are incredibly generous, everything tastes fresh and homemade, and you can feel the love in every bite.
If you’ve never had West African food before, this is the place to start. If you grew up on it, this will transport you straight back to Mama’s kitchen (maybe even better). Chef Temii is a treasure, the staff are absolute sweethearts, and the vibes are immaculate.
I’m already planning my next visit… and the one after that. Run, don’t walk!
10/10 – Chef Temii has my heart (and my stomach) forever. ❤️🇳🇬

Chef Temii was professional since day 1. I contacted her about 2 months before my wedding with all the details and by the time of the event she even contacted servers for me. The servers were very respectful and helpful. I heard nothing but great things about the food. I ordered two pans of fish and it was gone before me or hubby could try it…the chicken and rices were delicious. The price was unbeatable for a part of 100. Thank you again.

Very nice people. We ordered Egusi, fufu, jollof, chicken and plantain. It was so good that all my kidos cleaned their plates. By the way if you order pick up or delivery, please use the business its self. Because Uber and doordash be wilding.
Overall wonderful food and people.

formatted_address: 7508 Ambassador Row, Dallas, TX 75247, United States
name: Freshnez

reviews.text:
I grabbed a jollof bowl at Klyde Warren Park on a Saturday afternoon and WOW! Not exaggerating when I say this was one of the best meals I’ve had in Dallas in a long time. I got mine with plantains, fried eggs, cabbage mix, and a little Parmesan, and it was perfect. Not too spicy (I ordered it mild), super flavorful, and the kind of comforting, legit home-cooked taste where you can tell a real human being put love into it.

It was also incredibly filling without feeling heavy. I probably could’ve gotten two meals out of it, but I downed almost the whole thing instead. The ingredients tasted so fresh. Also thought it was very reasonably since the food is this good and this generous.

Huge shout-out to Stephen for the amazing service. He was truly so kind and welcoming.

I ate here after going to the museum. They now have a posted schedule in the park to tell you what food trucks will be there and when. Def going to try to catch them whenever they’re here. Highly recommend!

Stumbled upon this gem after visiting a museum in downtown Dallas on Friday night. The owner was gracious and very hospitable. I ordered the jollof with fried egg, veggies, and cabbage. This was my first time trying jollof rice and my expectations bar is set extremely high! The flavors were married so well and the balanced. I recommend everyone to try this place!

Tried this jollof spot at kylde warren park with a friend this afternoon after a co worker recommended it and it was amazing. The jollof and brisket were perfectly smoky and full of flavor. My friend’s chicken suya was so good she ended up ordering an extra pack to take home. Good food and workers . Highly recommend this place

Our group stopped by this food truck for lunch on a weekend at Klyde Warren Park. We had friendly service and delicious food! We all got different variations of the Jollof Rice Bowl, and they were all great! The standout was the brisket! Portions were generous and we left with plenty of energy to continue on our day of exploring Dallas ☺️

Just got back from a trip to Texas with my girlfriend. We both eat out all the time, we don't eat fast food, so we are constantly look out for places to eat. On the road from Amarillo to Waco, FreshNez kitchen is by far the best food experience we had in Texas. I love all the food I had in Texas, so this is saying a lot. People may be skeptical about this place being a food truck, but please trust me. I was skeptical too. I've tired "good" food trucks before. None of them come close. The owner is extremely passionate about the food he makes. His energy is great. He says he will never serve anything that isn't "great tasting", and I can't say otherwise with the two dishes I tired. I do believe him when he says that. We first just ordered the rice dish with pork and brisket, thinking thats all, and looking for other restaurants to try. After trying the food, I had to go back to tell him how good it was. We ended up getting another dish -Shrimp Tacos - thinking there was no way this dish was gonna be near as good as the rice. I was so pleasantly surprised.
Sadly, I never got to tell him how good the shrimp taco dish was, because we ran out of time. Personally I think it was even better than the first dish. My girlfriend also loved both but prefers the rice. The two dishes we tried were nearly identical in the way that they satisfied us, but at the same time these dishes were distinct and unique. All this to say, I believe anything you get will be great. Lastly, I've never tired coleslaw that I actually loved, until I tired the coleslaw from FreshNez. To be fair I haven't been very open to coleslaw in the past. (maybe I just haven't had any decent coleslaw before.) Anyways, I love the food and the passion this man has for his food. Definitely at least a 9/10 experience. No glazing here, genuinely so good.

formatted_address: 6505 W Park Blvd #215, Plano, TX 75093, United States
name: Arona Food Place

reviews.text: I first attempted to order online through their own website, but the payment options wouldn’t load. So I ended up ordering over the phone for pickup instead. The price I received at the register differed from what I was quoted online. Also, the itemized receipt does not total out correctly (see photo for details). I am assuming there is a hidden transaction fee when paying with a card… 🤔 For the price and the many awesome reviews, I was definitely expecting more from Arona Food Place. However, the food was underwhelming and down right disappointing — small portions and hardly even warm. The single piece of $8 peppered goat meat was dry, tough to chew, and smaller than the palm of my hand. The $26 ogbono soup left a lot to be desired… I believe the photos speak for themselves. I am actually being generous with my stars. 😒

Service - The lady in the front was so sweet, attentive and welcoming to my wife & I. We had a really nice interaction with her and another patron in the place.

Food - The seafood okra soup was soooo good! The portion was ALOT, I couldn’t finish it in one sitting (and I have a big appetite) so that tells you something!! Loved the flavors and presentation on the fish platter as well. The oha soup was yummy!

Wait time - They make the food fresh so either call ahead or be prepared to wait a bit (which is totally fine because the food did not disappoint).

Dining in - We dined in and had no complaints, but the place is pretty small so might recommend take out instead, unless you don’t mind it. Hopefully they can get a bigger place so that the dining in experience can be further elevated.

Had a fantastic experience dining at one of the two tables in this small but mighty restaurant. The egusi, efo riro and jollof rice were all delicious, and after establishing that we were not very familiar with Nigerian food, the proprietor was gracious enough to give us a lesson on proper Nigerian dining etiquette, including hand washing, using the poundo yam swallow to scoop up the stews with our hands and even the best way to enjoy the flavors of the dishes (without chewing!). It was a really great place to explore a unique cuisine that we are lucky to have in Plano.

Came here with my friends and we were immediately hooked. The atmosphere, service, and food are unbeatable! Don’t pass this place by without trying it out! The owner is so sweet and makes you feel like family.

First time here, we came cause of social media influence. The lady at the register was wonderful! She gave us tons of suggestions and we ate till our hearts desire. She even taught us how to eat the traditional way. We got the egusi, okra soup, rice with chicken and fried rice. Best authentic meal!!! 5/5 recommend!!!

A fantastic caterer to hire to make your day extra special. And she has ways to make you happy before,during , and after your event. 🥰🥰

Jola went above and beyond my wife and I’s expectations!! She was so thoughtful with the appetizer spread and the main dishes, as well as being a joy to work with. Not to mention how delicious the food was! One of the most consistent compliments we received at the wedding was how great the food was. She even packed up our left overs so that we could have some after the wedding (barely had time during lol).

You will not be disappointed! Thanks again, Jola.

Jolas Kitchen catered at our wedding on December 27th. I cannot say enough good things about Chef Jola, she was so communicative, and made excellent recommendations and suggestions,  which was so helpful to me as a first time bride who had never planned such a large event before. We were absolutely blown away by the presentation, and the care and attentiveness of chef Jola and her team. I have never worked with such thoughtful and kind caterers, they really thought of everything and made the night such a wonderful and stress free experience for us. The food was absolutely amazing and our guests could not stop talking about how much they loved everything, from the Beef Suya (my personal favorite) to the Cole Slaw, to the Jollof and Meat Pies, and the Puff Puff. A lot of brides don’t eat much on their wedding day, but I cleaned my whole plate and even took some home with me.  Highly recommend!

She catered for my wedding, and they were absolutely exceptional! They don’t just provide a service, they put their heart, creativity, and very best into everything they do. Every detail was thoughtful and made the day memorable and enjoyable.

We even received a priceless surprise gift from them on our wedding day, which meant so much to us. My husband and I truly loved it! 😍❤️

Highly recommended!

The wings were fantastic.

We will definitely return to try out more of the menu

name: Buk 9ja food Catering Services

reviews.text:
It’s a blessing to have good Nigerian food in Forney. I was really craving some Okra soup and I was so happy to find this catering service.
The food is fresh and well seasoned. I also appreciate the FuFu yam being made from real yam everything tasted organic and was well seasoned and delicious.

The owner is soo sweet and has good customer service I’ll go ahead and add another 5 star for that.

I’m definitely ordering in the future :)

Omg this is the place you want to go to get your authentic delicious Nigeria food, she is extremely nice and professional, the delivers on time with great customer service; she’s my go to always in forney Texas. Thank me later !!!

The food is amazing and I was very pleased with my order. I ordered the egusi soup and pounded yam as well as an order of jollof rice. The food was still hot when I got home. Both items were very flavorful with the perfect amount of spice. I will be ordering again!

BUK 9jafood is the best Nigerian food. Very organic, taste is delicious. Makes me wants more. I ordered the Jollof rice, Fried rice, egusi soup, vegetable soup with smoked fish and snails and we enjoyed our food. Am definitely ordering more.

I've tried to place an order 5 times and have yet to be able to. I'd love to be able to eat their food and give an actual review. Hope others have better response/luck than me, or this "business" will no longer exist.

name: Cubana Grille | West African & Jamaican Restaurant in Mckinney Texas

reviews.text: Omg the food is so good. My personal favorite is the oxtail and jollof rice! The gravy is good, the meat is tender, and the rice has a good spice. You can most definitely tell that whoever is in the kitchen knows what they’re doing. The portions are great and the staff is very friendly. I’ve ordered two nights in a row, I would definitely recommend ❤️ (the picture below is after I ate enough out the food to fit it all inside of one container)

Food and atmosphere were great! Afro beats music and vibrant decor are very welcoming. The owner came to our table and greeted our group of 8 and we had a very attentive waitress. My chicken curry fell off the bone, the puff puff was perfectly sweet and crisp on the outside and o loved the spinach and plantains. If you’re a ginger fan, try the pineapple ginger drink! So good! Can’t wait to come back.

Great tasting meals. Beef patties are amazing and have a kick. The owner is very friendly. Clean establishment. The jerk chicken and oxtails are delicious. Was expecting the ram suya to be spicy but it wasn't but no issue. Just takes awhile to be prepared if you do order it.

Good food, decent service, nice ambiance. We were there at 3:30pm on a Saturday. They have a bar, but when I ordered a drink off the drink menu I was told that their bartender wouldn’t be there until later. The food was really good—we ordered a platter to share, with Jerk chicken, Curry chicken, two different rices,  and CoCo bread as an appetizer. Our 10 year old had fried chicken and french fries (the only items on the kids menu). We’ll be back, likely after 5pm so we can have drinks.

This place is awesome!!!  I’ve never had curry goat before and it was delicious… more than anything the wait time was perfect! No one wants to wait 45 minutes to eat after you’d ordered. 12-15 minutes tops. Highly recommend. Oh and pace yourself with the rum punch 😁

formatted_address: 4841 Dolton Dr, Virginia Beach, VA 23462, United States
name: LIF Catering ( African food )

reviews.text: Visiting Virginia Beach  and saw this online so I decided to give it a try. SHE IS THE BEST!  I ordered ABULA and Egusi soup just few minutes ago 04/21/2023 and I single-handedly ATE everything. Thank you Ma! Next time I am in Virginia Beach I will definitely be getting more food.

I wish I could have ordered everything on the menu! The egusi, asaro, jollof rice meat pies and designer stew were all delicious.
The portions/serving size is very generous  and the owner is so amazing!
Thanks for giving us a taste of back home!
My sister’s food is finger-licking good! We had the asaro and Giz-dodo. It only lasted a few days because everyone including the kids loved it. You will not be disappointed!
It was really awesome patronizing this kitchen. The meals were tasty, well prepared, and dished. I don't regret my decision at all.

I called LIF after 7 pm during my hotel stay in Virginia to order for some Nigerian food and the food was delivered to my hotel within 30 minutes of my order. The service was exceptional and the food was sumptuous.

DC African Cuisine is a must-try! The food is incredibly fresh and full of authentic flavor , you can taste the love in every bite. The service is warm and inviting, and the owner is truly hardworking and dedicated to making sure every customer leaves satisfied.

If you’re in the area, do yourself a favor and stop by. Everyone has to try it — you won’t be disappointed!
Everything tasted great. I got the chicken egusi and it was the bomb💕🥂 will be going back soon!

We ordered food for over 30 players for my team and she got it ready within 2hrs,the food was very delicious, all the players appreciated it and I will recommend you also patronize her for a taste also…

very Affordable,Excellent food and outstanding service!!!

Good food, but pricey.
I got the potato (?) greens and plantains.
The greens was flavored well with beef(?) pieces in it, but also fish it seemed.
The rice went well with it.
I ordered wings for my friend but she couldn't finish because she said they were too spicy.

Omggggg this place is so delicious!!!

I’ve been to many different African restaurants and haven’t ran into not one as good as this food truck!!! They say the best food comes from a “Food Truck” and today I’m vouching for that !!
You go girl 😚

Baby, I’ve been craving FUFU for weeks, but I’ve been so busy working that I didn’t have the time to actually go but today I searched up Rhosabjal cuisine & seen that she was four minutes away from. I called and asked what all did she have and that it will be my first time trying Fufu and what soup would be the best to try with the fufu and she told me Eugusi Soup would be a very good choice. She was telling the truth I love it very seasoned not too spicy and the best part about it. She asked me how spicy did I want it, She was very respectful and had a good attitude I recommend anyone who is looking for some good African food to come here because it’s very good. Fast service, I got my drinks nice & cold. Thank you❤️

OMG! I’m so excited I couldn’t find no Egusi and fufu in Fort Worth I got tired of going to Arlington and let me see this is some good Egusi and fufu! 10/10 recommend and the customer service is A1. If you in the area and like African food check them out! You won’t regret it!!!!

I order different Liberian soups from Rhosabjal Cuisine every week, and they never disappoint! The food is always delicious, well-seasoned, and full of authentic flavors—just the right balance without being overly spicy. Every bite reminds me of home-cooked goodness.

Beyond the amazing food, the customer service is top-notch. Sabah is a wonderful person—kind, welcoming, and always making sure I’m satisfied with my order. She truly cares about her customers, and it shows in both her hospitality and the quality of her dishes.

If you’re looking for authentic Liberian cuisine that tastes like home, I highly recommend Rhosabjal Cuisine. You won’t be disappointed!

formatted_address: 1335 Admiral Nimitz Cir NT24F, Dallas, TX 75223, United States
name: Pearlie's Southern Kitchen

reviews.text: Last year I had Pearlies Southern Kitchen during their showcase at the Dallas State Fair and was absolutely blown away! Their signature dishes were reminiscent of true Southern comfort food. Kerston and her husband was exceptionally friendly, and the ambiance made me feel like I was back in grandma's kitchen.  Will definitely visit them at the state fair next month. Highly recommend!

Ever since diving into the story of Kerston Crawford-Thorns, I've been enthralled by the deep Southern influence and heartfelt memories that Pearlie’s Southern Kitchen brings to the table. I first saw their "Deep Fried Potato Salad" featured on the Kelly Clarkson Show, and it's no wonder it got national recognition! Kerston's dedication to preserving her grandmother Pearlie Mae's legacy is genuinely inspiring. From the State Fair of Texas to their upcoming Mobile Food Trailer, Pearlie's dishes feel like a comforting embrace of kinship and laughter on a plate. Can't wait to see more of what they offer on social media!

Went to this place at the fair. Tried to get one item. Poorly ran. They seemed very disorganized with multiple people trying to do multiple different things. They were trippingbover each other. This led to very long wait times for everyone while we were there. For us in particular, we waited for 25 minutes asking multiple times for our order. After 25 minutes, we asked for our tickets back only to be told we could not get a refund becuase they drop the tickets. They literally told us we couldn't have our order nor our money back. Yes this made us angry. A guy that may have been the manager came and tried to scold us for being angry and tried to send us on our way by pulling tickets out of his pocket and giving to us. Extremely poor service and very disappointed in the professionalism and lack of problem solving. We ate at numerous stands while at the park, probably 20 and every other stand was friendly and fast. I highly recommend to stay away and spend your money elsewhere.

Damn is not verbal abuse especially in the context it was used. We worked with you the first two times we asked for the order and continued to wait. Expecting a product in a timely manner once paid for is not disrupting business.

I went to the state fair two years ago . I was on my out and I noticed them . I ordered the deep fried peach cobbler. I would rate it a 100 . I’ve been looking for them since and I’ve finally came across them on google ! Thank you !
I had the chance to try the deep fried ox tails roll and the fried peach cobbler roll at the Texas State Fair a few days ago. It was bomb!! The people were nice too.
