The egusi was delicious and generously portioned, at a great price! The chef is friendly and welcoming… definitely worth trying.
Ordering was seamless and i got my orders same day. Plus the meal was delicious 😋 👍
Best Nigerian online restaurant in Texas, i got good value for every penny spent.. plus delivery was swift, I highly recommend.
I had a fantastic experience ordering from this vendor.

formatted_address: 5138 Belair Rd, Baltimore, MD 21206, United States
name: Mary's Catering & African Restaurant

reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE this place. I come here every time I’m in Maryland. The portions are great, the customer service is EXCELLENT, the food is so delicious. I highly recommend this Nigerian food for people who are African or even just us regular Americans! I’ve included a photo of their menu below. Everything tastes so good, but my favorites are the meat pie, the fried fish, and the jollof rice combo meal with stew and two pieces of chicken. I also like to order goat and cow skin on the side. Sometimes I get tripe too or beef! I can’t wait to come back.

I have been to many Nigerian restaurants in the DMV area and this establishment is BY FAR the best! Top service that makes you feel like you are visiting your auntie, great tasting and FRESH food, coupled with very reasonable prices. I make it a point to buy dinner for my family from Auntie Mary almost every Saturday! I highly recommend this restaurant...you will not be disappointed!

Been coming here 5 years consistently no complaints… I’ve tried all of the Nigerian restaurants in the Baltimore city area and this is the BEST!!! Flavorful, filling, authentic and most importantly the customer service is OUTSTANDING. Check them out and try their fried fish to get you started!!!😋

What a hidden gem! Mary’s food is AMAZING. This place never misses. Authentic and Fresh. I even ordered catering for a large party and the food was great. Everyone kept asking where the food was from.
Reasonably priced for a top quality service. The local pounded yam (not poundo) was surprising. It was my first time having having it in many years and it paired well with their eguisi.

formatted_address: 5504 Matlock Rd, Arlington, TX 76018, United States
name: African pride Food and kitchen

reviews.text: I got the fufu and egusi stew. I called ahead and it took 10 minutes, really convenient! the owner was very kind and excited for me, as it was my first time trying it. The fufu was the perfect consistency and thickness to scoop the egusi, and the portion was generous with the meat and fufu serving.
The lady that helped was so nice and welcoming. I got the beef jollof rice and it was amazing, the beef was nice and tender and the rice was magnificent. Thank you so much!!

The Egusi & Fufu was delicious. The lady is so kind & pleasant. Our food was fresh and hot. My husband and l each had the Egusi and FuFu with goat, we also had jollof rice with beef and plantain. It was more than enough whew. Had to take a to go plate. 💜
The Food from from this restaurant are down to earth home African Cousine. High quality taste and priced reasonable. I love this place. You all should try it.

So my husband and I wanted to try something different and after google searching African restaurants we came across African Pride and let me tell you that food is soooooo good. The young lady that helped us was very patient and well knowledgeable of the foods she provided. Now I tried fufu before and it was a downer, but after she explained to me how to eat it with my soup on my godddd it went down. She make you feel like your family and she patiently listen to your questions regarding the food before explaining. If you want authentic African food you must stop by and have a try of African Pride Food and Kitchen, I promise you won’t be disappointed.

formatted_address: 2026 N Jupiter Rd, Garland, TX 75044, United States
name: STAR BUKRI’S CATERING ETHIOPIAN CAFE

reviews.text: Unfortunately the Vegan Combo dish I have was terrible and informed the employee before I left the place but her response was very unprofessional!   The place were very dirty and nasty!   Honestly the food used to be better than this!

Absolutely stunning food, As someone who never had Ethiopia food before I found it to be very familiar and delicious to eat.
It was very well balanced and the spices are done just right.
I would highly recommend it to anyone.

The food is OK. The restaurant is a filthy, hole in the wall. To add insult to injury, we had to pay extra for the sauce (chutney) and water! This is the first time in my whole life, where a restaurant didn't have free water to drink!! Also, there is hardly any place to sit an eat there!!!

The food is great, pretty inexpensive and the people are nice. I bought 3 Veggie Combo plates for $30 (for myself!!!) yesterday and will be eating on them for days. Hot or cold, this food is delicious.

eating Ethiopian food and it was absolutely amazing.
I wish there was some explanation or some kinda platter where you could try diffent types of dishes just to taste.

I can definitely recommend the spaghetti and it was absolutely the bomb the spaghetti sauce was aromatic and flavorful and the just good in general.

I don't know what else to say oh there tea was absolutely fantastic and they sell donuts type bread and that's good as well

What else do they sell
From what I have seen some sauces,  the Ethiopian bread, samosas,   fried sweet bread and  food

formatted_address: 2501 E Mayfield Rd suite 101, Arlington, TX 76014, United States
name: Crown cafe

reviews.text:
I drove all the way from Denton to try the seafood okra soup I saw online. I was greeted by the kindest lady, Esther; she was truly a gem. Although I waited for a while for the food, when it finally arrived, it didn't look appetizing. Unfortunately, it was tasteless, and I had to ask for more Maggie seasoning. The seafood did not include snails, stock fish, or dry fish as mentioned on their menu, which was highly disappointing, especially considering the price. I was hoping for something much better and more flavorful.

The side of jollof rice was also lackluster; I only took one spoonful, and it had no taste or flavor, leaving me disappointed again. The moi moi was okay but a bit dry. Overall, for my first experience here, I was quite let down, especially since it was recommended by a friend.

The atmosphere was decent, and I would consider returning primarily because of Esther’s excellent service. She was genuinely concerned about my experience and wanted to make things right, which I appreciated.

I ate in that restaurant before and overall my experience was great but on 12/06/2025 I ordered for delivery thru Gruhub and it was a really badddddd experience I had. First I had ordered one egusi with pounded yam and grilled catfish with plantains and a side of jolllof rice. They called me to say they do not have egusi I had to switch to vegetable soup. Then I get delivered tilapia instead of catfish and it was sooooo burned. On my order I got charged automatically for $10 extra for some tips which I do not understand. For spending $74 I was so disappointed.
My favorite spot when I find myself within the DFW Region. Amazing food! Wonderful Service! Family friendly! So yummy in my tummy. Always reminds me of home from home😍

Sunday afternoon service was great but the food was even better. Efo riro soup with goat meat and the jollof rice with chicken. We also got hibiscus tea to wash it all down. Everything that touch my tongue was delicious and I could barely push the plate away. Portion sizes was big enough to share both plates. Extremely satisfied and will be back

I visited this restaurant with my family today, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience. The food was the worst I have ever had. The okra soup was black, clearly old, and tasted like it had been sitting for months. The chicken my son ordered tasted spoiled, and the meat portions were tiny and not fresh. I honestly felt like vomiting after eating the food. The bitter leaf soup was also not good at all.
The only positive part of the visit was the front desk staff — very warm and welcoming. However, based on the food quality, I do not recommend this place.

formatted_address: 1861 Brown Blvd, Arlington, TX 76006, United States
name: Azizas Kitchen

reviews.text: I stopped by this place yesterday. It was my first time trying this African place and it was a great experience. I ordered the spicy fish with spicy rice and greens. It was very good, flavorful and nicely spiced. The owner actually let me try the spicy sauce first to see if i liked it before ordering .Would recommend and I will be returning to try more menu items .

This was my first time trying African cuisine, and I had a wonderful experience! Aze and her sister Aziza were extremely welcoming and friendly. My daughter even made a friend with Aze daughter! They generously offered us samples of several dishes to taste, which made us feel right at home. Aze even offered to go get my daughter her diet Coke from the store since they were out, she was accommodating to my daughter's diabetes! Which is so nice of her! You can tell she loves kids!
The food is made fresh and with organic ingredients, and you can truly taste the quality. As they mention, this is not fast food , everything is prepared with care, so be patient because it’s worth it. I ordered the Ugali with beef stew, and my friend had the fried fish with rice. Both were flavorful and delicious 😋
The atmosphere, music, and overall vibe were great. I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be returning soon! ✨🙌🏻

The food was excellent and communicated the soul of the food, so flavorful. First experience with Swahili cuisine. The Nyama Choma was seasoned so well as was the beef stew. Had my first experience with Ugali. Good side dish. The plantains were so filling. Good food. Good people.

We stumbled upon this hidden gem in Arlington! When we walked in, it instantly felt like home, from the fragrances to decor to the welcome. Everything was spot on!

The ugali was perfectly made, the nyama choma was juicy and well-seasoned, and the sukuma was fresh and flavorful. The samosas and masala fries had the perfect kick and were a great side. The taste was as close to home as possible!

The owner, Aziza, was so kind—her energy lights up the place. Her story is truly inspiring, and it’s clear she pours her heart into the food and the experience. We’ll definitely be back.

First time visiting Aziza’s beautiful restaurant in Arlington, TX! Found it to be clean, quiet and comfortable. Menu was easy to navigate and understand. The food was ordered for take out and extremely well prepared. Being an African myself, I understand the importance of remaining authentic! This was definitely the case at Aziza who welcomed us in person and gifted us a plate of the beef pilau (that was delicious btw!) we ordered the spicy rice, beef samosas, sausages plantains and nyoma (grilled beef) yummy. Will be back for sure and I encourage everyone to support this establishment! Happy Holidays.

formatted_address: 2146 E Belt Line Rd, Richardson, TX 75081, United States
name: Shawley Cafe

reviews.text:
The food at this restaurant is outstanding!
It’s a wonderful atmosphere and they really care about giving you a cultural experience from the ambiance/music to the traditional coffee ceremony.
The employees are so kind and offered great recommendations.
I highly recommend shawley if you enjoy traditional Eritrean/Ethiopian food or if you’re looking for delicious vegetarian/vegan options

My experience was nothing special. I went on a Sunday evening. It's more of a Bar place. Not a restaurant. I was caught off guard once I stepped in. There was mens playing pool. I couldn't tell who was an employee or not.  After awkwardly standing there at the bar counter for a few minutes, someone finally approaches and serviced me.  I ordered something for $14 to take out. Handed her a $20 bill. She just said thank you,  walked off and never returned with my change. I guess she kept the $6 for tip money (I was confused).  I just let it go and walked out. Most likely won't go back, because of the atmosphere. Food was ok. I definitely could have made the stirfry myself. I just love the Ethiopian sour bread that's available elsewhere.
I'm ok, I don't hate the place, just not my kind of place.
Outstanding service! Warm and inviting for every age group! Sunday's coffee Saturday dinner and Monday night fun 💕💕💕💕 Thank you Shawley
The food is sooo delicious and just the right amount of spice and flavor. Daytime is nice for getting ethiopian/eritrean food and night time for hooka/music and drinks :)
Shady bar. Be aware of your bill, they have a tendency of adding things that you never ordered to rack up your bill. The trashy so called owner is out of control needs some house training.

formatted_address: 6401 New York Ave #111, Arlington, TX 76018, United States
name: Mumin Foods and Fashions

reviews.text: Omg food looks delicious and I love the atmosphere will be coming again and I try milk tea for the first time and it was delicious 😋

I was looking nearby Somali food so I gave this place a try and was impressed. The Italo-African history of Somalia really came through with the Spaghetti and Goat. The serving was a good size and very filling. The service was great and the staff were authentically friendly. This place is both a store and a restaurant so walk to the back of you are there to eat. I will be again, soon.

Great place to enjoy authentic Somali food. Like having a meal prepared by your very own auntie. The service was also good — very gracious and attentive staff. I recommend the goat. There is a masjid just a couple of doors down to conveniently make your salah after enjoying your meal or while you wait.

Oh man I not gonna lie this is a hidden Gem. Very very nice people and delicious food.
I would say don’t miss the beef sambosa and just try the amazing tasting food.

Your taste buds gonna thank you for sure.
❤️
This is the best Somali store in  Arlington Texas they got the best fragrance and clothing and the area is very clean I  real recommend coming to this place 💯

formatted_address: 19009a Preston Rd Ste 102-108, Dallas, TX 75252, United States
name: MamaJones African Market

reviews.text: The food here not only tastes great, but it also feels very healthy. The service is top-notch and down-to-earth, creating a warm, family vibe. Plus, the freshness of the food really stands out!"

I must say I was impressed when I went into the store, well organized, distinctly clean and the most impressive experience was the quality of food stuffs I purchased. The Crayfish was giving “Oron crayfish” for those that understand quality and taste. The periwinkles tasted so fresh when I used it in my  okro soup. The Mangala fish chef’s kiss… I was impressed. The taste of the Blended Egusi when cooked, tells it was dried well before blending . I could go on an on and on… I ll definitely be coming more often. Congratulations on your new endeavors and service to us. Thank you.

The food doesn’t seem fresh and sanitary. They were sitting in room temperature for several hours and the guy asked if we would like it heated up implying that the food was cold. I also don’t like the fact that there isn’t a hood over the food to protect it from germs and bacteria. I hope that the team would read my review to consider practicing food safety guidelines for the sake of public health.
They are very well stocked and serve fresh food. Best plantain I have had for a long time .

Stopped by MamaJones to pick up a few items and ended up grabbing more than I planned, and this is because the store exceeded all my expectations! From the nostalgic Nigerian snacks like Sisi Pelebe and Baba Dudu that brought back childhood memories, to the wide selection of authentic groceries, everything was thoughtfully stocked and beautifully presented. The store is spacious, very clean, and easy to navigate, with high-quality products throughout. Just stop by MamaJones if you’re missing home in Africa. This is my new go-to spot

formatted_address: 1716 Young St Suite 125, Dallas, TX 75201, United States
name: Talkinspoon by Guest365

reviews.text:
My breakfast sandwich and French toast were fantastic. Potatoes were good and they'd be great with the addition of onion and peppers. I appreciate them taking the time to call to confirm my order. I'll be back

11/8/25 Once again they exceeded my expectations! I requested an over medium egg..done. I asked for breakfast potatoes because it wasn't on UE..done. Everything is absolutely delicious. I love this place!! They just get it. I just wish I could order grits for breakfast.
Ali is very sweet, Amazing Positive Attitude! Amazing Breakfast at a great price!
great experience! 1000000/10. food was great & came out fast but was fresh. the atmosphere is all good vibes & positive energy. i love it here!

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
A Hidden Gem Worth Every Bite

I came into town from Houston on a bus and happened to stop at the convenience store next door when I saw a sign for Hawkinspoon. Curiosity—and hunger—led me inside, and I’m so glad it did.

I ordered the Jollof rice and Suya (beef), and it was absolutely amazing. The Jollof was perfectly seasoned—flavorful, rich, and balanced. The Suya? Tender, spicy, and unforgettable. I took my plate back to my hotel to eat… but the food was so good, I walked back up the street just to order two more servings. That’s how fire it was. 🔥

I met Lorenzo, and also got to speak with the woman owner—this is a family-run business with heart. They even have Airbnb units upstairs, making it more than just a restaurant—it’s a whole experience.

If you’re in Dallas, do yourself a favor and eat here. Support good people. Support real flavor. This spot is a hidden gem you’ll definitely remember.

— Shaun C.
Staying at the hotel and came by this convenience store for snacks. Alejandra was so hospitable and welcoming. :) I loved the local vibe. Will be back

formatted_address: 320 E Belt Line Rd # 300, DeSoto, TX 75115, United States
name: Edilycious

formatted_address: 621 N Hampton Rd suite 113, DeSoto, TX 75115, United States
name: Menu Six Fusion

reviews.text:
I’ve ordered delivery through DoorDash from Menu Six multiple times and I have never been disappointed. The food always arrives hot and packaged in sustainable containers, which I really appreciate. The Salmon Bowl and Ramen Fusions are my absolute favorites, and I love experimenting with different sauces each time I order.

Everything I’ve tried has been incredibly fresh, full of flavor, and consistently delicious. The pricing is very reasonable for the quality, and it’s become one of my go-to spots. I order a few times every month. Highly recommend!

I lucked up on this hidden gem in Desoto. The owners Enoch and Julia had amazing spirits. The food was absolutely DELICIOUS!!! It will definitely be a regular spot of mine now

The Suya Bowls 9/10

The Ramen 10/10

Menu Six is an absolute game-changer! My son and I came in because my wife and I craving some authentic flavors, and we were completely blown away.

We ordered the beef, chicken, and jollof bowl, and it was pure perfection. The meat was tender and cooked to perfection, and the chicken was so juicy. But the real star of the show was the jollof rice. It was rich, flavorful, and had just the right amount of spice. My wife, who is usually very picky, took one bite and said it was "wicked good!!!"—and trust me, she's not wrong.

The service was also fantastic. Our server was attentive and made some excellent recommendations. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot for a date night or a meal with friends.

If you're looking for incredible African food that tastes like it was made with love, you HAVE to come to Menu Six. We will absolutely be back to try everything else on the menu.

A well-deserved five stars!

The people are very nice. I had my year old daughter in my arms and he walked my order out to my car. The food is flavorful and we'll spiced. It's my first time visiting and I'll be back to try the suya bowl. I ordered the chicken and rice for someone else and the beef ramen for myself. So happy to have found something new in DeSoto to eat. The fusion tea was also delicious. The nice lady at the front counter let my daughter and I try one free. It didn't make it home. Lol

The place is so chill and I just love it so much. When I first went there me and my dad got some tea to try for free and it was so good. My dad got the steak and chicken bowl I think and I got the steak and chicken ramen. The ramen is SUPERRRR amazing I truly can’t express how much I love it. If I could I would definitely eat everyday.100/10 The picture on the left is a different day

formatted_address: 1320 W Main St, Lewisville, TX 75067, United States
name: Lagos Kitchen - Lewisville

reviews.text: We were greeted and seated right away, which was a great start. The kitchen staff was amazing and everything came out fresh and flavorful. We went around 7:30pm on a Sunday evening, and it was the perfect time—busy enough for good energy but not crowded. The portion sizes were generous, and the food was absolutely delicious. Definitely recommend!

I went to this place for this first time today and I asked if they had ox tails . I was told yes . I ordered Egusi with Fufu and oxtails. When the gentleman came back with my food I asked to see the food he opened up the container and it was meat in there I’d never seen before. I told him I didn’t want that and if they had chicken yes they had chicken but as you see from the picture the chicken was stale and not edible I’ve picked through the chicken to see if there were some soft pieces . Portion size for the egusi soup was small so I will not revisit .

the food was so good, we got chicken with jollof rice and the beef egusi, the fufu was so soft and the food was so flavorful, portions were amazing we ended up taking some home! service was incredible.

Nigeria! Where have you been all my life!  We were feeling adventurous and decided to try this place as we had never had Nigerian food before. I’m so glad we did!  Hands down the best food ever!  The depth of flavor is astounding!  I’m still not entirely certain what it was we ate because I’ve never seen food like this before, but the taste was out of this world!  How are we ever going to go back to fried chicken and Mac and cheese!

Do be aware their prices listed online are their old prices. I was a little shocked when I went to pick up our food and the total was almost double what we were expecting, but it’s worth every penny! Definitely coming back often!

The serving portion was very small for the price…. But it tasted so great. I most likely will not come back for 3 pieces of meat and fufu for almost 30 I could have eaten more for less and better. I left hungry and the cultural differences(no joy smiling or anything. She didn’t offer plantain ( sucks to be American). DONT GO HERE IF YOUR NOT AFRICAN !! Not a welcoming place. But the food is good. Just not enough for the $30 I paid.

formatted_address: 12255 Teel Pkwy #410, Frisco, TX 75033, United States
name: M&M African Kitchen & Bar

reviews.text: We had an exquisite experience at M&M African Kitchen. We ordered several dishes and everything was absolutely delicious. All their dishes were so flavorful and large enough to share. The owners are kind and entertaining. The location is beautiful and extravagant. We felt like royalty!

OK this placd is amazing. This is the best texture fufu I have ever had. It is so soft and malleable.

The egusi is also off the chain. It has a little kick to it (relatively mild) the chicken is tender. The flavor is amazing.

The lady was so so nice to ask if I had a fish allergy in advance to make sure I could enjoy the food.

The interior of this building is very Instagram worthy. Gorgeous decoration.

I will definitely go back and get food here. I have already posted it in a local group and I anticipate they are about to get a lot of visitors 😂

My friends and I went to M&M African Kitchen in Frisco on karaoke night and had an amazing time. We ordered the suya, lamb chops with rice, lemon drop cocktails, and everything was so good. The food was very flavorful, served hot and presentation was nice. Especially the Suya! We got multiple plates. The vibes were great all night, especially with karaoke, and the service from everyone was excellent. This was my second time visiting, and once again, the experience did not disappoint. The restaurant itself is also very beautiful def sets the vibe. We’ll definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend for great food, drinks, and a fun atmosphere.

This place opens at 12:00 PM on Saturdays, but I still waited 38 minutes for my food—even though no one was there before I arrived and I was the first customer.
When the food finally came, it was still disappointing. The server also seemed to have communication issues. She took my order, but it didn’t come out correctly.
I ordered Abula and specifically asked for extra gbegiri, but the Abula arrived with zero gbegiri—honestly it felt like negative gbegiri lol. What’s worse is this is the second time this exact issue has happened.
The meat also needed more seasoning (or at least salt). The restaurant is nicely decorated, but I didn’t come for decor—I came for good food and good service.
Overall: The place is well decorated but I didn't come for decoration or to be part of the decorations.

Saw this restaurant on TikTok last week and decided to give it a try this weekend.

I ordered the egusi with fish and it was delicious,  however, the portion size was extremely small. They gave two pieces of fish, which was great , however, there was barely any soup in the bowl.  I was really happy to see that they had kids meals however, for the price of the kids meal , the portion of rice was extremely small. I literally had to make my six-year-old an additional meal after he ate his jollof rice and chicken leg from here. He loved the rice, but he said that he didn’t have enough food. The staff seemed nice and  the restaurant was clean and cute.

Chances are I will be back again. Wishing this restaurant, much success.

formatted_address: 1093 W Main St Ste 204, Lewisville, TX 75067, United States
name: Lagos Island Market/kitchen

reviews.text: Good african store, very good food @ affordable prices. The customer service is top notch. I will recommend this place, anytime and anytime
Top quality service from Victoria👍 African food tasted so AUTHENTIC and power packed which is something I enjoy ☺ hopefully me and my son will be around Lewisville sometime soon again!
Food was okay. I wish the Egusi was spicy, the chicken and goat were quite tough. Maybe it  could've been better if it wasn't close to closing time. Overall it wasn’t bad

If I can give it no STAR’s⭐️ I would I was very upset about my order that I placed over the phone today an the young lady that answered was very rude an when I got there my food was ready for pickup an when I got to the car I checked my food before I pulled off an that’s when I noticed there wasn’t much of nothing in there to eat so mind you I placed an order for two an I spent $37 so I went back in there and ask her were was the rest of my food that I ordered an she replied that was everything and I told her not everything cause I just spent $37 in total she agreed to give me more egusi soup w/goat which was my order with fufu and when she added more, it still wasn’t enough, so I took what she gave me. I left the store went in my car and  checked everything thats when I seen that the goat meat was nothing but bones cover with Egusi just know I’m piss and they will never get my money or my service again ✌🏽
Nice food...I enjoyed mysel6

formatted_address: 3115 Apple Crk Ave, Crandall, TX 75114, United States
name: Mabel's African kitchen

reviews.text: The owner is super kind, friendly and I love that she made my order so quickly. Omg the food smelled so good that I pulled over to try it. Before I knew it, I had eaten half my food before driving. 😂 the meat is tender, the soups are seasoned to perfection! I’m so glad I have a place to get authentic home cooked Nigerian food from closer to my home. I’m a new regular!!! I wanted to her her I was so happy to get my order 🥰🥹

Incredible, authentic African food prepared with love. The taste is savory, satisfying, fulfilling just an overall pleasurable experience. Ms. Mabel's meal from preparation to presentation including customer service is outstanding. You have acquired a loyal customer in me.

I’ve had different kinds of meals from Mabel’s African kitchen and all of them is a hit back to back. I’ll recommend their Eforiro (vegetable soup) jollof rice, fried rice , ofada source and white rice. Also their Abula amala, ewedu and gbegiri 👌🏾
lol I had done finished the whole plate before I reviewed it was fresh and delicious probably the best I’ve had can’t wait to go back
I ordered pepper soup with goat meat it was the best. I will order again!

formatted_address: 918 E Harwood Rd B, Euless, TX 76039, United States
name: Osuma Suya

reviews.text: The thanksgiving’s lamb chops cost almost $80 after tax and fees but the portion is so measly and small. Half of the plate is onions, who even eats lamb chops with onions ? This is not enough to serve at any event, the meat is so skinny on the bone, barely any meat on these super expensive lamb chops. I now see why we could only pick up 1 day before thanksgiving, so we won’t see the scam you guys are trying to pull and leave reviews warning others. This is horrible portioning, it also was not tasty compared to your beef suya. Your staff told me the whole plate will be filled with lamb chops when I called, they did not say half onions, half skinny lamb chops… I truly could have made these lamb chops by myself for much cheaper and they would have been more delicious but I wanted to patronize you guys like i usually do, big mistake, not buying your thanksgiving options again.

I went to the Euless location and it was clean. Walked in and they were playing  Burna Boy loudly.

No issues cuz I like Burna. The lady immediately lowered the volume and got to ordering.

The Suya was delicious and Spicy. Sinus clearing. The cook is being helped by his forefathers who made Suya in the evening  by the city streets.

I have enjoyed the Suya with a quesadilla and guacamole. I have enjoyed my Suya with my rice and stew. I have enjoyed my Suya with some pineapple. I am enjoying this Suya.
Worst Suya ever! Undercooked and slimy!  Will make you sick. And the manager refused to give me a refund for it. And argues that this is what suya looks like… terrible service.

Horribly rude people. First time there, will never go again. I went in to pick up a uber order for a customer.. I was trying to find a bathroom and was told there weren't any bathrooms. I think I'll call the board of health on them since they want to lie and say they didn't have a bathroom. She didn't know I was there for a uber order. Obviously thought I was walking in off the street to use the bathroom. Don't lie and insult my intelligence. Rude as hell, will never step a foot in that place again. Only gave 1 star so I could leave this review  otherwise it would have been -10 stars!
In response to your reply, there is a difference between not allowing guests to use your bathroom and being dishonest saying you do not have a bathroom. I was not a guest I was representing a customer, since I was picking up food for a paying customer. Doing this over seven years never once heard a business tell me that they do not have a bathroom. So actually good luck with your business and your rude unprofessional disgusting attitude. Instead of apologizing for the rude behavior as most professional business owner's would do, you get on here and justify it. like I said good luck with your business, I happen to be a business owner as well and a nurse, Uber is just my side hustle.

I would rather drive to McKinney than come to this location which is closer for me. I ordered suya corn on 11/23 to be picked up on 11/26 at 3:30p. Arrived to pick up my order and waited 10 mins before asking for my order cause I wasn’t greeted. After waiting for 30 mins I was informed they don’t have the corn. To my asking they knew 2 hours prior that they didn’t have corn. Horrible communication and customer service.

formatted_address: 5610 S State Hwy 78, Sachse, TX 75048, United States
name: Palatables Shawarma & Grill

reviews.text: Tried this place for the first time and I was very very impressed. Very authentic and flavorful, amazing food options, and not overly pricey like a lot of other places. Shawarma is 🔥🔥, asun is 🔥🔥. I’ll definitely be back
Came here on a Thursday afternoon, ordered the smoky jollof rice with chicken. The food was very tasty. The man who took my order was nice. I'd visit again if I'm nearby.
We had the fufu and smoky jollof rice.  Both were delicious.  Do yourself a favor and come and eat some of this wonderful food cooked by wonderful people

I had an amazing experience at Palatable Shawarma and Grill! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. What impressed me the most was the customer service top notch from start to finish. I had a special request that wasn’t even on the menu, and he went out of his way to make it happen. Not only did he accommodate me, but he made sure I left completely satisfied. That kind of dedication and care is rare to find. Definitely my go-to spot from now on highly recommend!

I ordered to go on yesterday. The atmosphere and service was great. I ordered jollof rice, fish, and a meat pie. The tilapia fish was warm not hot like freshly fried, and texture was a bit dry. The meat pie was not fresh at all. I took one bite and trashed it.

I am in no way trying to bash your business. At the same time, I have to be honest as a paying customer.

formatted_address: 5248 Democracy Dr, Plano, TX 75024, United States
name: Naija Cafe Plano

reviews.text: My first time ordering from this restaurant through DoorDash, Ngl the puff puff is banging, love it. The efo with poundo taste good as well, but I can’t stop thinking about the puff puff, I fact the puff puff was free because I only ordered efo and poundo, thank you for making me try the puff puff. 🥰

formatted_address: 2905 E Arkansas Ln, Grand Prairie, TX 75052, United States
name: Toyin's Restaurant

reviews.text: extremely tough meat, had to ask for a menu which was just a little slip of paper. didn't finish
for sure never come again
Really love her Jellof rice and spicy chicken,couple with great customer service. Highly recommended 😍
Just tried their egusi. 10 out of 10. Flavor is amazing
Very delicious food! You can’t go wrong eating at this restaurant!

formatted_address: 401 N Central Expy #300, Richardson, TX 75080, United States
name: Zion Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
My son was craving Ethiopian food, so I hopped on Yelp to find a new place to try. We all love Ethiopian cuisine and wanted to explore somewhere different, which is how we ended up at Zion.

When we first walked in, we were warmly greeted by the woman behind the counter. She brought us menus and water right away. The dining area had a laid-back, almost country-western vibe, like it may have once been a saloon once, but it was clean and inviting.

The menu featured all the classic Ethiopian dishes we’re familiar with, and we were eager to dig in. We started with the appetizers: Sambusas and fully cooked Kitfo wraps. For our entrees, we ordered the Doro Wat and the Vegetable Sampler. Everything was fresh and delicious.

My youngest son loved the Sambusas so much that he ordered a second order just for himself! The Kitfo wraps were also tasty and the meat was well seasoned and flavorful. The vegetable sampler was full of flavor and not overly oily, which we appreciated. The Doro Wat was solid as well.

Overall, we had a great experience and would  come back to try out a few of their other dishes.

My husband and I came here for dinner last night and wow, the best Ethiopian restaurant we’ve been to! We had the kitfo wraps which had a wonderful spice to sprinkle on top as well as the Azawe beef tibs and vegetable platter which they combined into one. We even got extra injera on the side. Each bite was tastier than the one before. Our server was the daughter of the owner and she was very personable. I wish more people continue to find out about this place because it is incredible! I think they did a great job with the interior for where the location is. It was very clean and nicely decorated. We came here for dinner thinking it was next door to the Indian restaurant that used to be here, turns out, it replaced where the Indian restaurant was. It is BYOB FYI!

All in all the selling point is the wonderful lovely prepared food! More people should try and eat Ethiopian! It was a great price point to regarding the location and surrounding area!
Zion was a complete delight! The food was amazing. Flavorful, rich and colorful. Don’t get fooled by the simple atmosphere, the service and food are five star!

Would not return.
-Ye-Beg Wot (Lamb Stew) had an excessive amount of oil. Poured off a lot and it was still too oily. Made my family feel bad.
-Veggie platter was just okay.
My mother and I had a really good experience! The server helped us pick a few options and each one was delicious! We would definitely recommend and come back when in the DFW area!

formatted_address: 9560 Skillman St Suite 111, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Etopicafe

reviews.text: I was a bit skeptical to try out this place, but the food was very good! I just has a simple brunch, omelete and coffee! Everything was tasty, the omelete came with a good nice salad and avocado, the coffee was very flavorful. Angie and the Barista were very welcome. The restaurant has a good outside light and feels pretty good for a Sunday brunch! Ah, I loved the bread, the bread is like a wheat bolito and it was fresh and delicious. I

3.3 stars. Stopped in to get two coffees and some baked goods. Employee made two fresh coffees and helped me with the baked goods. Took them to a key account whose employees thought the treats were a tad dry.

WOW! The atmosphere and decoration is thoughtfully set. The bread and pastries are served warm leaving a crunchy crust and a soft and flavorful consistency on the inside. The coffee is served in an elegant form and its flavor is by far one of the best I’ve tried in the Metroplex. The food was also served carefully and did not disappoint. Highly recommended for foodies, adventurers and anyone interested in trying something new and exciting!

Etopicafe is incredible. The food was amazing, every single dish we tried was on point and full of flavor. The service was just as good, the owner and the staff had such beautiful energy, they made the whole experience feel welcoming and genuine. This is easily one of the best places I have eaten in the DFW area, I highly recommend checking it out.

Such a cool cafe. These are the type of places that I love to find. Hidden gem!

The cream puffs are extra extra delicious and the macchaito was made to perfection.
Also, loved the choice of music; amazing jazz music...

formatted_address: 5528 Alpha Rd suite 105, Dallas, TX 75240, United States
name: Koba Ethiopian Restaurant and Grocery

reviews.text:
Probably the best special kitfo I've ever had.... maybe even perfect. Something about their ayib and choice of ingredients. Maybe even how they arrange the food. Idk, but I do know I had a really good experience and and much better quality food than I was expecting.

This place is a mini mini market / mini restaraunt. Not alot going on inside, I didnt even find a bathroom. Only came for a simple dinner, but due to the size of the place and cozy feel, my dinner turned into an intimate date. Also shout out to the servers for being so chill and just on top of things. We got service and even items brought to us legitimately as we were about to ask for it. Its like the guy was reading my mind... or he has eaten the dish before and knows how delicious they make it.

Either way, id come back and I would recommend this place to others. Just not large parties unless its takeout for a large party.

I’ve been coming here for years and they’ve always done such a wonderful job. Food is flavorful and portions are generous. They’ve always been welcoming and in my opinion is the best Ethiopian cuisine in the metroplex.

Place was not too far from where we were visiting. Family member had never had Ethiopian food before and this place didn’t disappoint. Knew we were in for a special treat when it was combined with grocery items. Place was small but easily accommodated our family of 4. Staff made some excellent suggestions.
The food is excellent. If you are looking for collard greens I encourage you to try the gomen besega. I will definitely be back to explore other items on the menu

Delicious food from a small kitchen with an Ethiopian food store. The chicken tibse was flavorful and ample. The young lady that proved the service was friendly and attentive. The restaurant is quite small but when I went midday I didn't have trouble being seated. The menu looks like it's fairly small as well but if the rest is the items are as good as the chicken that doesn't really matter. Definitely plan to go back again.

formatted_address: 6882 Shady Brook Ln, Dallas, TX 75231, United States
name: Abeba Foods To Go

reviews.text: Overall, amazing food and service. It was my first time here, walked in based on the reviews and it was close to where I was working today. It is a rough part of town so be cautious. A woman greeted me when I entered and did clarify the meat is halal. I ordered beef and 2 added sides of red lentils and cabbage. It ended up being $15 for the beef plus $6 for the 2 sides. Took about 20 minutes to prepare but it was worth it because she made it fresh. Food came out of steaming hot and it was delicious!! There is a small seating area to the side. Will definitely be back. I also saw some packed Ethiopian food in the fridge in to go containers.

Absolutely delicious! The lady who helped me was very pleasant, and my food was prepared fresh, so there was a bit of a wait, but it wasn't bad at all. The other customers were friendly, making it easy to strike up a conversation while waiting. I'm glad I tried this place, and I will definitely be returning!

This place is amazing, the food is fresh and the customer service is A1. I was greeted warmly by Ado as soon as I walked in and the food came out fresh. If you are in dallas this is hands down the best place to eat ethiopian food!

The store is in a rough part of town, the food was colorless, the meat overcooked and dry, and my (takeout) food was not ready when I showed up 10 minutes after the ETA.  I paid $25 for lamb gruel, which I will note was $13 two years ago, that seemed to have been ladled from an old batch. Go somewhere else

Exceptional Ethiopian food. My grandparents lived in Jimma for fifteen years, and my grandmother learned how to cook while there. Abeba’s food sends me back to my youth.

On top of that, the portions are so generous! My partner and I can make daily split a dish and be happy! Can’t recommend the doro wet enough. And!! The doro wet came with two legs and two chicken legs. As the name implies, this is a to go place. However the two tables are a nice place to wait with comforting artwork.

TLDR: order here to be transported to Addis Ababa. Great portions, kind people, and incredible flavor!

formatted_address: 430 N Coit Rd #400, Richardson, TX 75080, United States
name: Sheba's Kitchen

reviews.text: This is only my second time here as I am from 8 hours away but both times at Sheba’s Kitchen has been marvelous. The staff is friendly and ready to assist newcomers with food options. The flavors are fantastic but I may be biased as 23andMe says I’m 0.1% Ethiopian.
It was our first time trying Etiopian food.  It was amazing.  Staff was friendly and helpful.  Try the honey wine amazing

Sheba’s Ethiopian Kitchen is an amazing place! The food is absolutely delicious — especially the beef stew dish called the Dallas Special, which I highly recommend. The waitress was very kind and welcoming, and the atmosphere is spacious and comfortable. I don’t usually visit many Ethiopian restaurants, but I really enjoyed this one. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking to try authentic and flavorful Ethiopian cuisine.

I’m honestly confused by all the top reviews, because my experience was completely different.  My friend and I walked in and were told it was open seating, so we sat at the bar. There were three staff members actively working behind the bar, but after several minutes of waiting, no one approached us to take our order. We made eye contact with two of the ladies, who both intentionally avoided us. It wasn’t until one of them came over to clear a dirty glass nearby that we were able to stop her and ask for drinks.
We ordered water, a soda, and an espresso. We got the water and soda, but never the espresso. A few minutes later, a gentleman sat down near us, ordered his espresso  and received it right away which was frustrating considering we had already been waiting quite a while. When the server finally came back to take our food order (again, only after we called her over), she didn’t give us the chance to finish asking our questions about the menu. I was asking about the combination platters how many meats and vegetables come with each and if substitutions were allowed but it felt like i was being brushed off. The server assumed our choices without clarification.
After we ordered, we waited again, only to find out later that the order had never been sent to the kitchen. By this point, we had been sitting there for nearly an hour. When we asked about the status of the food, she casually said it hadn’t been sent in yet. At that point, we decided to leave. We paid for the soda and walked out.
For such a highly rated restaurant, the lack of basic service and attentiveness was disappointing. We were sitting right in front of the bar  not hidden, not in a corner  yet we were never acknowledged or checked on. No one asked if we wanted to start with drinks or appetizers, and we had to flag people down just to be served water and a soda.

We had an amazing lunch with friends and were very well taken care of by Kal. We finished the meal with the traditional coffee service which was very special. Will definitely be back soon to try even more of the cuisine.

formatted_address: 207 Martha St ste a, Euless, TX 76040, United States
name: Habesha Cafe

reviews.text:
This was the best Ethiopian food I’ve ever had, and my friend and I’s families loved it when we brought the leftovers home too! I highly recommend the federation platter and veggie platter. The yebeg siga alicha and yemesir wot were my favorite dishes, and my friend loved the shiro and minchet. The chai was great too!

The owner was very friendly and helped us learn more about the food.

Was going to leave solid 4 starts. Place is nice and clean. Food was simple but good. It was my first time trying Ethiopian food and I wasn’t  “wow-ed” though I did like it. The thing that elevated my experience was coffee. I loved the presentation and flavor is really good. I didn’t have to add anything and could just sip black coffee by itself (in most places you can’t).  I admit this coffee pot can easily be shared by 2 people and I might not sleep tonight 🤣.

This is a nice little gem spot to come to when you can. This restaurant is clean with great service. The food was fresh and delicious. I had hot tea with the veggies platter. There's nice jazz music to enjoy. This is a positive energy place for sure..... enjoy

WOW!!!! My family and I were beyond pleasantly surprised to find this restaurant after leaving the airport. We love Ethiopian food so much and this place did not disappoint. The owner was so hospitable.She made my 3 and 5 year old a special dish that she thought they would love. My husband and I loved our food. The coffee was also delicious even without sugar and creamer. Very clean and welcoming . We will be back if we’re ever in the area again. Thank you!!!!

This place is a hidden gem. The atmosphere was nice.The people were friendly and they greet you would smiles. The food is amazing i will be back. You guys will be seeing a lot of me. This was my first time trying Ethiopian food i must say it was amazing. And the lady that took my order was beautiful and had a beautiful smile and was very friendly. This is a very friendly atmosphere. I recommend everybody try them.

formatted_address: 2425 W Walnut St #200, Garland, TX 75042, United States
name: Surma Grocery and Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
The food was delectable and flavorful! The portion was very generous! The coffee with incense was a delight! The atmosphere was peaceful and service was great!  Owner is very kind and sincere! A must go to Ethiopian restaurant!

Thanks so much Surma!

I recently visited Surma Ethiopian Restaurant for the first time, and it was an incredible experience. My entire group was new to Ethiopian cuisine, so I we weren’t sure where to start, but our waitress walked us through the menu, explained the different dishes, and gave thoughtful recommendations that made us feel comfortable trying something new.

The food itself was delicious! Everything tasted extremely fresh and perfectly seasoned. The grass fed beef was fantastic.

What stood out most was the warm, welcoming atmosphere. It’s clear that the staff truly care about making guests feel at home, whether they’re longtime fans of Ethiopian food or trying it for the very first time.

If you’re curious about Ethiopian cuisine—or just looking for a cozy place with incredible food and hospitality—I can’t recommend Surma highly enough. I’ll definitely be coming back!

They discriminate against amongst their own customers. Their customer service depends what is your status in the community. Good luck if it’s your first visit here , they will give you the trashy and worst meat part they can get for highest price in the town . If you are a woman they think you don’t know anything about the quality of the meat. If you ask for special order, the guy at the counter calls the owner to check your familiarity on his eyes..and the owner stare at you for 10 seconds like profiling you before he accepts the request.

For meat buyers, don’t waste your money
1.if it’s your first visit ,or have no any profile according to them
2. If you are a women
3. If you are not dining in the restaurant not you not going to drink there
This was the best Ethiopian food we’ve had in Dallas. The service was friendly and the atmosphere made you want to stay longer than planned. We will be back soon.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had an amazing experience at Surma! The food was truly authentic and full of flavor. I tried kurt, kilkel, kitfo, shkila-tibes, awaze tebis and many more everything was fresh and delicious. The portions were generous and the quality was excellent. The atmosphere felt warm and welcoming, and the service was outstanding, very friendly and attentive.

This is definitely one of the best Ethiopian restaurants I’ve been to, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to enjoy real traditional Ethiopian food. I’ll definitely be coming back!

formatted_address: 9560 Skillman St #100, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Sinï - Ethiopian Restaurant and Coffee Lounge

reviews.text:
Sini Ethiopian Restaurant and Coffee Lounge was excellent. I ordered the goat dish and it was tender, well-seasoned, and packed with flavor, easily one of the best goat plates I’ve had. I paired it with their coffee, which was strong, smooth, and the perfect finish to the meal.

The space felt comfortable and inviting, and the service was warm and attentive without being overbearing. Even just off one visit and one main dish, I’d still highly recommend Sini to anyone in the DFW area looking for quality Ethiopian food and great coffee.
Glad to find this place! authentic food and I’d come back next time I’m in the area)

I’ve ordered multiple dishes via DoorDash and just wow — the flavors, textures and portions are incredible. We have a decent selection of Ethiopian restaurants in DFW, and Sini is by far the best I’ve had.

You can’t go wrong with any dish, but highly recommend the Kitfo Dulet (Lebleb - cooked medium), the Firfir (Quanta - Dried Beef), and of course, Extra Injera because it is so addicting.

Absolutely loved the experience here and would recommend this spot to everyone. The restaurant was very spacious inside and had beautiful decorations everywhere. The service here was amazing- the staff helped me with recommendations, checked up on me, and taught me how to eat the dish properly. As for the food, it was just as good as the service. I ordered the Beef Tibs which is described as “tender pieces of marinated beef sauteed with onions, garlic, jalapenos, and fresh tomatoes; served juicy, dry, or zilzil.” The dish came with plenty of injera (Ethiopian flatbread). I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of the dish and can’t wait to come back. This restaurant deserves more recognition and I hope more people get to enjoy this spot as much as I did.

I have never in my life been so ignored by people who I believe are in business to serve the public.  I sat down asked the waitress for a menu and 15 minutes later I was wondering whether she knew I existed.  It was clear that they were not used to having non-Ethiopian customers.  After another 5 minutes, I simply got up and walked out.  The atmosphere was giving "you're not welcome", the service was terrible and the food was never served.  If I could have given a star lower than one I would have.

formatted_address: 5528 Alpha Rd suite 105, Dallas, TX 75240, United States
name: Agoza gebya

reviews.text:
Ordered Geba-weta Tibs and Quanta firfir halves to go, I loved both. The food was delicious - the firfir was spicy, the Tibs was soft & aromatic.
The owner was also kind and helpful.
Highly recommended!

This place is legit a gem. The food is ridiculously delicious. With my favorite Ethiopian spot shutting down last year, I’m so glad I found this place. This is definitely the best Ethiopian spot in Dallas that’s open. One of the best spots for African food. It’s a small mart with only a few tables!

I had the beyaynetu (vegetarian platter) and beef tibbs. The beef tibbs was so flavorful and tasty. The broth/liquid it sits in is amazing. Dipping injera in that was so good. The vegetarian platter was incredible. The different lentils and peas are cooked to perfection with delicious spice.

I also had shiro! It’s not on their display menu but they’ll make it for you. It’s a chickpea stew and great to dip injera in! The Ethiopian coffee was also really good.

Very friendly staff and service. During my meal, different staff members came up to me at different times individually to see how everything was going. I really appreciated that.

Please try this place if you haven’t! It’s proof that Ethiopian cuisine is one of the best cuisines you can experience. I will 100% be returning for a second visit.

Visited here for lunch with a friend. We ordered the chicken tibse and vegetarian combination. Hands down the best Ethiopian food we’ve had the north dallas area. Slightly pricey but the portion size was really good. The wait for food was long, primarily because everything is cooked fresh and to order, but it was totally worth it. Very friendly staff :) definitely visiting this place more often.

Food was horrible they forgot my salad I asked for my food to be mild they sliced jalapeños and placed them on top.the tibs had no curry sauce no flavor at all. I will continue to eat at Desta. This place was 50 thumbs down.

Best Ethiopian food I’ve had in Dallas. I’ve tried 2 other popular places but the food just is not as good! I love it here! Today I got the chicken tibse and cabbage. I’ve had the beef, lamb, and veggie plates before. All are delicious

formatted_address: 2148 E Belt Line Rd, Richardson, TX 75081, United States
name: Zemen Bar & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Quaint little cafe style Ethiopian restaurant that serves a full menu of Ethiopian staples.  Most of the food was tasty but a few observations:

1. Sambosas were served with very cold fillings. We sent it back and they quickly fixed it
2. We got the meats selection for two.  Some of the meats weren't exactly tender and very fatty and chewy. If we informed the owner, he would have quickly rectified the situation.

3. Service was mediocre even though the staff was very friendly and cordial.   We had to summon the wait staff multiple times and that could give the impression we were needy.  Normal perusal by wait staff would eliminate this.

4. The Ethiopian coffee is my favorite but it took almost 30 minutes or more to get a cup.  Maybe because they actually roast and grind the beans on demand?

I will return on a different day to try other things on the menu.  The people were nice and friendly and for that reason, I will return.

We’ve eaten here twice, and the food has been inconsistent. The vegetables have been good both times, but the meats have been hit or miss. The lamb tibs were just okay. The beef tibs, however, were dry, chewy, and so fatty that we couldn’t even chew or swallow most of it — we ended up spitting out so many pieces we just stopped eating. We called the restaurant hoping to return the tray (not for a refund, but to show we didn’t eat it) and see if it could be remade or exchanged for something else. If we return, it’ll likely be to try the vegetarian lunch buffet, since the veggies have been the only consistent highlight.

By far the best Ethiopian food I have ever had!! The server was really sweet and suggested the spicy Tibs. Atmosphere was clean and sleek looking. I appreciate the fresh roses on the tables. Will be back when I’m up in DFW!

Probably the best Ethiopian restaurant I’ve visited in the USA. The service is fantastic, the food is very well seasoned and the portions are excellent at the price point.
The tibs and kitfo are made to perfections. The addition of Asmara beer, zibib and home made Tej complete a great experience.
This is an excellent addition to the DFW area.

Walked in and was greeted immediately, service was just as awesome as the food. Had some questions about the menu since it was my first time at an Ethiopian restaurant and the staff explained everything. I had the Juicy beef Tibs and Sambusa, there was 5 but ate before I remembered to take a picture. Will be back!

formatted_address: 9560 Skillman St, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Abeba Grocery

reviews.text: 1st time ordering from here. Placed an order on Uber eats. The food was hot and delicious. Best Ethiopian food I’ve had since leaving Kenya in 2024. I’ve eaten at the expensive Ethiopian food places in Dallas and there is no comparison. I’ll be returning as long as the food stays like this. Peace and blessings!

Came in for a quick late lunch and left seriously impressed. The veggie combo was outstanding—packed with flavor and served in generous portions. The staff was attentive throughout, adding to an already great experience. From the taste alone, you can tell the rest of the menu is going to be top-notch. I’ll definitely be back.

All 10s across the board. This is my second time dining at Abeba grocery and I’ve enjoyed both my experiences. We had dry tibs and quanta firfir, which both tasted amazing. The owner took great care of us, I will definitely be coming back!

In Dallas for the theatre and made the drive to check out the food. Everything was very fresh and extremely delicious. Portions were very generous, the price was reasonable, and the injera was superb. I appreciated the hospitality of the chef and staff members. They were very helpful in describing dishes, answering every question, and providing overall great conversation. I do not drink coffee but was talked into buying green beans for my mother and roasting them myself. I was very hesitant, but followed the directions. Unfortunately you all have created a monster and she will now only accept Ethiopian green beans roasted at home, lol. So see you all again soon!

1st experience eating Ethiopian food and Yonic was a great host and very helpful in helping me choose a dish. I went with the beef tips with collard greens and red lentils. The food did not disappoint!!! Will be back when in town for sure.

formatted_address: 100 Central Expy ste 65, Richardson, TX 75080, United States
name: Addis Abeba Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Nikki was very attentive and gave my friend and I a lot of information as what to order.
We went with the veggie sampler and added chicken with mild sauce.
My goodness it was exceptionally delicious. My friend ordered one to go for her lunch the following day.
More people need to know about this gem. Been here many times and the food is always wonderful. I get the Taste of Etheopia platter which has been delicious and filling every time

I recently had the chance to visit an Ethiopian restaurant and bar located at 100 Central Expy Ste 65, Richardson, TX 75080. I arrived around 12:20 AM and noticed a keyboard playing music that gave off a band-like vibe. But that’s not what prompted me to write this review.

What truly stood out was the lack of service. Despite the restaurant having only a few customers, no one approached me to take my order. I sat at a table near the balcony, clearly visible to the staff. One of the customers even pointed toward me to alert them, but still, no one came. After waiting for 10 minutes, I had no choice but to leave.

As a Habesha visiting from the DMV area for a short two-week business trip, I had hoped to enjoy a warm, welcoming experience. Unfortunately, this visit was disappointing. I also explored four other Habesha spots in the area, and all of them featured hookah, which made it difficult to enjoy a proper meal.

In my opinion, I wouldn’t recommend this particular establishment—or any of the Habesha restaurants I visited in the area—if you’re looking for good hospitality, a clean environment, and a non-hookah dining experience.

Came in about half an hour before closing time and was still served a fresh platter of lovingly prepared Ethiopian food. It wasn't as spicy as I expected but I think they tailored it to my assumed Western palate. Next time I go in I will ask them to make it spicy. Serving was so generous that it was impossible to finish, even sharing it with a friend. Definitely worth checking out if you are interested in trying new things from around the world.

This is the best Ethiopian food I've ever had in Texas hands down. Y'all are amazing and thank you for such a wonderful service and meal. It was wonderful and I loved the classical music and real relaxed atmosphere

formatted_address: 117 Murphy Rd, Murphy, TX 75094, United States
name: Merkato Ethiopian Restaurant And Grocery

reviews.text:
I was really excited to try this place after seeing all the good reviews. Ordered the sample platter, which was pretty good, although less food than I've had at other restaurants.

While the food was good and the service was fairly friendly, the main issue I have is with the practice of bringing out additional food that seemed like it was comped, only to be charged for things we didn't originally order. Just take a note of that cultural practice that I wasn't aware of.

Took my parents here to try Ethiopian food for the first time. Really great experience, the service was really friendly and the food was amazing. They were able to make the tibs, dry tibs, and vegetable sampler not spicy. The dry tibs was especially so good, coming out sizzling and so tasty with the injera bread. Overall a great dinner and will definitely be back.

First time trying  Ethiopia food. We (2 people) ordered  the meat and veggie platter.  Everything  thing on this plate was delicious and flavorful and be both we're  stuffed.
Definitely recommend trying this Cafe, the staff was very friendly and welcoming .

Food was delicious. Had the injera with beef. The lentils on the place were my favorite. Having this combination is a mouthful of flavor that you have to try at least one time. It’s a great find here in Murphy and authentic  Ethiopian cuisine.

Mercato Ethiopian Grocery and Café is truly a gem in Murphy! The service is warm, welcoming, and attentive, making every visit a great experience. The food is absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and authentic. From start to finish, everything about this place feels excellent, from the atmosphere to the quality of both the grocery and café sides.

If you’re looking for authentic Ethiopian cuisine and wonderful service, I highly recommend Mercato. It’s a place you’ll want to come back to again and again!

formatted_address: 10190 Forest Ln #125, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Sheger Ethiopian Grocery ,Ethiopian Food to Go

reviews.text: This was my first time ever eating at a store like this. It’s a very small grocery/ kitchen that cooks authentic Ethiopian food. Spices and scent was really strong but the food I tried was really good. They said it was lamb.  This dish normally comes on some kind of bread but because I’m gluten free they were able to accommodate me with rice instead. I just thought $17 bucks was a bit much. But lamb is not a cheap piece of meat so I guess I’ll pay that price because I will be back.
I was buying 2.5 pound lamb meat half of it fat it’s trash

This is my Mom's store she cooks amazing. The Ingera is Immaculate here. And, Thanks for the great and bad reviews. Because they will help become better as a business >3
THANK YOU SO MUCH
I love the place but it’s kinda small.  You can only fit 10 guests for the half of it is a regular store. It’s always quiet and their food is good
I give this store / eatery five points because I love breads and spices and the lady that cooks is very nice have not tried their restaurant food yet but will on my next visit

formatted_address: 9241 Skillman St, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Dukem dallas

reviews.text: I spent 243.90 $ and I went home and opened it was so…….i attached the picture I’m very embarrassed for my gusts with small with small ball a lot of beef and it’s just messed up with a plastic bag no respect

I bought 8 pounds of meat for Kurt and Kitfo after 15 minutes of waiting. He weighed it showing me the pound. I didn’t open the box to look at it because I trusted him. This was for my gusts, then no body wanted to eat at home because the meat was rotten and Trash. These grocery owners kept playing the Trash game on costumers. They deserve 0 star.
We had the best Ethiopian dish, and the atmosphere was excellent. The raw meat “Tire siga” was fresh and tasty.

When we went in there was really nice music playing the service was excellent when we walked in they greeted us when we ordered our food it came in REALLY fast we got are drinks the best part was the food the tibs was really good and the meat

Don’t order you food online on Tuesday, even call to order! It will redirect you to order online and the place is closed on Tuesday. I don’t know why they have the system that don’t work. I ended going to the restaurant to pick up my order and it was closed. Funny thing is, it charges you online.
I hope they take of it

formatted_address: 112 N McKinney St, Richardson, TX 75081, United States
name: Megenagna Cafe & Bar

reviews.text: It's a truly delightful spot with a wonderfully pleasant atmosphere. The ambiance here is quite inviting, making it a joy to spend time. The selection of music perfectly complements the surroundings. It creates a soothing and enjoyable auditory experience. This combination makes for a very agreeable environment. You'll find it a great place to relax.
Love coming here for a night out — the atmosphere is amazing and the place feels VERY secure. Always comfortable!
The best place to hung out and have a good drinks in Dallas TX i have been there several times when I was in Dallas and I can’t wait to go back again .
Megenagna Café does an amazing job keeping the space very secure and comfortable for everyone. Truly appreciate that.

reviews.text: I was so disappointed when I received my orders. The Gored Gored was made with the sauce that tasted like tomatoes and the meat used wasn’t for this type of meal. I ordered Tomato firfir and the picture they had advertised was the tomatoes salad with jalapeño peppers and injera firfir but I received and actual firfir which was the same as my other order. I ordered Sambusa and they charged me $7.98 for one piece. The price is very high for the type of food served.
Best hookah I’ve had in Dallas (strong) - highly recommend! Yeti was also incredibly friendly. Very welcoming, it felt like we were guests in someone’s home. Will definitely be back.
I think her name was yeti, terrible customer service .we ordered the veggies combo and didn’t like it at all, it didn’t taste fresh at all -it tasted as if it was made weeks ago.dont recommend at all

I ordered a veggie combo and it was terrible, I’ve eaten at a few places in the city and this has been my least favorite. the food was cold and tasteless, the portion was small for a $17 plate!! it was mostly injera. I asked for a refund and was refused . Would not recommend.

The food was outstanding, you can tell the kitchen puts a lot of thought into the dishes and I really enjoyed it - I had the firfir Tibs, the meat was well seasoned and it had a nice kick. The atmosphere was great for our party - we had about 13 people with us and the food came out on time for us all. We enjoyed drinks with the owner and overall had a great time. We had a birthday in our party and they made sure she felt special on her day. I highly recommend the restaurant- parking was easy and getting in and out was a breeze.

The atmosphere was inviting and cozy, making it the ideal spot for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. If you're looking for the best carryout restaurant in town, look no further than Habesha Express. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

This is the worst habesha restaurant I have ever seen. The inside of the restaurant looks nice and a little bit dark. I ordered veggie combo (በየአይነቱ), the food looks good visually. name: Gojo | Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: Oh boy… where do I begin?… Took my family here to try something new and I wish we had just gotten happy meals instead. The food took over an hour to come out and it was not worth the wait. It came out cold like it’s been sitting there waiting longer than we were. The worst part of it all was when I had asked to speak to the manager she was so adamant about how it’s not that cold and that we were not waiting that long! Not even apologetic. How rude of the owner to infer that we were lying when the food was not even warm!

The beef sambusa is absolutely DIVINE! and the Beer was delicious 😋 I recommend the Bozena Shiro and the Veggie combination 🤤 The lamb and beef are well seasoned and the atmosphere is cozy, but one kick back is they are closed on tuesdays now! 😵 I found out by driving almost 2 hours to discover that 💔

It was just OK. We love Ethiopian food. These guys had all of the standard fare.  The service was based because our waitress didn't speak much English.  Eventually the manager had to come out to clarify our order.  There are other better choices,  we won't go back

I am, in any way, qualified to review the quality of Ethiopian food.  This is only the fourth Ethiopian restaurant I've visited.   The food tastes great!  There are so many flavors and we were stuffed.  I've never tried Ethiopian coffee before but I liked it.  I can't say how it rates against other Ethiopian coffees but it had a wide variety of interesting flavors that rolled out after each sip.  I loved it.

The location is a bit old and run down, which is why I can't give it five stars.  It is a tiny room with a bar on one side, a row of video slots on another wall, and a partition blocking a smoking room?  Not sure.  But, if you can get past that, the staff are friendly and the food is great.

I really enjoyed my visit there.

This place was amazing my wife and I went just to try something different. When we entered didn't know what to think it looks like a bar, but then was created by Kola she was the hosted and the waitress and bartender.
Quiet place, we didn't know what to get so Kola explained what was good and gave her recommendations.
What she recommended was amazing. The food was great she was great.
If we lived in town we would come back more often.

formatted_address: 8989 Forest Ln, Dallas, TX 75243, United States
name: Sheba's Ethiopian Kitchen

reviews.text: Outstanding service, excellent cuisine. Ordered the half half special with chicken and beef. $16 and easily feeds two. Lively atmosphere, full service bar, family friendly. The spices were just perfect and served with a smile. We will be back!

First time trying Ethiopian food! I have always wanted to try Injera bread and the veggies combo was delicious - my fave was the collar greens, the yellow potatoes, and the cabbage. My husband ordered the other plate and liked the soupy flavor but didn't think it was lamb, it was goat.

This was my first experience with Ethiopian dishes. I enjoyed the flavors, spices, and presentation. The best part was eating with your natural born utensils, your hands. The injera (pancake-like flatbread) is used to scoop the food to eat. This is a uber casual mom and pop atmosphere. You can watch sports near the bar area. The staff was very friendly and attentive. The portions are plentiful. This is a good place to meet up with friends and family to eat.

My friends and I had a great time at Sheba’s!! Just a heads up for those who haven’t tried Ethiopian food before.. you eat with your hands. Unless you’re eating soup, of course. I haven’t asked, but I’m sure they would supply silverware for those who rather not use their fingers to eat. When our server learned that it was my birthday, she made coffee on the house! That was very sweet of her and the coffee was very, very good! Ask for some steamed milk on the side with your coffee! You won’t regret it!
Great food, came out quick. I’ve been to other Ethiopian restaurants where food took long time, but not this one. Will definitely come back again.

reviews.text: I must say the food and the service here is very good! I was a little concerned by other reviews as to how long the food would take to arrive as I am on my lunch break! But the food arrive quickly! I had the veggie platter! As I am on the Daniel fast til good Friday, it was very good! I will be bring my family here to try it our really soon! Come on out to try it! You will enjoy it!

I really wanted to rate this place well because the food was good, but the truth is it too us over 1 hour to get food after ordering. I don't think it was the waiters fault, because there was only one waiter/bartender for maybe 15 people there. The manager should just have more staffed. I enjoyed the meal but won't be returning
I absolutely love this place! We make the one hour drive often because it is worth it! Always have great food and service.

When we entered the restaurant we were so excited to finally try Ethiopian food, especially after hearing this place was good. However our experience was very disappointing. We waited for what seemed like an hour to finally be served. We thought they were closing, there was barely anyone there and we arrived at 9pm. The food took more than an hour to come out and was served cold. I can’t understand how food that takes an hour can be cold. Even the rice I ordered to warm it up was cold. We were waiting to get the waitress’s attention to tell her and she was no where to be found. It took multiple attempts to get the attention of another waitress to try to solve our issue. Both waitresses were telling us different things towards how the food should be prepared. The service seemed like it was being performed by amateurs. She reported to our waitress and she repeatedly tried to apologize as if it could be made better. I was thinking they wouldn’t charge us for the cold food and they did! I mean I am African and have grew up having African food and it couldn’t even compare. If you do not know anything about Ethiopian food DO NOT COME HERE! It seemed like only the Ethiopians were being serviced. I mean the place wasn’t even busy. Very mad that the owner has the audacity to respond to terrible comments and tell them to come back. What I need is a refund and most importantly this needs to be resolved within the establishment. This was the first time I didn’t tip because the service and the food was that bad. I NEVER write reviews but this needs to be called out! If I could give this place zero stars I would!!!
**UPDATE
Just when things seemed to be terrible they took a turn for the worse. I just realized after writing this review I was overcharged for the “side of rice” I ordered; as an entree. I called the restaurant and the owner wanted me to drive to receive my money back, instead of taking matters into their hands and just calling back my credit card company or even canceling the order and redoing it. PLEASE DO NOT COME HERE!!!!!Angry can’t even describe my emotions. After speaking with the owner and telling them the terrible reviews I wrote on both yelp and google I was told “that’s fine.” How is disappointing your customers fine?

Nice small kinda out of the way. Good for date day/night.  Drinks are poured heavy handed, but who's complaining about that? Right!  The food is excellent. I like the vegetarian combo with injera. Every now and then I like to do something totally different. This was a pleasant surprise. Best kept secret in Norrh Dallas.

reviews.text: If you ever get lucky enough to come here, you will not be disappointed… The food is incredible. The staff is super nice.
