Four stars is an above average score, mostly earned due to the uniqueness and strong flavors of the food. I rated this restaurant in a category above a burger joint, but below a steak house. Three stars is what you would expect; not above average, but not poor.

We came to Heritage African Restaurant expecting a different dining experience, and we were not disappointed. The menu was full of unique and interesting dishes. They had a full bar, but we decided to stick with non-alcoholic drinks. I had a ginger pineapple juice, which was amazing. I would come back just for this. My partner had a Sene Gambian Long Island, which was also good. Each of these drinks cost $6.

We started off with Chicken Fataya, a pastie like dish. They come on a plate of three, and we got two chicken and one seafood. They were quite good, and came with a great dipping sauce.

For dinner, I ordered the Dibi Afra Suya, which is grilled lamb. It came with a side of rice, and both grilled and pickled onions. The lamb was bone-in, as I expected it would be. I do have to say, I prefer it boneless. The lamb had very good seasoning, but some of the pieces were tough. Both the grilled and pickled onions were flavorful and both tasted different. My partner got the Tilapia, which was a full fish with both a head and a tail. This made it a bit difficult to eat, and he thought that the meat near the skin was a bit fishy tasting. It came with a very good salsa-like bowl.

The total bill after tax but before tip came to $79.07. I will absolutely be coming back, but due to the price compared to the food quality I won't become a regular. I think it was fun for a unique experience and tasting new things. Plus, the ginger pineapple juice.

formatted_address: 1755 Duncan Ave, DuPont, WA 98327, United States
name: Fela’s Nigerian kitchen takeout and catering

reviews.text:
Fela’s Kitchen is truly a gem! The flavors are bold, authentic, and clearly prepared with love. I ordered egusi, fufu, and jollof rice, and everything tasted like home-cooked Nigerian comfort food. The portions were generous, the food was fresh, and the seasoning was absolutely perfect.

Customer service was also excellent communication was smooth, pickup was easy, and everything was packaged neatly. It’s rare to find Nigerian food in this area that tastes this good and consistent. I’ll definitely be ordering again. Highly recommended!

I just bought food from there now. I’ve been looking for African food for a long time and just got into town. But I tell you this was the best African food I’ve ever tasted in Washington. The quality of the egusi was so good. I shared it with a couple of my friends and they all loved it. It was actually one of my friends. An Asian guy who works at a hospital that referred me. All of us here are so addicted to it. Thank you fellas kitchen for bringing Nigerian fine home cooking back. I’m glad I tried it

I don't know who is getting paid to do these reviews but I'm going to tell my truth!  I seen this place online And I wanted to try egusi an fufu For the first time and I love to support small business. When I contacted the business, the communication was very poor. Then once I sent my payment, it was no communication for a little bit, which made me scared because I thought I was getting scammed. She finally answered me back and sent the address.. When I got there, the person took forever to come bring me my food and when she did, she was very rude. She just handed it to me and went back. Another red flag then when I get home, the food looked at absolutely disgusting before I even took a bite and I said you know what let me taste it first and when I did, I literally was only able to take one bite, and I immediately threw it in the trash. I am not want to waste food, but there's absolutely no way I could even finish it. There was a big hunk of tough meat right in the middle, and the fufu was not even done. I did contact her and let her know and all she did was say sorry you didn't like the food. She didn't offer me a small discount to try to make it right or anything and once I told her about herself and how she didn't care about her customers in her business then she tried to do what I suggested, which you should've done in the first place if you care about the integrity of your business and customers! My advice is save your money and go somewhere else not worth it and I wasted $40 and I drove an hour and a half on my birthday to be very disappointed! Her making it right could have literally changed the situation to where I wouldn't have felt so bad and I would've gave her another chance in the future but she put that on herself she didn't even try! I will never go here again! Quiet

Let me start with her food is fresh. I’ve ordered food and it’s warmed up food from other kitchens. The reason I know it’s fresh is because I told her what I didn’t want in my soup and it was done! That’s a big plus. I’m American but have been married to a Nigerian for a while now and I’ve even learned how to cook the dishes and my husband is a great cook and I’m so surprised you can find this type of food around here. Her food taste so good I definitely recommend and will be ordering again. Good job, madam I ordered Jollof rice w/ chicken I will say I don’t like thyme in my jollof but was still good and I ordered egusi w/ goat both. Very pleased 😌

I got the agoyin beans and agege bread, and I’d give them a solid 10/10. The jollof is also a 10/10; it tastes just like the jollof at Naija parties. The turkey stew? Definitely 10/10 too. Everything is delicious. You all need to check out this food!

formatted_address: 5999 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Weyni Market & Catering

reviews.text: Weyni Catering was absolutely amazing! I ordered catering twice  once for my brother’s graduation and once for a wall party and both times the food was a huge hit. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared.The service was smooth, and the quality was consistent for both events. Our guests kept asking where the food was from! I truly appreciate how reliable and delicious Weyni Catering is. Highly recommend for any special occasion or celebration!

Weyni catered my graduation party, and the food was absolutely phenomenal! Everything she prepared was delicious, and her service went above and beyond. She worked so hard to make sure everything was perfect, and it truly showed in both the quality of the food and the service. Her work truly speaks for itself!

We used Weyni Catering for our wedding reception. The food was extraordinary... absolutely delicious, full of flavor, with many meat and vegetarian options, and a hit among everyone in attendance. They were easy to work with even though our party was in Tacoma. Highly recommend!

Weyni Market and Catering is amazing! The food is out of this world. I had the veggie dish and it was absolutely delicious. On top of that, Weyni is so welcoming and kind — she makes you feel like family. Highly recommend!

BEST ETHIOPIAN FOOD IN SEATTLE! Everything is so yummy and authentic, absolutely amazing. Anyone who’s saying otherwise is lying or doesn’t know anything about Ethiopian food. Love this place and catering service!!

formatted_address: 4701 S Semoran Blvd STE B, Orlando, FL 32822, United States
name: Delightful Nigerian Cuisine

reviews.text: The Nigerian food was absolutely delicious. Everything was well seasoned, flavorful, and tasted authentic. The spices were rich without being overwhelming, and the portions were very satisfying. You can tell a lot of care went into preparing the meal..I’d definitely order it again

This was my first time ordering. I was a little skeptical. But wow! The food portions were incredible. The service was fast and efficient, and even when I didnt receive a tint add on, she went above and beyond to deliver it again. As for the taste, being a full Nigerian, I can tell you that the taste is incredible. Just like the local vendors in nigeria. Plus, they do platters. I know I wont be cooking as much now that I can order meals for the week.

Amazing dining experience! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, perfect for dine-in. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic Nigerian cuisine. Every dish was well-seasoned and served hot, with generous portions. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure we felt comfortable throughout our visit. You can tell a lot of care goes into both the cooking and the service. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy real Nigerian food in a relaxed, clean, and inviting setting. I’ll definitely be back!

I recently dined at your restaurant and wanted to share what a wonderful experience it was. The food was absolutely outstanding from start to finish.
Every dish we ordered was prepared beautifully and bursting with flavor. You could taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into each plate. The seasoning was spot-on, and the presentation showed real attention to detail. It’s clear your kitchen team takes pride in their craft.
The balance of flavors in each dish was impressive, and everything arrived at our table at the perfect temperature. We left feeling completely satisfied and already planning our next visit.
Thank you for such a memorable meal. It’s restaurants like yours that make dining out special.

This place is wonderful! From the incubator to this beautiful restaurant! Clean very nice, designed beautifully and exceptional service with a smile. The flavors are wonderful and nice size portions. Worth every dollar!  The vibe is unmatched!! Love it here!!

formatted_address: 14200 Tukwila International Blvd Suite 141, Tukwila, WA 98168, United States
name: Karibu Zanzibar Cuisine

reviews.text: This was our first time trying east African cuisine. It was scrumptious, bursting with flavors. The staff were exceptionally helpful in guiding us, describing all their dishes. Lena was such a superb host.  Highly recommend this

My friend and I had been wanting to visit this restaurant for so long that we braved 1 hour of heavy traffic to finally do it. What a disappointment! Zanzibar is known for their amazing cuisine thanks to the spices that they have grown and traded for centuries. Unfortunately none of that was reflected in the food at Karibu.

The food was so so so bad! So bad I cannot find the right adjective to describe it. We ordered several dishes: The ugali and spinach were pretty good, and so was the muhogo. The nyama choma beef was clearly boiled and then pan fried. There was nothing roasted about it. No char marks anywhere but there was oil on the plate. The chicken wings that came with the muhogo were a frozen pre-made item like you get at the grocery store in the freezer section with hot sauce poured over it.

The biryani rice was so bad it deserves its own comment: It was simply boiled rice with some saffron-colored stuff thrown on top. No oil, no herbs , no spices, no nothing! Heck, it wasn't even basmati rice. Boiled basmati rice with oil and salt only has more flavor and aroma than whatever that was. The beef that came with it looked like it had spices but we could not taste them. It was really tasteless and bizarre. The kachumbari had no flavor....at all. How does one make flavorless kachumbari??? At some point we genuinely felt (and hoped) that we were getting pranked. I am a good cook, and I cannot give such food to someone for free, let alone try to charge them.

We had ordered sambusas but they were never delivered, so I cannot comment on their taste or quality.

Overall this was by far the worst food experience that we have ever had. We are food lovers who try a new restaurant at least once a month and this is the only place we have sworn to never go back to.
We left still hungry but thankfully they are located across the street from Juba restaurant. We walked into Juba and they righted all our wrongs. We were more than happy to order enough food to eat there and take some home to wash away any memories of our experience at Karibu.

As for the 5 star reviews, I swear they were either paid, doing it to support the business, or they went at a time when the quality was different than what we got.
We arrived before their opening time, but they were so kind and welcoming and even offered us tea. Truly great service!

LOVE LOVE LOVE !! OMG their food is amazinggggggg :))) I have to say being a customer of theirs for a while now has to be one of my best  decisions ive made. Their milk tea to die for, best milk tea ive had and pairs perfectly with their mandazi, I have to say dipping the mandazi in the milk tea is the best way to eat it. ive had their beef briyani and Zanzibar mix, their soup ( Zanzibar mix ) one of my fav dishes its so fulfilling, the potatoes soft, the potato balls best part and the beef always tender. the beef biryani soooo delicious, big chunks of meat and so flavorful, my mouth is watering just talking about their food craving it again hahaha :))) if you really want to get a taste of authentic food from Tanzania cuisine please check them out, apart from their food being delicious they have such great customer service, they make sure your cup never stays empty, always reassuring you if your food is to your liking, overall amazing workers ; they are also always down to make a great conversation with you
The food was excellent. I truly enjoyed the Ginger tea and the chapati was just top tier

formatted_address: 4869 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Island Soul - Seattle

reviews.text:
Can’t recommend Island Soul enough. From the moment we walked in, the warm welcome and relaxed, inviting ambience set the tone for the evening. The service was attentive without being overbearing, and every team member we interacted with made us feel taken care of.

The food was truly outstanding, the seafood in particular was a standout, with each course somehow topping the last. Everything was beautifully presented, thoughtfully seasoned, and cooked perfectly. It’s rare to find a place where the flavors, pacing, and atmosphere all come together so seamlessly, but this spot absolutely nailed it.

We left full, happy, and already talking about what we want to try on our next visit. Easily one of our best dining experiences in Seattle so far, and absolutely worth recommending to anyone who appreciates great food and great hospitality.

We ate inside, I love the atmosphere. The drink was delicious and strong. The jerk wings were moist and tasty. The plantains were perfect. The curry chicken was so great we wanted more. We also ordered catfish, mac n cheese, and more curry chicken to go. We will be back. Sooooo Good!

FYI: This place is 21 years and up! You need to be 21 years old, so bring your ID!!!*****
We had to order take out and the restaurant staff was really nice about it, and explained how the rules are strict about the IDs for a valid reason.
Plantains were AMAZING. Best plantains ever. Can’t miss out.
The tostones were so good!!! Garlicky, savory, crunchy, great texture. Highly recommend.
Jerk chicken was really good.
Vatapa was alright, I wouldn’t recommend it :)
If you get a burger or sandwich, the jerk mayo is bomb. Def recommend to dip fries with the jerk mayo!

Absolutely delightful! From the food to the customer service, 10/10 recommend Island Soul.

Arrived on a Sunday @2:30ish pm with a group of 3 and were sat at the bar, no wait.

All of the dishes were SO FLAVORFUL AND DELICIOUS.

On a random Thursday night, I popped into this gem. I live in Magnolia and was in the area for my daughters softball practice. The bartender was welcoming and friendly, and made me a me fantastic rum cocktail. The jerk chicken wings were some of the best wings that I have ever had, and the atmosphere was energetic. I would be a regular if i lived closer! Either way, I can't wait for the next time I am in the area! Thank you Island Soul!

formatted_address: 6 Pittman Pl, Sicklerville, NJ 08081, United States
name: Ayomee’s African Kitchen

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 – Highly Recommend!

I’m so glad I decided to give this place a try! I usually drive all the way to Trenton or Upper Darby for good African food—both about an hour from me—because it’s hard to find a spot that gets cassava leaf right. But this restaurant exceeded my expectations in every way.

I ordered the cassava leaf, egusi, fufu, and chicken, and everything was incredibly hot, fresh, and flavorful. The portions were great, the quality was amazing, and the food tasted just like the authentic dishes I’ve been searching for.

The customer service was just as impressive. The lady who brought my food out was so kind and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

I’m genuinely pleased and honestly shocked that such good African food is this close to home. I definitely recommend this place and I will absolutely be back!
Made my day with this meal. It was delicious and unlike anything i've ever tasted. The owner is incredibly sweet. I tried egusi soup with chicken, fufu, and a meat pie. All very tasty.

I don't have a picture because I ate it all. Amazing flavors, cooked to perfection and drizzled with love. Argh I wish I lived closer so I could eat here all the time. Ayomee's kitchen is where it's at.
Kebobs incredible and tender
Puff puffs melt in your mouth
And don't get me started on her amala and goat argh... Heaven
Don't miss out, call her now!!! Thank me later

I ordered yesterday for my first time, and the food did not disappoint! My husband and were so happy and the flavor to spice was amazing. I got the egusi and fufu, and my husband got the potatoes green with fish, both so delicious😋!! The portion size was surprisingly large which I was happy about 😋. The lady that brought my food out was so nice, not sure if she’s the owner but I will be back to support. Trying to control myself to not run back there tomorrow lol.

First time trying egusi soup and I must say it was delicious!! I agree with all the positive reviews - presentation excellent, well portioned, and neatly packaged. I also tried the jollof rice with chicken, very tasty. Ayomee was so nice and accommodating 🙂 Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 23629 104th Ave SE, Kent, WA 98031, United States
name: Cushitic Cuisine

reviews.text: Visted Cushitic Cuisine this past weekend, and enjoyed it. There was no wait to be seated or for take out, so that was nice. The food was delicious (I ordered take out and my meal was made to order, so was nice as warm when I left with it). I had the beef Wat and had enough for leftovers the second day! The owner is great, its a family run small business, and so I highly recommend. I had the

Definitely can tell it’s a family business, feels like home! The food is dressed in spices and everything nice! The taste buds will be singing joyful noise once you’re done! I’ve tried a creamy pasta, and rice and chicken and once with beef! Never disappoints and always enough for 2-3 people!  Love this place

I just took a moment to sit down and enjoy my meal and must say, it was aaaah-mazing.😁😇 My experience from the moment I entered was pleasant. I was greeted by the young lady at the register and Sandit with a beautiful smile, it gave more of a family feel for me. It's a very clean environment, I like the comforting feel of the ambience. I wasn't extremely familiar with the cuisine on the menu, and Sandit was patient enough to explain it to me,  so I would be more knowledgable about what to order. The lady at the front, also shared her knowledge. The pricing is reasonable for the portion size. If you haven't been, get there, you won't regret it! I'm looking forward to my next visit, in the very near future. Thanks again for making my visit wonderful!😇

Hands down one of the best spots in Kent! This restaurant is an absolute gem! I ordered the Cajun shrimp pasta and my friend got the chicken burger combo, and wow — both meals were AMAZING. The flavors were bold, fresh, and perfectly cooked. We were honestly shocked to find food this good locally. On top of that, the customer service was outstanding, super friendly, welcoming, and made the whole experience even better. It’s also a huge plus that they’re open late, which is really hard to find in Kent. You can really feel the care they put into their food and their customers. Highly recommend, we’ll definitely be back!

Ordered the Cajun shrimp pasta and chicken sandwich. Both were very good and came out at a reasonable time.
Restaurant was clean and the service was great. Will be coming back again!

formatted_address: 2350 E Union St, Seattle, WA 98122, United States
name: COMMUNION Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text:
Great ambiance—intimate, stylish, and perfect for a nice night out. The food was good once it arrived, though the wait was longer than expected. My rum punch was excellent and easily the standout drink of the night.

At this price point, complimentary bread would’ve been appreciated. We ordered the hoecakes instead, but they were a bit dry, lukewarm, and lightly dressed—some warm flavored butter would’ve helped. A couple of people in our group found the wings and collard greens slightly salty.

Dinner for four came out to about $280, so definitely come prepared. Overall, solid food, great drinks, and a nice vibe—just a few refinements away from five stars.

I had been wanting to come here and I'm so glad that I finally made it! I was expecting the food to be good, but it still blew me away. The flavors of both the dishes and the cocktails were perfectly balanced and very interesting and compelling.

The biscuits were insanely flaky, the collard greens were soft but with a bit of bite, and the chicken wings had a crisp outside but were super juicy inside.

The service was also impeccable. Our host and waiter were both friendly, conversational, and approachable, but the service itself felt like a fine dining experience.

Honestly, I was blown away with all aspects and plan to return soon!

I had a pretty underwhelming experience at COMMUNION. I was shocked that the side dishes were better than the main ones. I will appreciate that this place is intended to be family style, so come with a couple of people because the portions are good. Collard greens were excellent, wouldn’t change a thing. Same with the hoecakes. Mac N Cheese was pretty good as well. Unfortunately, the rest isn’t so great. Both the pork chop and chicken were too over breaded, but at least the pork chop still tasted pretty good. The chicken was way too overcooked. I thought for a second that maybe this is the way they make their chicken on a daily basis, but I looked at a slightly older review and the chicken looked nothing like this. When we gave our concerns about the chicken to our waitress it seemed they weren’t really concerned. I probably will not be back.

This is one of those exceptional places that make you want to try everything and once you try everything you want everything again.

If soul food is supposed to nourish you soul, you will have you soul and taste buds having a spiritual awakening.

Chef Brown deserves all the cult following and Damien is exceptional as a host and a real bar wizard.

Reserve, as the place is popular and busy. Expect great things, you will not be disappointed.

I personally would take a flight half way around the world to eat here.

The food was delicious,  however, our selections were very limited.  They do not offer a wide selection of entrees and 3 entrees out of 5 were not available 😒.  We ordered the roasted chicken,  greens, and ho cakes. The food is seasoned and flavorful,  greens were the best I have tasted. The chicken was good but was a little tough, it was not falling off the bone you needed a knife to cut it off the bone.
The service was not good! Our waitress was nice but very nonchalant.  In fact we had to ask about dessert options because she did not offer the options for desserts. A lady from the kitchen walked around to inquire at several tables(in fact one right beside ours) she did not acknowledge us at all and we are visitingfrom Houston, TX. Lastly, if you are a rice eater, they do not cook rice...at least that is what our waitress told us. Overall, we enjoyed our food.

formatted_address: 2502 6th St, Bremerton, WA 98312, United States
name: Tolitoz Motherland Restaurant and Catering

reviews.text: We tried the Kenyan beef stew and the sticky ribs. Everything was super delicious! The owner was very nice and friendly. We'll definitely visit again.
Finally a place in Bremerton with some unique and tasty dishes. Everything on the menu looks delicious. Their shawarma and lamb is on point and their samosas are super flavorful.

All I can say is it was so AMAZING! The flavor was something I’ve never had, so full. Every piece, magnificent. I can’t say enough good things, even the white rice was especially good. The Kalbi Beef, fantastic.
The chef came out to speak to us, to ask us how we felt, he brought the flavors of the world into his restaurant. The Huli Huli chicken was amazing, had Sticky Ribs some cucumber salad and I was so blown away. I thought this might be the best food I’ve ever had.
I hope this secret of a restaurant in the liquor store in East Bremerton is realized. There are a couple tables out front, perfect day. Can’t wait to go back

I was genuinely excited to try this place after seeing all the positive reviews. Unfortunately, I never even got the chance to taste the food.
On multiple occasions, we went only to find the restaurant closed, with the explanation being "catering commitments."  upon calling.
While inconvenient, we gave them the benefit of the doubt.

However, the final straw came when I called ahead to confirm they would be open,  only to arrive and find a  health department closure notice on the door. To make matters worse, I later received a call asking why I hadn’t just ordered online.
With all due respect, as a customer, I should be able to choose whether to dine in, take out, or order online, and not be told how to engage with a business.

What's even more concerning is that the health notice clearly stated they were not permitted to operate, including catering, until it was lifted. Yet they continued to imply they were still fulfilling catering orders.

Overall, this was a very unprofessional and frustrating experience. I won’t be attempting to try this place again.

After seeing a post in this group we decided to try TOLITOZ MOTHERLAND today.  We opted for the platter ($60) so we could try a variety of dishes.  We chose the Huli Chicken, Butter Chicken, & Sticky Ribs for our entrees along with  Naan bread, 3 sides, and Passion Fruit juice drinks.  This fed 4 people with leftovers. The owner/Chef is from Kenya but has also worked in Dubai and other places throughout the world.  The flavors were amazing and the chef clearly cares about the food he is preparing.  You will order at the counter and take the food home.  While you wait for your food to be freshly prepared (about 15 minutes) you can shop the rest of the store for the perfect wine pairing or spirits to complete your meal.  Support a local!  You won't regret it.

Note: this restaurant is located inside the Pacific Liquor Store in the same parking lot as Church's Chicken & across the street from the east  Bremerton Kitsap Transit station.

formatted_address: 5041 Rainier Ave S Suite 108, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Rumba Notes Lounge

reviews.text:
Gotta come! Great variety of food. Occasionally they have a buffet so I drove down from Everett in the rain. Todays  event was sponsored with food from Chop Chop of Kent. It happens last Sunday of every month.
Rumba was packed for the special occasion.I felt most welcome. Organizer Kofi Tay from Chop Chop welcomed me. The Chop Chop co-owner  and cashier Tierra was so welcoming. The servers Savior and Rejoice  very generous. DJ Chris kept a lively mix of African fusion music. Family friendly with dancing kids. I'm going back for seconds especially fried fish, marinated eggs, noodles and beans with a smokey flavor. Warm sense of community around food and music. Come and enjoy new flavors in your life.

Decent spot, but not particularly exciting
Rumba Notes is okay if you’re looking for inexpensive drinks, but it doesn’t really have a lively or fun vibe on a regular night. The atmosphere feels pretty quiet unless there’s a special event or live music happening. The staff are friendly, and it’s a clean, safe place to hang out, but overall it lacks energy compared to other bars in the area. Worth a visit if you’re looking for a low-key drink, but don’t expect it to be a hotspot.

I’m revising my review. I’ve been coming to Rumba Notes off and on for about 5 years now and each time I’ve attended I’ve had a great time! The food is soooo good! I had the chicken wings and beef samosas. I went on a Saturday and Tuesday. Saturday was live! The age range was 3-50, Lots of men! Lots of dancing and lots of the drinks, which were nice and strong!! Tuesday is live jazz from various artists that crowd is more mature with ages ranging from 40-70. There is plenty of seating and whether you’re going for live jazz and dancing the vibe is just right!  I really the red light in the VIP area!

I didnt try much of the food, but this is a pretty cool spot. Stage and sound could use some work along with an updated menu, but this place and the people there are really cool.
I had a good time playing a show there and really encourage people to check out the live music. I think there's an open jam/jazz night there...
Great spot! The people are real, drinks were decent and the music was legendary

formatted_address: 5100 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Kezira Restaurant

reviews.text:
Very friendly service and great food!

We had never had Ethiopian food so it was great getting a walkthrough of the menu.

We decided to get the special platter to get a try of all of the food.  Our favorite was the chicken with collard greens.  For drinks we tried both the honey wine and the hibiscus drink.  Both were excellent!

Overall great place to checkout!

Brought my family to try Ethiopian cuisine (where they’re from it’s basically non-existent). Not pictured, we also had shiro and coffee. Always order extra injera. Family appreciated the alcohol selection. Everything was delicious, the service was excellent, and the ambiance was great.
Delicious food! Large portions at a great price. Really cozy spot with cool art. The veggie combo for two was AMAZING. So was the Kategna with Kibbeh (bread with butter and spices). Will be back!
The food is great! We loved the shiro dip and vegetarian combo. Nice to have a place open past 9pm serving food around here. So happy they are back open!

Zero respect for the neighborhood or residents in the community. Playing deep base music at 3:30am on a Monday is ridiculous and disrespectful. People here have been kindly asked to turn down music by multiple residents in late hours 11pm until sometimes 4am. It’s understandable if this were a club. It’s most certainly not. Very tired of taking so many actions, including multiple noise complaints with no end in sight.

formatted_address: 1001 SE Division St, Portland, OR 97202, United States
name: AKADI PDX

reviews.text:
absolutely amazing place! cannot wait to come back.

the appetizer sample platter is GREAT & a must get! I wish every restaurant did this, I always want try a bite of everything the first visit. The wings are all incredible, a perfect mix of flavors & textures.. worth the splurge.

It was our first time having proper jollof rice and it was soooo good. still thinking about it a week later..!  we got the chicken stew option & it was so flavorful. the rice on its own is incredible. great portion for 2.

the non-alcoholic drinks were amazing too. soursop banana lemonade..!

a very unique dining experience, the food was good…highlight was the sampling platter by far (pictured).  the space is interesting for a restaurant, lighting was very bright, and seating arrangements are sporadic across a very large auditorium.  Overall I thought it was a lovely place to share a West African meal with friends.  Well done.

Please note that you can order from your table and pay your bill via a scan to pay. When they ran my card they didn't allow me to add a tip (cash tip only) but you can if you close out your own tab online.

The food is AMAZING here. It was my first time here and I was blown away. The beef samosas were delicious and came with the most amazing red sauce. The Suya wings (not spicy) were by far my favorites but we also tried the hibiscus ginger (a little spicy) and the nokoss (not spicy, very lemony) wings. I ordered the red stew with lamb shank and fufu and was blown away by how good it was!  My partner got the beef jollof plate. The beef and rice were delicious! My niece got the okra stew and fufu. She loved it!! This was definitely got added to our list of favorite places and we will be back!

Delicious! Nice environment, good portions, and well made entrees. The staff was friendly, helpful, and quick to get us a table when we walked in with 5 people. I highly recommend the appetizer platter! Food was a little pricy, but was worth eating here to try the unique, spice packed flavors.

I really enjoyed the atmosphere. It’s bright and gives an outdoor vibe inside. The place was packed and we aired like 15-20 mins for a table. There were several options for the type of table you may prefer. We were sat on a leather couch with a long shorter table. Creating a chill laid back vibe.  I ordered the lentil samosa. Really good especially with the sauce. The lentils inside were a little harder than my liking but it didn’t take away from the flavor of the samosas. The sauce to go with it was really good. It paired well. Next, I ordered the jollof rice meal with the fish. The fish was amazing!  I don’t remember the name of the fish, it’s definitely not from the American shores. The jollof rice I wasn’t a fan of. The flavors seemed really dialed down for the non-melenated folks, that it was giving boxed rice with some seasoning. The pickled kale was refreshing. My date had the lamb skank okra stew with the corn fufu and really really enjoyed it.

formatted_address: 3114 NE 125th St, Seattle, WA 98125, United States
name: Senait Restaurant Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: Best Ethiopian restaurant ever. Loved the meat combos and veggie combo. The sambosa is also the best I’ve ever tasted.

We tried this restaurant for the first time today and we loved it! We had the #13 vegetarian platter,  sambosas, and oetena, it was all very good. We also had the ceremonial Ethiopian coffee and it was amazing! The owners are so nice, excellent customer service, we’ll definitely be back!
Nice service. I bought meat 3 weeks ago it was a good one. Senait and the workers are very friendly
One of the only places I've been that made Ethiopian food that reminded me of home. Great food, great service. Highly recommend.

My husband and I shared the Number 12 meat combo and it was so delicious and filling! Also very affordable lunch for two people compared to most places in Seattle. The look and appearance of the restaurant is very local/cozy, like a family member is cooking for you.

formatted_address: 7636 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Kebena Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text: I visited Kebena Restaurant in Seattle for the first time, and it was an amazing experience! We had the meat combo it was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. We also tried their coffee, and it was one of the best I’ve ever had! The owner even came over to chat with us, which made us feel so welcome. The service was warm, friendly, and genuine. Highly recommend this place for anyone who loves great food and great hospitality!

Everything we had was very flavorful and tasted fresh. The service was great and they were very accommodating with our group that had 2 kids in it. We had the combo dish so we could try both the meat and vegetarian options. The spice level on a few dishes were perfect.

GREAT food, and friendly service in an attractive and comfortable restaurant. With parking!  We love Ethiopian food and have enjoyed many local places, and this is our hands-down new favorite.  Lots of interesting menu choices, bountiful combination platters to share, and delicious injera.  I love that they have lots of "wot" choices also offered as side dishes at a lower price point.  Our party of seven was warmly welcomed by our server and the owner/chef.  We look forward to many visits in the future!

delicious ethiopian spot! we got the veggie combo plate #1, the meat combo plate, and an order of tibs. this family run restaurant was just what we were looking for. the flavors of everything were delicious and the owner/chef was so sweet to us. she kept checking in and made sure throughout our meal that everything was as we wanted, combined our veggie and meat plates for us, and gave us an extra side of their spicy mustard for dipping. it was overall a great meal and we left very full and satisfied.

Food was legit Ethiopian and was delicious. We ordered the veggie combo plate which had all the options.
The location of the restaurant is a bit out of the way but worth it.

formatted_address: 6501 Aurora Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103, United States
name: Bongos

reviews.text:
This may be one of my favorite spots in the United States. I ordered a few different plates to extend my experience, and everything was a hit. The amount of food included in each plate was so abundant that my friends and I had to take two plates back home, and what was pleasantly surprising was that the plates tasted even better the next day with a little bit of heating up in the microwave. For the price they listed, it's a truly economical option and a neighborhood gem.

Honestly I enjoyed the mango slaw, the beans, and the garlic rice very much. The mango slaw wasn't too watery or had too much mayo, and the mango bits provided extra depth in its flavor profile. The rice and beans were very well seasoned and I could really just eat it by itself without the meat. Of course, though, the meat was the star. Some types were spicier than others, but it was amazing to find out that the spiciness they had was the flavorful kind of spiciness, if that makes sense. Every type of meat was tender, from the braised pork to the jerk spiced chicken to the jerk pork chop and more, and had distinct flavors so that each dish offered a unique culinary experience. Like I said just then, I could've just eaten the rice and beans alone, but I would like to emphasize that having the meat definitely elevated the dishes.

In addition to such, I had a mimosa as well which tasted pretty normal, and a tres leches cake, which wasn't the best I have had anywhere but definitely solid. It was given in a box and when I took it out of the box, I could see the liquidy milky content at the bottom of the box, which was a good sign.

In a city that has so many pricey food options, this establishment stands out because of how they offered a large portion for a very reasonable price, along with how tasty the food was. There are still so many dishes on the menu under plates, bowls, and even sandwiches, that I honestly see myself coming back multiple times in the future, if not everytime that I'm in Seattle. Shoutout to my friend who introduced me to this spot!
Good food! Nice variety of different foods. Good prices. Excellent desserts. Fun place. I highly recommend Chef Dans Loco Moco and the 1AM sandwich. Two thumbs up! :)

The drinks, food, and staff here are amazing. You really get great value for what you pay. The guava cheesecake was incredible, the jerk chicken was juicy and flavorful, and the tostones and yucca were perfectly crisp. They paired perfectly with the aioli. The drinks were delicious and beautifully presented.

My only issue was that while sitting on the outdoor portion, I saw not one but three mice running around. It definitely took away from an otherwise great experience.

This place is aptly name because the flavors created a rhythm in my mouth. This song stays with me to this day. I hope to return soon for another dance.

I recommend the west indies plate and the coconut cake. So fire. The shrimp plate is a good one too!!

Definitely recommend! They serve Caribbean foods with an emphasis on sandwiches but they have bowls as well! I had their most popular sandwich (The 1AM). It was amazing. My wife had their kids bowl with jerk chicken and it was awesome. The chicken was super flavorful and the slaw was light and balanced! The seating is mostly outdoors.

formatted_address: 9131 Veterans Dr SW, Tacoma, WA 98498, United States
name: The TRIBE RESTAURANT AND LOUNGE

reviews.text: Best Samosas I’ve ever had! I also ordered the Curry goat, pilaf rice and greens. The flavor was so on point! Oh my goodness, I never had Kenyan food before and let me tell you, The Tribe did not disappoint! I started eating the food and was instantly like let me take a picture real quick because I had to tell y’all about this hidden gem 💎. I spoke with the owner, who is a Navy Veteran and his staff, and they were all very pleasant. I will definitely be back!

Absolutely delicious Kenyan food! We got the Ugali Greens with pork and the Mukimo and Cabbage with beef along with a side of samosas. Everything was so tasty and flavorful and came in large portions! We will definitely be back to try more off the menu. They’re super friendly and the remodeled front area is very welcoming. Takeout only as it’s very small with no dining area.
Best samosas ever! And the service was incredible! I felt like I was part of their family. Will definitely be coming back.

This place has the best Kenyan food in America, and it just took me back home to my mom's cooking! The portions are incredibly generous, and the flavors are unmatched. I'm willing to drive another 25 minutes just to have another taste. 🍲🌍

If you haven’t tried The Tribe yet you are missing out! This is our 2nd time since they opened and it has been amazing both times. The Samosas are to die for! The owner is extremely kind as well. So glad to have this delicious restaurant in the neighborhood!!

formatted_address: 290 Kenmore Ave, Buffalo, NY 14223, United States
name: Yalleys African Restaurant

reviews.text: I asked if the Buffalo jollof rice was spicy and was told that it was not, but when I received it it was definitely spicy. It did taste good however it was just very spicy. The chicken is really good and flavorful though. Also, the egusi was extremely spicy too.

I’ve been a few times. My boyfriend and I loved the food. We got the chicken pepper soup with fufu, the egusi with beef and pepper soup with  the chicken again our second time. My boyfriend has been back a few times without me. Unfortunately his last time being there Thursday 11/6 he got food poisoning. So we won’t be returning customers anymore. Also the service is ok. First time we came it was a male serving. Second time we came with our kids (group of 5) the lady serving seemed to be annoyed with our bigger group.

Very small restaurant but amazing food. We got the hot pepper soup with fufu, jollof rice with fish and waakye with fish. We also got a side of plantains. The atmosphere is cute and the music is thematic to the restaurant. Everything we got was flavorful and delicious. The service is a little slow but worth it because of how good the food is. The food was flavorful and spicey but not too spicey. It was just fantastic.

If you're looking for good West African food (Ghana and Nigeria, for example), this is a great place.  For many of the dishes, you're choosing your starches (fried rice, beans & rice, fried plantains or yams, fufu) and then a protein (fish, chicken, beef, or beans).  Everything we had was great, and the servings were huge!  I had heard that it might take a while to get our food, but ours came out to the table in a very reasonable amount of time.

Everything was well seasoned and well cooked.  The fried plantains that I had were perfect; just a bit crisp on the outside, but creamy inside.  Nothing that anyone in our party had was super spicy (granted, we're all Buffalonians), but some of the sauces were a bit warm, and all were flavorful.

They do have alcoholic drinks, but we just had soft drinks.  These were in a refrigerated display, and you can just take what you want, and they'll charge you when you pay.  I was really happy to find two kinds of ginger beer and Goya Malto!

Given what I had heard, the staff will help you with learning how to eat the soup and fufu without cutlery, but we didn't run into that situation when we went (I couldn't resist getting the suya kabab).  But if you want the authentic experience, I think you can get it here.

Food was great! Waited a bit for our food but I think that’s because the food was fresh! Made to order. Service was ok they were nice but they kept disappearing into the back. We were like chasing them down to ask for more napkins and any extra we needed once we got our food. The aesthetic of the restaurant was really cute, but it was kinda cold. Also had to wait to order a drink from the bar because again, they kept going into the kitchen but DRINK WAS 10/10 once we got it though. Good music while we waited! 👌🏻

formatted_address: 29100 Pacific Hwy S UNIT 11-13, Federal Way, WA 98003, United States
name: Lims Lounge & Restaurant

reviews.text: Atmosphere is ok because the music is good and it has decent lighting. Food is often (3 visits) hard and dry & unfortunately my stew was cold upon receipt at the table on my last two attempts to try this place. Service is absolutely trash if it even exists. They also overcharge some customers so i recommend you ask for a receipt if you order food. They’d do better to hire professional servers, it would improve the reviews and overall service and experience.

First of all, there are no seats. You gotta reserve seats and no space to even dance. Most customers are seated just staring. Definitely kills the vibe. Also the security guards don’t use a wand but bare hands to frisk customers. A lot of unprofessional approach to hospitality. The food is also microwaved so if you get matumbo (tripe), get ready for food poisoning. They can do better. I don’t think this is the real feel of Kenya, but we appreciate the effort. The owners nes to put more effort in design.

I loved this place more when there was a young chubby guy...so upset that I forgot his name. He was so friendly with an amazing service. I remember, the first time I visited Lims, he greeted me and my friends like he already knew us. He found us a seat and got our orders without rushing us. He continued checking up on us all night making sure we was good. And that continued until a few weeks ago. If you reading this young man, thank you.
I do love Lims, the BIGGEST PROBLEM is the  music. Am from Zambia, I always enjoy the first hour and half, maybe 2 hours... but it becomes about KENYANS.. We end up feeling lost. Maybe i don't get it, is it specifically for KENYANS? Enlighten me.
My review is to help y'all improve, don't rush to be on the defensive, just improve if you have to.
Weekend of October 10th, 2025.. I came in with Rachel Kundananji, one of the highest paid female soccer players in the world... we didn't get a good service i guess because you was short staffed...but it was a Saturday  y'all ... I apologized on yours behalf, but finally, the only waitress I believe came to the rescue after a 30minutes or more wait. She apologized and finally took our order and she brought our drinks fast and apologized again. I like her.
All in all, I love Lims, please treat us non Kenyans good.
Oh, to every Kenyan reading this, stop speaking Swahili to everyone that walks into this club...lol. love y'all though 😘 💓

If I could give this place a minus rating, I absolutely would.

I have had multiple bad experiences at Lims Lounge & Restaurant, and I’m finally done giving them chances. The customer service here is practically nonexistent. The staff consistently mistreats clients, responds rudely when you ask simple questions, and shows zero professionalism.

Their menu is confusing and misleading. What they serve is completely different from what is written. One time I ordered lamb stew with pilau, and what they brought was plain rice with watery soup and not a single piece of meat. When I politely asked the waitress about it, instead of fixing the order, she treated me badly and basically pushed me into ordering a second plate with meat, then made me pay for everything. It was honestly shocking.

On top of that, everything about the place feels chaotic.
•	The music is extremely loud, to the point where you can’t even have a conversation.
•	There is barely any space to sit or move comfortably.
•	The atmosphere is uncomfortable, with people staring, acting disrespectful, and giving off an aggressive vibe.

It genuinely feels like the owners don’t care about customers at all, only about squeezing as much money as possible out of every person who walks in.

Highly, highly NOT recommended.
Save your time, your money, and your peace of mind there are far better places in the area.
Good Kenyan food. Service can be a bit slow. Music is loud but there's a separate "family" area where there's no loud music.

formatted_address: 300, Lilongwe, Malawi
name: The African Table

reviews.text: This place was a dream. I think they really capture the name African table well because the Malawian and African cuisine was very visible and distinct. They prepare the food in an open area so you can smell all the lovely aromas coming through. It's well priced and the food is absolutely amazing. I must come here again! I did notice through that it can get busy and as such some of the items on the menu run out like it happened with me so go in early otherwise it's a great place

Standard Customer Service
They could definitely do more for decor but the food was great!The portions are worth the price

I really love the authentic Malawian and west African food. They also have Asian cuisine, my favorite dish being the sweet and sour chicken with fried rice.

Prices are fair from the cheapest meal being a soup priced at 8,000 Kwacha and the most expensive being seafood broil at 26,000 Kwacha.

It’s a great place to have a lunch meal with friends and colleagues.

Great location and ambience. Customer service was not so good in my experience, hoping they can do better. Ordered the Jamaican oxtail and fried rice. Food lacked a lot of flavor and it took forever to come, portion size was quite good.

While conceptually exciting, there appears to be something missing from the overall experience. The food, while having some highlights, when taken whole was just alright. The service was similarly average. The atmosphere could easily be maximised to suit the theme. It's a decent eating spot with great room to grow.

formatted_address: Next to Pure Food Fish Market, 1517 Pike Pl, Seattle, WA 98101, United States
name: The Athenian Seafood Restaurant And Bar

reviews.text:
We came in for lunch and, as it was really busy, waited about 20 minutes for a table.
The food was very good. The prawn cocktail was super fresh - big, juicy prawns with an amazing sauce. We loved it so much, we should have ordered two. For my main, I had the seafood sauté - a generous portion packed with chunks of fish and seafood, really delicious. My partner had steak with salad, which was great too.
Service was friendly and efficient.
It’s clearly an iconic spot in Pike Place Market, especially knowing some scenes from Sleepless in Seattle were filmed here.

Great location, decent service, the food is hit or miss. They’ve got drink and food items on the walls that are no longer on the menu.. one day your food is great, another not so much. Today I got the red snapper fish and chips. Ordinarily fantastic, today the portion was greasy and half the normal size. It was not good.. I guess it’s probably better for my health that the portion was so small. 6 bites of fish.. $24.99

Great food and the atmosphere was nice. The view of the waterfront was beautiful and our server was punctual and nice. Many of the tables for 3+ people were small and it felt a little claustrophobic, and some of the silverware provided was dirty. Apart from those things this is a good spot for a burger or fish food.

food was pretty decent, the sizes are rather small for the price, but it’s the pike place area. server was nice, seemed like they were in a bit of a rush sometimes though. the seating is very weird as you can only fit a certain amount of people in the booths, so if you have a bigger group, be aware. nice view of the waterfront as well !!

Part of Pike's Place Market, small, cramped dark environment. I had the seafood pasta. After adding a generous amount of salt, it was pretty good. The green beans in the dish were a little too crispy for my taste. The waitress was busy but efficient. Spent $120 with tip.

formatted_address: 1525 13th Ave, Seattle, WA 98122, United States
name: Cap Hill Kitchens

reviews.text: Gave my order to DoorDasher without checking the name. No idea how he even got through the locker system and when asked for help, staff just told me “Not my problem buddy”. DoorDasher returned with the order and they handed it to me with my drink all messed up from Thai Wisdom
Had one of the burgers from this place. They are always delicious. Add on some of the loaded fries and you won’t be sorry. This is a pickup window only hence the 1 star atmosphere.

Super duper good food. The man who served us kept checking in and was so kind. Definitely recommend the dosa and indo chinese menu.Vibey outdoor seating but more of a take out food place if outdoor seating is not your style.

Cap Hill Kitchens is a ghost/cloud kitchen hosting various restaurants such as Indian, American, Puerto Rican fusion etc, and offers a convenient option for pickup and delivery orders.

I recently placed an order from one of the restaurants within Cap Hill Kitchens called the House of Chettinad. The process of ordering was straightforward and was done through the website, and upon completion, I received a notification on my phone with instructions for pickup, including the locker number.

It’s worth noting that there is limited street parking available, which can be a consideration for those planning to pick up their orders.
The food is pretty much fine, wish it was cheaper and the portion was more to real life as I paid for french fries and the portion was really small for the price, but overall not bad.

formatted_address: 1715 N 45th St, Seattle, WA 98103, United States
name: Pam's Caribbean Kitchen

reviews.text:
This restaurant appears to be mostly run by a single person, which is impressive because it's not that small!
It serves Caribbean - specifically Trinidadian food - which is something you don't see often

I had the Jerk Chicken Sandwich - which came with a bunch of chicken pieces between coconut fry bread
The flavor on the chicken was out-of-this world. This is not a flavor profile you want if you're used to bland food. It explosively hits you in the face with its spice and its deep level of marination. Once you take the initial hit, though, it becomes addicting - and you keep coming back for more.
This was some of the best chicken I've had. Every bite was practically tripping with juice; it was cooked perfectly. Like I mentioned, the flavor from the marinade was unreal.

The fry bread for the sandwich buns was interesting. I've never seen something like it, but it was honestly pretty cool. Being pretty thin, it provided a nice softer component to the incendiary flavors of the chicken. Didn't taste much coconut though

For sides, we also got the aloo pies and macaroni pie. The aloo pies were decent; I thought they lacked a lot of crisp, but the sauce they came with was super good.
The macaroni pie was not very good - just way too buttery/oily with no other flavors to speak of. Pretty disappointing

The price was actually quite reasonable - my sandwich was just $12, which was a very good deal.
Overall, this is phenomenal, unique, and a great value - just skip the sides. 8.5/10

Absolutely phenomenal food. This is coming from a Trinidadian, it has been a decade since I’ve had good trini food. I tell ya I fly from my home in Asia just to try this and my goodness this restaurant is a required stop EVERYTIME I fly into Seattle now. It is rare to find a restaurant where everything is made in house. The owner Pam is a sweetheart, I felt at home in the restaurant. Trust, you need to go. I brought a friend that has never had Trinidadian food and how they are hooked. Pam thank you so much, amazing cook and wonderful atmosphere.

My orders
Aloo pies with Chana and chutney (My favorite!!!❤️)
Fried plantain ❤️
Jerk chicken sandwich ❤️ very filling!
Dhalourie Roti ❤️
Paratha roll ❤️
Rum cake- very moist and thick.
absolutely delicious. i got the jerk chicken sandwich and wings. spicy and nicely seasoned, the fry bread was out of this world. pam was very very sweet

I’ve been to Pam’s a bunch of times, and it’s always great. The jerk chicken is packed with flavor, the pork ribs are super tender, and the rice and peas are just right. Her house salad is fresh and tasty, and the cocktails are really good too.

Pam is also really friendly and welcoming. she makes you feel at home every time. Definitely one of my favorite spots!

Hands down the best Caribbean food in Seattle. The flavors are incredibly authentic, rich, and made with real passion. The owner, Pam, treats you like family the moment you walk in — you can genuinely feel how much she loves what she does, and it shows in every dish. The atmosphere is welcoming, the food is unforgettable, and the experience is one of a kind. I had the jerk chicken sandwich and absolutely loved it.

If you’re anywhere near Wallingford, you absolutely need to stop here. Highly, highly recommended!

formatted_address: 9988 15th Ave SW Suite A, Seattle, WA 98146, United States
name: Gõ Seattle Grab & Go

reviews.text:
We catered from Go Seattle for our wedding a year ago and would highly recommend it. It was much more affordable than any options out there, food was so delicious with wide appeal and service was top notch.

Dao did such a great job helping us plan out our menu. They were super accommodating with providing vegetarian options and a special menu for kids. Food was beautifully displayed, including dessert and drinks which we bought separately. They also accommodated a last minute request to bring hot water dispensers due to the cold weather. The whole team were extremely helpful with set up, serving guests, and cleaned up nicely as well. I couldn't have asked for more.

I was passing by looking for something to eat at a reasonable price, and came across here. I was greeted very warmly and had my order taken and food served quickly. I ordered the stir fried egg noodles with seafood. The size was very filling and the taste was very delicious. 100/10!
Delicious banh mi sandwiches, coffee and more. Lots of Vietnamese specialties.

I recently ordered catering from Go Seattle for an event and was thoroughly impressed. We had five food trays: chow mein, fried rice, fish sauce chicken wings, mango salad, and fresh rolls. Each dish was delicious, especially the fish sauce wings and rolls! I also have to admit the fried rice was amazing, other places that cater fried rice does not compare. The service was professional, and everything was delivered on time. My guests loved the food, and I highly recommend Go Seattle for catering needs.

We got catering from Go Seattle for my birthday party and I can't say enough good things about the experience. They were super responsive providing a quote, working through the menu, and delivering it on time. The food was all delicious from the mango salad, to the fresh spring rolls to the friend rice and noodles. The portions were generous and it was more than enough to feed everyone. Thank you!!

formatted_address: 1525 13th Ave, Seattle, WA 98122, United States
name: Ghana Fusions LLC

reviews.text:
Amazing new halal food spot in Cap Hill! I confirmed with the chef that all their meat is Halal before ordering.

They also offer catering, too. Will definitely try them for my future events.

True to Ghana culture it took forever for the food to come out. Will definitely order ahead next time. But it was good. The flavor is different from what you get in ghana but it was good. I had red red. The one thing I didn’t love is the beans were more mashed than I would have liked. Otherwise on point. The plantain had a crusty outside and soft sweet inside.

This week I called in to get a quote for how much food I would need to order to feed 16 people within a rather tight budget. Sue was so kind and helpful, she even accommodated my budget and quick timeline! She provided us with a full catering pan of Jollof rice, a half pan of fried chicken, a half pan of beef stew, Red Red Stew, plantains and veggies! The food was delicious, everyone raved about it! Definitely recommend eating at Ghana Fusions!!!
Delicious Ghanaian food. A bit spicy; i was SWEATING!!! lol wish there was a better area for eating once picked up. Even though this technically is take out.

Food is good. Order a lot of food then told them. Before the food was done I told them I didn’t want the soup anymore. They said my refund will be back on my card in a matter of days.. it’s been 2 months still no refund. Won’t be getting my services again.

formatted_address: 10515 Greenwood Ave N, Seattle, WA 98133, United States
name: Adulis Eritrean and Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: We loved our lunch at this restaurant. The vibe was great, our server friendly and the food was extremely tasty and unpretentious! Very few Ethiopian places offer fish goulash and I highly recommend the dish here. Even the dishes in the veggie combo had a few extra elements like okra curry and a beetroot potato thingy. We had a perfect end to our meal with traditionally brewed Ethiopian coffee.

The interior is beautiful and colorful. Definitely a family owned operation. Been a while since I had Ethiopian but the veggie combo was super flavorful and actually enjoyed the injera bread!

Also got the zilzil tibs - beef chunks with strong rosemary flavor.  Very flavorful. Small parking lot.

Went 2 nights in a row because we liked it so much! Got a few different meat dishes and the veggie sampler. Everything was super delicious. The injera is great as well. Come hungry, you probably won't be able to finish it all! The only thing I don't recommend is the dessert, because of the language barrier we didn't really understand what we were ordering, and it turned out to be spicy injera, of which we had already eaten plenty! It wasn't sweet.

Oh and the first night we came there was a gentleman playing a really cool stringed instrument I didn't recognize - but I took a picture!

We went there at 9pm on Saturday and it was empty. The kitchen is open until 10:30pm on Saturday.
Staff was super friendly.
It's a casual place.
We were 6 people and ordered 1 veggie combo for 4 people + a meat combo for 1 person + 5 sambozas and we ended up with more food than we were able to finish.
The food was delicious.
The bathroom cleaning could use more attention.
Perfect combination of flavor, portions and service! Definitely coming back again. And again. The waitress/owner even brought me some special Ethiopian chili powder to sprinkle onto my food.

formatted_address: 11301 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98178, United States
name: Tina’s Kitfo, Restaurant & Coffee Shop

reviews.text: This is the cutest little Ethiopian restaurant and coffee bar. Honestly, some of the best food I have ever eaten. So flavorful, so light. Incredibly delicious. 10 out of 10 we will be back again!

The vegetarian platter is delicious. A small dining with plenty of seating. The service was great and the food came out quickly. There is parking in both sides of the building. Highly recommend for vegetarian.

We had breakfast here for the first time today and everything was great.  The woman and the front counter was friendly   then also brought us our food and waited on anything we needed.  The food was full of flavor and fresh.  I would recommend this place to anyone who wishes to try Ethiopian food in the Seattle/surrounding area.  There was plenty of parking as well.
Super friendly and warm staff, good food. And good place to meet a friend.

My wife and I biked around lake Washington, and we’re looking for a place to have lunch. The south end of the lake doesn’t have many choices, but we decided to drop in and try this place. It was nice that we could bring in our bikes for safekeeping while we ate. The food was excellent and so is the Ethiopian coffee. Winnie has created a very comfortable oasis on a very busy street.

formatted_address: 6464 Martin Luther King Jr Way S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: ADOT ETHIOPIAN & RESTAURANT | አዶት ክትፎና እና ስጋ ቤት

reviews.text: Great food, great service, and warm Ethiopian hospitality! The flavors are authentic and fresh. Highly recommend! 🌟

First time to eat Ethiopian food. Very delicious and nice spicy tea. Kitfo and kitfo dulet is a must eat!! Really good!
The staff were very friendly and respectful.

The food was so good. Especially the kitfo. Their service is AMAZING. I have a 3 year old boy and he does NOT stay still. They handled him with kindness and allowed my partner and I to enjoy our meal in peace. Thank you so much!

Gluten free vegetarian Ethiopian food, absolute five star traditional Ethiopian food!
Highly recommend Derek tibs and Kitfo for my fellow carnivores.
Dont forget to ask for Jebena coffee which is served in the traditional Ethiopian coffee pot and cute coffee cups.

formatted_address: 205 SW 152nd St, Burien, WA 98166, United States
name: MOYA ETHIOPIAN RESTAURANT & COFFEE

reviews.text: One of my favorite family owned Authentic Ethiopian restaurant in downtown Burien.! Super cozy atmosphere and delicious food. The owners are so friendly and welcoming.! I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys delicious Ethiopian cuisine. Thank you so much for your service 🙏
This place was absolutely wonderful!  Some of the best Ethiopian food I've ever had (and I've had alot)!  Great portions, good pricing, and of course exquisite flavor!  Treat yourself and go there!
We ordered the lamb tips, beef tips, and collard greens, and we left two hours later, very happy. The location is great, easy to find, friendly service, and we will be back again soon.
The best Ethiopian food in Seattle! The lamb awaze and doro wot are out of this world delicious! A great place to stop before picking someone up or dropping someone off at the airport.

Moya is a great addition to the Ethiopian restaurant scene in the Seattle area. Big & bright dining area, friendly & attentive staff, very good food. The vegetarian sampler was delicious & satisfying.

formatted_address: 1306 S King St, Seattle, WA 98144, United States
name: Conspagna Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: One of the finest and authentic Ethiopian restaurants in Seattle!! Everything we ate was delicious. I would recommend the veggie platter and the meat platter (called Metebaber, off the menu).

Conspagna is one of my favorite Ethiopian restaurants in Seattle! The food is authentic and full of flavor. My top picks are the Tibs and Kurt (raw meat) — both were absolutely delicious and prepared just right. If you’re a fan of Ethiopian cuisine, this place is the right one.

A big shoutout to our wonderful waitress, Jerry. She was so kind, attentive, and made our dining experience even better with her warm and friendly service.

Later in the evening, DJ Koffi’s selection was on point — her taste in music is smooth and thoughtful, creating a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere that perfectly matched the evening.

Overall, Conspagna offers great food, excellent service, and a relaxing, enjoyable environment. Highly recommend!

I’ve had the pleasure of visiting Conspagna a few times now, and I’m truly amazed! The setup and decoration are beautifully done—it feels like being back home in Ethiopia. The food is absolutely incredible, with so many popular and delicious dishes that bring back wonderful memories. Every bite is full of authentic flavors, and it’s clear how much thought and care has gone into everything. This is more than just a restaurant—it’s a piece of home. Congratulations on such a well-done job! I’ll definitely keep coming back and spreading the word.
Great Ethiopian food! The server, Luel, was super kind and fast. If you're in a hurry, make sure to call and order ahead ’cause it’s gonna take forever.

Cute ethiopian resturant with ample parking. There's option to park on the street or a parking lot on the side.

The waitress with the short hair is kind and welcoming. Thank you!

My ethopian friend suggested this place and we approve. The veggie combo was delishes. My favorite was the red lentil and red garbanzo. Their salad, was also dresses and seasoned nicely. Almost addictive, I can keep it eating the salad by itself or with enjera. I did notice their menu on the website being slightly different. Online menu mentioned $8 sambusa. However, they didn't have any in-person.

highly recommend this place 🙂

formatted_address: 14855 Tukwila International Blvd, Tukwila, WA 98168, United States
name: Abay Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text: We LOVED the amazing options for vegetarians! Different lentil dishes, some spicy, some not. There was a cabbage dish, a beet dish, and salad that was dressed to perfection. The bread was a lovely sponge texture that held up for picking up food, but was still so soft  to eat. Loved the variety of flavors and spice (or mild) in this plate! Lovely music and friendly staff! If you're looking for a vegetarian or vegan meal, it's amazing!

Absolutely delicious — every dish was flavorful, authentic, well-seasoned, and beautifully presented. The restaurant has a warm and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for spending time with family or even enjoying a meal by yourself. I’d come back just for the food! I highly recommend trying their vegetarian combo — it’s full of rich flavors and perfectly balanced.

I really enjoyed my visit to Abay Restaurant. The food was delicious and full of authentic Ethiopian flavor — especially the doro wat and tibs. The injera was soft, fresh, and perfect for sharing. The staff were very kind and welcoming, and the service was quick. The place was clean and had a warm, home-like feeling. The prices were fair for the amount of food you get. I’ll definitely come back again and recommend Abay to anyone who wants to experience real Ethiopian food!

Like the river nile, This Abay restaurant delivers an amazing experience from start to finish. The vegetarian options were outstanding, full of flavor, hearty, and clearly made with love. The misir wot (spicy lentils), gomen (collard greens), and shiro were so good, I almost forgot to share!

The atmosphere was cozy, welcoming, and full of cultural charm. Traditional music played softly in the background, and the decor transported us straight to Ethiopia. It’s the perfect spot for a relaxed meal with friends or a cozy date night.

To top it all off, we ended our meal with the traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony. The coffee was rich, aromatic, and served with etan (incense), which added such a beautiful and calming touch to the experience. You can really feel the hospitality and heart in every detail here.

Highly recommend. I’ll definitely be back (probably tomorrow 😄)

The Food here is very good! I ordered the Doro Wat with the St. George Beer & it was everything to fulfill my cravings.

I’d highly recommend if you’re looking for a local Ethiopian food spot!

formatted_address: 8824 Renton Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Union N Eritrean and Ethiopian bar and Restaurant

html_attributions: Union N Eritrean and Ethiopian bar and Restaurant

reviews.text: The union restaurant truly captures the authentic taste of Eritrean and Ethiopian cuisine. Each dish was rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and served with soft, fresh injera. The presentation was beautiful, and the service was excellent—staff were kind, respectful, and attentive. It felt like a home-style dining

I called to complain about my food
The owner hung up.in my face.
I've tasted Ethiopia food before.
This had no flavor
The waitresses were rude. The owner hung up in my face
I will.never go back there again

HORTIBLE EXPERIENCE.
I've been real sick
This was a big mistake. $ 23.00
For some cold hard cabbage and hard peas. Don't know what else that was.
So Dissatisfied.

Stopped here on my way home after a late night out. Was pleasantly surprised to find them not only open, but still serving a full menu up until 1:00am. It's not my favorite Ethiopian spot but definitely on the list due to their hours.
The food was so good, just the right spice for the lamb tibs and the customer service was amazing such an amazing staff. I highly recommend coming to this place

I’ve been a regular at this establishment, but my recent visits have left me quite frustrated. First and foremost, the noise level is consistently overwhelming. Every time I walk in, the music is blaring, making it difficult to enjoy my meal or have a conversation.

Additionally, I’ve felt undervalued as a customer. On my last visit, I noticed a discrepancy between the menu prices and what I was charged. When I brought this to the attention of the staff, I was informed that the prices on the menu were outdated and that they would be updating them next week. This lack of transparency is concerning, especially since I often choose to spend my money here.

I truly hope the management takes these issues seriously!

formatted_address: 5418 Martin Luther King Jr Way S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Nazareth Market

reviews.text: We had to wait over an hour to get the food we ordered, not enough seething, no parking, and if you want to go eat leave your car home and arrive about two hours earlier. Beside that the meat was great 👍

Good place to eat traditionally Ethiopian tasty food, nice beef meat Especially "Kurt & Tibs", the roasted meat is very spicy and nice. If you visit it, I hope you will like those delicious foods and this good place. They have a delicious ribs with nice approaches. I have been eat this kind of ribs back home, but now I can find from here. Good job.
They are Very busy during lunch time because have customers and they provide fresh beef for Kitfo, Kurt, and Tibs. I love it ❤️❤️❤️

This is one of my favorites place to go to get fresh meat and eat Ethiopian food. They get fresh meat every Thursday, Friday and Saturday so if you have a special event, you can order order your meat and they’ll have it prepared. I go there consistently on Saturdays with friends and have lunch there  Efrem has been working in the industry for quite a long time dating back to Ethiopia and knows how to cut meat and prepare the best way. definitely five star!

Bruk and Efrem are outstanding, hardworking individuals. I sincerely thank you for your dedication, patience, and excellent customer service. All the team members are truly wonderful.
Please continue the good service .

formatted_address: 9050 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, United States
name: Evangadi Ethiopian Market and Restaurant

reviews.text: Best goat tibs in Seattle
I really like the food

formatted_address: 16704 International Blvd, SeaTac, WA 98188, United States
name: Langano coffee and Kurt bet

reviews.text:
I would love to see these guys get more reviews.
We're visiting from Australia and our parents took us here for our first meal.
Fantastic!
The guys here are great. Super friendly and hospitable.
And I LOVE the food. I've had Ethiopian before and this is top quality at good prices
Thank you so much guys!

Super delicious!! Came here with my family, the server was super friendly and the food was full of flavors. We’ve tried many Ethiopian places all over Washington but this was hands down the best place to dine if you’re feeling some Ethiopian cuisine!

Had a lovely meal here with my partner and her family while visiting Seattle. Metiku was very friendly and provided a great service to us all. As Vegetarians he was very accommodating to my partner and I. Highly recommend to others. Thank you Metiku!

This place is legit! Service was prompt and very friendly. Ordered the Awaze Tibs  and everything about it was perfect- cooked and served with care- just as if it was homemade. Will definitely be back!!!
This place is the best places to dine in around the airport, you can even watch live games while you enjoy their delicious food and beverages.

formatted_address: 11108 Evergreen Wy ste e, Everett, WA 98204, United States
name: ALEM RESTAURANT AND GROCERY

reviews.text: Very pleasant experience. I grew up eating Ethiopian food, and the closest places are way south. I was thrilled to find Alem market so close to my home. Owners are very kind. I ordered the Veggie Combo, and the Beef Tibs. Very generous portions, and the flavors were spot on, and in my opinion better than what I’ve had in the past in the city. I will defiantly be back with friends and family. Thank you for such kind, and fast service.

Wow! Our first time calling and picking up food here. If you are in the area don't hesitate. It is family run, portions are generous, and they are lovely. We got veggies platters, and a lentil sambusa. They were delicious and portions were great.

The food here is amazing. Super fresh never arrives even a little cold!! And the food is so so tasty. Even when my husband went for me once and couldn’t figure out the menu the person working that was really kind to him and Helped him get my order perfect !!

The portions are perfect and the price is very reasonable!! Highly recommended

The Doro Wat combo is what I ordered to go & it was delicious!!  I also purchased a pack of Injera that I use for my sandwich making.  So very good!!  The service was great and I will be going back to enjoy more items on their menu!! The Berbere spice that I bought is used in yogurt as a dip and spread!!  Go & enjoy!!
This is the best Ethiopian in the PNW, hands down. The injera is perfect, the lentils are cooked well, and the flavors are spot on! I would definitely recommend this place.

formatted_address: 16005 International Blvd, SeaTac, WA 98188, United States
name: Star Coffee Restaurant

reviews.text:
My husband and I found ourselves here after a mishap getting a rental car. We have never had Ethiopian food before and didn't know what to expect.
Everyone inside was kind and welcoming. The staff did a great job checking in on us as well. It was fun to see the people around us laughing, enjoying each other's company, and playing games.

We ordered the Misir Wot to share, and oh my God it was so delicious!! We didn't get it spicy, but the flavors were incredible and it was so much fun to eat!

I ordered the meat combo for lunch, which comes with vegetable sides. The waitress kindly guided me away from the medium, which would have been far too much food for one person. Even the small left me with leftovers for days! The food was super spicy and flavorful - I would definitely go again. It’s set up as a kind of a sports bar - so I bet it’s fun for dinner!
