I got the fried fish po’boy and cochon gumbo and both were excellent. The crunchy fish with their homemade remoulade was tasty.

My partner is vegetarian and she loved the jackfruit po’boy and vegan gumbo.

I would definitely add on the fries, thin with a dusting of Cajun salt!

Highly recommend the food and the people working there were kind and friendly and gave helpful recommendations!

Oh boy, Po’Boy did not skimp on the shrimp! Delicious, tasty, and very filling for the price point. I never thought I’d find fries more satisfying than Mc Donald’s but here they are! Fries were perfect and salted just the way I like them. My only negative is not asking for that sauce to dip my fries in. Plenty of hot sauces to choose from, staff were great, spacious and clean dining experience. I coming back for the gumbo next!

formatted_address: 601 Mission Bay Blvd North, San Francisco, CA 94158, United States
name: SPARK Social SF

reviews.text: We hosted our night-before-the-wedding welcome event at Spark Social SF in the Corner Cove, and it was perfect! Having a dedicated corner made it easy for friends and family to gather, relax, and enjoy the evening together. One of the best parts was being able to bring our “Dog of Honor” so everyone could meet him, since he wasn’t allowed at the wedding venues. The food truck vouchers worked out great—guests loved being able to choose their own food and drinks. The whole atmosphere was fun, casual, and exactly what we wanted. Everyone had a wonderful time, and we couldn’t have picked a better spot!
Cool food truck neighborhood. Sheltered benches to eat if you need to find a place to get out of the chill and warm up. Fire pits needed to be rented out in advance by the looks of it.
Awesome team event - super easy to book and pick up vouchers - we had the double decker bus. It was a huge hit with the team.

Lots of options and consistently good food quality, but the prices are on par with sit-down restaurants. Still, it’s a fun place to hang out with coworkers and friends, with far more variety than a single restaurant can offer.

Great little outdoor market spot for people can choose whatever it is that they want lots of different food trucks close to a whole bunch of things in San Francisco so it’s easy to get to not too hard to park at

formatted_address: 1098 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA 94109, United States
name: Sofiya

reviews.text: SO good! So many flavors and colors. Forgot to take a pic of the cheesy bread but oh my GOD was it delicious. Left VERY full. Came with a larger group which was great because we got to share a bunch of plates. Service was very friendly and accommodating. They no longer serve their pickled platter, but they brought us out a plate of pickles when we asked about it 😂

Pretty good restaurant in general. Food was delicious with a couple of small exceptions, service good for the most part, and the restaurant was clean and cozy. Really I would give this place 4.5*, but that's not an option on Google.

Regarding the food, the smoked salmon salad, whatever it was called was delicious. The Plov was on point, as were the Manti. The Borscht was also good, but the vegetarian version. The Cheburek was good and crispy, but a little lacking on the filling. The Shurpa was okay, but a bit too plain for my taste.

Service was good other than the server arguing with us about a drink order she forgot about, trying to make it sound like we never told her. Just say "sorry I forgot", and move on.

This is easily my new favorite restaurant in San Francisco! Every single dish was jam packed with unique flavors that truly blew me away. I highly recommend ordering family style, and trying out as many dishes as possible. The owner and staff were also very hospitable and gave us great recommendations on what to order. Sofiya was my first time having Uzbek food, and definitely will not be my last!

Gave this a try while staying at a hotel nearby and it was delicious! Flavorful and the staff were so sweet. It was a lot of food so I thought I'd save some as leftovers, but I ended up eating everything! Never had Ubeski food before and this was an amazing intro to it! The Plov was flavorful and filling. The Samsa with pumpkin was so delicious. Also had the fruit juice they make and loved it. I even loved the side salad that's made with tomatoes... Never thought I'd enjoy a tomato salad so much--ended up craving it when I returned home and made my own version.

We absolutely loved this Tajik restaurant! Everything was so perfect and delicious that we came back again just two days later — all the way from Sacramento. The food tastes like home, the atmosphere is warm, and every dish is full of incredible flavor. Thank you for creating a place we always want to return to!

formatted_address: 1635 Morse Rd, Columbus, OH 43229, United States
name: AFRA GRILL | AFRICAN & SOMALI CUISINE

reviews.text:
Afra Grill was a pleasant surprise for me. The lamb was tender. Oxtail savory. The vegetables and beans seasoned to complimentary perfection.... and the plantains..... chefs Kiss.

Their Fantastic Sauce 🔥. If you're into Coconut drinks. Their have a special Life is Good drink. Esquite.

The owner was very kind to us.

Great meal! I got a vegetarian combo, with jollof rice, plantains, and Afra spice sauce. Nice level of spice and excellent value.

Only weird thing was how I was charged for tap water.  Not many places do that.

My favorite restauranttttt, I always get the Chicken Afra and that jollof rice is just …. 🤤🤤🤤 they changed the menu a little bit which made me sad, but they still have the main thing I get and it slaps every time. And I didn’t see the option for Kachumbari when I ordered online, but I got it mixed in with lettuce, so I was happy again. And I can be healthier.
I really should try something else but my taste buds are just satisfied with what I always get. Maybe I can try the oxtail sometime 🤔 the beef sanbus is always good too

Delicious and hearty comfort food with generous portions. I had the (surprisingly giant slice of) salmon, it was seasoned and cooked to perfection. Relieved to learn that both Bariis and Jollof Rice rice are vegetarian. I chose Bariis to avoid too much spice, it was savory and satisfying. The veggie mix was mildly spicy and perfect over the rice. Highly recommend checking out this restaurant!

Today was our first time trying Afra Grill and everyone agreed that it was the best meals we’ve had from a restaurant in as long as we can remember. Everything tasted incredibly fresh and was filling. An incredible value for a great meal. Staff was friendly and helpful.

formatted_address: 1635 Morse Rd Suite #2, Columbus, OH 43229, United States
name: Somali Restaurant: Best Somali Food in Columbus

html_attributions: Somali Restaurant: Best Somali Food in Columbus

reviews.text: Everything soo good
Good food

formatted_address: 720 E Lake St, Minneapolis, MN 55407, United States
name: Mama Safia's Kitchen

reviews.text:
I stopped in here yesterday afternoon for lunch after my coworker recommended it, and I left feeling like a million bucks! The community was showing this place some love today too which is always great to see. I was also greeted by such a kind hearted lady working the register. She had such a warm vibe and her customer service was excellent.

I ordered the beef ugali and I cleared the whole plate. The best way to describe it would be sharing all the thoughts that went through my mind at the time of eating. Ooo, ugali has an interesting texture and they made it into a geometrical shape, cool! Ugali goes so well with both the veggies and the meat what the heck?! Whatever yellowness is soaking into the ugali from these veggies is actually delicious. This meat with peppers is so good and it is in a bunch of perfectly bite sized pieces, wow. This green hot sauce has the right amount of heat and goes great on the ugali. Plus I get a banana and a bottle of water, terrific!

Anyways, everything was seasoned well and each component complimented the other perfectly. The portions were generous, the dish was filling, and I left feeling super energized. I can't wait to stop by here again and explore more of the menu. I was also able to find free parking relatively easy about a block up the street in a neighborhood. The dining tables and space could've used a wipe down but other than that, no complaints!

I ordered Rice with Goat for take out and it was so good. The goat was so amazingly tender while the rice was perfectly fluffy. I also had a beef sambusa which was filled with ground beef. The service was fast and very friendly. Would definitely visit again.

Chill, family-friendly space, good food. Ordered beef suqaar with canjeero to go in the late summer. They were half out of canjeero, so they put 1 malawax instead of the full serving of canjeero. Satisfying meal. Would've preferred a touch more seasoning on the beef, but overall very tasty and it did feel very homemade. Both the canjeero & the malawax tasted great with the beef. The server was kind. Will go again.

While visiting Minneapolis we wanted to try Somalian food. Looking at the reviews, we ended up in Mama Safia's Kitchen. In one word, the experience was 'great'! Samosas were fresh and testy. I tried goat lever and Somalian bread. The servers were really friendly and explains things with passion. The restaurant was clean. The spicy tea was refreshing. Overall we were highly satisfied. We would like visit again.

Had an amazing lunch/snack at Mama Safia’s today. Folks were friendly, the sambusas weren’t too spicy for me (which I was worried about) and the Somali tea was INCREDIBLE. The perfect warm drink to sip on a snowy day. I highly recommend it.

formatted_address: 1096 Union St, San Francisco, CA 94133, United States
name: Sumac | Modern Street Food

reviews.text: We loved the Falafel Hummus Bowl and the Fried Chicken Sandwich! This little take-out spot on a steep hill is such a gem. Parking can be tough, but the food is absolutely worth it, every bite was delicious. We were visiting from Minnesota, where good falafel is hard to find, and this place definitely satisfied our cravings! We will stop by again before heading back to Minnesota!

Sumac Modern Street Food offers an amazing dining experience with bold, fresh, and flavorful dishes. The food is creative, well-prepared, and made with high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere is modern and welcoming, and the service is friendly and attentive. A great spot for delicious street food with a modern twists highly recommended!

Made a large order of individual lunches for our office and everything went seamlessly from the food itself, to the packaging and labeling of each meal, to on-time delivery. Not to mention the portions are quite generous. The team at Sumac/Gastrobot take pride in what they do, and it shows. Will be ordering from here over and over again :)

I’m moving out of town and this is what I will miss most. They have done a major overhaul of all their offerings over the last year and this is a major to go hub for all types of food in the area. I’m so glad to live across the street. The Smashburger and banana pie are to die.

Just some genuinely good people working hard, running a great business. Thanks for the food! Appreciate you.

I came here after a workout looking for a healthy and quick meal in the Russian Hill area. We got the chicken salad and the kofte (meatballs) with rice.

Both dishes were super delicious and come packed with veggies. The sauces were also super yummy.

This spot just opened up and the owners are really nice. I def recommend if you’re looking for something delicious, quick and healthy!

formatted_address: 315 5th St, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States
name: Mashaallah Halal Pakistani Food Restaurant

reviews.text:
By far the best restaurant I’ve visited in SF. Where do I even begin? This restaurant takes home made food and elevates it to taste high end. I am always worried about visiting a restaurant where the spices overpower the food, or the food is too oily, and you can’t actually enjoy the meat, but this place has PERFECTED food flavor balance and unbelievable flavor depth.

The food we ordered was the Lamb Shank, with Biryani Rice as a side, and the Haleem. Easily the best Biryani I have had in my life (don’t tell my mom I said that) and better than what I can make at home. The lamb shank was perfectly tender and flavoured just right. The Haleem was amazing. I would recommend and re-order both.

Beyond food, the owners and staff are the kindest most welcoming people I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting at a restaurant. Usually you go to a restaurant just to eat - but here, you make unexpected friends. It really and truly does feel like someone is hosting you for a meal in their home.

If I try to think of something they can improve or do better, I truly can’t think of anything. Really a 100/100 experience coming here.

Discovered this place through an SF Chronicle article and it’s truly a hidden gem. The owner makes all the spices in house, and it shows. The lamb curry was the best I’ve had. Perfectly balanced, full of flavor, and not overly spicy. The lamb biryani was equally excellent with fragrant rice and very tender meat. Warm and welcoming service. Will definitely be coming back.

A true gem of a Pakistani family restaurant! Plenty of seating for groups and very welcoming & fast service. The food was just like moms cooking at home. The hand made parathas were delicious, chicken biryani and halwai puri were great as well. But the star of the show was the lamb shank and the beef haleem - really cooked to perfection!

I visited MashaAllah Halal Food at 315 5th Street and ordered the Haleem.
It was absolutely delicious—rich in taste and truly felt like homemade food.
The owner is very kind and polite, which makes the experience even better.
Everything was perfect. I highly recommend everyone to visit this place! 😊

Dropped by around 5:45pm on a Saturday, no problems with seating, the place was very warm.

Food was very lovely, i had a lamb korma, chicken tikka masala, 2 orders of rice and 2 orders of garlic naan.

Service was great, the owners were very friendly and pleasant and were very enthusiastic

Atmosphere was nice, no loud music and very clean. The place is great for groups of 2-5 people to have good conversations at.

formatted_address: 1754 Euclid Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Faridas Somali Cuisine

reviews.text:
Small restaurant serving delicious home cooked Somali cuisine for 16 years.  It is located in a strip mall that’s not fully occupied.  Its menu is limited and occasionally they might not have some of the dishes.  However, once you take a bite of the food, you will forget about all of that, as all things are cooked just right, with good flavors that are not overpowering, and in good portions.

The goat plate is very tender and the fish in both fish wrap and fish salad is moist and savory.
Service is polite and courteous.  There’s a discount for cash payments, too.

During our recent visit, it was impossible not to notice that nearly every table had ordered the "2 Person or More Sports Plate." At just $35, this platter is an absolute steal, especially given the generous portions. The chicken and beef were seasoned to perfection, delivering a depth of flavor that truly impressed. The pasta, served with a marinara sauce — my toddler’s favorite. The platter also came with a fresh, crisp salad and refreshing mixed drinks, making it a well-rounded meal. You can feel the warmth and love in hearty Somalian food.

We opted for the watermelon and mango drinks, which were delightfully sweet and refreshing — just what we needed on a sweltering summer day.

The service was exceptional; the staff was not only attentive but genuinely warm and welcoming. To top it all off, they surprised us with complimentary sambusas, a thoughtful touch that left a lasting impression.

Overall, this spot delivers on both quality and value, making it a must-try for anyone looking to enjoy a satisfying, well-priced meal for a family. Highly recommended!
Amazing Somali food, very flavorful! Perfect place to bring friends and family

I went with my husband cause I was really interested since the name "Farida's" and my name is Farida lol (I'm the Mexican that went the other day) and the service was 10/10 it really worth it the price since they give you big portion and is so delicious + they gave us banana which I feel really respected as they want us to eat the traditional way, the rice has delicious flavor, the goat, the bread the best! Really really worth it, I love it, I can't wait to go back!

This is my go-to restaurant for take out Somali food.  We always order the Chicken suucqar with rice, pasta, and salad.  So delicious with big portions!  The green hot sauce is pretty spicy and flavorful and the ranch is really good too.  Make sure to get it with the mango or watermelon juice, and the side of banana for the full experience!

formatted_address: 408 Cedar Ave #1, Minneapolis, MN 55454, United States
name: Baarakallah Restaurant Somali Cuisine

reviews.text: Wanted to try something new. Walked into a "local" bonding, hole-in-wall vibe restaurant. Had no idea what any of the items on menu were. Staff explained what dishes consisted of. Went with the KK with chicken. Was able to sit and pay later. They brought food to our table and gave complimentary cokes and waters for us. Staff said they wanted us to "have a good experience and come back". I absolutely loved the food and we cleaned the plate fast! Also, they did not force a tip after paying. Definitely go! And experience amazing hospitality and great food

The steak suqaar was amazing. The chicken KK was too bit bland and sweet for me. A half size plate is still really big and filling! They gave us bananas for free as an appetizer which was super nice! The staff was so nice and we got everything despite our language barrier. Would 1000% recommend for the suqaar!
The food was amazing! If you’re a fan of trying different ethnic foods, I recommend you come here.
Authentic and the best Somalian food in town. A must try. Exquisite food.

One of the worst Somali restaurants in the area please avoid this place especially to order on Uber eats or any kind of delivery they don’t care about your order and they won’t answer your calls unprofessional people

formatted_address: 1624 Powell St, San Francisco, CA 94133, United States
name: La Mediterranee Catering

reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would. From start to finish, working with Jordan was smooth and easy. This was an important event, for 60 people in our home, and, in no small part thanks to Jordan, was stress-free. He also comped us a tasting ahead of time at the restaurant on Fillmore, which enabled us to make a couple of changes. Oh, and did I mention that the food was delicious?

La Med was an absolute dream to work with! We ordered their catering for our event and their team, particularly Jordan, Steve & Emmanual, did everything they could to make it the smoothest event ever. They went out of their way to cater for our requests and the food they made was delicious. Would highly recommend to anyone considering catering for their event. Thanks team!

The La Mediterranee Catering team did a stellar job for our big family event. They were very responsive to pre-event questions and order changes, as our guest count increased. The food was delicious and received compliments from our guests. The servers were professional and did a nice job with set-up and take-down. Thank you, La Med! We have loved your food for decades and you helped make our event very special.
La Med has served constantly memorable food since I was in college in the 60s. Still serves the same great dishes with the same wonderful quality at just the right price. Go enjoy!!
Have been a long time fan of this place. Love the pomegranate chicken.

formatted_address: 4879 University Ave # C, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Aalami Restaurant - Somali Cuisine

reviews.text: The rice and lamb was absolutely spectacular and the price was very good huge portions probably enough for two people unless you eat a lot of food

The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor! The service was fast and friendly, and the staff made us feel very welcome. The atmosphere was clean, cozy, and perfect for a relaxing meal.
Highly recommend this place.
amazing service! the staff went above and beyond to make sure we had a fantastic dining experience.

I came across this randomly and it was awesome!  The salmon and spaghetti were perfectly seasoned with interesting spices and a peppery green sauce for some kick!  I can’t wait to try other items!  There’s no menu on the wall or anywhere to be found which to me is exciting! The staff and customers were very friendly :-)

Im So Glad i Ran into this Place
... the stuff is Very Friendly and Helpful... and the food is very Good!!

formatted_address: 132 Hazelwood Dr, South San Francisco, CA 94080, United States
name: Sofra Grill

reviews.text: One of my favorite spots in town! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. You can really taste the quality in every bite. The team is super nice and welcoming, and the service is always fast. Prices are fair, and the whole experience feels authentic and comfortable. I’ve been here several times, and every visit has been just as great as the last!

I got picked up from the airport with my husband’s wish to take me to this place he had heard about from his friend and boy did it deliver.  He ordered way too much which meant yummy lunches for both of us.  We got the baba ganoush, lamb shank (photo shows) falafel Greek salad and kebobs.  Every single thing that we tasted was fresh and tasty.  Even though it’s far from Oakland , we will def be back
The dishes looked and tasted fresh. The cod fish special could use a bit more seasoning. But everything else we ordered were very flavorful. Also, our server was very friendly and helpful.

THIS IS INSANE! I cant believe i have found this amazing place! Guys i have tried all Mediterranean restaurants all over the Bay Area and trust me there is nothing close to this! You will be impressed by the food portion, quality, and price! I was never being able to finish my order! Long menu full of attractions and satisfying prices! The staff are so friendly and nice, very talented and always smiling, you will also find the owner himself  serving and welcoming you  with a lot of generosity and hospitality! Not only the food is amazing and quick but the vibes are so charming we always feel ourselves at home! Sorry to make it long but believe me every item on the menu deserves a story! Last but not least the phenomenal signature dessert: Kunafa! OMG! The fastest way to get dopamine and being happy! Really a perfection! 5 stars not enough trust me! Thanks for being here ❤️

Sofra Grill is my Friday destination, and every visit impresses me. The chefs’ attention to detail is evident in every dish: thoughtfully chosen ingredients, perfectly paired flavors, and sauces applied with precision.

This visit, I tried the Mandi. It was unique and flavorful with a generous lamb shank and rice. IMHO, reducing the nuts portion by half would be better. With the dish’s already substantial size, this wouldn’t diminish its character, just make it feel more balanced.

Highly recommended for authentic Mediterranean cuisine.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

formatted_address: 2598 San Jose Ave, San Francisco, CA 94112, United States
name: The M Stop Deli

reviews.text:
Tried The M Stop for the first time after seeing Daniel Lurie stop here for a bite! We had the K Line sandwich with pastrami, turkey, cheese, and chipotle sauce —  delicious.
At lunch, the shop was busy but not packed, with a chill, casual vibe. The ingredients tasted fresh, and the sandwich was well-balanced and flavorful.
That said, it’s definitely on the pricier side for a sandwich (ours was $20). You’re paying more than you would at a typically, but the quality is there, and it’s worth checking out if you’re in the area.

The best kept secret sandwich place in SF. I CANNOT believe how delicious this sourdough bread roll with Pastrami and saracha sauce was. The pastrami was smoky and out of this world. Definitely want to go back and bring friends and family.

I got the M-line sandwich and SUBHAN ALLAH it was the best sandwich I ever had. The tri-tip was seasoned to perfection and the juices were dripping out of my sandwich! Highly recommended!

Sal, the owner, was very respectful, humble, and professional. He made the experience pleasant and demonstrated genuine care for his customers.

First time here and it was great! I ordered 2 of the T Line sandwich and asked kindly for avocado instead of cheese. The worker was really nice and made the sandwiches very fast. Both sandwiches were big and lots of deli meat in them. The dutch bread was also very fresh.

Also got the rice krispie banana dessert, great combination idea. Recommend getting it if you want something sweet.

Extremely good and great atmosphere!

I came across this place on the DoorDash app while I was hungry and in need of something to eat. It is pretty unique that they name their sandwiches after the different muni bus lines from San Francisco. Their sandwiches are special from others, it is packed with a combination of meats, vegetables and special sauces they use. Everything is made from scratch daily which is a plus. This place is fairly new in the neighborhood, I remember when it used to be a liquor/convience store. They also offer drinks and snacks besides their awesome sandwiches. I highly recommend this place for all sandwich enthusiasts, anyone looking to try something new or if you just happen to be in the area. I definitely will be back to tryout the other delicious options they have to offer.

formatted_address: 48 Fieldgate St, London E1 1ES, United Kingdom
name: Janna Cafe

reviews.text:
Somali Food is one of my favorite cuisines and I've been wanting to try out @_jannacafe for ages.

Finally made the trip down and it didn't disappoint.

For starters you can't miss the Somali fries. Didn't know what to expect but they were hella tasty.

For the mains the platter did exactly what we wanted - meat heaven with spicy bisbas and flavourful rice.

As for dessert, oreo milk cake was meh but you gotta try their date cake - oh so good!

That's another solid Somali spot option added 💯

It's a West African casual dining place in Whitechapel. The entrance is located a few meters away from the back of the East London Mosque. We popped in after going to the cinema (Curzon) nearby. We opted for the meat platter for 2 as it was recommended. The food was amazing, especially the lamb, which was juicy and tender at the same time. our platter also had beef cubes on it which was also good but i preferred the lamb. The dish itself is not spicy at all so it has mild flavours, cooked with peppers, onions and their one herb blend but not spicy. The spice, if you want some, comes from the 2 side sauces the medium heat red one (slightly peppery and maybe has come cayenne in there) and the green sauce which is the real spicy one (i assume green chillies or similar) and the good news is you can use both sauces as much or as little as you like. For me it added depth to the dish. I also enjoyed the Guava juice. The dish is very big so we hardly finished 1/3 between the 2 of us, and ended up taking home the rest. Good food, nice spot for a quick and tasty halal meat lunch or dinner.

I’ve never had cuisine from this area of the world and omg best first time I think I could have. The sauces are so good and flavorful. l wanted to try allll the cake options! visit if you’re in the neighborhood or at the Wombats Hostel. Was much needed after traveling all day to get to the hostel

Absolutely amazing experience at Jana Cafe!
The traditional Somali food was authentic, fresh, and full of flavour. You can really taste the passion and culture in every dish. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Definitely one of the best places to enjoy authentic Somali cuisine - highly recommended!

"I recently dined here and had an overall fantastic experience. The food was plentiful and truly delicious, with many dishes exceeding my expectations. Our server was great, providing attentive and friendly service throughout the meal.

The only slight drawback was that some menu items were unavailable due to being sold out. While this was understandable, it would be beneficial to ensure that popular items are replenished more frequently.

Despite this, the quality of the food and service shone through, and I would highly recommend this establishment to others. With a bit of refinement, it has the potential to be truly exceptional."

formatted_address: 7277 Turfway Rd SUITE C, Florence, KY 41042, United States
name: East African Restaurant- Somali

reviews.text:
The owner/chef is so sweet greets you with the biggest smile and her cooking is very delicious. Be sure to get the tea.
Also the restaurant has seen many improvements in the few years I have been coming here. Huge portions. Very clean. Very reasonably priced. Will be back again and again.

Grabbed lunch here on a Thursday. We walked in and there was only one person working. It took a minute for our food to come out - which was fine considering the one man band in the kitchen. The sanbuz (sambuus or sambusas) were very good, the one-in lamb was great, but I was really in love with the simple yet delicious seasoned rice (bariis iskukaris). So good. So if you have the time, its well worth a stop. To be fair they do have quick bites as well. Either way, go.

My lovely wife and I stopped and ate here Nov 1st. When we arrived, i believe it was the owner that welcomed us. I told him that we’ve never been here before. He showed us to a booth, and explained some of the menu. We had plenty of questions about the names of some of the foods. He was very courteous and explained everything we asked about. Cans of pop were the drinks. He brought us an appetizer in just a few minutes. It was really good! My dinner was lamb and rice, with an included salad. The lovely one had chicken stew. (It also had rice and a salad) both of our meals were very good and so filling. The rice was very good, but didn’t look like rice. It resembled the little noodles that are in cup-a-soup. But either way, it was excellent!
After our wonderful meal, I went up to pay, and the owner was making a drink. I asked him what he was making, I think he said saah. But then said it’s a tea. He made me a cup of it while I was paying. We took it with us and after it cooled down a bit, we both enjoyed it. Another  wry good thing they have.
I’ve never had Somali food, or even met a Somali person. He was super and so was the service & food.
We will definitely stop in when we are in that area and try some of the other menu items.

We are always looking for food with great flavor.  This place was awesome and we will be back.

My favorite dish was the Samosas.. appetizer suggested by our waiter.. very friendly and i reactive service.  He was really helpful with helping us order.  We liked everything so he did a great job.  To be honest I didn’t enjoy the noodles due to some spice but my husband loved them..

I can’t wait to go back for the samosas.

I gave our kiddo a leftover crepe with whipped crème and berries and then a different one with the chicken and she loved them both

A must try! You will feel at home in this restaurant. They service East African food, mostly Somali. The service is friendly and they treat you like family. The hot spiced tea had just the right spices and sweetness. The chapatis were a good portion size, fresh and flaky. Both the beef and chicken stews were very tasty. We also tried the chicken sambusas which were crisp on the outside with plenty of flavorful filling. We enjoyed our meal very much.

formatted_address: 1447 Independence Ave Ste 117, Kansas City, MO 64106, United States
name: Yasmeen Cafe

reviews.text: I stopped in for a late lunch yesterday and my lamb dinner was delicious. The lamb was hot moist tender and served on a big bed of rice with a side salad garnish. It also came with a unique zesty green sauce that I really enjoyed! My side of naan bread was also delicious! Thank you for a delicious and unique dining experience.

Yasmeen Restaurant in Kansas City is truly one of the top Somali dining spots, offering outstanding food and excellent customer service. Their lamb wasla with rice is a personal favorite—tender, flavorful, and prepared in a unique way that really stands out. Whenever I’m in Kansas City and craving a satisfying meal, I make it a point to visit, no matter how far I have to travel. I’ve been coming here for over two years, and the quality of their dishes has never disappointed me. The flavors even remind me of authentic Mandi meat from Saudi Arabia. The staff makes the experience even better, especially the tall gentleman whose warm and friendly service always makes me feel welcome

I live in Olathe, Kansas, which means I often drive 15 to 20 miles just to enjoy a meal at this place. My brother recommended it to me on Saturday evening, and after experiencing the delicious food, I decided to take the whole family there the very next day. The food was outstanding, and the mango juice was simply phenomenal!

I don't really like the location of this restaurant but the food was amazing! Prices are affordable and portions are so generous that you can have enough for at least 2 meals(if you order 1 portion for yourself). I didn't like the mango juice as it felt watered down but other than that the tea and the food were phenomenal.

We went as a group and ordered the fish, lamb, goat and chicken suqaar. My favourite part? The green sauce that came with the food.

I really hate to leave a negative review on this place as it has been one of my favorite places to go these whole year to the point where I’ve come in at least every other week for the samosa’s. At first they were always fresh and hot ..the whole last couple of months they have been hot on the outside and real cold on the inside. I don’t know if the cooks have got lazy but these are no longer enjoyable and I will be giving my business elsewhere to other business’s who will take pride in the quality of the food they serve. Mind you I have complained about this issue to the establishment multiple times with no change on their end.

formatted_address: 6511 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: Bisbas Restaurant

reviews.text: My first time here and it was a wonderful experience!!! The food, customer service, ambience ---everything was out of the world. We hand the Mandi rice with half chicken and Beef  (order for 2) but 3 of us couldn't finish it.  It came with soup which was so delicious, a side vegetable and salad. I also ordered the Sambusas.... so very delicious and that's because it was made from the scratch.  The price was very reasonable.  I ordered my Mandi rice with half chicken and sliced beef. But by mistake they put both chicken meat. When I brought it to their attention, they immediately brought me the beef  and let us enjoy the sliced chicken as well. It was a wonderful customer service they provided. They served banana with the meal which we are not used to and the owner who standing nearby explained the whole story behind it. So we not only enjoyed a great  10 out of 10 dinner, we also learned history too!!  I also tried the cinnamon tea. It was so fresh and refreshing.  We heard about this place and drove 130 miles from North Hollywood to try them and IT WAS WORTH THE DRIVE.  We are planning to go back again with our friends soon to try the goat meat (which they were out of when we went because of high demand). I wish all at the Bisbas  restaurant all the Best. Keep up the good work and THANK YOU FOR TREATING US SO WELL.

First time trying Somali food. I'm so glad it was here! Heard good things about the cuisine and always wanted to try it. Was looking for a lunch spot between the Toyota dealer and home (near SDSU) and noticed the 4.9 rating. Went for dinner on a Thursday night. Not very crowded. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Menu was varied, portions were generous and prices were very fair (for the quality and quantity of the food, we each took half of our entrées home!).
I had the Chapati KK Chicken ($16), which was diced up flatbread mixed in an amazing sauce, with chopped chicken, onions and peppers. Served with a wedge of lemon, some very flavorful, but VERY spicy "salsa" on the side, and ... a banana! I also tried the traditional Vimto drink, a carbonated spiced jamaica drink served cold over ice (tasty). 😁
My wife got the Goat Mandi, served with a generous serving of rice pilaf and a green salad ($22). It came with the same nuclear hot green sauce and a kind of ranch dressing and a garnish of seasoned fries, and ... a banana! The goat was falling off the bones tender (some of which were very small, so exercise caution there) and the flavors were exotic and delicious (she took more than half of hers home, too). Part of that might have been the desire to try their fries, which I saw came with other dishes on the menu. I figured $5 for a side of fries just to be able to try them was a good deal. They brought them out late (after I inquired), but it was a whole heaping plate of shoestring fries (think McDonald's, but better) and they were too good to leave (took half of them home, too!) 😎
She also had the hot Shaah Caadeys (Somali spiced tea with milk), like an Indian Chai, but not too sweet.
Both of the young men working were very pleasant, friendly and helpful, taking the time to explain everything and patiently answering our questions. The setting is just a strip mall in an odd part of town, but they have obviously taken pride and care to create a warm, welcoming space. ALL of the dishes were absolutely delicious and the dinnerware was beautiful, in contrast to the cheesy napkins and the over stock stacked near the bathroom. 😁
We will DEFINITELY be back to try the rest of the menu and are very glad to have another wonderful variety of great, international food in the neighborhood.

Great Somali restaurant. It was absolutely worth my drive from LA to try this amazing restaurant. Food was delicious and the prices were very reasonable given the amount of food. My wife and daughter loved it. Will be back to try again soon.

Bisbas Restaurant is hands-down the best Somali spot in San Diego! From the moment I walked in, the warm, welcoming vibe and the incredible aromas pulled me right in. This place truly transports you with authentic flavors that are bold, fresh, and perfectly balanced.

I ordered the half chicken with rice, and wow—it was a masterpiece. The chicken was marinated in rich Somali spices, grilled to juicy perfection with that beautiful char, and served in a massive, shareable portion (though I didn’t want to share!). The rice was fluffy, fragrant, and mixed with veggies, and that creamy green bisbas sauce on the side? Absolute fire—spicy, herby, and addictive. I couldn’t stop dipping everything in it!
The service was top-notch—friendly, attentive, and happy to explain the dishes. I also tried the Somali spiced tea (shaah), which was the perfect sweet finish. Everything felt homemade and made with love.

If you’re craving real Somali cuisine, big portions, and a genuine cultural experience, Bisbas is a must-visit. I’ll be back soon—5 stars all the way! Highly recommend to everyone in SD! 🇸🇴🍗

Man ! First time having Somalian food and it was amazing ! I came here with my buddy and we started off with mango drinks and Sambusa ! Super good both a must try. We got the platter for two and the portion was huge ! We got half rice and half pasta for our base, with a half chicken and goat mendi as our proteins. Then I got the beef suqaar plate and that meat was so flavorful. My buddy got the  beef bisteeki fries( similar to carne asada fries ) which he loved ! We both finished off with Dubai chocolate! Definitely coming to this spot to try some items ! Restaurant was clean! Service was great !

formatted_address: 58 Leland Ave, San Francisco, CA 94134, United States
name: Creative Ideas Cafe

reviews.text: I was working on the visitation valley area a couple days ago and was thinking what am I going to have for lunch? I looked on my phone and there weren't many choices but came across creative Ideas Cafe. It had really good reviews and a pretty decent size menu. I've never had Colombian food before so I didn't know what to expect. I did a little research online and Instagram and watched a couple videos of food influencers reviewing the place. I decided I would give it a try. I am really happy that I did. I ended up getting the Bandeja Paisa which was really tasty. There was a mix of different dishes in the plate that I've never had before. Everything was flavorful from the Colombian chorizo to the Colombian red beans or the chicharronas or my favorite the cheese arepa with some of their green salsa. OMG that green salsa is the shit hella good. I also wanted to try the Ajiaco which is their corn and potatoe and chicken and soup. The soup had a really nice taste to it very comforting. I also did an order of their chicken and beef empanadas those were out of the park great flavor. The crunch itself was so crispy that also paired well with the green salsa I washed it down with a squirt grapefruit soda. Couldn't have paired better. I definitely want to go back and try some new dishes that I have not tried yet. Their menu is a pretty good size and everything is made to order. If you have a chance to stop by and visit this place, do not think twice you will like it. Keep up the great work!

We had such a great experience at this Colombian restaurant! If you are looking for authentic Latin flavors and a true taste of Colombia, this is the place to come. The atmosphere is cozy, family-friendly, and makes you feel right at home. We tried the tamal and a traditional Colombian breakfast, and both dishes were full of flavor, fresh, and absolutely delicious.

What really stood out was the service — everyone was super kind, welcoming, and attentive, which made the whole visit even better. We are staying in downtown and decided to come here, and honestly, it was more than worth the trip. If you’re visiting the area or even if you live nearby, don’t miss the chance to stop by. You’ll leave full, happy, and already planning your next visit!

The nacho fries are to die for! And I can honestly say that wholeheartedly. This place is to die for The food is exceptional the atmosphere is amazing The workers are super sweet very kind. And the fact that it's a block and a half away from my home makes it even better. If you like carne asada fries I highly recommend them I just got them again today December 3rd and man let me tell you I ate some got full put them away came back a couple hours later and my French fries were still crispy and crunchy. If that doesn't say this place knows how to make food I don't know what does 10 out of 10 would highly recommend for all your wonderful Colombian food!

If you’re looking for “REAL” Colombian food in the Bay Area; this spot is excellent. This is a small Colombian and Mexican cafe-turned-restaurant which has some of the most authentic and homemade Colombian food I’ve tried in the area. They even have local Colombian beers and desserts.

While it seems small, there are a few tables inside and outside. This establishment is growing in popularity and does cater. They have a variety of arepas, Colombian breads, and weekly Colombian soups which are just amazing. When we went today; they had ajiaco which I haven’t seen in YEARS. They also had bandeja paisa, pandebono, arepa de queso, and so many other treats.

If you’re not a fan of Colombian food - there is also tons of Mexican food here too. However; I HIGHLY recommend coming for the Colombian dishes which are honestly some of the best in the area if you’re a Colombia fan.
I just ordered 3 items and I wish I ordered more. The Empanadas are home made, the arepas are home made, the sauces are home made and now Im home sick. Authentic Colombian food. Delicious

formatted_address: 3486 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110, United States
name: Cuisine Of Nepal

reviews.text: Food came fast and was very hot. Employees are friendly. Lamb samosas were good, a little salty. Cashew chicken curry didnt taste very much like cashews but was still good, a little salty.
Love this place. Great food and wonderful vibe. The owner and chef Prem is the man! What a kind, curious, friendly man. The cashew chicken curry is delicious.

Fantastic experience on all levels - this was my best dining experience in several years. The food was ultra flavorful and the meat (lamb, chicken, and salmon) were all perfectly tender. The staff was courteous and generous. As far as pricing goes, we felt like we time-warped back 5 years. $15 bottle of wine at a restaurant seems unheard of, and food prices were also reasonable. We got a plate of momo and 3 main dishes for 4 people and this was a perfect amount of food. We will most certainly be coming back and we hope to see you there!

This is a very special restaurant. I’m sorry I don’t live in San Francisco, because I would love to have a restaurant with such home-cooked style, authentic flavor, and fresh ingredients nearby. Not only do Prem and his family make every bite special, they make you feel like you’re at home.

I love how we have these unique cuisine in San Francisco I can try without flying thousands of miles to Nepal. The food here is so delicious and the people there are really nice. The cook came over to say hello and kept pouring us drinks 😂 They have very good service. I feel I’m ready to climb Mount Everest after eating this food 😁

formatted_address: 1599 Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117, United States
name: Abu Salim Middle Eastern Grill

reviews.text:
They were quick with the smiles,  greetings and beverage fill ups.
The food was delicious.
The best creamy hummus I've ever had.  I didn't even km l need the juicy chicken schwarma on top.
The loaded fries were so good as well.
The star dish for me was the lamb shank with rice.  It comes with a light sauce that you pour it over the whole thing.
Meat was a bit gamey (which I don't mind), but it was fall off the bone.
Absolutely delicious.
We also ordered the baba ganoush and the beef lamb schwarma plate,  but we liked the other dishes more.
Would definitely come back for more hummus,  fries and lamb.

Easy to find, this place offers a true taste of the Middle East with its most traditional dishes. The portions are generous and packed with amazing flavors. Service is friendly and efficient, and the menu is simple yet detailed. A must-try if you’re in the mood for authentic Mediterranean food.

The only downside is that the tables are old and sticky — they could use a good scrub-down and a fresh coat to match the quality of the food.

Always quality! Love this place. The staff are always so incredibly friendly and treat me like family. I usually get the shwarma wrap or the plate. Big portions. So gas. I love their homemade hot sauce. Perfect for takeout and also dine-in. Love going to Abu Salim for a lunch or a quick dinner.

Love the atmosphere and wall painting make you feel like you’re fully immersed in yourself in the culture and food! Love the Mint Tea and Turkish Coffee wasn’t good! We ordered combo plate with hummus and basket of pitas which was good. The falafel was okay not what we were looking for. But everyone there was very friendly and nice!

Stopped by for dinner last night and we're blown away at how delicious everything was. The service was friendly and kind. The staff seemed genuinely happy to be there. We ordered promptly and food came out quickly but gave us enough time to enjoy the items we ordered. Portions were huge and priced fairly. This is the place if you are looking for a delicious meal with friendly people!

formatted_address: 1001 Howard St, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
name: Bini's Kitchen LLC

reviews.text: Went with a group and they kindly put two tables together. The food was tasty and the portions for a plate were large. We got one order of roti abd probably wouldn't get it again for the price, plus the plates had enough rice to eat with the other items.

Bini's Kitchen is so amazingly delicious.  The doubling with a little curry on top and a some delicious soup inside. I'm salivating just describing it.  I highly recommend the chicken curry with momo dumplings lunch special.  It's amazing.  You owe it to yourself to check it out.

Ordered Veg Momos (10 Pc.) to go. The taste was good. I liked the red dry chutney they gave along with the momos. I can easily eat 2 plates of these momos. The ambience is a small little place to have quick food. Price is also acceptable.

Bini’s catered a party for a non-profit I volunteer with. The food was flavorful and yummy.
Momos (like Chinese Shanghai dumplings without soup), rice pilaf with cinnamon, chicken curry, a vegetarian tofu & veggie stew, stewed eggplant.
Omg, it was so good!

Fantastic Nepalese food in the heart of an up and coming SOMA neighborhood. I’ve had lunch here four or five times, and the food is delicious, super authentic, and very consistent.

The restaurant is situated in the ground floor of a newer building, so the dining area has polished concrete floors and filled with light, with a beautiful design.

If you’re living or working downtown, this should definitely be on your list to check out.

formatted_address: 2156 Hoffman Rd, Mankato, MN 56001, United States
name: Somali Restaurant And Grocery

reviews.text: I recently moved to the Mankato area from Fargo, and was missing the great East African and Somali food we had up there. Well, this restaurant doesn’t disappoint. The staff were friendly (the older gentleman was great) and the prices aren’t bad given the amount of food you get. Two people could split a plate with two drinks and not go hungry. The environment is not fancy but it’s sectioned off in a small market/grocery store.

The food speaks for it self to be honest! And the customer service is Beyond friendly and warming. As a worker an son of the old man that some people I see here not to happy with him or believe his behavior isn’t at his best. He’s the owner of the restaurant. Fun facts; actually he’s the one who also makes those lamb shank that u see Every morning and some people trust are on line for it everyday! My father might be old but he’s Dedicated to his business an he makes sure it runs smoothly and Safely as possible for our customers and the staff. We Treat everyone with respect like any other human being wanted to be treated we listen and Provide the best service to our beloved customers.

If anyone feels other wise please don’t hesitate to reach out your opinion matters To us. Again Thank you for all the beautiful comments we appreciated you guys and we will keep improving.

BROTHERS RESTAURANT IS’NT GOING ANYWHERE:)

The greatest goat meat I've ever had the pleasure of tasting, not to mention the deliciously seasoned rice. Only $10 for a meal you may only finish if you're very hungry. Unique environment, as well as a grocery store with some of my favourite beverages. Very friendly people too. I look forward to returning. I highly recommend the rice/meat based dishes if you have celiac, as I personally encountered no problems.
Fantastic food, nice people, and reasonably priced for a good amount of food! Definitely recommend the rice and goat or lamb plate, don't forget the ranch, green hot sauce, and banana!

Went here on a whim and was incredibly surprised. It seems like a "hole in the wall" when you first walk in, and there's the restaurant on the right-hand side and a grocery store on the left. I ordered Lamb with Rice, and for $10 there was a very generous amount of both lamb and rice, along with lime and a banana. Certainly worth the money. The lamb exceeded all expectations, and was perhaps some of the best meat I have ever had, especially within the Mankato area. The grocery store has many "foreign" delicacies, such as Vimto soda and imported tea, among many other things. The service was great; the two men there were very pleasent, helpful, and conversational. I will for sure be returning many times into the future!

formatted_address: 601 Mission Bay Blvd North, San Francisco, CA 94158, United States
name: Lahore di Khushboo

reviews.text: The Halwa puri platter was awesome. I normally don’t order vegetarian entrees but puri is something special. These didn’t disappoint, flaky, inflated pillows of deliciousness. The platter wasn’t huge but I would say the price is right in line with all the other food trucks here. Each curry was delicious in the platter. They have a chili oil they drizzled on the chickpea one that had a subtle sweetness that was great. Next time I’d ask for extra oil drizzle.

The food and service here were absolutely delicious and the backdrop is amazing! Loved seeing the Golden Gate Bridge as we finished off our food here. Would definitely recommend cooking to visit and we’ll definitely be back soon!

Extremely Disappointing Experience at Lahore di Khusboo

My family and I were visiting San Francisco and decided to try Lahore di Khusboo. We spent over $100 on food, expecting a great experience, but we were sadly let down. The portions were surprisingly small for the price we paid – definitely not worth it. After receiving our order, we realized we didn’t have enough ketchup for the fries, so I went back to ask for more. To my surprise, the staff was incredibly rude and refused to give us extra ketchup, saying, "We can’t afford to give you extra ketchup." This attitude was completely unacceptable, especially after we had just spent a substantial amount of money.

The food itself was nothing special, and the customer service left a lot to be desired. We won’t be returning to Lahore di Khusboo and highly recommend looking elsewhere if you're in the area. Terrible experience overall.
Delicious chicken tikka masala and great customer service! Would highly recommend

I was here specially to eat Halwa puri and celebrate my friend's birthday. This is a food truck and the food that you get is authentic, home cooked food and delicious. They're mostly around San Francisco near Presidio and Valencia. The city vibe, the delicious food and their hospitality is priceless. We ordered Halwa puri which is mostly breakfast that has two big puris, chickpea curry, a tangy potato curry along with halwa which is a sweet dish and it was completed with Kashmiri chai. One must try as this tea is pink in color with a little salt taste which breaks the sweetness, loved it.
After that we got charga, this is a special chicken dish which goes through a process and the result of that can be only experienced after eating it. This dish comes with chicken leg, pulav rice, and salad.
We loved everything and before saying goodbye to them we had another Kashmiri chai and started walking around the city. Do follow them on Instagram @lahoredikhushboo and find out where they are going to be. On December 18th they will be in Pleasanton near Peri Peri as they do tie up with other restaurants as well. You can book them for private events as well. I'm already looking forward to that date, make sure you're too. A delicious Pakistani style cooked food brings the aura and taste of the place where it started this journey. I highly recommend this food truck. Since it was my friend's birthday we got a complimentary sweet dish rabdi kheer with gulab jamun which was delicious and not very sweet. Try out of you like dessert that's made out of dairy.

formatted_address: 700 Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117, United States
name: Palmyra

reviews.text: I was really impressed with the falafel plate here. Every item tasted fresh and full of simple, clean flavor. The team working here is genuinely kind, and the relaxed counter service setup makes the whole visit feel comfortable and easy. I left completely satisfied and will definitely return.

Highly recommend! I come here often because it has great food, kind hosts, and ample space/seating. Very comfortable place to eat, sit and read or chat with friends. I’ve tried the rotisserie chicken, lamb shawarma, and kofta platter - all were delicious, though my personal favourite is lamb shawarma. A special shout out goes to the cashier worker/server who is always warm, smiling, and extremely welcoming! Really appreciate his kindness and hard work. Owner is also lovely.

I would definitely come back here and get the falafel wrap again! Great combination of flavors and textures, very enjoyable. I ordered online for pickup and made a note about my allergy; the man behind the cash register was good about checking in with me about this and making sure I felt secure in my order. I could tell the service is very friendly and personable. I was in a rush to something so couldn’t engage in a chat but if I had time, I probably would have. Lots of indoor seating, a bit of outdoor seating.

Just a note to the business: if you can make your signage any bigger or more visible, especially being on a corner, I think it would bring more business! I was following Google maps and still walked right past it and then had to backtrack because the signage wasn’t very visible to me. Another friend who frequents this area said she’s been around a lot of places and never knew a Mediterranean place was nearby. Y’all have great food- advertise more boldly if possible!

The woman at the counter was incredibly kind, warm and friendly. You can tell they care about the business and making you feel comfortable while your there.
The food was fresh, the flavors were bright and I ended up eating way more than I should've! That hummus I could've eaten by itself. Super smooth and delicious. The salad with perfect. Vegetables were delicious!
We brought it to out father in the hospital and it made his evening.
The food here was delicious. They treat you like you're at home, and they're very friendly. Their tables are large and the space is pleasant. Their menu also offers a variety of Syrian dishes.

formatted_address: 388 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94111, United States
name: Nosh Cafe & Catering

reviews.text: I not familiar with the area but I found this shop on my walk. They are so welcoming and friendly and the coffee is amazing! I am visiting from Texas.

I couldn't find a sandwich shop that offered turkey bacon and I am happy I stumbled on this shop. They have turkey bacon and other meat options besides pork. Their breakfast sandwiches are stuffed generously and the employees are very friendly and welcoming

Great surprise going to this place.  The restaurant is located over Market street in downtown San  Francisco. We found this place going out if the Bart (sign at the entrance says NOSH CAFE).
We loved the service. There was a gentleman in particular who assisted us picking up our food but also with information on how to get to our hotel.  Also there was a female employee (skinny lady with two hair color style) great service and extremely polite and attentive.
Besides an awesome service, the food was delicious.  I went for late oatmeal, my husband ordered a hot chocolate and croissants.  We took to go a Greek salad and turkey sandwich.  Everything was delicious.
Thanks 🙏 for offering great food but most important for providing an outstanding guest service.  Definitely go here.  The first choice to go when you arrive in downtown San Francisco. .

I always walk by this place on my way to work ,but since it’s kind of unassuming, I never gave it a shot. Bad on me. I went the other day and ordered the chipotle chicken bowl…it was fantastic! Can’t wait to try other stuff out. The price is super affordable for the city and the service was very friendly. The guy gave behind the counter gave me a complimentary orange juice. I’ll be back for sure!
The food here is absolutely delicious! Seriously one of the best sandwiches Ive had. Highly recommend the Fog Buster. Tasted very fresh and super good serving sizes

formatted_address: 3119 Clement St, San Francisco, CA 94121, United States
name: El Mansour

reviews.text: It was a fantastic experience with Morrocan ambience with decor,  food, and music. The belly dancing show is a must see and enchanting. It starts at 7:30 so make sure to make sure before. It's a delicious 5 course meal. Bring cash for the belly dancers to show your love!

El Mansour is a feast for the senses—rich flavors, vibrant ambiance, and unforgettable entertainment all wrapped in Moroccan elegance.

Stepping into El Mansour in San Francisco’s Outer Richmond feels like entering a different world. The restaurant’s interior is draped in authentic Moroccan textiles, lanterns, and ornate décor that instantly sets the mood for a magical evening. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply craving something extraordinary, this place delivers.

🍽️ The Food
-  you’ll find equally indulgent Moroccan classics.
- Chicken Bastilla—a sweet-savory pastry filled with spiced chicken and almonds—is a standout.
- Lamb with prunes and honey, Moroccan seafood tagine, and eggplant dishes are rich, aromatic, and deeply satisfying.
- Portions are generous, and the flavors are bold yet balanced, with fragrant spices and slow-cooked tenderness in every bite.

💃 The Experience
- Every evening features a mesmerizing belly dance performance, adding a festive, immersive touch to the meal. Guests are often invited to join in, making it interactive and fun.
- The staff is warm and attentive, going out of their way to make you feel welcome and cared for.

Came here to celebrate a milestone anniversary and we definitely made the right decision. Absolutely everything was perfect from the excellent service from Gan, wonderful belly dancing from Janessa, beautiful atmosphere, fun music, and seriously delicious food! We ordered the 5 course meal with Rabbit Tagine and Lamb Shoulder with eggplant for our entrees and Strawberry Splash and Sweet Sunrise drinks. They also surprised us with an extra dessert for our anniversary. We loved everything and will definitely return. Highly recommend!! Thank you for making our evening so special and fun!!❤️

My first time trying Moroccan food. A nice dining with fun experience on belly dancing. The dancer is a great entertainer. Dancing with the dancer is a must. I would recommend it for a couple or a group so that you can take videos for each other.

The food is nice. The dish I love the most is chicken bastilla. Such a great filling and the crispy pastry they offer.

The service is great. They welcome you with warm water to clean your hands and when you finish the main course they let you clean your hands again before pouring the rose water, which smells super nice.

Our waiter Adir did great job serving our big crowd. Amazing food. We ordered King’s feast, the lamb is delicious, chicken was so soft and flavorful, kebab is also good. Atmosphere and ambiance is beautiful. The belly dancer is entertaining. We all had a great time.

formatted_address: 1924 Irving St, San Francisco, CA 94122, United States
name: Noori Pakistani & Indian Cuisine - SF

reviews.text: Great deals on the plate! Only $1 more to add naan. Mango lassi was delicious too!
Super quiet and lot of vegan options! Which are not common in the zone. Highly recommend, coconut curry is delicious.
Delicious food and great flavors! Everything tasted so fresh and well made.

This place is amazing! After a day at the park on a Saturday, my friends and I stumbled upon Noori for a late lunch/early dinner. Everything we ordered was ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS, and our server was the sweetest and coolest! I ordered the Go Vegan lunchbox (aloo coconut, tofu saag, rice, onion salad) and it all tasted so different and more flavorful than the dishes I've had at other Pakistani/Indian restaurants. We can't wait to come back!

I had lunch with my parents. Excellent indian pakistani food and very kind staff. I especially loved the Bhuna Gosht (slow-cooked goat) and Gulab Jamun for dessert. Lots of Naan to share and dip in the sauce. Will come again!

formatted_address: 499 Ellis St, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States
name: Azalina's

reviews.text: Despite its warts, San Francisco is a special place. This 46 square mile region of earth is gifted with a concentration of culinary delights. Expand that to the bay area as a whole and you are arguably, in one of the worlds epicenters of gastronomy. Therefore, to standout in this milieu is an achievement. Located at the corner of Ellis and Leavenworth Azalina's is certainly a destination worthy of those seeking epicurean delights. Touted as providing a take on Malaysian "street food", what is served is actually an elevated interpretation of the wonderful flavors and sensations found in traditional Malaysian dishes and the Malay hawker tradition. The chef's genius for manipulating those traditional Malay flavors results in creatively delicious food. The combination of texture, spice and other seasonings is studied and expertly performed. Attention is also given to the presentation that enhances the beauty of these culinary creations. This is a true San Francisco treat and it is no mistake that this restaurant has been on the NY times list of 25 best restaurants in SF. Unique and wonderful flavors, gastronomic excellence on par with SF as a world class foodie destination. The venue is beautifully decorated and offers a sophisticated yet comforting atmosphere. Excellent service is commensurate with the food, as guests are treated like VIPs and the staff displays genuine kindness with a desire to make your experience special. I write this review now after being a guest at Azalina's on 3 different occasions; in the parlance of sports aficionados, that makes 3 times at bat with 3 home runs.

Great mocktail selection

Five course menu was good, strong theme of soy and ginger

Soup was my favorite. Explosion of flavor

Coconut mochi burger was messy to eat

Tender fish. Flavorless cabbage and rice

Ice cream texture was icy, though soursop flavor was interesting

Surprisingly filling considering small portion sizes

Not great for party of two - only options are giant tables and bar seating

Had a fantastic meal here on all fronts. The chef came out to describe each dish on the tasting menu. Delicious mocktails. Good portions. Not too fancy. Feels authentic Malaysian. They do accommodate allergies. Woman-owned. Only downside is that it’s in the tenderloin, but there’s a man at the door which helped me feel safe.

The food is very unique with homage to South East Asian and Indian roots. Very subtle and nuanced flavors with a ton of random spices I've never had before. Every dish felt like it was jam packed with all these intricate components. Expect around a 2 hour end to end dining experience. Note that the restaurant is in the middle of the tenderloin, which notoriously has a lot of drug users wandering the streets. They're harmless, but it might make some people feel uncomfortable if you're walking from the east side of town on Ellis. Probably better to just take a ride over.

I'm Malaysian. I'm used to going to restaurant that have "Thai & Malaysian food" in their name in order to get my Malaysian fix in America, accepting that Malaysian food will always be very much under the radar.

And then Azalina's came along. She has managed to stay true to the source material while still elevating our food and it has been a joy to experience. The food and the story behind how she put together the dishes is absolutely incredible. Terima kasih for helping to put Malaysian food on the map and for doing so in a way that lifts up the community.

formatted_address: 532 Jones St, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States
name: Shalimar Restaurant

reviews.text:
This no-frills Pakistani eatery in the Tenderloin is open late (till 11 PM on the Tuesday night I stopped by for a quick bite). It has the standards including tandoori meats and naan breads as well as curries (meat and vegetarian). The chai tea hits the spot on a cold night too.

I ordered at the counter, and one of the waiters brought the food to my table. There were lots of single diners (all men, as were the staff this evening) on when I stopped by at 10:30 PM on a Tuesday night.

Not fancy, but filling, tasty, authentic (I haven’t been to Pakistan, but it remembers me of many eateries in North India), and reasonably priced.

There are two other locations as well, though I’ve only visited this one. My partner and I used to eat at this spot two decades ago when one of us lived in Chinatown, and I’m glad to see that this place is still serving up hot Pakistani food and chai!

They take card payments including Apple Pay. A saag gosht (spinach lamb curry) with naan bread, chawal (a rice pilaf), raita (lightly spiced yogurt), and a cup of sweet hot chai cost me about $25 with tax but before tip.

I’d come back when in the Tenderloin, especially when looking for something hot to eat late at night or craving Indian/Pakistani cuisine.

I just visited Shalimar restaurant and ordered Nihari with one naan. Honestly, this was one of the worst Nihari and naan I’ve ever had. The naan was poorly made (almost like cold naan) and not enjoyable at all. On top of that, the cashier was extremely rude, which made the whole experience even worse. I definitely do not recommend Shalimar restaurant for Nihari and naan. Save your time and money and try somewhere else.

Good place to have Pakistani food. Everything is so fresh and tasty! Not a fancy place or the area. But the food is worth trying. Mango lassi is delicious!! Fresh naan and chicken biryani was on point!!

The food is great. It's one of the few Pakistani BBQ spots that I've seen. They have authentic tandoori ovens,  and you will smell like BBQ smoke when you leave. Everything is spicy. Great flavor. It is in the tenderloin area, so do with that info as you will. The food is 5 stars for Indian/ Pakistani food (they serve both).
My go to for Pakistani food in the area. Every time I come to San Fran I always eat here at least once usually twice. So tasty and authentic. Free tea while you wait.

formatted_address: 4618 3rd St, San Francisco, CA 94124, United States
name: Smoke Soul Kitchen

reviews.text:
Yummy Southern eatery on Third Street serving classics like fried chicken, sautéed shrimp and sausage as well as the standard sides that make soul food so famous.

The fried chicken is lightly battered and spiced. Smoke Soul Salad (with fried chicken breast) is tasty with a citrusy house vinaigrette, berries and crumbled blue cheese served over a bed of kale.

A friendly neighborhood spot, with personable service.

Found this place online locally. Ordered the chicken & waffles, husband ordered the bacon biscuit sando. Didn’t get a picture though. Chicken & waffles was delicious, the fruit added sweetness to it. And for the price it was great. Unfortunately the bacon biscuit sando had potential but it was very oily/greasy, even the biscuit was drenched in oil. Environment  in the restaurant was nice and colorful. Staff was okay.

5 star brunch all around! Everything we ordered was super tasty with great hospitality. TV to catch a game while you grub as well. I'll be thinking about that Mac n cheese til I return. Can't wait to try the rest of the menu!

Vanessa and team catered our San Francisco Fire Youth Academy closing ceremony for 150 people. Event planning brings out the stress, but the team at Smoke Soul helped alleviate it by being punctual and professional. They delivered as promised. The food and set-up was top tier! Strongly recommend!

Food was yummy, staff was nice, little to no service, but friendly atmosphere. Cutlery and coffee is self-serve, which would've been nice to know, but we figured it out on our own. The serving sizes are pretty small. We got the chicken & waffle, pancake, and fried chicken. The chicken wings were fabulous, crispy and juicy, but the chicken breast was just okay. The chicken and waffle had 2 chicken wings (including the drumsticks) and 1 waffle with a handful of fruit sprinkled over. The pancake was thick and fluffy. All of the food was a little too salty. The structure of the staff is really disorganized, so expect to sit around for awhile without food. They forgot my dad's food, so he was just sitting there waiting until long after my mom and I finished our meals. Eventually, the staff came by to ask if we had gotten our beignets, and we let them know that we still hadn't gotten my dad's dish yet. They were kind enough to try to refund the dish, but I doubt we'll be coming back.

formatted_address: 2100 Webster St, San Francisco, CA 94115, United States
name: Kaböb Trölley

reviews.text:
Got the food from this food truck located at Presidio San Francisco and it was spoiled.. falafel were so bad that they were forming long strings when separated in half..
We got multiple items and nothing tasted good except for fries. Never again! Hopefully I don't get food poisoning from this place.
I wish I took a picture of the falafels..

We hired Ghezal and her team to cater our wedding in Mill Valley and she and the gentlemen who was with her, did a fantastic job!  The food was great, the expectations were clear, she provided exactly what was discussed, and most importantly everyone ate.  If you're looking to feed a big crowd, send them home happy, and have a great time, hire Ghezal and her Kabob Trolley team !

Great service, unfortunately got food poisoning from this food truck at OpenSauce 2024. It was the only thing I ate that day and within 2 hours my stomach was messed up for 5 days. I emailed the truck advising them and have not heard back. I do not have any food allergies.

I ordered the beef/lamb gyro. I asked for light onions. So not a relevant request! The only question to be answered is spicy or not! This was a PERFECT gyro! This truck has ruined any other possibilities! The sauces were amazing. The pita so soft and fresh. The meat was fresh and tender. I will be back! Again and again! And again. Will be following on facebook! Oh and the veggies, perfect mix! You will not regret this experience!

Very slow (5 people in line took ~15 minutes), fairly cheap, but you get what you pay for- my $9 (+$2 gluten free)  lamb pita involved two very thin strips of beef/lamb, industrial-grade tomato and cucumber, and way too much fake tzatziki-type sauce (that was mostly emulsified oil). The cook used his spatula to press down the gluten-free pita onto the grill, so the outside was burned and in the inside was barely warm.

The total thing weighed

formatted_address: 3111 24th St, San Francisco, CA 94110, United States
name: Bir Kitchen

reviews.text:
This is the best place for all the heavy hitters.  I am so thrilled with the level of culinary skill that I want everyone who appreciates great desi food to get to experience the food here.  I started coming here a month after they opened. I've probably eaten here 5 times and ordered out 4 times.

In particular, these are my favorite things to order:

The Non-Veg platter.  It includes:
------
Tandoori Chicken:  most tender tandoori chicken I've ever had in ages.  It compared a legendary tandoori spot that I went to in the Margalla Hills in Pakistan.

Chicken Manchurian:  a classic indochinese fusion dish, it takes crispy fried chicken and tosses it in a perfectly tangy, not too spicy, savory sauce.

Chili Momo (4 pieces):  The crispy fried dumpling is filled with a juicy, herbaceous, super tasty ground chicken. It's then tossed In sauce of garlicy onions & bell peppers.

Fried fish:  perfectly fried appetizer bites of breaded fish are topped with minced fried red onions. The topping is SO GOOD.
------

Butter Chicken: you can taste the Ghee and the cream. It's so good and the chicken is tender tender tender.   It's served with fluffy basmati rice in copper dishes.

Chicken Lababdar. A Mughlai dish that you never see on most menus unless you're in South Asia. This is a MUST try. The chicken is tender and the cashew, ghee, and cream sauce is incredible. We always order this.

Naan:  The fluffy garlic naan is topped with ghee and there is whole fennel seed in the dough.  It tastes so good when it's cooked.

Chapati- 2 smaller pieces in an order. They are soft and delicious.

Gulab Jamun- served warm. It is THE BEST  with layers of flavor, made with ghee, bathed in an aromatic syrup.

Mango lassi- they use fresh mango. It's great.

All the chutneys and sauces are substantial, super fresh, and aromatic.

Bir kitchen is a new Nepali restaurant that is family owned and operated. Everything here from the staff to the food is warm and inviting. As the weather gets colder, fresh cooked food like this is perfect.

I got the masala papadum, piro chatpate, baby corn manchurian, tandoori momo, and also the house special biryani.
- The appetizers were really fun and crunchy to eat. The piro chatpate has crushed up instant noodle and seasoning, and eating it felt really whimsical. I think it would be a great bar snack with a beer.
- I loved the baby corn manchurian! The chili sauce is savory, sweet, and tangy, while the corn adds a slight crunch.
- It was my first time having momos tandoori style, and I really enjoyed the meat filling. Preparing it tandoori style takes a lot of time so I applaud the effort that goes into this dish. The homemade green chutney is superb, and the spice gradually adds as you eat more.
- house special dum biryani is artfully made. I can taste the curated spice blend like saffron, cardamom, coriander, and more. This spice is the one that grows from your belly, not the spice that burns your tongue.

Bir Kitchen has a huge menu, tons to choose from. Very vegetarian and vegan friendly. Perfect for sharing with a group. Please support small businesses like Bir Kitchen!

Great for small parties or even large parties as they have a beautiful large table in the back room for a more private event! The food and flavors are impeccable! Authentic chefs from Nepal that will dazzle your tastebuds. Great service. Can’t say enough of how good this place is!

Samosa chaat split between my husband and I as an appetizer filled us up rather quickly. We still ordered gobi (cauliflower) manchurian, fulki pani puri, and tandoori style chicken momos. We had some leftovers as expected and will definitely be back to try the other four variations of momos they offer (steamed, pan-fried, jhol, and chili).

Bir Kitchen on 24th Street in San Francisco’s Mission District is a true gem, serving the best Indian and Nepali food with authentic flavors and generous portions. From flavorful momos, crispy samosas, and fragrant biryani to juicy tandoori chicken and sweet gulab jamun, every dish is prepared to perfection. If you’re looking for the top restaurant on 24th Street San Francisco for authentic, delicious, and unforgettable dining, Bir Kitchen is a must-visit.

formatted_address: 2966 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110, United States
name: Old Jerusalem Restaurant

reviews.text:
We had an absolutely fantastic family meal here.
This place is a real gem.
