If there were an option for zero stars, I would give it. I went here with my family, and my son, who is severely allergic to all nuts, ordered the Alfredo pasta with chicken. The menu made no mention of nuts or any allergy warnings. As soon as he took a bite, he had a severe allergic reaction.
We always ask about ingredients when eating out, but the staff ignored our questions, and the waiters denied that any nuts were used in the dish. When the owner/chef came out, instead of helping, he had the audacity to  blamed us for “maybe doing something else.” After repeated requests to see the ingredients, he finally showed me a sauce he adds that contained almonds — yet this was never disclosed on the menu.
This lack of transparency and concern is dangerous. Anyone with nut allergies, please proceed with extreme caution.

I had been waiting for this restaurant to open for several months and finally got the chance to visit. I ordered rice, camel meat, sheep meat, a mango cocktail, soup and tea.

The rice was dull and cold. Even worse was the sheep meat, which was served as a large chunk and priced between $20-25. Unfortunately, it was tasteless, overcooked, and seemed like it had been prepared hours earlier and just reheated upon order.

The camel meat, soup and tea were decent but nothing special—similar to what you can find on Lake Street.

The restaurant also has a café, which I plan to visit next.

Overall, this restaurant falls far below the standard set by other existing establishments.

reviews.text: Really cool vibe, hot fresh food, I ordered the veggie combo, some tea and had a great time! Beautifully spiced, with an extensive selection of vegetarian options this is definitely going to be a new regular for me!

Ordered pickup. I love an Ethopian veggie combo and I was happy with the flavors. That being said, I was shorted a wot dish in the combo (should have been six dishes, I was only given five), and they seemed to make up for it hy giving me extra collard greens, but more lentils would have been appreciated. A few of the dishes were cold as well and had to heat back up at home, a little annoying. I really enjoyed the lentil sambusa. Those were hot, great flavor, and a nice little kick to them. Not a perfect first experience here, but I'd order again.

We came here last year in late October, but I remember the experience very well. At the time, we felt this place wasn't suited for dine-in, as no one else was in the restaurant except for us and we went on to see lots of people come through the door and order things to-go or from the bakery. Our waitress was kind and patient, despite us frequently changing our minds on what we wanted from the menu. Why were we changing our minds so much? Because the menus we were given were outdated, and as such, they didn't have the dishes we originally wanted.

I remember the food took a long time to get to us and by the time it did, all of our injera was ice cold and while the entree dishes were still warm, they were unbearably spicy. Everything from the derek tibs to the legumes and lentils. I'm pretty sure it sat on the counter for a good while before she noticed it was there and brought it out to us. Our family is East African but this was too spicy even for us, our throats were still burning at least an hour after we finished eating. For what it's worth, they have very strong authentic Ethiopian coffee, and the porcelain it's served in is absolutely gorgeous.

Recent reviews make me believe that things relating to the dine-in experience seem to have changed for the better since our visit, but we have not been back since and don't plan on returning.

Terrible. I been here plenty of times and this by far the worst. So I found hair in my food? I have braids so I know that’s not my hair. Meat was tough and the collards greens I got on the side were served to me cold. With mostly the ends on it. Very disappointed and my money wasted had to throw the food away cause of the hair
Absolutely a delight! We had a great time with friends and the food was out of this world. We will be back. Thank you so much for the great service and delicious food ❤️❤️

formatted_address: 8171 University Ave NE, Minneapolis, MN 55432, United States
name: Asia-Africa Market

reviews.text:
Today after work I drove to this store with my Hubby and we got there by 9:20AM and waited outside because the store opens at 10AM.The gentleman arrived and opened the door few minutes to 10AM. The store was very clean, no smell , very organized and I had few questions for the gentleman who was friendly answering us. We got all we needed.  I got all I wanted and pocket friendly.
I will continue recommending this place to my friends who wants to get cultural foods.
Best West African food! The store a bit rough looking but the food is delicious. It’s expensive but good

Laab is still being advertised on the window for sale. when I walked in I was told the didn’t have any prepared. The store seems dirtier than I remember and the store associate was not at all friendly. I will not be going back.

So I received your reply saying you are sorry and to see your online menu. Am a supposed to be happy that I drove 25 minutes from East Bethel to your business to find out you no longer have the item available I wanted to purchase. I’m pretty sure by having lash, eggrolls, papaya salad and other Asian dishes advertised on your windows is false advertisement. Your store is dirty and hospitality is awful. I’m sad the former owners left this business. I’m sure you will be out of business soon. Bad reviews are all I see in the past year.
They have the best plantains and cassava . Always come here when I need those. Cashier guy is so friendly.  I'm glad this store is around where I live.

I love this store! They make really good sticky rice dipping sauces like the hot pot and the fish sauce with chilies and fresh herbs by request!Also, we love the egg rolls, homemade fried pork belly, and more! Such a sweet lady!

formatted_address: 719 Payne Ave, St Paul, MN 55130, United States
name: Karibu Grocery & Deli

reviews.text:
The samosas are fantastic. Fresh and a little spocy flavor added with the sauce they come with makes it delicious! Somali spiced tea and samosas made for a great afternoon snack! Great reviews for the gyros and safari rolls but nothing is not great!
Visit THIS Karibou for a great meal! It has a small store as well as very fresh halal meat for sale that is amazing!

Karibu is a hidden gem! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and made with care. The customer service is excellent—everyone is welcoming and respectful, and you really feel appreciated as a customer. The store is clean, well-organized, and consistently reliable. Highly recommend Karibu to anyone looking for quality food and great service!

I had a bad experience with this restaurant today. The food I ordered was reheated with lemon inside, one of the sauces was extremely water down the green one almost solid, the amount of food for the price was lacking too. Wouldn’t not recommend.
The place is beautifully designed and the food was really good. We’ll definitely be back! All Halal.

I had a good experience here. I stopped by cause I was in the area and this place was highly rated. The place was very clean and bright making for a nice lunch atmosphere. They have patio seating available as well and big windows to people watch or watch traffic while you eat. They do have a small grocery section but it was pretty bare. The lady who took my order was very friendly and had some nice recommendations for food. She was correct on what she told me to order I was not disappointed. If you are near the area and enjoy East African food definitely stop in and give them a try.

formatted_address: 912 E 24th St d2, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: Kaah Restaurant

reviews.text: Does this look like rodent droppings to you? 🤔 Found it in my goat meat, along with a hair. Just slightly disturbing. It tasted good, but there were a lot of bones and gristle. The guy who took my order had to be reminded to return the right change to me. Terrible experience really. 😟

Updating review I wrote five years ago. Kaah has the best Somali tea in Minnesota. However, their lunch dishes are far below average. Rice and meat dish is $22 which is more expensive than East Village Grill rice dish that is far superior in taste. This restaurant used to offer great cuisines. It is now at the very bottom of the list.

This place is very expensive  charging 13 dollars  for artificial colored yellow rice   and  serves you  bones  as goat meat. what they call  biriyani  is nothing but plain rice added to red color.  Tasteless and  expensive. There steak is hard chewy and salty and do not deserved to be call steak.   What you  find in Kaah as  has no  resemblance to the real authentic  somali baris and hilib ari. It lack  lack the right mix of  spices that gives aroma and tasted .  I was served rice soaked with yellow artificial color and salty  goat meat doused with soy sauce .I don"t   know the people giving this place five stars . Either they are owners, workers or people with no sense of taste. As fast food place charging 5 dollars I will be ok. I expect more when you charge me that kind of money. I   Please safe yourself do not eat this place. Horrible expensive and tasteless food.
Brought here by a coworker. Fantastic food. Good prices and huge portions. I've had roasted goat, breaded chicken, broth soup and rice... All were fantastic!
The worst Somali food I have ever had.. YUCK!!!! Don’t waste your time and money coming here, there’s better options out there.

formatted_address: 2532 25th Ave S, Minneapolis, MN 55406, United States
name: Harwanaag Restaurant

reviews.text: I ordered dinner through the Too Good To Go app, got a full entree. Based on their menu I think I got camel with basmati rice. Nicely spiced and aromatic, very delicious.

Delicious food. Everything came out hot. Tasty, generous portions for a good price, and the customer service was the excellent. The rice flavored with cardamom and cinnamon is excellent. And the sauces are also wonderful.

The young man who helped us was very hospitable. I will be back. Get the goat.

This place is hidden gem. I was taken back by the level of customer Service. We were off complimentary soup which was out of this world good. Then we tried the rice and goat meat and also fish sandwich I give it 10/10
I highly recommend this place.
Quick and friendly service and good food. Very hospitable. I had a great plate of chicken suqqar.
It’s very dirty Resturant , they gave us cold race and very bad taste goat meat. They also have no good consumer service  at all. I wouldn’t recommend any one to go there. Stay away.

formatted_address: 2647 Nicollet Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55408, United States
name: Lenza Restaurant

reviews.text:
A Truly Exceptional Dining Experience at Lenza Restaurant!

From the moment I walked into Lenza Restaurant, I was blown away by the impeccable customer service and inviting atmosphere. The staff here truly goes above and beyond to ensure every guest feels welcome, valued, and taken care of. Their attentiveness, friendliness, and professionalism are unmatched—it's clear they take pride in creating a memorable dining experience.

Not only is the service top-notch, but the cleanliness of the restaurant is also impressive. Every corner shines, and it’s obvious that maintaining a pristine environment is a priority for the team. The ambiance is always fresh, and you can tell a lot of effort is put into keeping everything spotless and comfortable.

The food itself is absolutely delicious, with each dish made to perfection. It's evident that Lenza Restaurant is committed to providing high-quality meals alongside outstanding service.

If you're looking for a place that offers not just great food but also a warm, welcoming environment and exceptional service, Lenza is the place to go. I’ll definitely be back!
Excellent lunch buffet to sample their East African and Middle East foods. New dining room is bright and airy.
Excellent and enjoyable buffet. Combination of Mediterranean, East African and American dishes
Boison food I got sick after eating the food not only one time two different days.  I never even go back this restaurant
Nice restaurant and very welcoming people 🥰

formatted_address: 3915 Hiawatha Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55406, United States
name: Mesob Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: This place is damn good. We were blown away by different dishes that we ordered one after the other. Tried Chicken tibs, Doro wot, the four vegan lentils and a lamb dish. All of them were fantastic. The waitress lady went above and beyond to help us decide what to order. Would highly recommend for fabulous Ethiopian food!
Excellent food. Very good service. I recommend the ginger tea. The injeera is delicious and fresh. Yellow peas were buttery tasting and everything was spiced well. Very good and will be back.

Alright, this place absolutely rocks! The staff was so friendly and the food was absolutely fantastic! This was my first time trying Ethiopian food and boy did I chose the right place. The staff helped me pick out the best options for a first timer and it didn’t disappoint! I highly recommend this restaurant and I will certainly be coming back!

Every year for my birthday, I get myself Awaze tibs and Gomen. I just moved to the Minneapolis area to try the same this year. I now consider this a favorite location. The outside feels like a cozy, local find in an industrial district. You will taste home in these dishes. Please come here.

Amazing Ethiopian food! I’ve yet to find better in the Twin Cities on quality.

Highly recommend the veggie sampler. It’s huge and could easily be shared. There are tons of vegetarian and vegan options on the menu outside of the sampler as well.

5 stars for the food, the service, not so much. Expect to be here for a while. The restaurant is laidback, and while it’s always appreciated when staff aren’t rushing you out the door, getting the attention of staff here can be tricky. We waited almost an hour for our food to come out, and had a tough time getting water.

formatted_address: 2000 Nicollet Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: La Mama Restaurant

reviews.text: Came here to grab a late dinner on my way home just as they were locking the doors (hours listed on my source were wrong; it closes at 9pm and not 930pm like I thought). The gentleman working, who I believe is the son of the owner, was nice enough to still make me a plate. Easily the best lamb I have ever had. Literally falls off the bone like a tender pot roast and has amazing flavor. Absolutely recommend and I’ll be back when I’m in the neighborhood.

Arafat as the owner of La Mama restaurant has a great presentation! The food is wonderfully seasoned and brought to life in the kitchen!

Also, to mention, in 2025 La Mama Restaurant won the best restaurant for Google Reviews! Phenomenal restaurant!
The Mandi lamb was fantastic. The meat was falling right off the bone and seasoned perfectly. The fruit juice was delicious and beautiful.. and the owner is lovely!!
Excellent food, I had gyro salmon mandi and a mango smoothie. everything was fresh and so delicious. A must visit if you are in the area. A very diverse crowd in the restaurant as well.
We ordered the lamb kabobs and the lamb shoulder. Both delicious! We also got a mango smoothie and a iced pistachio latte. The employee was very nice and made our food pretty quick.

formatted_address: 2649 7th Ave E, North St Paul, MN 55109, United States
name: Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text:
Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant is a true gem for anyone seeking authentic Ethiopian cuisine and rich highland organic coffee. The flavors are vibrant, the dishes are beautifully presented, and every bite feels like a journey to Ethiopia.
Bekele and Selam are exceptional hosts—gracious, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Whether you’re planning a special event or just stopping by for a meal, their charm and hospitality elevate the entire experience. Their service, paired with the outstanding quality of food and drinks, makes every visit memorable.
Having traveled extensively across the U.S., I can confidently say this is one of the neatest and most thoughtfully run Ethiopian restaurants I’ve encountered. The prices are fair, and there’s ample parking, making it convenient and accessible.
Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious food, warm service, and a cozy atmosphere that feels like home.

Our first time being here it was excellent, the only hiccup was that the waitress didn't understand English and we didn't speak  Ethiopian.  Other than that the food was full of flavor. Great atmosphere.

We first visited Ethiopia 9 years ago, and fell in love with the food and coffee of the country.

Coffee was excellent.  Hot and strong.  I did miss the popcorn to go along with the coffee, though.

We ordered the veggie combo for 2, as well as beef tibs.  Both dishes were excellent.  My wife has sufficient veggies for at least 1 more meal, maybe 2.  Likely the best Ethiopian meals we've had here in the Twin Cities.

Food was fantastic! It was a cute atmosphere in there, and I'd love to go back. The Doro Wot was warm, salty, and spicy; perfect with their Injera, which they sell! For about $20, I was full for the entire day.
Highly recommend this place. The atmosphere was very cute and welcoming. The food was amazing!

formatted_address: 1812 Nicollet Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55403, United States
name: Olive Kitchen

reviews.text: Olive kitchen was delicious. The neighborhood is a little sketch but the restaurant itself was quite spacious inside and very clean.  We ordered the chicken and goats, both were very tasty and flavorful. Portion size is pretty large. I recommend eating the dishes the Somali way with a banana on the side.

I just happen to be picking up a load in front of this restaurant and thought I would give it a try. I had the Beef Stew at the Owners recommendation. It was excellent! Service was great and portions are huge so I will even have some for dinner.

I ordered on Uber Eats so I can't say much about anything other than the food. But the food is delicious! The mixed vegetable dish and rice are my favorite. I didn't like the goat too much, and preferred the beef stew, but that may just be my general preference and nothing to do with the quality of the food. The quality of the food is fantastic, everything tastes flavorful and fresh. The quantity is also amazing. I ordered two times from here and those two orders have covered lunch and dinner for the past 3 days! Amazing restaurant :)

I came here a few times many months ago during a conference, I'm vegetarian so I had the rice+vegetables, super awesome food. The very spicy green sauce it comes with is the best spicy sauce I've ever had

I’ve lived next to this place for two years and have always smelled it walking past so I finally decided to try it. I am not a fan of goat but saw it recommended a lot so I gave it a try. I’m glad I did, the meat was tender and delicious, the rice was flavorful, and all of my sides were equally as good. My to go box was filled to the brim with plenty for two meals.

formatted_address: 12609 Nicollet Ave, Burnsville, MN 55337, United States
name: Tawakal Restaurant

reviews.text: Service was incredible friendly! Took the cooks recommendation and had goat. Very tender 9/10! Flavor w/rice was good, not excellent 8/10. Reasonable prices. Will return!!

I went here for a group project on Somalian Culture and the food was great. I’ve never had Somalian food before and I was definitely caught by surprise by the wonderful flavors and aromas of the food I ordered. Service was great and staff were very friendly and very helpful with recommendations. I ordered the baklava, waslad w/ rice and after speaking with a few patrons, they insisted I try the sambusa. All of it was great. Would highly recommend.

I need to eat more East African food. Food was hot, fresh,very healthy, and very yummy. Love the chef and the young man working here too. I want to try more of their breads next time. Nice stop when i was traveling to the Twin Cities for work!

Visiting from Chicago with the family. Very friendly staff that walked me thru the menu. Tasty food, prices were reasonable.
Had lunch after Jummuah. Bottled water was on the house. We ordered a meat/chicken rice platter, philly sandwich with fries. Everything was fresh and flavorful. Alhamdullilah.

Always a great place to get authentic Somali food!
I’ve been coming to Tawakal for years, and it never disappoints. The food is always fresh, flavorful, and comforting — truly reminds you of home-cooked meals. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the hospitality is warm and welcoming every time.

If you’re looking for authentic Somali cuisine in Burnsville, this is definitely the spot.

formatted_address: 756 County Hwy 10 NE, Blaine, MN 55434, United States
name: Midwest African Market & Deli

reviews.text: I am very glad I came, me and my girlfriend stopped by after the name caught our eye, we were immediately greeted by the stores extremely friendly and helpful owner(or at least I assume she is). She made me and my girlfriend feel extremely welcome and taken care off with small talk to start off and then two free samples that were delicious. As we left she wished us a good night, and I very much intend to come back as I felt very welcomed.

I was initially near here for the Bosnian market and the name caught my boyfriends and my attention, we were greeted right away with the stores extremely friendly and helpful owner! She gave us samples from her deli, it was a kidney and rice dish and a fried spinach and rice dish. I’m very picky but both of these blew me away. We will definitely be back to try more from the deli!

I am so glad I randomly decided to pop in and see what this store was about. Besides the groceries, they have a hot food deli. I've never had Liberian (or generally West African) cuisine, and now I know what I was missing! The staff were incredibly friendly and gave me samples of several dishes. Everything I had was quite tasty. I settled on taking home a dish of the sweet potato and have been eating it for several meals. It's spiced so well, with just enough heat to bring the flavor without lighting me up. You gotta pick over a few of the bones, but it's well worth it for the savory meat. Or if that seemed like it wasn't your thing, you could easily just ask for all greens and be happy you did. I'll definitely be stopping by here regularly!

Have been curious about this place so while shopping at B&N finally stopped in. Super glad I did! Their deli is open and full of delicious looking and smelling food. Was given a sample to try the Liberian Pepper Soup and immediately bought some to take home for dinner that night. The broth was a delightful spicy ham flavor (the perfect amount of spice - not too hot, just right) with pieces of ham, chicken, beef and fish, served over rice. Perfect for a cold, rainy day, or if you're feeling under the weather. Will be back for more of this soup and to try the other menu items! Staff/cooks were kind and very proud to share their food with everyone. Thank you!

I would like to start off by saying that I actually like this place’s pepper sauce, but there are sometimes where I show up and there is no one there; even though it says the store is open. Today was one of those days and it really just annoyed me because for such a good business they are inconsistent. It is 2:30 and on the website it says they don’t close until 6pm.

formatted_address: 1965 Cliff Lake Rd #105, Eagan, MN 55122, United States
name: Samosa Flame Grill

reviews.text: I had the tilapia (it comes with biryani/rice pilaf) and shaah (tea). The food was great! The portions are also huge. I thought I was getting one serving, but the tilapia order came with 2 servings. If you're getting takeout, I don't recommend using an ordering app, because if they run out of something, the app won't show it. Call in or stop in to order instead. Most of the entrees are meat dishes, but they do have some vegetarian food (falafel, cambuulo, malawax, etc.).

Samosa Flam Grill in Eagan, Minnesota, is a hidden gem that brings the flavors of Somali cuisine to the heart of the Midwest. This mom-and-pop halal fast food spot stands out for its authentic and delicious Somali dishes, offering a taste of something truly unique in the area. The menu features a variety of traditional items, from flavorful samosas to hearty platters of rice and meat, all prepared with care and attention to detail. Each dish is rich in spices and full of the bold, vibrant flavors that Somali cuisine is known for.

The restaurant itself is simple and unpretentious, with a clean and inviting atmosphere that makes it easy to relax and enjoy your meal. The no-frills design focuses on what really matters—the food. Despite its modest appearance, Samosa Flam Grill is welcoming to all, with friendly staff who are happy to guide you through the menu if you’re unfamiliar with Somali cuisine.

For those seeking a taste of something different, Samosa Flam Grill offers an authentic dining experience that’s both satisfying and memorable. It’s a must-visit for anyone in Eagan looking to explore the rich culinary traditions of Somalia, served up in a comfortable and approachable setting.
Beef suqaar was delicious, one of the best I've had. Sambusas were good - loved the crisp, but little too greasy. Staff was friendly.

Samosa Flame Grill has great food and a lot of variety!! I had the BBQ chicken platter, the goat meat platter, and the gyro wraps. Everything is prepared fresh to order. This is a solid spot for East African cuisine! I will stop in again to try more from the menu. These are healthy portion sizes too!

Joke of a business

I called ahead like a responsible adult so my order would be ready when I arrived. They swore it’d be ready. I show up…nothing. Just blank stares and a “it’s not ready yet.” Then I wait an entire hour watching the staff move like they’re underwater. If lying to customers and wasting their time were a service, these people would be five stars. Never again.

formatted_address: 1701 American Blvd E suite 15, Bloomington, MN 55425, United States
name: Zawadi Restaurant and Event Center

reviews.text:
Staff was rude as ever!!

I am visiting for the weekend and hungry, decided to grab a bowl. I get rice, chicken, cucumber salad, red cabbage and red onions. We get to the sauces and I don’t know what they are. I ask what they are, he says the names but the restaurant is crowded and loud. I ask again and he seems irritated. So I go for what I know and point to the bottle of white sauce and get that.

He looks at his coworker, whom shrugs his shoulders, he rolls his eyes irritatedly and adds my sauce to my bowl. Im like Damn, all this attitude for what.

I asked for a hibiscus drink. Which he asked his coworker to get. My drink was made and just sat on the back counter for a minute until he told the worker was for me. And he responded with a shocked look , like oh her!

Idk, the whole encounter and attitude and expressions were super unnecessary when you could be explaining your options to a person who has clearly never been to your restaurant before.

I wont be back if in town.

Adding the sauce names to the window with the ingredients listed would help if customer service won’t.

Great food though!! My bowl was fire! He was skimpy with the white sauce.
Great food, fresh, healthy. A lot of choices and toppings as well. Great atmosphere, clean and professional service. Will be back
The food is so good. Amazing seasoning! Came here once and I’m hooked, the spicy sauces are delicious. Highly recommend.

This is very nice complex. It contains the restaurant and some meeting space. Attached is the coffee shop. Whole complex is very nice and clean.
Zawadi was very good. Setup like a Chipotle or Subway, you pick your bowl. There are rice and or bean options. Then you pick a protein which included chicken and beef as well as vegetarian option of roasted cauliflower and plantains. Next you to choose from a large assortment of toppings  such as cheese, chopped tomatoes,  corn, cucumbers, etc. Finally you get to choose from a long list of sauces.
The servers were very nice with explaining the items and giving you more or less of items if you just wanted to try something.
I went with the sumac chicken on saffron rice. I ended up getting the red sauce and the green sauces that were not in the squirt bottles. The red sauce was super tasty and had a slow build of heat. The green was more fresh and herbal.
As mentioned before, the servers were very friendly, helpful and generous. I can't wait for them to open up a location in Sacramento!

I love this restaurant and the attached cafe! I have an autoimmune disease that can sometimes be triggered by foods— this is one of the few restaurants where the food makes me feel BETTER! If I could afford it I would get lunch from Zawadi everyday— back when I could go more frequently I had a noticeable decrease in my pain and inflammation. The staff are also really nice. I was so lucky one day; one of the staff had me try a special chicken dish that they were catering for a wedding in the same building. It was absolutely delicious and if I need catering in the future they’re at the top of my list. I also have to say that Nomadic makes the best chai lattes in the Twin Cities.

formatted_address: 638 Snelling Ave N, St Paul, MN 55104, United States
name: Snelling Cafe

reviews.text:
5 stars without hesitation! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Sneeling Cafe is an absolute gem! Hands down the best spot in town for authentic Eritrean, Sudanese, and Ethiopian cuisine. Their breakfast menu is incredible – fresh injera, flavorful ful, shakshuka, and all the classics done to perfection. Lunch and dinner are just as amazing with generous portions of tibs, kitfo, doro wat, and so much more. Bonus: they serve ice-cold beer and a great selection of liquor, making it the perfect place to unwind.

The vibe is super chill and welcoming – ideal for long chats with friends or just relaxing solo. Afowerki, the owner, is genuinely one of the kindest and most positive people you'll ever meet; his energy makes every visit even better. If you're craving real East African flavors with great hospitality, this is your spot. Already planning my next visit! Highly recommend! 🇪🇷🇸🇩🇪🇹❤️

Honestly just really good food in general!  I was really excited to try something I've never had before, and they helped me with some recommendations, and everything tasted fantastic!  They also had huge portions for the price too!

One of my Eritrean friends told me to go to this restaurant when we were talking about Eritrean culture. I’m glad that I listened to his advice because Snelling Cafe is the best African Restaurant that I’ve been too. The service is fast and the food portions are large. I love how the atmosphere feels extremely authentic and people are very kind.

The first time I came here I ordered shiro and foule. On my second visit I ordered Fatta and Eritrean Tea. I was very impressed both of the times that I came. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to try Eritrean cuisine.

Customer service is bad. Food is fine but depending on what you order it's just reheated frozen stuff. I also feels it's overpriced for what you get. Fruit flies were swarming around when I went recently.

Good food and service for the value. Chicken wrap was excellent and the fries were fine. The Hot Chocolate took forever to cool down, but when it finally did, it was nice. Plenty of free parking. Lots of seating. Pregnant atmosphere and employees. No free wifi.

formatted_address: 2910 Pleasant Ave suite 114, Minneapolis, MN 55408, United States
name: Falastin Cafe

reviews.text: 1000/10 service! Absolutely excellent customer service – went above and beyond!
Not open enough when it says it’s open
So good, The lady there was so nice. good atmosphere.
Really tasty food and fast service!
Wonderful!

formatted_address: 1053 Helmo Ave N, Oakdale, MN 55128, United States
name: Jokky Catering Services & Take Out Restaurant

reviews.text:
Oh my!

I had never had Nigerian food before, but it was like if Jamaican food and good Indian food had a baby.

And all I had was chicken, beef, and rice with plantains!!

Hands down my favorite go-to Nigerian restaurant in the Twin Cities. Orders are always ready much sooner than expected, which unfortunately isn’t the norm with many African restaurants. You can tell there’s real intentionality behind every meal—the flavor, spice level, and portions are all top-notch.

I’m also always impressed by the hospitality at Jokky’s Catering. No matter how busy she is, Aunty Joke makes it a priority to personally greet me with a warm smile.

This restaurant has my heart, and they’ve got a customer for life. See y’all soon!

I ordered some Egusi Soup with pounded yam and they were able to make it for me without meat  since I don’t eat meat; they were super kind and mindful to my needs and what I was looking for with the food I was ordering. (Very hospitable)
They allowed us to also sample a few items we were interested in to help us decide if we were interested in trying out those items as well.

If you’re looking to be introduced to West African food and to grow your experience in different cuisines with west African cuisine this is the place to check out!

They also allow you the option to buy their homemade sauces or homemade Egusi sauces so you can make them with your own twist at home with your own home made dishes; just go to their website and check out “game changer sauces” and if you don’t see what you normally get; you can call them and ask them if you can place an order to pick up one of there game changer sauces also if your looking for something specific.

One of the sauces (Jollof Rice Sauce) gives directions and steps on how to go about putting together Jollof Rice which my husband really loved when he first sampled it when he was deciding what he was going to order.

They also offer short menu items in addition to catering sized dishes as well.
I’m definitely going to be a regular
Delicious and great variety of food. Pounded Yam (fufu) was perfect and all dishes had a really deep, spiced flavor. Meat pies were spicy and had light and flaky pastry. Thanks!
I’m so glad I finally found an amazing spot for Nigerian food. I ordered pounded yam and Efo elegusi and it was absolutely delicious. Definitely going back to Experience more delicious food :).

formatted_address: 3744 Bloomington Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55407, United States
name: Mama Sheila's House of Soul

reviews.text:
This Thanksgiving, my heart found exactly what it needed: time with my soul cousin, deep conversation about life, and the gentle release of everything no longer serving us. We spent the day reflecting, laughing, and just being present with each other. And the perfect place to hold all that gratitude was Mama Sheila’s.
From the moment we walked in, the buffet felt like a true Thanksgiving embrace. Mama Sheila’s served up love disguised as food. Cranberry sauce, potato salad, collard greens with smoked turkey, tender cabbage, dressing with no meat, juicy turkey, candied yams, red beans and rice, jerk chicken, jerk BBQ chicken, cornbread, catfish, BBQ meatballs… and honestly, even more dishes I can’t fully recall because there was just so much goodness. Every plate was a memory, every bite a comfort. And those homemade beverages? They danced on my taste buds refreshing, sweet, and full of soul.
I ate there, enjoyed every moment, and of course had to take a plate to go. It was that good.
This Thanksgiving wasn’t just a meal  it was healing, connection, and gratitude wrapped in the warmth of family and incredible food. Mama Sheila’s helped make it unforgettable.

I am going to try to sum this up without wasting your time. GO EAT HERE. 🏆
I sincerely hope that summed it up. Here's why; We were greeted by a very friendly man. Once we explained that we were visiting from Ohio, he quickly explained the pricing and order of things. He went over the menu and answered any questions we had. Bet 🫶🏾
Pricing was $10.95 per pound. It's set up buffet style but not an all you can eat for a set price buffet type thing. Y'all,  everything looked good. I wanted a Lil bit of everything. 🐷 So here's the options that I can remember: fried chicken, jerk chicken, smothered chicken, BBQ chicken, meatloaf, and catfish. My husband was shocked there were no ribs and they told him no swine on the line 🤣  Side items consist of mashed potatoes, mac-n-cheese, cabbage, green beans, black eye peas, greens, candy yams, red beans and rice, and probably a few other items I can't remember. Cornbread was the only (and rightfully so) bread item!
Ok I had the BBQ chicken which was amazing. The meat was just falling off the bones. My side items were cabbage, green beans, mac-n-cheese, and candied yams. The cabbage and green beans were the star of the show. Omg so good 👍🏾 😍 Like, sooooo good. Every single bite had seasoning in it. It was a win-win situation here. The mac-n-cheese was good. Not the best I've had but still good enough to make me happy 😊 The only downfall was the candied yams. They just weren't good.  Everything else was so good, I didn't even care. I was full on top of full. I was soul food wasted! 😋🙌🏾
I ordered a slice of red velvet cake to go. I haven't eaten it yet. I'm excited tho.
The atmosphere: classic African American owned esthetics. Walls covered in famous and historical African Americans while also giving you a little bit of important history about each one. The music playing in the background was old school R&B 🏫 Perfect sounds and surroundings for a perfect meal.

Some of the best food I've had in a long time for a restaurant! Feels like you're eating a home cooked meal! I raved about it to the owner! Great atmosphere too! Definitely would recommend anyone try this place you wont be disappointed! Make sure to get the fried chicken! 🤯🤯🤯

For dessert you gotta get the pecan pie, sooo good!
The food is incredible and it really speaks for itself. Super comfortable dining spot with the most welcoming staff. I only want to add that skipping the pecan pie would be a mistake. It's the best!

It looked quiet so we stopped in for a quick bite. Everything that we tried was perfect! Crispy fried chicken, greens cooked just right with smoked turkey, mac & cheese had that perfectly browned top and was still creamy underneath. My favorites were the meatloaf and black eyed peas, though. Both flavors and textures were spot on. This was a great home cooked meal, but we didn't have to wash a single pot! It's cheap too. A full plate of goodies was only about $11. Oh, and they have kool-aid! Just like when I was a kid. This place feels like home, and I hope to return many times.

formatted_address: 1025 Currie Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55403, United States
name: Suga's Kitchen

formatted_address: 2532 25th Ave S, Minneapolis, MN 55406, United States
name: Kalsan Restaurant and Cafe

reviews.text: The best East African restaurant in the Twin Cities hands down! I go to Kalsan at least once a month to get the Chicken Suqaar with rice, it's one of my favorite dishes in the city. They recently remodeled the interior too so I tend to sit down instead of ordering take-out now. Great place!
I think Kalsan restaurant  is the best East African restaurant  in Minneapolis  definitely I will go back  and thanks  for the good food

I really like this restaurant please
try this place they have a wonderful service
It is really dirty

formatted_address: 912 E 24th St # B131, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: Royal Restaurant inside 24 mall

reviews.text: I never seen bad restaurants like this they can’t take responsibility if you left anything behind,and they don’t want check the camera so any one see this comment take care you belongs!!!

Royal restaurant, To me an organization I work with. They're the only ones that I could get a last minute. Catering from And the portions were remarkable and the service 100%. They did last minute catering for me and was done the same day. Delivery was 100%.  I will go back to this restaurant. I tried 5 other restaurants and could not get a last minute catering for nothing. I had to wait 24 hours for all of them and I had a meeting by 2pm served 50 people off of a 25 people order.  Thank you so much.

The food here is amazing, but beyond that the person behind the counter was beyond warm and welcoming. I had the large chicken Philly over rice, my kid had 3 samosas which were huge. The food was seasoned and cooked perfectly. We had some red drinks I forgot what they were called but so yummy. I will keep going back, wish I could give more than 10 stars.

3/24/25, evening sale. A guy at the front reception scammed us by overpricing the food we ordered by charging  us extra 4 dollars for a soup that usually comes along with the order we paid for. Customer service was very poor as well. I think it’s meant to mint free money from unsuspecting customers. We will never go back.
This place is nice they gave me free stuff best place ever🇸🇴

formatted_address: 600 E Hennepin Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55414, United States
name: Brasa Premium Rotisserie- Northeast Minneapolis

reviews.text:
I forgot how truly delicious the food is at Brasa. I needed to pick up food for an event, and decided to get take out.

We started with the fried sweet plantains, really caramelized and yummy. They are served with an interesting green dipping sauce. Lovely. We had the pulled pork sandwich, which is served with pickles and green sauce. The meat was so tender, and the accomplishments really complemented the pork. I absolutely adored the smothered chicken sandwich, which is served with red sauce and coke slaw. My goodness - this was DELICIOUS! They both came with house made tortilla chips - these were just as yummy the next day!

I enjoyed the butterscotch pudding also. The only slightly negative note was the chocolate cake, which was dry despite the whipped cream and topping.

I heartily recommend Brasa, in particular that fabulous smothered chicken!!

You can eat in, or order for takeout also.

The entire menu looks amazing!  It was hard to choose!  Ordered chicken chilaquiles verde with a side of yucca fries and fried plaintains.  The green sauce is so incredibly good.  Everything was cooked perfectly.  Service was great!  Attentive but not overbearing.  Atmoshere was busy but not distracting or unpleasant! Absolutely will stop here anytime I am in town!!!

We had Brasa cater our wedding and they were absolutely incredible! From start to finish, they were efficient, easy to communicate with, and so accommodating to our needs. The food was absolutely amazing—our guests couldn’t stop talking about it. On top of that, they went above and beyond by leaving us a thoughtful to-go bag with food and champagne at the end of the night. It was the perfect touch after such a special day. Highly recommend Brasa for any wedding or event!

Hidden gem! I came here for the 1st time last week for a staff meeting. Upon arriving, everyone was extrmelely friendly. We were seated immediately and given menus to review. I ordered the rotisserie chicken with Yuca fries, Mac and cheese, and cornbread. Everything arrived very quickly. I’ve been to numerous restaurants, and the wait time here was almost non-existent. The food came out within 5 to 7 minutes of ordering. The waiter was extremely attentive and continuously returned to see how we were doing and checked in to see how everything tasted. The rotisserie chicken I ordered with the green sauce was phenomenal. The mac and cheese and everything else was exceptional. I would definitely return. I had a really great experience and the environment was very welcoming.

One of our family favorites whenever we go through Minneapolis! The food is always fantastic, authentic & fresh!!!
I always go with a BOWL! I recommend the smothered chicken (it's so moist) or the pork bowl! Everytime we go I buy a hot vinegar to take home as well. Brasa would easily be a 5 star place but the recent move to QR code orders is a bit frustrating.

formatted_address: 701 Plymouth Ave N, Minneapolis, MN 55411, United States
name: SOUL BOWL

reviews.text: It’s beautiful. It’s clean. The cashier is personable and as I told him where I currently live doesn’t have black American food so this was a treat. The Glorilla greens are delicious.  The yellow rice is heavy handed with turmeric. The mambo sauce paired with the fried chicken is delicious.  My kiddo had the Mac and she said it was delicious. She did note though that the chicken was too salty. The season is there just need a tad less salt. We also indulged in the lavender lemonade. It’s super refreshing. Wish I knew about this place all the times I came down to mpls. I would have been shown love. Also there was business on Uber Eats and in the restaurant. They had steady traffic. Someone else had yams 🍠 and they smelled like heaven.

We stopped by Soul Bowl and were really impressed the moment we walked in. The space has a great vibe clean, creative, and full of local pride. The "Pride of the Northside" wall, the artwork, and the "Humble Hustle" sign really give it character and make it feel like more than just another restaurant.

I ordered the Crab Boil Wings with Fries, and they were full of flavor. The seasoning was on point, and the wings had that perfect mix of crisp and juicy. My wife had the Rasta Pasta, and she loved it creamy, flavorful, and loaded with toppings. I also tried the Queen B Lemonade, which was refreshing and just the right balance of sweet and tart.

The staff was friendly, and the service was smooth from start to finish. You can tell this place takes pride in what they do. Between the food, the look, and the energy, Soul Bowl is definitely worth a visit. We'll be back for sure.

I keep my eye out for Soul Food restaurants in MN and decided to try this place. Got the Caribe Bowl to go. The rice was nice. Chicken was flavorful & juicy. Plantains were a nice contrast. A bit pricey & slow but quality was pretty good. Will go again!

I tried the Plant-Based Caribe Bowl today and absolutely loved it! 🌱🔥 The flavors were bold and just the right level of hot and spicy — exactly how I like it. The plant-based “chicken” was so well-seasoned and crispy that it tasted just like real chicken. The sweet plantains added the perfect balance to the spice and made the whole bowl feel complete.

One of the best bowls I’ve had in a while — fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. If anything, I’d love a bit more protein and a little less rice next time, but overall this was a fantastic dish. Definitely coming back for it again!

⸻

Would you like me to make it shorter and more casual (perfect for a quick 1–2 line review) or keep this detailed foodie-style for people looking for specifics before ordering?

This place feels like going to your aunties house and seeing all your cousins. The food is soooo good. I had the Rasta pasta and it was so yummy, the chicken had a perfect char. The complimentary cornbread makes the meal feel like home. Everything was for sure a 10/10

formatted_address: 1025 Currie Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55403, United States
name: All Nigerian Cuisine

reviews.text: First time ordering and they canceled my order for delivery without letting me know why won’t be ordering again

formatted_address: 2456 Bloomington Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: Nile Market and Cafe.

reviews.text: Had the spaghetti and goat dish, hulbat marakh, and sambosas. Everything was very tasty. The spaghetti and goat was really great. Hulbat marakh is a collard greens cooked with fragrant spices served over injera bread with bananas on the side. The greens are a little bitter and the banana makes the flavor pop. The sambosas are filled with ground beef and seasoning. They are made fresh and the crust is crispy and flaky. Prices are very reasonable and 2 entrees were more than enough for 2 people to have leftovers. We are definitely going back often!

Tasty. Was in the area around lunch time and decided to try. Got a chicken sandwich and bottle of Coca Cola to go. Was pretty good!

Their drink/coffee machine was not working at the time, but it seems like they are just starting up business, so I’m guessing they will have things operating more smoothly in the near future.

I will likely return next time I’m in the area.

This was easily one of best restaurant meals I've had in the last year, maybe ever. I had hulbat marakh, and the owner brought out sambusas (on the house!) for us to share. I have enough leftovers for 1-2 more meals, after eating my fill. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. I will definitely be back!
Says it opens at 9 it's almost 11 and still not open.

formatted_address: 1810 Riverside Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55454, United States
name: Afro Deli & Grill: Cedar Riverside

reviews.text: If you haven't had Afro Deli yet your missing out on some bomb African fushion food. I will say this location for a store front may not be in the best location but their food doesn't show it. We got the Sambusas, fries and fried plantain.  The Sambusas were awesome. They were packed full of deliciousness. The fries were perfect and crispy.  The plantains were ripe and fried exceptionally. The sauces were tangy and bold. Nothing was over or under done. The food is completely worth a trip downtown for. The customer service was decent and the tables weren't to sticky. Lol.  Go get you some Afro Deli.

Fast casual and healthy! The food is worth fighting through the parking. I like this as a spot to hide and talk with my friend, I did get to have a five hour lunch with one of my mentees, and we had the place to ourselves for most of the afternoon. They do stiff delivery business so you will see drivers going in and out all day.

You can smell the variety of spices even before you get to the door. There is no bland food anywhere on this menu. If you are shy on spices , try, just ordering the chicken fantastic. The baked section and dessert section changes and runs out quickly. So if you want baked goods, better to get an early lunch.

BONUS TIP; They also have hummus that you can take home that is quite delicious .

Finally made my way over to the location on Cedar/Riverside. Quality remains high and the employees were very nice. This time I ordered the large Afro steak dinner bowl and the hot and spicy wings appetizer. The Afro steak dinner is beef, veggies, and a delicious red sauce over basmati rice. It was perfect, absolutely delicious and you get a lot of food for the price. Came with a side of crispy fries. I also enjoyed the crispy and juicy mini wings. Overall, Afro Deli continues to deliver high quality Afro/Mediterranean fusion cuisine no matter which location you visit.

Placed an order here today at Riverside. Cashier Jessica is taking orders with gloves on. With the same vinyl gloves on, then goes into the freezer grabs a frozen burger patty hands it over to the cook. From there proceeds to put fries in a box. I was disgusted. I attempted to discreetly asked for my money back for my purchase due to risk of getting sick from cross contamination. She the gets upset with me stating she did not touch any money. I’m like are you serious? She was very difficult with me because I asked for my money back, due to her lack of hygiene, and professionalism. In hindsight she could have apologized, and offered to remake the order. But she chose to become combative and defensive. To add to my frustration the other customers are giving me the side eye like I caused the problem, good luck to them. I hope they have steel stomachs. I was nice about it, but Jessica got upset for being called out. Afro-deli, please educate this woman. I see a lot of good reviews, but I did not get star worthy service today. So zero stars from me.

I placed an order for myself and staff in advance on their internal website (via Toast) for a 6:30 pickup. Order was confirmed and the website and ordering page said this location was open until 8. We arrived around 6:37 today to pickup and the store was close with staff cleaning. We attempted to knock to get the attention of the staff to see if the order was waiting or to confirm it was cancelled, but no one would come to the door. We attempted to call with no pick up. I wish the store would have called us to inform us that they had to close early and that our order would be refunded, but none of that happened. I understand things and emergencies arise, but it would have been nice to be informed about the status of the order. The lack of communication forced me to order from another restaurant that could make our order in a quick manner since we were on a time crunch due to work.

formatted_address: 1025 Currie Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55403, United States
name: Goorgoorlu African & American Food

reviews.text:
Great service, great food and absolutely great people!

I went in and immediately I was offered free samples to see what I'd like. Good thing that was offered because I went for a different dish than I would of tried.

Very generous portions indeed. Next time I'm in Minneapolis I'll try something else from here.

I’ve been here twice now and they are welcoming every time.  I really love their plantains & the special sauce they have for it. I was nervous to try the sauce but I love it ❤️

It feels nice finally getting good African food close by 🫶🏾
Good seasoned food, great atmosphere. I really recommend if you like West African food (Gambian and more) or wish to try it. I’ll continue to come back
The collards and fufu were 10/10, as was the sambusa. So warm, comforting, and delicious!

I’ve ordered delivery several times and have ordered several items: I’m telling you, this place doesn’t miss. Fufu and collards are rich, warm, and comforting with pieces of chicken and smoked pork - absolutely divine. The oxtails are perfectly cooked, falling apart, and simmered in a velvety sauce with chunks of potato and pepper that taste like they’ve stewed with the unctuous meat all day long. The sambusas are filled with meat; the wrapper light, flakey, and crisp without being heavy or oily. Get some of their hot sauce on the side- it’s great for dipping, adding to any food on the menu, or saving in your fridge to use as a condiment for literally anything else you eat. And the portions are huge! I get three or four meals out of each entree. Blow this place up! They deserve every ounce of praise they get- it’s no frills but some of the best food in the city right now.

formatted_address: 360 University Ave W, St Paul, MN 55103, United States
name: So Mala Cafe and Grill

reviews.text: So Mala Cafe and Grill is wonderful. I've been here with a friend for lunch a few times and have always had a  great experience! Very welcoming and friendly staff. They are very generous and the food has always been great!

My husband & I try a new restaurant once a week & last night we tried So Mala. I never leave reviews (I believe this is my first), but staff asked me for feedback & they deserve it! The food was phenomenal. I got the beef suqaar meal & my husband got the chicken suqaar. We got takeout & ate it nearby the capitol, then maybe 30 minutes later we ended up finishing all of it off! Was hoping for leftovers but it was too good to leave anything behind. Staff was friendly & I loved getting a free banana with each meal, taking bites of banana between mouthfuls of rice & meat was superb. Inside the restaurant was clean & basic, nothing special but would have no issues eating there.

Had chicken suqar. Was delicious, with fresh colorful flavor. Enjoyed eating with malawax. Somali tea was excellent. Prices seemed reasonable. The owner, Aweis, was very welcoming and friendly. He helped us learn some Somali words! Will come back.

Came back 2nd time. Enjoyed the goat!

Stopped in to So Mala Cafe for the first time recently and I was thoroughly pleased with my experience. The crew was friendly and helped me decide what to order. I ordered the goat meat and rice platter, the chicken wrap with fries, and the fried fish and rice! They generously gave me sambusa to eat while I was waiting for my order. Everything tasted great! The fried fish platter was my personal favorite but we all enjoyed the food. You’ll find quality Somali and Mediterranean food here!

I had a taste for Somali flavored Goat Meat & Rice and had seen this place a few time while at work. I was a little surprised they had goat meat at 6:30pm. I am very pleased with the service, the freshness of the food, and the cleanliness of the restaurant. The portions was way larger than other Somali restaurants I’ve visited in south Minneapolis and the cook the goat in green peppers and onions (great flavor). Also if you like spicy, they will cook your goat with the oh so good green spice that’s usually on the side. I will be back again soon. My meal is the $15.99 goat meat meal.

formatted_address: 3860 Minnehaha Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55406, United States
name: Selam Restaurant

reviews.text: We were hunting for Ethiopian food for one of our meals while spending the weekend in Twin Cities. When we stopped the sign was on but door locked as we were the first potential customers of the day...we waited and after about 5 minutes the door opened. We were glad we waited. The place is clean...the service ok...and the food amazing. My wife's lentil dish was the best Ethiopian food I've ever had. My beef dish was very good but hers was the winner! We will definitely recommend this place to others and will come back next time we are in the Cities.

My first time trying Ethiopian food and I was so impressed. The food was absolutely delicious! The waitresses were sweet and provided great service. The owner was so personable and polite. We enjoyed the Ethiopian music and hospitality. Thanks for an excellent experience.

First time visiting the restaurant. Interior design is awesome and restaurant is neat , service is okay ( it might be cuz I went around the closing hours but couldn’t be an excuse. I tried ጎመን በስጋ. I love their presentation of the food but taste wasn’t meet my expectations. Restroom was clean but cleaning chemical smell was intense. Overall my experience was okay.

Great Ethiopian food.  Service is good as well.  We have veggie/meat combo, aware lamb tibs and meat sambosa.  Each one is prepared perfectly.  The portion is big as well.  You will not go home feeling hungry.
The food was spectacular! We got the special Tibs (beef) Awaze (lamb) and the veggie platter. Everything was delicious. Staff were friendly and helpful , will definitely go back again!

formatted_address: 2111 E Franklin Ave Unite 1, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: Bole Express Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: Food was wonderful served hot.   William at the front counter was so helpful.  The flavors and spices were perfect.   The engera was just as it should be.  They did not disappoint.  Please try.

Came here almost a year ago. It was my first time at an Ethiopian restaurant, and I was impressed with the flavors of everything. I ordered the three meat dish to share with a friend. There was enough to bring some home. I will have to visit again soon.

First timer with Ethiopian cuisine, I thought the food was awesome.  Great flavors and colors, the plate itself was beautiful.  I couldn’t tell you the name of anything we ate but the gentleman at the counter was extremely helpful with recommendations, proper technique when eating, and checked in on us several times.  Food was cheap, $21 for 2 and brought home leftovers.  Really nice experience overall and will go back!

ethiopian food in minnesota is better becous of bole! hands down from the food to service as well as the set up! I recomend the vegie plater im sure you will love it! my friend had the kitfo and he wont stop talking about it.

I had a great experience here!

I like how you can order a variety of portion sizes. There is a good variety of meet and vegetable options. The menu was very well organized and easy to understand. I decided to order a “light size” of the lamb stew, which comes with 3 rolls of injera and salad. I also ordered beef sambusas. The light order of lamb stew was a great deal for $9! Not only did it fill me up, it was so tender! I have never had lamb so tender. The sambusas were crispy and fresh tasting. The dipping sauce tasted homemade too. Looking forward to trying more on the menu.

Also, the owners and staff were very friendly. They made sure we were comfortable and knew how to eat the food.

10/10✨✨✨

formatted_address: 3995 Egan Dr, Savage, MN 55378, United States
name: Sambosa Restaurant

reviews.text:
The food flavors was absolutely delicious and really fresh.
There are all lot of options in the menu but not available to buy.
The restroom was terrible dirty, unusable 🤮.
Take care with flies. I have trouble during my lunch with them.

My first experience 11/7/25- service was simply amazing. Very welcoming and peaceful. I got the family meal and it was even more amazing! Fresh, tasty, and definitely made with love! I WILL BE RETURNING

Had a get -together with my cousin and decided to try a new restaurant.  This is a hidden gem!!  I tried the Chicken Suqaar.  YUM!!  The chicken and sauteed vegetables had great seasoning!  Nice that the dipping sauces were on the side...and fun to try them all!
Great portions.  Had to bring the rice home as I could not eat that much!  Also tried the beef sambosas.  LOVE IT!  Another fun dipping sauce to try and was great with it.  Friendly staff answered our questions.  Fast service.  Really enjoyed our experience and trying new food.  Thanks.   We will be back!
The menu is outdated - this is the one I got today, which doesnt have the lunch special I came here for! Also they were out of all sambosa except beef, and there wasnt a good vegetarian option.

I stopped by for a takeout order of ground beef sambosas.  The interior is very bare bones and nondescript.  The lady who finally came out from the back cheerfully took my order and said it'd be a few minutes.  The sambosas were fantastic!  They were also the biggest ones I've eaten.  I could have stopped at 4 and have been satisfied but I ate all 5 and was stuffed.  I'll go back for more, and a few of the other menu items looked good as well.

formatted_address: 1501 Riverwood Dr, Burnsville, MN 55337, United States
name: Nawal Restaurant

reviews.text: Fast service. Never tried the place. Was hungry and gave them a shot. Did not disappoint whatsoever. I recommend this local restaurant. A+

They have the best sambusas in town Anytime I pick them up and bring them to others, they rave as to how good they are Compared to other Always. Get great customer service And the\n Prices are super reasonable.\n As well as this is my favorite place to get Somali style  hot tea with ginger and steamed milk.

Had take out. Inside isn't much, but the sign on the window says best goat meat in town. Had to try it! Very delicious cooked with peppers and onions, served with jasmine rice and a small salad. I will be going back.
The food here is AMAZING!! A friend and I split the Chicken Suqaar and I honestly don’t have words to describe how good it was. SO FLAVORFUL!! Definitely will be back!
They literally said, "we don't serve your kind here" and then tried to play it off as a joke.

formatted_address: 1996 Hwy 13 E, Burnsville, MN 55337, United States
name: Sanaag Restaurant

reviews.text: First time trying Somali food, and it was fantastic! We had both the camel and goat platters. Service was outstanding and our waiter gave us great recommendations on dishes to try. We were also pleasantly surprised by the soup, coffee and salad that's part of every meal. Delicious lentil soup. Highly recommend!

Sanaag Restaurant delivers an excellent dining experience. The menu offers authentic Somali cuisine prepared with fresh ingredients and rich flavors. Dishes such as the sambusas and chicken with rice are consistently well-prepared and served in generous portions. The staff provides attentive service, and the overall atmosphere is welcoming and comfortable.

A highly recommended choice for anyone seeking quality Somali food and professional service.

This place was absolutely wonderful. The service was amazing and the food was great. I had not tried Somali food before, but I am very glad I did. The woman who took our order was very helpful and even showed us what some of the dishes looked like before we ordered. The portions were large, which made them perfect for sharing, and all the food had incredible flavor. We ended up trying the Camel-meat special, which was tender and well seasoned. If you are in the area, I suggest giving this place a try.

I ordered the Chicken Suqaar. It had a very tasty seasoning on it. Finished it all in one sitting. Mango juice that came with my order was a nice touch to polish it all off. The hype is real if I’m in Burnsville again & need something to eat I will be back.

LOVE IT!

As a white man, I have to resist the urge to describe this restaurant as authentic (though it feels incredibly so).

My order is the goat with spiced rice, and it is...
*Chef's Kiss!

formatted_address: 2585 7th St W, St Paul, MN 55116, United States
name: Agelgil Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: This Ethiopian restaurant is absolutely amazing. The service is excellent, the food is fresh and delicious, and the place is very beautiful. The Ethiopian music creates an energetic and exciting atmosphere that makes the experience even better.

Absolute must. I got the half beef and half veggie. It was an absurd amount of food and reasonably priced. Some of the best Ethiopian food of hot. Bring a big appetite. They were super fast. I'd absolutely recommend this.

My server helped me look through the menu which was super helpful since this was my first time trying Ethiopian food. She recommended the Shiro which wasn’t too spicy and I loved it. If you do like spicy food, it comes served with jalapeños so you can adjust that. I did notice it was a much smaller portion than the Misir my friend ordered, but still plenty of food.

The food is usually delicious and authentic. However, it was cold and inedible this time around. The staff never checked until it was time to bring the bill, never came back to collect our cards to run it and had to go to the counter to pay. The wait staff never said thank you or apologized for not coming back to collect the tab. Love this place for its authenticity of the food but the service is abysmal.

We picked up a takeout lunch from Agelgil to enjoy outside on the first beautiful, glorious day of Spring in 2023, and the quality of the food was only matched by the amazing sunshine and warm weather.

The staff who took and serviced our order was so helpful and polite, we wish we could have stayed and eaten at the restaurant (but alas the outdoors called).

The spice and texture of the food was perfection, each bite better than the last. We loved it and hope to come back again soon!

formatted_address: 839 University Ave W Suite 103, St Paul, MN 55104, United States
name: West Indies Soul Food

reviews.text: I hate where it is located, but this place is delicious. The jerk chicken with BBQ sauce is my favorite. The rice is delicious. The ribs were on point. The service is excellent. Loved it!!!. If you try it at the State Fair, you must come to the restaurant. I have to come back and try other stuff.

I was very excited going here because of reviews I seen on the food; specifically the oxtail. However I’m sad to say I wasted my money, the rice and peas were really good and the cabbage was standard. However my oxtails were tough and pretty much inedible I’m disappointed and out of $27.

Workers are very nice, the space is clean. Good vibe overall

Oxtail Stew: taste 10/10, portion 5/10. If there was more meat it would be worth the money but despite the amazing taste I hesitate to order it again. If you don’t care about a small portion and spending a little extra, I recommend it.

Jerk rib: taste 9/10 the meat is very tender and delicious, wish there was a little more bbq sauce on the meat. Recommend ordering extra BBQ sauce for the meat. Portion 10/10. Highly recommend, will order again.

Collard greens: 10/10, may be salty to some but I like it. Will order again.

Plantains: 10/10 delicious and great portion, will order again.

Rice&beans: 10/10 good portion, well seasoned, will order again.

Mac&Cheese: 10/10, will order again!

Beef Patty: 10/10, hits the spot. Just eat it fresh right after you order it, or it will get dry. Will order again.

The people here were great! I just think the amount of food you get is not worth the price there’s slices of pie small slices that are $6 and we also purchased a oxtail plate with barely any oxtails and majority rice and peas which we didn’t like to much of honestly didn’t taste seasoned at all coming from a down south Louisiana Chef we created soul food and it wasn’t that! Coming up north it’s been a real task to get some decent soul food I’m not gone knock that other food may be great I haven’t tried anything else from there and probably won’t we paid $40 a plate to barely have any food or it to barely be seasoned like I said good place but prices should be adjusted because your not getting that much food for that

Amazing place hidden on a corner lot.

The food was delicious. The Jamaican Patty (hot beef) is highly recommended, as is the Jerk Chicken and stew.

Make sure to ask for Hot Pepper sauce, as their other sauces (while good and flavorful) lack a kick.

Great staff, food, and service.

formatted_address: 1304 E Lake St, Minneapolis, MN 55407, United States
name: Hufan Restaurant & Cafe

reviews.text: Hufan Restaurant & Deli is truly one of those places you’re grateful to discover. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with warm hospitality and a feeling of authenticity that’s hard to find nowadays. The food is incredibly flavorful, fresh, and prepared with real care. Every dish tastes homemade — rich spices, balanced seasoning, and generous portions.
Incredibly kind staff! My car had to be towed and I was in the area and needed a warm place to hang out. The food was tasty and the staff gave me a free water while I waited. Highly recommend (:

The Somalian tea was amazing! I got the beef suqaar which was very flavorful, and the crepes that come with it are so good. I also got 2 of the puff breads which were also so good. It was very early morning so only 1 staff person was working and he truly went above and beyond to make my first visit perfect. I will definitely be coming back.
The best tea I’ve ever had in Minnesota, hands down. The Somali tea is a must get, if you like cardamom you will like it. Support Somali businesses!!!💜

Their Somali tea is one of the best in Mpls..warm, creamy, and perfectly spiced. The sambusas are crispy, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. Great portions, kind service, and real Somali hospitality. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 12 E Franklin Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55404, United States
name: Lulu EthioVegan Cuisine

reviews.text: This restaurant is all vegan. And the food is very good. I tried Sambusa appetizer which is good, next Awaze tibs which I normally don't see in another Ethiopian restaurant, i took the risk to try it and its ok for my tastebuds. I tried the baklava here as its rare to find a vegan baklava. They are all good

Lulu's was amazing, and really appreciate it's all VEGAN. 🌱

Owner's son greeted me & took my order; helped me narrow down my options, as there really is so much to choose from, even helped me figure out how to order smaller version of certain menu items, so I could try more dishes.

Lulu herself brought out my main dish, and she was so sweet & kind.

Everything came out fast, yet everything was super fresh, super hot & full of flavor. 🔥

Super impressed! It was my first time, but I will definitely be back. Thank you, Lulu & fam! 💜

Super cute spot! Parking lot access via the alley. You can use the back door entrance.

My first time having Ethiopian food. Nice and clean inside. Love the colors and design inside.

I enjoyed our meal and the owner and family are very kind.
The food was INCREDIBLE! It was my first time trying Ethiopian food and it did not disappoint! I got the hummus & awaze tibs! Highly recommend :)

This food was so DELICIOUS! The flavors were on point and the presentation absolutely beautiful. This was my first experience with Ethiopian food but it's definitely going to be my weekend treat. If you're looking for vegetarian food that speaks to your soul, fills your tummy, and makes you forget that you're normally a carnivore This is the place to go. We had the family plate that had all the main course dishes and honestly only one item that didn't work for me but I can definitely see where others would love it. I'm not going to name that dish, but please believe everything else on that platter plus the hummus made up for it. Please go and check them out you won't regret it!

formatted_address: 1025 Currie Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55403, United States
name: African Bites MN

reviews.text: Food was not tasteful cassava was water missing a lot of ingredients taste like boiled cassava and water no flavors from the meats or seasoning no palm oil no nothing. Jollof rice very dry and tastes sweet no other ingredients just rice with tomato sauce no meat no flavor asked for beef and fish and received 3 tiny beef cubes and a piece of fish as small as a sardine also I asked for palm oil and received something that look and taste like it goes on tacos

The classic okra soup and egusi soup were a tragedy. The pounded yam was runny like mashed potatoes. Not solid enough to eat with my hands. The soups were oddly sweet and drenched with clover seasoning or all spice. I taste almost no pepper. There’s a peculiar mushiness to everything I tasted. Too much palm oil. Just tragic. Did not taste like anything I’ve eaten in Africa or anything I’ve eaten made by African people. Also the presentation was close but all in all a FAILURE. So sad I wasted money here trying to enjoy my favorite meals.
I believe that this restaurant is not in business anymore or under new management. Because it’s not on any of the food apps (i.e. DoorDash or Uber Eats). The hours are incorrect.
The food is absolutely amazing! They take pride in there Ghanaian entries. Always satisfied and left with wanting more. Highly recommended 👌 👍
one thing for sure she puts her love in it best beef tripes ever had if your down for the spice its amazing

formatted_address: 3867 Minnehaha Ave, Minneapolis, MN 55406, United States
name: Meseret Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: One of my favorite dishes I always get is dullet. I have tried many dishes there as well. I’ve been going there for many years and it was my first place there too. The ownership kind of changed, but the person who cooks is still there. The service is pretty slow, but the food is worth the wait.

I don’t know if my photos do this justice because I don’t have smell-a-vision. I loved everything about this place. I was a bit nervous that my take out was a quadruple order because of packaging - turns out they just care about presentation and making sure your food is separate, neat and palatable. We ordered the meat/ veggie combo for two people- it’s way more than enough and for an affordable price. Great little Habesha eatery.

Really loved the food here. I got the Gored Gored and I loved it. It was really spicy, but it was still great. Like that they gave you goat cheese to cool you down as you ate it. Apparently I got told by a guy at the restaurant that I chose the spiciest thing on the menu, but anyways, it was still great and I loved it. The place is also really convenient to get to, both by bike and by transit, as this place is right along the 38th street bike lanes and the minnehaha avenue bike lanes, and it is right along both the Route 7 and Route 38 buses

Gored-Gored (ጎረድ-ጎረድ) and Kurte (ቁርጥ ከ አዋዜ ሰናፍጭ እና ቆጭቆጫ ማባያ ጋር)  are my all time favorite meals in this place! This is a great restaurant for "Red Meat" lovers. The waitresses are polite and attentive during my multiple visits. The owners, Mr. Tadesse and Mrs. Meseret, come, greet and interact with customers on the dining table which shows genuine care. They truly care about the food they serve they check on you while dining. It is a family friendly restaurant welcoming all include kids. The place has two large screens dedicated to transmit live sports including the premier league.

Amazing neighborhood gem in Minneapolis! We felt so welcome while at the restaurant—the owner has such a warm, kind spirit.

Delicious Ethiopian food. Definitely get the veggie combo, which is big enough for two people (though it’s so good, if you arrive with an empty stomach you can finish it on your own).

Will absolutely be back!

formatted_address: 1808 Riverside Ave Suit 104, Minneapolis, MN 55454, United States
name: Cafe Jote - Authentic Ethiopian Coffee and Cuisine

reviews.text: So glad I stumbled across this cafe! I am staying near U of M, and wanted a place where I could get breakfast and coffee, which Cafe Jote most definitely delivered on! I ordered the fuul and an iced latte, both of which were so good and well priced. The fuul (stewed fava beans topped with tomatoes, onions, peppers, & yogurt) especially was delicious and very filling--definitely would recommend trying! The ambiance of the cafe is really lovely as well--the interior is really bright with high ceilings and a few tables, and the outdoor patio was a great place to read and sip on my coffee. Finally, Jote himself was fantastic!! He was so sweet and made sure my food and drink were prepared to my liking. A must stop if you are in the area--there is a full espresso menu and many other foods that I'm sure are fantastic.

Their lentil stew reminds me of home! Its served with this crepe that reminds me a lot of dosa. The woman who works here is very compassionate and went above and beyond with her service, she very clearly cares about her customers. The coffee is really earthy in this nice way too! All perfectly warming on a cool winter afternoon like this. I can't wait to come back and try their fuul and chechebsa!

Cafe Jote is small and cozy with a beautiful interior and a comfy outdoor dining area. Their coffee is good and strong. I had a latte. The customer service here is phenomenal and I felt very welcome. I would highly recommend Cafe Jote if you're looking for coffee in the West Bank area.

Really nice small place to have a quick bite or coffee. Had a latte and a Fuul. Both were amazing. The Fuul will likely be spicy for most people, but if you like the kick or enjoy spice, do try it! I personally enjoyed the heat.

Absolutely delicious! I knew it was going to be good when I walked in and it smelled fantastic. I got a latte and the dish that day was a version of scrambled eggs on a crepe/flatbread, I've genuinely never had more flavorful eggs and the crepe was very unique and complimented the eggs perfectly. The women behind the counter was very kind and attentive. I definitely want to come back another day and try some more food

formatted_address: 1341 Pascal St, St Paul, MN 55108, United States
name: Bole Ethiopian Cuisine
