For starters, the there was a wait for a party of 4 but it definitely was well worth the wait. Food was incredible. Our table shared the meat combo and veggie combo as well as some starters (goat cheese dip and lentil sambusas). Everything was delicious. I’ve had some Ethiopian food across the country but this has been my favorite restaurant by far. I cannot wait to go back.

Excellent Ethiopian food albeit a somewhat limited selection (no tibs!). Everything was really flavorful and the berbere was never so hot-spicy to cause sweat or pain. Injera was tart, tasty, and tender and the friendly and helpful staff kept bringing more as we gobbled it down. I especially liked the doro wot, yebeg alecha, and gomen. They were very accommodating of my 1-yo grandson.
The vegetarian sample platter and their ingudai tibs are absolutely delicious. They were friendly and food was served quickly. There was plenty of parking which is a plus. 100% recommend it.

formatted_address: 15353 E 6th Ave, Aurora, CO 80011, United States
name: SweetPepper Kitchen

reviews.text:
Tried the Ogbono with beef and pounded yam. The Ogbono is flavorless overall. The beef itself was okay, but everything together was a miss. It's missing something. For $20 I didn't even get a full tray with only 3 small pieces of the beef.

Regardless of the Uber price, it still was skimpy.
Skimpy and tasty would have been almost acceptable. The food also made me not feel well after and I eat all the similar ingredients regularly.
I will not be trying again, ty for the offer.

I'm done with this place! This is the 3rd time we've had an issue with their order fulfillment & their customer service-not to mention they don't adhere to the hours they post on Google.

Their food is good but it's just not worth the bad customer service! If you aren't interested in accommodating customers, DON'T BE IN BUSINESS! SIMPLE!

Whoever the person was that worked on Saturday 9.13 was especially bad. She didn't do her job so we didn't get our entire order because she ran out of food & then LIED about it saying she told us. SHE DID NOT! We felt lied to, short changed & manipulated! Done done done!!!!!
Went to the food truck on a Tuesday afternoon and got some sweet plantains. Super fast, cheap and yummy!! She told me the truck is there Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat.

It’s always a wonderful experience getting African delicacies from Sweet Pepper Kitchen. I get a taste of home cooked meals. It’s taste so good and affordable I come right back. They’re customer focus and have the right staff to get the job done.

This place has great food, but you won’t know because they’re hardly ever open. Totally unreliable and the customer service is lacking.

Yes, I understand it’s a “small family business,” but how are customers supposed to enjoy the business if you’re never open, constantly out of items when you are, or unable to serve customers because you’re short staffed? Also, how do you run out of pounded yam?! That’s like an Asian restaurant running out of rice. It’s always something and it’s been like this forever based on the reviews. Maybe they have enough customers and are okay serving their current clientele because they have no interest in new customers…I can’t even recommend this place to people I know because I can’t guarantee that they’ll even be able to try anything. Y’all need to do better and stop making excuses. People want to support you but can’t.

formatted_address: 1535 S Havana St, Aurora, CO 80012, United States
name: Ifka Cafe

reviews.text:
I go this restaurant to get Sambosa. I asked whether it is fresh or not. They said it is fresh. When I try to eat it, it is too cold to eat. It is made one day before. They lied to me. I throw it in trash right away as it has fish, egg and other foods sandwiched in it and it is contaminated easily.
On top of this, they overcharged me; 4.9x for a single Sambosa!

Updates: I visited Ifka for the first time since the pandemic started. I had a breakfast dish of sauteed beef cubes, onions and potatoes with crepes. It was delicious. A cup of tea was also included and all for $10. This place has no printed menu, you just have to trust the guy behind the counter.

Looking for something different for lunch the other day and found Ifka Cafe. There was no menu but the young guy behind the counter told me I could have goat, chicken and tilapia. I ordered the tilapia and it was the best fried tilapia I have ever had. It was fresh, crispy, done just right and a dust of spices on the outside that was super delicious. The humongous plate of rice was seasoned with cumin and some other spices, perfect compliment to the fish.

This place serves African, Middle eastern, and Mediterranean foods. Their dishes are mostly rice, pasta, goat meat, lamb shank. They serve Somali tea, special coffee, and other drinks. I love their specialty under the new management. I love their sambusa a traditional somali and Indian dish. Check it out if you ever visit this place. Friendly staff.

Wow I have been going to this store for quite some time now.  thire chicken shwarma with rice is very delicious and when they give you the food they are very generous you can eat it lunch and dinner and you only pay 17.68$ it is worth it 👌

Love their samosas.   Very tasty.
Excellent goat stew.  Love their lamb shank too...

formatted_address: 10375 E Iliff Ave, Denver, CO 80247, United States
name: Sudan Cafe

reviews.text: Unfortunately, my experience here was very disappointing. The staff were unwelcoming and unprofessional — the cashier even tossed the menu toward us and gave unpleasant looks, which made the entire visit uncomfortable. The food itself was decent, but the poor service overshadowed everything. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on the lack of respect and hospitality shown by the staff.
Very friendly and helpful owner. The Foul Special was terrific. Wish I lived closer and could have it regularly.

Went in here on my lunch break and got a foul sandwich in about the amount of time it would have taken me to order anywhere else. Service was SUPER fast, foul was fresh and deliciously spiced, bread was soft on the inside with a pleasantly crisp crust. I cannot speak highly enough of this place.
Lamb liver sandwich is one of the best sandwiches in town and very healthy. Restaurant is always very clean and the owner is very respectful and genuine. Love this place!

Searched for coffee shops and found this gem!  More of a restaurant but you can get various coffees like espresso and sudanese coffee also.  It's more patronized by Ethiopian natives so it's perfect.  No flash.  Very simple menu.  But absolutely delicious.  I was the only woman there for lunch but felt completely safe.  All my questions answered; such a wonderful experience!  I ordered the Foul (see picture).  Getting the one with falafel next time!  Definitely adding it to my favorites list.

formatted_address: 1951 S Havana St, Aurora, CO 80014, United States
name: Nile Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: Trust the negative reviews! The service here was absolutely terrible. It took them OVER an hour to bring out two dishes, and meantime they rarely came over to our table and the restaurant was mostly empty (and no one was a coming in for takeout orders… there was no excuse for the staff’s negligence)! What?? And it was very expensive for food that was not exceptional. So disappointed. We will not be returning.

I love the food and service at this restaurant. The staff are helpful in answering questions and I feel taken care of whether I dine in or order pickup. The vegetarian platter is my favorite. I highly recommend a visit.

Excellent customer service! The  servers are very interesting they know how to take care of customers very sociable and motivational to enjoy your moment in Nile Ethiopian Restaurant
Here is my clean and the true review of this Restaurant  after I have really ate and enjoy my Lunch
Let me start from the, professional customer service review for Nile Restaurant, including remarks about the servers
If you want it in a short about Nile Restaurant
I recently visited Nile Restaurant, and I was genuinely impressed with the overall dining experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff created a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The servers were attentive, respectful, and consistently checked in without being intrusive. They carried themselves professionally, knew the menu well, and were quick to offer helpful recommendations.

Service was prompt—water glasses were refilled immediately, orders were taken efficiently, and the food arrived on time. The servers handled everything with a friendly attitude, showing great teamwork and making the experience smooth and enjoyable. They were patient with questions, and their positive energy added to the authentic cultural environment of the restaurant.

Overall, Nile Restaurant delivers excellent customer service with server staff who are kind, responsive, and dedicated to providing a great dining experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for delicious food paired with outstanding customer services

I was really disappointed with my experience during my recent visit. When I sat down, the table was still covered with dirty cups, cans, and leftover food. I had to ask the server to clean it, and even then, her attitude was rude and unprofessional. It made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome. I hope the restaurant improves both cleanliness and customer service for future customers

I have called in and placed a take away order, I was told it will be ready for pick up in 20 minutes, drove almost an hour with traffic, but still our order wasn’t ready an hour & half later. We ended up waiting for additional 50 minutes onsite.

After all the disappointment with our wasted time, and poor service experience, unfortunately our food was not cooked properly. They gave us raw meat the kitfo with no flavor whatsoever and dry tibs almost looked like pre-cooked heated staled Frozen, not a fresh cooked meal even though I specifically asked them to cook it properly too. They were not busy to be overwhelmed by customer counts or anything, but the whole time I was there no order had came out for other people who were waiting before me for take out or dining. 2 other people were complaining about the time they had to wait, and one server had made a remark that her job was to put the order and she doesn’t control the team in the kitchen.

The servers were preoccupied with 2 or three guys at the one table near the bar, clearly flirting talking about meeting up after work to have a fun and so on. Very inappropriate behavior and unprofessional conversation between team members & customers at work site during business hours while others are waiting to be served.

I get it they are young ladies, and want to play, but not caring about customer’s time and messing up people’s order is not okay. I didn’t find out my order wasn’t right until I got home, and this is the second time similar situation happened.

I hope your Managment team or the owner read this message and make necessary changes to prevent disappointments for other customer since I won’t be ordering from them again.

Thank you!

formatted_address: 5707 E Colfax Ave, Denver, CO 80220, United States
name: Abyssinia Ethiopian Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text:
Positively delightful! It was my first time trying Ethiopian cuisine and our server was friendly and patient with us. Highly recommend the meat and vegetable sampler. It could easily feed 3-4 people. We had the plantains for an appetizer, best plantains I’ve ever had! Also tried the honey wine - I would recommend trying it at least once, comes in a cool glass. We had both the gluten & gluten free injera (bread like food served with the meal) - both were delicious.
Friendly staff, clean restaurant, reasonably priced, very positive experience.

First time having Ethiopian and it was amazing! I could probably eat 20 of their sambusas and the lamb in my dish was so tender. My husband is a spice fiend and he said his dish was the perfect balance of spiciness and flavor. My kids were unimpressed with the offerings but that's on us to broaden their culinary horizons better. Anyway. Staff was very kind to us, I was out of my element so their hospitality was much appreciated. Food was filling and so tasty and I definitely see us returning in the future. Thanks!!
first time having Ethiopian food and it was so so good! My friends and I split the 7 veggie sampler, some sambusas, and the plantains. Excellent service and excellent food.

We've eaten and ordered from here several times and it's been great. Tonight not so much. The tibs were so tough, overcooked, and lacked  flavor. The interaction was stiff and thick, and was thrown into a plastic bag and came broken in bits. The lentils in the vegetable combo were thicker than usual and honestly felt like they reheated an old batch. If we were dining in, I would have sent everything back it was so bad. Really disappointed.

First time trying Ethiopian. The food was delicious and there were many vegetarian options. I had the vegetable combination with five samplers: Gomen, Yemisir Wot, Fosolia Green Beans, Kik Alicha and Atkilt Wot served on a bed of Injera. The server was very friendly and patiently explained all the dishes. The decorations, including furniture made out of straw and traditional artwork, transformed the ambience into a more authentic and wholesome Ethiopian dining experience.

formatted_address: 11690 E Montview Blvd Unit 140, Aurora, CO 80010, United States
name: African Caribbean Palate

reviews.text: Incredible food and amazing flavor! Love Shelly and her vibes and excited for her new spot!
Must go and must eat. Absolutely incredible, I love them

formatted_address: 1422 Poplar St, Denver, CO 80220, United States
name: mesob

reviews.text: Second time coming here, and SO GOOD! Amazing food, great atmosphere, lovely service - highly recommend checking it out!My boyfriend and I got the veggie combo and the meat combo to split - it was the perfect amount. Definitely will be returning :)

First time trying ethopian food. Everything we ate was above average however they did not have sambusas and the veggie dishes were cold to warm. Meat dishes were hot but beef was quite chewy. Chicken leg was our favorite. The sweet wine was a pass for me.

We arrived late for a birthday dinner and were warmly welcomed. The food was excellent, much more flavorful than other Ethiopian I have had. The service was stellar, right down to sharing birthday cake with the staff. Highly recommended !

Here visiting from Texas and lucked up on this gem. We had the veggie combo and Shiro and it was AMAZING. You could taste the love it was cooked with. We also had the opportunity to watch the coffee ceremony. What a delight. Also, the owner and her daughter were so friendly. They explained the coffee ceremony and some of the history. We'll definitely be back.

There are a lot of Ethiopian cuisine options in Denver. This one stands out from other. However, the atmospher of the restaurant is not of high standard. Food was okay. Their injera was too sour compared to other ethiopian restaurants I,ve been to. Server was great explaining everything to us. Overall I would say this is a great restaurant.

formatted_address: 4363 S Quebec St, Denver, CO 80237, United States
name: African food Chavie spices

reviews.text: The food is so delicious I like
Her food is really good I really enjoyed it I can’t for next time.
If you live in Denver Colorado and you don’t have time to cook or even don’t like it, and you want a homemade Congolese meal, Chavie got any time.
Love the food and it looks so good, she knows how to cook
She can cook really good

formatted_address: 8450 E Iliff Ave, Denver, CO 80231, United States
name: 5 Star Café Eritrean & Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5 stars for 5Star Eritrean Cafe!

I came in for a platter and a cappuccino and left with a full belly, a happy heart, and leftovers to enjoy the next day. First impression of the food? Wow. This was edible art. Perfectly plated with vibrant colors and textures, and injera that looked and tasted legit from the very first bite. Every component on the platter had its own flavor story, and together they created a masterpiece. The server even brought out some berbere spice to sprinkle on top, which was the perfect touch. The vibe of the cafe was modern and relaxed, with upbeat music playing and a chill, cozy feel. I was the only customer for most of the meal, which made the experience feel extra peaceful and personal. And the cappuccino? So. Good. Rich, smooth, and foamed to perfection. I actually caught myself wondering, “Why don’t I start every day like this?” If you're looking for flavorful food, legit coffee, and an atmosphere that hits all the right notes, 5Star Eritrean Cafe is the move. Can’t wait to go back and try more.

Nice breakfast/lunch spot. The egg sandwich was excellent, but it would have been nice to have a smaller. This portion was huge. The peppers on it were very hot. They also have some interesting Eritrean options.

Service was fast and friendly but it took a while for the food to come out. The space is nicely decorated. A video of birds chirping in a cherry garden provided a pleasant atmosphere.

There is plenty of parking in the morning,

This was our first time here and we came in over the holidays with a group of 9. Our table was set and ready for us as we called beforehand. We ordered combination meat and vegetable plates for us to share and wow!! Such flavour, delicious food! Even my young son who had never had Eritrean or Ethiopian food was obsessed with the injera and loved everything. At the end of the meal, they even gave him a mango smoothie for free! We will definitely return. Thank you!!

This is an adorable little corner restaurant. The owners are on site and really take pride in their work. It seems to be extremely authentic food, and many of the patrons were speaking in their native language with the staff. I really loved the decor. The food was delicious! We got like a sampler platter and some lamb. Each dish was perfectly prepared and seasoned. It seemed like a lot of Care and attention went into each dish and it would've taken me hours and days to make something like this, so it seems like a great deal!
We also got a fruit smoothie. I think it was hard to communicate with the waiter on this. I asked him if it was real fruit or if it had added sugar. He said yes to real fruit and no to added sugar, but it was pretty obviously a premixed product that likely had corn syrup. I think it was just that he didn't understand English well enough to figure out what I was asking.

I visited 5 Star Café Eritrean & Ethiopian Restaurant and bought the best sandwich I’ve ever had. The bread was delicious, and every ingredient inside was perfectly balanced and flavorful.

But what truly made it unforgettable was the young lady with curly hair and big, beautiful eyes. I felt like she put her heart into making it, and that’s why it tasted so amazing.

If you happen to read this, please find me on Instagram @Constantinpax — I’d love the chance to meet you!

formatted_address: INSIDE of The Edgewater Public Market, 5505 W 20th Ave Suite #106, Edgewater, CO 80214, United States
name: Konjo Ethiopian Food

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying Ethiopian food, so I decided to visit Konjo in the Edgewater food court. The setup is very straightforward — you order through a kiosk/tablet, enter your phone number, and they text you when your order is ready. Easy and convenient.

I tried the Chicken Tibs Plate with Misir Wot and injera. The chicken was on the spicier side, almost like a cousin of Indian-style chicken curry, which I enjoyed. The injera flatbread was soft and filling, with the bubble texture showing it had been fermented. It did have a noticeable sour taste — I’m not sure if that’s how it’s supposed to be, but it was interesting to try.

I also ordered a sambusa for $3. It was a deep-fried pastry with a lentil/pulse filling, but the shell was a bit oily and on the harder side, so not something I’d go back for.

Just a heads-up that there’s a credit card surcharge and a public improvement fee added to the bill.

If you want a meal that feels like a hug from someone’s wise Ethiopian auntie, Kanjo is the place. I ordered the vegan platter with lentils and cabbage. The lentils were rich and soulful, the cabbage perfectly seasoned, and the gluten free injera was so soft it could easily double as a love letter from the motherland.

Also, do yourself a favor: ask for their house-blend spice. Trust me. It’s the kind of seasoning that makes you rethink every meal you’ve ever cooked. Pick some up to take home—you can gift it for the holidays, bring it to dinner parties, or sprinkle a little on your weekday meals when you need instant joy. It’s basically edible gold.

Kanjo, thank you for bringing Ethiopia’s warmth, flavor, and spirit straight to the table. I’ll be back—probably sooner than expected.

I discovered Konjo several years ago, and have eaten there many times. Their Lamb Tibs was my favorite. However, the last two times I have eaten there, the Lamb Tibs has been terrible. One time it was totally not spiced at all. The lamb was a dull grey color, and had absolutely no flavor at all. When I presented it to the guy behind the counter (circled in the photo), he said, “Yeh, I think they forgot to add the spice”. He did not apologize, he just gave me a ramekin of the bright red spice. I tried adding it to the lamb, but since it had not been cooked WITH the lamb, it tasted horrible. I dumped it in the trash and left angry and frustrated. I reached out to the owners of Konjo via their website, but they never responded. I avoided the place for about 6 months, but my craving for Ethiopian food got the better of me and I went back. I again ordered the Lamb Tibs, and this time it was properly spiced, but in the entire serving there was only two small pieces of lamb — that’s all ! I was again very disappointed, and I will NOT give Konjo another chance. They have disappointed me too many times, and I will never go back.

We ordered a plate with lamb and beef, and it was so spicy it was barely edible. We thought that the flavors were a bit odd and unfortunately both my husband and I got a food poisoning. We were excited to try Ethiopian food but that was a terrible introduction to the cuisine.

Eat here, plain and simple. If you get the chance get one of everything.

I don't know anything about authenticity, but I've eaten my way around an injera or two and I LOVE the bread here! Bouncy and tender texture and definitely sour!

All of the vegetable dishes are fantastic. Lentils have always been cooked well and the greens are tender and not mushy. My favorite is the cabbage, I could eat a bucket.

formatted_address: 10 N Sierra Madre St, Colorado Springs, CO 80903, United States
name: Ówàḿbẹ̀ African Restaurant & Lounge- Owambe

reviews.text: The food and chef are amazing! The wonderful aroma filled the air as we drove around the bend to the restaurant and pulled into parking. Everything tasted very good, of high quality, made with love, and was filling. The atmosphere was clean, warm, and welcoming. The dishes compared to the price were very reasonable. For 5 of us, we spent under $180 pre tip. Photos attached. However, we missed capturing the Fufu Egusi. There was not a single complaint at our table!

Being my first time experiencing this type of cuisine, I have to say that this was the perfect introduction. The food was beyond delicious, the service was beyond great and the environment was so relaxing. Our server Ernst truly made this experience that much better. He ensured that my husband enjoyed his birthday. I highly recommend experiencing this beautiful cuisine. Thank you to the staff for your hospitality.

Food was very good. The jollof and chicken was flavorful and their chili oil at the table has a nice heat to it!

Also enjoyed the plantains very much.

The atmosphere was very chill and the decor is very pretty. It is an easy location to spot with its nice bright orange paint outside and they also have a small parking lot at the side/back of the restaurant, so very convenient.

I believe today had limited staffing so service was a bit slow but I wasn't concerned by it. I had nowhere else to go afterwards so it wasn't a problem for me. Just wanted to mention that so others can plan accordingly.

The staff were very nice and helpful and overall I really enjoyed my experience and will definitely come back and try other dishes on the menu! Definitely want to try their egusi soup next time 😊

Came here in search of some delicious Nigerian food and this place did not disappoint. The jollof and chicken combo was so good, it brought me back my mom’s cooking. Excellent flavor. The lounge vibes look great, and our bartender Carla was incredibly friendly and attentive to our needs. Can’t wait to come back and stuff my face. If you have not tried West African food before, this is a great place to start.

Hmmm perplexed with this one. Went here for a date night, walked in and we really liked the ambiance and interior design, we were excited to try the food, have some drinks and enjoy the evening- but within minutes of walking in we learned there is no dine in eating/service. Only to go orders. You can eat your take out at the table but no service. We were bummed and really wanted to lean in as locals with the small biz. We just waited for our order to go and left. We got the combo rice plate with chicken. Wasn’t the experience we were expecting but appreciate the place all the same. Just wish we would’ve known it’s not dine in anymore as the inside is awesome and has great vibes.

formatted_address: 262 Havana St, Aurora, CO 80010, United States
name: Geez Habesha Bar & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Outstanding resturant! The service was friendly and quick and the food was AMAZING!

We had lamb tibs and the doro wot, both were delicious. Great coffee too!

My partner and I enjoyed an amazing dinner here tonight. We had the veggie platter along with some raw kitfo and a macchiato. This meal was Legendary! Everything was extremely fresh and flavorful. We will definitly be back. Thank you!
I love this place… I eat here almost every week and they do not disappoint!!! Great and friendly people!!! I will see y’all in a few days and thank you for always filling up my belly

As a regular customer, I can confidently say Geez Habesha Bar & Restaurant never disappoints. While all their food is fantastic, the Beef Lega Tibs is truly exceptional and my absolute favorite – always tender, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The welcoming atmosphere combined with the friendly servers and owners always makes for a wonderful dining experience. This is my top recommendation for authentic and delicious Ethiopian cuisine!
First time to eat Ethepioan food.  So good!!!

formatted_address: 1371 N Academy Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80909, United States
name: ArkCleoRich African Kitchen

reviews.text: Although in a mostly closed strip mall, the  restaurant is decorated nicely. I ate there before going to nearby Loonies Comedy Corner. I had grilled tilapia with plantains. Both were excellent!  The tilapia had a nice, spicy coating. There were also mild and spicy side sauces to add more flavor, which was not needed. The host/ owner was very attentive and explained the different foods, as did the wait staff. It is owned by a active duty soldier, formerly from Africa.

Upon entering, the restaurant is beautiful.  From the wallpaper to the ceilings to the art.
Staff was welcoming and gave great recommendations.
We ordered the goat soup which was delicious. The only downside was that the goat meat in the soup was fatty.
We ordered the fufu.
It was odd but good.
It has the consistency of mochi and the taste of mashed potatoes.
We also ordered the rice and goat.
In this dish the goat was good and not as fatty.
The rice was good.
We ordered a side of rice that was a bit dry for my taste.
Overall, I would recommend this restaurant and will return.
A+

It was mine and my hubby’s first time trying an African restaurant here in the springs , and they did not disappoint at all! The service was so nice, and the food was hot and fresh. The food was filling but not in a way that will make you feel slumped afterwards, it was just the right amount for a full belly. The flavors were so nice and would definitely recommend for everyone to try and try again.

This meal, two drumsticks and fufu was $20!!!! This place is extremely overpriced!  The service was terrible. My guest and I waited an hour for our food while two others came in were served and attended to right away. We only got a spoon and a roll of bathroom paper towels to clean up with. The soda I got was expired.

Two meals (2 drumsticks and a fish plate) and 2 drinks came out to $66!!!! Never again!

I will say the broth was good

Food was delicious. The owner gave us a soup to try for free. Our me was wonderful.
The music was so enjoyable as we ate and grooves along. If you’ve never had African food before, start here. You won’t regret it.

formatted_address: 1133 Yosemite St Unit C, Denver, CO 80220, United States
name: Global Cuisine

formatted_address: 306 S Ironton St Unit C, Aurora, CO 80012, United States
name: Megenagna

reviews.text:
Order #9 and you won’t be disappointed! Very authentic. The aesthetic is amazing, and the food is bomb 💣

Most meals have a little kick to it. But if you down for a little spice and good seasoned food… this is the place to go for a date night or a cool place to go with friends

Very delicious treats. We got some treats to go, some sweet cake and cookies, a savory twisted donut very tasty I dipped it in hot ginger tea at home, and some savory lentil filled pockets called samosa so good! Oh and of course this piece of cake was so great, it’s moist and my baby really liked it.

Disappointed 😞
I've picked up the veggie combo to-go for several years from here. I was in the area and stopped today.  It was not the same. Anyone can have an off day but idk if I'd want to try again. I'm giving a 3 which I think is very generous ( because of the memories).

They are still quit quick with the preparation...appreciated. Portions seem smaller.

Uploaded image is after I had taken a few bits, but it is less.

First time in Denver and we were looking for a comfort diner/food at the end of our long day. We were so pleased with the deliciousness of the dishes and great customer service. Try it for yourself, you will be amazed. Thank you team at Megenagna, one of the best ethiopian cuisine I have enjoyed not only in Denver but across the USA. :)

Best veggie combos around. The tibs and coffee are also amazing. My wife and I get food from here all the time. They also have a small grocery store connected to the restaurant. Everything is always super clean and everyone is nice.

formatted_address: 970 Yuma St Suite #160, Denver, CO 80204, United States
name: Konjo Catering and Events

reviews.text: I LOVE this place! I’m a huge fan of Ethiopian food and Konjo doesn’t disappoint. I’ve ordered the veggie platter several times which is a beautiful, colorful array of spiced lentils, spinach and cabbage with a side of fresh salad. It is delicious! I’ve never had so many veggies packed with this much flavor all on one plate. Not to mention service was fast and employees working the front are super friendly and attentive.

I was skeptical at first. Typically the best Ethiopian meals I've had took forever and ordering fries was definitely not an option. This place proved that my skepticism was grossly unfounded and came through with a delicious, spicy meal in a matter of minutes.

So good I’m writing this review before I even leave the marketplace. Ordered the veggie platter, everything was delicious, especially the spinach. And the woman taking my order was such a delight. Will definitely be back!

I'm an avid ethiopian food consumer. I'm super excited to see more authentic, diverse options for food in Denver, CO, especially on the west side of town. While I support this business and its endeavors in a popular food hall, the food wasn't anything to be excited about. It's a good place for people needing to be introduced to ethiopian food - it's healthy - jampacked with veggies, spices, and meat (i believe it's a great paleo option)

Konjo's is overpriced, has small portions, and comes out cold. I really appreciate the "server" and staff people at Konjo's - they're friendly, and want to know how to better serve you. However, with my experience in Ethiopian food, I know good quality food, and it wasn't served up here. $14 for a meat combo, which was a tiny plate of meat, a veggie side, and a tiny salad.
Both the food and the service here are awesome. It was my first time trying Ethiopian food, had the veggie option and it was great. The sambusa was out of this world.

formatted_address: 1121 S Peoria St, Aurora, CO 80012, United States
name: Zula Cafe & Lounge

reviews.text:
TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE!!!! I  should have went with my gut feeling. After calling the place serval times for a call in order and not getting an answer I ordered ahead via Doordash. I was notified 10 mins later that my food was ready and (veggie combo). At arrival of the restaurant It took 10 minutes for the cook to realize I was inside of the establishment. She assured that my order was recieved but not ready. The kitchen door was open but there were no pots on the stove and the microwave was running. I went outside to let my ride know it would be a minute as I was coming through the door I saw the cook plating my food from storage containers  assuming from the microwave. As she presented my food I let her know I saw that she was serving me left overs. I opened my togo box and felt the temperature of my food the injera itself  was  ICE COLD!!! I then inserted my finger in the middle  and yeh temperature of my food was like warm and immediately requested a refund in which I received.  Disappointed for sure,  but the server at least acknowledged the fact that she indeed served me left over food that was just warmed up and did not argue the fact.

Extremely disappointed I will not return or recommend.
I've never eaten this kind of food before. It was delicious and the service was wonderful!!! What a fun experience!

Very nice relaxed and classy atmosphere.  The authentic ethiopian food is great and very filling. I have heard the weekend night time vibes can be alot of fun, will return and report back.
I enjoyed the jazz music playing while we ate lunch.

Big fan of Ethiopian food so when I saw this restaurant I was excited to check it out. It did not disappoint! The food was fantastic and the staff were very friendly and made it a welcoming environment. Will be coming back!

On vacation and decided to give Zula a try. Neither of us have much experience with Ethiopian and the staff was very helpful, did a great job explaining the menu and making sure we were ok with “spicy” before we ordered. The food was very flavorful and would absolutely come again.

formatted_address: 13160 E Mississippi Ave, Aurora, CO 80012, United States
name: Cafe Paprika

reviews.text: Back from Morocco for about a month and had a hankering for Moroccan food. Absolutely loved this place. The food is authentic Moroccan food - not just ‘Mediterranean.’ Highly recommend the Bastilla and the sweet couscous - identical to what we ate in Morocco. A friend also loved her chicken kebabs. The service was lovely, and the servings were large enough for leftovers. Will be happy to enjoy my meal again. Thank you Cafe Paprika!

Good middle Eastern restaurant in a small strip mall. The lamb dishes are great. The lamb kebabs were a lot of food for lunch. The lamb was cooked to perfection and paired well with the sauce. The rice and vegetables were very good. I had planned to go with Flan for dessert but was full by then.

Service is good - fast and friendly. The space is nicely decorated and comfortable. The music is low level and pleasant.

The parking lot is small and can fill at peak times.

I've never had this style of gyros before. The tastes were. Great blend of savory and sweet. Definitely a skilled chef in the kitchen. I did not like that the meat was cut in bite size pieces. It allowed it fall out of the gyro. I now know I prefer shaved meat. The decor of the restaurant was beautiful, it's too bad the place was not busier, it is a great place. Clean, friendly and good food.

Years ago, I had takeout from Cafe Paprika but tonight I had the pleasure of having dinner there and we were blown away by the beautifully flavored chicken tangine with prunes and apricot lamb. The hummus was the best we’ve had in years and the pita was freshly toasted and delicious too. We loved the mint green tea and are already eager to return soon. Thank you chef!
Our server was super nice. It's definitely worth a try. Good Moroccan food.  It's a bit milder in flavor.

formatted_address: 2222 Bruce Randolph Ave, Denver, CO 80205, United States
name: Nola Voodoo Tavern

reviews.text:
This place feels like home! The food is delicious and you can tell this is a well known hangout spot for community members!
I also had a chance to try the pineapple upside down cake right out of the oven, and it's one of the best slices of cake I've ever had.

I had a catfish po-boy and my husband had the sampler platter. It was really good! There was definitely a community feel to the place- there was a game on and when the Saints scored a touchdown they gave out free shots to the patrons.

The gumbo was amazing, but let’s be real... the red beans and rice came in and stole the spotlight ⭐️. Everything we ordered was a hit, no misses at all. And don’t even get me started on the pineapple upside-down cake… chef’s kiss 🤌🏽
On top of the food being a solid 5/5, the staff was just as great/super welcoming, attentive, and made sure we were happy every step of the way. Great food, great service, great vibes. If your in the area check them out (and order the red beans and rice..😉). 😄🍽️
Voodoo Tavern is a great place to go if you're missing NOLA. The food is great and the atmosphere bring you back to the French Quater.

Great neighborhood spot. Best food I had outside of the Crescent City. Gator bites and the Nola Trio all day, I even took some to go. Great service and great drinks as well. Got to shake hands with the owner him and his staff were all great. Definitely will stop every time I'm around Denver.

formatted_address: 2266 S Colorado Blvd, Denver, CO 80222, United States
name: Casablanca Restaurant

reviews.text: This was excellent! Just excellent. We shared the vegetarian plate. Everything was fresh and flavorful. These are the best dolmas and falafel we have ever eaten. The parsley was so fresh and the dressing was perfect.  Dessert was the Kanafeh - not too sweet and beautiful. I think everything was made to order. The service was friendly. This place is the best kept secret in Denver!

We were welcomed upon walking in but that was pretty much the extent of the service we received. Besides taking our orders and dropping them off, our waters were never filled and it was a hot day with no/low air conditioning in the restaurant. Even when paying, the lady didn’t say a word to us and was busy talking to someone on the phone. The restaurant also has a strong smell of old furniture which really bothered some of the people in our group.

The food itself was decent. I enjoyed my Moroccan lamb shank enough and the chicken kabob was decent but one in our group ordered the lunch portion and it was like 3-4 small pieces of chicken.

Overall, if you are really craving Mediterranean in the Wash Park area and don’t feel like driving, getting some good to go here may not be a bad idea but service leaves a lot to be desired.

Absolutely perfect dinning experience with food I have never tried. It was incredible. Our first place we ate at from Montana. And the observing was friendly, warm and helpful. 100% must try! Well be back!

I believe that this could be a good restaurant again with trained employees. First, the cook arrived late. It took quite awhile for my food. A phone customer was able to order and pickup before we were served. The was a problem with the hummus so I was served rice and asked afterwards if it was OK. My friend's lamb was tough. Finally, there was something on the containers which stopped me from finishing my drink or taking the leftovers. My friend was OK with taking them. $56, too much for the whole experience.

The atmosphere was quiet and relaxing!
The tacos were absolutely delicious!😋

formatted_address: 2883 Welton St, Denver, CO 80205, United States
name: Welton Street Cafe

reviews.text: It's crazy that I've lived in Denver my whole life and never ate here. Experienced it the first time yesterday with my women's group and the food was delicious! I got the catfish dinner. The greens were nice and a little spicy. The yams were great. The Catfish was fresh and light. We didn't have a reservations we walked in. They were a little tight but the manager was able to get us in without having to wait over an hour and a half which I so appreciated. Clean establishment and the staff was friendly And attentive. Overall a wonderful restaurant in the neighborhood ‼️

We went here with another couple for dinner. The area is interesting a lot of old buildings. I had a turkey burger, my husband had the whiting and cat fish sandwich, my brother in love have the same the whiting and cat fish sandwich and my sister in love had honey hot wings.  We shared a fried bread with cheese and broccoli. If you go be prepared to wait at least 45 minutes for your food. They tell you this when you order. The staff was friendly. Our server forgot 2 items that I ordered and I am not one to complain and say anything, but I really wanted to try the peach cobbler, but I wasn’t going to wait another 15 or 30 minutes for it. If you are not in a hurry for your food this would be a nice place to go and enjoy yourself with the people you go with. The price for the food is fair. I was disappointed because my turkey burger didn’t come with fries and when they ask if you want them seasoned they mean it. I had unseasoned and had to add salt. They do have outside sitting.

I give this restaurant 5 stars across all categories! The food was soulfully delicious! Our servers Sarah and Fathima were so friendly, professional and accommodating! My fiends and I can hardly wait to go back!

Stopped by Welton Street Cafe and was warmly welcomed by Lucille at the bar, who helped me with my order. I went with the jerk chicken dinner, paired with potato salad, cabbage, and fry bread—and wow, it did not disappoint. The chicken was packed with flavor, the sides were comforting and well-seasoned, and that fry bread was the perfect touch. If I lived in the area, this would definitely be a regular order.

I also tried the banana pudding for dessert. It was good, though not particularly memorable compared to the standout main course.

Overall, a great local spot with friendly service and soul-satisfying food. I’ll be thinking about that jerk chicken for a while.

Let me just tell you. I am from the Deep South in Alabama. We know fried chicken. This place has some of the best friend chicken I have ever had. I totally see why this is an institution. Everything about this place made me feel like I was home. The green, yams, and mac and cheese were all stellar. Don’t skip on this restaurant. I can’t wait to come back and try the hot wings next!

formatted_address: 3PQJ+978, Douala, Cameroon
name: Special Monday and Saturday

reviews.text: I recently visited this spot that specializes in African dishes, and it was truly impressive. They operate mainly on Mondays and Saturdays, making it a perfect weekend choice. The food was delicious, and the service was top-notch. One of the standout features is the spacious parking area, which made the visit hassle-free. It's conveniently located right across from Etoo, so it's easy to find. The environment is calm and welcoming, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a good meal. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality African cuisine in a relaxed setting.

formatted_address: 2160 S Holly St Ste 3, Denver, CO 80222, United States
name: Tuti Grill

reviews.text: Loved the lamb kabsa! Fall off the bone lamb with savory rice and salad. Enough for two people.  Delicious.  Very friendly and attentive owner.  Highly recommended.

Visited this place for the first time in Denver, I ordered chicken shawarma wrap and a shish kebab wrap with two lemonades. The wraps were good in taste and moderately seasoned.
However, I can note that calling the place isn’t the best approach to order food as they don’t have a designated cashier or anyone specific to serve tables and that’s why you’ll need to probably wait about ten minutes extra.
The lemonade has also extra sugar and there’s no option to choose from adding honey or not adding any sweetener which’s essential inquiry in any restaurant.
I hope to visit this place again and see positive changes.

Update:

I decided to visit Tuti Grill restaurant again together with my significant other and had even a better experience than the first one, we opted for a mix grill plate and Falafel 🥙 plate appetizers which come in 5 pieces and hummus with olive oil and I can confidently say it’s the best I’ve tried in Denver!. I attached photos for you to see.

I found this restaurant by Google search. The atmosphere was nice, traditional, no bar/alcohol.

I had the baba ghanouj for appetizer. It was very good, fresh as well as the bread. I had the Tuti Mix Grill for entree, the meat and rice were seasoned well. There was a beef that came in four pieces it was the best. I shared this with my partner who is Turkish/Iranian. We were both pleased with the portion sizes and taste. The server was great as well. I strongly recommend trying this place!

Was craving Mediterranean food and this place was close, so we stopped in. So glad we did! The food was so delicious - even the salad was flavorful. We played it safe with chicken dishes but cannot wait to go back to try some lamb! This restaurant will for sure be in our rotation.

The food was tasty and prepared to order, so very fresh. As a vegetarian I had two appetizers- I loved the baba ganoush, it was rich and tangy, and the falafel were light and crispy and perfect. My husband had some lamb dish he declared tasty. We had no leftovers because we both wiped our plates clean. Oh, and the rice was fluffy perfection. Highly recommended- we will be back

formatted_address: 62517 Railroad Sq, Tallahassee, FL 32310, United States
name: Halisi Africa

reviews.text: I was working in Perry and heard of this location.  It was roughly an hour drive but I was so glad I made the trek!  The food was fantastic!  The atmosphere was top notch and the staff was above my highest expectations and hopes!   I cannot wait to return with many associates!!  This made me long for another trip to Africa…but until I can make that journey your restaurant and boutique will be my home away from my home!  Thank you so very much!  And please tell Esther she was truly amazing!!!

Tried this place out.  The food was amazing and the atmosphere as well.  Our server was great, very polite and caring.  However, the flow of food delivery, was not that grea.  My main dish came out first, then the second one and the appetizer last and was the wrong one.   I still enjoy it as the food was the Star.

First time trying dishes prepared with fufu. We had fun sampling a few dishes and definitely gave us the want to discover more. They had run out of cheese for the zanzi pizza so we didn't get to try it, but they were willing to do what they could to try and make it without. The flavors were so different from dish to dish!

It was a very nice experience.  My husband and I went for a mid-day date, and we were pleased with everything: the food, service, and atmosphere.  There was a cool vibe, from the boutique upon entry to the projected music videos delivering  melodic tunes.  I really enjoyed the authentic dining experience and the education from our hostess about the foods and best way to enjoy them.  If you are looking to try African cuisine,  this is a great option.

So much to say , I travel for a lot different cities & states tasting African dishes. I googled this place and went to try it out . I arrived at 12:40 didn’t leave until 2:30pm. They gave our order to another table took over a hour making our order on top of that the food we initially ordered they ran out of beef after 30 minutes of opening time so we had to change what we initially ordered to something else . This food is not AFRICAN TRADITION, it’s more Haitian / American . The goat was over seasoned tasted like a Haitian meal and the egusi soup tasted like tomato soup which the real egusi soup base is tomato but the egusi they serve does not have African ingredients. The egusi was very watery the onions in it was raw/ the fufu ahh , is horrible it was cold and tasted old. The waitress apologized several times I stayed in hopes the food will make up
For the mistakes but the food just made the experience worse . She came with the bill I asked her was it something they can discount due to the bad experience and having to wait
Over a hour & 30 minutes and she said she’ll ask the manager came back the food was on the house. I am grateful for that , but I would’ve loved some real African food I don’t mind paying whatever the amount is. The portion is small as well. I drove out of town to
Try this place. I’m not saying don’t go there , all I’m saying is that this is not a traditional
African restaurant the cook is not African and I don’t want people to be
misinformed. Other tables had mistakes as well , just need some improving . Go get a real experience with a real African restaurant the flavors is amazing. Far as the aesthetic goes it’s a cozy feeling nice music being played several items for sale in the boutique love the painting on the wall.

formatted_address: 178 Long St, Cape Town City Centre, Cape Town, 8001, South Africa
name: Mama Africa

reviews.text:
We've been here for Christmas Eve and had the Christmas Menue.
Besides traditional hand wash and face painting, be had a great stay here with good food and nice music.
Sometimes we needed to interact with the band and had to join some dances or musician sessions!
It was a nice experience and we had a lot of fun.
The food was a delight. I had the meat Plate with crocodile, zebra and kudu. Never tried it before, but I will definitely eat it again, because it taste great!
We also had bottomless wine, and the red wine is pretty delicious. A bit heavy, but great in taste!

Great ambiance with a great African band, decor and food!
They took us 15 minutes before closing and we did not feel rushed!

Staff was super sweet and informative of the dishes we were trying and we got our faces painted!

Unforgettable moments at Mama Africa! From starter to dessert, every dish was exceptional with superb service throughout. The warm, vibrant atmosphere immediately puts a smile on your face and celebrates authentic African culture beautifully.

The food was outstanding - we loved experiencing traditional South African flavors in such a welcoming setting. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making our evening truly special.

The live music and energetic ambiance create a perfect blend of dining and entertainment. This is exactly what Cape Town is about - great food, warm hospitality, and unforgettable memories.

We can't wait to come back on our next visit to Cape Town. Highly recommended for anyone wanting an authentic taste of Africa!

Came from Saudi Arabia to Mama Africa – absolutely worth it! Super authentic African food, bursting with real flavors, cozy vibe, and incredibly warm staff. One of the best and most genuine African meals I’ve ever had. Highly recommend!

The restaurant serves pan-African fare with live music and has a very touristy feel. The decor reflects the African heritage with cartoons and humor. The menu offers several exotic options, including game and crocodile dishes. We ordered the Moroccan lamb tagline and the Malay chicken curry. The lamb was tender and succulent while the chicken was okay though a tad chewy. The servers were very friendly and efficient and overall we had a positive experience.

formatted_address: 15 Bennett St, Green Point, Cape Town, 8005, South Africa
name: GOLD Restaurant

reviews.text:
We had an unforgettable evening at GOLD in Cape Town. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was vibrant, welcoming, and truly unique. The entire experience felt like a joyful journey through different African cultures.

The three live performances throughout the evening were absolutely spectacular — energetic drumming, beautiful dancing, and captivating storytelling. Each show added a wonderful rhythm to the night and kept everyone entertained and engaged.

The food was outstanding. GOLD serves a wide variety of dishes from across Africa, all beautifully prepared and perfect for sharing. Every plate introduced new flavours and textures, and the entire menu felt like a culinary expedition. The drink selection was excellent as well, and we especially enjoyed the Rosé wine, which paired perfectly with the dishes.

What made the evening even more special was the incredibly friendly and attentive staff. Every team member made us feel welcome, explained the dishes with enthusiasm, and contributed to the warm and lively atmosphere.

If you’re looking for a dinner experience that combines culture, entertainment, and fantastic food, GOLD is an absolute must. We will definitely be back!

Gold Restaurant is a very lively experience. There are traditional African dances and performances being done throughout the restaurant that travel to each dining room so you are sure not to miss any. The food, in my opinion, was just ok. It’s a set menu so no need to think about what to order. Some items of the menu I did enjoy were the Zanzibar fish curry and Moroccan lamb stew. Go here if looking for a great experience

We were a little sceptical when we booked our evening at the Gold Restaurant. But, what can I say, it was a great experience! The mood and atmosphere captivated us as soon as we entered the restaurant. From the very beginning, the staff provided us with very personal service (thank you, Patricia!) and we felt very welcome. The atmosphere and African joie de vivre immediately captivated us. It was incredible how this positive, life-affirming attitude was conveyed to every guest. The 14-course menu showcased the full range of African cuisine. Singing and dancing didn't just take place on stage. The whole troupe passed by every table and captivated everyone. In the end, it was a big party that encouraged almost all the guests to dance. A wonderful evening!

We had an incredible experience at the Gold Restaurant. It is  catered mainly for tourists but it is definitely worth a visit to enjoy their traditional menu of 14 dish tasting dishes, which were fantastic. We enjoy every bid of it due to the traditional cooking techniques and the rich spices that bring each dish to life.The life shows were spectacular with great African music and dances. The drumming, dancing and as a matter of fact, the whole show and experience was great. It has an enchanting atmosphere.

I visited all the way from Saudi Arabia, and it was an unforgettable experience! The atmosphere is vibrant and full of culture, with amazing live performances that pair perfectly with the food. Each dish is rich in tradition and truly delicious. The staff are warm and welcoming, making the evening feel special. A must-visit in Cape Town!

formatted_address: 6-8 Lagoon Dr, Umhlanga, uMhlanga, 4320, South Africa
name: African Roots Cafe Restaurant

reviews.text: African Roots Cafe, now under new ownership, and is fully Halaal. Situated along Lagoon Drive at Pearls Mall, just a short stroll from the vibrant Umhlanga beach. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed, perfect for any time of day. They serve delicious breakfast, hearty lunch, and satisfying dinner options, with a diverse selection of Mocktails, Matcha, and expertly brewed coffee to suit every craving. Plus, they stay open late, making it an ideal spot to unwind with friends or enjoy some quiet time. The shisha offerings add a delightful touch for those looking to relax and chill in a cozy setting. A fantastic place to experience warm hospitality and great flavors! Thank you Aseeya (GM) who was absolutely friendly and hosted us.

What used to be a great coffe shop has now become… restaurant that focus is on chilii and spice… simple dishes poorly executed… female manager asia brilliant her hospitality is welcoming…..

Chicken strips so so so salty…..
Toasted cheese was perfect for kids but only 1 bread option…. Gone is that beautiful potato bread

🥲🥲🥲

Also lets not forget the beautiful “all gold tomato sauce”

Came to Durban for the week, and this was the best cafe I have ever been to, friendliest staff and muslim owned so everything is halal. Everyone is welcoming and extremely hospitable, and by the end of the week you'll have made friends with all the lovely staff 😊Their iced coffee is the best and I've come here every morning without fail 🤭 if you're looking to have breakfast with family or just relax with work or studies then this is the place to go 🫶✨️ (again their iced coffee is to die for 😆)

"Wow, African Roots Cafe is a must-visit! 😍 Burgers are 🔥, wraps are huge and packed with flavor (chicken feta avo = 💯), and the prawns platter is a spice-loving's dream 🍤🔥. Coffee is on point ☕️, and hookah on weekends is the perfect chill vibe 💨. The Manager Shamsher and the waiters are amazing with the service 💕. Ambience is top-notch too! Highly recommend this spot 👌 5/5 stars"

Absolutely great food. They have a new female Muslim manager called Aasia. She is such a great cook. She adds spice and flavour to everything. She made me an ice matcha to die for. The breakfasts made with bread are amazing. The milkshakes have real fruit in it and are so tasty. My friend is vegan so we were so happy that they make their own mayonaise without egg in it. Her recommendations are amazing. I suggest, as with all restaurants not to go during peak hour during the festive season for the best experience. The food is so good that they get really busy and then theres a longer wait. The waitress and waiters are exceptional. They are even trying to train more. Highly recommend for anyone and everyone. They are kid-friendly and had colouring books with crayons and a small seating area for my friend's daughter. It is THE place to be

formatted_address: 18601 Green Valley Ranch Blvd #100, Denver, CO 80249, United States
name: Pupusas Paradise 3

reviews.text: Elsa always have a smily welcome. Clean place even when is busy and friendly service.

The pupusas here are pretty good, I’m not going to say they’re the best I’ve had but they are pretty good. The waitress was nice and friendly but she did take a while giving us our check. I recommend you give this spot a try!

This restaurant has the best caldo de res ever !!!!! I have never tasted better, the meat is so tender and flavorful, the vegetables are cooked to perfection, and the passion fruit drink is so delicious. The service is amazing making you feel right at home and the restaurant itself is so good with good decor and music selection. They treat you right at home here, you need to check it out. Come support  Hispanic restaurant here in GVR!
The food was muchísimo rico🙌 The service was great and the flavors were very fresh and tasty. Definitely the best Salvadoreña Comida I’ve had. 💯 Please support them!!

A friend suggested that we try Pupusas Paradise the next time we were in Denver. So after a little sightseeing, we found the closest one to us.

The staff were very friendly and greeted us right away.

Our eyes were definitely bigger than our stomachs. The paradise sampler platter was delicious and filling!! We actually packed some up to take back with us to the hotel.

formatted_address: 8535 W Colfax Ave, Lakewood, CO 80215, United States
name: SHASHA AFRICAN GRILL

formatted_address: 3341 Belair Rd, Baltimore, MD 21213, United States
name: Saviour African Food Restaurant And Catering

reviews.text: this the 2nd time I ordered for delivery and got the wrong order, the 1st time I ordered I got the wrong soup and meat and no drink, instead of chicken they gave me 2small fatty beef meat. I even called twice in advance to make sure they don't mess my order again and the older guy called "Zee" assured me I'll be fine only to realize It was a Lie, i got the wrong soup and meat again. They never even gave me the 5$ Ginger juice drink he said I would, instead gave me 1$ ginger ale can soda!? This was no mistake but intentional,rude and disrespectful. You can see the food presentation itself looks messy n small like Cat food, it went to the trash. I had to order again from a different restaurant on the same belair rd. Be warned!

My first time getting takeout here last night & the food was good and hot! I only took a few bites when I left (due to my fast) and it knocked me right out lol. The cashier was very nice and patient with me while taking my order, and I didn’t wait long for the food to come out either. The plantains were soft and sweet just how I like it. The jollof rice was good, but I would’ve loved it to be super spicy (I love very spicy foods lol) but the curry goat was very spicy just like I requested & the meat was tender and juicy. Very reasonable prices too! If takeout slaps like that, I could only imagine what the dine-in experience will give🤩 I will definitely be back!!

Hidden gym in Baltimore! Don’t expect the red carpet treatment; however, staff are helpful in assisting you with making a food selection. Very clean and great musical vibes.

Food: every-time I’ve come, I’ve always tried to order something different. To try new and exotic things. Always happy and satisfied. FLAVORFUL, tender, and hot. I have no complaints. The food has gotten smaller over the last year but I’m still left satisfied.
*Try the OHA soup
My food was fresh and delicious! I only got chicken and rice,  but it was good! Chicken was nice and spicy, the plantain and was rice was nicely seasoned. I would definitely go back and get more.

Food: Equsi Soup with 2 meat (goat) and Pounded Yam Fufu
Comments: It was our first time trying and it was very good and unique. The fufu had a great consistency and the soup tasted very good. Price was affordable for amount of food.

formatted_address: 5114 W Emerald St, Boise, ID 83706, United States
name: BAMI'S CATERING (BAMI'S KITCHEN)

reviews.text:
Absolutely delicious. The beef was so tender, I got the egusi soup with fufu. I'd definitely go back.

Update, I went back for more because it was so delicious. This time I ordered two egusi with double portions. I paid over $40 with tip and felt like my portions were cut in half. This is all I got. Again, it is delicious but where's my food?

The food here is delicious! You won’t regret having such a delicious experience! We got the Egusi and Okra stews and the Jollof rice with beef plate. If you don’t feel very hungry and just want to try something new, I would definitely recommend the Egusi stew. It’s very flavorful and comes with a portion of fufu. It doesn’t come a lot of food though so don’t be too surprised! If you want more value for your money, I would definitely recommend the Jollof rice plate. The owners are very sweet and attentive and they have a lot of pride about the food they make! Be adventurous and try it! 🇳🇬

Food is DELICIOUS! My only complaint is that it is pretty pricey for the amount you get. Someone else mentioned the portions on the egusi stew. I have noticed the portions are extremely small in the egusi and okra stew. I would go more often if their portion size for this was larger. I always see videos on TikTok of other places where the portions are práctica overflowing. But for $16 I expected a decent portion. Not just a measuring cup of stew. The photos of the lady who posted the "double portions" thats a single portion.

Me and my boyfriend had never tried Nigerian food and this was our first time experiencing it. And let’s just say we were NOT disappointed! Not only was the food amazing, walking away with full bellies,  but the lady working there was so sweet and accommodating.
10 out of 10 would eat here again. Would recommend to anybody having Nigerian food for the first time!
ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! Definitely the most delicious and memorable meal I’ve had in 2025–the melon soup was so good, I was  thinking about it all weekend lol! I can’t wait to come back and try more

formatted_address: 7346 S Alton Way #10g, Centennial, CO 80112, United States
name: Apple Spice Catering Co. Denver

reviews.text: Apple Spice was very easy to work with for a Celebration of Life. They were very patient with me asking a ton of questions and they did a menu tasting so we could try everything before we ordered. It was nice that they went above and beyond to do that. On the day of our event, the staff was wonderful in helping us set up the buffet tables and ensure everything was placed properly. All of our guests loved the food and wanted more sandwiches. We are very happy we went with Apple Spice and would use them again for an event in the future!

I chose Apple Spice for an event my company was hosting for about 75 people. The food was FANTASTIC, rave reviews from the attendees. They literally thought of everything. From ordering to delivery, the process was easy and efficient. Every member of their staff that I dealt with was professional and helpful. I will definitely be using them again for future events. Couldn’t be happier.

My company somewhat regularly uses them for catering company wide lunches. I’m sure they are great to work with but god is the food mediocre. The sandwiches are what you make in a rush between meetings and the salads sadly aren’t much better. This is a widely held belief around my office. Would not recommend.

I’m always impressed with Apple Spice boxed lunches. Everything was fresh and delicious. I appreciate having everyone’s name of the boxes to make the work lunch easy and organized. People are always excited to hear lunch is coming from Apple Spice! Thank you.

I placed an order for delivery of 15 executive box lunches for a client meeting. I inadvertently placed the order to be delivered to the wrong address. A mistake that I didn't catch until day of! I called Apple Spice at 8:00 am to let them know that I put the wrong delivery address on my order. They were absolutely 100% accommodating. I received my order at the right address on time. Our delivery person was Sierra. Sierra was hands down exceptional! Very friendly, polite and professional. She set up the box lunches with care and great organization. Everyone was very happy with the box lunches. It was like we were all opening little food presents! 😄 Food was amazing, fresh and packaged beautiful! Thanks Apple Spice! This was a great experience!

formatted_address: 5560 E 33rd Ave, Denver, CO 80207, United States
name: The Blazing Chicken Shack II

reviews.text: Visit here two times a month with my cousins. So, we love it here. Haven't had a bad meal yet. Not wild about the fried  chicken but everything else is fabulous.

Oxtail plate is the same price ($20+) as the Jamaican restaurants with half the servings. I have 2.5 oxtails on this plate and they’re not tender. I wouldn’t buy again. However, I’ve had their fried catfish in the past and when I say it’s good. It’s GOOD coming from a picky eater. THATS their specialty in my opinion. The sides are definitely decent for Denver and they’re a decent size, you’ll be full for sure. Cornbread is decent and they give a big cut. I will be coming back for sure just not for oxtails.

So going to start this off with saying how delicious the food here is.  Probably the best catfish I've had in like ever !.   The sides were also amazing.  I tried the red beans and rice and the collard greens.   Everything was delicious.  So here's the only thing I'd  say if you plan on visiting this place.  Make yourself extra, extra, extra time.   We walked in at 2:30 and did not get our meals till about 5:15pm.  We were fairly warned about the crazy wait time well in advance and we chose to stick it out.   We had no other plans and were not incredibly hungry at the time so we didn't mind waiting, if you're on a time crunch or just dont want to wait almost 3hrs to eat then skip this spot.   I feel like they prioritize their to go orders vs their dine in patrons.   Either way, Delicious  and in my opinion it was worth the wait.

We went to this establishment I found online and it does have soul food home cooking.
It tastes 👅 delicious and piping hot…it takes several minutes to get your food but why complain when it comes out to you it’s steamy hot and delicious 🤤
The staff is so friendly and helpful, the prices are great 👍🏾 and the atmosphere is cozy in Park Hill area. Love it💕
Some of the best gizzards and catfish I've found in Colorado since moving here 10 years ago. I'm excited to try the gumbo next!

formatted_address: Shop 6, 1 Dianthus Rd, Table View, Cape Town, 7441, South Africa
name: Temi's Foods And Catering

reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of dining at Temi’s Kitchen, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience! From the moment I walked in, the warm ambiance and friendly service made me feel right at home.

Now let’s talk about the food, absolutely delicious! Every dish was clearly made with love, care, and authentic flavors. The ingredients were fresh, the seasoning was spot on, and the portions were generous. Whether you’re craving local favorites or something more unique, Temi’s Kitchen delivers both quality and taste in every bite.

The jollof rice? Perfectly cooked with just the right amount of spice. The grilled chicken? Tender and flavorful. And don’t get me started on the soups  rich, hearty, and full of depth.

TEMI’s kitchen is a restaurant you won’t regret visiting. I can’t stop craving  their fried goat meat. Well seasoned and spicy.
If you are looking to visit An Authentic Nigerian restaurant in Tableview Capetown , I will recommend TEMI’s.
The best place u can have correct Nigerian food they are 100% good 👌
Wow it an amazing food. Reallylove the food will come back again
The best Nigeria restaurant in Cape Town , the food is always fresh and sweet

formatted_address: 119 N Robinson Ave, Oklahoma City, OK 73102, United States
name: Plus254 - A Taste of Africa

reviews.text: I had chicken pilou with spinach and the masala fries and samosa. It was good!! The samosas were crispy on the outside and perfectly flavored throughout. Check them out when you see them.

I didn't eat at the physical location, but their food truck came to OU's campus. I got the jollof rice with chicken and plantains - they gave me a complimentary samosa too! Everything tasted amazinggg, and the workers were so friendly. The samosa especially had the perfect texture. I can't wait until they come back to OU's campus, and I'm making plans to go to the OKC location soon.
Excellent! We will be back, don't miss out! We had the Chapati chicken and spinach, Also the Suya seasoned beef and grilled plantains.
Amazing. I got the pilau chicken with spinach. They gave me two free samosas! Delicious, large portions for $12.

Firs time trying south African food. I worked close to the building but never know this restaurant replace the other Greek restaurant. I tried pilau chicken and the lady is so friendly gave me samosa to try. It was delicious. Food is good portion too I will definitely go back and try other food too.

formatted_address: 7325 St Andrews Church Rd, Louisville, KY 40214, United States
name: African Best Restaurant

reviews.text: I had been wanting to try fufu for a while now. I got the egusi and fufu as well as the meat pies. They were all delicious and wonderful.  I was so happy with my meal. I will definitely take my friends there.  The egusi was savory with a kick and the soft chewy fufu paired really well.

I've been wanting to try African food especially fufu for a while now. I decided to check this place out and oh my GOD it was some of the most delicious food I have ever tasted in my life. The egusi soup was full of spices and so flavorful. The meat pie was perfect. I loved it all! Thank you!

I just ordered the Jollof Rice and Jerk Chicken meal. It’s not like Jamaican Jerk Chicken but it is sooo good. I also got a meat pie. I was told it’s like a Jamaican Beef Patty but it had a different thickness to it that I wasn’t used to so I was a little taken aback on that one. For my drink I bought a BB Cocktail de Fruits. I thought it was juice but it’s more like a fruit soda. I like it. When I called to order my food I was told that they no longer had regular size plates. Only large. At first I was going to change my mind but decided to just split it with someone instead. I’m glad I did. I will definitely return and recommend this place to my friends.

What a hidden gem! I am shocked this place does not have more reviews. When we went (around 6pm, on Saturday), the dining room was fairly empty, but customers did pop in for their food pick up.

I think everyone should know about this place. It is amazing. My husband and I had never had African food, so we weren’t sure what to order. He ended up getting the fried chicken, and I tried the (whole) fried fish. Both had crisp skin and were cooked to perfection. The rice was also absolutely yummy. And, while we waited, we were asked if we wanted meat pies. Those were golden with flaky crust and a soft meat and onion mixture. I recommend it all.

Great place, wonderful food, kind staff!

We enjoyed pur experience at Africa's Best! My husband and I tried attieke with red snapper fish and egusi soup with fufu. The service and atmosphere was so nice,  they were warm and inviting and have such warm spirits. We will definitely be back whenever in Louisville again!

formatted_address: Pretoria Central, Pretoria, 3100, South Africa
name: African Restaurant

formatted_address: 1141 Burnett St, Hatfield, Pretoria, 0083, South Africa
name: Africa Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text: Food becomes a bit boring after two days, I am staying for five.  The food is well prepared, and more than enough.  Some food from the buffet is used again (from lunch to dinner & dinner to breakfast next day) but it is still good.
Friendly staff, fairly accommodating. Food is average. Reasonably priced.
I ordered the beef burger, has to be one of the best burgers and hand cut chips(these were amazing!)I’ve tasted in Pretoria, kudos to the chef and friendly staff!!

This place was located in between the Ocean Basket and Roman’s Pizza along the Burnett Street of Hatfield, Pretoria. Their foods were delicious with very friendly and serviceable waiters.  I was particularly very impressed with the neatness that characterised the set up. Kudos!

Really bad service at the restaurant from the 12:30 lunch service team .  No warm welcoming.  I came from Cape Town, went straight to the restaurant and was starving. I asked three times for the menu. Twice from the same person, then once by another. We left the place hungry and had to go look for another restaurant as we received no service.

No one even came to ask what we will drink etc.

Disappointed, don't waste your energy or petrol driving there!

formatted_address: 10203 Two Notch Rd, Columbia, SC 29229, United States
name: Le Bambou Restaurant Africain

reviews.text: What a great experience! The West African food was delicious. I highly recommend trying the red snapper and the oxtail soup. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

I tried the special chicken this time and it did not disappoint!!! Came with hollow rice, green beans, and a half chicken with a homemade sauce cooked into it and plantains as well!!! Filling, flavorful, delicious & enough for two people!

Another time i tried the red snapper with plantain fufu and egosi soup. Safe to say im addicted! Literally my fav restaurant ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
I’m planning to return! I did a large take out order and the food was delicious and freshly made.  The restaurant was very clean. Next time I visit I’ll be eating there instead of ordering take out.

My first time trying West African cuisine and it was amazing! I got the spicy peanut soup w/chicken, yam fufu, and jollof rice. My partner got the spicy chicken shukuya. Everything was so flavorful! The owner was very nice and talked with us. Good prices as well.

Hands up and down this is the most flavorful, fulfilling, home cooked food I’ve had in this area since moving here seven years ago. I really enjoyed how knowledgeable the server was and the friendliness of the entire staff. I love its family owned and operated. I will definitely come back to try more dishes. Ohhhh and the hibiscus & pineapple juice is delicious. Lastly, the chefs menu, was a special plantain sorta puff with chopped onion and spices blended into a perfect round plantain puff loaded with sweet and spicy flavor.

formatted_address: 128a W Laurel St, Fort Collins, CO 80524, United States
name: Raska International Cuisine & Sauce

reviews.text: If you want delicious flavors and spices like you have never had before, flavors that have a party in your mouth and dance across your tongue, I could not recommend any restaurant higher than Raska! We drove up two and a half hours (one way) to visit our daughter and take her out to our favorite restaurant--Raska. And I would drive up two and a half hours right now just to eat there again. We ordered the plantains, the eggplants, the brussels and the mushrooms with a little side of the yams and the lentil stew--all served family style. (My favorite is the plantains) Everything delicious--although there was quite a debate about whether the traditional Raska sauce or the caramelized Raska sauce was better--both are so good! Oh and I am a total coffee snob, been roasting my own coffee beans for about 20 years, the Ethiopian Coffee is top notch!!

Cute atmosphere, lovely owner, great food. Had sweet yams and doro wot. Each was about $20, but the portions were SO generous. We were some of the last people of the night and both the owner and host stopped by the table to offer food/drinks while we wait and apologize for the wait.  Very celiac/GF-friendly. Love this place!

This is probably the best food I have experienced in Fort Collins!! The menu is largely vegan and gluten free, and every dish is packed with flavor, and big portions! The raska sauce is to die for. Please come here and try this food. You get to eat communal style, and use the spongey flatbread called injera to scoop up and eat all of the yummy dishes. They also source their veggies from local farms! I highly recommend the Doro Wot (chicken) and Misir Wot (lentils- vegan!!). The owner and chef Hanna is the kindest woman I have ever met. She makes you feel like you've entered her home as a welcome guest, and the whole experience is cozy and filled with comfort. Go support these amazing people!!!

This is a great little restaurant offering Ethiopian cuisine. It is fairly close to downtown area, but you could easily miss it unless you are looking.
