The restaurant itself was very cozy, authentic decor, and I enjoyed being able to have our own private area to enjoy our food.

formatted_address: 6989 Hayden Rd Ste A12, Scottsdale, AZ 85250, United States
name: Authentic EthioAfrican Kitchen & Bar

reviews.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant was truly amazing, and I absolutely loved the decorations—they were beautiful and created such a warm vibe. The food was delicious and served in generous portions, which I really appreciated. On top of that, everyone there was incredibly friendly and polite, making the whole experience even better.

Went as part of a large group. Everything was fantastic. I’ve never had Ethiopian food before and this was a perfect introduction. We enjoyed the food so much we forgot to take photos after the first few trays, but the hot wings and both lamb dishes we sampled were a standout! Everyone was friendly and attentive. The cocktails were also really good- the Ethiochelada is a must-try!
Delicious and reasonably priced Ethiopian food.  The inside as one of the most pleasant dining experiences I've had with mellow music,  extremely clean and well decorated.

This is a wonderful little spot in Scottsdale, all of the food was very authentic and came out perfectly. The enjura was lovely. Expect a little bit of a wait with service as both times we went it was one waitress managing the front and bar service, but she was quick to sort things out and very nice.

Some of the best Ethiopian food I have ever had!! Their chicken sambusas are perfect appetizers and I always bring home extra injera! Shiro Wat and Misir wat are my go to veggie dishes as well
as spicy chicken doro wat!
Ambience is authentic and appealing. An absolute best addition to Scottsdale dining! So glad they opened this second location close to home

formatted_address: 1221 E Van Buren St, Phoenix, AZ 85006, United States
name: Las Potencias Africanas

reviews.text: This is not a restaurant but the service and atmosphere are remarkable. I enjoyed every moment. Don Tomas is full of wisdom. He is direct and will not steer you in the wrong direction. I left feeling fulfilled and accomplished. Will definitely be back. Thank you ❤️
Definitely was on point both times I went. Had to send my friends. And affordable!!

formatted_address: 628 E Adams St, Phoenix, AZ 85004, United States
name: The Diaspora Collective

reviews.text:
I was very impressed when I approached the restaurant. Its a nice house with a huge patio and plenty of intimate outdoor seating. We sat inside and it was like walking into a friends home. The decor is very nice. I loved the hardword floors and the African decor.  They have a littlebgify shop that sells African clothibg for men, women, and children. They have soaps, coffee, nick nacks, jewelry and much more that you can purchase.
We started with cocktails. The old fashion and a nice spice to it. The mojito was very refreshing.  We had the hummus and bread; absolutely delicious. The burgers that we had melted in our mouths. They were grilled amd so was the bun. The bun had a light sweetness. We had a side salad of arugula with it. The owner stopped by our table to ensure that we were enjoying our experience, therefore, the customer service was great! We had a chance to speak with the chef before we left and he seems to love cooking up those good meals; which means he cooks with love. Thats important and appears to be the secret ingredient. We were told they have live carribean music on the patio on Saturday nights.
I can’t say enough about how great the food, staff and atmosphere here is! The food is amazing, made with fabulous quality ingredients; the whipped goat cheese was the best appetiser I’ve ever had!
This place has been an incredible surprise. Food is delicious and staff is incredible. We cannot recommend this restaurant more. Even our two picky kids loved EVERYTHING!!!

formatted_address: 4729 E McDowell Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85008, United States
name: Kare Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Great experience and delicious food here at Kare!
It was my first time here so I had the buffet which was a great way to try out different dishes that they serve. It was all excellent.
To top it off they offered coffee for free when my meal was done with incense and a great presentation.
Highly recommended if you're wanting Ethiopian cuisine with amazingly kind service and a very authentic atmosphere.

I'm a huge fan of Ethiopian food and have tried it everywhere I've lived in the US and abroad, when it's been available.  This place is so far my favorite in the Phoenix area!  We tried the vegetarian/vegan combo and foul, as well as the lentil sambusas.  Everything was incredible, service was very friendly and welcoming, and we loved the decoration and music.

Whether you love Ethiopian food and are craving shiro wot and zilzil tibs, or this is your first time, you owe it to yourself to try Kare!

The lady who served is was such an amazing soul. From preparing the food for us to telling us what everything was! She was so sweet and made sure we loved everything! And told us about the buffet they do as well! Definitely will be back!

My friends and I had such a wonderful time here tonight.  The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was great, and the food was delicious. We all enjoyed the coffee, meat and veggie combo and red wine tremendously. Absolutely recommend this establishment.

Kare has the best Ethiopian food in the valley hands down. I love how chill the atmosphere inside with Ethiopian customers chatting and watching Ethiopian music videos. First I ordered meat sambusas. They are super crispy and the filling is delicious. The sauce is very spicy but delicious. We got the meat & vegetable combo and it was delicious. I love meat but the veggies were super good. Finally I got the traditional Ethiopian coffee and that was so earthy and delicious. It comes with a burning frankincense you can smell while drinking the coffee. We hung out there for a while after dinner and had a few glasses of Ethiopian wine. They also sell spices and coffee products I feel like I must return and buy some Berbere spices.

formatted_address: 2920 N 54th Dr, Phoenix, AZ 85031, United States
name: Chima's kitchen and bar.

formatted_address: 3641 E Baseline Rd Suit Q102, Gilbert, AZ 85234, United States
name: Mercy's kitchen And Catering Services

reviews.text: Small and clean restaurant with delicious food. We tried the fufu with chicken soup, the jollof with beef, and the pounded yam with egusi soup and goat. Our favorite was definitely the fufu with chicken soup- so flavorful and delicious with the fufu soaking up all the spiced goodness. The staff were also very nice, but be prepared to wait a bit- we were the only table but our dishes took about 45 minutes. Would love to go again though and try some of their other dishes!
This family-owned restaurant didn’t disappoint—authentic flavors, clean space, and clearly loved by lots of regulars.

First time I came food was great and service was amazing. Today I cannot say the same. A big party came in about 15 20 minutes after me. I ordered a meat pie, egusi and okra. It took 30-45 minutes to get a meat pie. Some how the big table next to me got theirs right away. They brought the okra out and the other tables food. 20-25 minutes later still no Egusi. I kindly asked the young lady to remove it and bring me the bill. Out of thin air Egusi appeared. It was not what I asked for nor could the young lady tell me what meat was in my bowl. I kindly again asked her to remove it from my bill and the food from the table. Very disappointed. My son and I will have to go else where for food after waiting for an hour plus.

Absolutely fantastic. The atmosphere was cozy and clean. I ordered to go and the wait time wasn't too bad. Portion size is good for the money and wonderful. Perfectly cooked, spiced and just fantastic. We loved the Jollof with beef and the plantains are especially good. 100/10 will visit again.

Mercy’s Kitchen and Catering Services – A Hidden Gem for West African Cuisine in Arizona
If you’re craving authentic West African flavors, look no further than Mercy’s Kitchen and Catering Services—easily the best African food restaurant in all of Arizona. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm hospitality that makes you feel right at home. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, and the entire space is spotless, reflecting the care and pride they put into everything they do.
They offer a wide range of dishes to suit every craving—from spicy jollof rice and tender suya to rich, egusi soup and perfectly cooked plantains. Every meal is full of bold flavors, expertly prepared, and served in generous portions—all at very affordable prices.
Whether you’re a longtime lover of African food or trying it for the first time, Mercy’s Kitchen delivers a truly memorable experience. It’s not just a meal—it’s a cultural journey, served with heart. Highly recommended!

formatted_address: 4432 N 19th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85015, United States
name: First Cup | Ethiopian Restaurant & Cafe

reviews.text: We always come here because the food is delicious. We usually get the variety plate that comes with veggies and meat. So good! I also got the ginger hot tea, so simple but so tasty! Fair price, service is great and the place is very cozy.

I’ve been eating at First Cup Ethiopian Restaurant on and off for over five years, and every single time it’s been an incredible experience. The food is always of excellent quality—fresh, flavorful, and consistently prepared with care. That consistency is rare to find, and it’s one of the main reasons I keep coming back.
The service is outstanding. The team here greets me warmly every visit, and what touches me the most is the love and compassion they extend—welcoming me barefoot without judgment. That level of respect and kindness goes far beyond food; it’s a reflection of their beautiful spirit.
If you’re looking for a restaurant where the food is always top-notch, the service is heartfelt, and the atmosphere feels like home, this is the place.
Love and ((HUGS)),
Laura Foster
Founder, Souls Healing Humanity

Second time here, and I'll definitely be back. Excellent food and service. As I am not Ethiopian, I don't know much about the food or what is customary, but the Lady here was very nice and answered all the questions I had. I had a vegetarian plate, and I am not leaving hungry. Thank you First Cup.
We visited this restaurant for the first time today. The food was great and the people were kind. We would highly recommend this place!

A True Taste of Ethiopia in Arizona!

From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with the warm, welcoming hospitality that Ethiopian culture is known for. The restaurant’s atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, with traditional music and beautiful décor that instantly transports you to Addis Ababa.

The food was absolutely outstanding. The injera was soft, fresh, and perfectly tangy, and the variety of wot dishes was a flavorful journey—each stew rich in spices and depth. The doro wot was tender and savory, with just the right amount of heat, and the misir wot had that comforting, earthy taste that makes you want to keep eating long after you’re full. Vegetarians and meat lovers alike will find something to love here.

What truly sets this place apart is the care and authenticity in every bite. You can tell the recipes are made with love and passed down through generations. The coffee ceremony was a beautiful experience—not just a drink, but a cultural ritual, filling the air with the rich aroma of freshly roasted beans.

Whether you’re new to Ethiopian cuisine or a lifelong fan, this restaurant is a must-visit. It’s more than just a meal—it’s a cultural experience you’ll remember and want to share with friends and family.

formatted_address: 2935 E McDowell Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85008, United States
name: Al Rahma Restaurant

reviews.text: It’s been a great place to go. Food is so delicious people over there so kind. You need to come to this place and try the food from East Africa

Very Good Food ! My Family and I went there for the first time and We enjoyed Our experience!

Thank You to All The Staff!
Great food a nice hole in the wall i stumble upon price and good quality very nice service alittle rough on the edges but dont count it out till you try their food

Tried this place during our stay in Phoenix. The quality and portion size of food was top notch. The person serving us was very friendly and helped us with the details of Somali food that we were eating for the first time. When the food came out, it tasted just divine. Will visit again.

I love going to this place. The food is authentic and the staff are top notch friendly. They make you feel at home. The owner is always cracking jokes with all the customers. I am definitely going back again again. I recommend this place. They give you a lot of food too, I usually get take home bowl.

formatted_address: 849 W University Dr, Tempe, AZ 85281, United States
name: Cafe Lalibela Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text:
Been coming to this Ethiopian spot in Tempe for almost 10 years now and honestly, that’s the best part. The food hasn’t changed, the quality is still great, and that consistency is rare these days.

I love their food and especially the injera bread. Always fresh, soft, and perfect with the dishes. Everything tastes comforting and authentic, the kind of place you keep coming back to without even thinking twice.

Tried their house special coffee this time and it was excellent. Proper Ethiopian coffee, rich and smooth, and a great way to end the meal.

If you’re looking for solid Ethiopian food that’s been doing it right for years, I’d definitely recommend this place. One of those reliable, no-nonsense favorites that never disappoints.

Be cautious about mold on the bread.
Three baskets of bread that were brought to our table had visible mold. We informed the staff, but they did not apologize. They did remove the charge, which we appreciated.

We were told the bread was from overnight and that this was likely the reason for the mold. Serving overnight bread with mold can be unsafe, and this explanation was concerning. We were also told we could return another day to speak with the manager.

Aside from this issue, the platter itself was good. However, I would not return.

Cafe Laibela is an absolute gem for anyone craving authentic Ethiopian cuisine. From the moment you walk in, the warm and inviting atmosphere sets the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. The restaurant has a cozy, family-style feel with welcoming staff. The food is nothing short of amazing. Each dish is rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented on traditional bread. Whether you’re a longtime fan of Ethiopian food or trying it for the first time, Cafe Laibela delivers an unforgettable experience with both its cuisine and atmosphere.

The food was delicious!  My favorite is the Fasolia (green bean, tomatoes, and carrots).
We got the Vegan platter for 2. There were 3 of us and we were full with leftovers.
The service is not very friendly. The space was comfortable and very clean.

Been going to this place for years and recently visited again.  They serve a delicious cuisine of Ethiopian food. The dishes are flavorful,  abundant, and the quality is spectacular. You can get individual dishes or shareable dishes. They serve their dishes with injera which serves as your utensils and what you use to grab your food. It's so delicious 😋.  The atmosphere is very relaxed. The restaurant is very cozy and friendly.  The service was great and the staff is very attentive and courteous. The dishes were plentiful and extremely affordable.  You get a lot of food for the cost. I certainly recommend this place for the dishes,  ambience, friendly staff, and bang for your buck!

formatted_address: 5704 N 27th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85017, United States
name: Malik Market

reviews.text: I drove 27 minutes to come to this restaurant, but when I arrived, it was closed. It was really disappointing after driving that far. Please update your hours online so customers don’t have to waste their time.
Catering services specialized in East African and Middle Eastern food. Send all order inquiries VIA WhatsApp to number listed on webpage or call the line directly.
The food here is awesome. No complains about anything. Freshly home made. The owners of the place are very friendly and nice.
The Ric cooked maybe week ago it tastes no good I just leave the food and go

The surrounding area is very dilapidated and the place is like a hole in the wall.
But the food was amazing! A home cooked meal made by a mother and daughter team.
Highly recommend this place.
We had the goat and rice and the chicken and beef samosas, excellent.
The wait is long but worth every bite!

formatted_address: 3550 W Cactus Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85029, United States
name: Waw South Sudanese Cuisine

reviews.text:
What a lovely place
2 different restaurants share the space
You can order from either menu
Lovely lovely people and absolutely delicious food. Made my whole day a lot better. Highly recommend trying it out!
Soooo good and really friendly staff that makes you feel right at home. They also bring you extra bread throughout the meal and even brought us a plate of dates for dessert!

Just to clear it up if you are wondering where it is exactly it is inside of the Nigerian restaurant and there are two separate menus one for the South Sudanese and one for the Ethiopian. Me and the people I was with got some lentil soup, Sambusas;from the Sudanese menu,and Injira; from the Nigerian menu.  Which were both amazing.I especially love the atmosphere the people there were so sociable and nice they even gave us a little sample of the food before we ordered it. 11/10 really amazing people such a cool place seems really new and nice. they also serve non-alcoholic beer.
Tried out the sambusas and bean stew, both were very delicious and the hospitality was amazing! Definitely worth giving a try, I’ll be returning!

formatted_address: 1820 W Northern Ave Suite #110, Phoenix, AZ 85021, United States
name: Ms. Martha's Caribbean Kitchen

reviews.text: Saturday night visit. My party had the jerk chicken bowl as well as the oxtail bowl with rice and peas. The rice and peas are kidney beans and rice. Everything tasted well. The jerk sauce does not have a kick at all. It was quite bland as far as jerk sauce goes. The oxtails were very small but tasted great.  I also tried one of their housemade juices that was very good. The order taker was not hospitable but was much nicer when giving the food items. Indoor and outdoor seating available.

I had the pleasure of dining here after checking recommendations from Instagram. Let me tell you, IT DID NOT DISAPPOINT!  From the start, walked in the smell was amazing, the music inside, a mix of Trinidadian Soca, Reggae, and dancehall, made me feel like I was back in the West Indies visiting extended family.  Mom n Daughter ran the show flawlessly. What I thought would be a quick birthday lunch (Sept 13th) turned into a few hours of family and food! The curry goat was amazing.The spices, the seasoning, everything was on point. I got to try the oxtail eggs rolls, and they were absolutely amazing. Even the simple things like a beef patty and cocoa bread, hiit the spot like I couldn't imagine here in arizona. If you are looking for a true caribbean cuisine experience that will have you wanting more and keep coming back.This is the place! I cannot wait to get back here again! Turn up the soca!!!

Amazing, would recommend. Got the chicken curry bowl and oxtail plate and wow, the oxtail was DELICIOUS, the seasoning on it was so flavorful. The curry chicken bowl and plantains were just as delicious.

Service was great, it’s a massive must try for me.

I had the coco bread w/ beef patties, yellow rice, oxtails, curry goat & plantains. The food was excellent!!!!!!! The service was excellent!!!! My cousins who were visiting from Chicago & my daughter all enjoyed their food. We couldn't wait to eat our leftovers. My daughter & I will definitely be visiting very soon.

The host was so nice and welcoming  and very everyone and letting each and everyone one of us when our food would be coming out. Because they try to bring the whole party plates out about the same time.  I thought that was nice so everyone could eat together.  And the food is cooked fresh. The taste and smell of  the food was off the chain. Iwas very  impressed.  I will be back and will pass the word on to my friends!

formatted_address: 16816 N Cave Creek Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85032, United States
name: Topnotch Island Flavor Kitchen

reviews.text: Thursday evening, pickup order. The order was estimated to be ready in 20 minutes, it was ready in 10 minutes. The items were kept in a hot box so everything was still warm upon my arrival. The jerk chicken kabobs were spicy. I enjoy spicy things but the kabobs were nearly so spicy I couldn't enjoy them. The plantains were very good but overpriced, $3.50 for four pieces of a plantain. I would try other things on the menu.

I live in Central Phoenix, but I am willing to drive past all of the Jamaican restaurants in the area to get to Topnotch Island Flavor!

This was my first visit, and I ordered the beef patty, oxtails, cabbage, and rice and peas. Everything was finger, licking, good!!! The crust on the beef patty was light and flakey. The oxtails were delicious. The menu doesn't show that they are spicy, but they do have a bit of a kick to them. They aren't spicy, but they are well-seasoned. The cabbage was so good. I loved every bite. Everything was great, but the rice was excellent. The rice was moist and fluffy. The rice added to the meal it did not detract.

I had my mouth set on oxtails, but I would like to go back for some of the other items on the menu. They even have a lunch menu which offered reasonably priced items for lunch.

Can't wait to go back!

We ordered delivery and were SO impressed with the food! Portions were generous, it was very hot and fresh once it got to us. The jerk chicken was perfectly spicy and soooo good, the skin was so flavorful and the meat was tender and fell off the bone. The oxtail meal was very flavorful and rich, like a slow cooked stew meat. The slaw was slightly sweet/tangy and refreshing, the coconut rice was also slightly sweet so they went well together. The fried plantains were AWESOME! This was our first time trying any Jamaican food and we were blown away, will definitely go again!
Happy new year! Happy new year! I had an absolute ball there! I miss you guys already! I had fun prancing around in my black boots! You guys are so adorable, like little teddy bears!

Had lunch on Friday, the young man at the entrance ignored us for the first few minutes while on his phone, but then gestured for us to find a place to sit, he definitely did not want to be there lol. A lady came out and with a smile said she would be there shortly to take our order. The menu had changed from what we saw by recent pictures online and google reviews, but we had driven from Tucson and there was plenty we could choose from otherwise.
We had the beef patty, it wasn’t piping hot but flavor was ok. The escovitch whole fish was good, as was the ackee and saltfish although it could use some scotch bonnet. Their curry goat is delicious, rich and a huge portion. Their rice and peas wasn’t the greatest and they were out of ground provisions, the lady said it’s just used as a menu description for the ackee and saltfish, but it would have been nice to have some.
We have been to 5 different “Jamaican” restaurants in Phoenix in 2 years and Topnotch is the best we’ve had so far and we will probably be back knowing we have to drive over 2 hours from Tucson. Sorry I ate some of the ackee before I took the pics

formatted_address: 4734 W Glendale Ave, Glendale, AZ 85301, United States
name: New Africa kitchen llc

formatted_address: 10802 N 43rd Ave Ste 1, Glendale, AZ 85304, United States
name: Calabash Lounge

reviews.text: This is  one of my favorite  places to come. Very clean place. Good amount of seating.  Music is hands  down the best in the Valley. Oh yeah lets not forget about the food. I am a hot wing snob, they  by far  have the best wings in town. I love this place!
Good spot to be at if you in phoenix, very clean, music is good, seats are clean and they have some food.

formatted_address: 933 E University Dr #112, Tempe, AZ 85288, United States
name: Ethiopian Famous Restaurant

reviews.text:
Had the meat combo for two. It was delicious! It was my friend’s first time having Ethiopian and he enjoyed it. All of the dishes in the combo were warm and tasty. Woman serving us was friendly and checked multiple times to see if we needed anything.

I am glad I chose to check this place out tonight and left feeling stuffed and content. Would go back again.

The google address points towards a hookah lounge, but it’s actually the next business over in the far corner.

This Ethiopian restaurant is a delight! The menu has a great selection, with vegan and non-veg platters that can easily feed 3-4 people. The injera is incredibly soft and light, alongside the flavorful dishes perfectly. The interiors are neat and beautifully designed, creating a warm ambiance. It’s a fantastic spot to explore Ethiopian cuisine, with excellent hospitality and service. The fresh, pulpy mango juice is a standout! Ample indoor seating and plentiful outdoor parking make it a convenient and inviting dining experience. Highly recommend!

First time visited this place and the foods are severed very quick and tasty. New experience and new taste and really liked it. Baklava dessert is delicious and it’s must try dishes. They have separate place for your traditional photo shoot which is awesome and cool.

Definitely a must try. If you’re Ethiopian you’ll feel right at home. Real authentic taste, and using all the Ethiopian ways of making the food, with real passion. Second time here and will be here whenever I’m in the area. 5⭐️ try the meat/veggie combo 👌🏾
Hole in the wall eatery. Only those who know about it are usual diners because the service is absolutely slow. The food is delicious. Disappointed they don't serve water for free.

formatted_address: behind grace walk church, 7840 W Lower Buckeye Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85043, United States
name: El New Yorican - Puerto Rican Food Truck

html_attributions: El New Yorican - Puerto Rican Food Truck

reviews.text: I recently placed a catering order with El New Yorican Puerto Rican food truck and everything was absolutely on point. The yellow rice was flavorful and perfectly cooked the pernil Was tender juicy in season just right and the pasteles were incredible. They were rich, authentic and clearly made with care. You can tell solo puts pride into his food. The flavors felt like home, and the quality was consistent across the entire order my guest love it and I have people asking where the food came from. If you’re looking for real good puerto rican food whether it’s a plate or catering I highly recommend

We got lunch here. The flavor was on point!! The portions were super big and the prices were the most reasonable we have seen from any of the food trucks in Phoenix that serve Puerto Rican food. The owner served us and made us feel like we had known him even though we just met him. Absolutely recommended!!!! Wepa!

Yo this spot was on point.  I was in town for a baseball tournament that my son was in and on our way out we stopped at El New Yorican!  He treated us with hospitality which I really appreciate it! If you guys are in town you need to roll through!!

I ordered half the menu and everything was on point. My first generation Puerto Rican mom came to visit and she was blown away. It reminded me of my grandmother and her cooking, almost brought a tear to my eye. Alberto is the man and treated my mom like it was his family. Cannot wait to go back.

We had El New Yorican cater our baby shower appetizers and it was amazing. We had Rellenas de Papa and Empanadas and they were so delicious. Our guests enjoyed the unique flavors of the empanadas, which were full of meat and also had some cheese inside! Yum! Everyone loves Papas, so those of course went so fast. Its basically a potato ball with meat inside. Very delicious. We had about 65 people and every one of our guests was very very satisfied. If your looking for someone to cater an event or party with some nice Latin Caribbean flavor, look no further than the best Puerto Rican Food Truck in the Valley, El New Yorican!

formatted_address: 4371 W Bell Rd, Glendale, AZ 85308, United States
name: Monae Fusion Brunch Café

reviews.text:
Our out of town guest picked this restaurant, and it ended up being such a sweet surprise. The food was absolutely delicious. The attention to detail was phenomenal. Every dish was beautifully presented, even if my photos don’t quite do it justice.

Service was great, a little slow at times, but genuinely thoughtful. You can tell they care about creating a high quality experience and making sure you are well taken care of.

From the smoothies to breakfast to lunch, everything we tried was superb. The menu is unique, fresh, and full of flavor. Highly recommend stopping in and checking this spot out.

It is located in a strip mall in a mid neighborhood, but do not let that deter you. This place is an absolute gem.

From the moment we walked into Monae Fusion the atmosphere struck the perfect balance between welcoming to refined. The service was attentive, friendly, and genuinely invested in making the experience memorable.

The menu offered a great mix of comfort and creativity. The food was simply outstanding. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. You can tell the ingredients are fresh and handle with care.

Each bite felt intentional from the seasoning to the textures and plating. Nothing wax overdone, anx Nothing felt like an afterthought. The flavors were well-balanced and layered showing real culinary skill rather than gimmicks, and the portions were generous without being overwhelming.

What truly sets this place apart is consistency,  excellent food, great service, and an atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just enjoying a night out this restaurant delivers on every level.

The owner, stopped at our table, thanked us for coming and was very personable. You can tell that she is filled with the Holy Spirit and that God's grace and favor is definitely on her life.

We higjly recommend Monae Fusion to everyone, because we will absolutely be back.

Perry and Renee

I’ve been to Monae Fusion multiple times, and every visit reminds me why I keep coming back. The food is absolutely incredible  from the fresh sandwiches and flavorful tacos to the creative fusion dishes, everything is made with love. My personal favorite will always be the smoothies they’re so fresh and refreshing!
Beyond the food, the atmosphere is amazing. The scenery and decorations make you feel welcomed and relaxed, and there’s a warm, uplifting vibe the moment you walk in. I also love that it’s a Christian-based restaurant you can truly feel the peace, positivity, and kindness in the air. Monae Fusion isn’t just a place to eat, it’s a place to enjoy good food and a beautiful environment. Highly recommend!

One of a kind gourmet restaurant! The food is beyond delicious and almost too pretty to eat. The owner is the cook and she visits with her patrons when she is not busy preparing their meals.  Super comfy chairs.   It is tucked away deep in the corner of the Frys parking lot you've really got to look for the entrance.

My husband and I decided to try Monae for the first time today. The atmosphere is comfortable and there is a laid back vibe. Several of the items we had hoped to try weren’t available, mostly the items we wished to try as a part of the African fusion part. I ordered the Saumon fume toast and my husband had the Golden Topper sandwich. My toast was absolutely delicious. My husband’s sandwich was ok. The chicken was overcooked and it had no spice even though the menu indicated it was spicy. The potatoes were also bland. If the server had come around while they were warm, we would have asked for salt. The server indicated that it was just him so we understood why the service was really slow. We tried the peanut butter chocolate coffee and the brown sugar oat. The brown sugar oat was very good. If we came back, I’d call first to see if they had the items we wanted to try since so many items on the menu were unavailable.

formatted_address: 2350 W Northern Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85021, United States
name: Hana's House Restaurant Middle Eastern Cuisine

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had an amazing experience at Hana’s! We got the family dinner with skewers of kebabs and kefta — everything was absolutely delicious. The meat was juicy, tender, and full of flavor. You can really tell they use quality ingredients and put care into their cooking.

The service was great too — very friendly and attentive. Even with the construction going on outside, the food and experience were still top-notch.

I saw a bad review from someone named Calvin before coming in, and honestly, it couldn’t be further from the truth. After trying it myself, I can say that Hana’s definitely deserves a 5-star rating.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food and awesome service!

Do not let the exterior put you off! This was an incredible dining experience. The restaurant was dead when I came in with the exception of some online orders but the host greeted me warmly, didn’t hover despite it really just being me, gave me good advice with my Arabic coffee (which was delicious), there was a small salad while I waited, the food was hot, came out fairly quickly and everything was as a flavor explosion. The portions were also large enough that I had to take some home, which is never a complaint for me!

I will be back for sure. This is truly what the term “diamond on the rough” is used for. Thank you!

Just happen to be driving by on our way to Sedona and stopped at this GEM!!
Wow 👌 👏 😍  the flavors the portions and quality of the food was top notch!!  Everything was nicely seasoned and flavored.  And the service was once again, unmatched.  I happen to mention that my birthday was yesterday but that we had suffered an accident which prevented us from leaving for our trip.  And as we were on way we got the food to go.. well they packaged and included a nice little treat to go, a Baklava with a note that read happy birthday, free of charge!!
And then we decided to have a bite to eat before hitting the road, so as we sat there, he came back to check on us and brought us 2 water bottles, again free of charge!!  Talk about going above and beyond for a customer!! 💪💪💪🥰🙏🙏🙏😊🙋‍♂️
Will definitely be coming back and here and spread the word about this nice restaurant and the amazing food they serve!!  Thank you so much for making our day!!

🤩🤩wowww soo delicious here 🤩😋 all the meat was soft and flavorful . The mint lemonade was sooo good , they blended it up fresh so there was pieces of mint and chunks of lemon in there and it almost tasted basily 🤩❤️ The chicken shawarma with hummus was just like everybody said so mouth watering 😋❤️ the hostess/ server was great , he was friendly and polite. The place is clean, open and bright. We did get confused at the end because you pay at the front door , you don't have to wait for the check 🤭. Thank you for having a delicious family restaurant that we can come to again and again ❤️❤️🥰

Not sure what all these 5 star reviews are about. Been having this place bookmarked for some time and finally had the opportunity to drive out to give it a try.

It was 6pm on a Thursday and the place was empty inside. Thought this was a good sign because it means the food will be extremely fresh. However this was not the case - I’m not sure if it was an off day but the food we received was extremely disappointing.

We each ordered the Hana Special Mix which came with a beef kefta, chicken kefta, chicken tikka and beef tikka. The only good thing on that place was the beef kefta… everything else was insanely dry and borderline inedible.The meat did not taste like it was freshly made and tasted warmed up. There was zero char on the meat and the meat had that old mushy texture like it was sitting out all day and was reheated before serving.

Best thing about the place was the beef kefta, rice and sides. $28 for this sad plate left us extremely disappointed.

With the abundance of other middle eastern restaurants in the valley, I would not recommend going to Hana House due to the lack of quality, not to mention the portion sizes.

Did I mentioned they have a 3% credit card surcharge as well?

formatted_address: 2935 W Van Buren St, Phoenix, AZ 85009, United States
name: Golosinas Viruya

reviews.text: The food was okay. There were no menues beside the one scrible on a board, but with no prices. The ladies were not that friendly but okay service.  The prices were reasonable.

First experience — it was busy when we walked up, we still got extremely fast service. We ordered 2 plates; chicken flautas & fried chicken with bananas, and drank aguas frescas. The food was amazing!! I could eat it ALL DAY. Their sauce used is delicious. All together, everything tasted fantastic and I will be returning. The owner was there too, she was telling us how they’ve only been here 1.5 years but get so busy. Amazing!! Definitely head over here when you can.

Awesome food truck at the SW corner of 29th Drive and Van Buren. Easy to miss if you've never been here. Exactly next to a tire shop.

Lived in Honduras decades ago. Great service, food!

Nice cozy place, beautiful outdoor dining, amazing food. I had the Pollo con tajadas (chicken and friend plantains) and it was delicious. The portion was pretty big, enough to share. My mom also tried the baleadas and she loved them.
Excellent food and prices. Best authentic honduran cuisine in town. Baleadas are fantastic!

formatted_address: 7102 N 43rd Ave, Glendale, AZ 85301, United States
name: SOLMATA AFRICAN RESTAURANT OPENING SOON

reviews.text: This place could not be found. All directions led to a residential neighborhood with no sign of the restaurant.
They do not exist.

formatted_address: 11111 N 7th St, Phoenix, AZ 85020, United States
name: Different Pointe of View

reviews.text:
The best view and dinner!

It is a bit out of the way if you’re not staying close by but it’s worth the drive. The view is breathtaking and you can watch the sunset while you dine.

The only critique I have is the service could have been more personable. Normally they will ask if you’re celebrating anything etc.the service was great other than that.

The appetizers were large portions, I ordered two and I was full. The beef tartare was great!

The star of the show was definitely the dessert! We got the pumpkin mousse.

I would highly recommend going even just for a drink and appetizers in their terrace room!

What a fantastic experience! My partner and I came for a nice dinner and was blown away by the views. I will say upfront that I think this place is great for a few cocktail and an app to watch the sunset. I felt the service and ambiance inside where you eat dinner to be lacking. The food was great! The steak was huge and perfectly seasoned, the chicken was so juicy and the free bread was the cherry on-top. I’m sure we’ll be back!

We've had experience at many 4,5 star restaurants and different states and countries and by far this was an absolute amazing experience. The service, and the food was amazing.. and the drinks were chefs kiss. One comment is about the parking it is a little bit of a walk unless you schedule for the golf cart to bring you to the front door. All in all had a great experience and will definitely be back the next time I'm in Phoenix.

Great drinks and some of the nicest views around. Arrive just before sunset to experience how the atmosphere changes as daylight fades. There’s plenty of outdoor seating, and every spot offers a different perspective to enjoy. A perfect place to relax, sip, and take in the scenery.

We chose DPV for our anniversary celebration and it turned out to be a wonderful experience. Watching the sunset from that height was absolutely stunning and made the evening feel very special. The staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive throughout our visit. The ambiance added a perfect touch and made the whole experience even more memorable. Truly a great place for a special occasion.

formatted_address: 5114 N 7th St Suite 1, Phoenix, AZ 85014, United States
name: HULA'S Modern Tiki Uptown

reviews.text: This place is honestly such a hidden gem and really underrated! I had one of the best meals I’ve ever had in Phoenix here. The Hawaiian jerk chicken was bursting with flavor and tasted like absolute heaven, while the fries were perfectly crispy and seasoned just right. The atmosphere was another highlight—it felt cozy, pretty, and calming, which made the whole dining experience even better. The staff were also friendly and welcoming, which added to the good vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back soon and recommending it to my friends.
The food and service were fantastic.  Drinks were delicious.  Perfect place to meet your people.

Went here after work with some coworkers,  it was Wednesday,  so happy hour prices until 10pm. Mocktails and cocktails were the same price so why not try some fun concoction. I had a Dr.Funk drink, it was amazing,  also tried the bites, yum. Definitely will be back to try some other fruity drink!

Food was very tasty, but I would have liked more.   They worked well at making it a themed restaurant, including the bathrooms.  There was plenty of food choices, and recommend a visit just for the experience.

Ordered 2 drinks both were pineapple n orange based little on sweeter side but at the bottom felt good during happy hour, in food ordered sweet potato fries with dips which was yummy and main course went with jerk chicken which so so yum

formatted_address: 4904 N 19th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85015, United States
name: El Metro

reviews.text: Customer service is always amazing! The food is made fresh and taste great 👍  it’s also a market I find all my favorite items from back home here at this location it’s a great place to stop to grab some groceries and have a meal on your way out!
Excellent service and delicious meals & Very clean area😍😍😍
5 star food. That all I can say. Great friendly staff
Great service. Delicious and fresh food. Highly recommend this place. The owner was very nice and friendly.
Authentic, fresh and delicious. Recommend! 👍🏽👍🏽

formatted_address: 3527 W Bethany Home Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85019, United States
name: Adidas Ababa

formatted_address: 2827 E Bell Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85032, United States
name: The BelAir BAR & GRILL

reviews.text: Loved the food here, I’ve had Rwandan/Ugandan food a lot and this was highly up there. Nice to have some in AZ now. I recommend the chapati with beans.
Awesome! We loved every piece of food on the plates! Great seasoning on it all. Nice experience all around. Parking is mostly in the back FYI. Open late!
When I tell you, grab all your friends family penpals and enjoy this cozy warm African space, the servings are not of this world m

Another new place to try. FYI parking is at the back.
This place is clean. African atmosphere. They have Kenyan DJ good to see African supporting each other. Music on point.
The food is very good goat meat tender. The food is well represented.
The only thing be ready to wait. I waited for 2hrs for one person. I guess is the server could keep checking on customers mingt help.
Upstairs was the best. And the owner is the best and it's a new place they are doing the best to keep moving.
Thank you will be back soon.

Note:
it's African food which means it takes longer to make and keep the flavor. The food is worth waiting.

This place is more of a night club than anything and NOT at all what this neighborhood wants or needs. They think it's appropriate to play music so.loud it wakes our family including my child up all hours of the night. It's rude to the community and I would love to see their permit that allows this. As we have other businesses we had to sign off that we approve music up to 10pm because they are so.close.to.houses. Heaven for bid you dial their number as No one ever answers.

formatted_address: 2350 E School Dr, Phoenix, AZ 85040, United States
name: All About Food AZ-cafe eden

reviews.text: Black-owned, Comfort Food is good and seasoned. Good sides as well. Try their side salad(Only have ranch dressing to offer). Cooked-per-order, possible 20min or less wait but worth it. 8 pcs Chicken wings off the hook as well. Get there early.

This was my second time here!! And when I tell you the food was amazing!! Got the fried shrimp... The first time my order was wrong and they had no problem with fixing my order the second time. And I was satisfied both times!! Grilled and fried shrimp. The women in the kitchen was so sweet!!! I will definitely be back! And the spaghetti so fireeee!!!

The best fried chicken wings in Phoenix!  I do not know what they season that chicken with… whatever it is… it’s amazing!  I drive a long way to pick them up.  Keep it up ladies!

I also like to sit at the bar and have a drink while I wait!

Awwwww Man, Where do I Start. I Ordered the CHICKEN (6 Wings)  & FISH (CatFish)  Dinner w/ Green Bean Fries & Mac & Cheese 👏🏿👏🏿👏🏿👏🏿 I AM DEFINITELYm COMING BACK 😁😁🔥🔥

Love From Coach Judah 🏹🏹💪🏿💪🏿
O we play pool have drinks and get food  here  also dancing just pure fun and enjoyment

formatted_address: 3920 W Charleston Blvd # A, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: Le Bon Goût Chez Fa

reviews.text: I’m writing this review as I still sit in the restaurant. This place was absolutely amazing. Everything was so delicious. I came with my family and everyone was absolutely delighted. We tried red snapper, yassa tofu, yassa yap, fataya, nem, oxtail soup, and fried plantains. Please try them so you can be delighted like we were. The empty dishes just prove how delicious everything was, lol!

Had a delicious Senagalese meal and experience with friends here. Mr. Mohammed & Chef Fa were so welcoming and kind. They offered us 6-7 samples of the different drinks available. I loved the Ginger Juice & Ditakh the most. All the drinks were sweet and refreshing. We also had these stuffed Fish Empanadas/Fataya, Yassa Yap w/ Jollof Rice, sweet plantain, oxtail stew, & fufu which were all so good with and without their spicy sauces. We ordered more Fataya to go because they were bomb. Will definitely be back for the food, good music, & vibes.

First time having African food. It was amazing. The flavors were intense. It's a family-run business. The nephew who waited on us was very sweet and helped us through the menu and gave us some options that we absolutely loved. He told us about the oxtail which was amazing. The beef dish I had was delicious. The plantains were thick and sweet but not too sweet.  The food takes a while to make as it is made by order. It was definitely worth the wait. I will be back again and I highly recommend this restaurant.

The food is crazy! The best red snapper in the world! Auntie Fa is sooooooooo nice, we tried the oxtail and fufu and red snapper with jollof rice and it was crazy. The jollof rice had a perfect spice and the fufu texture was next level. The food takes a long time to get because the family works hard in the restaurant, it’s an amazing restaurant. Deserves a Michelin, actually THREE Michelin stars

Wanted to try something different, and authentic. Saw a highly recommended review on Instagram so i decided to give it a try.  Food was amazingly flavorful, and savory.  Love how they let you sample the drinks if you not familiar with them. Had the signature Red Snapper w/rice, and salad. The fish was slightly overcooked on the outside but the inside was delicious. Presentation was awesome with the Africa shaped dished. Looking forward to going back and try the oxtail soup.

formatted_address: 3385 S Decatur Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: Taste of Africas

reviews.text: South Asian trying African dishes for the first time and I have to say, the food is absolutely delicious, flavorful, and served hot. Ordered red snapper platter, fufu, and hibiscus juice. The portion were gpod for family of two adults and a 6-year-old. Everything about the food was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. They also have an African market next to the restaurant with clothing and artwork that makes you feel like you’re getting a glimpse of their home country

The lady’s and gentleman in charge of the restaurant were very welcoming and kind individuals who made my first time trying authentic African food the most amazing experience I could ever have! The food itself is truly phenomenal and delicious! LOVE THIS PLACE AND WILL BE COMING BACK 👍

I appreciated the friendly service when I ordered delivery. However, the “jollof” was very rubbery and difficult to eat, although the fish was good. Unfortunately, this experience means I won’t be returning.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Exceptional Service, Flavor, and Hospitality

I hosted a private group dining experience here on very short notice, and this restaurant absolutely delivered. From the moment I reached out, they were responsive, flexible, and incredibly accommodating, even reserving the entire space for our group of nearly 20.

The staff prepared a hot West African buffet exactly as requested — everything from spinach and stews to a full range of proteins. The food was flavorful, well-seasoned, and authentically done, and my group couldn’t stop raving about it. The house-made drinks — ginger, hibiscus, tropical— were powerful, refreshing. The egusi, pounded yam, was a hit amongst the Nigerian crowd.

The Afrobeats playlist and ambiance was ON POINT: lively enough to set the mood but soft enough for real conversation. The owner went above and beyond, even helping us capture photos of the group and making sure everyone felt welcomed.

People left full, happy, and satisfied- especially those trying West African cuisine for the first time. This restaurant truly helped create the exact experience I envisioned.

If you’re hosting a group event, cultural gathering, or just want genuinely good African food in Vegas, I highly recommend this place. Great food, great service, great people and they executed with speed, heart, and accomodating service.

I had such a wonderful experience here! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me warmly and made me feel welcome. The service was quick, attentive, and genuinely friendly throughout my entire visit.

The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted like it was made with care and attention to detail. My favorite part was how well-balanced everything was, both in taste and portion size.

Overall, this place exceeded my expectations. Great food, excellent service, and a welcoming atmosphere—I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends and family!

formatted_address: 953 E Sahara Ave E-22, Las Vegas, NV 89104, United States
name: Nigerian Food

reviews.text: Amazing Nigerian food, and if you haven't had it before she will help guide you.  Get off the Strip and come eat fantastic food!  Call ahead if you're in a hurry, all food is made fresh.  Homemade style.

First time trying fufu and egusi soup. Got level 3 I believe and it was tasty although next time I'd go higher. Service was nice and the restaurant was cozy and I really liked the dish a lot.

It's also in a neat little area with a great view of the strip once you walk out.

Food was magically delicious!! If you want authentic Nigerian cuisine, then lol no further. Whenever I travel I always look for a Nigerian restaurant to try and besides me going to Nigeria last year, this is as fresh and authentic as it gets. With it being made fresh, it will take more time to
Prepare but it’s worth it and very professional

I won't say I'm the best person to review Nigerian food. This is only the second place I've had Nigerian food and the other was in California. The food was tasty to me but very pricey therefore I don'tknow if I'll be able to eat it often. I liked the egusi though level 3 was not spicy enough for me. My husband got the jollof rice with mixed meat which he said was a bit tough and the rice a bit too wet. The flavor was good though. The staff was friendly and the decor could be updated a bit but I don't mind those things as much as food.

I had a truly disappointing experience with the owner’s service. Her rudeness and lack of basic customer service skills were shocking. After we were told to expect a 55-minute wait, we were informed via text over an hour later that our food was ready. The kicker? She expected us to arrive in just 2 minutes, despite it being already 7:55 PM!

When we explained that our Uber was on the way, she had the audacity to question why she should wait for us. Seriously? She claimed to be a pharmacy, but that doesn’t excuse her unprofessional behavior. To top it all off, her own business hours on Google clearly state that they close at 9:00 PM!

This experience was not just frustrating; it was infuriating. Customer service should be a priority, and this encounter proved otherwise. I won’t be returning.

formatted_address: 5006 S Maryland Pkwy Suit 11, Las Vegas, NV 89119, United States
name: Nigerian Cuisine by MJ

reviews.text: Ohhh, it was actually terrible. Why would you specify that a plate of food can serve two people (grown adults, I suppose) and it’s just 2 spoons of rice? For $50! Talk about the wait time for delivery!! So upsetting. I wouldn’t recommend it.
Horrible Nigerian food experience in Las Vegas!!! We paid over $80 for the meals we order and waited over an hour before food arrives. No meat on the food!!! Do not waste your money at this place.

This is the worst nigerian food I have ever ordered. First of all the food cost $250 for only 4 plates of food, plus $25 for tax and $20 for delivery. The food took almost 3 hours to be delivered and then when the food finally arrived, every single item was terrible. Even the plantain tasted so bad. How can anyone mess up fried plantain!!!!!!!. The reviews are either lying or they don’t know what Nigerian food should taste like. Just look at the beans and the yam porridge, the food was not completely cooked. DON’T ORDER FOOD FROM HERE

Worst place to order food! This was an order $25 meat soup. Ordered delivery order. When I called they are said  ' it was to be picked up'  yet I was charged a delivery fee. Finaly pictured that is what was delivered $25. The soup was all in the bag and had to put back in the bowl. No pounded yam as expected. I tried calling several times nothing. DO NOT ORDER!
It should be all Zero though no option for zero

I'm a Nigerian and visiting from Boston Massachusetts. I visited Las Vegas for the first time, and have a notch for Nigerian food. Nigerian cuisine was highly recommended. I drove down to the spot and I was amazed. The guy is humble and down to earth experienced caterer. I ordered my Eba and Egusi soup. It was so delicious and fresh. I fully recommend the Nigerian cuisine. I will be back in December to Vegas and I promise to visit the Nigerian cuisine again.

formatted_address: 3900 W Charleston Blvd Suite 120, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: Mama Putt @ Flavor House

reviews.text: We held a brunch event at Mama Putt last week and couldn’t have been more pleased. Every dish arrived hot and bursting with flavor, and the presentation was lovely. The menu felt like a genuine cultural experience — exciting, authentic, and very satisfying. The staff were attentive and professional, which made the whole event run smoothly. Would definitely return and recommend Mama Putt for anyone looking for delicious food and a memorable brunch experience.

1st time trying this place. Got the teriyaki salmon bowl, empanadas,  fried musubi. Sweet chili sauce for the empanadas was perfectly flavored and spiced for me. I love spicy! Fried misusing was delicious! Salmon bowl was perfectly grilled and delicious.  The man who rang up the order was pleasant and personable. Will definitely try again...
I ordered  rice with beef. The beef was super tender, easily could cut with a spoon. The Suya was hot temperature, seasoned well with some heat, lots of heat.

Service was interesting. It was around 6pm, my husband and I walked in to what seems to be an empty restaurant. We must have missed the crowd because the server proceeded to inform us that their teriyaki items ran out which was alright as we weren't there for teriyaki to begin with. Anyhow, we decided on chicken curry with Fufu. Shortly after, the server tells my husband that they ran out of curry. I was a tad disappointed but quickly browsed the menu again and picked the chicken stew with Fufu. The cashier seem to have difficulty getting our orders in and getting our change back to us. Again, not a problem. Service was just nothing to look forward to.

Food was a 5 out of 5. I've been wanting to try Fufu for a few months now and I must say.. I wasn't disappointed. The chicken Stew with Fufu was delicious ! The flavour was on point, meat was tender, and Fufu was well done.  Knowing how to eat Fufu is key to a good experience, so YouTube it if you have to.

Atmosphere of the dining is decent. Nice music. Spacious dining room. Overall clean and tidy.

We will definitely return for the food. 😊🔥

I came here yesterday, because I wanted to try Cameroonian food. The server came over and greeted me which was very nice. Very polite man, so I asked for recommendations since it was first time. I went ahead with his recommendation and I wasn’t disappointed. He recommended Ndole and it was good I liked the bitterness. I will be back again to eat and I left something there so I do have to be back. 😂🤦🏽‍♀️

formatted_address: 4972 S Maryland Pkwy Suite 21, Las Vegas, NV 89119, United States
name: Soul of Afrika

reviews.text: Soul of Afrika was a really nice place to eat, with flavorful food and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The staff were especially helpful, they checked in on us, asked if we needed any help, and were genuinely kind, which made the whole experience feel comfortable and enjoyable. Overall, it was just a nice place to be, and I’d definitely recommend it.

Absolutely loved everything. Visited Vegas from DC and honestly was not expecting much. We actually visited Nigeria Cuisine first and had a horrible experience then came here. The difference was CLEAR!!!!! The place is cozy and inviting and cleannnn. The service is great and did I mention the place is clean? Okay. Now to the food, I wasn’t expecting much as I previously mentioned, but I was pleasantly surprised! The food was a solid 9/10 and generous with the goat meat. Loved every bite as shown in the picture attached. Clean plate club. We are so happy especially after the nonsense experience we had at Nigerian Cuisine. I highly recommend - this is the standard we need to support and uphold!

We got the stew and rice/ chicken and the jollof rice/catfish. Little gem of a spot. Boyfriend said it almost tasted like Dad's growing up and was so happy and full on just half the stew plate.. !! So happy and can't wait to come back and get more and then some!! It all tastes RIGHT. When you walk in and the smell/atmosphere, we want to stay and eat next time. Thankyou guys for an amazing lunch/dinner!!!

I wanted to love this place. I understand this isn't Ghanian food, but a soup isn't meant to have the texture of stew. We didn't get something we ordered. Spent over 200 dollars, and the family we brought here was definitely not impressed.  I ordered jollof rice and beef, and there was barely any meat. It was a huge bone and tons of fat. I'm so disappointed.  😢  Our server was nice and definitely tried. As soon as we sat down, it was so dark that the kids were scared. Thankfully,  someone turned on some lights. My jollof rice did taste okay.  I don't like to write anything but 5 star reviews because I know some days aren't good days, but I felt I needed to share.

Also, they have none of the appetizers on the menu or a kids menu. I wish I had known that before we drove and ubered all of us over.

Great customer service.

But..

Food is overpriced.

You guys charge $6 for malt. Seriously? And $2 for tiny bottle of water.
Your egusi soup with fufu is $27 which is way overpriced. Your Egusi soup was tasty but lacking good seasoning. Your meat was tasteless.

Your restaurant location is in Las Vegas not in NYC, ATL, Seattle, Miami or San Francisco. Make it affordable for everyone just like the hotels around you in Vegas.

formatted_address: 3480 S Maryland Pkwy, Las Vegas, NV 89169, United States
name: COCO'S AFRICAN KITCHEN

reviews.text: It taste so bad.I was here today .. the experience was horrible..the fried rice wasn’t nice it looked bad with a very dried meat. The suya stick taste bad I couldn’t eat it. I asked for tilapia on my porridge the porridge was bad they gave me can fish instead of the fried tilapia. The meat pepper soup meat was tooooooooooooo soft …in all the food was not food at all ..it 0/100% for me.i have not seen a catfish pepper soup like this.

We ordered the Suya “ meat sticks” it came with maybe 10 dry pieces of beef jerky and some onions and tomatoes. It was the most dry,  hardest, beef jerky  meat and not anything close to suya. My husband ordered the jollof plate with goat meat and plantain. The goat meat must have been there for 10 days as it was hard dry and ugh. The plantain wasn’t fresh , more like rubber or plastic . The jollof rice was actually good. I’m pretty sure they have the food made in bulk and just warm it up in the back. The server was nice and refunded my suya sticks. Unfortunately , we will never eat here again.

CoCo’s African Kitchen is hands down one of the best restaurants in Las Vegas. It is absolutely outstanding! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and hospitality that makes you feel right at home. Truly a home away from home! The food is absolutely delicious,authentic, flavorful, and prepared with so much care. Every dish bursts with rich African spices and tastes that remind you of the motherland. Whether you’re trying African cuisine for the first time or you grew up with it, CoCo’s will exceed your expectations.
The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is excellent, and the portions are generous. It’s more than just a meal. It’s an experience!!
If you’re looking for a place that serves outstanding food in a warm and vibrant setting, look no further. I highly recommend CoCo’s African Kitchen to anyone in Texas (and beyond). Once you try it, you’ll definitely keep coming back!

CoCo’s African Kitchen! Authentic. Delicious. Unmatched.🍲
Come Hungry, Leave Happy!🍛

This restaurant should not exist at all, I was on a vacation in Vegas, and the moment I came in town, I decided to check if there's an African Restaurant on doordash, and bang this restaurant pop up without me looking at the review, I placed an order for a 2 jollof rice, 1 for rounded and egunsi, and a plate of pepper soup  , spending over 116$, jollof rice doesn't even taste like a restaurant jollof rice, the moment I ordered on doordash, I realized they didn't ask me for the option of protein on my food, I called the restaurant and a guy picked up,  and after I explained the situation he got my order and told me I ordered 2 sides of jollof rice and it doesn't come with meat, at the end of the call, he said I will throw some goat meat in there buddy and dude hung up, I got my order and it was a mess, the pounded yam doesn't even taste like pounded yam, either flower or pounded, the egunsi was all white , no sign of vegetable what so ever in it, I manage to eat the pounded yam but trust me, I had food poisoning for the first 3 days of my vacation,  I tried leaving feedback on doordash but for whatever reason it didn't let me  ,saying I can't get refund. But am not talking about refund but the quality of the service here,
Talk about the pepper soup,  I don't even know what to describe it with , I couldn't eat it at all. All ended in the trash,  this restaurant is nothing to write home about, I ended up spending over 600$ at Calabash African Kitchen,  mennnnn, the customer service was good, quality of food was 💯.  Cocos restaurant,  you guys are not representing African restaurants well at all.

The owner responded to my review talking about i ordered side of Jollof rice does not come with protein, I did not order side of Jollof Rice, I ordered 2 plates of Jollof rice, and i paid 30$ each, so both rice i paid 60$, is your side of Jollof rice 60$? what about the fact that your food gave me food poison???? did you read about that in in my review? why not address that part?

Why not allow me to reply to your response? why do i only have one option to delete my review?? this is so unfair and you are just selling rubbish to your customers, especially those that are not from Africa, who dont even know what it looks or taste like.

I am trying to upload the receipt for my order but for some reasons wont let me.

JUST CHANGE THE QUALITY OF FOOD YOU ARE COOKING FOR PEOPLE TO EAT TO THE BEST. when people order from the restaurants its not that they cant cook at home, they sometimes just want a better taste than what they are use to.

if you get a chance to read my review before eating here, please don't go there if you don't want to damage your health.
The beef patties were sooooo good! And the plantains were perfect. Definitely a must try

formatted_address: 5006 S Maryland Pkwy, Las Vegas, NV 89119, United States
name: Folaf African Resturante

reviews.text: Excellent and perfect Nigerian African touch food, prepared while you wait and play African games. Place to visit.
If you're looking for that great home cooked African food, this is your place. Try it..
It’s really Indians and the restaurant is a cover up!! Be safe y’al
A little small and maybe no for everyone but nice food

formatted_address: Westlake Center, 4529 W Sahara Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: PSAINT ROC LLC DBA LAS GIDI

reviews.text:
My wife ordered egusi soup from this restaurant to surprise me, since she knows how much I love it. The result? Pure disappointment—and serious concern. The soup was nothing but salt, no authentic flavor at all. When my wife called to complain, the owner openly admitted he loads it with Maggi and salt because, in his words, “people in Las Vegas like spices.” That is reckless and dangerous. Excessive sodium and artificial seasoning at that level isn’t just bad cooking—it poses real health risks, including high blood pressure, kidney damage, heart disease, and long-term organ strain.

This is not food—it’s poison disguised as a meal. The owner even said “it’s all about business.” That tells you everything. Please, do not order from here. For the sake of your health, your family’s health, and the community’s safety, this place needs to be reported to public health immediately.

⚠️ WARNING: This is a serious risk to human health. Be careful and stay away.

Ordered on DoorDash, food took twice as long to come because they had the door locked. Certain items on the menu weren’t available but overall, the food was pretty good. Fried rice and plantains were delicious but the soup swallow was really watered down. The meat was terrible, not as advertised. Fried rice was supposed to come with meat, but didn’t have any. By the time we got to us, it had leaked all over the bag as well, terrible packaging.

First of all, they should remove that “las gidi” from their name because they are a disgrace to Lagos.

I ordered 1plate of ofada sauce with white rice and 1plate of jollof rice and chicken

The ofada sauce had a very nasty smell, not ofada smell or the iru smell, something nasty. It  was literally smelling like poo, just 1 spoon of it and I almost threw up

The jollof rice was nothing to write home about, no taste at all, just red colour and oil. Also had a nasty smell, I don’t know what kind of useless oil they use in that kitchen

The chicken was not cooked, inside of the chicken tastes and smells like the chicken has gone bad.

This restaurant is literally a health hazard and should be closed down

How I wish I can make a formal police and health report for the US government to look into this sham of a restaurant

I hope this review helps someone out there, DO NOT BUY from this restaurant, you will be left traumatized!!!!!

THE ABSOLUTE WORST—food and service alike. I ordered two plates of spicy noodles, asun, and chicken suya, and beef kebab, but I received soggy, salty noodles (both portions served on one plate), and it looked disgusting! They even added shrimp, which I didn’t ask for, with no regard for allergies. We also never received the beef kebab.

By the way, the asun was basically three tiny pieces of goat meat drowned in lots of veggies and oil. When I called to express my displeasure, the man had the audacity to tell me the plate was big enough for two portions, so there was no need for two plates. He added that it’s only Nigerians who complain, well, he’s absolutely right because we know what the food should taste like! He also tried to play the “I have people your age at home” card, which goes to show the deep level of unprofessionalism.

No apologies were rendered, the worst customer service, crowned by the mediocrity of a Nigerian man trying to prove a point when he’s clearly wrong.

🚨 ABSOLUTELY THE WORST PLACE EVER – RUN AWAY!!! 🚨

This so-called restaurant is an embarrassment to food, hospitality, and basic human decency. The food is disgusting beyond words. Overloaded with salt and Maggi until it tastes like punishment, not a meal, the owner literallytold me he loaded it with Maggi. Every bite felt like they were daring me to keep eating, and the worst part? They serve it with zero remorse, like they know it’s trash and don’t care.

The customer service? A total disaster. Rude, careless, and offensive.  The owner himself is the crown jewel of the nonsense — arrogant, unprofessional, and flat-out disrespectful. He had the audacity to say he doesn’t like Nigerians because “they complain.” Excuse me? People complain because your food is HORRIBLE, your service is HORRIBLE, and your attitude is even worse.

This isn’t just a bad restaurant — it’s a health hazard, a scam, and a shame all rolled into one. If you value your health, your money, or even the tiniest bit of self-respect, avoid this place like the plague. Don’t walk away — RUN.

formatted_address: 3711 S Valley View Blvd suit H, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
We were really curious about tasting Ethiopian food so when we saw the sign we decided to go and give it a try.
The experience was superb!, we were greeted at the entrance with a kind and joyful smile; this was our sign that we were in for a treat.
We stepped in, she gave us the menus and we told her it was our first time and asked her to explain us the menú and food.
She graciously suggested a few and went in for a fabulous tasting of a magnificent cuisine. We waited for our food and in the meantime we started seeing that another table came in and then another one and we started believing that this place has the magic of the cook and hostess (all in one for that day) she makes you feel like you arrived at your grandmas house.
Each dish was a delight by itself, we finish it all: clean plate. After that we saw a few friends and told them about this fabulous place and food.
We will definitely tell the world about it!!
Don’t miss it!!!

I LOVE small businesses and small restaurants. This was my 1st visit to Gursha and I'll DEFINITELY be coming back again! Gursha is a very warm and inviting restaurant. I was welcomed and seated immediately. Having only had Ethiopian food once before, decades ago as a teenager in Chicago, I wasn't sure what to try from the menu. The recommendations were soooo greatly appreciated. The lamb special was AMAZING!!! Absolutely DELICIOUS!!!
Finished the meal with baklava and spiced tea for desert. Very nice too.
The Ethiopian music playing on the TV added to the relaxing mood.
Check this place out. It's a local gem here in Vegas...and only a few minutes drive off of The Strip if you're visiting.
Highly recommend.

We can't say enough good things about our experience here. Mimi the owner is the most warm, friendly person. We haven't had a lot of experience eating Ethiopian food and her recommendations were so perfect. The food was incredibly flavorful the most wonderful comfort food. She even showed us how to use our hands to scoop the injira bread into all the yummy stews and fed my toddler and mother in law a bite. We left feeling so content and full!

I'm from Hawaii and the only Ethiopian restaurant there closed a few years ago. I've always enjoyed it and I'm glad to discover Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant on the 9th Island.

The food came out quickly, Mimi, the owner is super friendly, and the food... The food is amazing. I had the veggie sampler (of course) and the awaze tibs. The tibs was spicier than they made it back home, but I love spicy food.

I asked Mimi what Gursha means, and it means feeding each other. It's a tradition to share good food with everyone on your table.

Yum! I'll be back for sure.

First time trying this cuisine and wow! Splendid! Mimi was a sweetheart and cooked the meal entirely by herself from scratch all while teaching us about the food. It was great, Thank you Mimi!!

Highly recommend for people who have never tried Ethiopian before - step outside your comfort zone for a wonderful meal at a local business :)

formatted_address: 4825 W Flamingo Rd #6&7, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Luhena Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text:
Incredible Ethiopian food with excellent service. We had the tartar and the lamb and they were so good. The lamb chops were so tender and super flavorful. I wish we had gone there before our last day so we could have gone back again. Big portion sizes. The staff were super nice as well. I felt bad we couldn't eat it all as it was so good and they were so nice.
Super clean interior and nice place to talk too.

The food is outstanding—rich, flavorful, and authentic. Every dish is perfectly seasoned, with generous portions that make it easy to share.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting. It’s a place where you can enjoy a casual meal or settle in for a longer evening with friends and family.

The staff is friendly, attentive, and genuinely happy to guide you through the menu if you’re new to Ethiopian cuisine.

It is a great spot if you're looking to try delicious Ethiopian food. The food is flavorful, the place is clean, and the vibe is modern. The service is a little bit slow; they take a while to bring the food except that It's definitely worth a visit if you want a good experience.

After a 5-hour drive from LA, we arrived around 10 pm and were warmly greeted by Hanna at the entrance. Since it was our first visit, she kindly recommended the Kitfo and Beg Tibs. The food was served promptly, and both dishes were absolutely delicious — flavorful with just the right amount of kick.
The service stood out as well. Hanna and Hermela checked on us multiple times to make sure we were satisfied and had everything we needed. Another highlight was the restroom — clean and well-maintained, something that is often neglected at some Habesha restaurants.
Overall, a wonderful first experience with excellent food, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere.

When the food is so good, you order extra and the owners win your heart!
The kitfo brought back the sweetest childhood memories of Kitfo bets in Yohannes area in Addis Ababa, and the owners’ genuine hospitality made us feel right at home. The mom cooks in the kitchen while the dad takes care of the customers a typical Ethiopian feeling brought from thousands of miles. The food was so delicious we couldn’t resist ordering extra and even though we couldn’t finish it, they were so kind and didn’t charge us for one of the dishes when we came back on another day. Luhen in Vegas, this is definitely one of our favorite spots! we’ll be back! 🇪🇹❤️🍽️

formatted_address: 4850 W Flamingo Rd # 10, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Lucy Ethiopian Restaurant and Bar

reviews.text: This is the best Ethiopian restaurant that we have ever experienced!  The food is absolutely delicious and the service is magnificent.  Hannah went above and beyond to make us feel welcome.  Her recommendation enabled us to try small portions of each special dish.  We will be new regular customers at Lucy from now on.  Highly recommend giving it a try.

My husband wanted to try something “new” 🙂
I’ve eaten the food before but not at this location. It was delicious!
We ordered 1 meat combo, 1 meat and veggie combo and 1 veggie combo. If we would have ordered two combo platters it would have been enough for the 4 of us.

Today was the first time having Ethiopian food and it was amazing. The beef samosas had great spice blend with a nice dipping sauce. We ordered the Lega Tibs and Doro Way. The Lega Tibs were tender with wonderful garlic herbiness. Yum. The Doro Wat was also amazing. Spicy, but not in a make your mouth on fire way. It was the kind of spicy that made your mouth warm and happy. The service was fantastic and super friendly. Thank you to our wonderful server Heran. We definitely be back to try other items on the menu. I didn't give a 5 rating because I've only been there once.

reviews.author_name: Green Sea Shells Mag: Wellness by KK
reviews.text:
If you’re in Las Vegas and craving Ethiopian cuisine, Lucy Ethiopian Restaurant is a decent choice. Tucked away in a quieter neighborhood just off the Strip, it’s easy to find with plenty of parking. We discovered it thanks to our Eritrean cab driver, who highly recommended it.

We ordered a veggie combo and two samosas, which were the perfect portions for our family of three. The food had a home-style touch, satisfying without feeling heavy—something we appreciated. The service was surprisingly quick, especially for an Ethiopian restaurant, and the staff was warm and welcoming.

That said, there’s room for improvement. The women’s restroom was clogged during our visit, and while the flavors were enjoyable, they could have been a bit more complex. As someone who regularly cooks Ethiopian food and has dined at nearly every Ethiopian restaurant in NYC and Los Angeles, I’d say Lucy is a good option if you’re craving hearty vegetarian dishes or Ethiopian fare in Las Vegas.

Wow! SO DELICIOUS! My family and I got the veggie combo, prime beef tibs, doro wot, ceremonial coffee set, honey wine, and samosas

Our server Genet was so kind and friendly. She took care of our entire order, and she was also very patient with us and gave us her favorite dish. Honestly every server was amazing.

MUST GO! Best ethiopian food of my life.

formatted_address: 6174 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: HABESHA RESTAURANT & BAR
