reviews.text: The food here is made with love. This is a joyful place. Brooke was awesome and super attentive. The scenery is just beautiful in rich blues. If you're in the mood for exceptional, fresh food, this is the place. I highly recommend!

Vegetarian meals, besides meat. Server was kind and friendly but not very helpful as she didn’t really understood the menu and didn’t explain the food nor portion sizes. Food was flavorful: some spicy, some with turmeric. I don’t like collard greens but this was fantastic. The special bread is cold and used to eat with (no utensils). The Habesha veggie plate is definitely for 2 people.

We got the vegetarian combination plate which came with several different types of lentles, some cabbage, collard greens and salad along with injira, the teff pancake. We also got the lentle sambusa. Everything was OK. The waitress was very engaging, kind, friendly and attentive and made the experience memorable.

Truly phenomenal! When I moved here I was hoping to find a good Ethiopian restaurant and "boom!" Food is beyond wonderful, the decore delightful and the service divine! And ask about indulging in the coffee service!
Great food, great music, friendly staff. I will be coming back.

formatted_address: 4160 S Pecos Rd #1, Las Vegas, NV 89121, United States
name: Calypso Lounge & Restaurant

reviews.text: Best Nigerian restaurant in Vegas hands down! It’s a beautiful lounge with a chill vibe. Highly recommend. Ps. Egusi was chefs kiss!

The food looked good I got it delivered via Uber eats . I wish I had know how spicy it was going to be. Please guide people about spice level. I could barely eat my meal  and I paid 80 dollars for it .

Unfortunately, our experience here was very disappointing. This was our first time visiting this place, traveling from Phoenix, and we were really looking forward to it. It took over an hour for our food to come out, and when it finally did, it was extremely salty. The Ogbono soup served to my oldest sister was cold, which raised even more concerns about the quality and care being put into the food. After the meal, my sisters and I ended up getting food poisoning — my younger sister even threw up several times, which was very alarming. It was heartbreaking, especially since we were excited to try something new together. I truly hope the restaurant takes this feedback seriously and makes major improvements in both food safety and service.

I recently visited this African restaurant to celebrate my girlfriend's birthday, and unfortunately, the experience was deeply disappointing. To begin, the food was served cold, which immediately detracted from any potential enjoyment of the meal. The temperature suggested that the dishes had been prepared well in advance and left unattended for an extended period.

Moreover, the portion sizes were shockingly small, especially considering the prices on the menu. It felt as though we were paying a premium for minuscule servings that hardly justified the cost.  My combo came with 2 small plantains- I could literally count the pieces of meat on one hand .

Adding to the issues, the establishment appeared to be severely understaffed. The host was also responsible for cooking and serving drinks, which raised serious concerns about hygiene and food handling. It seemed as though the food was not freshly prepared, but rather reheated, possibly in a microwave.

To make matters worse, the restaurant seemed to be out of almost everything, including the fufu, which was a major letdown. The food was also overly spicy - the egusi , jollof rice combo and the ogbono soup -

Overall, the combination of cold food, inadequate portions, and questionable food preparation practices made for an extremely unsatisfactory dining experience. I cannot recommend this restaurant and strongly advise others to consider alternative options for African cuisine.

I love the chicken and beef egusi soup so gooooood!!!! I always get extra pounded yam but the one provided is bigger than most I’ve had which is great!!! Some places are stingy with the pounded yam I have to buy 3 or 4 but not here!! The hookah is always good love it!! Owner is very nice and welcoming atmosphere, drinks are good as well. My favorite spot I can eat egusi have some hookah and drinks and music what’s better than that? Love this place if I’m not able to go in I order it online and expectation are always the same. Highly recommend

formatted_address: 5081 N Rainbow Blvd #100, Las Vegas, NV 89130, United States
name: Nigeria cafe

reviews.text: This place is original Nigeria food with home taste. price is right.

formatted_address: 4780 W Tropicana Ave Suite #108, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Abyssinia Restaurant & Lounge

reviews.text:
I definitely recommend dining here for an evening out. Another recommendation: the Meat & Veggie platter. It's a must try for first time visitors. Be sure to ask about the spiciness level. Some of the spices will get you, and is worth the sampling.

Good atmosphere, good food, and good service. I'll return to explore that lamb menu.

We hadn’t had Ethiopian food in years and were craving it and thankfully we found this spot. The restaurant is small but the interior is beautiful and comforting. They have traditional music playing in the background which we very much enjoyed. The host was very kind and service was excellent.

We ordered the sambusa lentil and the vegetarian platter. The sambusa was fresh and crispy. The platter came with a variety of lentils and vegetables - each one extremely delicious and flavorful! My favorite was the yellow mung and my wife’s favorite was the green mung. It reminded us of Indian and Sri Lankan cuisines.

Overall, it’s a solid restaurant and we would recommend to those who enjoy similar traditional dishes. We would definitely come back again.

Hey, y'all, hey. I hope y'all are having a great day 🤗 About 3days ago I went to Abyssinia Restaurant & Lounge. It's near the blade. When you walk in right away you see these beautiful soft leather, purple sofas. You seat yourself well at least we did.. Right away I asked to use the bathroom. To see if it was clean. Because if a Restaurant bathroom isn't clean I'm not eating there. It was VERY CLEAN. I don't like where it's located but that's just me 🤭 Anyway we order the platter part veges & part meat. It took a while but when it was brought to us, the AROMAS...FROM THE SPICES WAS EVERRRYTHING. I'm closing my eyes & I can still smell the freshness of it all!! The colors from the lentils to the greens to the  tibs were so colorful. We order the injerah I probably spelled it wrong. The only thing was the injerah was cold. I mean cold like it was just taken out the fridge. I told our server I think her name was Mani. She apologized & when she brought it back it was warm. The other thing the food wasn't that hot either. It was more room temperature.  But when I TELL Y'ALL THIS FOOD WAS CHEF kiss  😘 SLAP YO MOMMA as they say.. GOOOOD it was REEEEEEEALLY GOOD!! I was disappointed they didn't have any honey🍯 wine. But I'd definitely will go back. Aye, stop reading this & get to the Abyssinia Ethiopian Restaurant 🤭
Continue to enjoy y'all day smooches 🤗 btw the injerah what the food is placed on is so make your toes curl DELICIOUS due to the seasonings having soaked in i loved it!! See y'all at my next review 🤗

Really Good Ethiopian food. My wife is from Ethiopia and we always try to get some injera when we travel. First time for us in Vegas and the injera was really really good.  Very good service and overall good experience.
Clean.. delicious Ethiopian food.. superb ambiance. We tried the Tibs and the veggie platter. The taste takes you back to Ethiopia.

formatted_address: 3375 S Decatur Blvd unit 2, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: Africa Love Food Market

reviews.text: Yes I’ve found ingredients for momma African dish
TASTY!!!

formatted_address: 4230 S Decatur Blvd #600, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Melkam Market

reviews.text:
Very cool niche store with international goods!

Efraim was especially helpful and great at small talk and customer service! Will be visiting here often

Me and my friends went there for a break time around 7pm. The restaurant is attached with the market, at the front by the market side looks busy but at the back  the restaurant part a little bit quit.  The building,the chair,the restroom is brand new, excellent, clean and the room smells nice.
We ordered "agelgil" (አገልግል)  and "tibs" (ጥብስ). The portion of the agelgil is more than enough for two people and the taste was super. My friend also likes the tibs and was fresh. Our server was very polite. Every time when I went to a restaurant I expect a very tasty food, enough portion and a nice polite server,here I got all! Thanks. Oh btw the price was reasonable. Defiantly I'll bring families and friends.
To be the best of Vegas needs some improvements on
1: our food was late, as a matter of fact other than us there was only one family in the restaurant and shouldn't be that late.
2: even if the server was very polite she didn't ask us how was the food,or what else should we need, ( I saw a coffee with jebena ጀበና ቡና)
3: keep it professional የአገልግል ምግቡን ለመገልበጥ ስትቸገር ተመልክቻለሁ፣ she needs a help, when we need something we have to wait until she come from kitchen. I saw a lot of employees or family friends walking by but no offer to ask.
I wish you to grow one of the best Ethiopian authentic restaurant. See you in a few days.
They sell you things getting expired like meat 2 weeks old meat people at the counter for no business bad experience ever

Just passing through and got a great gored gored (one of the best I've had in a while) and Ambo water to go, and got to practice some Amharic. Friendly staff there and the place is very nice with easy parking.

I asked the cashier if they sell kategna, he replied not yet, but he went to the kitchen and got one for me for free, and it was tasty!
I have no words!
Thank you sir!
Will definitely come back again.

formatted_address: 6985 W Sahara Ave suite 119, Las Vegas, NV 89117, United States
name: Paradise Place Jamaican Cuisine

reviews.text:
The atmosphere was genuinely enjoyable; clean, festive, and inviting. The décor and overall vibe set the right tone for what I hoped would be a positive dining experience.

Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the environment. From the moment I arrived, I didn’t feel welcomed or acknowledged, which was disappointing given the otherwise pleasant setting.

In addition, the restaurant did not have several of the menu items I was interested in. I chose a dish directly from their posted menu only to be told it was sold out, despite it being the beginning of the week and still two hours before closing. This raised questions about preparation and inventory management, and it took away from the overall experience.

The potential for a great visit was definitely there...good ambiance and a clean space..but the lack of customer engagement and limited menu availability made the visit less enjoyable than expected. With improvements in service and consistency in menu offerings, this place could truly shine.

Never again. I paid $46.56 for one meal. I should have gone to the Dutch pot. Or the other Jamaican spot on flamingo. Online and in the restaurant menu said $28 for curry goat. I asked why it totaled to that much, lady said goat curry is $35. And the rest is “taxes and fees” how is it still $46.56? How??? That’s over 35 percent !!!!  This is lunch, just one order.  One meal. Not a dine in. I opened the meal in the car and all I got was bones and fatty meat. And mushy veggies. $35 for ox tails but not boney fatty goat no meat. I didn’t have time to argue because I had to go back to work. When I love eating at a place I make sure to advertise and  give good reviews. The restaurant has to be realistic. This is Las Vegas you can’t just decide to charge what u want when u feel like it and add extra fees and taxes for to go meals. It doesn’t work like that. I called to make sure and the lady lied and said online it says $35 well maam that’s not true. I’m disappointed my hard earned money paid for bones. Look at photo would you pay $46.56??? This is not a fancy restaurant in a nice location.

Went as a part of three. Waited to be seated at the door (like the sign said) no one acknowledged us for almost 10 mins, so i flagged someone down to get service. There was only one table open when we got there and that’s because a couple had left. They only had one server helping a packed restaurant so I understood. I did see what looked like two kitchen staff trying to help up front.

It was a night that they had live music. It was great so it made the long wait to order easier. However, once our food was ordered it came right out.  Food was really good.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Paradise Place is an absolute gem! The food is absolutely delicious—everything is full of flavor, and if you’re craving some tasty oxtails or curry goat, this is the spot. The ambiance is superb, with a warm and welcoming feel that makes you want to stay a while.

Customer service is outstanding; the staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel right at home. The atmosphere is amazing, and the live music on Tuesday nights takes the dining experience to another level.

I would highly recommend Paradise Place to anyone looking for great food, great vibes, and a truly memorable experience!
Food was 10 outta 10. Flavorful yet not overly spiced. Amazing rice and peas(beans). Good prices, good food, great people.

formatted_address: 4825 W Flamingo Rd #1, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Karod cafe

reviews.text: Never eat a big belly in Vegas like I do in Karod cafe! I couldn’t help recommending that to uber drivers. And the genuine coffee will be a must to try! Appreciate Karod’s the best Ethiopian kichten in Vegas!

I’m so amazed I found this place. The food is incredibly authentic and honestly reminds me of my mom’s cooking. The flavors, the spices, everything tastes real and homemade. The portions are huge too, which I didn’t expect at all. I can’t believe I never knew this spot existed. This is definitely my new and only go-to for Ethiopian food from now on. 😊

I highly recommend Karod Café to anyone looking for a real taste of Ethiopian cuisine. Whether you’re Ethiopian or just discovering the food, this place is a hidden gem in Las Vegas. I’ll be back soon—and I’m bringing friends!
Authentic Ethiopian food must try ….everything is delicious home cooked food style amazing taste n hospitality .
I was in Vegas for two days and ate there twice. Great food and great service. I enjoyed their delicious kitfo and shiro.

formatted_address: 6370 W Flamingo Rd #30, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Axum Palace Resto Bar

reviews.text:
When Merkato closed some years back, I gave up on the hunt for good Ethiopian food.. One of my best friends let me know about this gem that I seemed to have looked over. BEST ETHIOPIAN FOOD IN THE CITY OF LAS VEGAS.
My favorite dish is the awaze tibs. They did not disappoint. Flavor was ON POINT! They served the lamb without bones as well.. major plus! I have eaten twice through delivery and food came at perfect temp. They serve a plentiful helping! Do yourself a favor… grab a bite!
So much flavor and just enough heat... spice blends are on point!! This is my favorite Ethiopian Restaurant in town, food is great and everyone was super friendly.
Axum was awesome! Very friendly staff. Nice bar area and restaurant and stage area and Ethiopian music. We got doro wot and kitfo and both were great! Thanks!

I have been looking forward to this place and oh what a disappointment. The place had 2 or 3 people, seem mostly employees. Looks nice and cozy I will say. Service was terrible. Server doesn't speak English so a gentleman who apparently works here came over to help. Many menu items not available.  Ordered some drinks mainly water and beer. After that we sat for a long time with no one coming over to take order. They just stared from the bar. After waiting too long, I went over to the bar to close out and pay for my drinks.   No questions asked as to why. They all just stood behind bar talking and laughing.  I have  NEVER had such terrible service even in the worst restaurant I've eaten in. This was beyond worst. I will definitely not be back. All i have to show is my water and beer. Do better folks. I am all for international restaurants. I hope to have one of my own but they have a reputation that needs to be remedied. Poor service to the point I am embarassed!!! Horrible service. If the food is great, I guess I wouldn't know
Our flight landed late and we didn’t want fast food, I was so grateful they were open and served us a delicious, fresh dinner with a smile on their face at 11 PM! Thank you!

formatted_address: 4734 E Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89121, United States
name: Jerk Dat Flamingo

reviews.text: Definitely check out their catering option if you have to do an event or you’re looking to feed several people. The food is amazing and the set up is great. Call and ask for Chef Elijah to it set up. They make it pretty easy

Elijah is a great host and phenomenal cook! We came in Christmas eve, and we tasted and i have to say, the food is amazing we will definitely be back real soon thank you the oxtails fell off the bone the seasoning is amazing. God bless this owner he is an amazing soul

Had an amazing experience at Jerk Dat on 12/28/25. My boyfriend and I met up with a friend. Upon arrival we had to wait to have our orders taken, but the wait was totally worth it for such delectable food. The owner recognized our friend almost immediately after helping him out on the side of the road over a year ago - talk about an elephant memory! 🐘 He treats everyone like family, and we felt right at home. Before we even ordered, he gave us samples of his homemade soup 🍲 on the house and free bottled waters. That soup? 🔥 Made with love, it hit the spot and warmed my soul. I was getting over a cold, but after tasting it, I felt like I could run a marathon.
Food was delicious, and the portions were generous. I ordered curry chicken with noddles on the side as my boyfriend and our friend ordered jerk chicken with noodles on the side. Would've given 5 stars for the food, but my noodles were a bit cold- no biggie, still devoured it 😋.
The real MVP is the owner, who gave us a free big container of soup to take home. I was nice and let our friend have it since he showed me this place and paid for our meal-not gonna lie was willing to fight over that soup😅. If you're looking for a place with heart, come here! Highly recommend.
P.S. Owner, what's it gonna take to get those recipes? 🙏🏻

We came in HUNGRY from out of town, and the owner was kind enough to let us sample before we ordered. He prepared our plates and we enjoyed his conversation. Our plates were so hefty, we were able to eat leftovers for 2 additional meals! Very happy we found this gem!

So glad I gave this place a shot, I got the jerk chicken and oxtail with collard greens.

The oxtail and chicken were so tender they practically melted in your mouth and fell off the bone, and overall the food was really good and the lady serving me was very friendly and kind.

I try not to eat out very often, but I'm definitely adding this place to my cycle of try again's.

formatted_address: 4360 S Decatur Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Seble Market and Cafe

reviews.text: A must stop if you’re in town and craving habesha food . Tg was our server and her attention to details and pleasant smile was really nice 💯
It is one of the best ethiopian food u could find in Las Vegas.

By far the best Ethiopian restaurant in Vegas. The atmosphere is not pretentious but genuinely Ethiopian. It feels like Addis. If you are a fan of meat this is your place. You must try the goat dishes. The people are very friendly and inviting and the food is consistently the best. It's also a butcher shop. Meat is super fresh. Try it and, like me, you'll keep coming back

Seble Market is a gem in the community! The variety of fresh produce and quality products is impressive, and the staff is always friendly and helpful. I love the wide selection of local and international foods. The store is clean, well-organized, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great restaurant experience!!!

The best Ethiopian place to get a fresh food and same test.
The owner so friendly approach to everyone.

formatted_address: 4230 S Decatur Blvd Suite 200, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: NU Ethiopian kitchen

reviews.text: Great Ethiopian food and service. Very vegan friendly. Got two veggie combos for two people, though a single veggie combo could definitely be enough for two to share with how generous the portions are. The stewed red lentils (center of the plate) and the beets were my favorite, though even the potato and cabbage and collard greens were so flavorful (honestly everything was). Will definitely be coming back!
So happy there's another Ethiopian dining option in the valley.  Good food and great service.   Standouts are the lentil samosas and coffee.

Amazing food and great service!
Mini took good care of us and made us feel like we were guests of royalty at her home! Really health, great prices and you won't leave hungry.
Good food. The injera is really good.  The spice and flavoring are on point.  The service is a little slow and takes some prompting.
Good food and extra friendly service. Limited menu, but what they offer is delicious and is served with plenty of injera.

formatted_address: 1911 Stella Lake St #150, Las Vegas, NV 89106, United States
name: Gritz Cafe

reviews.text: Gritz Café was hands down the best place we tried in Vegas. The food was a solid 10/10. The grits with bacon are an absolute must-have. The chicken was crispy and seasoned to perfection. Don’t forget the hot sauce and a little sugar for the grits, it takes it to the next level. The service felt warm and homey, and everyone was incredibly kind. Truly a 10/10 experience.

If I could give Gritz 100 stars, I would. Everything from the food to the service to the ambiance was phenomenal. From the minute you walk in, it feels like home and every single one of the staff members was so friendly and attentive that it felt like family. And the food? My God..! I don't even like grits but I felt it would only make sense to try some here and they did not disappoint! Nothing I ordered disappointed - the hot links, the waffle, the eggs, EVERYTHING was cooked to perfection. If I was a local, I'd be in there all the time and I will definitely be back to visit whenever I'm in town.

The food was amazing, cooked to order, and delicious!  The wings and catfish are seasoned and cooked to perfection. The grits are a must to try.
It's a small spot, but the turnover is quick and they have takeout.  Our server was knowledgeable and attentive.  So good I went back the next day for lunch.

The Holy Trinity is my favorite meal! Gritz cafe uses turkey for their collard greens and OMG they are so delicious! I love the food here and have not had a bad experience. They cook the food fresh and the waitresses are so sweet and friendly. I’ll always visit Gritz cafe when I visit. All the food is always on point. I definitely recommend this place!

Grits Cafe is hands down one of the best meals I’ve had in a long time! The food was absolutely 5-star, and the service matched the same level of excellence. The prices were reasonable, and the portions were delightfully generous. It was so good that we all ended up ordering an extra plate to take home for later!

The staff was friendly, welcoming, and very accommodating to my daughter’s shellfish allergy, which gave us peace of mind and made the experience even better. We truly felt at home, and we all left happy and satisfied.

I’ll definitely be coming back on my next trip to Vegas—this place is a must-try!

formatted_address: 3876 Main St, Niagara Falls, ON L2G 6B5, Canada
name: MCUIRE - Inspired by Nigeria and Ghana (Creative Fusion Concept Restaurant)

html_attributions: MCUIRE - Inspired by Nigeria and Ghana (Creative Fusion Concept Restaurant)

reviews.text:
Mcuire is a must try when visiting Niagra Falls Canada!  I had been wanting to try African cuisine for some time, being a pescatarian I had been unable to find a place that would accommodate. Well Rosemary and Donny made the visit so worth it!  The Egosi with Shrimp was my favorite, I could not stop eating it…the spices were so good.  We had the tasting dish which included the plaintain, Jollof rice, sweet bread (puff puff), fish and homemade ice cream which (Mango), I believe they change flavors of ice cream for the week.  It is a lot of food so have your appetite ready!
You will leave there full, happy and feeling good!
Thanks Rosemary and Donny again for making our first time memorable, while celebrating my husband birthday.  The decor was nice and cozy too!

I rarely leave reviews, but this experience was unacceptable. If you are truly Nigerian or Ghanaian, I strongly advise against ordering here.

From the start, the service was poor. The staff was unwelcoming over the phone, our call was disconnected, and when reconnected, we were told to wait 15 minutes just to place an order. Delivery was promised within 55 minutes but ended up taking nearly 1 hour 30 minutes.

Every single dish was disappointing.
•	Ordered Semo but received Banku.
•	The Suya and Jollof rice both had sugar, completely inauthentic.
•	The Jollof and Fried rice were also overcooked.
•	The Okra soup was bland and inedible.
•	The Plantain was burnt and tasted of char.
•	The Efo was inedible.
•	The Zobo was watered down, lacking both flavor and color.

After waiting so long, we couldn’t eat the food and had to throw everything away. To make matters worse, they even took a photo of our order for their Google reviews which likely contributed to the delay.

This was hands down the worst dining experience I’ve had. If this were the last Nigerian/Ghanaian restaurant on earth, I still wouldn’t return.

Do not eat here.
————————————
Update:
Owner responded: “Thanks for your feedback. We’re a fusion restaurant, so not everyone may enjoy the concept and that’s okay. Thanks for giving us a try. We appreciate you.”

Instead of taking accountability, the owner chose to deflect. This was not an issue of “fusion.” It was poor service, incorrect items, excessive delays, and inauthentic food (sugar in suya and jollof, wrong substitutions, burnt plantain, etc.). Nothing about that reflects Nigerian or Ghanaian cuisine, fusion or otherwise. After waiting over an hour and a half, the food was inedible and had to be thrown away.

Went with a friend, we called in to make reservations, was asked what we want, and received time that food would be ready. We arrived, and food was brought out immediately. Ordered the main course sampler. Portion size was more than enough for each person. Diverse variety of food and also complimented each other well. Desert included (don't leave too early lol enjoy the desert). Staff was diligent and attentive. It was an amazing experience and good food. It's definitely worth it. 😌

I think this has to be one of my new favourite local spots and I can't wait to go back! It was my first time trying Nigerian and Ghanaian food, so my husband and I each ordered the tasting platter meal so we could try a bunch of things and my mouth is watering just thinking about it! Everything is so amazingly well seasoned, the flavours are phenomenal! Even the rice dishes were so delicious! I also had their tea and my husband had their sorrel/hibiscus drink. The way they served the tea with cocoa and sweet cream on the side was beautiful. And their dishes are plated so beautifully as well. Prices are very reasonable also. Wish I could give more than 5 stars!

This was our first experience trying Nigerian/Ghanaian cuisine, and my son and I weren't sure what to expect. From the moment we stepped into the restaurant, we were met with a warm and welcoming atmosphere, complete with traditional touches. The staff greeted us like family, making us feel right at home. The chef, who is both kind and passionate, reflects that warmth in her cooking. Beginning with the complimentary, refreshing hibiscus iced tea, each dish, prepared to order and infused with traditional spices, was a delightful journey through time, offering not only expertly crafted, flavorful cuisine but also an authentic connection to a rich and vibrant culture. We highly recommend MCUIRE to anyone seeking a truly unique and captivating dining experience.

Tip: It's best to call ahead and place your order, so it's ready when you arrive. Also, when they say spicy, they mean it! If you're still building your spice tolerance, it's wise to start with a milder option.

formatted_address: 6109 Rock Quarry Rd suite 105, Raleigh, NC 27610, United States
name: Elle Et Moi Cuisine LLC

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying this restaurant. I was greeted with a warm smile and engaged in enjoyable conversation about the food. All of my questions were thoroughly answered regarding making selections.
The food was delivered with generous portions and absolutely delicious. We chose the oxtails, and although I would have preferred them to be a little more tender, the flavor was absolutely lovely. I chose for my entrée the red snapper… Absolutely delicious! And this was my first time trying the spinach. I loved it. It had a mild garlic flavor, and the texture was something different for me but absolutely delicious. We also loved the Fufu. Not my first time having it, but it is a must-have to sop up all the good juices or broth with your food.
Definitely will be trying this spot again!

The food and service were amazing. It felt like home style food. I could tell it was made with love by the way it was presented to us.  We loved every thing that we ordered. It was so flavorful and felt like it was made just for us. I wish I could say what was my favorite dish,  but everything was equally amazing to me. However my brother really enjoyed the fish and jollof rice.   Each time I’m in town this will be my first stop. I can’t wait to return.

I got the okra and lamb soup combo with fufu and rice. It was so good and I definitely would get again. The guy who took my order was really nice over the phone and in person. He made conversation and was really pleasant. The food was absolutely so flavorful and worth the price. You get a decent portion for what you pay for. I personally even have leftovers for later which is even better in my opinion. I can’t wait to go back and try the oxtail!

With my first time trying African food I was pleasantly pleased with the taste of my dish. I got egusi soup with smoked turkey and fufu with creamed spinach. My boyfriend got the jerked chicken and jollof rice with creamed spinach. We both were obsessed with the layers of flavor and perfect amount of spice. The owner and his daughter are very sweet people and were very helpful explaining menu items. Their fresh made juices and lemonades are amazing too. They also have certain items you can buy like a mini grocery store. Portions are plentiful. Pricing is reasonable.

HANDS DOWN THE BEST AFRICAN RESTAURANT IN RALEIGH! Oxtail was delicious! The atmosphere was impeccable, everyone was so friendly and welcoming. You can see the small community this restaurant has brought together. I love it and I would come back again to try more dishes. This was the first time I visited and I had a great first impression. The prices are reasonable

formatted_address: 2454 Miracle Lane, Mishawaka, IN 46545, United States
name: Kate’s Kitchen Authentic African Cuisine South bend

reviews.text: I first tried them at fusion fest a year ago! Loved their food came back again without knowing it was the same people food is still amazing!! Loved their flavors everything I ate definitely hit the spot 🫶🏼 The hospitality was amazing! Talked us through traditional way of eating African food!

My fiancé moved to South Bend from Richmond Virginia , and whenever I come to visit, this is the only place we choose to eat. The staff are very nice, welcoming, and the food is always amazing. Highly recommended!

So I must say this will be my last time ordering from Kate's I go yesterday to get egusi and foo foo, usually it takes about 15 minutes this time it came out in 5 minutes, I get home for 27.00 my container should have been full, it wasn't but the beef in it was dry old and tough, ive ordered 4 times from Kate follow her where ever she goes but I'm Done only once outta the 4 times has it been 27.00 worthy,  if you don’t dine in your not going to get quality from Kate's Kitchen. Been supporting Miss Kate since she was selling dinners out her home,  also cool runnings when they would come in their food truck every Tuesday downtown south bend and sell out with in a couple hours, the truck did much better than the restaurant ( closed). Sad thing is Miss Kate 1/3/26 3pm or so they would take 27.00 for one meal and it was horrible, the meat should have been thrown away! But this is it for me just gotta wait til I go to Chicago to get egusi . As you see I didn’t even unwrap the other fufu ball

Rating:
Food: 5/5 (Very good food!)
Service: 4/5 (Good Service!)
Atmosphere: 3/5 (Good Atmosphere!)

Great experience at Kate’s Kitchen Authentic African Cuisine! I tried the restaurant when it was in South Bend, but they recently moved to Mishawaka, Indiana. New at trying fufu and it was delicious! I didn't know what to expect, but they are providing some lovely and delicious meals here!

The service was good. Although the prices are kind of high, you get a good meal for your buck. The menu was explained well and I appreciate the kindness.

The atmosphere was okay, but again, I haven't been to the new restaurant yet. A touch of African history or small decor would make the restaurant great! Nevertheless, really good African food at Kate’s Kitchen Authentic African Cuisine!
We had lunch here and it was an absolute delight! The food was delicious, the service was impeccable, and the atmosphere was simply enchanting. We had an amazing time and would definitely be back.

formatted_address: 6411 E County Line Rd, Tampa, FL 33647, United States
name: Steaming Pots West Africa Cuisine Mobile 1

reviews.text: It was an absolute amazing experience. I am so glad to know that they have a food truck now my husband and I always utilize their location on Waters Ave for our anniversary tradition and to know that it’s closer to home now is amazing. The Customer Service is hands-down, such a pleasant experience as well as the food is out of this world on the taste buds.  It is a must try! Keep up the great work thank you all so much for being so authentic!

Food had bold authentic flavor and it was such a breath of fresh air from all the regular Americanized dining experiences nearby. I had jallop of rice with beef for the first time and fufu and we were pleased! 😁. We got up there a little bit late so I missed the oxtails but I will be back because I can't wait to try them. Service was 10 out of 10 and the food was fresh and delicious. It's about $20 to $25 a dish which was expected for a food truck and the proportions were fair and dense! I've got a full belly and still something to eat for lunch tomorrow. Thank you for the wonderful experience!

My fiance and I are traveling through from South Dakota and we’ve been wanting to try something totally new to us. We were instantly blown away by the inside. It was so nicely decorated and the art was so beautiful. You can tell there’s as much love in the decorating as they put in the food. If only we could have this back home!! Amazing service too! Thank you again!

Delicious every time! My favorite is egusi soup with goat or beef and a side of jollof rice. The flavors here are incredible and you won’t find anything like this anywhere else but HERE! Very unique and absolutely delicious.

Beautiful people serving delicious food! ❤️ It was my first time ordering/eating West African food and it was amazing. Everyone was full of so much love which made the experience so much better! Highly recommend especially if you are interested in trying it for the first time. The peanut soup w/ goat & fufu was a 10 out of a 10🔥  Rice💣 . The puff puffs didn’t even make it home at how good they were! Thank you for bringing this taste of your home for all of us to enjoy! It definitely will not be my last! 🫶🏼

formatted_address: 840 Deltona Blvd r, Deltona, FL 32725, United States
name: Forks & Fingers Nigerian Cuisine

reviews.text:
Did an order for thanksgiving pick up, the food was fresh and tasty, the owner was so wonderful and I can't wait for the store location to be open to have a sit down meal!
Update: they opened for some dates and the in-store service was wonderful! Friendly and knowledgeable and gave me options to make sure my meal was yummy! I enjoyed the vegetable soup with goat and fufu!!

This is not a restaurant you go to eat. I have no idea what the food tastes like because I came here to sit down and that was not an option. So, in a way the 3-star rating is unfair but I wouldn't want people to show up and think they're going to eat, like I did today.

Absolutely delicious food and very friendly customer service I had some questions on dishes as I’ve never had them and Mrs Abike answered everyone of them to make sure ordered what we would enjoy let’s just say we ordered 6 dishes and loved them all will be ordering again next week best part is we dont have to drive all the way to Orlando. Make sure and give this place a try it is highly recommended.
Fresh and flavorful. This is truly authentic, African cuisine. Check the website for dine-in dates. I did and was not dissatisfied 😋

I was very excited to try this place because Nigerian food is one of my favorite cuisines. The service was good, everyone was nice, but the food was okay. Very very small portions of meet are served in your food. The chicken with jollof was 98% rice. But the okra soup w. beef I ordered was pretty good in flavor, except I had one small piece of beef that was super hard and inedible, I thought it was a bone at first. Anyways we were sad to have this experience as we were super excited to try this for a long time.

formatted_address: 2876 Airline Blvd, Portsmouth, VA 23701, United States
name: ES African Kitchen

reviews.text: I would give zero stars if I could. This place is unbelievably slow — we’ve been waiting over an hour just for fufu and egusi! No updates, no apologies, nothing. It’s ridiculous to make customers sit this long for a basic meal. Completely unprofessional and disappointing. I’ll never come back here again. The man at the front also wasn’t welcoming at all and looks like he hates his life and his job. If you’re hungry, don’t come here — unless you plan on starving for an hour first. Apparently, fufu and egusi take longer to make than a five-course meal! No communication, no urgency, just vibes. Save your time and your sanity. Mind you we came here all the way from Yorktown just to try their  food.

I had the absolute best jollof rice and oxtail from ES African Kitchen! I’ve tried jollof rice from across the diaspora, but this one was truly next level; hands down the best I’ve ever had. Every bite was pure heaven. The vegetables had the perfect crunch, the rice was bursting with rich flavor, and the oxtail was melt-in-your-mouth tender.

Yes, there was a bit of a wait, but honestly, food this good is always worth it. The sobolo was the perfect complement , a beautifully balanced blend of hibiscus and ginger that hit all the right notes.

Please do yourself a favor and support this amazing business. You won’t be disappointed!

My sons and I tried this place for his school project. He had to try a different country’s food and he chose Africa. We found ES African Kitchen on google. The lady there is so nice and attentive. She showed us how to eat the fufu and egusi and she washed our hands before doing so. She even provided smaller plates so that we could try each other’s food. I’m unsure of what it should taste like so I cannot really say if it was good, bland, etc. I will say it was worth trying something new and I will recommend it to anyone wanting to try African dishes.
Tried fufu and spicy egusi with chicken for the first time. It was so good!!! First time trying Ghanaian food, and SO worth it!! Highly recommend. Mum, thanks so much for the amazing dish!

If you want delicious authentic African food this is your spot!  We ordered the Jollof Rice with curry goat & light soup. Couldn’t wait to get home to eat, so we started eating the Jollof rice and curry goat in the car. The jollof rice is moist and flavorful and the goat meat is lean and tender. It was so good, we called the restaurant to inquire about catering our upcoming event and she graciously accepted.  Can’t wait to get home to try our light soup.  If you want delicious and authentic African food and great customer service, this is the spot.

formatted_address: 2544 Bank St, Ottawa, ON K1T 1M9, Canada
name: Detola's Kitchen - Nigerian/African Cuisine

reviews.text: I went there with my friend yesterday to try some Nigerian food. We ordered a few things from the menu but they were all delicious and properly spiced. Will definitely come back here again and recommend the restaurant to anyone who wants to taste Nigerian food!

Flavourful and delicious food, just a bit too oily for my liking. Jollof rice had a good fiery kick. Beef was lean and tender. Chicken was tasty. Plantains were soft and sweet. Coleslaw was nice and tangy. Restaurant looks new. It's brightly lit and clean. Service was pleasant. I got the Ajebutter Chicken and Beef Combos. Looking forward to trying other items, like the Moi Moi.

Had an absolute good time here trying out the Nigerian food. Spicy lovers, come on down. If you’re opting for the combo, the sides are on the smaller portion. So if you want more, should order them separately.

I would have probably given a 4 star review because I typically like the food (their suya wrap is the best I’ve had in Ottawa). However, I will give a 1 because they really need to do something about their customer service. The owner herself is cool but the person that answers the phone is extremely rude for no reason. I’ve called in to put in my order and so has my husband - each time, we’ve been met with disappointingly rude behaviour. It’s really discouraging sometimes when I want good food but remember that I have to deal with their rude phone staff.

First time trying Nigerian food and it was really good! Jollof rice and the meats were seasoned perfectly and the spice kick was just right. My favourite though was the plantains which were sweet and not greasy. The egusi and fufu combo were yum too.
Overall - friendly staff, clean and spacious restaurant and reasonably priced. The only downside is it took around one hr and 10 mins for our food to be prepared and served. The homemade quality and taste of the food made up for it, but still quite a long wait time. Great experience otherwise. Will be coming back!

formatted_address: 7365 W Sahara Ave b, Las Vegas, NV 89117, United States
name: Pretty Soul Kitchen

reviews.text:
I visited Pretty Soul Kitchen in Las Vegas after seeing Keith Lee’s recommendation on TikTok, and I’m glad I did! When I arrived, I was greeted by a friendly young lady who provided excellent customer service. I was the only guest at the time, so she walked me through the menu and gave great suggestions.
I decided on the Catfish Soul Bowl, which included two catfish fillets, collard greens, cornbread, and mac & cheese for about $33. The food was flavorful and satisfying. My only critique is that the collard greens had a lot of stems—quite a few—but they still tasted great overall.
The location offers plenty of parking, which is a big plus. It’s not near the Strip, so you’ll definitely need a car to get there, but I enjoyed being away from the hustle and bustle. Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my meal and experience. Thank you, Pretty Soul Kitchen—I’ll definitely be back!

I was in Vegas for a few days and was told that the food here was absolutely delicious. I was also warned that the service wasn’t good. However, we were greeted, seated, and served by Schanelle, who was extremely warm, friendly, and welcoming. We arrived about an hour too late for brunch, yet she went in the back and found me a couple of biscuits (they’re available during brunch hours only). Schanelle was a pleasant surprise based off the reviews I had seen online and the warning I received from my referral. Nevertheless, I was thrilled with her service and my shrimp basket. My honey and best friend ordered the shrimp and grits. He loved it but I wasn’t too crazy about either. If I’m ever in Vegas again and hungry… I’d definitely visit again. The vibe was cool too. The female DJ was nice and kept us bouncing to the beat. Thanks, Schanelle for excellent service and for being so personable.

I love to support black owned business ❤️ I'm giving it 3 stars because the food it was okay. The greens had too many large stems. Fish was decent. Soul rolls were good. Bartender gave us our food before our appetizer. I think she forgot to ring it in. We did get a free shot so that was cool. $19 for a drink and $12 for a side of yams is insane. I paid it but overall I give this place a 5/10 bar was empty but dirty they wiped it off with a wet towel but didn't dry it. Customer service I'll rate it a 7/10. My friend had the spaghetti and fish the spaghetti was watery tho. They got some work to do but I think they can get it together.

Ok y'all, I stopped in for lunch at Pretty Soul Kitchen on West Sahara right past Rainbow to the left behind L.A. stereo.
I had the catfish sliders my coworker had the smothered chicken mash potatoes and cabbage. We split some soul rolls. The food was well seasoned. The soul rolls was not what I expected. Full of favor, chicken, sweet potato and Mac and cheese. If you are looking for a culture food experience this is the place to try out. I have to go back for bunch to give the a grade.
Stop by and tell me what you think. #prettysoul

The restaurant had a nice vibe with a dj playing music until around 4pm. The service was a bit off. There was a 20-30 minute wait for catfish so we ordered appetizers, which we did not get until after our actual meals came out. It took about 30 minutes for me to receive my drink, which I had to let the server know I had not received it yet. The food was okay. It was a bit to salty or too much seasoning for my liking but good. I got a fried shrimp bowl. I had to take the batter off the shrimp to eat it due to the excess seasoning. The atmosphere was great. Good vibes and there was a dj playing some great hip hop & R&B music. They were very busy, so a reservation is highly recommended. Not sure if I'd go back and try them again but we'll see.

ood was mediocre.

formatted_address: 3430 E Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89121, United States
name: Zenaida's Cafe and Catering

reviews.text: I really enjoyed my meal here! The Micky Mouse pancakes were delicious—fluffy, sweet, and full of flavor. The steak and eggs were overall very good as well. My brother ordered the biscuits and eggs, and he liked them too. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, with jazz music playing in the background, and the staff were so kind and attentive. They even gave out complimentary cookies, which was such a sweet touch to end the meal. Overall, a wonderful spot for a lovely breakfast!

I visited this restaurant for the first time this morning and I absolutely loved the experience. The food I had and the service provided was AMAZING!!! I love the ambiance especially the Jazz and Blues wall art. I met the owner Chef Sterling C. Burpee, he was very courteous and friendly. The Complimentary Chocolate Chip Cookie served at the end is freshly made by his wife. The food was freshly made by his son. I will definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone and I definitely look forward to future visits.

Start with a glorious sugar bomb in the best possible way by ordering a giant cinnamon roll. It comes dripping with homemade whipped cream and crowned with fresh berries. It's decadent and absolutely worth it.

I highly recommend you order something Savory for breakfast if you had a sweet appetizer like we did. I'm glad I ordered the breakfast tacos. We also had a Belgian waffle that was light, warm, and topped with berries.

The baked French toast was pillowy, rich, and balanced thanks to the fruit and whipped cream.

The staff? Warm, quick, and on top of things.

And just when we thought it was over, they dropped off 3 incredible chocolate chip  cookies that were. A sweet kiss goodbye.

We were so hungry we didn’t even think to take photos until the plates were half-devoured, and honestly, that’s the mark of a good meal. No fluff. No filters. Just flavor.

From the first bite of the very first item we ordered. OHH MYYY LOORRD!! 🤤 amazing cinnamon roll! The whipped cream is soooo fresh and homemade. Delicious and I’m not even a whipped cream person.
And then the bacon. Cut from the slab. Wow! I see the place from the outside and not impressed but it’s always these places with the best food. This place is QUALITY!
And to close the amazing breakfast off we were given fresh out the oven chocolate chip cookies. This place is the best!
THANK U REBECCA! You’re sweet and a great server. All the staff was friendly and offered assistance. Great team atmosphere. Such a welcoming place! Hidden gem!

The better of the two to me was the baked french toast. I'm not going to lie, when I see whip cream on any french toast I always assume it's going to be straight out of can. Because I saw high praise from this place we decieded to order it because it looked good on yelp. We rolled and eight for the point and it was fantastic! Not going to lie, that french toast gave me peace that day. the whip cream was made with love and attention to detail. Fresh fruits were fantastic to the meal. The bread was just SCRUMPTIOUS. I might mess around and come back and order the two exact plates.

formatted_address: 2004 Pulaski Pike NW, Huntsville, AL 35810, United States
name: Suya Parlor

reviews.text: When I say the food was good ! It was absolutely amazing !!!! I bought the Jollof Rice and the Suya Loaded Fries. The way the chicken fell off the bone though… OMG… I will definitely be back very soon !!!! The service was great, food was amazing, and the restaurant was very clean !!! Then to finish off, I bought a Zobo to drink and it was to die for!!!! It was sweet but not too sweet, just how I like it !!! Deserves a 100/100🔥🔥

TLDR: the people are kind, the food is good, they are way underprepared for their viral fame, they need more hands in the kitchen and seats for the guests. If you go now, you’ll probably wait way too long.

I was SO excited to try this place, and the food was good, and the people very kind, so this was a really hard review to write.

This restaurant went somewhat viral in a TikTok posted 8/13, where a Huntsville guy tried them out and raved about it, and I think they have struggled since then. If you look back, there were no negative reviews about long wait times before that timeframe. I suspect they weren’t at all prepared to become a sensation overnight, and are a bit of victims of their own success.

The food wasn’t without room for improvement but it was genuinely good. I could eat the beef meat pies all day every day. Asun (goat meat) and Suya (beef—very spicy!) were excellent.

However, we waited 15 minutes at least just to place our order, then were told it would be a 45 minute wait on food. Not ideal but I know Nigerian food often takes time and I was really excited. It actually took an hour and 10 minutes, meaning we were there for 1 hour 25 minutes.

There is only one 8x11 paper laminated menu  that had to be passed around, no tables or chairs (only one short bar seating that had 2-3 chairs), and about 10-15 people standing, waiting an hour+ for food. The lights weren’t even on in the area I suspect they mean to make a dining area, or in the bathrooms.

I also want to verify the experience of the prior 1 star review from Stacey— I don’t know her, but she was in line ahead of me, waiting at the front counter, for 15-20 minutes that I was there. She told me she had a pickup order and was waiting understandably frustrated that she hadn’t even been able to say she just needed her order. When the time came to tell the cashier, she said “oh, your order just came through! I’ll approve it now and send it to the kitchen to be made”. It was clear that this customer had NOT *just* placed that order as she’d been waiting with me to pick up the whole time I’d been there!

Great food!  The small staff was so informative and sweet.  They brought us a free same of o e of their signature dished and it was amazing.  The only drawback was the lack of seating.  Right now it is more of a to-go place.  However, I still give it a 5.

This place is well worth the wait. I got the Jollof rice with Suya beef, a meat pie, and a zobo drink. Everything tastes amazing but just know they are still new so they don't have any dine in tables and they just got promoted on TikTok so the wait was pretty long(~45min-1hr) around lunch time. However the staff was super nice and apologtic of the wait. Hopefully they stay successful cause I want to go back.

Customer service is amazing! They are so sweet and welcoming. The food is made fresh to order so if you’re in a rush it’s best to order ahead. I ordered the Suya loaded fries & the pepper soup with goat. 10/10 and I def will be back. Portions are pretty good for the price as well.

formatted_address: Baumschulenstraße 88, 12437 Berlin, Germany
name: Berlin Naija Foodie

reviews.text: The owner cook with heart! The food is always fresh and warm. We also ordered catering from this restaurant for an event and we was very satisfied! I can’t wait for the moment when we’ll be able to eat inside.
Really really good food and friendly staff. We live close by and will be regulars. Wishing you the most success in this business. Happy 2026 and God bless. 😊
Such a welcome addition to the Neighbourhood. We picked up some food to take home, great friendly service and the food was fantastic. Can’t wait to keep going back and trying the whole menu!

Truly authentic Nigerian taste in Berlin!

I recently visited Berlin Naija Foodie and was absolutely amazed. Their food delivers the authentic flavors of Nigeria—you really feel as if you’ve been transported straight to Lagos with every bite.

The service was warm and genuine—they treat you not just as a customer but like family. The use of fresh and locally sourced ingredients makes the quality even better. It’s rare to find such authentic representation of Nigerian cuisine in Berlin.

If you are searching for true Nigerian flavors in Berlin, this is the place to go. I highly recommend trying their fried meat, jollof rice, and fried plantain (if available) or classic dishes like Egusi Soup with Pounded Yam—flavorful, hearty, and simply unforgettable.

In short: Comfort, flavor, and hospitality—at Berlin Naija Foodie, you’ll find all three combined with true Nigerian warmth. Definitely worth a five-star rating!
Much love to the lady working there. She let me sit inside and eat my food although they weren’t open for dine in yet. Jollof rice w plantain and chicken was soo delicious

formatted_address: 3 Berners St, London W1T 3LD, United Kingdom
name: Enish Oxford Street

reviews.text:
I visited Enish with my family and a friend, and we were treated to a hearty taste of Nigeria right in the heart of London. We ordered three different soups with pounded yam - bitter leaf, egusi, and efo riro - and each one was rich, flavorful, and deeply satisfying. The portions were generous, especially the soups, which came steaming hot and full of depth.Unfortunately, my wife didn’t enjoy her yam porridge as much. She found the tomato base a bit too sharp and the overall taste lacking compared to yam porridges she'd had before. That said, the rest of us were thoroughly satisfied with our meals.The service was warm and attentive. Special shoutout to Tomi, who served us with professionalism and a friendly demeanor that made the experience even better.
The ambience is distinctive - walls adorned with vibrant paintings and artificial greenery that give the space a moody, club-like feel. While it’s consistent across Enish locations, I personally prefer brighter lighting during meals, especially at lunch. The darker tones felt more suited to nightlife than dining.
Expect a wait time of around 20 to 30 minutes, but it’s well worth it when the food arrives piping hot and full of flavor.If you're looking to have fresh fish as part of your meal, it would help to call in advance with your order.Overall, I’d definitely recommend Enish to anyone craving authentic Nigerian cuisine in London. Just come hungry – and maybe skip the yam porridge.

A must try. We went back, no exaggeration, 3 separate times for lunch or dinner. We just had to try other items on the menu. Everything we ordered (fried yam with peppers sauce, asun, plantain, jollof, egusi and pounded yam, goat meat sauce) was delicious!

Service was professional. They generally don’t have an upbeat energy or any spectacular personalities and they were not rude either. Just mellow workers focused on their roles.

Ambiance is good to seat and enjoy your meal.

Walk in’s accepted but know that each time we went, they were at least 60-70% full as it is a small space so make an appointment if possible. We stayed at the Edition hotel just two doors down so it was easy to just walk over.

If all else fails, Nando’s is next door.

Highly recommend Enish! Looking forward to try other locations.

Only feedback to the establishment: Maybe add an aroma360 or automatic scent dispenser to manage the strong smell of traditional dishes. Delicious but typically smell so that the cozy area could always smell fresh.

It was quite busy when we arrived so we waited a little but were seated quickly. We had Egusi with Pounded Yam and their Abula with chicken. We also had some plantain on the side. It was all very delicious but a lot more expensive than most people would be used to paying for this type of cuisine (I personally didn’t mind). We had the African Fanta x2, again which was more expensive than I can imagine people being used to at £8 per bottle. Great dining experience overall.

Overpriced food and it wasn’t tasty. Things are very expensive there. The lady who was at the front of the restaurant wasn’t welcoming. No smiles and was very strict n straightforward. Took them a while to take my order and also took them a while to bring my order. I ordered something simple but wasn’t expecting what I got. Giving them 2 stars cuz the two ladies at the bar were smiling when I requested for an info. The guy who served me added service charge without my notice n approval. I asked him why, and he was saying erh it’s a tip… I told them from the service they provided me I can’t tip them so he should take it off. He told he has, but he didn’t. I had to go to the bar to pay for my order cuz they were delaying and I was running late. That was where I asked the ladies to take the service charge off which they took it off after couple of words exchange (the ladies at the bar weren’t rude tho). For the lady at the front gate, omg! she was so bossy. This happened like 2-3 months ago. I’m really not going back there. Tasteless and saltless plain rice. The only thing I liked was their fried ripe plantain
The place was very nice,very delicious food,very good music(dj kudos),Mary was offered great service,very helpful while ordering. It was our first time.It’s a must come back plot! BEST AFRICAN FOOD!

formatted_address: Pat's Delicious African Restaurant, 4616 Cleveland Ave, Columbus, OH 43231, United States
name: Pat's Delicious Nigeria Restaurant

html_attributions: Pat's Delicious Nigeria Restaurant (QUALITY)(Best Igbo Food) EXHILARATING TASTE•

reviews.text: Stopped by to get egusi and pounded yam. It never disappointed. The heat level was to my liking. Respectable mother and daughter who prepare and take your orders respectively. Friendly people with great food. Try them out, please. I ate it while driving, I just couldn’t wait.
Try the food for the first time. Amazing 👏🏾 excellent service. Made me feel very welcome. Will come back when I am in Columbus again.

My sister and I came before the dinner rush and got to have personal time with Pat, the owner, where we talked about how to eat fufu and just life in general. Pat provided amazing service. As soon as we sat down she gave us chin chin and gave us recommendations. The food was authentic and the jollof was delicious

We found Pats Delicious on Google and we decided to have  a little bit of everything and honestly it was Amazing. The food was a 10/10 and very authentic. My friend was smiling because she got extra cow skin. Great place and absolutely amazing customer service ❤️would definitely eat here again when we’re back in town.

We stopped in to try fufu and egusi soup because the girls had seen it on TikTok and were dying to give it a try! Our food was delivered by THE Pat and she was so kind and sweet! She talked to us for a few minutes and taught the girls how to eat it. Unfortunately the didn’t really care for it (they are very picky), but the adults liked it! Loved the warm welcoming atmosphere too! We will be back to try other dishes, maybe next time without the girls! 😂

formatted_address: 116 Person St, Fayetteville, NC 28301, United States
name: Taste Of West Africa

reviews.text:
I had an amazing first experience at T.O.W.A! The food was absolutely delicious — the egusi, fufu, chicken, and veggies were all cooked perfectly and full of flavor. Everything tasted warm, comforting, and truly like home.

I also want to give a special shoutout to Giuliano. His customer service was outstanding! He answered all of our questions with patience, kindness, and real knowledge about the dishes. He made us feel welcomed and taken care of from the moment we walked in.

I’ll definitely be returning, and I highly recommend this place to anyone wanting authentic West African food and great service.

We visited today and Taste of Africa is an absolute gem! Every dish was packed with rich, bold flavor, and we could truly taste the love in the food. The atmosphere was so welcoming, our waitress and the staff were super sweet, attentive, and helpful.
We left full, satisfied, happy, and are already planning our next visit. If you’re looking for some authentic flavor and amazing service, Taste of Africa is the place!

Its a really pretty place with a cozy REAL feeling. I feels like a loved restaurant, the food is also AMAZING! the seasoned rice jolaf with talapia was to die for with plenty to take home too! The mango passionfruit juice is also delightful! Jazz my server was very nice and patient with me! 40000000/10 food would stay forever.

I really enjoyed coming to this restaurant and getting a new experience trying African food for the first time. My food was delicious! The staff were very kind, and the atmosphere is beautiful. They didn’t have one of the things I ordered to go with my meal, but the chef kindly offered to sub it with something else. I’d highly recommend this spot to anyone! Thank you for the great food and service.

Never disappointed, the food always tastes delicious and the service is always outstanding. Each dish is crafted with care, showcasing a perfect blend of flavors that keep patrons coming back for more. The staff is attentive without being intrusive, ensuring that every need is met promptly. It's a place where the ambiance complements the culinary experience, making every visit feel special. Whether it's a casual lunch or a celebratory dinner, the restaurant consistently exceeds expectations.

formatted_address: 1391 Walter Reed Rd, Fayetteville, NC 28304, United States
name: Pointone African Cuisine

reviews.text:
A must stop when I am in town visiting. I hadn’t been home in a couple years and was seeing mixed reviews. I’m so glad I didn’t listen because the quality is just as good as I remember and the flavors are phenomenal. The service was great and the server/cashier was so kind.

I used to get egusi with fish, but this time I tried okra stew with fish. It was even better than the egusi stew I love! My siblings would not stop stealing my food because it was so good. I saw some complaints about how long the food takes, but everything is made to order and fresh. It is so worth the wait and I am looking forward to the next time I’m in town to get some more good food.

Beef Eugusi soup …. Unbelievably gross. It was not edible, it smelled burnt and tasted flat out burnt. I called to question if it was supposed to taste like that and lady who I spoke to said it’s supposed to taste burnt from the melon seeds. This tasted like charcoal. I feel like there’s no way it should have tasted the way it did. I had everyone at work try it and did not like it either. They agreed it tasted burnt. It was $25.00 for something I unfortunately had to toss out after I had one bite. I wanted to enjoy this meal so bad, I’m a foodie and not picky at all. My friend recommended Taste of West Africa and after she tired my food she could not believe how terrible and not edible it was. She said it should not taste like that. This place was closest to my job, so came here instead.  This meal really was not a go for me, I typically do not leave bad reviews but I had to for this one. Photo’s shown are after myself and 3 other co workers tried it and as you can see didn’t make a dent , barely touched. The yam ball has grease from the egusi soup, from tasting it. Portion was great sadly it was not good.

We finally had an opportunity to try Point One and it did not disappoint. Fayetteville desperately needs more authenticate food experiences and this one hits home. This is truly authenticate African cuisine and I love that it has not been watered down to fit the American palate.  The flavors are bold and the spice levels are on point. Because of the intricacies associated with preparing these dishes, I recommend dining in when you have time to spare or consider ordering ahead.

The service was amazing and the young lady that helped us that was extremely patient and made great recommendations. We will be repeat offenders and intend to return often. Thank you for a great experience!

I ordered the pepper soup and it was not pepper (light soup) soup.it was salty water with browning absolutely no tomato base at all with pieces of bone of goat meat. This was awfully serve to me as a take out. I wish it was not late too return this bowl of salty water. No where near authentic. I really wanted this meal for warmth and illness. It was a horrible $20 wasted!!! I DO NOT NEED another apology for not meeting my expectations. You are a place of business that SUPPOSED to provide a service to customers. With the way the economy is today and keeping your business afloat with food orders at your place of establishment costing $20-$30, it’s like you’re providing dishonest services. Make good to the customers that spend their hard earned money. No you cannot please everyone, but there is absolutely some way to know with all the dissatisfied reviews your establishment is raking in. No apology for me. Remake my meal correctly for what I spent….Period!!!

The food is amazing you just have to know what to order. The Banga Soup with Chicken and fufu is the best hands down! I eat it almost everyday and do not need another meal all day afterwards. It is spicy, my second favorite is Spinach Soup then the okra (this one is extremely spicy to me). The egusi soup is not good to me but thats my preference. I do not think it’s the restaurants fault just my pallet prefers the banga instead.  The only con is it is pricey for the serving size I would like more soup if I’m spending $25-$30 each time.

formatted_address: 7870 Culebra Rd, San Antonio, TX 78251, United States
name: ULTRA KITCHEN (RESTAURANTS & CATERING )

reviews.text: I tried this place to be open about what they offered. Unfortunately it wasn’t as good as I hoped. The food was just too spicy & greasy for me personally. My favorite thing was surprisingly the egusi & fufu. Which is a dish the owner gave me a little free portion sample to try. I didn’t like the beef tripe of it all but other than that…it was good to me. I originally ordered the suya with coconut rice, a side of jollof rice, a beef pattie, and a pineapple ginger juice. I was pretty disappointed with the suya because there wasn’t very much of it on the plate. There was mostly a lot of rice. For the time I waited…I was hoping it would be more tender and not tough to eat. A lot of the food had like this maybe smoky after taste that I wasn’t a fan of. It didn’t smell or taste all that great. It didn’t really seem like a clean cook either. But I could be wrong…idk. I was mostly excited for the plantain but it wasn’t really my favorite. That aftertaste of whatever they cook their food on ruined it for me. They were okay. The beef pattie was okay but dry. He did give me this sauce that made it less dry. The owner did mention that I probably wouldn’t be coming back to eat there but I might seriously consider trying their yam & egg to see what’s that like. I will also say that the person helping me tried to be very accommodating to me my first visit. Which I appreciate but I have to be honest on my personal experience & opinion with the food. I do wish the tables were wiped down better as well during my visit.

We’ve been searching for a good smoky jollof rice and suya beef we once had, never could find any quite matching. Alas! We came across Ultra Kitchen and their jollof rice and beef suya are on point! Beef we think they make it even better, more tender!
My husband and son found this place first and insist that’s the first place we needed to go after my months long trip away. They were so right!!
The service is excellent. A very family business and so warm and friendly! The place is very clean and nice as well. Overall such an enjoyment.
We licked the plates (see our before and after pics!) and definitely will be a usual there from now on! We still need to try their fufu and other dishes!

A note, to make sure to give some extra 20 minutes or so for the food to be ready. It takes time, effort and heart to make such wonderful meals! And it’s totally worth the wait!

Came later in the night and the service was amazing. She helped me pick out what she thought I’d like and it was absolutely delicious. We picked out the peppered snails, egusi, jollof rice, and okra soup and it was absolutely delicious! I love a good slimy okra and the seasoning was so good, the jollof rice was smoky but perfectly done, the egusi was everything I thought it’d be and the snails were great with this delicious tomato/pepper sauce. The service was impeccable honestly. They were so kind and helpful and I’ll definitely be back

We tried the beef suya, jollof, egusi, and goat meat pepper stew. Everything was amazing!! And the staff was incredibly warm and welcoming! I’m from out of town, so the chef even showed me how she makes the jollof rice so I can do it at home (although I’m sure mine won’t be nearly as good). We loved it!

This tasted so good. I ordered through uber eats, amala, gbegiri, ewedu and assorted meat. I also ordered suya beef . It was good too. I’m currently eating as I send this message. You have to try it. 10/10 you won’t be disappointed. I thought the meat won’t be enough, I ordered extra meat but I was shocked that there was a lot of assorted meat and stews was more than enough. This food made my day omo , kudos  to the chefs

formatted_address: 3300 S Decatur Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89102, United States
name: Mesob Ethio Fusion

reviews.text: I loved the food at Mesob. Semirah was lovely, she is very sweet and generous, she invited me to have some coffee after doing the beautiful ceremony with incense which smelled so good and the coffee was delicious. I got the veggie plate and it was all vegan and so yummy. Next time I am back in Vegas I will definitely be back!
Food was delicious and service was outstanding. Came here with my family and we all loved it here. This was our first time trying Ethiopian food and we will definitely be back!
So friendly here! Food was delicious. Definitely share- plates are very large and Intended to be shared. Wonderful time. Very down to earth.
Best spot!!! Super clean!! So tasty!! So vegan friendly !! Family owned !!! very grateful to have this place serving the community food for the soul

I have a sensitive stomach and tend to be mindful of quality and ingredient balance, so I was curious to see how a “fusion” twist on Ethiopian cuisine would hold up. I ordered the veggie platter. I could definitely tell where the fusion influence came in; the dishes had a creative spin that set them apart from the more traditional stews I’ve enjoyed over the past 20 years.

Notably, the Gomen (which is typically made with collard greens) included peppers, giving it a unique and interesting flavor. I only wish the peppers had been cooked down a bit more for that signature tender texture, but I could tell the chef had put real thought into the preparation.

I was a little disappointed in the cabbage and potato stew, as the potatoes were slightly undercooked, and I also felt the portion size was on the smaller side for the price — I usually have leftovers, but this time I didn’t.

On the bright side, the yellow lentils were magnificent; smooth, rich, and full of flavor. They really stood out as the highlight of the meal.

What truly made this visit special, though, was the staff and chef. They were incredibly kind and welcoming, with a clear passion for both the cuisine and the community.
If you visit, take a moment to chat with the chef — he’s full of knowledge about the area and the inspiration behind the dishes.

formatted_address: Peckham Palms, 14 Bournemouth Cl, London SE15 4PB, United Kingdom
name: The Flygerians - Peckham

reviews.text:
First time at Flygerian and I am pleasantly surprised at the quality and tastiness of the food - absolutely delicious 10/10! The service was also excellent, chilled yet professional. The ambience was also lovely with good Naija music playing.
I had the Jollof suya box, supa dupa wings and gizdodo…yum! I’m glad I dined in because I thoroughly enjoyed my experience.
Keep it up @The Flygerians

10/10 wonderful customer service, Fantastic food, great ambiance, great prices. Ade serving was fabulous! and another lady but we didn’t get her name, we’re both wonderful  We definitely will be back again! Thank you & God Bless.

The food was amazing, this is the second time I went and the presentation and taste was I would give a 10/10. The atmosphere and decor was beautifully kept with notes of  Nigerian culture and hints of Peckham culture.
Will definitely come again!

The food, absolutely spectacular. 10/10. We went when it was pretty empty but it's such a nice spot and the price, personally, was perfect. Big portions too. Go here for one of the nicest food spots in Peckham
A lovely restaurant with a kind and cheerful owner. It was my first time trying Nigerian food, and I thoroughly enjoyed it! Thank you for such a wonderful experience.

formatted_address: 7600 Eckhert Rd #3, San Antonio, TX 78240, United States
name: Trices Cafe and Lounge

reviews.text: Love the ambience. The waitress was so kind and professional. The food was delicious! Everything we ordered was simply tasty! I will definitely come again! We ordered so many things: Efo riro with Pounded yam, Amala with Gbegiri and Ewedu, Catfish pepper soup, Coconut rice with chicken, and Goat meat pepper soup! I can’t complain. As you can see the plates were empty and we had to take home leftovers. We ordered so much food not knowing if we would like what we ordered and they delivered! Thank you to the Trices team.

Ok.. I need to be honest and candid, because I want to ensure my reviews are reputable.

I’ve been wanting to try African food for a WHILE and have seen a ton of videos of people eating fufu and wanted to try it for myself. I’ll start with this overall summary… it’s definitely an acquired taste! If you like ethnic foods like Mexican and Indian food, I think you’ll like this.

Most of our table ordered Joloff rice, because I think that’s the most accepted dish for unacquainted Americans. It’s a flavorful rice made with a tomato sauce and spices swerved with the meat of your choice. Expect it to be large pieces of meat. My wife got chicken and it was three huge drums with sauce. My brother in law got tilapia, and it was literally the whole fish chopped in two pieces, bones and all. The meat was tender and delicious though.

I wanted something with Fufu (a hammered yam dough-like ball that looks like bread and kind of has the consistency of a starchy or thick mashed potato), so they recommended the egusi soup. Wanting to really go authentic (since I love trying different foods from different cultures) I got the assorted meats, and in retrospect, I should have gone just beef or chicken. This had tripe in it, some other meat, and something I couldn’t even identify. Maybe a layer of lamb fat or something. I like menudo so I’m good with tripe, but maybe should have taken it a little easier on my first go round. You get a piece of the fufu, then soak it in the soup and grab some food, the eat it like that. Again, it really reminds me of Indian food, and I thought it was really good, but it wasn’t for everyone at the table. My wife isn’t quite as adventurous so it was a no for her. I ate every last bite lol

So I definitely recommend trying it if you’ve never had African food but are an adventurous eater and like to try new things! Service was friendly and nice and the food was awesome :o).

My family and I have been on the hunt for the perfect place to experience Fufu for the very first time, and we finally found it! This restaurant's food is absolutely incredible! I was so stuffed, yet I couldn't help but want to keep eating because every bite was simply delicious. We’re already planning our next trip from Cibolo because it was that good! If you’re nearby or even just passing through, do yourself a favor and stop by for a bite—you don't want to miss out! We can't recommend it highly enough!

I have never had Fufu before as I wanted something different than I’ve already had and the wonderfully friendly worker HOOKED ME UP!!! So delicious to the last bite! My husband had the Jollof Rice with assorted meats and devoured that. We will definitely be back to try more! Don’t know why this place isn’t hopping but it should be!!

This was going to be my first time trying this type of food.  There was only one other person in the restaurant.  The server was not friendly at all.  Not even offered a cup of water.

I expressed I was not familiar with the menu and she continue to ask "do you know what you want?"  Not to mention the screaming baby the whole time I was waiting.  Needless to say, I did not stay, and if the food was like the service, I'm sure I would be unhappy with it as well.

formatted_address: 1911 Tamarack Cir N, Columbus, OH 43229, United States
