name: Drelyse African Restaurant

reviews.text:
Columbus, Ohio has many African restaurants, but Drelyse Restaurant truly stands out for its authentic Ghanaian dishes. The jollof rice 😋 is one of the best I’ve had—comparable to what I’ve enjoyed in Ghana and across several U.S. states.

Prices are very affordable, especially when compared to similar portions in states like MD, NY, VA, and NJ. The staff are warm and friendly, which makes the experience even better.

Highly recommended—you’ll be glad you tried it. Satisfaction guaranteed! 💯

I drove all the way from Toledo and received amazing service. The African food, including the egusi, fufu, plantains, and tilapia, was exceptional, deserving of six stars. The restaurant had a pleasant atmosphere and was very clean. I will definitely recommend and return. Thank you, Drelyse, for a six-star experience.
Been eating here for years and it’s always great. Full of flavor and worth it! Peanut butter soup w/ fufu is my favorite with a side of fried yams
Great food! The app works well. I ordered delivery through the app and had a great experience.

I love the Attieke. The flavor is unique but food is pricey(it’s worth it).
Don’t go there if you’re broke lol.
I’ve tried the Attieke with tilapia, banku with pepper and fish and also their fried plantains with lamb shank. They were all delicious….
Can’t wait to go back

reviews.text:

Absolutely would go here regularly

Lovely no frills place with a beautiful interior and great food. We are the vegetarian platter and foul. Also got a side salad. Food was better than other Ethiopian resultants I have been to across the country. We are the only ones eating there so it was a peaceful dinner. Highly recommend for vegetarian and vegan food.

If you're looking for authentic Ethiopian, this is a great choice. The Lamb Awaze Tibs were delicious and the Veggie Platter was very fresh. My only critique would be the portion of the Doro Wot; it only included one leg piece, which left us wanting a bit more protein for the table.
That said, the ginger tea is a must-try, and the staff is wonderful. Our server went above and beyond to explain everything to us.

4/26/25, This was my first time experiencing Ethiopian food.  I had the vegetable platter and it was very flavorful. Eating with injera bread and no utensils was actually satisfying. Service from Natalie was great and the atmosphere in the smaller dining area was nice and calm.

Photo on first shows kitfo what I got was mixed left over and when I called she said different kind of kitfo I order from them many times the first 2 times was great the last time was like this can’t tell what kind of meat and it tasted weird couldn’t eat it like they just mixed whatever they had and put in box.

formatted_address: 4755 W Flamingo Rd D, Las Vegas, NV 89103, United States
name: Yeshi Mart

reviews.text:
As part of my mini Ethiopian food tour, I stopped by Yeshi Mart and ordered the veggie platter. I have a sensitive stomach, so I’m always mindful of how my body reacts to different preparations and ingredients.

Unfortunately, my stomach didn’t respond well to many of the stews here, and the injera seemed to contain more than just teff flour; it had a noticeably lighter, almost white color, suggesting added wheat or other grains. That could explain why it didn’t sit well with me.

That said, the portions were very generous, and I appreciated that they provided extra injera with the meal. However, compared to other places I’ve tried , the food didn’t feel quite as fresh or carefully prepared. The flavors were mild and lacked the depth and balance I’ve come to expect after visiting several Ethiopian spots in the area.

If you’re looking for large portions and convenience, Yeshi Mart may still be worth a try; but for those with sensitive stomachs or gluten sensitivities, I’d recommend proceeding with caution or confirming ingredients ahead of time

I have lived in many cities around the country. As an Ethiopian, Yeshi's food, dishes, and injera are by far the healthiest and most delicious food I have come to love. Their injera is clean and doesn't upset my stomach. Their dishes are made from real, pure, and simple ingredients that are nurturing to the body without feeling full, one can reach satiety. I have been on a healthy, clean eating diet for a couple of years and Yeshi's food is where I go when I am not eating at home. It is primarily set up as a store but their food is beyond a restaurant options that are available in Vegas area. I recommend their veggie combo and Tibs.

Old days yeshi mart used to be great atmosphere even food amazing until another owner took over, I'm talking about 8-10 yrs ago 2 days ago I stop by yesterday to pick up my Togo order 💔 I order combination which is ketfo and  tibs so much oil not even organic butter its like graceys oil letter that even my stomach heavy bloating  i hope health administration will show up to door until fixing this is issue.

Exit the strip and try Ethiopian cuisine - you get huge portions fresh made (so take a little time) all under 20$. The Injera is hand made because what you cannot see is a huge bakery behind and also butchery. Of course it is finger food and if you dislike spicy meals just tell it - they are wonderful people and cook with lots of love.
I order them so often online that I feel guilty I am not giving other places a chance. I udually get the veggie combo, sometimes switch it up with a meat dish.

Whether you’re hanging out with friends or just looking for a laid-back place to decompress, this lounge delivers on comfort, flavor, and good energy.

We had a wonderful time at the Sky Cafe hookah lounge. The service was amazing. The staff is so nice and the hookahs are a 10 out of 10.  I also love the vibe and relaxing atmosphere! A must visit if your in Vegas!!!

Hands down the best hookah spot in Las Vegas! The vibe is chill, the hookah is top quality, and the customer service is unmatched. The staff is super friendly, attentive, and always make sure everything is perfect thank
from setting up your hookah to checking in without being overbearing.

They know their flavors and gave great recommendations. The lounge is clean, comfortable, and has a great atmosphere whether you’re coming with friends or just to relax solo.

If you’re looking for great hookah and 5-star service, this is the place. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I love coming to Sky Lounge when I want to unwind. The atmosphere is super cozy, the hookah is always great, and the service is amazing, staff really makes you feel welcome. Being open 24 hours is a huge bonus, especially for late-night hangouts. Definitely one of my go-to spots.

The host is an absolutely wonderful woman. Hookah was excellent.
Expect to spend around $40 for food and hookah.
Would recommend to anybody wanting to try hookah.

name: V ETHIOPIAN RESTAURANT AND HOOKAH LOUNGE

reviews.text:

Very casually run, mom and pop style? After midnight, maybe closer to 130am or 2am is when the place gets crowded. Someone mentioned it's difficult to be a DJ here. The DJ needs to play a bit of everything, because there's like 16 different countries worth of people just there at night. The music jumps around so much, it's difficult to get into it. Everyone is just waiting for their genre, dance and then sit back down. Music is loud. No EDM, thank goodness.

I've only been once and everyone was welcoming. Attire is casual to dressed loungey. I've only been once, and I was the only non- Black, African descent, Islander/Caribbean looking person there. We had an incredible experience at this Ethiopian restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing—flavorful, authentic, and beautifully presented. You could tell he took pride in the food and service, which made the meal even more enjoyable. I’ll definitely be coming back soon!

The waiter and waitress both explained about the food and the custom of eating with spongey bread instead of cutlery. It was amazingly delicious. There were many side dishes to dunk the bread ( injira) in shira wot? Sp? Was tantalizing to my taste buds!!! All the good food was washed down with a coke . Reasonable prices and we had lots of leftovers. Will go back again and have recommended to my friends.

My  friends and I recently had the pleasure of exploring the vibrant Ethiopian culinary scene in Las Vegas, and what a delightful experience it was! From the moment we stepped into  Ethiopian RestaurantChampagne Kitchen and Lounge,  Ethiopian Cuisine, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The inviting ambiance set the stage for an unforgettable dining journey filled with mouthwatering dishes. From the fragrant foment beselam to the succulent tibs and flavorful row meat, each bite was a true celebration of Ethiopian cuisine. Our taste buds were transported, and we found ourselves reminiscing about the rich flavors of Ethiopia with every dish. Great Ethiopian restaurant to go to if you’re in town. Lively place with indoor and outdoor seating, Great service, great atmosphere, decently priced with delicious food and drinks. Will go again most definitely.

I had such a wonderful time. The staff were polite and professional. Although the restaurant was totally filled up the staff had time for any questions we had and they were very attentive to us. The food was delicious. The food was very tasty and seasoned right. I highly recommend this restaurant.

I went here at the end of November and forgot to leave my review. I am so glad I remembered because they were extremely amazing. reviews.text: Stopped by on a long road trip through Las Vegas and it was absolutely amazing. The owner was very kind and great to talk to and the food was delicious. My first time eating Ethiopian food. It was " Amazing ! " The owner made sure my first time eating this Awesome food was an experience I would not forget ! Believe me I will not ! Can't wait to go back and eat more foods on the menu. Go there, you will not be disappointed !

The owners, Zee and his wife, are great. They are friendly and honest. The pricing is very affordable for the high quality Ethiopian products they offer. They have the best quality Ethiopian food and products I have found in Las Vegas. My wife will attest to that too. She is Ethiopian.
Had one of the best experience of an Ethiopian restaurant. Host/owner was very friendly and food was delicious. Love seeing owners who are attentive to their customers' needs.

Best customer service. The place is very clean and neat. The owner is very friendly and approachable. The  food server that served us has a good customer service skill.
We really enjoyed the food. I will recommend this restaurant to my friends and colleagues.

reviews.text: First of all the appetizers were so good it didn’t make my photo roll. The fresh hot pita bread was delicious with the eggplant spread. And the food just tasted so homey.

How have I lived in Vegas all these years and never been here. The food is amazing. The service was friendly and fantastic. I loved the grocery store attachment. I was able to find all the spices and seasonings I use to cook in larger quantities with more affordable prices than Amazon or Walmart. Absolute hidden gem!

I had an amazing experience at Zaytoon Restaurant, and it truly exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable, making it the perfect place to enjoy a great meal.
The food was absolutely outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. Every dish was full of rich taste and high quality ingredients, and you can really tell that a lot of care goes into the cooking. It was hands down some of the best food I’ve had.
The service was just as impressive. The staff was friendly, attentive, and professional, always making sure everything was perfect without being overbearing. They made us feel genuinely valued as guests.
10/10 the koobidehs taste like they do in Tehran, can’t get much closer than this. Beats every kabob shop in LA, phenomenal food and service. Nice stuff Zaytoon!

Get ready to immerse yourself in an unforgettable event that you won’t want to miss! It’s a unique experience like no other, packed with excitement and extraordinary moments that will leave you amazed. No need to rush—just come and enjoy every delightful moment!

second time coming and it's not a let down.  brought another friend and they enjoyed it as well.  once you climb to the top of a mountain, you either stay there or you descend. Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence. ... (4 stars)

The BEST South Asian restaurant in Las Vegas, without a doubt. We got the non vegetarian lunch special and it had so much food and each one tasted to unique in flavor. The chef prepares the food after you order, and we said if we can’t get goat, the chef then prepared two DIFFERENT chicken than just same one like most other places would. The atmosphere and the person serving was so warm and cozy. The food really brought up the South Asian culture and I highly recommend the lunch special as you get so much variety, two of us shared each one and we barely finished. This lunch special is a MUST TRY and the food was just phenomenal and full of flavor and spices and only for $15!!! Good food, good people, what more can you ask!!!

It was a great lunch at the restaurant. Found the food really authentic and hospitality was amazing. I think the price is also very good. The best part is not only the food is halal but also environmental is. The blessing of eating from a true halal business i believe.

Great food great service and friendly staff. The tea is very good as well. It will definitely wake you up. Excellent desi food especially maize (daal). We had a great conversation with the owners, who made sure it feels like home. From Pakistan 🇵🇰

Although I missed my chance to snap pictures of the food, I can attest that it was quite tasty. When we arrived at the restaurant, the dining room had already closed, so we had to get takeaway. Everything was well-designed and aesthetically pleasing. The staff members were very welcoming and accommodating. The chicken biryani was delicious, and the food was perfectly seasoned. will return.

formatted_address: 1710 44th St SE, Kentwood, MI 49508, United States
name: princess African Cuisine LLc

reviews.text:
Princess African Cuisine is an absolute gem in Kentwood! I ordered the jollof rice, egusi stew with goat meat, fufu, Puff Puff, and two different types of fried fish one of them being red snapper. Everything was absolutely delicious! The jollof rice was flavorful and perfectly seasoned, the egusi stew was hearty and comforting, and the goat meat was tender. The fufu paired beautifully with the dishes, and both fried fish options were crispy on the outside while moist and flavorful inside.

The Puff Puff was a real treat light, fluffy, and slightly sweet, the perfect way to round out the meal. I also loved the pepper sauce, which comes in both super spicy and non-spiced versions, giving you just the right amount of heat depending on your preference. The plantains were cooked perfectly, with a soft texture and a touch of natural sweetness, and I enjoyed a refreshing drink that tied it all together.

What makes this restaurant even more special is the owner and her beautiful family, who are from Liberia and bring a true West African flair to every dish. It’s authentic, welcoming, and full of love in every bite.

Princess African Cuisine is located on Kalamazoo and 44th (1710 44th Street, Kentwood, MI), and it’s a must-visit for anyone who loves bold, authentic flavors or wants to experience West African cuisine. Highly recommend!

The food at Princess African cuisine restaurant is top notch the best..for us that’s from the mother land this is a one stop shop to home..

We tried the atikeh and fish,and food oo.very delicious.

Princess and her staff are very accommodating and professional
Very welcoming host and delicious food. Puff puff was out of this world. Egusi, fufu and fish was finger licking good. Very clean and hygienic place. Highly recommend buying the hot sauce.

When I first came into this restaurant the first thing I notice is the amazing music. I rate the experience of this place a 10/10. The food I give it a 10/10. I recommend getting the extra spice sauce. The food was already amazing but when I put the spice sauce on the fish. My mouth exploded… the flavors in the sauce is amazing… but be aware.. it’s very spicy. 10/10 for everything. If I could I would order from here everyday.

I went to this restaurant over the weekend.. the food was amazing and very affordable.
And we met the owner princess who was such a wonderful host

reviews.text: The man is a very nice man. And this was my husbands first tine trying Nigerian food. It is very very delicious! So many flavors and the fufu is so delicious as well! Thank you so much! Next time we will compensate a tip for this time! 10/10 definitely recommend!
Travelled from Houston and stayed days looking for an African restaurant in Amarillo. And was glad to find one. A reasonable portion and taste close to my home made soup😀
I am a VERY picky person when it comes to food. I am so happy that I tried this place. The food tastes so good and it is SPICY which I love! They will definitely be seeing me again.

I am currently snacking on the most delicious piece of Felicia's African Milk Candy on my long drive back to Albuquerque. They gave me a sample of their tripe and with it I got to taste a little bit of what I have waiting for me when I get back home. Needless to say, my mouth is watering the entire ride back! 12/10 worth the 4 hour drive to get AUTHENTIC West African comfort food with the flavors you are looking for 🙏🏽 Keep being amazing Felicia!! Maybe one day I can convince you to make a permanent home in one of Albuquerque's food truck parks 👀

Felicia is awesome. The food is spicy but so good. If you want to try something new dont wait. Her and her family are super nice and the food is very good. Something I have never tried and glad I did. Thank you Felicia!

formatted_address: Bijlmerdreef 1288, 1103 JZ Amsterdam, Netherlands
name: African Kitchen Restaurant

reviews.text:
firstly, the food was very lovely and also very filling. You can tell that it is fresh because they took a while to prepare food. The atmosphere was very  Especially that atmosphere was very welcoming atmosphere atmosphere was welcoming.

Now this is the slight issue I had. I ordered “fried rice” with fish and as you can see in the photo of the menu, there is a side of plantain. unfortunately, you have to pay extra for the planting. Their waitress said that it was on the menu for presentation purposes however this is fourth advertisement. Just an advice, maybe Update the price to compensate for the sides of plantain or taking new photos without the plantain but then again, I understand the presentation is not gonna look the greatest.

I enjoyed the fried yam with tilapia. Great service.  The ladies need to learn how to smile more. Both ladies didn't seem happy to serve. The gentleman has always been nice during all my visits there.
This Nigeria/African restaurant has been my favourite eating spot whenever I am in Amsterdam. The service and food is delicious 😋. I will always recommend it whenever you are in Amsterdam or around.

I had the moin moin and some plantains. Great choice. The pepper soup was also a hit. Atmosphere was okay. It was a Saturday so they had old school music playing. Also, make sure you factor in it takes sometime to get your food.

My friends and I were hoping to enjoy some delicious West African cuisine, and we certainly did. The atmosphere was delightful, and we felt very welcomed. It was incredibly kind of the waiter to offer us a student discount. I will be sure to share my experience and plan to return soon.

formatted_address: 254 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5H 1X6, Canada
name: Nganda African Street Food

reviews.text:
i am so happy we found this restaurant!
so amazing all around, i wish i could give 10 stars!
the server was so nice and asked us if we needed any explanations of the menus or any recommendations. it was very fast service and she was so funny and kind! great welcoming and friendly vibe
the fufu and egusi was so mouth watering flavourful. i could eat it 10 times over
the jollof rice and suya beef was seasoned so well! the flavours worked so well together and was so delicious.
perfect portions for two people to share two dishes
the ginger beer was delicious and so was the mango juice
good prices for the fresh homemade cooking and good portion size
thanks for having us!

I am Korean and I am sure that every Korean like the foods in this restaurant,especially Poulet Mayo avec(grilled chichken with sauce) and Chikwange(it tastes like ddeok)

One of my classemate from Congo recommended this restaurant and the menus. I am very satisfied.
If you ordered large size, it is enough for 2-3 person.

I ate regular size with a friend.

Oh my god!

Just when I thought Toronto’s food scene was getting stale, this spot brought it back to life. I had the jollof rice, fufu, lamb, and chicken and every bite was full of flavor. Rich, spicy, comforting. The service? Even better. West African food done right.

Excellent African food. Suya was a bit tough but overall good. I was expecting it to be spicier but it was a good heat level.

Excellent service!

My friends and I found this place as we were walking along Adelaide. I love how each tables are named after west African cities. The ordering system is pretty advanced. Food tasted authentic and the chef/owner came by and ensured we had a great experience.

I am a massive fan of the 1er gaou and also the goat dish, and in love with the beef suya with jollof rice and the fish stew and fufu. The dishes were all from various west African countries and the owner sharing the origins gave a beautiful touch.

I wish this restaurant utmost success and I really want everyone to get a taste of west African food at Nganda. I cannot wait to bring people here in many more trips to come!

formatted_address: 4255 S Durango Dr, Las Vegas, NV 89147, United States
name: House of Dutch Pot Las Vegas

reviews.text:
Amazing find outside of the strip. This is a must go to spot if you want to try Jamaican food. Tried their combo meals of Oxtail and Jerk chicken and then Salmon and Coconut Shrimp. Both were good but I gotta give the best one to the Oxtail as it was very tender and their original sauces were really good.

We also ordered desserts: Bread pudding, carrot cake and cheesecake. We love everything especially the cheesecake.

Kudos to Chef O and Ashley who was an amazing waiter for us.

Found this place on Yelp and decided to try it out. We were greeted when we walked in and seated right away. We did put a reservation in before coming but it wasn't needed as the place was empty of dine in guests but had a steady take out service. We wanted to order the Red Stripe chicken wings but were told they were not available. So we got regular chicken wings and a jerk sauce. They were well cooked but lacked flavor. I ordered the Jerk Chicken and Jerk Shrimp with festival and a side salad. The main was super tender and very flavorful. The side salad, well, was horrible. The menu said it was to have a mango vinaigrette but it was served with ranch. My first time having festival and it was great. My friend had jerk chicken and jerk oxtail, also well cooked and flavored. He had garlic mashed potatoes. Just average missing the garlic flavor. He also had Mac and cheese which was really good. Over all a few misses but the meal was good. The biggest drawback was the competing music. Caribbean music in the dining area and Whitney Houston blaring in the kitchen area.  Also, these are fine dining prices and a casual restaurant. 128.00 for 2 people.

Open from 10:00am daily House of Dutch Pot lies tucked away in an area of failed concepts on Durango, the "first Jamaican Caribbean Authentic Restaurant" featured on Diner's, Dine-Ins and Dives making a go of it with friendly service and hearty Caribbean plates.

Helmed by St. Thomas native Chef Oniel Smith, the former occupants remembered only by circular lighting and blinged-out banquettes, House of Dutch Pot submerges guests in a sea of blue while music plays at medium volume over TVs showing sports.

Known as “Chef O,” his passion for Jamaican cooking evident across a menu that veers from tradition plates like Jerk Chicken to Mac & Cheese Oxtail Eggrolls, prices may look steep until one realizes most plates come with two sides beyond shareable portions.

Spread across starters including Coconut Shrimp and Tacos, six Cod Fritters for $15 more like Hushpuppies than Baccala, Food arrives quick whether one selects tender bone-in Goat Curry or one of several combos such as the $40 Oxtail and Jerk Chicken with their own complex Sauces.

Selling Seasoning on-site, the Jerk appropriately punchy with lingering heat, Seasoned Fries prove fairly basic in comparison to aromatic Rice, stretch handmade Roti or “Festival Bread” best compared to a Churro or Fritter more lightly sweetened with hints of Coconut.

Open from 10am daily, the space’s small footprint about 1/3 full for lunch on Sunday, Desserts should not be skipped as both Rum Bread Pudding and Carrot Cake arrive piping hot beneath stewed Fruit steeped in booze.
This place is beyond words! The food was infused with so much flavor that I've never experienced! I ordered the Ox tail and curry goat, with ox tail fried rice, which was to die for!!!

Katie was very kind and attentive! I told her it was my husband's bday and at the end of our lunch, she brought out a pineapple carrot cake and it was DELICIOUS! Oxtail and Jerk pasta were super flavorful and my Father said the Oxtail tacos are his go to meal now! Honestly, everything had so much flavor and spice, it was a great experience. Chef's kiss! Thank you all at House of Dutch Pot! We will be back!

formatted_address: 7320 S Rainbow Blvd #112, Las Vegas, NV 89118, United States
name: Soul Food Cafe

reviews.text: We not impressed at all! The specialty drink was EXTREMELY SUGARY. I was told by the waitress the red snapper dinner was 5 pieces, only to receive 2. When I asked the quanity the guy there dismissed me and I had to be forceful and inform him "had i not been told that, I would not have spent $30 on a 2 piece fish meal dinner!" He was not attempting to make it right, instead wanted me to simply accept the misconception. The lady checking out requested the order be corrected, but left with cat fish instead of red snapper (realized after i was home and ready to eat, what i thought was red snapper). My red beans and rice was not good at all, the beans were not fully cooked. My rice and gravy was plenty of rice with minimal gravy. I understand were in a certain time in the US but don't charge for quantity if you can't provide quality!!! Soda machine was not working, did not have the debit/credit terminal working. The lady before us had to get her order corrected over 3 times. The lady after us had to request to have the drink watered down due to the sugar amount and her food with less salt... A waste of my money and time. Not to mention the gentleman's poor customer service.

This is a home away from home. I’m actually on here now about to place an order for smothered chicken, Black Eyed Peas, macaroni and yams two complementary cornbread and of course a peach cobbler and some tropical punch Kool-Aid mix with a little lemonade always bring my people here from all over the world. #Vino🎬LoveYouMore!!
Great southern style food in a friendly lively environment.  Staff was very friendly. I had catfish, greens, and blackened peas for good luck for the new year.  Delicious!

Order ahead if you’re in a hurry! Because these cooks ain’t .. all they’re worried about is making some of the best food I’ve ever eaten!  and they had a bunch of celebrities on the wall that I didn’t know …but the food was amazing. Eat here today.

I have been in Vegas 4 days. Kenny ran this place with ease.  When I say it was our first time and we were nervous. This man was so accommodating, attentive and kind. The cornbread was hot water deliciousness. My catfish was fried to perfection. I don’t eat anyone’s greens, but my mom’s. He let me tase the greens 🔥. That lemonade and dessert delicious.  Please don’t at here you will not be disappointed.

formatted_address: 6197 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: African Spices

reviews.text: Worst chapatis ever. Do not buy their chapatis. They are burnt ,dry and greasy they taste like the been cooked 3 or 4 days ago and they are selling them. Please dont buy

I would give African Spice a 100/5 stars if I could for all of the above categories food, service, and atmosphere. Since my first time trying it, I honestly can't stop thinking about the food. The sambusa was the star of my very first visit with it being crispy on the outside and perfectly seasoned on the inside. It is just packed with so much flavor and a must have! You can tell it’s made fresh because every bite has that perfect crunch. It is definitely one of the best sambusas I’ve ever had. Another thing I love about African Spice is the customer service. It is family owned and you can feel the warmth as soon as you walk in. They are always giving me free samples to try of new dishes and desserts. Everything is done in a timely manner and made to perfection. Every time I went it genuinely felt like they cared about making the experience enjoyable. If you’re looking for delicious East African food with warm service then African Spice is absolutely worth a visit.

Food was delicious! We ordered the fufu with lamb, chicken squash, and some chicken sambusas and all of the dishes had a unique exquisiteness to them all served in generous portions. The man behind the counter was nice and allowed us to turn off the fan hitting our table when we got cold. We will definitely be back

We ordered the Fufu plate and the portions were enough for two of us to finish the plate. The fufu plate was full of aroma and flavor. We were given soups and bread to try while waiting for our food. 10/10 would go back and recommend
The only place where you can have best food is in the town of San Diego is here

formatted_address: 5241 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Taste of African Cuisine

reviews.text: The location of the restaurant might discourage you but the food is really good. After moving out of San Diego, I still drive an hour just to order my favorite rice and goat. Worth the drive !!!
Amazing food and genuine hospitality, they treat you like family! I love how humble the place feels.
Worst service out of all the Somali restaurants in the city. Matter of fact, worst service I’ve ever seen in any restaurant if you can call this a restaurant.

This had to have been the most "unpretentious" place I have ever eaten at in recent memory! I thought I had entered an auto repair facility but then I noticed some gentlemen sharing the evening Iftar meal. They beckoned me to a nearby table and the chef soon came and took my request. There was no menu, just suggestions of what he was offering this day.

Moments later, he returned with a heaping plate of macaroni, salad, chicken, and rice. It was so good and the price was so compelling that I left with an order of flank steak, macaroni, salad and rice for the following day’s Iftar dinner. Good food is wherever you find it!

The food is amazing!! We got the spicy and sweet chicken, coconut rice, plantains, and juice. We got there at 8:01pm, because the website says they are open until 9, and Google says they are open until 8:30. The blonde woman who works there was incredibly kind. She heated us up food to go even though they were technically closed. Amazing food and employees. But please update your hours.

formatted_address: Cantina Wy, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: African Cuisine

reviews.text:
African Cuisine is an amazing restaurant with amazing food! They used to be a restaurant at the SDSU farmers market, but a while back opened up this restaurant with the same great food! They're great because they always pack the plates full!
The chicken is always moist and flavorful, and all their sides are incredible. They have 2 different rices, but i always get the saffron rice since i find it more flavorful and often has a piece of potato with it.
I also always get the spicy jerk chicken, but it can be pretty spicy, so be careful ordering it! And I recommend the lentils if you're unsure about a side!
There is plenty of seating inside, but they also wrap the plate in saran wrap if you're taking it to go.

Dropping my daughter off for school and wanted a quick bite. Stopped in here and was not disappointed! The girl at the counter was so helpful. She offered samples and even split up our servings so we could try everything. She gave us 1/2 sweet jerk chicken (which had a very small kick but more BBQ sweet) and 1/2 chicken curry. 1/2 curried lentils and 1/2 collard greens. We only paid $18 (I think) as we shared and were both stuffed! Everything was delicious. The inside dining only had 3 small tables in the A/C so we had to sit in the patio that was a little warm. But the food was so delicious and a great value! Will definitely be back as there were a lot of vegetarian selections were interested in.

Excellent and welcoming service. Was nearby looking for food and decided to give this place a shot. Amazing. Between my gf and I we tried everything, we got 2 of the big plates (2meats and 2 veggies and rice) and it was all amazing. The jerk chicken and curry chicken was so good i can't wait to come again. Also their drinks ( e got the mixed berry and mango) were perfect.

Also we had our dog with us and they had no issue with us dining inside, the dining area is really nice.

If you don't visit this spot trust me you're missing out.
Really nice & positive service, great portion size, awesome vegan potions, everything was super tasty. Worth my visit for sure and happy to get some restaurant food that’s veg forward. Thank you!!

Very nice comfy restaurant 👌🏼 open space...The food here was delicious 😋flavorful first time trying it & i was satisfied💯I got the large plate: coconut rice,sweet chicken,curry chicken,plantains,collard greens they give you alot of food!You get your money's worth plus some🎯
I highly recommend this place. I will be going back 😊with my family!

formatted_address: 3727 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: JOLLOF PLUS

reviews.text:
Delicioso!
Ordered the Tilapia, Coconut rice and plantains. My stomach is more than satisfied and the customer service was above and beyond. The fish skin was crispy and well seasoned.  I have to warn you that the coconut rice is highly addictive so please proceed with caution ⚠️

I walked into the store front which was very confusing because there are multiple restaurants that advertise food but it was only possible to order the African food on the kiosk. There is no one working in the store front so the kiosk is the only interface.  I was the only one there and I ordered two lunch specials. I assumed it would come out quick since I didn’t order very much and there was no one there, but I waited for over an hour to get the food.  Despite the wait, the food was very good and tasted homemade.

They gave me, what looks like Uncle Ben's yellow rice instead of Jollof. I'm so disappointed in this service from fellow Nigerians.  The goat meat is just covered in tomato sauce, not seasoned. I'm upset that the server tricked me. This was not a mistake. This was done purposely. If they couldn't fulfill the order, they should have cancelled it.

When i take the time to write a review is because the food or item either didn’t meet my expectations or as in this case it was beyond my expectations. Also there aren any pictures which can be helpful for future customers.

I was so scared to order and spend money when trying something new specially because i am very very picky but with this one i took the risk.

Red Stew (w Goat Meat): My favorite dish out of the 3. It was a tomato base, slightly spicy (a lot less spicy than buldak instant noodles). It might have some oil you can see on the top of the container just mix it up and you'll. be alright. This dish has so many Caribbean flavors might be the reason i loved it. Oh, Goat meat 100% cooked and very soft meat.

Egusi Soup: It taste so good i can’t describe what it taste like just know that it taste great and it has flavors. The egusi consistency is like scrambled egg, soft to me is excellent because i thought it was going to
be grainy and i hate that texture on my food.

Sauté chicken:  Taste goods. At the time of this review i haven’t eaten that much, main focus was on  the red stew.

Fufu: One ball of fufu got me full, i bought 6 of them thinking it wasn’t going to be enough 😂 but it is.

I wont be ordering again simply because the restaurant is very far away from me and ubereats fees are insane. But hey a least this time i have no regrets spending $90.00 for food.

I am very satisfied, thank you very much ! ☺️

I should have read the review before placing my order! DO NOT order food from here except you talk to them on Phone! I repeat DO NOT. I am a Nigerian and most of our restaurant service or turn around is poor but this restaurant is the worst when it comes to wait time, customer service and delivery. Unfortunately, I was not able to get my order but I have asked for my refund which I am yet to get!!!  Believe all the negative comments I beg you, they are true reflection of their service. If you want to eat tomorrow then order today because chances are that, there will be excuses as to why they have poor turn around time when you order. I have never written a review in the last 5yrs but for this restaurant and what they did to me I just have to.

Note to Owner: PLEASE, hire a food consultant to help position your service better than what you have. It SUCKS AND ANNOYING!!!!! 😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡

formatted_address: 4651 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA 92116, United States
name: Muzita Abyssinian Bistro

reviews.text: Absolutely delightful. Came here a few times, food was great every time. And the novelty (i.e. you have to eat with your hands) was fun for my friends’ first time experience. I love the spices and the flavor of the food! I don’t know much about their food culture but I got a briefing every single time by the waiter. He is very friendly and humorous! Would definitely still go back.

This place is pretty special, you can't get good Ethiopian food just anywhere. It's fun to eat the injera bread with the entree of your chosing. For anyone who's never tried it, it reminds me of Indian food but with spongy bread instead of rice. They offer beers from Ethiopia and surrounding nations (I recommend the Walia). It's a unique experience and definitely worth checking out. I hope they open up a restaurant in northern San Diego some day.

Extremely friendly staff, they gave us extra complimentary options to try. Good food, definitely try their sambusas, absolutely delicious. The entree was a bit a mild on the flavor, but definitely a 4/5. Make a reservation prior to visiting, it's a small cute place, fills up fast.

Muzita was such an enjoyable experience  for all our senses. It was our first time experiencing Abyssinian food and it won’t be the last. Abel cheerfully greeted us upon entry and helped us with our order. What a great ambassador for his cuisine. We decided on 3 vegetarian lunch specials. We thoroughly enjoyed each one of them. You taste the multi layers of flavors and spices and we didn’t even miss eating meat, it was so satisfying. Abel was attentive, gracious and we loved how happy he was to share his  culture with us
Incredible food, every bite was amazing! Also our server was working really hard serving a bunch of tables mostly by himself and he was so kind and energetic. Highly recommend any of the shiros!

formatted_address: 5985 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: KABSA

reviews.text: I haven't ate Kabsa ever like this it's was so delicious. I recommend as a middle food.

I ordered Nigerian food catering from them, and the food was delicious! Ordering was easy and they accommodated all my requests. I can never find Nigerian and African food on this side of the states so I am so glad to have found my new favorite caterer!!
Delicious food and amazing Karak tea. Feels like you’re in the gulf. Come and try this food and you will come here everyday
Ordered Mandi and tasted very authentic. Great customer service and I’m happy to find a spot with very delicious and quality authentic food.
AfroHalal’s Mandi was absolutely delicious. The rice and chicken was very well-seasoned. I highly recommend this caterer to everyone in San Diego.

formatted_address: 3647 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Addis Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text: Food was great. Service was excellent. Ginger tea was amazing. I really enjoyed the me combo. I usually eat the vegan combo meal, but this time I decided to try the meat combo. It did not disappoint. Very nice environment to have a nice conversation with my friend. Music was not too loud.

This is a restaurant run by an Ethiopian from Africa, which has been in business for many years. The shop has a very unique style, full of local cultural characteristics. The owner is very enthusiastic and will guide you on how to order. Traditionally, Ethiopian meals are served on a large injera—a type of flatbread—topped with various stews, meats, and vegetables. You eat by tearing off pieces of the injera and using them to scoop up the dishes, which is a distinctive experience. If you’ve never tried Ethiopian food before, it’s worth a visit. However, the injera has a sour taste overall, and neither my friend nor I were quite accustomed to it—but it was all part of the experience.

I have taken my friends here twice. Would be way more if I lived closer! The food is delicious!! The portions are large and the service is fast. The owner is very kind and funny. I love coming here. Please give it a try!

Excellent food.

We had ethiopian wine and beer that actually paired very well with each other. I had a veggie plate while my partner had the lamb.

They have redone the dining room beautifully. The service is, as always, amazing they make you feel like a member of the family. The food is incredible, it's so delicious and they even have gluten-free and injerra if you let them know that you need it. We will always be back. It's a family tradition and such a fun place to take food adventurers.

formatted_address: 3727 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Buka - Nigerian Restaurant

reviews.text: Amazing service and absolutely delicious food! 10/10 — I highly recommend. Truly the best Nigerian food around! The owner was incredibly friendly, helpful, and had great conversation with us, which made the whole experience even better. We can’t wait to come back!

DO NOT EAT HERE

This restaurant is the worst place I've ever eaten. I saw cockroaches and rodents ALL throughout, and if that wasn't bad enough I got FOOD POISONING that lasted all weekend. Not to mention, there staff is incredibly rude and when we asked to speak to the manager the owner of the restaurant was extremely loud and disrespectful, in front of our whole family.

If I could this rat infested place NEGATIVE stars I would!! I reiterate...

DO NOT EAT HERE

I came here excited to try food from a highly rated place. Opened grimy doors and ended up in a gray empty space that was kind of scary with a white guy sitting in the middle. He was friendly but the space was not. I could not imagine having a meal there. It didn't smell like any delicious food or any food either. Super weird! I looked closely at the reviews and they are all placed by people with 1 or 2 reviews today so that's definitely sketch. I'm giving it 2 stars because well, what if it's a real restaurant with good food? I just know I won't be trying it after what I saw.

Let's start with the vibes. When I walked in, it was definitely a hole-in-the-wall. One review said it was "sketchy," and I kind of get it, it's not the most inviting space. It feels run down and not exactly like a place you'd want to dine in.

That said, I didn't want to be too quick to judge. California is expensive, and it's especially hard for small, ethnic restaurants to maintain a dine-in space while serving labor-intensive dishes. As someone who's Caribbean (Dominican), I get how much time and love it takes to make meals like this, and I respect that hustle.

I ordered the egusi, red stew with beef, jollof rice, and got fufu added on at pickup (shoutout to the staff for that, I didn't see it as an option during checkout, and they threw it in for me on the spot). The service was warm and genuine. My food was ready in about 30 minutes, and they were super sweet during pickup.

Now, the food. Flavor-wise, it was solid. The egusi was well-seasoned, though the color threw me off , I'm used to egusi being more yellow, but this one leaned red, so I'm guessing they might've mixed in red stew. The jollof rice was very seasoned, definitely a standout. The fufu was okay, but something about the texture or flavor was slightly off. Not bad, just not the best I've had.

The biggest disappointment was the red stew with beef. For almost $20, I got two tiny pieces of beef. That felt stingy, though not entirely surprising. I've seen this happen before at West African spots. Still, I expected a little more protein for the price.

Overall:
* Food is flavorful and portions (aside from the meat) are generous.
* The service is friendly and accommodating.
* The physical space needs some serious love, it could turn people away at first glance.

Would I go back? Probably not, just because I'd like to explore other spots that might offer more consistency. But I do think they're doing their best, and with some improvements to the space and portions, this place could really thrive.

Buka has never disappointed me. The food is always fresh, full of flavor, and made with care. If you're ever in City Heights, do yourself a favor and stop by. It's one of those places that truly feels special

formatted_address: 2884 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Awash Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Wow, talk about some amazing food and service.  This has to be one of the best Ethiopian restaurants I’ve been to in America.  It’s a hole in the wall for sure, but that adds to the charm.  The person waiting on us was so kind, so nice, so helpful.  You could see him literally running to the back to place orders and run food.

The table next to us was a little complicated.  He told them they weren’t setup for tea or coffee on a Monday night.  The diners insisted and he finally said, you know what, I can make it for you, but it will not be presented as normal, but I can make it in the back, to which the diners agreed.  He ran to the back and next thing you know, tea and coffee were brought to them….extraordinary.  As a former restaurant worker, I’d have not asked them to go through the effort, but this was above and beyond.

When I was leaving, they had some bread on the counter and I asked what it was and he described it and then gave us some to sample….it was amazing!

Anyway, we had the #1 special (it’s spicy but not super hot..for reference, I eat 2-3 Thai chilis raw with just about every meal, so YMMV) and the vegetarian combo.  It was all so so so very delicious.  I will definitely be back!

Awash has wonderful, flavorful food.  The best option is to go to the restaurant first and speak with the owner about what you should eat and how spicy things are before you try ordering online through DoorDash.  Ethiopian food can be variable depending on his it is prepared.  We visited for my birthday and followed the owner's recommendations based on our parameters.  We were not disappointed.  I enjoyed the ribs and other beef dishes.  They have Ethiopian coffee, beer, and Mexican Coke (cane sugar based) products.  The ambiance is nothing spectacular; the restaurant is the front half of a convenience store with an eclectic mix of goods worth browsing (Italian Panettone, butane grills, beer/wine, motor oil).  Definitely worth visiting for the food!

Delicious, soulful Ethiopian food in a humble and welcoming spot. We had the veggie and meat combo and everything was full of flavor. The Ethiopian coffee was the perfect finish. Great host and a great experience overall. Highly recommend.

For dinner we just stayed in and DoorDashed food. We started off ordering Beef Sambusas (Pastry shells stuffed with onions, jalapenos and Ethiopian herbs. For main course we ordered Awaze Tibs (Beef tenderloin or chikinia bits sauteed in onions and green peppers, cooked with Ethiopian butter), Yedoro Wot (chicken cooked with Ethiopian spicies, berbere sauce, onions, garlic and Ethiopian butter) and Kitfo (ground beef spiced with Awaze (Ethiopian hot sauce) and served with homemade cottage cheese, raw as well). It also came with some White Enjera and Teff Enjera to try with all the dishes. We really enjoyed the Awaze Tibs, that was great with the Enjera. The one we liked the least was Kitfo. The Yedoro Wot and Beef Sambusas were ok. Overall nice to try this cuisine but my stomach said that it is not for me.

Delicious food in the middle of an Ethiopian market. It’s kind of cluttered and messy. The service was OK. We waited a while even though they didn’t appear overly busy. The food arrived quickly after ordering.

formatted_address: 925 E Plaza Blvd Suite 106, National City, CA 91950, United States
name: Nigeria Breeze Restaurant

reviews.text:
This was my first time trying Nigerian food, and I’m really glad I stopped by Nigerian Breeze. I ordered several items, including the fish, igese, spicy beef, plantains, and a meat pie.

The fish was amazing — the flavor and texture were absolutely on point. It was cooked perfectly and easily became my favorite dish of the night. The spicy beef definitely lives up to its name; it’s very spicy, so if you’re sensitive to heat, I’d suggest skipping that appetizer. The plantains were perfectly cooked, sweet, and flavorful.

The meat pie was delicious overall, though it had a bit more bread than meat. I would’ve loved a little more filling, but it was still enjoyable.

Overall, I’m really happy I came here and tried something new. The atmosphere is great for a date or a relaxed meal — plenty of seating, no overpowering music, and a comfortable space for conversation. I’d definitely come back and recommend it to anyone curious about Nigerian cuisine.

I had an incredible experience at this Nigerian restaurant! The food was not only flavorful and authentic, but the quantity was so satisfying — you definitely get your money’s worth. The quality of every dish truly stood out, from the seasoning to the texture. Whether you’re craving jollof rice, egusi soup, or peppered meat, everything was cooked to perfection.

I dined in and also ordered takeout, and I was impressed both times. The packaging for the takeout was top-notch — secure, neat, and still hot when I got home. The service was just as amazing — warm, professional, and attentive from start to finish.

I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants a true taste of Nigeria with excellent value and top-tier service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

First time trying this place and Nigerian food and I loved the experience. Authentic Nigerian dishes and the service was really great. During our stay we noticed a lot of clients coming in to purchase to go. I strongly recommend. My son even used his hands to try the fufu. The portions are very big, enough to share and actually spicy but not too spicy.

This was my mother and I’s first time coming to this restaurant and trying this type of food and we were very pleased with our experience! The food was delicious and the service was great, very friendly people! Highly recommend!!

Huge shoutout to the owner Maria for the amazing hospitality and food! We came in right before a rush, everyone came in and ready to devour the delicious food! Definitely one of my favorite restaurants in SoCal!!! We literally couldn’t decide which of the dishes we liked more! This is a must try!

formatted_address: 4717 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Red Sea Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Very nice food.
Old style, original Ethiopian environment.
Feels like home, best African restaurant in San Diego.

Say it with me
DEL-LISH-OUS

I have frequent this authentic Ethiopian Restaurant during the past few years of living in San Diego, and I still can't get enough!.  Food quality, presentation and of course the most important, TASTE!

The owners are truly blessings to the community. Upon entry, the restaurant has a museum like feel, highlighting great Ethiopians and art from the culture

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND  stopping by for a taste for any occasion!
Ask for the Honey wine!

So delicious! We had the Yedero Tibs and the veggie special which came with 7 types of veggies. We also got a sambussa as an appetizer which was super crispy. It was a great way to try a variety of flavors. We’re excited to come back again!

I was hesitant about writing a review bc I wanted to gate keep this restaurant for myself but this is a small, family owned business. This will be my go-to restaurant for Ethiopian cuisine in the SD area. The depth of flavor and spices along with the portion size and price is unbeatable. The service was a highlight and I saw that the waitress happily answered a lot of cultural questions for the other customers too.

I had a lovely experience dining here. The food was delicious, they accommodated my gf request, the service was amazing, and the atmosphere was adorable. The food was flavored and spiced perfectly. I will definitely be coming back!! The owners were so sweet and down to earth. You can tell how much love and care they put into their food. Parking in the area was easy. It was very reasonably priced as well :)

formatted_address: 4155 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Lucy Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
I highly highly recommend this place. Not only the food but the people are beautiful. Will make you feel a part of their family. We told them that a few of us are having Ethiopian for the first time and they made sure it’s a great experience.

We ordered a Vegan special platter and got to try a bit of everything. One vegan special is sufficient for two people. My friends also got the Ethiopian Tej (honey wine). It was too strong for me but they absolutely loved it.

My daughter and I wanted to try Ethiopian food and we were not disappointed. The cafe is neat with lovely and unique decor, the menu is extensive and reasonably priced and the food was very good. We shared the vegan sampler plate and it was more than enough for us both. The service was fast, and the server took the time to explain the food and answer our questions about the process of making the injera. It was a lovely cultural experience that I would gladly repeat.

This is my go-to Ethiopian spot in San Diego! I usually get the vegan special and add another veggie or meat dish. It’s always delicious! The vegan special has 8 good dishes. I also appreciate that I can eat a lot and still feel great afterward, not heavy or sluggish.

There’s street parking in the front of the restaurant or the side street. I like to park in the back lot and then enter through the back entrance.

Just a heads-up, they serve tap water for free or you can buy bottled water.

Delicious food! My first time here and I’ll be sure to return. Staff was friendly and gave me some wonderful recommendations. We started with the house salad and sambusa try both the potato and lentil! So so good!
We were a party or two and ordered the meat combo! Plenty of food more than enough for two! I tried the Ethiopian honey wine, it was also good not too sweet. Beautiful decor and music. Thank you!

Ethiopian decor, very unique.  Meals served on large, round, thin bread plates with rolled bread that were in place of forks.  Very similar Middle Eastern/ Arabian style. The place was very clean and the service was very good.  They roasted the coffee beans when we ordered and it was delicious. Great place to go if you are looking for a different experience. Parking is on the street so it can be unpredictable.

formatted_address: 2425 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: BLUE NILE Ethiopian market and restaurant

reviews.text: This place is LITERALLY A HIDDEN GEM! Modest kitchen in the back of a market with kind people & DELICIOUS food. I had the Abay Special T'ibs (Chikina) & added collard greens + lentils. The food was so flavorful, hearty and comforting. It was a good amount of food, and despite being super hungry, I saved about 1/2 for my next meal to go. Although it was delicious, after tax/tip I paid $45 for this plate of food. the sides seemed a bit overpriced given their size. this is my second visit & I’ll be back to again to explore the menu further with some of their more affordable options. Impressive food, low key atmosphere and so satisfying 🇪🇹🤤

Don't judge a book by it's cover. This place is modest in it's curb appeal, and outrageously good in it's service and flavor. Ordered the veggie sampler and a spicy beef tomato dish. My wife and I ate until we were stuffed. Please go and support this mom and pop establishment.

This is a delightful little place. Restaurant is in back of store and it is absolutely delicious. Really cool staff and it’s hard to describe the tastiness of the food. Absolutely authentic- don’t expect silverware and don’t complain about it. Use the fantastic injera bread and enjoy the entire experience!

This is a chill, unassuming hole in the wall spot - so you know the food is going to be GOOD. This restaurant did not disappoint. So delicious. Run by very kind people. Don’t sleep on this restaurant! There is a small downstairs part of the restaurant in the back behind the storefront, but there is also an upstairs area which I did not see. Highly recommend.

Excellent dining experience at SD's newest Ethiopian restaurant utilizing the outdoor patio space. Everything was made fresh to order, and the awazé (hot sauce) was super savory and spicy! Will definitely be coming here again our my next trip. Highly recommend for Vegan, vegetarian, carnivore and those with food allergies!

formatted_address: 2707 Boston Ave, San Diego, CA 92113, United States
name: Fufu Lounge

reviews.text: I ordered Egusi, Efo, and Suya, and honestly every single dish was a big disappointment. The food was very low standard and tasted wacky, like no care was put into it at all. This is my first time visiting San Diego, and sadly this restaurant gave me a terrible experience with no good memories. The pictures of the food look nice online, but in real life the food is nothing close to that just very underwhelming and not worth it at all. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

I tried almost everything on the menu at Fufu Lounge, and my absolute favorite was the jollof rice with plantain and protein. Add on the suya on the side for an extra delight! Definitely a 10/10 meal! The flavors were spot on and tasted just like authentic, home-cooked Nigerian food.
The service was amazing, with a super friendly owner and staff who made the whole experience even better. Even with delivery, the food arrived with such great quality and care!
If you’re looking for a spot with delicious Nigerian food and great vibes, Fufu Lounge is it. Highly recommend!

First time ordering. It’s better you order online first since from reading the reviews they only have one chef on duty at a time. I ordered through Uber Eats.

I got the Ofada stew with plantain and pepper soup with plantain, but be aware — neither comes with any meat or fish. You have to order protein separately, which was surprising. Luckily, a lady chef from the restaurant called to confirm and kindly added protein (I requested goat meat) at no extra charge. The protein was very small & the  food itself was very salty, almost too salty to enjoy. Pickup was easy through their food locker. Overall, an okay experience that seems to depend on which chef is cooking that day.

I ordered eba with egusi and the meat literally smells like rotten. The meat also had some weird green film on the outside. This was my first time eating this type of food so I assumed it must be normal but after trying other places and reading these reviews im convinced there is something wrong with this restaurant. im not the type to waste food but I threw the whole $40 meal away. Would not recommend.

I have order their suya and jollof rice thru door dash nearly 10 times. I used to live in Atlanta and go to Nigerian restaurant there religiously and after trying different Nigerian restaurants, even in Nevada their Suya is the closest I have ever tasted to the one from Atlanta. They also have this very very rich, hobo ginger, spice purple drink, and sometimes it’s not in stock and they gave you the grsvf  drink, which is the only reason I gave a four star. Sometimes the suya can be a little dry it comes with raw red onions exactly how it was served in ATL Overall, the experience is really lovely. I have never been in store but just having the same food from 10 years ago definitely the best Nigerian place in town.

formatted_address: 7122 Miramar Rd, San Diego, CA 92121, United States
name: GIHON Ethiopian Kitchen

reviews.text: First day open in their new location today. Best Ethiopian food in San Diego. I've eaten at every other place in San Diego and it's not even close. Sambusa wrapping is fluffy and they are fried perfectly. Vegan options are excellent, including beets, eggplant, green beans, and more. I am excited to try the mushroom tibs next time. I hope the quality of this restaurant continues to be fantastic.

Delicious food! Definitely the best Ethiopian food I've tried! I went for the vegan platter and each bit was so good! I'd heard so much about Ethiopian food and tried it somewhere else and it wasn't very good so I was a bit skeptical about trying it again and I'm so glad I did! The owners were lovely as well and we spoke about Ethiopia and how it is developing really well! Definitely recommend!

My friend and I ordered the meat platter + misir + gomen and a side of shiro. Everything was so delicious and authentic. The misir and gomen were so aromatic. The filet mignon was especially tender. Everyone in San Diego needs to try GIHON!!!

Gihon Ethiopian Kitchen is the best Ethiopian food I have had in San Diego county! I have tried all the places in North Park and Gihon is THE BEST. I got the vegan platter with my husband and we devoured it. There are unique dishes with beets, eggplant and a special tofu sauce which was incredible. I highly, highly recommend this place.

It was a nice ambiance because it’s tucked away from road noise and quiet. A great place for an evening dinner.

After reading a few reviews, I decided to order the very popular vegan platter and it did not disappoint! Excellent food and more than enough for two people. I also got the lentil sambusa and it too tasted amazing. Very healthy and very delicious meal served with the traditional anjeer bread made from teff. Quiet location with a few patio tables - a great experience.  I’ll be back!

formatted_address: 4869 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Perrony Italian & Mexican Kitchen

reviews.text: You can definitely tell that they take their time to cook. It shows in the taste. The burrito shell is put on the grill for the perfect amount of time. The ingredients taste fresh. I am totally going back, God willing.

This restaurant, formerly owned by a Somali owner, is now owned by a Mexican owner. Surprisingly, they don’t offer any halal food except for salmon fish with pasta. However, I tried the salmon fish with pasta, and it was incredibly delicious. I highly recommend it.

Food was absolutely delicious. I finally found an amazing pasta spot, that also sells a variety of different food, located in SD! Easy to spot, vibes are cool, and employees are very nice n helpful. Portions and prices are reasonable and worth it too!

Nice owner. The neighborhood guys comes around and talk a lot.
Noise but fun and chill out
Goat rice was fantastic. It tastes balance moisture and has great flavor. Free banana water, so friendly and welcoming atmosphere.

The food was great.  Service is friendly.  Prices are reasonable.  The only thing preventing me from giving 5 stars is the cleanliness.  I got pictures of the sticky napkin holder and one if the disgusting fans.  The floor has loose tiles which is a safety hazard.  It's a shame these people don't put as much pride in their facility as they obviously do in their food and service.

formatted_address: 804 B Ave, National City, CA 91950, United States
name: Sabor Piri Piri Kitchen

reviews.text: The best spicy chicken sandwich I have ever tasted! The flavor is so bomb. I devoured mine so quickly. The samosas are also so good. Definitely will be back and I highly recommend for all chicken sandwich lovers.

Sabor Piri-Piri was some of the best unique ethnic food (Mozambique/African) food I've had!

We first had them by ordering online and having them delivered. We got their sweet potato and also their chicken peanut curry. We really liked the food, so we then went physically to check out more menu items.

We ended up having the red chicken curry made with their (slightly spicy) Piri-Piri sauce! And omg that was amazing! Apparently Piri-Piri is a spicy pepper from Africa, so it had a unique flavor I never had in San Diego. Their kale and black eyed peas was made with the same sauce so it gave it that nice slightly sweet and spicy flavor. I honestly didn't have high hopes but it ended up being one of my favorite items! The staff was welcoming and really nice. They answered my questions as I was unsure and new to Mozambique curry.

The shop is really small but has decent seating inside as well as a nice spot outside to eat. There's Tahona next door (great to grab to go margaritas), so it's nice to grab a few different items with friends and enjoy the spread outside with a Marg!

There's still more on the menu we haven't tried, so we want to go again!

I really like Sabor Piri Piri from eating it at the farmers market.  The restaurant didn’t disappoint. We are outside. I didn’t take a picture of my food from the beginning but I made up by taking pics of the menu. The chicken samosas are delicious!

Sabor Piri Piri is the place to go for some delicious food! We had Eva cater samosas for our staff and those Samosas flew off the tray. The sweet and spicy sauce was amazing, everyone kept raving about it! The sauce paired perfectly with the chicken and vegan samosas. We loved hearing all about how she learned to make samosas. She was so sweet and knowledgeable about her craft. Can’t wait to try more of her delicious food!
Healthy and comforting all in one bowl! This place is really making a name for themselves. Very delicious and for a good price. Definitely highly recommend.

formatted_address: 3817 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Asmara Cafe/restaurant

reviews.text: Excellent experience... The owner is so nice what a great place. I only tried two items on my first visit. The breakfast sandwich was a nice size and delicious. The cappuccino was so good. You can take out or eat in.

We really enjoyed the food here. I got the egg sandwich and it was exceptional, so well seasoned. My wife got the fava bean dish, which was also so good. Freshly made food with very attentive service. Definitely worth the visit.

This egg sandwich has to be one of the best I've had. It was fresh and tasty. Bread was soft but with a crispy top... Yummy. The balsamic lemon drizzle she makes from scratch. It is delicious! The sandwich wasn't heavy on the tummy. Cappuccino was delightful. Tried the beef sambusas...crispy and meat well seasoned. The woman was so friendly and cheerful. Definitely recommend trying this place.

Wonderful customer service and good food!!

Me and my family enjoyed our visit to this little coffee. I absolutely recommend, if you want to enjoy authentic experience of a little travel to the horn of Africa.

The Eritrean food is delicious, healthy and homemade. The owner very friendly and attentive. Definitely can recommend the Veggie Combo plate with injera bread which is very reasonably priced. Nice cafe/dining area. Hope to return soon to try the coffee!

formatted_address: 5157 College Ave unit c, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: FLAVORS EXPRESS SDSU

reviews.text:
This place was delicious! Don't let the negative reviews fool you.  Yes, its not situated like a 5 star restaurant, but what you get in return is some quality, good tasting, and well portioned food. My daughter's shared a small platter and the wife and I a medium. It was more than enough food to share.  Service was also friendly which was a plus. The lady serving was a little quiet (which some people might mistaken as rude behavior), but you can tell she was friendly and wanted to make sure we had a pleasant experience.

Definitely recommend you give it a try

Everything is seasoned well, great balance of flavors. Chicken is still moist and the dark meat almost taste like steak the way he seasons it. The man behind the counter had good vibes that complemented the reggae. Next time i will get his name. 9/10 will eat again

Food is absolutely amazing! We got two Kubwa plates with saffron rice, sweet jerk chicken, spicy jerk chicken, curry chicken and one other that I forget but again just amazing! I cannot recommend this place enough. This was our first time but will not be our last.

Excellent food!  I don’t know anything about East Africa, but I had the saffron rice and eggplant and kidney beans with collard greens and LOVED the flavors.  Cumin in there and a lot of other flavors.  The guy who served it up was from Kenya!  Wish a place like this existed near my home

One of the best unexpected meals I've had in 2024. Excellent flavor and quality ingredients, you can tell the food is made with passion. Put simply, just really well prepared food with lots of different main and side options to create your own plate.

formatted_address: 2820 Market St, San Diego, CA 92102, United States
name: Sweet Spot Real Jamaican Restaurant

reviews.text:
Usually the go to Jamaican spot when visiting SD, their food is pretty good, portion sizes are enough, and food tastes fresh. The atmosphere isn't too bad, as they do have limited dining seating  and very limited parking space, which is a struggle trying to find parking nearby, when there aren't any parking spaces on their parking lot. Service timing is fair. For some reason, it seems as though they run out of beef patties quickly. We sat outside of the restaurant on their patio.

I ordered the Oxtail plate, with rice and peas, cabbage and plantains. Not overly salty, flavorful and Oxtails had enough meat on them.

I decided to give this place a try, again, because we heard of the change in ownership.  Sadly, different owner, same lack of basic customer service. Staff seem to be burdened to acknowledge customers upon entering (the exception is the young man with a speech impediment who is the only pleasant person there). The lady there ignored some customers in favor of others and was extremely abrupt with her responses and unhelpful.  I thought that I must have offended her until I asked 2 different people to retrieve my order and they reported similar experiences.
Initially,  the food was good but subsequently went downhill. When the food started matching the service,  it's time to stop patronizing. The patties were consistently good. Sometimes the meal has plantains, sometimes not; fish is sometimes red snapper, sometimes not and is instead a barely edible, overcooked aberration that rivals chewing gum; fried chicken meal has sauce, sometimes not. Request for sauce or condiments are completely ignored( I would pay for them if necessary)and if the order is made incorrectly ( their mistake), they expect you to pay for it ( small vs large order).  The last time we were there, the food was not good. We have had better service buying tacos at the food truck outside the home depot.

Food is delicious!! It can take a while for some of the menu items, but it's definitely worth the wait. We had the brown stewed chicken which was just so tender and flavorful. The fried chicken was great a well. The beef patties are flaky and lightly spicy. You can't go wrong with any of the menu items. Definitely give this place a try.  I guarantee you'll be back.
Outstanding food.  This place is laid back with a calming atmosphere.  We enjoyed the curry goat and oxtails plates which was way more than expected.  Each plate was enough for 2 to done

Nice restaurant. Went there with 2 of my co workers I had the curry goat with rice &beans and plantain, they both got  chicken curry and beef oxtail respectively. My goat has waaaaaay too many bones in it but it's goat (maybe) but I loved the crunchy cabbage. Nice music I love Bob Marley he was playing slowly in the background.

formatted_address: 1740 S Coast Hwy, Laguna Beach, CA 92651, United States
name: Mozambique

reviews.text: We are so happy we discovered Mozambique!! Oscar at the host station provided superb service. The rooftop ocean view at sunset was gorgeous and relaxing. Kristian provided outstanding table service! He was extremely attentive especially given a gluten and dairy allergy. The Seafood salad with a side of beets was absolutely delicious!! The Lobster, Shrimp, Scallops and Calamari were extremely fresh! The Sky Burger and Samosa were fair and the Sweet Potato Fries were very tasty. We were celebrating an anniversary. Kristian generously gifted us a delicious Sorbet Trio. The ambiance, service and meal was extremely enjoyable! We definitely recommend Mozambique, a little gem in Laguna Beach!!!

I made a reservation here and went to the rooftop only to be told rather rudely that reservations are not for the rooftop and that I needed to go downstairs. I went downstairs and the poor waiter was stuck basically handling the whole floor by himself to do staffing issues. He did his best but the experience was less than ideal. The food was okay. As a frequent SoCal visitor from CT, it is a one and done for me.

Great rooftop location with an amazing ocean view!

They offer valet parking but there's street meter parking if you can find a spot.

The entrance has a large bird cage that has a Toco Tucan (Nancy) and two Macaws (Beira & Pemba). Make sure to stop by to check them out and say hi

The building has multiple restaurants on each level with Mozambique located on the rooftop but they also have indoor seating in the level below the roof. But the rooftop is where it's at!

The menu has good options to choose from. I got the salmon, also tried the traditional Southern African pie with beef and mushrooms.

As for appetizer, we got the ceviche which was good but nothing special about it. I've had better elsewhere. Not sure how that ties into Mozambique cuisine. The Samosa was yummy. The Peri Peri chicken was also yummy but not sure how that ties into Mozambique cuisine.

The salmon was good but there's nothing particularly special about it. I thought it would have an African touch...but it was just an ordinary salmon dish. Don't get me wrong...it was good, I was just expecting more. Oh...it came with a side of French fries... They were a bit stale... Also nothing special about them... I've had better at fast food restaurants.

The southern African pie is where it's at...it was yummy and met my expectation of something out of the ordinary. Be careful it's very hot inside.

Service was good but a bit slow. Maybe because we had a large group. The waiter was working hard. I think they need to have someone other staff assist when it's a large group.

Prices are what you would expect at a Laguna Beach restaurant with a scenic view.

They have a live band and a DJ in the evening (around 8:30pm) I believe Thursdays - Sundays. Unfortunately, we had to leave around 6:30pm

Overall, I enjoyed the experience. Worth going for a special occasion or at least once to check it out.

This was a lovely surprise, because it was a taste from home - Cape Town.  We were greeted and seated outside the Parrot room immediately! We ordered from the happy hour menu, and had chicken wings, calamari with sweet potato fries, beef samoosas, and a beef pie! There was more than 1 seating  areas, and they upstairs restaurant had live music. We left with the parrot in the cage saying ‘hallo’. FYI Valet is $10 for up to 3 hours, I’m not sure about street parking! We will be back!

We've been trying to come to this restaurant forEVER... WE FINALLY MADE IT TODAY. The food was absolutely amazing.  Try the M-Fries...spicy kick on warm and crispy fries.  So good. I also recommend the sampler platter as well.... the sausage, prawns everything was amazing. We DID sub the Chicken on the sampler for bacon.... just a personal preference but EVERYTHING was great.

PROTIP: ASK FOR KENT to be your server! Request him when you make your reservation.  He's an experience! Full of great stories, knowledgeable about Laguna, excellent service and tasty, descriptive menu recommendations.... he's a great compliment to everything on the experience. DON'T DO LIKE US AND PUT IT OFF, GET TO MOZAMBIQUE! Also do the rooftop!! Great beach views and a nice breeze. Bring a jacket if you get cold easily.

formatted_address: 6109 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: Island Spice Jamaican Restaurant

reviews.text: Really good Jamaican food!! The curry chicken was delicious and the jerk chicken smokey, tangy, and had a little spice, they have lots of fun drinks and an authentic menu!  Definitely worth trying, over and over!!  Takeout is standard but they have a Jamaican decorated dining room with 6 or 7 tables

I am visiting from Maryland and wanted some good carribean food. When I tell you I picked a winner with Island Spice Jamaican Restaurants!. Beef Pattie was amazing and you can tell it's made fresh. The curry chicken  rice and peas. Perfectly made and seasoned.  I want to thank you for making such an amazing meal!

I smelled delicious food cooking as we walked up people getting their orders to go people seated waiting on food for dine in every table was full the young cashier guy was very sweet and welcoming ordered food was brought out to us it was delicious hot,fresh wonderful I will be coming back I purchased a large jersey meal great portion size I ate in but I left with a meal from my left overs because portion was very generous excellent food customer service

Island Spice shares the same parking lot as Alanberto at the corner of College Ave and University Ave, across the street from Taco Bell. You can’t miss the Jamaican colors.

We ordered a large plate of curry chicken ($17), large plate of oxtail ($22), and small side of jerk chicken ($12).

We ordered for take out and the second she handed over the boxes, I was shocked at how heavy 3 boxes were. When we got home, I was in awe  at the portions! So much food!
