The entrees came with the protein choice, side of veggies and red bean rice. Everything was delicious and we had left overs. The chicken curry and oxtail were so tender it fell right off the bones. I used a plastic fork to eat and the meat had no problem. Great price, portion, taste and service.

Overall rating: 8.5/10

Ordered the oxtail small plate which was more than plentiful for one person. This is my first time trying Jamaican food so maybe I’m not the best critic. The meat itself was well seasoned and cooked very tender. My only reservation is that I found the taste to be a little too sweet. Knowing that scotch bonnet peppers are typically used in the traditional recipe, I expected it to be a little spicy, but it wasn’t in the slightest.

formatted_address: 885 S Hamilton Rd, Whitehall, OH 43213, United States
name: The Point African Restaurant

reviews.text: This is my top pick for authentic Ghana Food. I suggest you try everything they offer. You will not be disappointed. My favorite is the Waakaye. But I would be remiss if I did not mention their Fufu and Light Soup, Jollof Rice, or Tilapia and Banku (another favorite). The prices are very reasonable and the portion sizes are excellent.

Ordered Rice ball with peanut soup.  Husband from Ghana was very excited to try it. The man who took our order(Mark)...we asked if he was also from Ghana (hubby and I are new and he loves connecting with people). The guy said I don't want to talk about it. Okay, first odd thing. Then we asked to pay for/buy 1 extra rice ball to share. He said even if there is a price...we don't have any extra around. He forced us to spend more money for food that 1) We didnt want 2) was not tasty to begin with.That is odd. A restaurant not permitting customers to pay for extra sides.
On their menu, today(Tuesday),  you can only order 2 of all the items listed.
Peanut soup should look thick.. closer to gravy/curry consistency. It was very light and watery, similar to light soup. It was not very spicy at all. Over all the food was not delicious, the service was not excellent....very disappointed. Gave 2 stars because it was clean and the music was okay. Wouldn't recommend, won't be back, and I can make better food at home.

We tried the Waakye and the peanut soup. The Waakye had good portions, but it wasn’t spicy, even though they offered it as an option. There’s a little shito that comes with it to give it a tinge of spiciness.

We were really looking forward to the peanut soup because it was one of the recommended dishes, but it was a letdown. It was watery and didn’t have much flavor other than lamb.

So I was a bit confused they don’t have a online menu , they do have a set menu if you come in to the store
I ordered the number 12 - jollof rice spicy , beef stew ,boiled egg ,salad  for $16.00 the guy was really nice who ran the front . And the drink was $3 once I got my food it was more rice there anything very little meat

A beautiful Ghana cuisine selection with solid variety in a limited menu. The location has up close parking available in a shared plaza. There was plenty of seating, with a very clean and relaxed atmosphere. We tried two recommended meals by the hostess, and was not disappointed one bit! Highly recommend the Wakkye if you want to try a dish with variety, great flavors, and some heat available. Customer service was spot on, responsive, and very courteous. If you're looking to trying West African cuisine please check this place out!

formatted_address: 16719 Bernardo Center Dr Unit A, San Diego, CA 92128, United States
name: Burma Place

reviews.text:
Love this place. Ordered 4 dishes, and a side of steamed vegetables. Everything even just the steamed vegetables was good. All the vegetables were fresh. Perfectly cooked, and they would stand alone without any spice. I am looking forward to try new dishes when I return to eat here again.

Had pork curry, chicken eggplant, pumpkin vegetable, and pineapple fried rice.
Couldn't be happier to find Burmese food in San Diego! This place is fantastic! Excellent rainbow salad, tofu and coconut rice! Can't wait to come back and bring others 😋

SO GOOD! The food is delicious and the staff are incredibly nice. Highly recommend the shan tofu or the vegetarian entrees like garlic eggplant or fiery vegetables. Of course the tea leaf salad is a must if you haven’t had it before. The staff were very helpful and friendly. I never needed to ask for more water, a to-go container or signal ready to order; they were on it. Excited to go again and try more of the menu!
Good selection for vegetarian options. Speciality soups and plenty of selection of noodles, salad, soups , etc. overall good experience, I'll be back for more.

Great service, big portions. The tea leaf salad was pretty decent. Excellent variety of textures but the flavor was a bit one dimensional. Would’ve loved a bit more acidity to balance it out.

Would love to try a different dish, and definitely want to try the black sticky rice dessert.

formatted_address: 2820 Historic Decatur Rd, San Diego, CA 92106, United States
name: Kebab Craft

reviews.text: Kebab Craft at Liberty Station is a great spot if you like customizing your meal. You can basically build your own plate by choosing the base, protein, sauces, and toppings, which makes it easy to tailor everything to your taste. I ordered a plate with two sides and went with beef, veggies, and fries. Everything was flavorful and filling, and the portions were generous. It’s a convenient and satisfying option when you’re walking around Liberty Station and want something hearty but still customizable. I’d definitely come back to try different combinations.

A pretty decent kebab place. Nice, fast service! You can customize a lot of items which is good since there is no many vegetarian savory places at the market! It was better tasting than what it looked. Not the best falafel pita I had but pretty good!

My sister and I came to Kebab Craft on a Saturday night at 7pm and I ordered the beef shawarma loaded fries with chipotle, tzatziki, and garlic sauce. The food was soooo yummy and refreshing especially with the tomato and onions!! Fries were very crispy and cheesy! Just wished they added more beef lol but very great portion size for it being $15. Customer service was great, the cashier was very nice and helpful on recommending and explaining the food items. Food didn’t take long to arrive (possibly because we came at a time when it wasn’t that crowded) But overall, everything was very delicious!! ☺️

I had the Chef's Cali wrap and it was fabulous!  The delightful young woman who took my order recommended the Chipotle sauce.  She nailed, it was perfectly paired.

If you go to Liberty Station, definitely give them a try!

Soooo good!!! Took our chances off the map after a day at Sea World. Amazing fresh food! Had the mezze platter and loaded fries, everything tasted super, and the Baklava… I would come back just for that.💜

formatted_address: 2920 Zoo Dr, San Diego, CA 92101, United States
name: Safari Kitchen

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our experience. Obviously, zoo food is expensive so this was no exception. However, the portions were big and the food tasted great. We both had the buffalo chicken sandwich that came with fries and we ordered a side of onion rings to split. We both got full before finishing everything. The service was great with very patient workers while we tried to figure out what to order. We will be coming back here next time we are at the zoo

The rating could be misleading. The food is a hit or a miss at this place.

The good:

Buffalo chicken sandwich was pretty good.

The bad:

Rude/unwelcoming cashier, cold burger patties in the bacon cheeseburger. The patty was very dry. It wasn’t even room temperature, it had cold patties. Kids meal is terrible. It has only three chicken strips, barely enough for a child.

I would recommend to try some other place.

The food was very decent for park food walk up. We ordered the loaded tots, chicken fingers, and chicken club sandwich. There were plenty of seats in the shade to eat at. It was a bit expensive, but at least the cups could be refilled.

We had pretty low expectations, so we were pleasantly surprised 👌🏻
Huge portions, quite delicious food, decent prices.
Sorry, we were too hungry and made one bite before taking a photo 😂
The loaded tater tots were very yummy

formatted_address: 15500 San Pasqual Valley Rd, Escondido, CA 92027, United States
name: The Watering Hole at Kijamii Overlook

reviews.text: The Watering Hole at the Safari Park in San Diego is awesome! STUNNING VIEW OF THE SAFARI makes it a great spot for lunch. Try to get seating on the side and bring binoculars to see things clearly. The sandwiches and salads are yummy—especially the chicken club sandwich, which took the cake! If you're having trouble deciding, that's definitely a good choice. We also tried the pretzel charcuterie board, and it was really yummy, shareable, and fun. Overall, we had a great experience! Highly recommend.
Amazing views of the park, food was good but limited options available. Sevannah was very nice and took very good care of us

Everything about this dining experience was top notch. You get the nicest views, some decent grub, but most importantly the staff were just great. Super attentive, kind, made sure we weren’t waiting long for anything. Shout out to the crew - David, Stein, Sebastian for elevating our trip to the safari park!

Can’t understate just how relaxing and quaint it is to enjoy such good food with the views of the napping animals 😌

From being seated to the end, pretty disappointed. Seated at one of the two tables without shade but also infested with flies (there were a lot of empty tables and no other table seemed to attract all of these flies). Waited over 20 mins to order while all others seated after us were served.

Food was good. Margarita was not worth it…tasted pretty much only Tajin...and another waiter confused me with another group multiple times (of the same ethnicity).

Located in the Overlook area. Who doesn't want to have lunch and watch a baby rhino run around?
Food was pretty good. Hubby had a nice pulled pork sandwich. I had vegetarian/vegan options. Beer selection was good too. Price was decent for being in the park. Staff was friendly and easy going. Sat in a front table excellent view. I recommend reservations during the busy season and weekends. Its pretty popular. Note there is no railing so keep an eye on the kiddos.

formatted_address: 629 Kettner Blvd, San Diego, CA 92101, United States
name: The Lion's Share

reviews.text: Each dish is better than the last. This is the food joint for people who work at food joints. Great decor and will definitely be seeing me again soon. Be on the lookout for their pop up events!

Never expected to be blown away by EVERY DISH we ordered. At 1st we were very reluctant that we would find something we would like because we aren't into all the gamey meats they had.... BUT my goodness, everything was perfect!!!  Or "fireeee" as my picky husband said!

The Baja Fresh Oyster appetizer was delicious! The flavoring was bright and fresh, it had all the flavor profiles to tantalize my taste buds, I could've eaten 2 doz!!! The Patatas Bravas scallops appetizer was also a hit as it was cooked to perfection. The sauce paired so well with it, my plate was wiped clean. Make sure to also get the tacos de lengua!!! The meat was tender but not too rich, and the salsa complimented the well seasoned meat even my 1 year old son was saying, "Mmmm!!!"

Hubby had the Our burger which was cooked perfectly. Every bite left u craving for more... n that says a lot when youre just eating a burger.

Also, the bread pudding was delectable!!!!

This place is a 10/10 and far exceeded all of our expectations!!! Make this place a must try if you're around the area!! Service was great too! Soo happy to have celebrated my son's 1st birthday here!!!!!

We hosted a company happy hour for a conference event in the upstairs private party space. The rooms were interesting, food and drinks excellent, and service impeccable. Evening was a success. Highly recommend!

If you want to have the best cocktails in all of San Diego, go here.

I had a cocktail with gin, chili, and katsuobishi. Incredible depth of flavor. Smoked sea salt garnish. Photograph below.

I had a tequila reposado with honey, and espresso, their take on an espresso martini. I forget the other elements of the drink but it was delicious.

I finished with a cocktail called Fat Boy Summer. By this time, I was feeling good and can’t recall the ingredients. But, again. Delicious.

The atmosphere  is swanky, moody and intimate. Talented and professional bartenders.

I spent $62 for 3 cocktails- worth every penny.

I’ll definitely be back.

Absolutely fabulous experience. The tacos were bursting with flavor and the meat was so tender it melted in your mouth. The venison sliders were juicy and thick. Every bite was perfect. Washed it all down with two shanties. I took the bread pudding to go and it did not disappoint.

formatted_address: 3425 Hancock St, San Diego, CA 92110, United States
name: Taste of Nigeria

formatted_address: 734 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA 92101, United States
name: Sambusa & Soul

reviews.text: Quality food that exceeded my expectation. Highly recommend to my friends and fam and local community.
Exquisite taste and great Sambusas!!!
Great good & great customer service!
The Sambusas are the best!!

formatted_address: 8439 Sunset Trail Pl, Rancho Cucamonga, CA 91730, United States
name: African homemade food

reviews.text: My first time trying this place and I was so happy I did because their are the closest African restaurants near me but still a little bit far. I did regret it. Food was well portioned, meat was fresh. The lady gave me a 5stars services. Will definitely go again soon. It is a must must MUST try .

Great food and Service!
We have been wanting to try authentic Nigerian Food for a while.

We got the Egwusi and Beef. I was actually surprised when I felt like the flavors actually were a little reminiscent of other Asian flavors (Japanese Dashi Umami). The yam (reminds me of mochi) definitely  gives some heft to the meal making you feel nice and full after. Really great experience. If you have been interested in trying Nigerian at home I would definitely recommend.

We will be coming back soon, really want to try the lamb next!
I got the chicken peppered soup & jollof rice w/ beef, it’s so smoky and flavorful. Definitely very authentic and appetizing.

The African food vendor in Rancho Cocumonga that I called was too expensive.
How can I buy one piece of goat meat and soup for $40? I don’t throw away my hard earned money like that.
The food was good, the beans and plantain were my absolute favorite, I will definitely be back, and she was so responsive and timely🤍

formatted_address: 3915 Carnegie Ave, Cleveland, OH 44115, United States
name: Sandra Aduke’s Kitchen

reviews.text: The jollof was very good but extremely dry. One piece of stew meat was $3 so once that was gone I just had a bunch of steamed rice and no sauce. Red sauce only comes with white rice and then due to the interface setup, you can’t ask a person or a computer for a side of sauce.

I was really disappointed with my experience. Unfortunately, the food was not good at all. The smell was extremely unpleasant and overpowering, to the point where it was hard to even enjoy being inside the restaurant. The taste matched the smell, and I wasn’t able to finish my meal. Order the Egusi and the meat smelled old.

I ordered online but needed to make adjustments to my order. Sandra was actively communicating with me and happily worked on the changes to the order and pick up details. The food was ready on time and very delicious as well. I’ll definitely recommend & refer!!!!

I order from Sandra Aduke kitchen on a weekly basis and it is phenomenal. Excellent service, great tasting food. Pretty big portions and I can eat my plate in 2 meals.
Highly recommend this place for authentic Nigerian takeout!

Food tastes great! Although, I don't understand why we're given bones as meat. We pay extra to get protein but there's little to no meat on the chicken, fish or goat meat. I've had this happen on multiple occasions and would much rather cook for myself than order from here again.

formatted_address: 7455 Mission Gorge Rd, San Diego, CA 92120, United States
name: Bekker's Catering

reviews.text: I've worked with Bekker's Catering for quite a few events now, and I'm always so impressed by their team. The food was incredible, but beyond that, Josie and Colton were incredible partners day-of. They helped bus tables, serve water, and packaged up all of the food at the end of the event. Not to mention that they are the sweetest humans ever!! And the price was great! We plan on using them again and again for future events.

Bekker's is the best :) We had so many compliments on how amazing the food was and how great the staff was.  Everyone was so friendly and had the venue set up in record speed.  Using Bekker's bartenders made coordinating seamless and they were also amazing to our guests.  Kimberly was AMAZING as our coordinator as well.  She was so organized, communicated with all vendors, and kept to the timeline with no hiccups at all.  She took away all day of stress, and everything went as planned.  We are so grateful for how easy she made things and how beautiful everything turned out.  We had multiple guests with dietary restrictions, and she made sure they were catered to appropriately.  I cannot say enough positive things about her and Bekker's team !!!!

Bekkers was able to make all of our food gluten free for the Celiac groom (including the Mac and cheese and bread rolls!) We got so many compliments on our food during the wedding. The whole team was professional, including the awesome bartender that did a fantastic job making our multiple signature drinks.

Best experience! I had the pleasure to work with this company for my wedding and they were the absolute best! Lacey was our lead for the reception and she was amazing to work with. She made sure everything went smoothly with the catering service and her team was very professional. Our bartender John P, made the best tasting cocktails and kept the bar line moving swiftly with him just working it alone. Overall GREAT experience. This company worked with me from beginning to end. All my questions were answered and they have great pricing for putting everything into one packaged deal. ALL BRIDES LOOK AT THEM!! Best choice I made to work with them - as a bride who planned her entire wedding.

One of the best catering companies I have ever worked with. I was helping with a wedding on 12/31. It was an outdoor wedding with rain and wind. The tent was also dripping in areas. The catering staff was phenomenal with everything and helping to keep everything dry while still setting up. They were so kind and kept asking everyone if they needed anything. I can’t say enough about how hard they worked and how they just pitched in to make a wedding and reception in difficult conditions perfect. The food and appetizers were so good and perfect for the theme. I would not hesitate to use them again especially if it was the same crew!

formatted_address: 23048 Sky Mesa Rd, Homeland, CA 92548, United States
name: Sankofa Catering and Rentals, USA

reviews.text: Any time I’m in California, I make sure to stop by and  enjoy some authentic Ghanaian food. The service and food are impeccable. You have a customer for life.
Best in town

formatted_address: 1960 54th St, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Chef Budda Blasian Soul Food LLC

reviews.text:
I ordered the 2 pc catfish with 2 sides; macaroni and potato salad. The grease was definitely old and it affected the taste of the fish.  Macaroni was good. Cornbread muffin was good. Potato salad was ok.  Famous blue drink was just ok.  I wouldn’t return.
Lady at the register had good customer service skills.

Parking is almost none. Dine in available but I noticed alot of people were picking up their orders. Ordered chicken wings and shrimp combo . The shrimps was huge and tasty. Beans and ground beef was too sweet for me but had a nice favor. Macaroni and cheese was dry . Chicken wings and shrimps had a nice crunch .

I had The Big Greedy combo. The food was good, not too salty. The batter was thick and crispy, but chicken wings were a bit rubbery. The fish and tenders are my favorite. The mac n cheese and the collards are fire. The sweet and sour sauce had a bit too much peppers and seeds in it for me, but the hot sauce has a great flavor. The purple kool-aid was really good as well. Parking is tight and limited in front of the restaurant, but they had great TVs inside and had football playing while I waited.

Food was good, very tasty. I ordered greens but was given mac-N-cheese.  Not sure what happened there.  They were out of beans as well.  Prices are a little high, but they were well organized and very busy.

I was excited to try this place based on the reviews but I dont know what the hell I got. I ordered the Chicken egg rolls and fish combo.

My girl ate the egg rolls and they tasted like old grease. After an hour, it caused her to have a stomach ache. The next morning she was in the bathroom sick.

As I was eating my fish, there was a slimy stringy thing that was sticking out of when i would pull the fish apart. When i went to pulled on the string, it was wrapped around the whole fish and bundled up in the back, like a worm. Im not going to say it was a worm but it was unsettling enough to throw everything out. I know fish have parasites but the quality of this fish is questionable.

formatted_address: 1124 S Lewis Ave, Tulsa, OK 74104, United States
name: Afrikan Delights

reviews.text:
After doing a couple of loops around the mother road market I decided to stop by the Afrikan Delights restaurant. I was greeted with warm smilea by the chef and another employee. After reviewing the menu I decided to order on the kiosk a build my own regular plate with four chicken wings, Waakye Rice (Rice & Black-Eyed Peas), and Efo-Riro (Spinach). I waited a little bit for my food and almost thought I had missed the text, but the chef signaled me over and I picked up my order.

The first surprise was the large mount of Waayke rice compared the very small cup of spinach. I noticed that the black eyed peas in the rice looked burnt and unfortunately tasted that way too. The rice was a little over cooked and sticky as well--not what I was expecting. It was difficult to take more than a few bites, so I tried the spinach, which was cold and did not have a of spice or flavor. I moved on to the chicken wings, which were just basic chicken wings--nothing special.

I've had the blessing of having home made and restaurant made West African food and unfortunately Afrikan Delights missed the mark. Their food lacked a lot of flavor or warmth. I gave them three stars because of the attentive customer service and for replacing the rice. The chef was kind enough to check on me and listen to my feedback.

I was still pretty hungry after not finishing a lot of my meal, so I was kicking myself for that!

I hope that the flavor improves in the future as I love supporting local and black-brown owned businesses!
My first time trying Fufu and egusi soup. I was very tasty and enjoyable to eat. The service is amazing, very helpful and nice. The atmosphere in Mother Road is super fun. I will be returning.

I enjoyed their food during my six weeks in Tulsa. I missed African food and they delivered to my expectation. Their food was delicious, fresh and authentic! The customer service is also very good, the owners are friendly and humble.
If you are in Tulsa I encourage you to visit Afrikan Delights, you won’t be disappointed.

First time trying west African food and it was so good! You could tell the spice level is most likely turned down for the crowds of OK but I’m sure if I asked it could have been spicier. Fufu was soft and bouncy, and the egusi was flavorful and savory. The chicken leg was well seasoned.

My girl got the kids meals with fries and I did the large build your own plate with chicken wings, jollof rice, fried plantains, collard greens, and a large hibiscus drink. Nothing to far out of the ball park, but the food was executed well. We really enjoyed it and plan on coming back.

formatted_address: 5777 Cleveland Ave, Columbus, OH 43231, United States
name: 🇳🇬 🇳🇬 Intercontinental Nigerian Restaurant (AfricanFood) Best Nigerian Igbo,Yoruba, Hausa Cuisine🇳🇬🇺🇸

html_attributions: 🇳🇬 🇳🇬 Intercontinental Nigerian Restaurant (AfricanFood) Best Nigerian Igbo,Yoruba, Hausa Cuisine🇳🇬🇺🇸

reviews.text:
I visited Intercontinental Nigerian Restaurant today and ordered the jollof rice with fish, tripe, and plantains. The food was okay overall. This was my second time trying Nigerian jollof rice, and it was a good experience, even though it didn’t fully stand out to me this time.

What I really appreciate is the variety on the menu. There are many options to choose from, and I’d like to go back and try some of their other dishes. Here in Columbus, Ohio, we’re fortunate to have many African restaurants serving our diverse African communities. I’m truly grateful to all the restaurant owners who continue to share our culture and flavors with us.

The place has the usual atmosphere of small restaurants on a strip mall. But the food is well made - authentic Nigerian cuisine.

I came in within an hour of their opening and the service was quick. Good good and good value for your money - in my opinion.
Absolutely delicious. The jollof rice and egusi  soup are AMAZING! The flavor is insanely delicious. We will be coming back and HIGHLY recommend!

Gideon and his mom are the best! The food was to die for! I’m definitely coming back. I went with me and 7 of my friends because we wanted to try a new authentic restaurant. They definitely put authentic in restaurant!
Such loving people at the end of our meal we got to meet the cook his mom and thank you so much for her hard work and the meal!
If you’re looking for a great place to have some authentic Nigerian food, this is the place to go! I look forward to seeing the business grow!
P.s. it took a little bit of a weight, but they made sure all the food was warm and ready to be served for all 8 of us total it’s only Gideon and his mom was well worth the wait!

Lovely Lady served me. Food was excellent. I ordered the warrior platter with fish And I ordered some chicken dish with rice. The food was abundant and I had enough for 3 days. If you like spicy food there is a little kick to it but not as hot as some food I've had like Nepali or some very hot Mexican. I actually left my wallet there and 4 days later when I realized it wasn't in my house somewhere and I called them, they had been trying to contact me and find me. So happy ending as well. I know God will bless them and their restaurant.

formatted_address: 2920 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: MAKE Projects

reviews.text:
Located in North Park, MAKE cafe offers a large and airy space with great food from various cuisines and the business supports women refugees and immigrants. We went here for brunch for the first time and we left stuffed and feeling good!

Parking:
Just like any other North Park establishment, expect to take time looking for street parking.

Service/Ambiance:
The place is huge and could accommodate larger groups. It has a rustic feel with high ceilings. You order at the cashier and they serve the food to your table. Our food came out very quickly.

Food:
Unfortunately we didn’t have enough time to order a lot but many items on the menu looked inviting. We ended up order the MAKE Breakfast sandwich ($13) and added beef kofta sausage patty ($5). The flavor of patty was amazing and I really appreciated that the milk bread didn’t crumble/get soggy— big must for me. It was a well-made sandwich which I’d get again.

Overall:
I’d definitely come back to MAKE cafe to try out many other things on their menu!

Incredible food, amazing staff, and an important mission. A delicious restaurant that is also a nonprofit supporting communities in need. The Afghan chicken tacos were insanely delicious. We were with a big group and ordered a variety of items off the menu. All of them were top quality and fresh. Lots of open space and very family friendly. Highly recommend. Will be coming back frequently

Absolutely delicious! I wasn't expecting the food to be this good - I came to support their mission & values - but the food & drinks had such yummy and unique flavors. Only complaint is we wish we ordered more!!! Not the cheapest place ever for breakfast but very comparable prices to every other place in North Park with the added benefit of your purchase supporting their mission of job creation & sustainable community-led agriculture! Will definitely be back next weekend!

This place never disappoints. The food is fresh, flavorful, and perfect portions. The chicken n blue corn waffles and Afghan Tacos were delicious!
Mimosas with lemongrass and OJ is a great upgrade from the standard. Friendly and attentive staff. Highly recommend.

The food and service were wonderful, and the vibe/decor is just darling! I thought the prices were very fair, considering we each got an app, entree and coffee.

We came for breakfast and their citrus-yogurt with seasonal fruit and granola was a perfect, lighter appetizer for two. Usually I am the person asking “who goes out for a yogurt bowl?” but this bowl was unique with all of the different flavors and just the right amount of different textures (creamy yogurt, crunchy granola, fruit).

The sambusas were also heavenly! They are a must-get item and also work well as an appetizer. I also liked that they had many small plate options for sharing - a little taste of everything! For two people, I think 2 apps and 1 entree or 1 app and two entrees would be plenty.

formatted_address: 2032 Murray Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15217, United States
name: African Eats Cuisine

reviews.text: The food was okay, tore mine and my friends stomachs up though, so it probably wasn’t made to order … and our waiter brought out dirty glasses, I’ll add pictures, of water with no ice. Then another table comes in they get completely different glasses that were clean I’ll add the pictures for proof, and they had ice in them. I will say he gave us samples of the food so we could choose what we wanted first but that was unacceptable and the bathroom was very dirty…

This was my first time eating African food, and I was extremely excited. I had been hearing about this restaurant for a while, and wanted to try it. It’s located in the popular murray avenue in Squirrel hill, surrounded by many other restaurants. I’ll cover the food later, but I have to begin by saying that the service was dismal. When we went for lunch around noon, there was nobody when we entered the restaurant and we had to shout to see if anybody was around to help us get seated. Our server was the least responsive server I have ever encountered, and it almost looked like he was unhappy to be there. No smiles, no greetings. Anyway, we sat down and ordered our food. Since we were trying this for the very first time, we wanted to be safe and went with safer options as suggested by our friend. When he returned back with the food, there were no plates. We had to explicitly ask for plates, and then he returned with just one plate for both of us, and we had to ask for another one. The whole thing was bizarre. When we got done with food, we then had to shout again to see if he would bring our check. I don’t know if they’re understaffed, but this is not how you treat a customers specially in a dine in setting. The only saving grace was towards the end of the meal when a gentleman who I assume to be, the owner came and had conversation with us about the food and recommended us some food to try the next time. He seemed really nice and was welcoming. He also did not charges any tip, which I’m not sure, is the norm at that restaurant or why he did that. Now coming to the food itself, it was pretty tasty. We had the jollof rice which was pretty flavourful. He also had the efiroro which seem to be a type of spinach stew. Honestly, that was super unique, and I have never tasted anything like it. Again, I’m not in a position to tell if it was authentic, but it was still quite tasty, nevertheless. I guess African food is an acquired taste and I guess it’ll take me a while to get used to all the flavours. Overall, I can recommend this place if you want to try new cuisine but I would avoid dine in and just to take out.

I recently had a disappointing experience with this African restaurant that left much to be disgusted. To start, the food was excessively greasy—imagine eating fried rice that tasted like a concoction of mismatched ingredients thrown together with no flavor balance. The meat portions were unbelievably small, leaving me feeling unsatisfied. Worse still, the wait time was horrendous; I waited for what felt like an eternity, only to receive food that looked like leftovers from the day before.

To add to the frustration, when I ordered online, they didn’t even bother to call and inform me of changes to my order. It was a complete surprise when I received my order was an insult.. My experience here made me long for the African restaurants in (Africana restaurant)Queens,New York, where in less than five minutes, you’d have your food, and it would be fresh, flavorful, and served with care. Sadly, this place was the total opposite, and I can’t see myself returning anytime soon.the worst African restaurant ever in Pittsburgh. Just go there and waste your money

When I tell you my oxtail was so tough o think they cooked it for less than 5 minutes they literally don’t care I can’t even eat this tough oxtail they didn’t care to trim to fat off and you literally only get 3 pieces lol this is literally the worst African food in the world lol the rice is piled high but I get 3 oxtail? The gravy looks weird to and don’t order the Suya they only give you a few pieces of chopped up steak ! I like to support my people but yall have to do better I will never be back i literally neverrrr got served hard oxtail it’s super easy how did they mess it up? They literally can care less

Decent food. I've only tried a few African spots in Pittsburgh, and this has been on the less delicious side. Still, it was very decent food. And, many of the food items were unique, so it's nice to have spots like this in the area. I ordered the beef meat pie, puff puff (3 of them), and akara bean 'cake.'

My favorite of the items were the delicious puff puffs. If you want a nice, chewy, donut-like snack, then this is the food for you. It was not too oily and very cheap, at a dollar for each of the dough balls. The inside as fluffy. Not too flavorful. I would have enjoyed it more with a dusting of sugar; then, it would serve as a nice dessert.

The Akara was interesting. It seemed to have little bits of vegetables included within this bean cake. I was surprised by the level of spice and flavor included in this small patty. It was on the greasier side as well, but also quite inexpensive at just $1.50.

Finally, the meat pie was not very good. It was thick in breading and extremely dry. Not just the breading was dry, but the meat itself was as well. It was not very flavorful but did have a little bit of vegetables included as well. Small portion size for the price.

All in all, I was not the biggest fan of the food. The portions were quite food and dry, and the flavors were not particularly good. I have not tried many African foods, but there are much better places in Pittsburgh. Definitely try Fabs, it's got similar food but much better quality.

formatted_address: 7650 Girard Ave #400, La Jolla, CA 92037, United States
name: Trilogy Sanctuary

reviews.text:
A Plant-Based Dream in La Jolla — Truly One of a Kind

We were in San Diego for a business trip and stumbled upon Trilogy, and honestly… we ended up eating here every single day (and ordering takeout). This was the only place in the area that checked every box for us: organic, gluten-free, plant-based, no processed ingredients, and no refined sugar. That combination is almost impossible to find. There are plenty of vegan restaurants, but you never really know what’s in their food and lots of places rely on processed substitutes, seed oils, or sugary sauces. Trilogy is different.

Everything is clean, intentional, and made with real ingredients. I usually have to cook all my meals when I travel because I don’t trust restaurant food, but it was such a relief to finally relax and enjoy a meal knowing it aligned with everything I look for. It honestly felt like my body could breathe.

We tried almost the entire menu:
– Nachos
– Breakfast Burrito
– Miso Bowl
– Adora Bowl
– Plant Power Bowl
– Cosmic Quinoa Bowl
– Chili
– Avocado Bruschetta
– Mac n Cheeze
– Perfect Tacos
– Enchiladas
– “Best Burger Yet”
– Carrot Cake
– Pumpkin Pie
– Paradise Cheesecake
- Coconut Cortado
- Latte
- Matcha

Every single dish had flavor, freshness, and that homemade feel you can only get when the kitchen cares about ingredients. Nothing tasted heavy or artificial just real food prepared with love.

We need more restaurants like this. Trilogy made our trip 10x easier, and we wish every city had a place we could trust the way we trusted them. If you’re serious about clean eating, this is the spot in San Diego.

Trilogy is the best vegan cafe in San Diego hands down! The seared spring rolls, enticing eggplant, mac & cheez are all delicious options, but the real star of the show is their sweet treats — I pretty much order their transcendent brownie and vegan cookies every time I come! The ingredient and flavor quality is so good, although it better be for the price haha. Only other downsides are the run-down environment and often unfriendly service, but I will still be back for the best healthy, vegan meals!
Nice place to have brunch and enjoy the view. We ordered nachos, dumplings, baked sweet potatoes, avocado toast and enchiladas. Everything was great, dumplings were a bit chewy.

This vegan restaurant stands out as one of the finest places I have ever dined at. I tried three dishes and they were all a delightful experience, showcasing the vibrant flavors and textures that fresh, plant-based ingredients can offer. I wholeheartedly recommend this exceptional establishment to anyone looking for delicious, high-quality vegan cuisine. The attention to freshness and creativity in their menu truly sets this place apart!

What a gem the Trilogy Sanctuary is. Easily missed, the elevator transports you to a rooftop oasis right in the middle of La Jolla. The smoothies were tasty and wholesome and left us energized for the rest of the day. Looking forward to another visit next time we're in San Diego!

formatted_address: 2312 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Pomegranate

reviews.text:
Pomegranate was a great experience! Everything was packed with flavor. The lamb chops I ordered were packed full of flavor and cooked to perfection. Overall everything was seasoned well and the presenatation was beautiful too. The customer service was also amazing! It was my first time trying this food and I can't wait to come back. If you want something different and are in ther area, please try this restaurant. Highly recommended!
Eat up!!!

Let's start off with how awesome our waiter, Eddie, was. Can't speak higher, he was so helpful in menu selection, funny and knowledgeable. We hadn't tried Russian/Georgian food before and he was helpful in what to order, mindful of our walnut allergies, and how to eat or pair the food authentically.

We ordered the Khinkali and Chakapuli. Both were really good, but our favorite was the lamb stew - so flavorful and came with yummy rice. Lemon, mint, tarragon flavors and the lamb was cooked to perfection, fell right off the bone - it was a delicious cozy meal.

We also got marani chacha shots, Georgian beer and a pomegranate martini which was so good! (Also made by Eddie)

Highly recommend to trying this spot and the cuisine!

This the best place in town. I go as often as I can. I love borsch and their borsch is fantastic. The service is second to none. Great atmosphere with a great selection of Georgian food. Highly recommend 100x over.

The staff and the entire team are very kind and welcoming, have never been so welcomed anywhere else, amazing atmosphere and overall experience! This is my second visit, and there’s no doubt it’s the best food in San Diego—and California in general! Everything is homemade and fresh - actually made with love. Many thanks to everyone!

The sampler salad is great for trying out if it’s your first time there. We ordered all the popular food and everything was delicious!
The sever was super helpful and friendly. Definitely must come back

formatted_address: 3351 Adams Ave, San Diego, CA 92116, United States
name: Jyoti-Bihanga

reviews.text: Valeria met my friend and I so warmly today.  We always look forward to lunches at Jyoti Bihanga!  The light streams in the corners windows and it's comfort food, servers and atmosphere is so refreshing! Soups are some of my favorites there...especially the  lentils.   Beyond the Smile veggie burger is  the best one in town...or anywhere!  This is the only restaurant where I will eat mashed potatoes and gravy. Apple pie is all natural, no filler additives.  You really TASTE the apples.  Tea selections are quite pleasing  as well. Eating here is a peaceful and palate pleasing respite!!!!!  All the best servers and staff!  Thank you for exceptional spiritual quality!

This is My Favorite Restaurant in USA.
Its very difficult for me to find the perfect ingredients (gluten free, sugar free, no seed and canola oils and so on) in the salads and meals. They have the best food. And also the team is meditating every day before they open the restaurant.  How important it is to cook with pure and kind head !!! The price is very very very affordable.

Since 1986! Impressive. My review is redundant - but here goes: VEGAN food! Plus other WELL LABELED options like vegetarian and gluten free. Lilting music, soft lighting and pastel blue surrounding - like a meditation bath - with nibbles! Interesting information about Sri Chinmoy abounds. Indian lamps and lovely greenery. The Rama Bowl was enjoyed by my table mate. I had a small nachos. The beans were seasoned in a yummy way and the fresh guacamole was delicious.

Super friendly staff, great outdoor seating and very dog friendly. Large menu, with a variety of options. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten free. There’s a reason this place has been here for nearly 40 years. The vegan neatloaf is great, So is the beyond burger. Mashed potatoes and gravy is an amazing side to have with the sandwiches.
The food is absolutely delicious, fresh and healthy! Even my husband, who enjoys red meat, loves eating here.! The carrot cake is amazing!

formatted_address: 4661 Park Blvd, San Diego, CA 92116, United States
name: Plumeria Vegetarian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Loved the food. My wife said they have less oil than other Thai restaurants. The flavor was outstanding 👌🏾 Rice was okay; she had white, I had brown. My Cashew Mock Duck was good and she had the Pumpkin Curry 🍛
We always split the food and we both dug (slang), both.

Pros: Taste, Waitresses, Ambiance

Cons: Fried Tofu was not fresh

Lighter Thai vegetarian restaurant with many mock meat options.

The duck noodle soup was excellent. The mock duck was crispy with a pleasant texture. The herb soup base was tasty (great for a cooler evening) and complemented by fresh vegetables, soft noodles, and a lime sauce.

The brown rice and steamed tofu were great options with Plumeria’s Mixed Fiber Plate.  This was a moderate and healthy option - not too light or heavy.

The fried rice noodles were wide and soft.  The sauce was flavorful and not overwhelming.

The yellow curry had a thinner sauce (almost a buttery component on first taste) with crisp carrots and potatoes. In comparison, the pumpkin curry had a robust flavor and body, which was a popular dish (recommended!).

Overall, the steamed tofu and mock duck were good options for our group. The mock beef was not as popular due to the texture.

A spice level of 2-3 out of 10 was true to the scale and worked for the kids in the group.

We stumbled upon this after visiting Balboa Park. Every item on the menu is delicious. We had the Tom yum soup, Spicy rice noodles with Vegan Chicken, Khao Soi with Tempura vegan duck and the Thai tea. I would highly recommend this for a visit.
Lovely Thai food for vegetarians. Really enjoyed the service and ambience and the rich taste of Thai food. Special shout out to khao Soi and the spicy basil fried rice

Overpriced for quality, taste and quantity. Wait staff judges but service is quick.

Tom kha is spicy coconut milk with few pieces of boiled veg. Not your typical authentic Thai.

Satay were just fried vegan meat.

formatted_address: 1905 El Cajon Blvd, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Loving Hut San Diego (North Park)

reviews.text: Wow, phenomenal food! We got the summer rolls and pho and thoroughly enjoyed both. The summer rolls come with a delicious pineapple peanut sauce that was unique and very flavorful. The pho was outstanding - the broth was rich in flavor and the tofu was unique. The server was also very kind and welcoming. We’ll definitely be visiting again any time we are in SD!

Okay, I liked the Loving Hut I went to in San Francisco and thought this one in San Diego would be similar. It wasn’t. The food was tasty but didn’t stand out in any particular way. The service was poor. The cashier hardly engaged the customers unless asked to. I had to ask for water, dishes and a serving spoon - things that should just be usually done. Then the floor was sticky as if mopped with dirty water. Not going back. So disappointed for a what could be a great place for vegans.

Heard good things about it. Went to try it. Empty place. Dirty kitchen. Saw red flags but still decided to order.

They served old microwave food, yucky. Overpriced for disgusting stuff. $9 for a single piece of fried oyster Mushroom.

Danny at register was chill. He was quick to help out.

We stop here about once a month or so and always get bounce between our favorite spicy cha cha and the Bahn mi but everything is outstanding. The Bahn mi tastes just like you'd remember and the cha cha are faux shrimp that are equally convincing and delicious. In a strip mall of chains, this place is a jewel.

I ordered on uber eats so can’t speak on atmosphere & service too much but if you are going to order or eat in listen to me! I spent 40 mins combing through reviews. I decided to order the garlic noodles with the shrimp & the Mongolian beef. I wanted to try it for myself but could’ve used the advice of one review let me just say it lacks flavor and not that much garlicky. It’s literally noodles nothing special. The shrimp however is good and seasoned nice. Someone said it reminded them of imitation fish meat that’s spot on. Tastes good to me. Now the beef lacks flavor I really was thinking I was going to get saucy WELL seasoned food. Nope. That’s disappointing. The noodles came with a free Thai tea that is ok. I ended up spending near 50$. For the noodles to be around 16$ with a few shrimps is just not it. Charging for utensils crazy. Especially spending that kind of $. On top of charging for a little siracha pack still crazy. I put it in the details they didn’t give it to me. I wonder would the mock chicken meal have been more flavorful. Welp at least I can say I tried it.

formatted_address: 2310 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92104, United States
name: Olympic Cafe

reviews.text: This was a vibe. It gave you Mediterranean small cottage vibes on a sunny day. I ordered the patty melt. My gawd!!! Delicious is not the best adjective, mouthwatering is better. That reminds of the chicken skewers… they were orgasmic with each bite. In the neighborhood make sure to check this place out.

Olympic Cafe offers an exquisite Mediterranean experience. The beef kebabs were especially well seasoned and the chicken was tender and delicious. The salad was fresh and the dressing complemented the rice and protein combo really well. The meat was freshly off the grill and my friend and I really enjoyed being able to talk and catch up over this delicious meal. David, our server, was such an a great curator of the experience and he really offered a level of service that inspires us to come back. If you’re in San Diego and looking for Mediterranean food, you have to check out Olympic cafe

I don't usually take time out of my day to write reviews but this spot truly deserves it. Ever since I ate here last week, I literally cannot stop thinking about how delicious my meal was even though it was so simple. I ordered the charbroiled chicken platter with roasted potatoes paired with a side salad and OMG the flavors of every component was truly divine, Id genuinely be so honored to eat this everyday for the rest of my life. If anyone can share a recipe I'd praise you for life. 🙏🏼

The food was absolutely amazing—delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. Honestly, it was one of the best cheesecakes I’ve ever had. The only downside was finding a fly in my overly sweetened Greek coffee, which was truly disgusting. While I understand accidents can happen, the response was underwhelming—a brief, almost dismissive “sorry” with no effort to make it right. Had they handled the situation better, I would have happily given them a 5-star review, but the lack of care left me disappointed after such an otherwise wonderful dining experience.

We had the kebab platter and it was fantastic. The food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Avani took care of us and delivered outstanding service: attentive, friendly, and professional. Highly recommend this place for a great Mediterranean experience!

formatted_address: 3890 50th St, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Madina Delicious Restaurant

reviews.text: Reliable appetizer and the choices end early. Today we discovered the beef suqaar. The fight was on and the place is very welcoming.  The food was delicious.
I would say it's a hidden gem in San Diego. Amazing halal food and lovely people.

Good rice ,very tasty chapati with whatever choice of sukar.The prices were very reasonable for the quality and portion size. Given how flavorful the dishes were and the unique flavors of the cuisine, it was great value for the money."

I had the pleasure of eating at madina delicious restaurant The food here is absolutely delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Highly recommend the wasla with rice.
Excellent

formatted_address: 9119 Clairemont Mesa Blvd Suite H, San Diego, CA 92123, United States
name: Tahini Authentic Middle Eastern Street Food

reviews.text:
Whenever I take a trip down to San Diego, I always look forward to dining at this fantastic restaurant. The freshness of the food is truly impressive, making every meal a delightful experience. My personal favorite dish is the "make my own bowl," 🥣 🥣 🥣 where I can customize my ingredients to perfection. Each component is seasoned just right, creating a harmonious explosion of flavors with every bite.

Today was particularly special, as I had the opportunity to chat with one of the owners, Moody. He is an incredibly friendly gentleman, exuding warmth and hospitality. I expressed my thoughts to him, mentioning how much I would love to see a location open up in Oceanside. He listened attentively, and it was clear he values customer feedback, making the experience even more enjoyable.

I ordered online for pickup and got a completely different pita than what i ordered. Unfortunately I picked up in a hurry and didn't notice until I got back to work and didn't have time to drive back/ wait for correct order. I ordered a pita with steak, lettuce, onions, pepperoncinis, shredded cheese, feta cheese and a side of almonds. It was packaged neatly in a paper bag with my name and order, but the pita i received had chicken, fries, tomatoes, parsley mix, pickles, basically everything i didn't pick haha. I do think it was an honest mistake, probably just misplaced someone else's order into my bag, but I was pretty bummed. Also paid an extra dollar for the steak that i didn't get. I did get my side of almonds though. After removing the pickles, I ate it anyway and it was just ok, but then again it didn't have any of the ingredients or sauces that I picked.

I had a great experience at Tahini’s! The food was really good and everything came out fresh. I also wanted to say Mohamad was super helpful, friendly, and made the whole visit even better. Great service and great food. Definitely recommend

I haven't been to Tahini for 5 years. They were so successful they moved into the space where the Japanese restaurant used to be. The meat stacks are made fresh daily. It's an order at the counter type place, quick service and a great spot for lunch. No alcohol but they have sodas

It was the first time to visit, it’s a good place, the vibes and the service is great. We ordered shawarma chicken and steak, the food wasn’t not bad but the garlic sauce was so weird we didn’t like it. The big issue was with the samosas, I got the beef one it was horrible. The beef has no taste and the dough was burned with better taste. We paid around $80 for 4 orders which is a little bit pricey regarding the quality.

I just wanted to edit my review to thank the Restaurant owner who contacted me and tried to make everything right. I explained all of my experience and he was very professional and helpful. He also offered me a gift card . Thank you so much and I know you will be very successful.

formatted_address: 6755 Mira Mesa Blvd Ste 111, San Diego, CA 92121, United States
name: Charminar Indian Restaurant & Catering

reviews.text:
Having tried many Indian food options in Texas, this restaurant in San Diego still felt decent overall. The Baby Corn 65 is a must-try, with well-balanced spices and great flavor. The Chicken Dum Biryani was good, but the Mutton Dum Biryani was disappointing as it didn’t taste fresh and wasn’t up to the mark.
The ambiance was pleasant, though the restroom maintenance needs improvement—the flooring was slippery and the doors were quite tight. Overall, a satisfactory experience with some room for improvement.
Plan ahead for rush hours!

We had dinner at this Hyderabadi-style Indian restaurant during a recent conference trip to San Diego. We arrived around 8 p.m. on a weeknight, and the place was still busy enough that we had to wait about 5–6 minutes for a table. It’s a very casual spot — not a fine-dining setup, just a simple, informal restaurant.

We started with water, but surprisingly they didn’t serve ice with it. For appetizers, we ordered a chicken kebab and kodi vepudu (a spicy fried chicken dish). The kodi vepudu was flavorful and nicely spiced, but the kebab was disappointing — bland, lacking seasoning, and without the smoky, chargrilled flavor you’d expect.

For the main course, I ordered Dum ka Chicken, a Hyderabadi specialty, and my friends ordered mutton ghee roast. One thing worth noting: unlike most Indian restaurants, the main dishes do not come with rice, so you have to order rice or naan separately. I got a tandoori roti, while the others ordered butter naan. The portion sizes were very large — none of us could finish our meals, and we all ended up taking leftovers home.

The food overall had a strong South Indian/Telugu-style flavor profile — bold, spicy, and rich — so if that’s what you enjoy, you’ll likely appreciate it. We were too full to try dessert, but the meal was satisfying.

very nice restaurant with great menu options.  i ordered the street fried rice and the fried baby corn, and both were really really good.   i also ordered 8/10 spice level and it was for sure spicy.  i love spicy food and some places 8/10 are not spicy at all.  this place has some real spicyness, but also still a good flavor.  i would recommend going less on the spice level if you like spicy food but still want to enjoy the flavor. my only complaint was that i did not find the chai to taste very good.  for some reason it tasted quite salty to me, even after adding sugar.  overall i still really recommend the food as it has great flavor, and the staff was kind and professional.

Charminar delivers some of the most authentic, flavorful Indian cuisine in Orange County. The spices are beautifully balanced, the dishes taste freshly prepared, and every bite feels thoughtful — rich without being overwhelming.

The biryani is aromatic and perfectly cooked, the curries are deep and comforting, and the naan comes out warm and just right. You can tell the kitchen respects tradition while maintaining consistency and quality.

Service is warm and attentive, and the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming — ideal for both a casual dinner or bringing guests who truly appreciate good Indian food.

If you’re in Laguna Woods or nearby, Charminar is absolutely worth the visit. We’ll be coming back.

We ordered the Dum Ka Chicken and the Chicken Chettinad, with Garlic Naan and Dahi Kebab. The main entrees were excellent, and the curries were sooooo flavorful. We loved everything and will surely come back.

The service was also really nice, and the staff was really attentive.

formatted_address: 139 High St, London W3 6LX, United Kingdom
name: Sabiib Somali Restaurant - Acton

reviews.text:
Somalian cuisine is incredibly delicious. We ordered the platter for two and the portion was sufficient for three average eaters. The rice was fragrant, fluffy and tasty. Meats were well marinated, flavorful and tender. This platter also came with pasta which complimented the meats the same way the meats complimented the rice - it was amazing that meats works perfectly with either staple. There was some thin pancakes served at the side along with a salad, mint sauce and a spicy tamarind sauce (I’m guessing from the colour it’s tamarind). I love that every diner gets a banana to complete their meal. We didn’t get dessert as we were stuffed after the meal.
As the place is packed, reservations are a must and be prepared to wait as each sitting is 90 minutes. I noticed that diners who could not finish their meals were given aluminum trays to pack the food and bring it home. What a great way to minimize food waste.
I highly recommend visiting this restaurant if you are in London. It’d be worth the trip.

We ordered the Platter for Two and honestly, it was incredible. Everything was full of flavour. The Somali rice and pasta were delicious, and the slow-cooked lamb shoulder was so tender it just melted. We also tried the seabass, and it was perfectly seasoned with garlic, lime, coriander, and xawaash, definitely one of our favourites.

We also had Somali tea and coffee, and both were lovely. The tea had just the right amount of spice and the coffee was smooth and rich.
The portions were generous, the food tasted fresh, and it absolutely lived up to all the hype we’ve seen on social media. We left full and really satisfied.

We’ll definitely be coming back, highly recommend!

I recently dined at Sabiib and was genuinely impressed by how beautiful the place is. The ambiance is modern yet warm, with a lovely attention to detail that makes it feel special. The food was very good, a refined, modern take on traditional Somali dishes, and everything tasted fresh and flavourful.

What stood out most to me, though, was the service. Despite how busy the restaurant was, and it really does get quite crowded, the staff were attentive, polite, and managed everything with a smile. It’s clear they put real effort into making sure everyone feels looked after.

Compared to other Somali restaurants I’ve been to, I’d say Sabiib is on the pricier side, and the portions are smaller than what I’m used to. Still, the overall experience, from the atmosphere to the quality of service, makes it a great spot for a nice evening out or a special meal.

We had a wonderful meal here tonight. It was our first time trying Somali food, we were thoroughly impressed. Huge portion sizes, cooked beautifully, fresh and delicious. The staff went above and beyond to make our evening a great experience. We will definitely be back!

Wow! First time trying Somalian food and it was absolutely delicious. The restaurant is beautiful and staff are very friendly! We were served by Fartun Y and she was lovely!
We got a platter for 2 in order to try a little bit of everything, the portion was huge and it did not disappoint. The weirdest thing is that the banana actually goes so well with the food! Moctails were also delicious. Very very satisfied and definitely recommend.

formatted_address: Beresford Sq, London SE18 6AY, United Kingdom
name: Roon's Catering

reviews.text: Been coming to this stall for a few years and never disappoints. The spicy samosas are unbelievably good! The lamb on Fridays is a must! Friendly service and incredible food!

I really wanted to support a local Somali-owned business, but this experience was a big disappointment. We always talk about supporting our own community, but situations like this make it difficult. The lack of communication, late replies, and unprofessional handling of my order, which never happened, really let me down. I was even ghosted on the day it was meant to be delivered. This order was supposed to showcase the beautiful Somali food that my colleagues have never experienced or eaten before.

I genuinely expected better from a sister in the community. For anyone thinking of ordering, please be aware of my experience. I would recommend going somewhere reliable.

I recently ordered a variety of Somali dishes from Rooms Kitchen to share with my friend visiting from Jamaica, and it was such a beautiful experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and truly made with love. It was his first time trying Somali food, and he really enjoyed every dish — the variety and taste left such a positive impression.

May Allah bless you, your hard work, and your wonderful service. Insha’Allah, big things are yet to come for you and your business. Thank you for not just providing food, but creating an experience that brings people together. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

I recently had the chance to try out Roons Catering, and I’m impressed. Their food is full of flavour, especially the Somali-style dishes—authentic, vibrant, and clearly made with care. The service is flexible and friendly, especially for events.

If there’s one thing I’d recommend, it’s that Roons seriously consider opening a permanent store (or stall) where people can taste their food more readily. They already have the quality; they just need a base so people can discover them casually, try small dishes, and build loyalty.

Overall, Roons Catering is doing great for its size. With a storefront, they could expand their reach, consistency, and brand strength. I strongly recommend them for event catering, and I’m excited to see how they grow.

First time trying somali food and it was so delicious! The flavour was incredible. The owner let us try a little bit of everything before ordering to see what we liked. The lamb was super tender and flavorful, and I don't usually like lamb, but it was delicious! The price was very affordable as well and portions were very generous. We will definitely go back!

formatted_address: 1784 E Dublin Granville Rd, Columbus, OH 43229, United States
name: Red Sea Cafe & Deli - Somali Restaurant

reviews.text: Great food at an affordable price! We went for a family style option, choosing chicken with rice. We also received an appetizer that was absolutely out of this world. The green chili and onion sauce provided just the right amount of kick to satisfy both of our appreciations for spice! We plan to return for a lamb lunch on a Friday or Saturday. We strongly suggest you check this place out!
Incredible food! The best lamb and rice I have tried in Columbus! The appetizer of the hand pies are life changing! Everything was delicious and the people working were helpful and very sweet.

I was in columbus recently for a work and I came this restaurant “ Woooow the food is really good and fresh. Plus the quality and quantity is absolutely amazing. Thank you Red Sea & Deli and definitely will come back .

Absolutely wonderfully fresh and delicious food! I ordered the chicken & rice, it came with a small  salad. My daughter ordered the goat & rice (small salad also included). Everything was wonderful!

The service was superb — friendly, thoughtful, and the waitress took time to discuss the food varieties. The bread for the wraps / sandwiches is made in-house; I’m looking forward to trying those!

10/10! Adding this place to my return list!

Alhamdullihah! One of the best somali restaurants I eat in on a regular basis. And the food is diabetic friendly. My family enjoyed it and look forward to return asap Thanks Red Sea restaurant for your quality service 👍👍👍Both!

formatted_address: 7061 Clairemont Mesa Blvd, San Diego, CA 92111, United States
name: Elijah's Restaurant, Delicatessen and Catering

reviews.text: Excellent service, great iced tea (frequent refills), great house salad. Beef tongue 1/2 sandwich was excellent though hardly “overstuffed” (as other reviewers have mentioned). Still, will give 5 stars since everything else was great including the atmosphere.

My dad asked me where to get a great pastrami sandwich. I chose Elijah's after looking at pictures online. I had tried theirs years ago and remember it was good. The menu calls it an overstuffed sandwich. What we got was anemic (see pics) not overstuffed and it was some pastrami folded in half and slapped between two pieces of bread. The meat was really chewy. I told the waitress and showed her the online pictures compared to our anemic sandwiches. She literally said nothing and walked away. They also never brought out water that we ordered and we had to ask the waitress for it. The restaurant was mostly empty so they were not busy. Paid $20 each, overpriced for my anemic sandwiches and will not be going back again. Strange thing is on my way out I saw a patron with an actual overstuffed pastrami sandwich which made me wonder if they are racist (we asian) and made us crap sandwiches on purpose or if the cook was on a break and someone who is not a chef made the sandwiches. Also quite annoted that the waitress basically ignored me when I asked why the sandwiches we received were nothing like the pictures. So I gave them a chance to fix it and was ignored. Awesome.

Nice spacious and clean shop.
Full bar wine selection.
Food is well prepared and tasty.
Ordered an eggplant wrap and an egg white omelette delish.
Just the right amount of food.
This is my most-visited deli in San Diego! Something seems to be going on in the small though, like a complete renovation, so maybe they'll be moving at some point? Love the over-stuffed sandwiches!
Stopped for the Filet and Egg special. Steak was cooked and seasoned to perfection. Top notch customer service as well. Exceeded our expectations!

formatted_address: 3149 Cleveland Ave, Columbus, OH 43224, United States
name: Calanley Somali Restaurant

reviews.text: Calanley Somalia Restaurant truly delivers amazing food! I had their rice with goat meat and chicken barbecue stew, and everything was absolutely delicious. The meat was tender and flavorful, the rice was perfectly cooked, and the stew had a rich, authentic taste that brought everything together. You can really tell they put love and care into their cooking. If you’re looking for tasty Somali dishes with generous portions and great flavor, this is the spot. Highly recommend!

Delicious food!! They seemed surprised we came in to eat, and it was our first time trying Somali food. But they were very accommodating and helped us try a lot of different things! Portions are large and the extras (juice, salad, soup, bananas) were awesome. We got the goat kebabs, beef tips, and chicken kaykay. All were yummy! Will definitely be back!

Tried this restaurant for the first time. Upon entering I was skeptical about eating there because of the disorganization and many flies. I stayed because the reviews I read were good and my wife is Somali and has been adamant about me trying Somali food since she cant cook it😂.

The service was decent and the food was delicious. I loved the soup. It was my first time trying camel and it reminded me of pot roast. It was a bit dry but still good. I would have preferred it simmering in some gravy and poured over rice with sweet peppers😁.The beef was good and seasoned well. The spaghetti was just right.

I would give 5 stars but the restaurants appearance is unappealing.

We ordered 1 goat with anjera, 2 kay kay with chicken, one beef suqaar with anjera (pictured). Price is $68 ($17 per meal average).

Thoughts:
-I am familiar with injera, according to the web “anjera” is also a fermented flat bread. What I received (pictured below) is a flour tortilla with grill marks. There is no debate about that, it is not any type of house made, fermented bread.

-the quantity of the beef is good! It tastes fine. It was very hard and chewy.

-everything comes with a white sauce. It is very apparently miracle whip (or “salad dressing”) which has been watered down to a pourable consistency.

-they gave us one small cup of lentil soup to share with 4 plates. It was good.

-each plate comes with a banana.

Summary:
tortilla, not anjera
$17 a plate
Overcooked

We really want to like this place. We were excited to get it but it’s super overpriced for what you get and not as advertised.

We won’t come back for what we got.

Disappointed with the decline in cleanliness
This used to be one of my favorite restaurants, but the sanitation has really gone downhill. The moment you walk in, there’s a bad smell lingering in the air. Tables are left dirty, sticky, and unkempt. It’s honestly sad to see a place I used to love fall apart like this. I hope management takes this seriously and brings back the standards they once had.

formatted_address: 5227 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: الصومالي

reviews.text: The place is not very good and not visible and there are a lot of Somali taxi drivers but the rice with meat is very delicious I went there several times
The food is good, but the cleanliness is not good.

formatted_address: 1450 Kettner Blvd, San Diego, CA 92101, United States
name: Darband Persian Grill

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience here over the summer ('25), still thinking about it six months or so later. The kebabs, the tomatoes, the rice... And very friendly staff as well as a relaxing, sophisticated but comfortable atmosphere. A highlight of our visit to SD.

Truly a gem for authentic Persian cuisine in downtown San Diego. The name “Darband” itself carries legacy, and after dining here, it's clear why they've been around since 1998.

We stopped in and ordered their signature kabob plate — juicy, flavorful koobideh and well-charred chicken served alongside perfectly fluffed saffron rice and grilled vegetables. As seen in the photos, every element on the plate was executed with care. The chicken in particular stood out for its tenderness and bold seasoning.

The market section of the restaurant also has a fun mix of imported items and snacks — everything from dried mulberries and raisins to lavash bread, fresh juices, and soda options. A great touch if you want to bring a little taste of the cuisine home with you.

Atmosphere is clean, casual, and inviting. While it's a simple setup, the focus is clearly on the food and authenticity.

Will definitely return when back in the area. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a solid Persian food experience.

I saw many one-star reviews and thought I should try this place myself and share my own experience. It’s clean, plays Persian music, and definitely offers an authentic Darband-style food experience. I hope people can be kinder to small businesses like this.

I visited San Diego in April, and had this place saved on my map since I was staying nearby. It was a Tuesday and not very busy. The service was quick, the girl behind the counter was polite, and the food was delicious.

I have a habit of always getting the Koobideh kabob because i've always loved the aroma of the spices in the kabob, which makes the meal more enjoyable for me. The kabob was juicy and the roasted tomatoes made every bite even better. The rice was fluffy with a drizzle of saffron water which smelled amazing. I even decided to have one of the hot serranos that came on the side. They also have delicious Persian tea available to self-serve. You have to try some with your meal, as the flavor is distinct and goes great with pesian spices.

My meal was just as delicious as it was in 1999 when I worked on 5th avenue and they were right up the street!
The servers were very informative and recommended some delicious meals!

formatted_address: 9265 Activity Rd, San Diego, CA 92126, United States
name: Tandoori Group - Catering Services

reviews.text: I planned a desi wedding in the middle of Joshua Tree where the site had no kitchen infrastructure. Varun and his team were UNBELIEVABLE and was able to cook everything on site for my Indian wedding. First of all the food was so freaking good and I had so many people come up to me saying that this was the best wedding food they've ever had. The highlights were the chaat and pani puri. I cannot thank Varun enough for how incredible all of their staff, setup, and food was and making it a highlight for people

Varun & team catered my wedding in November and were easily the best vendor I worked with. I kid you not the guests broke out into cheering at the reception when tandoori group was mentioned because the food was immaculate all weekend.

From the flavors to the presentation, Varun's team handled it all. My husband and I had specific dishes we wanted made for each event that were off menu and the tandoori group was able to accommodate it all.

Thank you again tandoori group team!

We recently hired TANDOOR GROUP, SAN DIEGO, CA for our Diwali Celebration, and we couldn’t be happier with the entire experience! From start to finish, their team was professional, organized, and incredibly attentive to detail.

The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavor. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about the menu in its entirety. It was clear that everything was made with fresh, high-quality ingredients.

Beyond the food, the service was exceptional. The staff were friendly, efficient, and went above and beyond to ensure everything ran smoothly. They handled setup and cleanup seamlessly, allowing us to fully enjoy the event without any stress.

We truly appreciated how flexible and accommodating the team was with last-minute requests and dietary restrictions. Their communication leading up to the event was prompt and professional, making the entire planning process effortless.

Thank you!

Perfect catering for delicious food!  Their live dosa station and live chana batura were the hit of the party. Very easy to work with and very accommodating and flexible even when the party ran behind schedule. Will use their services again!

We had the pleasure of choosing Tandoori Group for our housewarming catering, and the entire experience was excellent. From the start, Varun (the owner) was incredibly kind and accommodating, taking the time to understand our needs and helping us finalize the perfect menu.

On the day of the event, there was an unexpected emergency that delayed the food preparation. Varun personally stepped in and ensured everything was delivered to us within an hour—at no extra charge. Not only that, he went above and beyond by including a complimentary dessert. That kind of thoughtfulness and professionalism truly stood out and made us feel valued.

The food itself was absolutely delicious—every dish was flavorful and beautifully prepared. The ras malai, in particular, was outstanding and had all our guests raving about it.

We’re so grateful to Varun and his team for their support and exceptional service. We’ll definitely be working with them again and highly recommend Tandoori Group to anyone looking for catering in SoCal.

formatted_address: 9756 Mira Mesa Blvd, San Diego, CA 92126, United States
name: Blazzers

reviews.text: Yesterday was my first time trying Blazzers, and the food was so good that I came back again today for lunch! I ordered the New Yorker Special and it was delicious, fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made. Great spot, definitely my new go-to!

BOMB.COM
Omg! As someone who used to frequently go to NYC and absolutely LOVED the chicken over rice, this is it! This food truck was so it, I am so happy that my bf & I stopped by for dinner.

I ordered the “New Yorker” and my bf ordered the “anda shami” while we also shared the garlic fries. The garlic sauce is soooooo good!

Will absolutely be coming back!

Ordered blaze fries but they did not include any sauce. Too dry to eat without sauce.

Edit: the owner offered me a free order of blaze fries to make up for this. They went above and beyond by explaining the situation and I am now changing my review. The one they gave me is 5/5 stars. Would definitely get again but I will be cautious and make sure that there is sauce on the the fries for now on.

The burgers (cheeseburgers and tikka burger) and fries were amazing, especially  the garlic fries!! So glad we trusted the reviews and stopped. Now I want to try all the Pakistani food too. The guy working it was so great as well. Highly highly recommend.

Blazers food truck was pretty darn good i have to say this is my 3rd visit.

I have had positive experiences here and got multiple different things this time.
My favorite dish was the 'New Yorker' had a wonderful and satisfying tastes with signature sauces on top the meat was perfect and combo with rice and lettuce was a filling bowl.
The blaze fries are definitely a big hit forsure fans of carna asada fries will love this lots of crispy fries and super good meat of choice and cheese and signature blaze sauce and garlic sauce was a tasty pick up I'd recommend.
The Tikka roll was a good fill not too big but had a great taste of chicken and sauce mixed in with lettuce and such.
The double cheese burger was a big hit too not a miss at all and a solid choice of beef and cheese if you wanted more protein or something less adventures.
Definitely give them a try

You can usually find them baby the park in ride by mira mesa and the 15fw and behind best buy.

formatted_address: 10436 Craftsman Way ste 120, San Diego, CA 92127, United States
name: BAHAR Indian Restaurant & Catering

reviews.text:
I recently dined at Bahar and overall, it was a great experience. The food was absolutely delicious, with standout dishes like the biryani, chicken tikka masala, samosas, and the mixed chicken platter being true highlights. Each dish was full of flavor and well-prepared. However, the vegetable kebabs were a bit of a letdown and didn’t quite meet the same standard.
