On the downside, the service left something to be desired. We were seated in a spot that was quite chilly, and when we asked for the heater to be turned on, we were told it was broken. Despite our requests, we weren’t moved to a warmer area, which made the experience a bit uncomfortable.

In summary, the food was fantastic, but the service and ambiance could use a bit of improvement.

We recently had Bahar cater our daughter’s first birthday and aqiqa celebration, and they exceeded every expectation. The food was truly the highlight of the event. Guests are still talking about the incredible Chicken 65 and the rich, perfectly spiced Goat Biryani—both were absolute crowd favorites.

Even our non-desi guests couldn’t stop raving about the samosas and gulab jamuns. It was so special to see everyone, from every background, enjoy the flavors with so much enthusiasm.

The two staff members who helped with serving were wonderful as well—kind, attentive, and always on top of refilling trays before anything ran out. Their presence made everything run smoothly.

We feel so lucky to have such a gem of Indian food right here in our backyard. Bahar helped make our celebration memorable, and we’ll happily be returning for future events.

I recently dined at BAHAR in 4S Ranch, San Diego, and here's my take. I tried the *Malai Kofta* and *Chicken Bezwada Biryani*.

Unfortunately, the Malai Kofta's gravy was a letdown - it lacked depth and flavor, feeling somewhat bland. The Chicken Bezwada Biryani was average, nothing to write home about.

On the bright side, the ambience was stunning! The decor and atmosphere were inviting and made for a pleasant dining experience.

Given the potential shown by the setting, I'm hoping BAHAR works on refining their food and quality. With some tweaks, this spot could truly shine. Maybe next time I'll get to enjoy better dishes.

Food: 2.5/5
Ambience: 4.5/5

This was our first trip to the restaurant, and we enjoyed the food.
We used to go to Sitar off Mira Mesa but they closed down in 2021.  We started going to Charminar in Mira Mesa.  Good to see an Indian restaurant in 4S Ranch.  The food is excellent and the restaurant is not as crowded as Charminar.  Service was fair but we understand the restaurant had only opened two months ago.  Seemed like our waitress was new.  It took a while to get service but the food arrived very quickly.  Will definitely go back and try the buffet next.

Tried this restaurant and liked it. It’s a huge place that can accommodate a lot of people, with a nice ambience. The food overall tastes good and has authentic Indian flavors. We went for dinner and tried a few dishes; Goat Biryani, Chicken Ghee Roast, and Chicken Boti Kebab. The Chicken Boti Kebab was especially good. The service, however, was a bit slow and not very attentive. Planning to try the buffet next time to get an overall idea of the food quality and taste.

formatted_address: 3545 Aero Ct Suite B, San Diego, CA 92123, United States
name: BoujieMana

reviews.text:
Would definitely go back! The food was great - the shakshuka had chickpeas, lamb sausage and was very flavorful, the accompanying pita bread was pillowy and warm. The brunch menu is very reasonably priced.
Service was on point.
The restaurant design was very intentional and neat. I liked the custom art, the mirrors in the co-ed bathroom area, high ceilings. They had expensive looking heaters with movable arms, and in general it did not look like they spared any expense in decor. (Which hopefully doesn’t impact the restaurant’s viability!)
The restaurant does seem a bit out of the way, and was very quiet for Saturday at lunch - I hope more people visit so that it stays around!

Went here for our 5 year anniversary. Host was very pleasant upon arrival. Thanked us for celebrating our anniversary there and offered complimentary champagne and an appetizer, which was very gracious of them. Interior decor is very nice and pleasant. The menu was very interesting. Seemed like a blend of Mediterranean and Italian.
We ordered the hummus with extra pita, kousa, the snapper, the ribeye and the hazelnut affogato for dessert.

Hummus was delicious and the pita as well. Seemed like they used lard in the pita, so it had almost a homemade tortilla chew to it. 4/5

The kousa was very delicious. Didn't know it was gonna be a roll when ordered, which made it very nice to eat. The toasted sesame added a nice crunchy texture and complimented the lamb really well. 5/5 Definite recommendation!

The ribeye was cooked a little under our request. Requested med rare and the steak came out more rare in the thicker parts and med rare where it was thinner. Steak was seasoned nicely and tender, however the temp was not there. It came out barely warm, probably because of the cook, but that was a bit disappointing. The salad on the side had a nice mix of greens, but the vinaigrette was a bit too salty for my taste. 3/5

The snapper was cooked perfectly and the cold heriloom tomato and red onion salad that accompanied it was very good! I'm not the biggest fan of tomatoes but I did really enjoy those. 5/5

Hazelnut affogato was a nice finish to this rather big meal. The gelato has an amazingly creamy texture and the espresso complemented it so well. Definitely gave me that pick up that I needed! 5/5

Definitely would be coming back, especially if they have seasonal menu changes.

Pros

Truly beautiful atmosphere: The moment you step inside, the space feels warm, elegant, and thoughtfully curated. It’s the kind of place where you instantly relax and want to linger.

Wonderful service: Every staff member I interacted with was attentive, quick, and genuinely pleasant. Their professionalism and kindness create a very welcoming feeling.

Calm and soothing vibe: The restaurant has a peaceful energy that makes the whole experience comfortable and enjoyable.

Lovely tableware and furniture: The plates, utensils, and overall setup are high-quality and a pleasure to use — small details that make the visit feel special.

Cons

A small sharp bone in the burger: The burger is too salty but tasty. Also, I caught a little sharp bone in the patty, which was an unexpected and somewhat unpleasant surprise.

Tea arrived not hot enough: The water in the teapot, and even the refill, were only warm, so the tea couldn’t brew properly. It took away from what could’ve been a simple comfort.

Side salad felt too simple: The salad that comes with the burger was mostly just leaves with a very sour dressing. It could really shine with a few extra ingredients and a softer, more balanced flavor.

No sugar offered with the tea: I usually enjoy one spoon of sugar with tea, and it wasn’t provided — a small detail, but one that would make the experience more complete.

I had lunch here today, and the food was absolutely delicious. What a hidden treasure—you wouldn't even know it was there. The service was great, the atmosphere was really nice, and everything is laid out well. It's a great spot for a nice lunch or dinner. I will definitely be back!

This place is off the beaten path and is located behind a few apartments near a small park on aero drive.

We've been here a few different times and have tried their happy hour and dinner menu. As of this writing, their happy hour M-Th 2-5pm only.

There is plenty of parking and plenty of indoor seating with a small private room that you can reserve. The decor is very modern and boujie and the bathroom is next level fancy with heated toilets. The staff is very friendly and professional. Our servers have always been polite, meticulous, and helpful.

Food usually comes out in a reasonable amount of time, but can take longer if they're busy. From the happy hour menu, the deviled eggs, chicken wings, fries, and pepperoni pizza are excellent! Every item was flavorful and cooked perfectly.

They are known for their pita and their pizza because they also use the same dough to make their pizza. The dough is crispy, light, and airy with a nice chewy texture.

The cheeseburger was just ok. The middle of my burger was medium but the outside was burnt and little bitter. Would not recommend this item.

The octopus is amazing! Crispy tentacles and firm meaty texture. It was the best octopus I've ever had!!

Overall this place is a gem of a restaurant. It's a bit pricey, but I think it's worth the cost.

formatted_address: 4655 Executive Dr Suite 100, San Diego, CA 92121, United States
name: Banyan Kitchen

reviews.text:
They never get my order right.
Simple, but they rush and and don't read:
Truffle Fries, topped with chopped bacon and two over easy eggs with runny jokes. $18.00
This is what I get.

Within an office building. Music isn't the best (not very laid back), but that's where the bad things end. Breakfast croissant was pretty good, save for it's simplicity (little acid would help), and the lady was super nice. Parking in the facility is not free, but can ve validated with over $10 order.

I tried the panko chicken sandwich here, it was actually really good. I enjoyed it. My complaint though is the price is a little crazy, this sandwich (which I could have easily eat two for lunch) was $15! It didn't come with a side or drink or anything.

The panko was super crispy and it tasted great, but I can't justify the price.

I hosted a wellness event catered with brunch from Banyan Kitchen, and they did not disappoint! My guests absolutely loved every item on the buffet, so much so that there was not a single bite left over! Absolutely remarkable, from the fresh quality to delicious preparation of each item cooked to perfection. Grateful for the kind service! We will definitely book again for future events!

So delicious! We got a quiche and the goat cheese omelette. The quiche is seriously to DIE for they were so flavorful and creamy. I am an avid baker and the baked goods were made to perfection. As for drinks we got a vanilla latte and a chai latte- they were so good. We are always looking for the best cafe in San Diego and this is our new favorite!

formatted_address: 6628 Mission Gorge Rd C, San Diego, CA 92120, United States
name: Chamorro Grill

reviews.text: Great place the bbq chicken and beef spare ribs are great. Meat is cooked to order has lots of flavor. The red rice is good and they have great spam masubi. The spam is fried perfectly. Definitely a great spot.

I tried this spot recently, and overall the experience was just okay. The food tasted fresh, but it was a bit overgrilled and came out more burnt than I would have preferred. Portions also felt small for the price — a chicken mini was $12.50, while a beef mini would’ve been $15.50, and all you get is a small bowl.

The sauce wasn’t really to my taste, though that might just be a matter of preference with the ethnic flavor profile. The decor had a touch of Hawaiian influence, but the overall vibe was more of a fast-food, casual setup.

On the positive side, the staff was genuinely friendly, which I appreciated. That’s probably what nudged my rating up to 4 stars, but if I’m being honest, my personal experience felt closer to a 3.

We were chatting with a volunteer at the House of Chamorro in the International Houses in Balboa Park, as I wasn't exactly sure where Chamorro was relative to Guam. We had a very nice conversation and the young lady said we were lucky to have a few really good Chamorran restaurants here in San Diego. Fortunately for us the Chamorran Grill is less than 15 minutes away from us, so we went to check it out. She had recommended the chicken BBQ plate with the red rice and pancit as a typical, traditional dish to start with. Wow. It was really, REALLY wonderful! Never had anything like it before. The BBQ chicken was tender boneless thighs bbq'd to perfection with just enough char, but still tender and moist (and a generous portion!) served over a bed of shredded cabbage with a side of red rice (delicious!) and pancit (really flavorful rice vermicelli that my gluten sensitive wife can eat!), with a few lemon wedges and a killer fina denne sauce (citrus juice, soy sauce, spices and peppers). It's become one of our new favorites and we love introducing friends to it. They all love it and now some lunch dates are requesting it by name!
The BBQ plate is less than $20 and feeds both my wife and me amply. It's a small hole in the wall place in a non-descript strip mall, but there's lots of free parking and it's close to SDSU. The people are always friendly, the food is always fresh (it can take a bit if it's busy, but it's well worth having it cooked fresh to order). Bonus: they also have spam musubi on the menu!  🥰
Another new exotic favorite to add to our favorites, and they offer a "loyalty card" that gives you a free entrée after ten purchases. Hafa Adai! 😎

Stopped by at this restaurant recently and it was good! The restaurant
features Hawaiian-Filipino fusion cuisine. I ordered the mixed combo plates with BBQ short ribs and pork ribs. Price was also
good.The portion was more than generous and it tasted fantastic!

A restaurant serving Hawaiian, Guamanian, and Filipino food by two Filipino brothers who have deep roots in Hawaii and Guam. The dishes we got were good and the prices very reasonable.  You have to wait a little for grilled meat dishes as those are prepared on order.  They also have some unique dishes like chicken kelaguen (citrus shredded chicken) that you won’t easily find anywhere else.

formatted_address: 9810 Carroll Canyon Rd ste 102, San Diego, CA 92131, United States
name: Deccan Bites

reviews.text: Found this place online with great reviews and it did not disappoint. The fried chicken is very good and was so crispy and juicy with really good French fries. Also tried chicken 65 combo and that also tasted great. It wss a bit spicy but pairing it with rumali roti made it very nice. I would say the spice level was high, probably should have gone with medium to low on the spice level. Great place over all!!

Fried chicken and Indian food? Well it's more of an Indian flare on fried chicken, but why not!

My wife found this place on Instagram and wanted to give it a try since we were going to be in the area.

There is a small amount of parking in front of the restaurant but some of them are only 30 minutes but they also have a drive through. The inside looks like a typical fast food restaurant and there are about 10 tables inside. You order at the counter and they will hand you a buzzer to notify you when to pick up your food.

We ordered a few different things and everything tasted like you would expect.

The 65 chicken was interesting and had a lot of flavor. The fried chicken was crispy and juicy. I got the spicy and it was decently spicy, but I have a higher spice tolerance.

Tater tots were crispy with a powdered garlic taste.
Overall, the food was tasty but reminiscent of fast food fried chicken. For the price, I don't think it's worth the money.

Definitely worth a try though, especially if you're in the area.

Don’t sleep on this place! We were craving fries and so we found this place and we ordered the Peri peri fries, garlic tots and the chicken tenders! We loved everything…Food was packed with flavor and the service was excellent! We will have to drive back down from Fallbrook to try more things!

I tried Onion samosa, Osmania biscuits and Irani chai - perfect snack for a cold & rainy San Diego evening!! The samosa was particularly good with great crispy outer filled with tasty onion filling, recommend this place for a quick snack and hanging out with friends!

Driving from LA and found the place. You expect the place to have fresh and flavorful food, and that it was. Plenty of parking. The place has ample tables and suitable for families as well.

Tried tenders, chicken and sandwiches. No complaints. Kept it up

formatted_address: 4360 Twain Ave, San Diego, CA 92120, United States
name: Taste of Egypt Catering

reviews.text: the food from taste of egypt catering is top-notch, with every dish bursting with authentic flavors and made with the highest quality ingredients. a must-try for anyone craving delicious egyptian cuisine!

I went to their booth in La Mesa Oktoberfest, the person in front was rude and the food was really bad for its price. The lettuce was bitter which means it has been sitting all, the tortilla also tasted really cheap and proportions are too small.

Wow! First time trying Egyptian food and we were not disappointed! Amazing flavors and the chicken was soooo gooood! The owner was so sweet, clearly has a passion for what she does and wants to make you feel at home! She said the spices she uses come from Egypt- and you can tell! Just excellent- thank you !

Wow. I live in the upstairs apartment and have been wanting to try this place. Man, I would not share this with my own mother. I got the beef sharwma and wow. I have no words. She get down in the kitchen guys. You HAVE to try it!
The single best goulash I’ve ever had! The stuffed grape leaves are 12/10. Koshari is bomb but on the spicy side. Will be ordering again. Thanks for bringing a taste of Egypt to SD ❤️

formatted_address: 5915 Balboa Ave, San Diego, CA 92111, United States
name: Sufi Mediterranean Cuisine

reviews.text:
Delicious Persian cuisine and a great experience overall. You order and pay at the counter, then they give you a number and bring the food straight to your table, which was easy and convenient.

We ordered a few appetizers along with our meal, and everything came out together (not sure if that’s standard or just because they were busy when we stopped by), but the food was absolutely worth it. We tried the Shirazi salad, the eggplant dip, and I ordered one skewer of beef koobideh with white rice. Everything was flavorful, fresh, and cooked perfectly.

If you’re craving authentic Persian food, this spot is definitely worth visiting.

I would like to share my experience at Sufi Restaurant with you.
The quality of the food is truly excellent, especially the koobideh kebab, which was incredibly delicious, juicy, fresh, and served hot. This time, I also tried the tahchin; it was perfectly cooked, and the chicken pieces didn’t have any unpleasant smell at all. I definitely recommend trying it at least once.
As for the service, the waiters are very polite, patient, and genuinely kind. While you are in the restaurant, you feel as if one of your close friends is taking care of you.

Having tried dozens of Persian restaurants across Los Angeles and San Diego, I can confidently say that Sufi Mediterranean Cuisine in San Diego stands out. Their Cornish dish is exceptional — perfectly seasoned, juicy, and cooked to absolute perfection.
The freshly baked hot bread paired with sizzling kebabs makes every visit a memorable one. There’s something special about the way they serve it — right off the grill, perfectly charred, and full of flavor.
What truly sets Sufi apart, though, is the service. The staff is consistently friendly, welcoming, and genuinely attentive without being overbearing.  Waiter treatment to costumers is like family — always kind, hard working, attentive and truly customer-focused.
They always make you feel like a valued guest, whether it’s your first time or your tenth.

⭐ 1 Star
Sufi Mediterranean Cuisine

I usually enjoy eating at Sufi Mediterranean Cuisine and have visited many times. But today was very disappointing and will likely be my last visit. The meat was extremely bad — the taste and quality were nothing like before. It felt old and poorly prepared, and I couldn’t finish my meal.

I hope the restaurant pays attention to this feedback and improves the quality of their food, because customers expect fresh and good-quality meals every time. The meat smells really strong that’s why we pot it on the other table.
One of the best Persian / Afghani food you can ever get. The food is absolutely delicious and Halal. Staff is very friendly too. A go to spot with family and friends.

formatted_address: 3355 Adams Ave, San Diego, CA 92116, United States
name: Sahara on Adams

reviews.text: I like they gave sweet while waiting. I ordered a beef kebap bowl, but it was tooo way small, barely was a portion for its price. I ate all of in minutes and still feeling hungry. Also beef was half portion, and not kind of burnt and untasty

When this place first opened, the food was amazing—fresh and absolutely delicious. Unfortunately, that’s no longer the case. I just had the beef shawarma, and it was cold, super dry, and not tasty at all. For $15, it was no pleasure at all.

i absolutely fell in love! i was a first time customer and received such a welcoming experience. everyone was so friendly and helpful and not to mention, the food was amazing! i got the chicken shawarma fries and it was seriously the best fries i have ever had in my whole life! we even received recommendations for the next time we come back, which we most definitely will! 10/10 recommend!

It was first time in here today. Ordering and paying is confusing. If I say chicken shawarma, the chaser has no idea what I want as they have like 3 dishes with that name. I asked for chicken shawarma a la carte, which would mean a wrap anywhere else in the United States besides this restaurant. What I got was a container of chicken. Another guest also complained of a messed up order due to this naming convention on the menu. They don’t know what people are trying to order. Secondly, I waited 15 minutes outside with my dog for what I thought would be a quick one item order. After the first 15 minutes I had to leave my dog outside alone and wait inside because I suspected something went wrong. I waited for another 15 minutes staring at my order ready to go with my ticket on it, holding my buzzer, ready to say something if anyone had approached me and asked what my number was. My buzzer never went off the whole time, and no one asked why I was standing there, they just made other orders. After a 30 minute wait, I watched the other guest receive their messed order, and the employee throws the ticket on my food in the trash and offers it to the guest. At that point, I say it’s mine and she hands it over with no other words exchanged. I was ready to forget about the wait until I opened a box of plain chicken. Why would I want a box of plain, now cold, chicken? The menu is not clear, and the employees don’t have the capacity to bridge misunderstandings at time of order. I will not be coming back here.

We tried this place for the first time and got two of the beef Shawarma platters. The food was cold and could have used a little more seasoning. The portion was a decent size, but I think it could’ve been better for the price. Their pita chips were very good. The real downfall of this visit was the service. Several of the employees ignored me while I waited to order at the cash register for over 5 minutes. We definitely won’t be back

formatted_address: 2263 Morse Rd, Columbus, OH 43229, United States
name: African Paradise Restaurant

reviews.text:
We had our Wednesday dinner.
Ordered
Lamb shank with rice.
Beefsteak and rice.
Food is okay but needs more improvement.
Comes with soup and banana.
Service is slow and not expect much.
Table was sticky and floor has food waste. Restroom was clean.
My first experience and the price made me hesitate. However, the portion size, the flavor and taste made the food worth every penny. And the atmosphere at the restaurant is so calming and relaxing.
Loved the taste of the food. The value for money was great! One of the best halal places in Columbus

There's a joke that the perfect ethnic restaurant should have 3 stars in online ratings, and this restaurant perfectly exemplifies that principle.

The idea comes from 1) the fact that the food will be extremely authentic and taste incredible 2) the service will be unmatched with every staff member going the extra mile over the smallest things and 3) the restaurant will not be "clean". This restaurant hits all three without a doubt!

Go for the awesome food and service and get over the apparent lack of cleanliness; that's where the flavor comes from and you will be fine.

The food wasn’t all that the pasta tasted like it was from the day before and the chicken had no flavor at all only food coloring and a bit of salt they can do better for a 2 people plate to be 42 and not taste even ok is unacceptable

formatted_address: 1122 Morena Blvd, San Diego, CA 92110, United States
name: Morena Provisions

reviews.text:
I stumbled upon this local café looking for coffee, and it felt like walking into an eccentric fairy garden! The ambiance is so dreamy and magical, with whimsical touches and cozy nooks that make you want to stay forever.
They offer a surprisingly wide variety of food--from fresh sandwiches to pastries and even ready-to-go options if you're in a rush. I had the Bay Smoothie, and it was incredible--freshly made, vibrant, and honestly better than any smoothie chain l've tried.
While I waited, I browsed through their adorable gift section filled with trinkets and thoughtful, feminine finds--perfect for a last-minute gift or just a little treat for yourself.
A special shoutout to Sandy, who made the experience even more lovely with her warmth and kindness. She made me feel right at home and added to the cozy, welcoming vibe of the place.
If you're looking for something unique, relaxing, and full of charm, this café is an absolute must-visit. A total hidden gem--I'll definitely be back!

Morena Provisions prepared and delivered a plate of Artisan Sandwiches and Pesto Pasta Salad for my business meeting lunch today.  The food was delivered on time, very nicely  presented so that I didn’t need to re-plate, and my guests all praised it.  Everything was fresh and tasted wonderful.  I highly recommend and will definitely be returning.

Love this chic place that I found this morning! Their sweets are to die for, but the selection of veggie salads and paninis is amazing. Check their website and place your order online, then go pick it up, fresh daily! You’ll go back for more!

This location is more of a display and taster of Waters' catering business than a restaurant, but it has many choices and good variety that also changes periodically. Food is ready and displayed so one can simply pick and choose from what's available that day. You can have your meal warmed up and eat it there or take it out. You also have a choice of microwave or oven heating and they use biodegradable cutlery and crockery.  Way to go!
My personal favorite are the roasted veggies and I usually pair them with one of a few available proteins - salmon, chicken tenders, tri tip, etc. Loads of side dishes such as casseroles and vegetable based extras, prepared in a way that everyone can like. Also offering a good number of desserts, soft drinks and even wines. Most of the menu is genuinely healthy so you can put together a tasty lunch that is also good for you. The one drawback - not really cheap.

This place is really cute and conveniently located, but what really stands out is Matt, the head chef. To put it plainly, Matt crafts the finest artesianal sandwiches in all of California, if not the world. The chicken pesto and chicken salad are both amazing, and I’m sure the rest are phenomenal too. Definitely worth stopping by!

formatted_address: 2446 Bank St #109A, Ottawa, ON K1V 1A4, Canada
name: Sa’hara

reviews.text:
This has quickly become my favorite Somali restaurant in Ottawa. The food was exceptional—every dish was prepared with remarkable care and authentic flavor.

Our server and host, Ahmed, made the experience even better. He was welcoming, attentive, and incredibly helpful, especially when introducing my family to Somali cuisine for the first time. His knowledge and recommendations allowed us to try several memorable dishes.

The menu also offers smash burgers and a variety of other unique options, making it an interesting spot for all tastes. We will absolutely be returning.

Highly recommended—especially if you’re looking to support a family-owned local businesses!

I ordered the Mac Duo and it was so good I want it again already. The fries were crispy and perfect, I love the sauce drizzled all over them. The burger was one of the best burgers I've had in a while; the meat cooked well and no weird flavor. Perfect amount of sauce and toppings too. They're definitely generous with everything. I ordered take out, but the restaurant looked very nice and clean. Looking forward to trying more items of their menu.

My husband and I tried Sa'hara on a whim while in the area for the first time and were not disappointed. It was outstanding. We usually have different flavor palates, but not this time. We split a platter with lamb, beef, and chicken and it was more than we could eat in one sitting. The food was made with care, flavorful, and the seasoning was done well without being overbearing. Will definitely have to eat here again next time we're in the area.

This place has always been good but I went today and had a bad experience with the fries. They tasted like they hadn’t changed the oil, plus there wasn’t much meat on the chopped fries. The burger was really good so no issues there but the patty didn’t really have that smash burger char or carmelization. Would still come back here to support this business and get the milk cake, but the fries were so bad I couldn’t eat them and I don’t like wasting food.

Food is yummy and reasonably priced. Especially the lamb dish, the lamb was very fatty and juicy, the rice seasoned nicely, and the hot sauce they give is actually spicy!

They were a little slow, but the owners service was exceptional.

I would recommend this place.

formatted_address: 3727 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Pastries by Buka

formatted_address: 2492 Home Acre Dr, Columbus, OH 43231, United States
name: Foodateria Kenyan & Nigerian Kitchen

reviews.text: My wife and I came here on a Friday night and had a wonderful meal and experience. We had the suya and jollof meals as well as a samosa. We got to try a side of the cabbage and well which was super good. Everything was so good and well prepared. We also got the chai and hibiscus tea which both were awesome. Very nice people and great service, it was are first time and we will definitely be back.

I was really impressed with this place. I ordered the stewed chicken with fried plantains and rice for my sides. This reminded me of a creamed chicken dish my grandmother used to make. The saltiness of the chicken worked well with the sweetness of the plantain and the rice was good too. I would like this dish more in the $14.99 range rather than $19.99 but the guy said they do lunch specials where the prices are batter. The food itself was excellent though.

So I went to Foodateria Kitchen again this evening. They specialize in upscale Kenyan & Nigerian cuisine.

Also, they do have 8+ vegan / vegetarian options as well. Ya’ll the place is straight 🔥

The service and food is absolutely exceptional. It’s a must try. It’s where WyCliff’s Kitchen use to be in the northeast side of Columbus.

Customer service was great, very friendly and welcoming! The coconut soup was so rich with flavor. The stew and goat was delicious! I also purchased hibiscus tea, and ginger tea both were bold in flavor. I highly recommend and I definitely plan to come back again.

First time eating Nigerian or Kenyan Food.  I will be back for sure.  Food was fresh and alive with flavor.  The owner/son was a great host and proud of his food.  The restaurant was also clean and well kept. I suggest the meat pies and karanga mbuzi

formatted_address: 10175 Two Notch Rd, Columbia, SC 29229, United States
name: Splendid Foods Nigerian Restaurant.

reviews.text: The food was very authentic, tasted like the Nigerian state she is from. Great that there is a sink available for hand washing. The only feedback: growing pains were present as restaurant has only been open for 4 month. Will need to be re-evaluated later

Place is small, but does have dine in option. I’m so excited to finally have access to African food close, I was traveling to Atlanta but no more! The service was superb very friendly and the food did not disappoint, I can’t wait to go back and try other options from the menu!

The owner was very friendly and prompt. She was also very helpful in selecting our meals. We appreciated the authenticity of the soups. Our favorite item we ordered was the scotch egg and would highly recommend.

Food was terrible. I brought egusi soup with fish. The fish was pretty good but the soup, I wasn’t a fan of. I go to different restaurants in Columbia to buy egusi soup so I know what it suppose to taste and smell like. No I do not expect everyone to cook it the same way but this was so terrible it was so hard to eat because of lack of flavors and bad smell it had. It had a bitterness that was just unbearable to eat. I tried fixing it up at home until I just couldn’t take the horrible smell, I just threw it away and The fufu was more like mash potatoes. The place was so smelly, it literally hit you at the door. Again I say I go to different restaurants that cook the same food as this restaurant and the smell does not meet at the door. The lady was very sweet she gave me tape to hold my tag on my car. Other than the food the customer service was great. Thanks again!
BEST egusi and fufu and Jollof rice in Columbia SC! The owner is super sweet as well!! Will definitely be back! 😁

formatted_address: 6163 Balboa Ave, San Diego, CA 92111, United States
name: Tropical Star Restaurant & Specialty Market

reviews.text:
10-11-2025
Happy Saturday!
I drove by this place at least 3x weekly  never knew it existed. My friend invited me to come dancing. I thought, “Why not? It’s only 6.3 mi from my house.” Glad I went, fun experience listening to Latin music and watching ppl dancing; I had to leave early so I didn’t get a chance to dance, next time lol

My friend and her friends ordered Papa Rellena ($6) and Empanadilla ($5); they enjoyed it. I, however, didn’t ordered any food but had Lulo drink ($6.45). My very first time trying it, refreshing!

Note:
-Regular hours, order food at the market counter.
-Dancing hours, start @ 9 pm. I believe the entrance fee is $5. In terms of food, it’s full service from Snack Menu.

Have fun dancing y’all!

I had a great dining experience at this South American restaurant today! The moment you step inside, you’re greeted by an exotic little grocery store selling authentic South American spices and grocery items, which sets a unique vibe. Turn left, and you discover a cozy restaurant with a bar and coffee station.

The menu features dishes from countries like Colombia, Puerto Rico, and Brazil. Every dish we ordered was bursting with flavor and made with incredibly fresh ingredients. The portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality. My personal favorite dish is the avocado salad—the dressing is light and refreshing, and the avocado portion is impressively generous, making it a healthy and delicious choice.

Another standout was their signature corn tortilla, made from fresh corn that’s cooked, ground, and crafted with care. The texture and taste are worlds apart from typical cornmeal tortillas—truly a labor of love and a must-try. Every dish we had was a delightful surprise, showcasing the rich diversity of South American flavors.

This restaurant has been a local gem for over 40 years, and this new location lives up to its reputation. If you’re curious about South American cuisine or just love great food, I can’t recommend this place enough. It’s a fantastic spot to explore bold, authentic, and beautifully prepared dishes!

I will not be returning to this establishment. I ordered three entrée plates at $19.99 each based on the appealing menu descriptions and photos. We ordered takeout, and upon arriving home and opening my order, I was very disappointed. I ordered the Lomo Saltado, which was advertised as containing beef, tomatoes, onions, cilantro, fries, and rice, however, my order was missing the cilantro and there was 1 hidden tomato. Additionally, the dish was excessively salty. My son’s meal was also overly salted. Overall, the experience was disappointing, as the food did not match the quality or description presented.

I do enjoy coming here to get some good Latin eats.

I ordered the chicken Pastelitos and a Cuban sandwich. Both were very flavorful and delicious. I over-ordered. Lol. I couldn't eat the entire sandwich, I had to take it home. But was still delicious later.

My friend ordered the Arroz con Pollo with beans and a salad. He enjoyed it. But would have preferred not to have big chunks of chicken.

When we came in on April 5th, there were 2 women at the register. They were having a conversation which seemed more important than greeting customers.

Afterward, the young lady who was the order taker was not friendly at all. I felt like I needed to rush to give her my order. Not pleasant at all.

Once we sat down, our order came out fresh and hot. Again, delicious. The server was nice.

There was no wait and eat getting a seat. I suppose I'll be back. Knowing what not to expect is half the battle.

Come in for delicious eats. I also enjoy the bodega as you walk in.

I always put the most honest reviews not like some of these people that get discounts on the food.. Anyways, the rice just tasted different to me. Not that good, but it could be cuz. It's from some other place because I'm puerto. Rican, the bacalito was good, the Chicharron was not good.
But the service was very good. I personally will not go back because it was very expensive. And what I don't get is the pastel was black, didn't taste bad, but it was black. I asked them why they said because it was frozen for so long. Okay, that does not sound good to me. I used to get pastel from my mom and have it in the freezer for a long time. And it never turned black. So that broke the camel's back right there.I'll never go back.But if you want to just go try it go ahead But don't order too many things, because it's very expensive and you don't really know if it's fresh

formatted_address: 10663 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V3T 2X6, Canada
name: Taste of Africa

reviews.text:
I ordered fufu with egusi soup, and honestly, I was really disappointed. The fufu was gritty, dry, and tasted more like mashed potatoes than real fufu. It should be smooth, stretchy, and easy to swallow  this wasn’t it at all.
I asked for spicy, and while it was spicy, that’s all you could taste. There was no depth, no real flavor  just heat. Proper egusi should have a rich, nutty, slightly earthy flavor from the melon seeds, balanced with the seasoning, meat, and vegetables. This just tasted harsh and oily, like the spice was covering up everything else.
Maybe it’s because I’m white and they didn’t think I’d know the difference, but I do and in my country, this would be shameful to serve. I genuinely wanted to enjoy and support them, but this meal was a big disappointment.

Only customer dinning in on a raining night. Owner/server was super helpful and answered all our questions regarding Fufu.

Order Jollof rice with Jerk - Honey chicken.
-A bit too savory for my East Asian taste bud but definitely love the experience.

Girlfriend ordered Pounded Yam, Eba Or Ogali Served With Egushi & Spinach Goat & Beef Soup.
-Quite spicy and goat is a bit dry but very savory and hot ! Love the combination with pounded yam.

Only 5% GST and no tip required.
We had the jollof rice and honey chicken and the egushi soup with plantain fufu. They are very nice and service is made to order so it might take some time. Food was nice and hot.so good very yummy

It’s our first time trying fufu!!
Got so excited cause I got influenced
And I forgot the soup that we ordered ,the women who was serving us told us it’s spicy 🌶️
It’s SO SUPER spicy, the level of spicy kinda made it taste less good but I couldn’t stop even tho my lips were swollen. 😩🤩

waited 15 mins to order then another 20 for my food.. I got the fufu and egussi which was delicious but the meat was tough. it was $27 before tax. It is a lot of food but fufu is not good anymore after putting it in the fridge for the next day. I don’t think I will be coming back.

formatted_address: 8699 120 St, Delta, BC V4C 6R5, Canada
name: ALEBI AFRICAN CUISINE

reviews.text: 5 stars. Just got home from eating dinner here. It was my first time eating African food, the staff were fantastic helping me choose what to eat as I have dietary limitations. The food was fabulous, full of flavour and clearly cooked with love. My son also loved his meal. The staff were also extremely friendly and welcoming and it just makes me want to go back and take more people with me so they can experience it too. You really have to try this restaurant as soon as possible. We will be back.

I ordered from here yesterday, and it was a delightful experience. The food was excellently packaged with neat, thoughtful presentation in attractive bags, with containers that perfectly suited each dish. Most importantly, the taste was absolutely delicious. It was rich, flavorful, and satisfying. I look forward to visiting in person soon. Thank you for such a high standard of excellence. I truly loved it!

Update: May. 8/25

My friend & I went for lunch today and manager/daughter Cathy couldn’t have been more hospitable and patient explaining the menu to us as first timers.

She offered us a complimentary taster portion of the appetizer Puff Puff. It’s a sweet, deep fried dough ball. Careful it comes very hot to the table.
We liked it very much, my friend says it’s similar to our chinese milk bread.
Could be enjoyed for dessert too I think.

We shared Jollof Rice (w/chicken) with plantain and salad $26.99 and Egusi Soup (w/beef) $26.99. The soup came with (yam powder) fufu.
You choose the protein: beef, chicken or fish (mackerel).
Spice level is 1-10, we asked for 3/4 and found it very mild so the little bowl of spicy condiment Cathy supplied amped it up nicely and had great flavour.
They also offer turkey, goat and tilapia on the menu.
We very much enjoyed our food and the 4 star rating only reflects the fact I have nothing to compare it to as new to Nigerian cuisine.

North Delta is pretty south asian heavy as far as restaurant choices so Alebi’s is a very much welcome dining option.

My friend and I have vowed to try something different in future visits to expand our experience of Nigerian food culture.

May.  2, 2025:

I only stepped in to check out the new restaurant in my neighborhood and have a look at the menu.

I was met by manager Cathy whose mother is owner. She told me they’ve been in business for 12 years at another location and here in N.Delta since Mar. 1/25.

I’m happy we have more diverse eating options and look forward to coming back for a first ever Nigerian (west african) meal.

Located in a strip mall with ample parking.

Flavour is good. Vibe is good. Can do better on menu pricing clarity. I dined in and ordered Egusi with goat. There is no mention on the menu anywhere or by the server there’s an up-charge for goat. Was surprised when settling the bill as a result didn’t tip the usual amount. Could be they are still working out kinks in their operation given they recently opened. Advised server to please make sure additional charges are either stated on the menu or mentioned.
Will update this next time I visit see if they have taken action on it.

Coming here around 3pm for food since I'm craving for fufu. The menu is confusing so I just ask the server to recommend the food. Food come out in a decent amount of time, I was so excited. My fufu was a bit plain for my preference and the food kends up giving me stomach upset, maybe from the spice. The meat is a bit hard and chewy, flavor is ok tho. As for my friend, he orders a rice plate: lots of rice (but the rice is like not cooked properly because it tasted kinda raw, but I'm not sure if that's how it supposed to or not), the goat meat is ok but I wish there's more, the plaintain is really good tho.

Also when we visit the restaurant, the light are off so it's kinda dark. I understand that they might want to keep the electricity low but it's kinda weird that they only turns it on when we're about to leave.

Another thing is that the price in the menu is not accurate. We saw on the menu is like $25/dish for both our dishes but they end up charging us $34 without any explanation. So we end up tipping lower than usual.

formatted_address: 6171 Imperial Ave, San Diego, CA 92114, United States
name: Caribbean Taste

reviews.text: I tried the brown stew fish plate and it was incredible. The flavors were rich and comforting, the kind of meal that makes you want to finish every last bite even when you are already full. Truly a dish worth coming back for.

Anyone who has anything negative to say about this place is out of their minds! Came here for some lunch and got the oxtail jerk chicken combo. Holy SMOKES! It was so delicious. The portion was huge. Everything was flavorful. As someone who has visited the Caribbean, I can say this is the real deal. Oxtails were meaty, jerk chicken had a nice kick and the plantains were amazing. I can’t wait to come back.

I got the jerk chicken & oxtail combo. Very tasty & portion was generous. The jerk chicken had a little kick to it but perfect for my palate & the best jerk chicken I’ve ever had. My friends & I enjoyed everything we ordered.

This place is so good, it makes me want to go to Jamaica. Its hands down the best Jamaican food in San Diego and I’ve tried ALL of them. Nothing compares or comes close.
The staff doesnt care about excellent customer service or politeness so if you come here for that, go somewhere else. But I love that them, straight to the point attitude and they dont care about your “special requests” 🤣
If you dont like spicy food or you have food sensitivities, go eat at Applebees bro lol
I would give this place 10 stars!

Best jerk chicken I have ever had! The sides are meeeeh don’t really like them. But all the proteins here is FIIIIIRE!!!! And the prices aren’t terrible either! I hear once a week! The patties are pretty good too!

formatted_address: 4350 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92105, United States
name: Ali's Chicken & Waffles

reviews.text:
The best chicken and waffles I’ve ever had! First time I had these was over pandemic when we ordered for take out. It took over an hour but when we opened the box, I was surprised that the waffles were not soggy from all the steam. It retain its texture, the flavor was semi sweet and I didn’t need to use syrup. That’s how I like my waffles and to me, that’s a major bonus.

The chicken was juicy even though it’s white meat. The flavor in the breading was on point as far as spice levels.

Fast forward, post pandemic, we’ve revisited several times and this past weekend, it was just how I remembered it.

The location shares a space with the donut shop. Parking in that lot is tight, you would be lucky if you found one. It’s also not the best area.

There are a few tables inside to dine in. We ate it fresh and took 30 minutes for our order to come out. Recommend to call in your order.

Prices are reasonable, the combo #1 came with 2 tenders, waffle or fries and a side. The mac and cheese wasn’t super creamy. It was a perfect mix of cheddar and Parmesan.

Ali’s fries were also a nice treat. Similar to carne asada fries with all the toppings. We got chicken instead of shrimp. The spicy chicken sandwich was not spicy. They said next time, to let them know that we want it higher than Thai spice

I also got sambusas, which are similar to empanadas or samosas but different shape. Choice of filling, I got savory. This was not my favorite because of the dried texture. The chicken curry just needed dipping sauce.

Overall, we would come back here again and again.

Food is so good I had to come and leave a review through my job’s email! Awesome location with plenty of options. I got the Original Chicken Sandwich combo & it never disappoints. Definitely recommend getting it with their Ali’s Sauce. A must visit in City Heights. ✨

Incredible comfort food and great vibes! Ali’s Chicken and Waffles hit the spot! The chicken was crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned, while the waffles were soft, buttery, and just the right amount of sweet. The combo is seriously addictive. Staff were friendly and welcoming, and the portions were generous. Whether you’re grabbing brunch or a late-night bite, this place delivers on flavor and hospitality. Definitely coming back!

The best chicken sandwich in San Diego. The spicy is seriously good. We love their mac and cheese, and fries. First time trying a waffle and chicken here and I must say that was great too. Pro tip: order online via toast app, so that your food is ready upon arrival. Also,  It's so good that you might want to order more than 1 sandwich per person ;)

Simply the best.
Limited menu.
Just Chicken and dipping sauce.
Same ideal motip as Raisin Cane Chick Fil a
I love all sauce especially Coconut Sauce.
Chicken tender was juicy and crunchy spice cover.
Thai tea was good.

formatted_address: 1180 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6H 1N1, Canada
name: African Delight Cafe and Restaurant

reviews.text: All authentic east African food literally, the fish is amazing with its Salad , the beans is like the Sudanese way of making, hospitality is great, with the smell of coffee to the ambiance of Africa it's your best way to enjoy delicious food .

My friend and I were on the lookout for halal African food and decided to try this place. We ordered the African Delight Platter with injera, which turned out to be a fantastic choice! The injera, somewhat like dosa but better. We also had the Beef Tibs with rice, which was good, and the Lamb Chacha with injera. The Lamb Chacha didn't have much flavor and the portion was small. We had a great time and loved the food! However, the cleanliness of the restaurant, especially the toilets, left much to be desired and had a noticeable odor.
The food was really quick to come and was very delicious. It was our first time eating Ethiopian food and we loved it.

When First time tried African food here I loved what we ordered
My friend and I both love the food kinda spicy for us but really delicious 😋😋
But second time here we ordered fried fish and stew of okra with lamb .
We kinda disappointed that's why changing the star from 5 to average.
Fish super dry no taste,stew of okra we believed the meat was beef not lamb which they said it's lamb 🫤
Not taste not texture was lamb to us .
Any way they are really nice people and I love the vibe here.

Had the pleasure of visiting this authentic  Ethiopian restaurant last night! It’s like a hidden gem!
A lot of options to choose from! I absolutely enjoyed their food! As good as it looked, it tasted equally good!
Must try their veg & non veg platters, fish Tilapia, okra w meat , lamb and authentic ethiopian coffee.

formatted_address: 3334 Rosecrans St, San Diego, CA 92110, United States
name: Caribbean Pleasure

reviews.text:
My review is based on take out.
I’m from Haitian-Brooklyn. So I was nervous coming here thinking it wouldn’t be good. But the food was delicious.
The staff is friendly and service was smooth.
I ordered Griot and diri djon djon (fried pork and mushroom rice ) paid $30.  It’s a lot of food.  You won’t be mad
I love the fact they fry the griot when you order and it’s not just siting in warmer.  It tasted nice and fresh. They give a nice amount of sauce which was real tasty.
The rice was full of flavor. They definitely have a the Haitian flavors.  They have seating for those who wants to dine in.  Looks quiet and clean.
You have to go up the stairs to get into the restaurant.  So if you drive by and don’t see much activity in front just keep that in mind.   I will definitely be back.

Delicious food within walkable distance from home. Pleasure to try Haitian food. I got the jerk chicken and husband got the oxtail. Food was fresh and tasted authentic. The spices came together nicely in the jerk chicken and it gave the broth a kick which I liked. I would recommend this place and I like the Mom and Pop feel.
Great food. The chicken was not dry at all, and the amount of rice I got was enough for 2 people. The passion fruit juice was super sweet.

This restaurant is one of the best in town. The food has a unique taste. We, the whole family, ordered different food and had a taste from each other plate. We had fish, goat, chicken, plantain, and mixed rice. Everything was outstanding. The people are very nice. Highly recommended with five stars.

It was our first time to eat at this Haitian restaurant and we loved the food we ordered. We had the Bouillon soup and it became an instant favorite. We also had their fried plantains and pikilz and it goes really well with our food. We also had the jerk chicken and rice and beans and it's really really sumptuous and hearty. We will definitely come back.

formatted_address: 4348 54th St, San Diego, CA 92115, United States
name: African Spice Restaurant And Catering San Diego

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: Boma - Flavors of Africa

reviews.text:
(Dined in October) This all-you-can-eat buffet offers an abundance of superior vegan options, surpassing any other I’ve tried in the area. The warm, cozy, and stunning atmosphere sets the perfect tone for a delightful dining experience. To top it off, the service is exceptional, living up to the Disney reputation.

A special thank you goes to our hostess, Vivian, who served us on the two separate nights we visited during our vacation. She provided an extra special dining experience and even went above and beyond to speak with the chef and prepare an off-menu vegan dessert platter just for us. Thank you again! I can’t wait to return.

I wish I could give this place a 4 1/2 star. The food was amazing with wonderful selections. The food ranged from African inspired to your basic scrambled eggs, waffles, and bagels. my party tried to fill up on the African inspired food that we can’t eat at home. It was very delicious and I don’t have enough things to say about the food.

this place gets very busy so I highly recommend getting a reservation. Even with our reservation, we still had to wait about 10 minutes for our table to be ready.

A server brings drinks to your table, water, etc. are included with the price per person. I highly recommend trying their POG juice. The server also let us take our leftover juice and coffee into cups when we were done dining so we were able to enjoy them by the pool for the afternoon.

I also recommend trying the bread pudding, it was one of the best things I ate on this trip.

Went for dinner heard it was fantastic and was so disappointed it was no different than your regular buffet anywhere else their basmati rice was worse than minute rice the best meat they had was the sausage,  I had to fill up on fruit and dessert because the rest wasn't worth the 60 dollars per person charge . I've eaten in many of their restaurants and all were fantastic but not this place.  The Sanaa bar poolside had better food , but like everything else this is just my opinion.

A different style of food! For the breakfast buffet, it is essential to make a reservation; upon arrival, there is Spanish-speaking staff, so this is a good point in case you need it! It is fully decorated with an African theme; colors, images, and sounds transport you to a land with African smells and flavors at all times. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the buffet maintains the same protocol as any other place. The flavors are different because they focus on African food, but there are also the basics like fruit, sweet bread, eggs, and other food that is expected at any buffet. There are areas for improvement: since it is an African-style restaurant, no one explains what the food is, or at least what it is about, so you can decide to try it or pass on it. They don't inform you of food or drinks that are not included in the buffet. In our case, we ordered two cappuccinos, and in the end, they obviously charged for them. I suppose it only includes juice and coffee. I insist, no one explained it to us! Something that seemed a little out of place to me was that the waitress brought the check to the table without asking, so I obviously asked her why she had brought it if I hadn't finished breakfast yet. That action obviously didn't feel right; it's something we're not used to. It might seem like they're urging you to leave the place. I insist that basic information was missing so as not to misinterpret the situation. The experience, being something different, is good, but it's not memorable. I can't recommend something I'm not familiar with. I wish the trained staff would take the time to make sure the diners had a better time.

Such a fun breakfast experience! There was loads of food options from oatmeal to bacon and eggs to some traditional dishes. They had Mickey Waffles and syrup, fruit, pancakes, granola bowls and yoghurt. Everything was delicious.

The bread pudding was amazing!! We would recommend.

Nearing the end of our meal they did a performance with the drums which was an unexpected surprise.

We would definitely go back.

formatted_address: 3530 S Orange Ave, Orlando, FL 32806, United States
name: Flavors Nigerian Restaurant

reviews.text:
Great taste of home in Orlando!
The food was very authentic and flavorful — exactly what I was craving. Jollof rice was well seasoned, the egusi was rich and delicious, and the portions were generous. Service was friendly and welcoming, and the vibe felt like true Nigerian home cooking. If you’re looking for real Naija food in Orlando, this spot definitely delivers. I’ll be back!

My husband and I were a little nervous to try this place because of some of the reviews, but we really wanted to try African food. We were so surprised. It ended up being one of the best meals we have ever had, and the portions were pretty big. I actually got full halfway through my plate.

If you are new to African food, definitely try the egusi with chicken. It’s a great gateway. As Mexicans, we thought it was similar to Mexican food but with different presentations.

We will definitely come back. Don’t let the bad reviews discourage you. They are probably from picky eaters expecting foods they’re used to. The woman working the front was very kind and helpful, and the restaurant was clean. There was a bit of a strange smell, but that usually comes with the combination of spices and meats used. It did not bother us, so don’t let it put you off. ❤️

I had a great time at Flavors Nigerian Kitchen in Orlando. I ordered white rice with stew and it was delicious. The stew was full of bold Nigerian flavor. I also had fried plantains—they were sweet and crispy. The staff were friendly and welcoming. The restaurant felt warm and homey. If you want real Nigerian food in Orlando, try this place. I’ll definitely go back again!

The first sign that this was a good place to eat was the flood of Nigerians coming and going to pick up food items from the restaurant. The menu items were explained to us by a kid (the owner's child), but his recommendations and explanations were great. The food was fantastic. This unassuming restaurant was a must try place, go back for more.
Wonderful Joyce served us and explained every dish! Wonderful Delicious Réal African food for the whole family!

formatted_address: 5494 Central Florida Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32821, United States
name: Selam Ethiopian & Eritrean Cuisine

reviews.text:
Selam Ethiopian & Eritrean Cuisine is an absolute gem—especially if you’re vegan and gluten-free. The veggie combination platter was huge, beautifully presented, and packed with rich, complex flavors. Every dish was delicious and incredibly satisfying.
The honey wine was amazing (a must-try), and the hot tea was the perfect complement to the meal—warm, comforting, and thoughtfully served.
On top of the food, the service was excellent: attentive, welcoming, and genuinely kind without being overbearing. You can tell they care deeply about the experience they provide.
If you’re looking for incredible vegan and gluten-free options with generous portions and outstanding hospitality, Selam is absolutely worth the visit. I’ll definitely be back. 🖤

I really like this restaurant. The manager is extremely welcoming, and the food is great. They sell the type of food that people from Ethiopia eat. Furthermore, all the staff are from Ethiopia too. This is a really good family-owned business. The only problem is that the waitresses are not well trained.

Heard so many people recommend this place and the hype was justified!! Abraham was so funny and recommended that we add the lamb to our meat combo. It was delicious! The coffee was so good, the alcohol recommendations were also good. It was a little slow because they seemed short staffed but I can't fault them for that. Will be back!!

Great experience and delicious food. First time trying Ethiopian and very pleased with the experience. I steered the vegetarian plate and beef tips. My favorite was the mushroom dish followed by the cabbage and lentils.

We had the samosa trio (lentil, beef, and chicken) for appetizers, and they were all delicious—crispy on the outside and perfectly seasoned inside. For our main course, we ordered the meat combination, and every single bite was full of flavor. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful, especially since it was our first time dining at an Ethiopian restaurant. They took the time to explain the dishes and how to enjoy them. We also tried their iced tea, which was so refreshing and flavorful that we ordered extra to take home. We’re so happy we found this place while on vacation, and we can’t wait to come back the next time we visit. Everything about our experience was amazing—great food, wonderful service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: Jiko - The Cooking Place

reviews.text: This place has great ambience and great service. It is beautifully decorated and very spacious and clean. As for the food, I wouldn't recommend this establishment for children. The menu is definitely for the more mature palette. The food was okay but the price point is pretty high so our expectation was for the food to be great. We did have the best server who took care of us and provided us with whatever we needed. I do recommend this place for desserts and adult entertainment.

Cannot recommend this place enough. We had an amazing experience. It started when our hostess gave us a small tour of the restaurant explaining that they had the largest selection of South African wines outside of South Africa explained why it’s called the cooking place as well as a few other fun details before bringing us to our seats.

Our waiter was very tentative and kind. The giraffe bread – as they call it was amazing and was served with a delicious flavorful butter. We ordered the tenderloin for an appetizer and it was to die for. It was nit gamey at all and wonderful flavor, I wish I would have just ordered this at for my entrée!!

The wine selection was amazing, highly recommend trying some of their South African wines, even if you’re not a wine person.

For entrées, we had the Moroccan spiced lamb shank and the Injera Basket. The lamb shank was huge and fell apart with a fork wonderful flavor and was served with a crunchy couscous and pomegranate seeds. The plant based Injera basket was wonderful and it was nice to mix and match the different toppings to combine flavors.

I was in a party of 2, both of us moderate eaters and with the bread appetizer and two entrées. We had plenty to bring back to our hotel room and eat for dinner the next day.  we even had a few leftovers after our “leftover” dinner to have as a snack.

I highly recommend if you have the budget to check this place out. However, I wouldn’t recommend bringing kids/small children here as the food choices gear more towards a refined pallet. The restaurant is also very quiet.

An Absolute Masterclass in Flavor and Hospitality!!
"From the moment we walked in, we knew we were in for something special. The atmosphere at Jiko is warm and sophisticated, but it’s the food and service that truly steal the show.
The menu is a beautiful exploration of African flavors—the Oak-grilled Filet Mignon was cooked to perfection, and the mac and cheese lived up to the legendary hype. Every bite was layered with spices and care.
A huge thank you to our server, who was incredibly knowledgeable about the extensive South African wine list and made us feel like the only table in the room. If you’re looking for a dining experience that is both adventurous and comforting, Jiko is a must-visit!"
Best Meal of Our Trip!
"Jiko exceeded every expectation! The food is elevated, unique, and incredibly delicious (get the Wild Boar Tenderloin!). But what really sets this place apart is the service. The staff is attentive, friendly, and deeply passionate about the menu. It’s not just a dinner; it’s an experience. We can’t wait to come back!"
Option 3: Focus on the Atmosphere & Wine
Title: A Hidden Gem for Foodies
"If you want a break from the standard theme park fare, Jiko is the place to go. The open kitchen and changing 'sunset' lighting create such a beautiful vibe. The service was impeccable—our server gave us the perfect wine pairing suggestions that elevated the entire meal. High-quality ingredients, bold flavors, and top-tier service. 10/10!

Our server, Brenda, was friendly and attentive. She knew the menu well and made helpful suggestions.  The food not only tasted good, it was delectably presented.  We had the spiced carrot soup which had a surprising depth of flavor, garnished with pine nuts and African spices.  Also we had their lovely Jiko salad. The short rib was tender.  The tagine seafood dish was generous. Dessert was a towering kava pudding with a sculpted chocolate topping, a small scoop of ice cream, over a shredded wheat confection on a base of cake that had been soaked in a rum-like liqueur. A delightful evening. Although an upscale venue, that recommends chic casual many if not most diners were very informally dressed in clothes they had worn in the the park. Don’t miss a walk out the back of the hotel to see the African animal compound in a savanna like environment. Free parking in the self parking lot, a rarity in Disney World.
Jiko is on level one so you need to go downstairs from the grand lobby.  There are stairs and elevator on the right as you walk in to the hotel, beyond the gift shop.

Excellent decor with a view of a shallow pond. My wife had the halibut with mushrooms. I just had the small appetizers. The boar tenderloin was superb. Then I had the Mac and Cheese with Waygu ground beef and chopped toasted almonds as an add on to my wife’s meal. This was the best and very filling.

formatted_address: 7048 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819, United States
name: Nile Ethiopian

reviews.text: Good Ethiopian food but by no means the best we’ve had—it was authentic, but didn’t seem to have been made “with heart”. We had their special Nile lunch for two. Of the items provided there were only two that we thought were above average, the collards and one of the two chicken preparations. The service and atmosphere were also pleasant enough but lacked “heart and conviction”. Though authentic, this restaurant smacks of being geared to the tourist market rather than set up to serve the best Ethiopian food, service and ambience possible at this price point.

This is by far the very best Ethiopian I've ever had! We had the chef's special, the in house wine, the Wolfstrap red wine, and the Ethiopian coffee. Everything was fabulous but besides the food, the honey wine and
Coffee really stood out. The honey wine is made in house and tastes like a carbonated mead - sweet and delicious. The coffee is strong and flavorful but the presentation is an experience you really shouldn't miss. Our waitress was so friendly and knowledgeable it made me brave enough to try new things and I'm so glad I did.
You should go. You're welcome 😋

Brought my family here after seeing it on IG. We were in town for the holiday break and upon arrival  were greeted immediately. We waited patiently for our food and have to say it was WORTH the wait. Food was excellent and satisfying. You can tell they took their time and have earned a returning customer in the near future.

Came here for lunch and ordered the dinner combo for two. More than generous portions, super flavourful, especially the red lentils and split pea, with once exception (one of the beef items which was chewy) the meat was tender and tasty. The service was excellent and atmosphere relaxed. It’s not too far from the convention center and would definitely recommend it.

We love to explore international food, and Nile Ethiopian was the perfect place to experience some incredible delicacies!  We had the tomato fitfit as our starter, which was incredibly fresh and delicious!  It was an excellent prelude to our main course: the meat combination and kitfo.  If you like living on the wild side, you’ll enjoy kitfo!  It’s semi spicy along with a savory spice mix that complement the raw, minced beef.  The meat combination includes a set of well spiced dishes, all incredible in their own right.  And, eating with your hands using the injera along with the decor gives you the sense that you’ve been transported overseas.  We had great discussion with our waitress, and learned quite a bit about Ethiopian culture, food, and life. We will definitely return!

formatted_address: 4904 S Kirkman Rd, Orlando, FL 32811, United States
name: Kalalou Signature

reviews.text: Mario Peters and Marvin held an incredible evening for our office Christmas party. The food was amazing and perfect. We had an incredible time at the event and it wouldn’t be possible without them and their amazing team. I have absolutely no complaints and this is a great place to host a party and spend time with family. The attention detail and atmosphere was amazing. I truly wished I took more photos. Everyone should eat here it’s an incredible experience.

If you're looking for an elevated Haitian Caribbean dining experience, this is the place to go! We were looking for a classy establishment to satisfy 3 generations of my family, with a bunch of dietary restrictions (picky eaters), for my father's birthday celebration.

Chef Mario, Marvin and the rest of the team went above and beyond. Beautiful presentation, with food that tasted just as good and a great attention to detail. Thank you for an excellent experience!

This is absolutely the best dining experience I’ve had. The attention to detail, this is Haitian Haute Cuisine. The level of service, the food, the experience. The Chef came out to greet us. In all my years of eating at Haitian restaurants I’ve never experienced service like this. I strongly recommend. Chef Mario well done.

I came here for dinner and was grossly overcharged for my meal. I would like someone from management to reach out to me. I had fried goat, green, plantain, and a side of broccolini, and a gin and tonic mixed drink. Before tip this all was a total of $70. I thought the bill was kind of high when I paid and I was not given an itemized receipt. It was late and I was tired, so I didn’t dispute it, and I should have and not have been so trusting. When I look online, the goat itself is not even $45 on the dine in menu. Not to mention my gin and tonic was made incorrectly because there was no tonic, yet it was rang up as a cocktail. A gin and tonic is not a cocktail. Also, I did not even get the two sides included with the goat, the broccolini was a substitute either way $70 before tip and tax is too high for what I had between the service and the food.

If you’re searching for a restaurant that delivers unforgettable flavors, warm hospitality, and a truly welcoming atmosphere, Kalalou Signature Restaurant is the perfect choice. From the moment you walk in, you’re embraced with a vibrant yet cozy ambiance that immediately makes you feel at home. The décor is stylish, the vibe is inviting, and the entire space feels thoughtfully designed for comfort and enjoyment.

The food is the real star here—every dish is prepared with remarkable care, bold seasoning, and authentic flavor. You can taste the freshness in every bite. Whether you’re enjoying one of their signature entrées or exploring something new, the plates are beautifully presented and bursting with taste. It’s the kind of meal that leaves you satisfied, impressed, and already thinking about what you’ll try next time.

The service is exceptional as well. The staff is friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They take the time to explain menu items, check in at the right moments, and ensure every guest feels valued. From drinks to dessert, everything flows smoothly.

Kalalou Signature Restaurant is more than just a place to eat—it’s an experience. With fantastic food, great ambiance, and outstanding service, it’s the kind of restaurant you’ll want to return to again and again. Highly recommended! Big up to Chef Mario 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👍🏽👍🏽

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: Tusker House Restaurant

html_attributions: ศุภาวัฒ เจนอักษร

reviews.text: This is easily THE BEST RESTAURANT I'VE EVER BEEN TO! I have a sensitive stomach and everything agreed with me. The staff went ABOVE AND BEYOND! They were very welcoming and helpful to my wife that has diverticulosis. The chef came out multiple times to see and go over what my wife needed and my son too as he has a cinnamon allergy and EOE. The characters all came out multiple times and were very nice and incredible to interact with. Our waiter was fantastic from start to finish. Chef Tray was an angel and overall incredible human being. I will remember this experience for the rest of my life and look forward to returning the next time I come to animal kingdom.

Incredible dining experience! This might be the best character dining in all of Walt Disney World. The food was incredible, the character interactions were so special and the service was top notch. We were celebrating my daughter’s third birthday and Donald chose her to be the special family of the day and they hand delivered her a cake with a card signed by all the staff. That is a memory that we will never forget. The characters spend so much time with each table and make everyone feel special. They came around multiple times and we never felt like we were needing to be in a rush. Do not skip out on this place in your next visit. Incredible!! ❤️

First and foremost, this is a character breakfast review. We accompanied children and grandchildren. The food is good. Nice selection of foods I’ve never had as an American but enjoyed trying. Omelette station with quick service cooked to order perfectly. Awesome building with neat decorative attributes.
Kids love this. That’s what really makes it worth the price. The seating with reservations for breakfast was fast and prompt. Our server was awesome. Kept us full of drinks, table cleared and made sure none of the characters missed our table.

Pricey!  $490 for 5 "adults" and 1 child. Then getting hit with the mandatory 18% tip, this meal got pricey quickly. Service was pretty good,  far from the best we've had at Disney. Atmosphere was fun, and the characters gave us plenty of attention. Some of the food was really good,  some was pretty meh, and tough filling a plate for family members who don't enjoy international foods or just have have adventurous palates. I really wanted to score this one higher personally, but most of my family wasn't satisfied, and at that price I can't be very forgiving there.
Also worth noting, you have to buy admission to the park to access this restaurant.

For breakfast, it is the best character experience we have had at disney. The food was pretty good, but each character was able to visit many times. To the point our son was almost tired of seeing them, probably ten times each (not a complaint, surely got our money's worh!)

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: Tiffins Restaurant

reviews.text: Had an absolutely fabulous experience at this restaurant located inside of Animal Kingdom near Pandora. Reservations are required, but you can do it very easily through the Disney app. We were able to get reservations the same day. From the time you enter the restaurant everyone is friendly and the service is great. The ambience is relaxing in the decor is beautiful. We were seated promptly. They have a very good specialty cocktail menu and I had one of the drinks that came with a tahin rim and a watermelon garnish and it was absolutely spectacular. My son really loved their strawberry lemonade, which was homemade. For appetizers we started with the lobster mac & cheese. It was really good, but it could have used a lot more lobster. For the main entrée, we had the filet mignon and scallops served with polenta. The fillet was tender and well seasoned. The polenta was absolutely delicious and I’m not the biggest polenta fan so you know it was good. The scallops were tender, moist and absolutely amazing!! Of course it’s Disney so the price point is a tad higher, but it really wasn’t unreasonable and I was really pleased with the portions and the service. I would definitely return.

Went to Tiffins at Animal Kingdom and we got in without a reservation — it wasn’t too crowded, so we were seated pretty quickly. It’s definitely on the pricey side, not crazy expensive, but something you should check against your budget. We were a group of four, all from Brazil, all from Minas, so when the appetizer came with "pão de queijo" we were already excited. Of course it wasn’t exactly like the ones from Minas, but it was honestly really good and a fun surprise.

The dishes overall were excellent — super well-prepared, beautiful presentation, and everyone at the table thought the food was amazing. The atmosphere is great too, very themed, very well done. Everyone said it was one of the best restaurants they’ve been to at Disney.

I personally didn’t love my main dish — I ordered a burger and it came with some flavors and toppings that didn’t work for me, but that was just my plate. Everyone else absolutely loved theirs.

Service was exceptional, drinks looked amazing, and everything felt very polished. Even with my dish not being my favorite, I’m giving it five stars because the overall experience was top-tier. I’d definitely come back and just pick a different entrée next time. It’s a great spot with a really cool vibe and totally worth visiting.

My family and I just had an absolutely delightful and delicious dining experience. Our waiter, Michael, was not only attentive and gave fantastic recommendations, he was very funny!

Everything we had was delicious - the bread trio and pork belly appetizers were split among the 5 of us.

As for entrees, two of us had the surf n turf (steak and scallops with a truffle polenta), two of us had the short rib (with a side of AMAZING potatoes), and one got the fish of the day which was a whole fish bass with incredible curries and fried rice.

Dessert was incredible from the crème brûlée, hazelnut mousse, and sorbet trio which was actually REALLY tasty with unique flavors - perfect for anyone who needs a lactose free dessert!
