Lastly - incredible cocktails, wine, and beer recommendations! Shoutout to Michael once again for taking care of us and making sure my mother had enough water and lemons to meet her needs! Do not miss this restaurant if you’re in Animal Kingdom!!

Had a nice experience at Tiffins! Our server, Rhema, was outstanding — warm, attentive, and incredibly friendly. She feels like family now.  We ordered the butter chicken, truffle fries, and gobi Manchurian with a bottle of Goats Do Roam! Everything tasted great, but the portion sizes were pretty small for the price. Still, Rhema’s excellent service and positive energy made the meal enjoyable.

If you’re visiting Tiffins, definitely ask for Rhema.

Exquisite.
The food was incredible. The menu is a joy to eat. Love the Pineapple Pork Belly. The Short Rib Beef, was the best I had. Fully cooked to about 2 hrs in a Red wine. One must have the White Chocolate-Orange Cream Brûlée. It has a drawback: portion and price.
Overall a 4.9 out of 5.

formatted_address: 3701 Osceola Pkwy, Kissimmee, FL 34747, United States
name: Sanaa

reviews.text:
Incredible Food and Wildlife Views!

We had a fantastic lunch at Sanaa! Watching giraffes and zebras on the savanna while we ate was a unique highlight.
The food was excellent:
* Bread Service: A must-order! The nine dipping sauces are incredible.
* Butter Chicken & Lamb Kefta: Both were perfectly seasoned and delicious.
* Sanaa Burger: A great twist on a classic with a naan bun.
Pro-tip: If you're splitting the Butter Chicken, definitely ask for extra rice- especially if splitting the dish. Big thanks to our server, Kim, for the wonderful service. We’ll definitely be back!

Loved our meal at Sanaa! The bread service was incredible — honestly could’ve just eaten that and been totally happy. For the main, we had the Butter Chicken with Lentil Daal and Rice, and everything was full of flavour and perfectly cooked. The bread was definitely the star of the show though!

The atmosphere is cosy and relaxing, and the view of the animals outside makes it extra special. Such a unique and peaceful dining experience — would 100% go back! 🐘🌿

Met out of area friends staying at the Villas for dinner at Sanaa which was my first experience with this particular Disney restaurant. Friendly staff and the atmosphere was themed as expected for an Animal Kingdom destination. Luckily my friends had been there before and were familiar with the drinks and appetizers. Bread service is shown in one of the photos. Our server was kind enough to point out the range of spiciness in particular dishes which was helpful to me as first time guest. I had the Goan seafood curry, also in the photos. It tasted a lot better than it looked. Some delicious chunks of fish were hiding in the brown "soup". The grilled lamb looked interesting and don't be afraid of taking the kids. There were some good kids meal selections, the cheese pizza is pictured and was heartily enjoyed.

Always an amazing meal when we are at Disney. The wait staff are always so great and the food never disappoints. Get the bread service! The restaurant is inside Kadani Village at Animal Kingdom Resort and you can go outside and see animals grazing while you wait to be seated. We always try and go at sunset. It’s simply a gorgeous place to eat a meal. I also recommend the samosas and butter chicken.

Sanaa at Disney’s Animal Kingdom Kidani Village is truly unforgettable. The famous bread service is an absolute must — warm, fresh breads paired with an incredible variety of flavorful condiments that are as fun to try as they are delicious. The butter chicken was outstanding, cooked to perfection with rich, comforting flavors that left me wanting more.

On top of the amazing food, the cast members made the experience even more special. They were warm, friendly, and attentive, ensuring everything ran smoothly while making us feel welcome and cared for.

Between the food, the atmosphere, and the excellent service, Sanaa is easily one of the best dining experiences at Disney. Highly recommended!

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: The Mara

reviews.text:
Loved the pizza and falafel hummus platter here. They put a white sauce on the tomato pizza which is unique and i have never seen that earlier. its awesome.
They do fry veg and meat in same fryer, so if you care about that you should avoid the falafel platter.

Great variety of delicious food. We ordered the BBQ Jerk Chicken Strips & the Combination bowl. Both were amazing and came out quickly

They also have a mobile order area where you can order on the app & pick it up without waiting in line.

There is limited seating indoors, but plenary of seating outside and by the pool.

One of the busiest and loudest quick services we’ve been to at a hotel. It was so crowded during breakfast, with super long lines for hot food. We opted each morning to just get cereal and muffins because it was so busy.

The breakfast at The Mara was actually pretty good, but unfortunately, the service fell short in a key area. My wife has a food allergy and placed a special order, which ended up taking over 30 minutes to be served. When she went to ask about it, they told her they had already marked it as delivered despite the fact that she was still holding the beeper device they gave her, which hadn’t gone off.

We did receive a refund, and we appreciate that gesture, but it’s really important for the staff to be more attentive to these kinds of details, especially when it involves allergy related orders. Mistakes like this can be more than just inconvenient....they can be dangerous.

The Mara is a great breakfast option when your staying at Animal Kingdom Lodge! They have Mickey Waffles, Oatmeal, Pastries and more. They also have gathered famous Zebra Domes! It also has a great atmosphere to go along with the animal theme. It’s located next to the pool which is convenient to go swimming right after breakfast

formatted_address: 9404 S Orange Blossom Trl, Orlando, FL 32837, United States
name: Moroccan Breeze Restaurant

reviews.text:
Oh my gosh !! It's been so long since I've had such good couscous, and now you can even order your merguez sausages to go! They're absolutely delicious, just like their other dishes. I thoroughly enjoyed it. And to finish, a little mint tea with some biscuits... oops, I ate the biscuits before taking a picture (I'm such a glutton!😌☺️). Seriously though, I highly recommend this place if you want to discover authentic Moroccan cuisine. If I could, I'd give it way more than 5 stars! They absolutely deserve it.
Abiba and IIham are really very pleasant .. thanks 🙌

We absolutely loved the food and the way we were treated. This small place is a hidden gem that everyone should know about! The dishes had the perfect temperatures, authentic Moroccan flavors, and beautifully balanced portions. 100% recommended — we’ll definitely be back soon!

**Authentic Moroccan Delight in Orlando! **
During our trip to Orlando, my daughter and I discovered Moroccan Breeze in the Apna Bazaar food court, and it was an absolute treat! On our second day, we shared the Lamb Couscous and the Lamb Tagine with prunes, both bursting with rich, authentic flavors that transported us straight to Morocco. The dishes were incredibly delicious and masterfully prepared.
To complement our meal, we enjoyed refreshing mint tea and a selection of delightful pastries. Everything was perfect! We were so impressed that we returned on our last day in Orlando to bring some of this culinary magic back home to Tampa to share with my husband and son.
Moroccan Breeze has truly captured the essence of Moroccan cuisine, and we can't wait for our next visit. If you're in Orlando, don't miss out on this hidden gem!

The food was fantastic—I loved it! It felt like I was eating at home. The place is very clean and well-organized, with friendly customer service, and the food arrives quickly. I loved this place and will definitely be coming back.

My family and I were invited to this restaurant by our Moroccan friend to try authentic Moroccan food. The food was amazing! We had the tajin, kefta and the MOST AMAZING coconut pastry I have ever had in my life! I had to control myself and bring some to my mom to try because she is a coconut lover! (She absolutely LOVED IT) The staff is so kind and hospitable and make you feel at home! The atmosphere was family friendly,we really enjoyed this experience and will be coming back!

formatted_address: Sanford, FL 32773, United States
name: Falidelicious Restaurant 5 stars!!!!!

reviews.text: Great service! Great chef! Great food! They always put the customer first. Her focus on food freshness and safety is what appeals to me the most. Definitely worth it!

This food has sustained me for many years in all kinds of events: weddings, after church fellowships, birthday parties…so much more!! If I’m advised against eating the wonderful varieties that FaliDelicious provides, I will become very irate. This food is a blessing

When I first moved into Florida, I needed someone to cater for my birthday party. Fafa made me the best meals, especially, the okro soup, which is the best I have ever had. Everyone at the party was excited for the delicious meals. You won't go wrong with Falidelicious.

Such an amazing chef. Her service makes the whole experience delightful.
The challenge I have had with other African restaurants is that it doesn't taste like home. Not with Falidelicious. Her food is just perfect. Truly delicious African food

The food is always so delicious! I've ordered catering several times and it is delivered promptly and warm. I've gotten Fufu and Egusi, Jollof, Spaghetti, Rice ball and light soup (my fave of all), Puff puff, pound cake and Meat pie. I highly recommend. I keep going ordering and will be placing a new order soon 😋

formatted_address: 6415 W Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32818, United States
name: Gen Bagay Restaurant

reviews.text: amazing restaurant, delicious food with exceptional service. cozy atmosphere, perfect spot for a lovely dinner. would definitely come back!

AMAZING FOOD! AMAZING SERVICE! My family and I are on Orlando for a week on vacation and we were able to find this spot. The women that cooked was so sweet, and we picked up our food late right when we got back from the airport and she had it ready for us nice and hot and they were getting ready to close. We appreciate that so much because we were hungry! Lol We will definitely be eating here again while we are in town. Kembe la, Nou fe bon Manje, Nou bay bon sevis! 👍🏾👍🏾👏🏾👏🏾🇭🇹 🇭🇹 🇭🇹
Food looked amazing and tasted even better and great customer service will be coming back !!!

I just ordered griot and it is the best I had so far. I will say there is a little more fat than I would like. But the meat pieces are actually pretty big. The food did take a while to be cooked but it was definitely worth it because it was hot and fresh and very good. I’m definitely going to be eating here almost twice a week 😭

I went to visit my family in Orlando and we stopped by this restaurant called Gen Bagay and the food was to die for. Honestly some of the best Haitian food I have had in a while! And it was so affordable!! I would definitely recommend eating here. The staff is also super pleasant and the place is so clean!! Can’t wait to go back when I visit again!

formatted_address: 719 Good Homes Rd, Orlando, FL 32818, United States
name: Seana's Caribbean | Soul Food

reviews.text: Spent $50 for 5 LITTLE dry oxtail bones that they threw sauce on and put on some hard $2 pasta. Smh. Best thing was the lemonade. Spoke to the manager about how I feel cheated out my money and could I at least buy extra oxtails before I even tasted it. He called the owner and the owner wanted me to buy a whole other plate. First and last time going here. I’ll take my $50 back to sunshine carribean where I get enough meat for what they charge. Then it’s always “oxtails high”. Yea but not $35 a plate with 5 bones. Garbage.

Best Soul Food I have tried in Florida! I ordered the fried cat fish, with Mac and cheese and cabbage, everything was an explosion of flavors, nothing disappointed. This food took me back to my childhood! The Customer service was also exceptional, Very kind felt family oriented. I highly recommend this place. A nice chill environment as well. Loved everything about it!

My first time trying Caribbean soul food, was definitely a good experience. The chicken was cooked amazing, I got the jerk chicken. The rice was flavorful. It is definitely worth paying a dollar more for the side of mac and cheese w collared greens. I definitely recommend. The staff was polite and nice, felt welcomed.

Everything was amazing and food came out pretty quick. They were out of a good amount of stuff and I wasn’t a fan of the mac but other then that it was great and i can’t wait to go back. My friends had the catfish and the wings which were also excellent. The drinks were great as well highly recommend the sweet tea

Let me start but saying that I would still absolutely recommend going here. This trip I went in person and ordered curry chicken over rice and peas, steamed cabbage and mac n cheese. $16 gets you  a hefty plate and a drink, a deal you’ll hardly find in Orlando. Here’s the thing, the curry chicken wasn’t what I expected. If you’re looking for chicken that’s simmered in its curry, that’s not this. Seana’s curry chicken is just baked chicken with curry gravy over it. The curry itself is a little lackluster. That being said, I will vouch for everything else on the menu. Especially  honey fried chicken and catfish.

formatted_address: 1901 Tallokas Ave, Orlando, FL 32805, United States
name: EZ Eats Afro Soul Food

reviews.text:
Whewww I just ordered off door dash.. food is ok I paid 57$ for 3 meals. I got lamb chops. It comes with only 3 lamb pops. The seasoning is over powered and that’s a lot coming from being from  Chicago we jerk everything!! I paired it with the Rasta pasta overwhelming as well hellllaaaaaa spicy on top of 3 pieces of lamb that’s spicy.
And broccoli.. Broccoli is bland.. I opted out on cooking tonight had a long work week .. I dont know if I’d give it another try. Ordered for my mom and husband I didn’t ask yet how they feel. But when I told my husband I would order this place he said ummmm I don’t really like it an I said well that’s what we gone eat lol.. Anywho give a few more lamb pops and dial back on the spice and we may have a hit… An I love spicey food soooo… welp I just asked my not how was her good she said she couldn’t eat her wings the cause was to overpowering she couldn’t even taste the chicken..

A much needed meal after a busy day, I stopped into West Lakes Food co, located on North Dollins avenue, in Orlando, fl for EZEATSAFROSOULFOOD where I know passion and flavor go hand in hand. Anytime I am in the Orlando area and looking for a quick bite to eat this is my goto. I went inside and placed my order on the kiosk which was then handed off to me by the front desk tenant. I went with two of the popular dishes the honey jerk lamb chops, baked beans and rice. As well as the passion fruit barbecue jerk wings, now both of these dishes are packed with flavor offering both jerk, sweetness and savoy. If you ask me thats the perfect flavor profile. The food is always hot, fresh and delivered in a timely manner. I plan to come back soon and I highly recommend checking this place out.
It was like a inside drive through.  The food was OK, I'll try it again but something different.  Oxtails was good, rice was sticky, pasta was sticky and spicy, and mac was sticky

I’ve ordered this many times before. So this is very disappointing!!! Originally, I thought my Afro soul bowl had no cornbread, but when I got to the bottom, the cornbread was flat and dry.. This is my first complaint from this place, but I don’t understand why they would serve something that should’ve been thrown in the trash.

I got the honey jerk lamb chops with rice, definitely one of my favorites. Food here is absolutely amazing with multiple options to chose from. 10/10 must try again. Service is great and fast I’ll definitely from here every time I’m in town.

formatted_address: 2620 N Hiawassee Rd, Orlando, FL 32818, United States
name: Igatap African Caribbean Cuisine

formatted_address: 2901 Osceola Pkwy, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830, United States
name: Harambe Market

reviews.text:
An African Themed Market With Good Food and Drink
The Animal Kingdom Theme Park is divided into several smaller themed parks within its boundary. We spent quite a bit of time in Africa and found this great little place for lunch. Their menu is quite expansive with many common food items and some of them have been changed up with African spices and flavors. We were in Africa, so we wanted the tastes of that land and we got them. My wife had the Chicken Caesar Salad ($12.99). Fresh crisp romaine lettuce tossed in a Caesar dressing with tomatoes and grated Parmesan cheese, then topped with a nice portion of chermoula-marinated chicken. The spices for the marinade lent a warm, yet bold and slightly acidic flavor to the chicken. Not at all spicy hot. The portion size is large. She finished all the chicken, but left some of the lettuce. A very good value. Beef and Lamb Kofta Pita ($13.49). I think this is the African version of a gyro. The meat is a combination of beef and lamb, not heavy on the lamb. The same chermoula spices as on the chicken. A nice portion of meat on a warm, soft pita topped with a tasty tzatziki sauce. It was served with crunchy house-made potato chips. Chicken and Shrimp Rice Bowl ($15.99) Chermoula-marinated chicken and peri peri-marinated shrimp served on top of a west African savory tomato based slightly spicy jollof rice with another African specialty - kachumbari tomato and onion salad, topped with tzatziki sauce. The entire dish was really enjoyable. There is a covered outdoor eating area directly across from the market where you can dine in the shade. Be adventurous, give it a try.

The food was very good. The seasoned shrimp were well-balanced and not too salty. The spiced yellow rice was excellent. I really enjoyed the bowl. All the tables are outside, but they have fans and complimentary iced water.

One of my favorite walk-up places to eat anywhere in all of the Disney parks. Such amazing native flavors, really just very good quality and flavorful. Fantastic value for what you get compared to many places in the parks, and quite a bit of food.

I always get the #1 chicken and shrimp bowl, with seasoned rice, fresh tomatoes and pickled cucumbers, and tzatziki sauce.  So good!!

Hidden gem. The cheesecake was so good. I was shocked -- mango passion fruit. I do think they could have left off the Costco style frosting because it's so good on its own. Even the crust is good. Watermelon lemonade was refreshing. Again. Shocked. Because it's made with minute lemonade I was expecting really sweet. But it wasn't. The lamb kafta is yummy. Grab napkins because it leaks. And tons of tables. You're not stuck holding food while elbowing people away.

Compared to my other meals at different locations across all four parks, this one didn't stand out as much. Doesn't mean it wasn't good. On the contrary, the kabobs were well done. My only reservation was the pita - it was rock hard. Guess microwaved or heated but served much later.

Other dishes were fine - jollof rice was nice!

formatted_address: 5160 S John Young Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32839, United States
name: Kalalou Caribbean Bar & Grill Orlando

reviews.text: Food was delicious like the fried food/appetizer.  The salmon was dry over cooked. I finally got my lemon water by the time I almost done eating.  I only ordered lemon water. Ensure if theybwere under staffed.  Nonetheless, it' disappointing to experience. The waitress seemed overwhelmed and we have to ask multiple times by several people in my party. Unfortunately the service was poor.  The food was good, however,  not worth the experience.

We called about 30 minutes before closing to let them know we had a party of eight and would arrive in about eight minutes, and thankfully they were kind enough to accommodate us. My brother and his family drove an hour and a half to meet us, while we had just flown in from New York, so after a long day of travel, all we wanted was a good meal together. The food was delicious, and the service was truly outstanding. Our waiter was kind and attentive, and even though it was close to closing time, the staff made us feel welcomed and never rushed. We are incredibly grateful for their hospitality, especially since we stayed until 10ish, even though they closed at 9p. Friendly, good vibes with traditional and modern Haitian music.

As a Haitian let me tell you this food is amazing!! The service Top Tier. This place needs to be packed to the brim. If you in the area check this place out you will not be disappointed. Don't forget the drinks!! Yes!!! And thank you Jean you served it up!

We had a great experience at Kalalou. Words cannot describe how much we appreciated our time there. The atmosphere was inviting. There was music playing and ambient lighting. Kevin, our waiter was personable and always ready to assist us with any questions. The food came at a very reasonable time. The food was delicious. Compliments to the chef. You can tell there is a lot of attention and care made in the meals. If you’re Haitian, you will have a sense of nostalgia from these exquisite flavorful dishes.The fried food was fresh, not greasy. A wonderful time all around. 10/10!
I enjoyed the Fresh food. No complaints at all. Dine in and the restaurant always had friendly waiters with both of my visits.

formatted_address: 7600 Dr Phillips Blvd #22, Orlando, FL 32819, United States
name: Bocas Grill Orlando

reviews.text: Our meal was great and extremely fast. Manoli was an excellent server. He was quick, polite, and attentive. The food had generous portions. If we had any complaint, it was that the food was just slightly saltier than we liked it. But that may have been a preference thing. We would still gladly return!

It was a great experience today! They made my birthday one to remember! Our server, Manoli, went beyond expectations with great service ! The food was amazing! We’ve been here before but not for lunch, great experience! The lunch menu deals for this season are to die for! Definitely we will come back soon! The loyalty program has been revamped and  it does offer an incentive to come back 🙂
Phenomenal taste and presentation! Great service and amazing food. Pure delight to the eye and the nibble in every piece and sip. Thank you!

Vanesa did a great job serving our table. We ordered a Parilla Mix Surf and Turf Deluxe, food was excellent, everything was hot and fresh. One drink we ordered was a Passion Fruit Sangria which was delicious and refreshing. Same as The Coconut Lemonade and Passion Fruit Juice, made with fresh ingredients.

Loved this place. It was our first time. Once we were at the entrance we were greeted by a sweet young lady that took us to our table. Immediately we were given the menus and a bottle of cold water. Ordered our food and drinks and it was awesome. The food was so fresh I was amazed. The cocktails were delicious. Our server was on top of everything and made our experience awesome. For sure I recommend it 💯%

formatted_address: Clarcona Ocoee Rd, Orlando, FL 32808, United States
name: The Magical Taste

reviews.text: Remember to ask for marie, her service is exceptional! she made our dining experience truly magical.
I tried the herring patty and the order of acra.  Delish.  The owner was such a nice lady!
Just had the rice, red beans and chicken with pikliz. It was delicious!! Great customer service from Monia. Cant wait to go back!

I stopped for lunch today and it was delicious 😋
Finally found a great place to eat some Caribbean food. I highly recommend 👍
Great food. Nice people. Customer service is always good.

formatted_address: 6432 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819, United States
name: Cafe Mineiro Brazilian Steakhouse

reviews.text:
Honestly, the worst meal I’ve ever eaten at a restaurant.  Everything was overcooked.  Like beyond well done and very dry.  The only steak they had was variations of sirloin, even though they tried to dress it up as “garlic steak”, “steak with Parmesan” blah blah blah.  It was all sirloin.  It was fatty and tough as nails.

Service was just okay, not spectacular.  The waitress was okay, the guys bringing the meat were as inept as humanly possible.  Like, helping two of us and ignoring two of our friends, literally walking off mid sentence while asking for a portion.

I’ll never never never be back.  Even at $36 it wasn’t worth the money.  Spend the $60+ to go to Fogo or Texas De Brazil

It was really really good. Their buffet was incredible, they have a lot of variety. Rice with milk, yellow plantain (maduro) garlic pasta, beans… Their meat was awesome and they gave us pan de queso as an appetizer. I would come back!!

Excellent Brazilian
steakhouse! The meats were flavorful, perfectly cooked, and served with great variety. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making the experience even better.
Outstanding service by Leonardo Nobre and Raphael Junqueira. Highly recommend
Café Mineiro!

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the staff, because it was our first time at this establishment, and we were warmly welcomed by the hostel. They provided us with comprehensive information about the dishes and how they were prepared. Special thanks to Tatiana, she was excellent at her job and provided outstanding service! I recommend it for the whole family. You will truly enjoy the excellently prepared cuisine and get a lot of pleasure from the dishes! 100 out of 100%

This restaurant was recommended by a friend who came two years ago while vacationing in Orlando.  We came on her recommendation and she was 💯 correct.  We all ordered the rodizzio lunch.  The food was absolutely delicious.  In addition to the several cuts of meat that came out routinely, there was a wide variety of food choices included with the buffet.  The service was outstanding.  Tatiana took care of us and was very attentive.  We did not feel rushed at all.  We will be recommending the restaurant to anyone we know who will be in this area.  Hopefully they will be lucky to have Tatiana wait on them.

formatted_address: 10173 University Blvd, Orlando, FL 32817, United States
name: Mark's Jamaican Bar and Grill

reviews.text: Heard about this place through a friend. We stopped in today. So glad we did. This is a small restaurant/bar. We were greeted warmly, and menu was explained. We ordered a LARGE Jerk Chicken, white rice, green banana and dumpling along with a beef patty. Absolutely Delicious!!! Large fed both till we were completely full. Highly recommend.

Met the owner Mark while getting food, super friendly person. The food portions are absolutely huge, and I personally really like the plantains. I'd say the jerk chicken could be less dry, but the brown stew chicken was absolutely amazing. They give a discount to UCF students, and I would definitely come here again. The portion sizes are HUGE.

Oh my gosh, this is the best Jamaican food we’ve had in Florida! The oxtail was absolutely delicious, and the curry chicken was so tender it fell off the bone. The mac and cheese was also very nice, and the cabbage was very delicious. I give it a perfect 10 out of 10!

Never ever disappointed with the food music and staff. Great portions and reasonable prices. Come here at least twice a week. Today we had the oxtail curry chicken and curry goat. Next time I will have pictures they ate too fast lol but here’s the rest of mine chicken and ice cold Guinness

We had the curried shrimp and rice dinner and fish dinner. To be fair, the pictures were taken after we had already eaten some of the food. We just could not wait to eat and then I remembered to take pictures. Both were good. The young ladies at the counter were courteous. Overall, it was a fair experience.

formatted_address: 9436 S Orange Blossom Trl, Orlando, FL 32837, United States
name: Kabsah

reviews.text: Delicious authentic Yemeni food. We ordered Chicken mandi, Lamb haneeth and Tabbouleh salad. Everything was great, both the chicken and lamb were falling off the bone, really flavorful and tender. The Lemonade was refreshing and the Basbosah was delightful! Even the complementary tea was great. Portion sizes are generous and easy on the pocket too. Service was top notch and our server Banna was very attentive and gracious. I would highly recommend this place.

Our server was Muhammad and him along with the food was superb. Personally, this was my very first time trying Yemeni food, and I was truly impressed. Our server was very patient and thoroughly explained each item I was interested in on the menu. With Muhammad’s help, I made my selections for the food and was very happy with the quality, taste, and quick service I received. If we are ever in the area again we will be sure to stop by.

Delicious, authentic Middle Eastern food in a warm and welcoming setting. We ordered the haneeth and mandi, and both dishes were outstanding, tender, flavorful meat and chicken , perfectly cooked rice, and rich spices that made every bite enjoyable.

A special thank you to Banna, who works there and made our visit even better with great and genuine hospitality.

Halal food

The food was fantastic. I enjoyed my chicken mandi with saffron basmati rice and my husband had lamb fahsa and loved it!! Perfect baklawah! Highly recommend!! Small staff, have a little patience when busy. Worth the wait!!

This was such an amazing stop after a long day driving! Truly the food felt so homey and delicious. It was as if I was invited in someone’s home! 100/10. The server Banna was honestly very nice and recommended the best of the best foods. This was the first time some of us tried Lamb Haneeth and WOW it was so good ! The rice and the lamb 😍. The chicken Kabsah WOW ! As if I was overseas
Fattoush salad was perfect.
The dessert Basboosa was OMG! Sooo soft and moist and flavorful. This place is truly a hidden gem and should be visited more!

formatted_address: 7044 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32819, United States
name: World's Magic Restaurant

reviews.text: Before entering you might get a bit disappointed because of the atmosphere outside but trust me when you will get inside you will feel great. A middle eastern vibe, very clean and neat. And food was very good. Will definitely recommend if you visit to orlando.

This place was a delightful treat for dinner. My boyfriend and I actually meant to try the place next door and mistakenly walked in here, but it turned out to be a wonderful accident - we had a delicious dinner and our server Muhammad helped us pick traditional Arab options. Would absolutely recommend!

While visiting Orlando, Florida, we stumbled upon World’s Magic Restaurant, a hidden gem serving authentic Saudi cuisine. This was a rare and delightful surprise—while Mediterranean and Arabic restaurants are quite common, it’s not often you come across a true Saudi restaurant outside of Saudi Arabia itself.

We ordered the Lamb Mandi and Chicken Mandi, and both dishes were nothing short of fantastic. The rice was fragrant, perfectly seasoned, and absolutely bursting with flavor. The meat was tender, juicy, and cooked to perfection, with just the right blend of spices. The hummus was smooth and delicious—though I would have loved a slightly larger portion. The Arabic salad was fresh, crisp, and the perfect complement to the mandi, while the stuffed cabbage leaves were a pleasant surprise—honestly better than grape leaves in both flavor and texture.

A side of garlic sauce elevated everything on the plate; in my opinion, it’s a must-have with mandi. The restaurant itself had a welcoming and well-kept atmosphere, with tasteful décor that set a warm tone. A particularly thoughtful touch was the musalla area at the front for guests to perform salah, which we deeply appreciated.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel at home from the moment we walked in. While I do wish the menu had a few more unique Saudi dishes to explore, it was refreshing to see authentic flavors from Saudi Arabia represented so well.

If you’re in Orlando and want to try something beyond the usual Mediterranean or Middle Eastern fare, World’s Magic Restaurant is well worth a visit.

So delicious!
The Saudi food here is amazing full of flavor and so fresh! Loved every bite, can’t wait to come back.we ordered mandi, hummus and more

Amazing food. It’s a family run atmosphere. Expect great home cooked food in a warm inviting atmosphere. If you are looking for sterile white tablecloth service look elsewhere. The meat with rice was to die for.

formatted_address: 436 S Parramore Ave, Orlando, FL 32805, United States
name: Sister Soul Food

reviews.text:
I stopped by Sister Soul Food for one of their $5.00 bowls, and let me tell you—it’s definitely worth it for the price! The jerk chicken had that perfect smoky kick, full of flavor and cooked just right, while the ribs were tender, juicy, and had that fall-off-the-bone goodness you look for in real soul food. Both were seasoned beautifully and packed with flavor that left me wanting more.

The only downside was the macaroni and cheese—it came out clumpy and a bit hard, which took away from the comfort food vibe I was hoping for. If they could get that creamy, cheesy consistency down, it would’ve been a perfect meal.

Overall, the bowls are a great value, the meats were on point, and I’d definitely come back for that jerk chicken and ribs again!

We waited in line for a little while because they were busy, which is always a good sign for good food. The casher was very friendly and helpful. The food was great and very fresh! The portion size was amazing and the price was just as good for the amount of food you get. We decided to eat there and everyone was friendly, no complaints.

My husband and I aren't usually on this side of town. It was 3 o'clock we hadn't eaten anything as of yet and couldn't decide. While waiting on my husband to come out of Palmers Feed the street over I googled good food near me.
I was starving.
Sister Soul food came up with excellent reviews.
I told my husband I don't know where you plan to eat but I am eating at this spot with great reviews.
First I am so proud of the great customer service.
The cashier was so friendly and informative! The black guy with the perfectly groomed beard and mustache was just so hospitable.
I was hungry so I ordered a lot.
I have never been sooooooooo disappointed and hurt.
My husband fried fish and shrimp were so overcooked we couldn't even chew it.
It seemed overcooked and old as if it had been sitting.
I thought I ordered the pork chop dinner but I got this 1 pitiful pork chop the size of a chicken wing. Mac n cheese was so dry no salt and no real mac n cheese flavor.
I ordered the bowl with string beans rice and cabbage too.
All stalks no flavor and the rice was sooooo puffy it was as if my oldest granddaughter had cooked it.
I love cabbage and couldn't even finish it.
I had a bill that was almost 50 bucks.
My feelings are soo hurt because we couldn't get home fast enough to dig in. When I opened that mini bowl with my one small pork chop in it I just couldn't believe it. How can they feel okay serving this.
I wanted to love them.
I wanted to come on here and brag about this spot we had found accidentally.
I wish them all the success.
Maybe it was just a bad day.
I will admit that it was busy and a long line and the place was like a hot sauna no A/C.
My menopause was on full blast but I stuck it out because of the long lines, the hospitality and the great reviews. I have been dooped!

I ordered the $5 special that came with fried chicken, yellow rice and baked beans. Not one of the items had flavor. Yellow rice taste like boxed pre-cooked rice from Walmart. Baked beans were filled with cinnamon that left me with a headache. Fried chicken didn’t have any flavor and some of the chicken was drenched in the gravy from the baked beans which gave it a weird taste. They stuff all the food in this small container which makes it messy. They need to find another method for the packaging because it’s a mess. All in all, I wouldn’t return.

Honestly Sister Soul Food wowed me for a first time and unexpected visit. Was craving a good home cooked meal on Sunday afternoon and this popped up. When I pulled up the line was out the door, stood in line maybe 10 minutes but once inside that’s when you place your order. Me and my brother got two $5 dollar bowls each and ma they did not disappoint! Smothered pork chops 10/10 field peas 10/10 yellow rice 10/10 the cabbage was 10/10 Mac& cheese was decent not bad but not all that either. The fried shrimp same. Would I go back though ABSOLUTELY the people are kind, the food is good, and the price point is unmatched!

Was excited about thali

Absolutely delicious! We ordered five menu items to split, all as vegan and 10/10 would get each one again 🤩
Our server was Anthony, he was friendly, service was quick, and our water was always filled.
We will definitely come back!

Ordered Mysore Masala Dosa and Chilli Garlic Noodles. The dosa tasted good but wasn’t hot enough, same with the noodles.
I understand the restaurant was short-staffed and dine-in was closed early. However, it’s better to say no upfront than serve food with long wait times or compromised quality.
We also ordered two Kathi rolls to go. Waited 30–40 minutes, which was fine since they informed us. But the rolls were very disappointing — extremely small portions, $16 each is not justified, and they were not properly stuffed.
Overall, poor value for money. Quality and portion size need improvement.

The restaurant’s name suggests an authentic South Indian experience, but the reality was a major disappointment. While the dosa texture was good and the North Indian dishes (chapathi and paneer) were decent, the South Indian staples were a total letdown. The sambar and rasam lacked any depth of flavor and tasted like they were made from instant "ready-to-eat" mixes.
To make matters worse, the pricing is exorbitant. Since they don't offer thalis on holidays, we ordered rice, sambar, rasam, and yogurt individually—only to be charged $8 per item. Paying that much for "miserable" tasting food feels like a total rip-off. We ended up paying over $200 for a family of 4 adults and three children. To top it off, an 18% gratuity was automatically added; given the poor food quality, I truly hope that money actually went to the hard-working waiters rather than the management. It seems the kitchen understands North Indian cooking but is totally lost when it comes to South Indian cuisine.

Paid ~$45 for filter coffee, Gobi Manchuria, and an onion dosa, and honestly, it felt overpriced.

Filter coffee at $8 didn’t feel special enough to justify the price.
Gobi Manchuria was okay but served in a plastic bowl—if this place considers itself fine dining, the presentation should match the pricing.
Onion dosa was average; the sambar was very thin (almost rasam) and the chutney was cold.

I will stick with old friend, woodlands

Genuine question guys,: Is it just me, or does this place feel way too expensive for what you get? Almost like a rip-off?

formatted_address: 1412 Alden Rd, Orlando, FL 32803, United States
name: City Food Hall - Orlando

reviews.text:
Me and my family came here on Christmas Day to come to Eggdose and we absolutely love the food that they have. The crew was so nice and catered so much care to us despite while working on Christmas Day.
We also tried the bar that was here next to Eggdose and we met the manager Roberto and the bartender Miguel. Both were very nice. Roberto recommended two drinks that I recommend to try, which is pinky promise and tropical rush.
Going back to Eggdose they gave us some extra home fries that we ordered to go because it was that good.
Overall, I recommend coming here to try other restaurants If you haven’t yet.
I’ve been to the blessed belly food truck in Kissimmee and I recommend trying the one that they have here as well.
Me and my family can’t wait to come back

This spot was pretty awesome! There are a large variety of restaurants, about 10, and everything on offer was extremely intriguing. We snagged a few items like a smash burger, an eggdose sandwich, some creole fries, birria tacos and egg rolls, and some Ube horchata. All of it was great. Only complaints was that the interior was a little hot like the ac wasn’t on and we went during a quiet time so it was kind of awkward. Other than that we still recommend a visit for the delicious food!

This place was so fun! They have valet and even though they were unorganized and delayed, we enjoyed our time here. There was a fitness class going on outside (in between rainstorms) & inside was so cool! There was tons of food stands with a variety of options. We tried options from Egg Dose, Blessed Belly and Kalalou. The food was so unique and delicious, I wish I had more room to try them all!  The hall also has a bar with specials and they were tasty! Can’t wait to go back!

Cute location and lots of different choices. We had lasagna fritta from Tanta Pasta and gyoza and Japanese chicken with a spicy sauce from Ramen Takagi. We enjoyed all of our choices and look forward to going back to try more.
Lots of good choice of food.  Nice bar with craft cocktails. Lots of indoor space. Outdoor area is super nice artificial grass, couches, Cornhole.  Great area for walking.

formatted_address: 5829 Grand National Dr Suite C, Orlando, FL 32819, United States
name: Tabla Indian Catering

reviews.text: Tabla was the caterer for our wedding this past weekend. They did an amazing job. All the food tasted fresh and was at the spice level we chose. All the guests said it was great. They were able to curate a menu from different parts of India. We had Gujarati and Punjabi food. They also made things for us that were not explicitly on their menu. I definitely recommend Tabla for any event that needs India food catered.

We recently had the pleasure of working with Tabla Indian Catering for our large community event with over 400 guests and we could not have asked for a better experience . From start to finish their professionalism , organization and attention to detail was outstanding . The food was the highlight of the event - authentic Indian spices and flavors with  every dish from appetizers to the desserts were fresh , flavorful and delicious. The goat biryani, Rogan Josh , pav bhaji and pani puri live stations were a big hit . We highly recommend Tabla Indian catering for  great food , great prices and phenomenal professionalism . Thanks a lot Tabla

We had Tabla Catering for our wedding, and they absolutely exceeded our expectations! From the very first tasting to the final service on our big day, everything was handled with so much professionalism, care, and attention to detail.

We recently hired Tabla Catering for our wedding in Orlando, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team was professional, responsive, and incredibly accommodating. The food was absolutely phenomenal—our guests are still raving about the Butter Chicken, Paneer Tikka, and the beautifully arranged appetizers. What truly stood out was the attention to detail and personalized service. Tabla made sure every dish matched our preferences, and their team handled everything seamlessly on the big day. If you're looking for wedding catering in Orlando that blends amazing flavors with flawless execution, Tabla Catering is the way to go!
Excellent event at Tabla ballroom. Anthony and his staff did a great job. This is our 3rd event with Tabla catering ballroom and all were awesome. Thank you Tabla!

formatted_address: 8607 Palm Pkwy, Orlando, FL 32836, United States
name: Sofrito Latin Cafe

reviews.text:
For quite a few years now, when we come to Orlando, we end up having a nice dinner... And sometimes lunch too at this great place.
They serve a variety of South American specialties and trust me, they are all good!
This time my wife got the Peruvian chicken and I got the Cuban shredded pork. Both entries came with three sides! I got some delicious fried yuka, boiled yuka and fried plantains .
The bork was delicious, nicely spiced but not too hot. Both yuka were well cooked and very flavored in their different ways.
I should mention that the portions were very generous, so we got quality and quantity.
My wife's chicken was very well cooked too and she got yuka too so all was very good.
The price was very reasonable and everyone working there was very friendly.
A great experience once again, that's why we keep coming back.

Order at the counter, self seating and get ready to have your senses blown away!! The favors and the smells were absolutely amazing! My Uber driver recommended it last year when I was here for a convention, but didn’t have time to go, so made sure I went this time around!  So glad we came!

The food was great and there were many options both large and small portions.  There are a few vegetarian options.
It is a counter service restaurant so you place your order at a kiosk or with a person at the counter.  Then you are given a number and you find a table and the food is brought to your table.  I always feel a bit frustrated when asked for a tip on a self service kiosk and I have not gotten any service yet.  Don't expect a follow-up on drinks or desserts,  you have to go back to the counter and order.  There is seating inside and on a patio outside.  There are large group tables so it would be a good place for a larger group.  Oddly, there was a professional photographer going around offering to take photos as well.

The food was ok, I liked the drinks and atmosphere. You pay at counter and they bring your food. They made two errors to our order and the server was rude about it…when our receipt showed what we ordered word for word. 1 thing they didn’t bring the other they made it wrong both easy fixes. A simple sorry and fix it wld have been great but … instead we got the attitude. 🤔

Thank you to Miguel for the wonderful pictures he took of us. Lovely memory we’ll get to keep of our fish time in Florida! The food was delicious, we got patacones with shredded beef and drink. Servers were also really kind.

formatted_address: 485 S Kirkman Rd, Orlando, FL 32811, United States
name: Bon Appetit Grill

reviews.text: The food was mid. Not the best Haitian food I've had, by far. I had the Legumes with pork. But the pork was a pig's foot...  The Sos Pwa was watery and flavorless.  The portion of legumes was less than I expected compared to how much rice I received and the huge pig's foot. I probably won't eat here again.
The food is good I just wish they make sweet plantains and stop putting the vegetables on the meat talking about the onions and peppers it look pretty but I don’t like it but this place has good food

I would give this place 0 stars if I could. The young lady at the cashier counter is VERY rude and irritable she  should not be working there at all. I just left there not too long ago and only order a SIDE of rice while I waited for my DoorDash orders. But when they told me the price which was $9 (the other place does not charge this amount even tho money is not an issue) so I asked to make it a meal instead  which totaled to 11.05 (they charge for you to use your card) so I paid the 11.05 but what she did was put the old plate of rice to the side that had the gravy/sauce on it that I asked for. Then she scooped another plate of rice into a different plate then when I told her I wanted extra gravy she literally scrape some of the rice from the old plate (that had the gravy/sauce on it already) then dump the rice from the old plate back into the pot. Mind you the man who plated my food originally, was very nice but since he did not understand me (bc he doesn’t speak English) he also gave me Turkey on the side (that I didn’t ask for I just wanted extra turkey gravy on the side. So the rude young lady took that same turkey n gave it to me without checking to see if it was enough meat. So basically the turkey only had 3 pieces of meat in it. If I didn’t ask the other gentleman  to give me more meat I would have been left with only 3 pieces of meat that I originally didn’t want from the jump because I only wanted rice. But yeah that young lady has a horrible attitude n I will not be back to this location even tho I know she’s at the other location sometimes. I do not recommend coming here but the rice is great but the Turkey meat isnt too good just the sauce to add to your rice.

I ordered a griot,and the girl told me only one size for $17 plus tax. Now ,money is not the issue. I told her please put pork skin for and I would even pay extra for the skin ,she said” it already comes with skin”. She bagged the griot didn’t show it to me ,and when I got in the car I was disappointed with portion and the fact that she didn’t put pork skin ,after I told her I was willing to pay for it. I drove from Kissimmee to come here. I won’t be back.

This place should be shut down honestly. I ordered a griot simp and the griot was old hard and dry. The plaintains were so dry as well. The portions? Don’t even get me started. Just laughable. You look at this plate and tell me if you would enjoy.

formatted_address: 829 Good Homes Rd, Orlando, FL 32818, United States
name: JazTro By Chef D.O.C.

reviews.text: This place has been in my radar for a while and finally got to try it, Me and my family all agreed this was a great choice for the evening! Every dish was delicious, The pork was like boneless spareribs but Wasn’t chewy at all very lean and the sauce was delicious, the stir fried rice Was refreshing because you tasted the fried egg, chopped the vegetables and every bite yet it wasn’t heavy. The bistec cebollado had a nice flavor, tostones nice and crispy clean oil after taste, the rice Was amazing full of hearty Latin flare like if a great grandma Was in the back of the kitchen, never thought I would be talking This much about rice. Mofongo, Nice garlic punch, moisture was perfect plump shrimp with the buttery savory sauce, Combination was a success, but the little chopped cabbage on the side was a perfect touch. Last but not least This bread pudding was an awesome finish, wasn’t gooey nor dry, spoon sunk right through to scoop it up along with the creamy Coquito dessert Sauce in the bottom complemented by some cold ice cream, Gave me a resemblance of a banana foster sauce minis the bananas, but still has the component of caramel and cinnamon, Let me tell you, the owner is  passionate about what he does and it shows, will be returning if I’m ever in the area and I live in Deltona

What a hidden hole in the wall gem I stumbled upon!!! The food is 10/10 I came in with my friends and we all tried something different. I had the grilled chicken and side salad and it was juicy, well seasoned and delicious. The atmosphere is great and the vibes were even better. This is one of my new favorite places and I’ll be back.

Don't be fooled by the small place. The food here is divine!! I am not from the local area and we were hungry so we stopped to eat at JazTro. The food is sublime! The best chicharones de pollo I've ever had. The chuletas were juicy and full of flavor. And of course we had to try the Coquito bread pudding. BEST BUDIN EVER!! I'll certainly make the trip down just to eat there.

A Hidden Gem Worth Discovering!
My wife and I stumbled upon this charming little spot while in the area, and we were blown away. The food was absolutely amazing—full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was top notch, attentive without being overbearing. Though the restaurant is small, it’s cozy, comfortable, and impressively clean. We’ll definitely be back!

Dare I say the best Puertorican food restaurant I have been to in all of Orlando. The food is clearly made with care and tastes like authentic homemade cooking. The quality is superb. If you think Puertorican food isn’t for you because it’s greasy or fried.. try this place and then tell me.

formatted_address: 5722 York Rd, Baltimore, MD 21212, United States
name: Nailah's kitchen

reviews.text: Nailah’s Kitchen was amazing! My fiancé and I had a wonderful time. The owner has such a beautiful spirit, and the food was outstanding. Hands down the best jollof in the DMV area—we’ll definitely be returning soon!

Food was delicious. Me and my family really enjoyed the quiet setting. The staff was very nice and friendly. I ordered the tilapia and broccoli . The garnish was perfect. The sorrel was very tasty. Definitely worth the price you get a great portion size of food . I would recommend this place. Especially if you love African food. I will be back to visit ! 😋😍.. to be continue I came back here for a date in late August it was very nice the food was good my second time here.. came back my third time earlier in November of this month we did take out foods always good . Service is always good .

I chose this spot to go to after my graduation ceremony. Overall, my family and I had a great experience. Our server was very kind and attentive. The atmosphere was very aesthetically pleasing. The food was great, it was my first time trying Senegalese food and I was not disappointed! I tried a lamb dish and it was very tasty. The pineapple ginger drink was very good. I would highly recommend.

I was in town with my family doing a college tour and we looked up this place since we were hungry.  Let me tell you this Senegalese place was the highlight of the day. We walked in and the owner greeted up and was the nicest man you could meet.  We had a few questions and he patiently answered all of them. The food was OUTSTANDING. We had the Dibi chicken, Dibi lamb and the Mechoui.  All were well seasoned and you had a choice of mild or spicy. We went with spicy with the chicken and mild with the rest.  We also had the seasoned rice.   Everything was great there wasn't one wrong thing with the entire experience.   This is truly a 10/10 place, if you get a chance to visit when you're in the area don't hesitate!

A great spot to eat after a movie at the Senator. We enjoyed the lamb shank and fish dishes. Beautifully spiced, large portions and delicious appetizers and sides.

Friendly owner, clean and comfortable, inviting, modern decor.

formatted_address: 20 S Caton Ave, Baltimore, MD 21229, United States
name: Malam Ishaku Suya

reviews.text: I was craving for Suya and work in Bmore on weekends, so I decided to look them up. Amazingly, they open on Sundays. You need to order in advance over the phone. Got the Half Tray Suya for $45...compared to Suya Guys, this is a steal...$20 less and about the same or more. Customer Service was top notch and as a first time visitor, I also got extras. If you are looking for a bang for your buck ...suya without breaking the bank, I would recommend the suya. I might need to add more spicy because it was mild spicy, which I understand giving the diverse customer base. They also cater and do parties and events. I am definitely willing to patronize that service in the future given my experience with the customer service. Lots of Parking..it would be nice to add extra signs to direct customers from the street though...or lights and colors to showcase where they are. I would definitely be returning back. Check them out and thank me later.

Great suya, kilishi, and even better customer service! Was visiting the Baltimore area and decided to seek out some suya. Found this spot on Google Maps and came here based on the reviews. This place and business owner has good reviews for a reason! I was looking to purchase something to pack to take back to ATL and purchased four packs of kilishi. The four packs were only $22! There's suya for purchase to grill/prepare but I didn't have anything to pack that in for the plane. The owner gave my some pieces of suya to sample during my stop. Suya is GREAT. Spicy, flavorful, and all of the other good adjectives to describe a perfect piece of food. Highly recommend for people in the area who are close enough to buy some to take home and even for people like me who are visiting the area. The kilishi is amazing. Better than any jerky related product you can get anywhere! Hit this place up!
I enjoyed my suya and highly recommend this place. I felt bad that I couldn’t order a small plate however, the $45 pan is huge. I’ll eat it for days with my family. Best suya and kilishi in Maryland.

I visited from Atlanta and decided to try out his suya. Let me tell you, this suya is gooooood. And he gifted me a bag of kilishi also known as jerky beef.  I wished I ordered it as well. Next time I visit, I will definitely order some bags of the kilishi as well. Good customer service as well. I bought the 20 sticks.

My daughter asked for jollof rice and suya on her birthday. Consulted Google and took a chance patronizing this place, round trip 90 minutes drive from DC to Baltimore. It was well worth it. I got the family platter for a reasonable price, paid him using cash app and picked up my suya on time. It was delicious. I'm going to go back again. Another satisfied customer. (For my Nigerian family: Oh and he was even kind to dash me a pack of kiliishi).... great service with smiles!! Highly recommended.

formatted_address: Lexignton Market, 119 N Paca St Stall 28, Baltimore, MD 21201, United States
name: Platinum Amala - Lexington Market

reviews.text: The Vegan spot wasn’t open yet, so I found this little gem at the Lexington Market and I was pleasantly pleased. I got the Fufu, Peanut Stew, and half Egusi/Spinach and it was delicious! I definitely recommend Amala and the service was great as well! Very courteous and I will be returning for sure. Thank you!
Very friendly location, delicious nigerian in west african foods sold here 😋 11/4/25

Extremely unprofessional business. They ran out of an item and failed to notify me, leaving me waiting over an hour until they closed. I don't know what happened, but the food isn't good anymore. 3 weeks ago it blew my mind, but now the curry tastes watered down and they added potatoes to it for some reason? Flavor completely gone. Last week I tried the stewed chicken and the meat was old/dry. I'm also pretty sure they used turkey, not chicken. It was uncharacteristically huge and looked like cheap GMO meat.

Food absolutely horrible. The bag was dripping with excessive grease and so was the food. I ordered spinach without meat and yam. I get this dish from other places that was closed  today. Thought I try here. Never ever again.
All our order was so on point. The service was top notch.  Thanks for the african food you're giving us.the taste is so good.

formatted_address: 5702 Harford Rd, Baltimore, MD 21214, United States
name: Kuramo Restaurant

reviews.text: I try to support local small businesses but this is beyond ridiculous. Now which kind scam this be o?! I tried to give this place 1 last try and again I’m disappointed. The food and quantity used to be good and worth the money but now since they moved to this bigger location, they’ve increased the prices ($17 per combo) and decreased the portions of food. Extremely unethical. Not only have they increased the prices they charge EXTRA $4 for 1 piece of meat such as beef, goat, and Pomo (cow skin) etc... PER PIECE!! Small pieces at that. No bigger than an .50 cent piece.. And more bone than meat. Even the moi moi is $3 for a mouthwash cup size each. I ordered 1 order and was charged $6 for 2 little cups..When the website clearly states 2 pieces for $3.. RIDICULOUS! They never have puff puff or meat pies. The prices change daily regardless of what the website says. There’s always an excuse. Even the jollof is tasting different. Honestly that was the only reason I was patronizing this place because of the rice. No longer will I after this final attempt .. So don’t order and think you’ll get what you see advertised on their website or the price shown.. lai lai..  on top of that they are extremely slow. It’ll take over an hour after you place your order, even if you want to dine in.  I ordered an efo combo it had a plantain sticker in it. Yuck!  GBEGIRI-EWEDU should have assorted meats but nope they are charging for each piece. Ordered this as well and of course Looks nothing like the advertised picture. ALL The portions are extremely small no matter which combo or side you order.  Other small businesses aren’t trying to bust your head with over charging and give you tiny portions.. These containers aren’t the large size and definitely aren’t filled up. If you call in to order and ask for a total,  they tell you to call back in 10-15 mins about 3xs.. why? When you go pick up the order something is always missing. ALWAYS! It’s not even worth it anymore. They should humble themselves and stop cheating people. If people stop patronizing their business then they will rethink business ethics. I won’t waste money here again.  I’ll spend my money at the Jamaican or Latino spot. I won’t be disappointed about the portions. Buyer Beware!!

DoorDash order. The asaro was not asaroing. More like old yam n stew mixed together to say they had asaro. I literally picked it up like a chicken nugget. The meat was fried good but flavorless. The ayamase looked disgusting, smelled spoilt and only had fatty parts. I didn’t even bother with that. The rice was mid and the only thing that was great was the $4 piece of chicken. Pls update menu to say “one choice of” and not “one of each”. Kind of wild to pay $4 for a piece of chicken when a pack of obasanjo is like 6 bucks… but I get it convenience. I wish I could have tried the moin moin and meat pie because maybe that would have been redeeming because these reviews gave me high hopes. Overall trash, inedible and a waste of $55.33, but a lesson in laziness…Who sent me to go order food I can make myself? Really disappointed though.. This can’t be Nigerians making this food.
The service was pleasant. The atmosphere was comfortable and clean. The food was fresh and seasoned well.
This restaurant need complete renovation. You can see flies flying around. Chef/server/ host all was handled by one person. Kitchen look dirty from outside. Food was not good at all.

My husband and I visited. The egusi and fufu was great. It was recommended that I have it with both vegetable and beef which was a good combination. We even took food home for later.  Definitely want to come back soon!

formatted_address: 5002 Belair Rd, Baltimore, MD 21206, United States
name: Makkeey's African Kitchen

reviews.text: The food is delicious. Very friendly cook and owner. The price is very reasonable and the jollof rice meal is amazing. $15. I placed my order on phone and was ready on time for pickup. I recommend this restaurant.
It’s would been great if I had fresh chicken I had to throw away my chicken and only had soup chicken was so old and dried my swallow was great

Food is so amazing!
First time eating from this wonder African Restaurant, and trying African food. The food is amazing and hot when delivered. I will definitely be ordering from here again.

Ordered the pepper soup with extra Fufu for $17. A little pricey for smaller portion but was tasty. If you don’t like spice don’t bother coming, very well seasoned.

Will be returning. 10/10.

The food was good but we were missing a part of our meal. I think there was a misunderstanding with what we ordered! I would still recommend, just make sure you get what you ordered by checking the bag.

formatted_address: 1065 S Charles St, Baltimore, MD 21230, United States
name: Jollof Bowl

reviews.text:
I was REALLY REALLY excited to try this place. I was in the area snagging free books with my friend at the Book Thing of Baltimore and my friend and I came here after. I ordered half jollof rice and half spaghetti, suya beef, and then spicy slaw on the side. I also got the passion fruit ginger drink to complement my drink. My food was SOOOO GOOD. The spaghetti and rice was GASS. The suya was delicious. My friend got chicken and it was sooooo good, I definitely need to get chicken next time. There are so many options for sides and sauces to add - I didn't know what to pick. My biggest critique is that I would like them to have toppings that are cooked/warm. I chose not to get any toppings. My friend got corn and it was cold. I do think they should swap their current toppings with steamed corn, sautéed onions, etc. We spent about $21-22 for a bowl and a drink, and with the amount we are paying, I feel like they should fill our bowl up more.

Everyone was super nice and cool. Service was smooth and quick. There was a decent line when we arrived but it moves fast, we probably waiting about 10 mins but that's not too bad with how long the line was. This place is in the food hall, so there's plenty of seating to eat. I would definitely come back when I'm in the area and try a different combination.

I stopped by Jollof Bowl on a whim and I’m glad I did. The jollof rice was on point flavorful, not dry, not bland, just right. Everything tasted fresh and well-seasoned, the kind of food you keep thinking about after you’re done eating.

What really stood out to me was how comfortable the place felt. No rush, no attitude, just good food and good energy. If you’re tired of eating the same things and want something that actually has flavor and soul, this spot is worth the stop. Definitely adding this to my Baltimore rotation. OH LAWDD

I went to Jollof Bowl with some skepticism at first, but I have to say I was pleasantly surprised!

The food was absolutely delicious — the jollof rice was perfectly seasoned, and the variety of dishes they offer was just right. The portions were huge, and everything was cooked to perfection.

What really stood out to me was the price — four of us ordered a ton of food, with plenty of extras, and it came out to less than $100. Talk about a steal! I can’t recommend this place enough, especially if you’re in the mood for something flavorful and filling without breaking the bank. Definitely will be coming back!

I learned about Jollof Bowl from a post on Instagram. It looked interesting, so I sent it to a friend who also enjoyed these foods. She said "When are we going?", and so we went the next day.

Like others have said, the food is delicious. They are not stingy with their portions, and the food has genuine spice to it. They made it feel like home cooking.

I would definitely come through again.

Located inside Charles street market . The menu is easy to read and line moves along not too long of a wait . You will have to find seating in a booth . I ordered the chicken bowl with rice and noodles . The chicken was cooked good and not over seasoned same as the rice and the noodles are spaghetti which was different but tasted great. I would just recommend a better drink selection like maybe bottled water and or a juice or tea , the only beverage offering is a variety of non alcoholic ginger beer . Parking is not that great since it’s downtown Baltimore.

formatted_address: 4517 Bowleys Ln, Baltimore, MD 21206, United States
name: Bossb African Restaurant

reviews.text: After my dad chemo's treatment. We always take turns choosing somewhere to eat before we get back on the road. For the 2 hours drive home. I was surprised when my dad chose this african restaurant Bossb 4517 Bowleys Ln, Baltimore, MD 21206 Because I'd love African cuisine food. It's one of my favorite cultural food. We stop here at Bossb African Restaurant. My dad and his wife wasn't too pleased. It was just ok for them. I ate when I got home. The food was good.The flavors was there, but very, very small portions that I got for $30.72 Appetizers: Asun=$7.99 Entrée: Abula On Spot with assorted meats =  $19.99 which I attached pictures below. I wasn't expecting for my order to be loaded with food. Upon checking my order before before leaving the restaurant . It was unbelievable I could not believe what I had received and paid for  😳. So I approached the young man behind the counter and ask him was this My order and he said yes. In a very kind and respectful voice. I was like wow in disbelief.  I said OK respectfully tied the bag back up and left to never return. We did received  great customer service.The atmosphere was  good.  Parking lot was very limited. 4  parking space Which made it very hard and difficult to park

Let’s talk about the lady behind the fantastic food first. From the first time I entered the owner has been a blessing to know and eat from. She is a fantastic spirt and chef. The food is hands down the best and the love in each ingredient while preparing the food is great. I suggest you stop by immediately to enjoy lunch and dinner. This African cuisine has a home cooked taste, the food is a plus for me!!!

I ordered through DoorDash. I ordered white rice with Ayamase, jollof rice, Efo riro and pepper soup. The rice is okay but the Ayamase does not have pepper at all. The efo riro is great but the pepper soup which I paid 14.99 for is too small compared to the picture on their website. I would have attached a picture below but there’s no option. I should have just ordered one thing first. Anyway, I don’t think am ordering any food from there anymore.

I’m honored to be the first reviewer! The staff were incredibly kind and professional over the phone. It was very inexpensive so i decided to go all out. I ordered three suya sides, asun, and gizdodo. When I arrived to pick up my order, everyone greeted me with a warm welcome.

My total came to $37, and I added a $9 tip. I asked the cashier if the food was good, and without hesitation, she raved about it. I was a bit skeptical—but let me tell you, as a Ghanaian, after tasting the food, I’m seriously considering switching sides! The food was absolutely delicious, and I’ll definitely be coming back! 👍🏾
Jollof rice is heavenly ! Price reasonable I spoke wit her over the phone amazing  woman ! Keep the quality the same ! I will spread the word about how amazing your food is !!! Ese 🤎

formatted_address: 2416 E Monument St, Baltimore, MD 21205, United States
name: Beulah International

reviews.text: If i could give this business less stars I would.  The woman at the counter has a vile attitude and the food she gave me was inedible. I ordered egusi with chicken and the chicken was rock hard. It could barely be pulled apart. You can tell when someone takes pride in the food they serve and their culture. This clearly is not the case here. I had to throw half of my food out it was so bad. 0/10. I do not recommend. Save yourself the $25-$30. There’s a sign that says no refunds so choose wisely.

Do NOT spend your money at a place that treats Black customers unfairly.

The food here is usually okay, but the service is consistently awful. During my recent visit, the woman behind the counter came out to confront me after I asked a simple question. I ordered my food and asked for the price. She pointed to a small monitor and said, “It’s right there!” I have a vision impairment that makes it difficult for me to read certain displays, but I typically keep that private. I didn’t see the price on the monitor, so I politely asked her to tell me.

Instead of answering, she snapped, “Oh, you cannot see!?” She still never told me the price. At that point, I told her to cancel the order. She then came from behind the counter and said, “You people always doing this!”

That comment made it clear to me that she holds prejudice against Black Americans. I will never eat here again. My decision may not impact their business, but it will certainly protect my peace.

Omgggggg first time trying this kind of food and I’m soooo thankful I came here !!! Won’t be my last time. Food was freshly cooked and made with love 10/10 . Egusi and fufu.. with fish is a must try . I will be back

Beulah Africa Restaurant serves up some of the most soul-satisfying Nigerian dishes I've ever tasted. The egusi soup,okro soup with goat meat, and fish—is rich, flavorful, and deeply comforting. You can tell every dish is made with love and tradition.

Order Okra Stew and this was the best i had delivered to me. Will be my go to from now on. The meat was not dry and they gave decent portion sizes. Had to add this before i finished it all. Went back for a second time and the food is still amazing and the flavors are beyond. The chef does a great job at keeping the food fresh

formatted_address: 210 S Central Ave Suite 102B, Baltimore, MD 21202, United States
name: Africana Cuisine

reviews.text:
Do not order the Ogbono soup. MAC was god awful. He was not willing to offer any accommodation

Edit: Aquira spends $25-$35 everytime that I come here and I’ve been about 10 times in the past 3 months. Aquira wasn’t expecting a “discount.” Aquira was expecting some compassion and understanding. I wasn’t nasty to you sir. I don’t see you as competition because I’m not your competitor I would like everyone to win. You’ve lost a regular customer. My biggest thing as a business owner is for a customer to be satisfied and for a customer to return. Any who I pray your business continues to be blessed. Just lost a a faithful customer in me. Take care

This business is a scam, the food is the worst food I have ever tasted. The owner doesn't take calls and the phone kept going to voicemail, so I had to wait almost 30 minutes plus to pick up my order. He finally opened the door and my order was incomplete because he said he didn't have the fried rice and plantains that I ordered and said he would notify DoorDash to refund me.
Guys read the reviews about this place, they are accurate reviews. This business needs to be shut down to the general public. These guys are wasting people's time and energy. Very dirty and unhygienic place. Again, read the reviews and stay away from this business. I will follow this up with the authority and ensure this business is closed.

I ordered a meat pie, Mac and cheese, a beef patty, and oxtail via Uber Eats. I actually ordered it at 11:30 PM and they close at midnight. The owner stayed open an extra 30-40 minutes just to get my driver the food (the drivers kept canceling). He was really easy to contact and communicate with, and I really appreciate that.

The order was missing the mac and cheese, but I was able to get refunded for that. The meat pie wasn’t very good; pretty dry. The beef patty was pretty good — the crust was slightly dry but the filling was flavorful and generous. The oxtail though was truly excellent. I only meant to eat a couple and save the rest for later — I devoured every last bit lol. They were tender and delicious.

Where do I begin, besides don’t waste your money. I ordered the peanut butter stew with okra. The peanut butter stew taste very burnt with an OVERWHELMING AMOUNT OF PEANUT BUTTER. And the okra was very bland. The total cost was 41.56 NEVER AGAIN DOOR DASH THANK YOU FOR MY REFUND.

formatted_address: 2400 Boston St Suite 120, Baltimore, MD 21224, United States
name: Spice Kitchen West African Grill

reviews.text:
My wife and I had lunch here on a Sunday.  We were greeted warmly as we made our order and all questions we had were answered in a friendly and amiable manner.  The staff showed real appreciation for our business and went out of their way to make sure everything was good with us.

The food was ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL.  I had the lamb chops and my wife had the steak plate.  We both had the spinach, I had the rice and stew with Plantains, she had the Jollof Rice with Plantains.  Everything was delicious.  Perfectly seasoned and prepared.

The restaurant is beautifully appointment with images and patterns of Africa and it's painted in a beautiful dark orange.

Truly an extraordinary dining experience.

I also grabbed the Goat Eggrolls to go.  Fantastic.

Explore Baltimore - Spice Kitchen West African Grill

Spice Kitchen West African Grill is a popular restaurant in the DC/Baltimore area (DMV) known for authentic, modern West African street food, especially Suya (spicy marinated grilled meats/seafood) and flavorful dishes like Jollof Rice, Efo Riro (spinach stew), and Spice Honey Wings, aiming to celebrate West African culture and connect community through bold, accessible cuisine.
What it offers:

Signature Dishes: Chicken Suya, Lamb Chop Suya, Salmon Suya, Shrimp Suya, Spice Honey Wings, Asun Goat Egg Rolls, and tender Spice Honey Ribs.
Sides: Famous Jollof Rice, Fried Plantains, and Spinach (Efo Riro).
Drinks: Refreshing options like Zobo (hibiscus) Lemonade and Mango Passionfruit Lemonade.
Concept: Blends fast-casual style with traditional West African flavors, offering comfort food, quick bites, and family-friendly options.

Key Points:

Owner: Olumide Shokubi, a Nigerian-American, started it from a ghost kitchen to introduce his culture's food.
Locations: Has physical spots in Hyattsville, MD, and Baltimore, MD, with pop-ups sometimes appearing in other areas.
Mission: To elevate African cuisine, build community, and educate people about West African flavors.

In essence, Spice Kitchen is a destination for delicious, spice-forward West African food that's both authentic and appealing to a broader audience.
If you're interested in trying it, would you like to know about their specific location in Hyattsville or Baltimore, or perhaps see a sample menu?

This meal was honestly delicious. The suya beef and chicken were well-seasoned, smoky, and full of flavor and had a nice kick to it. You could taste that classic suya seasoning in every bite, and the meat was tender and cooked just right to perfection.

The jollof rice was also rich and flavorful, just how good jollof should be. It wasn’t dry, and it had that familiar taste like it was made in someone’s home. The plantains were sweet, soft, and perfectly fried, which balanced out the spices from the suya and jollof really well. I will definitely come again whenever I am on that side of town.
I see a lot of reviews saying it’s too pricey. The price is completely justified in the quantity and quality of the food in my opinion. The corn is AMAZING. I will definitely be back.

This place is amazing! The staff was very friendly and their food was delicious. The original spice level was perfect for me. I also love that they use self-service kiosks and don’t ask for tips. The menu pricing clearly reflects equitable pay for the staff, which I really appreciate and am happy to support. On top of that, the portion sizes are generous. I can’t wait to go back and try their other entrees. Highly recommend.

reviews.text:
YO, BALTIMORE—DROP EVERYTHING AND RUN TO PAPARAZZI GRILL ON PARK HEIGHTS AVE RIGHT NOW!!! 😱🇳🇬 This place is straight-up THE BEST-KEPT NAIJA SECRET in the whole city—authentic West African fire that will RUIN all other food for you!!! Baltimore, we NEEDED this gem!!! 🌟🌟🌟 #JollofKings #NaijaFire #BaltimoreEats #WestAfricanBmore #PaparazziGrillOrBust #FoodgasmAlert 🍴🇳🇬💯
