We started with the sambusa, one of each flavor and although they were all delicious the lentil was the favorite! The meat platter was the perfect amount for our table of four, but the food was so good we kept ordering more. If you want authentic cuisine definitely come by, but be prepared to possibly wait on a weekend night as table space is limited and demand is high!

My My where do I begin, I absolutely enjoyed my experience dining at this restaurant, the food is impeccable and amongst some of my most desired! This Family inspired establishment deserves to be recognized in the Carolinas! Guys, pay a visit and dive into this deliciousness!!

As an Ethiopian, I can say the food has the real, authentic taste. The portion was generous, the price was fair, and the flavor was just right. The service was kind and attentive, and the place had a warm, welcoming feel. Highly recommend for anyone looking for true Ethiopian cuisine!

This was our first time trying Ethiopian food, and it was all amazing! The cashier was super helpful in helping us decide what sides to get with the meat platter. The green beans were delicious. We will definitely be back!

formatted_address: 1115 N Brevard St Enat Ethiopian, Charlotte, NC 28206, United States
name: Enat Ethiopian - Optimist Hall

reviews.text: I’ve been to Optimist Hall several times, but this was my first time trying Enat. I will definitely be back, it’s the best Ethiopian that I’ve had in the Charlotte area. Flavors are amazing and the portion sizes match the pricing.

This was such a good dish! We got the large plate that has a few different options on it (beef, lamb, chicken, etc.). We shared it between 3 people and it was more than enough. You can probably share it between 4 people to be honest. Note that some of the stuff is pretty spicy!

If you’re looking for an Ethiopian restaurant, you’re in for a treat! They offer gluten-free Injera made with teff, which is a fantastic option. The staff is super friendly and really knowledgeable about the menu, so feel free to let them know you want the 100% Injera made with teff. Plus, there’s a delicious vegan option available right on the menu.
Enjoy your meal!

This is my 2nd time trying Ethiopian food. I ordered Lamb Tips with pea split and beans and carrots as sides. All of them taste great! The size is decent too. I will definitely go back and try other food there
Enat is simply an authentic Ethiopian staple in Charlotte. The food is warm, fresh, and delicious ALL THE TIME! Keep up the great work Enat 💪🏾🏁

formatted_address: 3007 Central Ave, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Abugida Ethiopian Cafe & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Great injera! Great honey wine!
And some of the best Fitfit I have ever had. Often people don’t spice their fitfit correctly, and this was spiced perfectly. They also chopped up bits of injera in their Fitfit, and I’ve not always seen that.

The food is outstanding! We have eaten a lot of authentic Ethiopian food, and I always judge the quality of the restaurant by their injera. And I’m always hoping that they have some sort of honey wine, whether it is homemade or it is tej.
We had the Abugida Feast, which included chicken or beef and all of the veggies. It was plenty of food for two people. Although I’m still glad that I got the Fitfit.

The atmosphere was good, a little bit chilly inside, but the plates were very pretty as well as the glassware. The servers were attentive, and the food came out very quickly.

The staff was excellent with explaining the menu & asking if we will be eating off the same dish. The food displayed beautifully and tasted great. I wish there were better options on the drinks  such as traditional iced sweet tea or fountain drink soda for refills vs. the can. The restaurant was cozy. The unisex restroom was clean. We ended up parking in the parking lot beside the  business instead of in back. We will be back.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in Charlotte, and certainly the best authentic Ethiopian restaurant. I have been a frequent customer for a few years. I’ve never had an unpleasant experience. The staff is very friendly, and the restaurant is very well kept.

The chicken, beef and lamb tibs dishes here are all great but I lean toward the lamb.

This is a different kind of experience as you eat your meal with the bread that's served. There are plenty of vegetarian options for those looking for that.

The wine and coffee available here are also very good.

The food was pretty good. Not the greatest. Tried the non-veg platter. The Doro wet was great. The service was good.
Loved the experience with the coffee. The ambience is okay. The restrooms are pretty neat. A quick stop to have some decent Ethiopian food. Price is more on the higher end.

formatted_address: 5020 E Independence Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28212, United States
name: Alhadji Spicy Suya Food Truck

reviews.text: Heard the suya from this place was bomb. I decided to have the frozen suya shipped to me since I’m out of state. Website promises 1 day processing and fast shipping but that’s not true. It’s been almost a month and I still haven’t received my order. I called and emailed seller multiple times and have not heard back from him yet. Thank goodness I ordered through PayPal so I can get a refund. Will not be doing business with them again.

I called to place the order drove 20minute to the wrong location,
Called and got the right adress. Went to pick up and was giving 3 pieces of chicken barely 10 suya and fried plantain for $47! And the food was too salty
Will never eat again

I’ve been wanting to try Suya since I came across this type of food on youtube & I had the  pleasure of my Uber eats driver to go grab me some from here on yesterday and all I can say is 10/10 I got the jollof rice & the beef suya spicy & omg delicious!!!
They have a number but they never answer or call back. Terrible
First time having this food last night after Safari lounge. This was so good. I will be back for the beef suya, rice and plantains!!!

formatted_address: 4808 Central Ave, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Queen Sheba Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar in Charlotte

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Wow — what a beautiful experience at Community Kitchen Cafe! The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with love. You can taste the care in every bite. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff made you feel right at home. This place is more than just a cafe — it’s a true gem in the community. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

Very very delicious! This was my first time eating Ethiopian food. I loved it! I tasted so many new flavors. Everyone was very kind to me. The chef was great!!! He taught me how to eat Ethiopian bread with my hands, as it's a different culture than my own, since I'm from Cuba. I give it 5 stars. I'll be back.

This restaurant is under new management. The Ethiopian cuisine is fantastic. The Awase and legaTibs plate was huge, and the beef was tender and perfectly seasoned. We also had the Vegetable Combo plate, and everything was excellent. The cabbage dish was my favorite. We ended the meal with traditional Ethiopian coffee. I highly recommend Queen Sheba Restaurant.

One of the best unique experiences in Charlotte. The food is great, definitely try the avocado salad, a unique item many Ethiopian restaurants do not make in this specific manner. In addition they do Ethiopian coffee ceremony another very special experience rarely seem in the USA. The owners are good people that treat you like you are in their house.
Amazing coffee ☕️ food was a delicious vegetarian option.

formatted_address: 3113 N Sharon Amity Rd, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Nile Ethiopian Restaurant LLC, DBA Nile Grocery and Cafe

reviews.text: This is a very small place but has some of the best Ethiopian food in Charlotte. We did not plan going there but just ended up as the place we wanted to go was super crowded. The sega wot was just amazing. Tasted like home made food. She was really friendly and helpful. There is a small area dedicated for some Ethiopian grocery items. You can also get some cute crockery’s there. Injera is available as well.
Excellent food and friendly staff.  Best Ethiopian food outside of Addis!

I got the vegetarian sampler plate. To preface, this was my first time having ethiopian food.

I would say the food was pretty good, but to me, I thought it could be a little more flavorful/spicy.

We also had to wait around an hour to get our food, and one of the dishes was not prepared so they replaced it with a repeat of another dish.

Our server was so kind and completely helpful though. In fact, everyone there was so helpful and accommodating.

She even brought out another dish because we were missing one. I don’t know the name of it but it was honestly the best one. I’ve attached a picture of it though. It’s the bright orange side dish.

Nile was simply lovely. You walk in and the dining room is to your right. We went on a Saturday evening and it was empty, super peaceful. We ordered the veggie platter, beef tibs, Doro Wot, and the tea. Everything is delicious. The beef tibs were seasoned and very flavorful. Doro Wot had a good spice level, also very flavorful and I loved that it came with a boiled egg. And to finish the meal, the tea is a must. It was really nice to enjoy an empty restaurant, sipping on our tea. The owner also treated us with so much motherly love, I felt like I was at a home with the treatment she gave us. She served the Tibs and Doro Wot on the veggie platter for us, taught us how to properly enjoy the food. She also packed our leftovers for us which she absolutely did not have to do. I’d highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy some real good home-y food.

The food was amazing! We will definitely come back my husband and I drove two hours to get to this location the food was homemade the Injera bread was so soft and light the vegetables OMG! I can’t even explain the flavors.  I remember corn,collard greens, and some other type of veggie stews, it was amazing! We started with coffee with no sugar it was quite tasty but of course all coffee with no sugar you know it’s bitter, but it was amazing as well the tea I cannot even explain so many flavors! We will definitely be back thank you for the hospitality and the great food. This location also has a different variety of items from popcorn kernels, grains, to home decor definitely a one stop shop amazing people great customer service. Great Prices! We ordered the veggie platter and Beef Tibs.

formatted_address: 4301 Monroe Rd, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Red Sea Ethiopian and Eritrean Cuisine

reviews.text: Great food. Pricey, so i got an appetizer. Delicious.  If you've never had Ethiopian food it may be odd to you just without silverware etc. Just a heads up. Great service and great food. They have pool tables in the back room too, that's kinda fun.

I've been going to Red Sea for years on and off, I would recommend it, it's fantastic but the service is subpar and confusing... Every time I go there, they're confused about my pickup order.... this is going to sound weird but sometimes, some of their food is bland like the lamb chops had zero seasoning very surprising... And there is zero presentation to their food but it does taste good I would probably rate it like a 5.94 out of 10...🤷🏽‍♀️. It could be better... it's just okay.

Came here for the first time today, it’s sensational! My friend and I split the veggie platter and the lentil sambusa because I am vegetarian, and it was so delicious and so much food that we took a to go box as well. Mella, the girl who served us, was so kind and attentive! It’s a beautiful restaurant as well with lots of art and very clean. You should go here for sure!
Food was banging I love to eat with my hands every now and then and this is the spot to some to

The service was great, nice people. I think it was the owner who went around the store greeting the guests. My only complaint is that the rice was soggy to me which when you add the stew to it, it makes me more wet. Plus, I wanted it spicy and didn't get it spicy. Next time I'll ask to have the stew separated from the rice. The sambusas was delicious though

formatted_address: 420 Buford Wy, Mt Holly, NC 28120, United States
name: Adepa's Kitchen

reviews.text: The food was absolutely delicious and truly a hit with everyone at our event! Everything was well-prepared, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. We received so many compliments from our guests. I will definitely be ordering again and highly recommend their catering services.

i got yam, tsofie, & fried rice. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, flavorful, and prepared with so much care. On top of that, the owner was incredibly nice and welcoming. Definitely a spot worth coming back to!

I saw Adepa’s Kitchen on Google and I am a Ghanaian so even from the pictures and videos I could tell that’s a real authentic Ghanaian foods and not one of the “wannabes” so i took a short trip from Charlotte to Mount Holly with my mom to get the Yam And Chofi and Babyyy that was worth the one hour trip we did. From the flavorful Chofi to the perfect crispy yam to three different sauces( brown sauce, green sauce and red sauce) and all tasty too. Let’s just say I am going to go back until I have tried everything and oh both her and her husband are so welcoming and so sweet.  And I will recommend you order ahead so that by the time you get there your food will be done and ready. Thank you Adepa’s Kitchen.

We stumbled upon Adepa’s Kitchen while in town for our family reunion, looking for something different to eat and they popped up at just the right time. It turned out to be the hidden gem we didn’t know we needed.

From the very first bite, the food absolutely blew us away. Every dish was full of rich, authentic flavor and clearly made with love. But what truly made the experience unforgettable wasn’t just the amazing food it was the spirit of the people making it. The team at Adela’s Kitchen radiates warmth, joy, and genuine care, and you can taste that in every bite.

The interaction and disposition of the staff made us feel right at home, and it became instantly clear why their food is so good: it’s made by people who truly love what they do.

We wholeheartedly recommend Adepa’s Kitchen to anyone in the area. If you haven’t tried it yet, make it a priority you’re not just getting a great meal, you’re getting a piece of their heart and soul on a plate.

We are here from NY and possibly will make the move to NC just to continue having the good lol.
Adepa never disappoints. The food is always fresh and delicious. Ordered through DoorDash and was a seamless experience

formatted_address: 320 W Carson Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28203, United States
name: Suya king food truck

reviews.text: This is a food truck uptown, Charlotte! I ordered the wings, the fried sweet plantains, and African jollof rice  All the food was just extremely delicious. But please bear in mind that they are not whole wings they’re halfling so I only receive six wings and not 12 however this is an excellent place to Splurge on because it’s authentic! Cook, fresh and delicious. Some thought that I was not African, but I can cook African food very well! This spot is a great treat. I’m not a big fan of partying Amen ( from patron buying food at the location). However I enjoy the food very much, and will definitely visit and buy again! Thank you to all the staff.
Unfortunately, I can’t provide feedback on the service or atmosphere as I ordered through Uber Eats. I placed two orders of suya, and I must say it met my expectations and satisfied my suya cravings.
The food is so good the flavor the seasoning the easy it's cooked is perfection. Customer service is good as well.

I had this & immediately wished I had ordered 2 plates ! Because half of it was gone in the car & by time I got home I needed more !! It was so good I had jerk chicken with jollof rice ! 10/10 I will be back & I will be recommending thank you !
Great flavor. Will definitely be back. Wings were my favorite.

formatted_address: 3720 N Tryon St, Charlotte, NC 28206, United States
name: DK African Restaurant

formatted_address: 6024 The Plaza, Charlotte, NC 28215, United States
name: Somie’s Bar & Kitchen

reviews.text: My boyfriend said enjoyed the food, the menu was very easy to understand especially if you're a lover of trying all kinds of foods from any ethnicity. This place is nice looking inside and clean. Staff makes you feel very welcome and doesn't rush you at all. We ate lunch here and I must say I can NOT complain about anything 😍😍😍😍

I’ve been here a few times and the food is always fresh and hot.

Edit: I hadn’t eaten here in a while and decided to place an Ubereats order. I ordered egusi soup and pounded yam, and to my surprise, the quality of food has gone down DRASTICALLY. My initial review is from a year ago, so I know what quality to expect. The portion of food I received wasn’t enough for a child, yet I was charged nearly $20. I was also charged extra for goat meat and received all bones!!! I was livid, but wanted to give them an opportunity to make things right.

I called the restaurant and spoke with Kenric, who advised he would reach out to the owner. I took pictures of my meal and sent them to the email address he provided. Long story short, the cook told Kenric that they’d actually put extra meat in my soup (a complete joke!!!), and the owner said he’d put extra meat in my food the next time I ordered. No offer to remake my food or partially refund my order.

Judging by the reviews, my experience is not unique. They’d better make some changes before no one wants to eat here. I certainly won’t be back. I attached pictures of my food so we ALL can see that there was no meat in my soup, and how tiny the bowl is. If you don’t want to be cheated out of your money, try Royal African Cuisine. The food is priced about the same and the portions are way bigger.

I just ordered Okro soup and pounded yam from here and couldn’t even eat more than 2 bites. This soup is so disgusting and tastes old or spoiled. The pounded yam was burnt or old and re warmed. I would not recommend ordering from this restaurant… I’ll stick to Samoha African Cuisine !

First time trying Authentic African food and it did NOT disappoint!
Cashier was extremely helpful, I went with family and he let us try a sample before we ordered as well as answer all our questions (and there was a lot).

Went last week and already been back multiple times definitely recommend!

Pictured: Egusi Soup & chicken w/ Fufu , Pineapple Jamaican Sof Drink

I ordered food here around christmas time, kept the food in the fridge so we'd have food on christmas day and the food was good. Today, I visited here with a friend around 5pm. He got his food and walked out without looking at it. When he got home, he called me and said OMG did you say this place was better than samoha it can't be. I said what happened? He said the food was old and stale. I asked him to send me a pic and he did. I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw it. When I called to complain to the owner she was extremely rude and almost screaming ontop of her lungs. It's simple - apologize and make up for it but no. She then put me on hold for almost ten minutes, got back on the phone and started arguing with me. It was so bizzare to get such a reaction. She didn't even say bring the food back, let me see nope. Just rude, combative and obviously lacking any customer service skills whatsoever. Shameful. I've included a pic of the food. Even the plantain looks old and stale. My friend said it was the worst experience he ever had at a restaurant here in Charlotte and he was better off going to jack in the box. I'll also be posting about my experience on my blog. Never again.

Edit to add: I just read the comments left under my post. This owner isn't only unethical, she's a liar. I paid for the food with my own money. Again, I paid for the food. I drove my friend to this restaurant when this happened. It does NOT matter whether HE paid for the food or not. What matters is the food left a lot to be desired. It was absolutely awful.

formatted_address: 5622 E Independence Blvd #129, Charlotte, NC 28212, United States
name: The Cooking Pot- African kitchen

reviews.text: Long but necessary! I first want to start by saying had I trusted the previous reviews I would have truly missed out on the most authentic African food Charlotte has to offer. I had my very first taste of Egusi and fufu here with the Jollaf rice and I can truthfully say in my experience there is NOT another African restaurant that compares. My food is always fresh and hot. I have enough to get full and still take home leftovers. I am truly hooked on this place. On days the cooking pot was closed I tried other African restaurants and never received the same quality of food, service or consideration. I now wait until they are open, no exceptions. People go where they feel welcomed but stay where they feel valued and let me tell you,  I have received nothing but great service every visit. She even remembers my order and that I do not like meat. She challenges me to try other dishes and have really opened my palates, and as a pickey eater. That’s talent!! You can literally taste the love in every dish and that’s what makes this place so special. I do not leave reviews often but there is a disservice being done here as I read through some of the reviews. I absolutely love everything about this place and if your looking to try good African food, consider forming your own opinion from your own experience.

I really want to give this place 5 stars; however the food quality is hit or miss and I absolutely love authentic African food. The Moi Moi (grounded and seasoned to perfection black-eyed peas) is my absolute favorite thing to get here. When it comes to the chicken- it has never seemed like fresh chicken as it is always fried extremely hard and then sauced, it seems like day old chicken. The jollof rice is good; however I wish that they would make a milder version so those who can’t tolerate spice that well can enjoy or at least try it out too.

Everything looks delicious from the photo but the chicken was a miss. The moi moi didn’t disappoint.

Update in response: I’ve actually frequented several African restaurants and this restaurant several times and depending on time of day of arrival the food consistency differs. I wouldn’t have left a review stating my thoughts if I had only visited once or twice. African food is one of my absolute favorites as it intertwines closely with Gullah cuisine. I’m not saying based on this review that I’ll never visit again, it’s just the quality has not been consistent on the times that I’ve been. Again the Moi Moi, has never disappointed me.

Now wonder they been closed down for almost 3 months....Rude customer service and miserable staff how is this even a business... must be a joke the lady working behind the counter yelled at me and told me that i couldn't talk to anyone in the store after I purchased my food and told me I was not allowed back into the store because I was talking with another customer about the experience I encountered with being shorted on a party jollof rice I ordered. I ordered a party jollof and plantains and was only served 2 spoons of rice. But wanted to give me gravy for free I did NOT request for gravy I requested for rice!  lol if that the case why notú charge me for the gravy instead of UNDER portioning me on the rice that I paid for. Under portioning and rude and I wouldn't advise any one to eat here! The police was called out because she refused to refund me and made me pay for my food before serving me and they advise me to file a claim through the BBB & file a claim through my bank which im going to do ! U were yelling at me I wasn't yelling at all  I was calm until the police came ! I was never escorted out by the police ! I even sat outside to file a claim ! All of your reviews say the same thing UNDER portion and rude SCAM ! U won't be open long and GOD don't like ugly u will see ! U are a compulsive liar all ur customers can't be lying it's literally repetitive complaints about your restaurant

This is what you get for $30, a spoonful of egusi with fufu & side of jollof rice that tasted burnt. I walked into the restaurant and asked for a menu, was told they dont have menus and then she proceeded to ask me what i want. First red flag. You would think with charging this amount of money for these tiny portions you would at least receive good service or something that would make you feel like what you just paid for was worth it but that wasnt the case. I rarely ever write reviews but this was not a good experience overall. And from the looks of the responses of these other reviews on here, this business doesnt seem to take accountability or know how to provide customer service.

The pictures are before anything was eaten. On the left is how the food came & was presented to me. On the right, i scraped some egusi to the side so you can see the depth & actual amount that was given.
The food was amazing if you don't like spicy beware, I got the egusi soup with chicken and beef with pounded yam. They gave me some nut thingy they sweet kinda than very spicy. Plantains are amazing.

formatted_address: 2200 Thrift Rd, Charlotte, NC 28208, United States
name: DK Malewa Congolese Cuisine

reviews.text: I ordered from this restaurant through Uber eats. I would give more than 5 stars if I could. It was so good. I called the restaurant to ask questions and the multilingual gentleman was super polite and helpful. Bonne continuation!

I ordered Cassava leaf and they gave me chopped up collard greens and they were dry. Fufu tasted old. Very disappointed especially coming from Philadelphia and eating cassava. Waste of money. I do not recommend going there.
Excellence!!! If you really want to discover how good Congolese cuisine taste like? Give it a try ! You will ask for a membership 🤣🤣🤣
The food is delicious.
Love the place and food 😋

formatted_address: 1902b W Roosevelt Blvd, Monroe, NC 28110, United States
name: Samoha African Cuisine - Monroe

reviews.text: Long overdue review. Visited Oct 2022. Enjoyed trying several things by sharing two orders with my wife. Fish and oxtails were delicious. Had my first Vita Malt - not my favorite but fun to try!

What a great authentic restaurant!!! The Cuban Sandwich was divine. As were the fresh made empanadas. They offer a cafeteria style food bar with several choices of meats, rice, beans and sides. Tamales were EXCELLENTE!

I’ve been craving fufu for the longest and checking this location for a min lol. And everytime I came to Monroe they would always be closed and today I finally got it and I loved it.!! I’m used to ordering pepper soup but the guy there told me what everything was so I tried something new😇 great place to eat from hot n ready there’s no wait very welcoming also.!!
I wasn't impressed. I love African cuisine, and Jamaican. But this did not do it for me. My food tasted like it was cooked days before.

Okay, I went the first time. Food was good. So I decided to go back with my kids.  Lord the Abula with ewedu was made fresh , I drove by 20 minutes home and lord the food was hot and delicious.  All I can say bi say I nearly bite my tongue commot for my mouth.  The children ordered Okra and Egusi.   And let me put am dis way.  No sound out of them till dem finish their food.  Please support this store.  It’s not always going to be perfect.  But the food will not disappoint ❤️❤️❤️

formatted_address: 9640 S Tryon St unit k, Charlotte, NC 28273, United States
name: Afro caribbean soul food & catering

reviews.text: I cannot comment on service or atmosphere as I had my food delivered but every single item I ordered was AMAZING!!! Large portions and so reasonably priced! The pork chops, collards, rice and Mac and cheese were all very good but the cabbage is the absolute best!!!!
Ordered an 8 piece chicken. Waited 3 hours and there was 3 pieces in the bag and it was soggy with the skin falling off. Awful food and service don’t go to this place unless you want to get scammed.
told me to cancel order even though they weren’t even locked yet
Excellent

formatted_address: 214 N College St, Charlotte, NC 28202, United States
name: Mert's Heart And Soul

reviews.text: Had our anniversary dinner 11/4 and everything we ordered was delicious. Highly recommend the soul rolls, salmon cakes and fried green tomatoes. We had the seafood platter and shrimp with grits entrees. So good and will be back before our next anniversary. Deondre was our kind, polite, fun and hard working server. Definitely made our first visit here memorable. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

The first time I was introduced to Mertz Cafe was back in 1996. I’ve talked about it ever since. Finally I’ve got the chance to revisit when my daughters and I took a girl’s weekend trip to see Wicked (10/24/25) When I tell you nothing changed about Mertz. I mean nothing! The atmosphere was top tier! The service was impeccable. The food….oh man…the food was awesome! So many restaurants would have changed after that amount of time has passed. Definitely won’t be staying away for that long again😂

My friend recommended this place to me for some “good soul food” while I was visiting from New Jersey. This was the best soul food I’ve ever had, and one of my favorite meals. The food came out quickly but home cooked and steaming hot. I got the fried chicken tenders, yams, mac ‘n cheese, and it comes with cornbread with some sweet butter. The chicken was seasoned perfectly, the mac was perfectly cheesy without being too much, and the yams were sweet, soft, and refreshing. The prices were great for the amount of food you receive. Additionally, my server Kashima was extremely kind, informative, and attentive. I highly recommend you don’t miss this spot when you’re in Charlotte!
We were looking for a great spot that served collard greens and fried chicken. This spot was recommended and boy it did not disappoint. Such a simple, delicious and not over done type of joint.

The host was rude. I ordered my food online at 3:36p and got there at 4:25p to pick it up. It wasn’t ready and the host got an attitude when I asked why it wasn’t ready when I ordered it almost an hr ago. He said they didn’t get it until 4:05p and they “don’t control when the orders come in”.

Then after waiting an additional 25 minutes; the food was bad. They gave me a burnt chicken wing which honestly should’ve been thrown out not served to a customer. I spent $26 for this horrible food and poor customer service. I wouldn’t recommend this place to my worst enemy.

formatted_address: 601 S Tryon St Suite A137, Charlotte, NC 28202, United States
name: Oh My Soul On The Moo’ve

reviews.text:
I was really impressed with the food selection and ended up visiting twice. On my first visit, I tried the burger with onion rings—the burger was decent, and the onion rings were great. I also had the peach drink during this visit, but it wasn’t very flavorful, so I wouldn’t order it again.
On my second visit, I had the cauliflower bowl with added protein, which ended up being my favorite dish. I also ordered the banana bread latte; while it was decent, it didn’t stand out as I was expecting to taste some banana flavour. I would also say that the pricing overall is on the higher side.
The young woman at the front was wonderful—kind, welcoming, and provided excellent service. The staff overall were attentive and regularly checked in to see how I was doing, including two of the male staff members. it was cozy, quiet, and had interesting decorations, which made for a pleasant experience.
The only challenges I encountered were that some items I wanted to try were unavailable, which was disappointing. I was also very disappointed with the blondie (white brownie). It was extremely stale and hard—even after microwaving it—and nearly impossible to bite into! It was definitely not made fresh.

Grateful for this fully vegan cafe! We really liked the S.A. Spicy Macaroni Salad and Banana Bread (which reminded us of french toast) but we could’ve done without the Howzit Boet Wrap. For the wrap (and most of the food I think), it was not made-to-order. They took it from the prepared food section and heated it up for us as we requested.

So excited to have this new vegan option in Downtown Charlotte.
For my first visit I tried the Sausage Roll. Easy to find in the Ally building. I walked in and was helped immediately.
Side sample of a corn salad was delicious as I waited for my order. But I didn't have to wait long, my pastry was handed to my promptly.
I stayed to look at some of there assortment of snack items and grab and go sandwiches. I'll be back to try more.

The sausage roll pastry was fresh, flaky and savory. Comes with a side of sweet acidic chutney. Compliments the item well.

Nice,cozy environment that is suitable for a small meet up with 1 or 2 people. Coffee shop vibes.
I really loved the atmosphere staff was super friendly, and very informative about all the options they had.will definitely be back tomorrow!

Sometimes I get the craving for a big bowl of roasted veggies, and I usually get my fix from Oh My Soul in Noda. However, the craving hit on a Monday this time and OMS wasn’t open. To my luck, I found their sister restaurant OMS On the Moo’ve in downtown was open for delivery! I had the Mama Africa Bowl and now I am happy and full :)

formatted_address: 3424 Wilkinson Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28208, United States
name: Toubaafrogrill

reviews.text: Abu works hard on making his food appeal to all customers. The signature dish, the Afro Burger, is full of fresh ingredients and amazing flavor. I am pleased and looking forward to another. I hope his Senegal flavor will turn into a restaurant as well someday.
They are too good and delicious 🤤 I can't wait to buy again 😋🤤❤️
Very good food
They sell very delicious food and it's safe😋

formatted_address: 3052 Eastway Dr, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Royal African Cuisine

reviews.text: The rich flavors and authentic recipes transport me back to my roots with every bite. From the jollof rice that has the perfect balance of spices to the tender, flavorful meats and delicious stews, every dish feels like a warm embrace. The ambiance of the restaurant adds to the experience, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal with family and friends. i highly recommend trying their egusi soup paired with pounded yam or fufu it's simply divine, Royal African Cuisine on Eastway Charlotte is a must-visit.

Located in the shopping center with a lot of stuff that tends to get overlooked. We were allowed to sit wherever we wanted. Went to use sanitizer at table realized it was soap not sanitizer at table. I guess it was there maybe as it's customary to wash your hands at the table?Went to bathroom but women's bathroom was out of order. Clean bathrooms but dirty walls/doors... Ordering was super weird but server was super helpful. We were told we weren't allowed to share? Apparently per management cuz of extra dishes?! We ordered the Agusi Soup, the red sauce was earthy and really smokey it was good with the fish all put together. The tripe had great flavor more spices and heat than the soup but the tripe could've been softer but not bopping in all. Goat was gamier than expected tomato based sauce good simple provided some balance. The brown sauce I swear tasted like it had oyster or fish sauce in it? The yam had some fried yam pieces drier than others good flavor not sweet goat with skin kinda greasy. Overall worth trying but probably not my type of flavor profiles.

Do not go here this was the worst egusi soup I have had in my life , it was dry and gritty. The tripe is under cookies or over cooked I’m not sure. The food itself taste like the bottom of a burnt pan. The whole meal tastes burnt. I spent 43 dollars on this! Ew I’m very disgusted PLEASE AVOID GOING HERE. IM UPSET BECAUSE IM VERY VERY HUNGRY!

I am Jamaican and wanted to try another cuisine, and this was it! I was so hungry to eat all this food, I forgot to take pics of the whole food items I bought. The food was so delicious, I rarely eat out and I am telling you, I truly enjoyed the meal!

One point I will touch on is that, they truly need to do some upgrading on the dining furnitures. I wouldn’t want to wear a nice dress and have it torn on one the seats. I noticed in one corner of the table upfront had a notice that said reserved but seems as if someone may have been sleeping there. They were clothing items among a couple of balls which were underneath a table with a travel bag on the floor. Did turn me off a bit, which I noticed after ordering the food. I didn’t want to speculate so I got my food and left. It was just a sight for soar eyes is all I am saying, overall the food was good. I totally enjoyed it. I will get the okra soup next time with fufu.

I used Uber Eats to order Okra Soup with pounded yam, tripe, mackerel, and vegetable spring rolls. I love okra. It was filling and a was plenty for lunch and dinner on a long day with work. Would possibly dine in to be able to ask questions about specific menu items. Was a little pricey for just two items, one being soup (over $35).

formatted_address: 8927 J M Keynes Dr suite 100, Charlotte, NC 28262, United States
name: Sol'Delish CLT Restaurant

reviews.text:
I came here at 9:05pm on a Saturday night with my friend. The first observation was that the interior is small. Our Waitress was Lee.

We ordered “berry blast” and “giving me the blues” at 9:08pm. We ordered food at 9:12pm. We got salmon bites for appetizer. My friend got 2 bakes turkey wings with rice and seafood Mac. I got the 3 friend wings.

Berry blast was delicious! I think our waitress made our drinks.

9:24pm is when salmon bites arrived. Food came at 9:39pm. We also got corn bread.  The Food was DELICIOUS and fresh! Music was great! My friend was visiting from out of state and I was visiting from another part of NC. We were in the area for pride events. We both desire to return! We didn’t have a single complaint regarding the food. Highly recommend!

Also, I believe someone told me that they were moving locations to a bigger spot, which would be great!

The customer service was good. I was greeted very well. I gave four stars because, I asked to sample the mac & cheese, the young lady, said okay. I was there waiting on my food, for over 30 mins. I wanted to taste it because i was considering, ordering another item. I told her this. Instead, she just quoted me a crazy price. I even said, my meal is already 33.00. I would be paying another 7.00 for something, I can't sample. If she couldn't give me a sample, just say say, i'm sorry, I can't offer you a sample. Just don't leave me, sitting there, with my mouth watering. Especially, after I told you, I would leave you guys a review. Well, here is my honest review. Jump off the wagon, and do the righteous thing. Resturants, needs the cosumer's, but the cosumer's in all honesty, DO NOT, need the resturant industry. Thanks for your service

Ordered the salmon nuggets, crab cakes, greens, broccoli, yellow rice, jerk turkey wings and the Parmesan garlic turkey wings. Sides were good 9/10. Crab cakes 10/10 and full of fresh crab meat. Parmesan garlic wings were great too. Only thing jerk wings could have had a little more spice. Will be back 👍🏽 $88 for all of this, nice size portions.

5 stars for the Business Sense to keep both locations and make one a Take Out ONLY and dine in at the Boardwalk. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

3 stars for the food.
❤️❤️I wish they'd place liquid foods in a separate container.
⚜️I got the Turkey Wing as so many raved about it and the issue: the meat didn't taste seasoned nor drained to the bone. It's baked so an overnight seasoning so things can macerate isn't asking for much but their recipe/style relies on the garlic Parmesan on top (since that's the one I ordered). Maybe the other offerings like Jerk have been seasoned so you can enjoy all of item. ⭐⭐⭐

I appreciate the Kale and Collard Greens offering. Now, they were in a well seasoned spice-a-rific POT LIQUOR. However, collards are tough on their own so a longer cook down would have been wholly appreciated by me. Nonetheless, I'd totally order again and just hook up at home. This is the healthier version so you don't cook away all the vitamins as slow stewing/slow cooking can do.

My folks got the whiting. I wish they had more grilled options for fish. Why? My family enjoys whole fish grilled.

The delight on their plates was the fries for me. Often, Togo fries can be a gut punch of limp and cold. Not these seasoned fries. I'd totally recommend. 5 ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

P.S. You can not order any breakfast "brunch" sides at the Tryon location. I asked for a side of grits and learned quickly. I'm figuring they don't offer any brunch items per the cashier's statement but the menu posted on Instagram should denote that. Why? To avoid confusion and manage expectations BECAUSE I spent a good amount of time asking family if they wanted fish and grits or chicken and waffle.

P.P.S. there's no seating here. They'll call when the order is ready which was a lovely and needed gesture. It was offered without me having to ask.

‼️In all, I hope they continue to grow and expand on what they can do best.

Pictures of 2 of 3 plates.

The service was fast. Love the atmosphere. Not very spacious but great ambiance. I enjoyed the drinks. Bartender did a great job. I would recommend and I do plan to return next time I am in town. The fried fish was so good along with the yams. Mac n cheese was okay just a little different for me. I LOVE the collards😋

formatted_address: 5630 N Graham St, Charlotte, NC 28269, United States
name: Rasin Haitian restaurant

reviews.text: I genuinely always enjoy my food when I go there. I love my Haitian peoples and the food. It's always a nice environment and very pleasant customer service. Thank you for not permanently, closing. See you again sometime soon. 10 out of 10 always will recommend. I was so happy when I walked in, and I seen that they had Crémas and they are not shy with the alcohol.

Amazing delicious food!! The food is fresh and made to order. My go to order is stewed chicken with Djon Djon rice and green plantains with a cup of their soursop lemonade!! I’ve been a regular for about a year!!!

I’ve recently came here earlier Sunday Afternoon, 6/29, & drove at least 3 1/2 Hours from Wilmington NC to eat some Authentic Haitian Food. I’ve found out about Rasin Haitian Restaurant through Google. I understand that this was a Small Business, I wasn’t greeted immediately when I first walk in, & didn’t know what to expect. But, as soon as I’ve placed my Order to the Sweet, Friendly Young Lady at the Counter, all of my unsuspecting thoughts shifted away. I was concerned about whether had enough Tables to sit, since it was a smaller place. But, there was more than enough Tables to dine in. The Owners/Staff treated us with Super, Warm Hospitality. Also, their Food was the best that I’ve ever eaten since I’ve visited Fort Lauderdale. Had to wait for a little bit for the Food, but it was worth the wait. The Griot was cooked & seasoned perfectly, the Meat wasn’t fried too hard, Black Rice was great, & the Fried Green Plantain was the best, not too dry. All of the Food had great flavor. Prices were a little bit pricy, but it was reasonable for the quality & quantity of the Food. The Food has very large portions. Thank you, Rasin Haitian Restaurant for creating a great, memorable experience during my Charlotte Road Trip. I’ll give this place a 10/10. It’s great to know that I’ve found a great Haitian Restaurant here in NC. I will definitely return back to this Restaurant, it’s well worth the 3 1/2 Hour Drive. 👍🌴🇭🇹💯

Update: This was my second time visiting this Haitian restaurant, and once again they did not disappoint! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. The seasoning and authentic flavors really stood out, you can tell the food is prepared with care and love. The service was top-notch as usual; the staff was attentive, friendly, and made the whole experience even better. Definitely one of my favorite spots, and I’ll keep coming back whenever I’m craving Haitian food!

Overall, this restaurant continues to impress me. It’s rare to find a place that delivers on both amazing food and excellent service every single time, but they do it effortlessly. I highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys authentic, delicious Haitian cuisine, whether it’s your first time trying it or you’re already a fan, this is the spot to go!

A Hidden Gem for Authentic Haitian Cuisine!
I had the absolute pleasure of dining at this incredible spot recently, and I can’t say enough good things about it. If you’re looking for authentic Haitian food packed with flavor and made with love, this is the place.

We ordered the oxtails with black rice and plantains, along with the stewed chicken, cabbage, and red beans and rice—and every single bite was amazing. The oxtails were perfectly tender and seasoned to perfection, and the black rice had such rich depth of flavor. The stewed chicken was equally delicious—juicy, well-spiced, and comforting, with the cabbage and beans rounding it out beautifully.

We also tried the beef and chicken patties—flaky, savory, and just the right amount of spice. And to top it all off, the passion fruit lemonade was the perfect refreshing finish. It was sweet, tangy, and so refreshing.

The food was fantastic, the service was warm, and the atmosphere was welcoming. This is the kind of place that makes you want to come back again and again. Highly recommend!
Side note: I wish we had taken pictures but we dug right in as soon as we received our order.

🔥 **STOP what you’re doing!!!**🔥 Rasin Haitian Restaurant is THE TRUTH!!! 🙌🏽 They catered my aunt’s 50th birthday and our family reunion in June 2025, and let me tell you… I’m STILL dreaming about that food!! 🤤✨ The flavors? UNMATCHED. The staff? So sweet, professional, and made us feel like family. 🥹💛 Every single dish was fresh, flavorful, and served perfectly on time. If you want Haitian food that’ll have you licking your plate and asking for seconds (and thirds 👀), Rasin is IT. 10/10 highly recommend!!! 🌺🇭🇹

formatted_address: 124 E Brooklyn Vlg Ave, Charlotte, NC 28202, United States
name: Aura

reviews.text:
Cool spot to unwind and relax. Great views of the city while enjoying a cocktail.
Sit at the bar or your own little cabana area. On the 5th floor of the Marriott Hotel. Bartenders were friendly. Also has a pool behind the bar if you’re a guest staying at the hotel. Awesome place to stay of meet up for drinks with friends or coworkers. If you’re visiting charlotte I recommend checking this place out !

I can’t only grade the drinks because we didn’t order and food. This place is such a lovely establishment, perfect to relax and chill in any sunny weather. Just no rain. However THE DRINKS. PERFECT O M G!!!! The DRINKS, whatever you go for, even the non alcoholic drinks are delicious. Will return in the summer or spring actually.. go on a nice 70 outside or even night OMG. It’s inside the JW MARRIOTT, we got lost trying to find the entrance however once we did.. it’s a beautiful place.

Halle was absolutely amazing! She was super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our time drinking there. Her energy and warm personality really made the experience enjoyable. You can tell she genuinely cares about her guests. We’ll definitely be coming back..  thanks to Halle for such great service!

I didn’t have a reservation, but the host was still able to seat me—right around 5 p.m., just as the happy hour crowd was rolling in. Spoiler alert: the rooftop view overlooking the city is absolutely worth it, so I’d recommend making a reservation to secure your spot.

Since this was just a stop before my dinner plans, I kept it light and ordered the spicy guacamole (and yes, it lives up to its name—spicy but so good!) along with the burnt end lollipops (smoked brisket). To sip, I went with a refreshing Charlotte mocktail.

Another perk? During happy hour, all appetizers are $3 off, which makes it the perfect time to sample and share.

What would have been this establishment a five star for me would have been attentiveness and hospitality.

I stayed one night at the JW Marriott Charlotte and had dinner at Aura Rooftop.

I tried two rice bowls—the Salmon and the Wagyu. Both were quite good, but what really stood out was the atmosphere. Even though the rooftop is only on the 5th floor, the vibe was amazing with a stylish and relaxing setting.

Perfect spot to enjoy good food, cocktails, and city views while unwinding. Definitely worth a visit if you’re staying at the hotel or nearby!

-- Recommend to do reservation

name: Mamageesastnight

formatted_address: 4808 Central Ave, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Community Kitchen Cafe Fusion of Ethiopian, Latin & American Cuisine

reviews.text:
Community kitchen cafe ,delivers not only rich, flavorful cuisine but also a warm and personal touch that makes the experience stand out. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was inviting, and it only got better when the owner himself came around to greet us. It's rare these days to find that kind of hospitality, and it really added to the authenticity and charm of the evening.

The food was absolutely delicious – from the perfectly spiced lentils to the tender, flavorful meats, every dish felt like it was made with care. The injera was soft and tangy, exactly how it should be. You can tell there’s pride in the kitchen and a strong connection to tradition.

Whether you're new to Ethiopian cuisine or a longtime fan, is worth a visit. It's the kind of place that makes you feel like a guest, not just a customer. We'll definitely be back!
Community kitchen cafe i love ❤️ 😍 💖 ❣️ 💕 💘 ❤️ 😍  thanks
Community Kitchen is an amazing cafe that works to serve the Charlotte community! The most friendly family owned cafe! The coffee and the food is beyond amazing!
My experience was awesome! The culture and the food was great.
Highly recommend stopping by for a cultural food to go or a sit down meal.
This place is amazing—fresh, delicious food and excellent customer service!

formatted_address: 2109 Avent Ferry Rd #146, Raleigh, NC 27606, United States
name: Nafkot Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text: As big fan of Ethiopian cuisine I decided to check this place out  Raleigh.  Interesting decor, clean restaurant, and Ethiopian music playing as it should be.  The waiter was attentive to begin with but a few periods of longer waits after ordering.  I had the vegetarian medley and it was tasty but rather luke warm in temperature.  The injira was plentiful but the did not serve the food on top of the injira as I am accustomed to and prefer, as it soaks up the flavor to eat at meals end.  I would go again but they could step it up a bit on the food temp and wait.

Our first time eating Ethiopian cuisine after a long time wanting to try. I took my parents here who were visiting and it was 5 stars fantastic! We ate every single bite. Thank you to Angel who was our waitress and answered our questions from the menu to help us decide and gave us great service!! Highly recommend.

First time ever eating Ethiopian food and I believe we picked the best place to try it. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful in choosing our food and explain to us when everything was. Definitely a great place for a vegetarian to go.

Had Ethiopian in every city I’ve lived, and this spot is fantastic. Been here a few times over the years and again today…Still a delicious, calm, mood enhancing experience. I got the veggie combo, baklava, and coffee shot…all got me feeling awesome.

Love the staff too…the owner (I assume, or manager) who’s been here for years, is very kind.
My first time here I was alone and emotional, and this same man saw me crying and gave me free baklava 😭How generous! I’ll always remember that.

TLDR: Great service and high quality eats and experience. I definitely recommend this spot!

My daughter and I love to go here to eat. We tried it once, and we had to go back again. The food is authentic and delicious. She's vegetarian, and it's easy to find menu options that she enjoys. 10 out of 10. I definitely recommend that you try this restaurant.

formatted_address: 832 E 4th St Suite 1352, Charlotte, NC 28202, United States
name: London D's Catering LLC/ London D’s Cafe

html_attributions: London D's Catering LLC/ London D’s Cafe

reviews.author_name: Foodie Queen Best and Worst food I've ever had.
reviews.text: This place doesn't deserve one star. I can't believe that the Courthouse would allow such a low grade establishment to exist in their location. I've been to this place three times and couldn't believe the food being served here. No integrity or quality of the food she's serving here. Simply Horrible!!! I tried to give her constructive criticism to empower her with a discreet an honest conversation about the appearance of her food which was old brunt and dried out. Her gravy had a film on it from sitting there for hours livermush not cooked sausage links brunt and biscuits old brunt and dried out!!!  She started talking loud to me saying oh I can't believe your a Black woman attacking a Black business then she went to get someone to try and escort me out simply because I was being honest. She needs to do better!! The Courthouse needs to replace this business and offer their employees better. I'm sure that the jailhouse food looks and taste better. Those five Star reviews she has must be from her family who  are used to her horrible cooking. There is a restaurant across the street. You be better off spending your money there.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
London D’s is an absolute gem! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and genuine hospitality. The atmosphere is inviting, the food is flavorful and made with love, and the service is top-notch. Every dish I’ve tried has been fresh, delicious, and beautifully prepared. It’s rare to find a place that delivers consistently on quality, flavor, and customer care, but London D’s does it effortlessly. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great meal and an even better experience!

Will not return or recommend this place cafe..period! I was charged 14.00 for a cheeseburger and fries and the only thing was good we’re the fries! I had been at the court house all day and finally got a break for lunch! They kept running out of pork chops call all the court house workers were grabbing them up so I ended up just ordering a cheese burger! It was gross! I try not to down play our people but y’all do better! The 2 guys ahead of me wanted pork chops but they got the meat loaf instead the guy was like yo this is dry and through it away and walked out! Bring the quality back! Back in the day someone else ran this place his food was off the hook!

I had an bacon and egg sandwich, when I got my sandwich it had cheese on it, mind you I didn't ask for cheese nor did I want it. So I returned to the cashier, to tell her that I didn't want cheese on my sandwich and at first she stated that I asked for cheese on the sandwich but I reminded her that at first I wanted an croissant with bacon and egg but they didn't have croissants so I got wheat toast with bacon and egg. Now the price is right but if the customer doesn't want cheese on an sandwich, they should not be charged for cheese.

Ordered through Foodsby at my job. I got the blackened salmon with rice and mac & cheese. Everything was so delicious, I ate too quickly! Seasoned, hot, with that crispy layer on the mac & cheese.
I order through Foodsby when I'm really busy at work and can't leave, and a few times I've received disappointing meals, so it really made my day that London D's delivered such a great lunch. ❤️❤️

formatted_address: 5427 N Sharon Amity Rd, Charlotte, NC 28215, United States
name: Maxwell Catering

reviews.text:
I cannot say enough amazing things about the catering service I received for my birthday party!
From start to finish, everything was absolutely perfect. The food was not only delicious, but also beautifully presented - my guest are still raving about it days later! Chef Lisa created a menu that perfectly matched the theme and vibe of the party.
She took my vision and ran with it, turning it into something even better than I imagined. Every dish was packed with flavor, cooked to perfection, and taste homemade with a gourmet touch. The entire staff was professional, friendly, and incredibly attentive. They made sure everything went smoothly and took all the stress off my plate - literally - so I could relax and truly enjoy my party . We even cut a rug together. 💃🏽              Thank you, Chef Lisa for making my birthday special.
You exceeded every expectation! I highly recommend you for any event where incredible food is top-tier.I not only have a cater for life - I have a friend for life. I love you, Chef Lisa!

Lisa and Maxwell Catering exceeded our expectations in every way. From our very first tasting, we were impressed by their professionalism, attention to detail, and the delicious variety of dishes they offered. They walked us through the menu planning process with patience, making sure every guest — and vendor — was covered. In the week leading up to the wedding, they double-checked all final counts, ensuring nothing was overlooked. On the day of, they arrived on time, executed dinner service seamlessly, and treated everyone with kindness. Our guests raved about the food, but as the bride and groom, what stood out to us most was how their staff took such special care of us personally. They made sure we had time to eat and enjoy our own wedding meal, which meant so much.

On Behalf of Ashley & Demetrius Simmons - August 7th, 2025

Chef Lisa was an absolute blessing for us during our wedding. From the initial call to discuss what we wanted, she helped guide and shape our ideas into a plan that we were excited about. Then came the tasting! She came to our house and served us a sampling of what we could expect at our wedding and the food was amazing! She made the process simple for us. This was one thing, that once we booked her, we didn't have to worry about it anymore. The day of the wedding turned out great! Our guest made many comments about how great the food was! Thank so much Chef Lisa! Will definitely look for you for any future events!

Maxwell Catering was absolutely amazing! The owner, Mrs. Lisa, was so kind, professional, and incredibly helpful throughout the entire process. She made everything easy and stress-free, and the food and presentation were both elegant and top-notch. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and takes pride in delivering excellence. I highly recommend Maxwell Catering to anyone looking for a high-quality, Black-owned catering company that combines professionalism with a personal touch.

Ever since I was younger, the Maxwell family has always been known for their great food & singing. That legacy has carried on through Lisa.
Lisa, you have a loving heart and a beautiful spirit. And you obviously put your heart into every dish.
Thanks for the delicious food & the beautiful presentation. Once again, you did not disappoint.

formatted_address: 4431 Brookshire Blvd, Charlotte, NC 28216, United States
name: Rudy's Soulfood and Catering

reviews.text: Just received our first time order via DoorDash & I wish I would’ve read the reviews first! Meatloaf dinner was supposed to come with mashed potatoes but received hard rice kernels; collards- bland & Mac was dry & crumbly— absolutely no cheese pull at all! The fried wings had a pretty crispy looking coating, however, only seasoning tasted was garlic; yellow rice- hard & bland; broccoli casserole- very mushy (gave purée or baby food). Def not the soul food taste that I was looking for or use to! $55 wasted!! #First&Last
This was a phenomenal place to eat at. Customer Service is awesome and the restaurant has a wonderful vibe to eat. Met the owners wonderful people..

Took about a 15 minute drive here to get the Honey Blackened salmon, Mac and yams. The salmon was dry and a little burnt for my liking. I didn’t taste honey. The Mac and cheese was unseasoned and dry as well. The yams were okay but not the best. I don’t have to go back or recommend this place.

0 stars. We ordered 2 dinner and 2 sides. Neither side came. ($10). Total was $68. The chicken was dry n overcooked.  We ordered Honey hot, there was no sauce on either, nor on the side The Mac was burnt on top, greens were dry.  We were supposed to get cornbread the two meals...we did not! I normally read the reviews first, I failed this time. I do not recommend. I will also be leaving a review on City Kitch.

Food was mediocre.  Money wasted. Cabbage was a dark brown. Looks as it was gravy or vomit. So I didn’t taste it. Meat loaf bland. Mac n chesse tastes like not homemade. Jiffy cornbread.  I will not be ordering again.

formatted_address: 2120 Kilborne Dr, Charlotte, NC 28205, United States
name: Ms DiDi's Caribbean Kitchen

reviews.text: My first time having Haitian food and this place truly set the bar. The service and the food was phenomenal. Everything was fresh and seasoned to the gawds. 10/10

So I was really looking forward to eating here and the food looks great. It’s very clean and it’s also Haitian owned so I was very excited to support my own culture, but I got the.Legume with beef Which was $27 and I only got two pieces of meat very small pieces so that was very disappointing for the price. It is a very pricey, but if the food is good, I do not mind paying for the price legume good I proceeded to eat it in the more I ate it the spicier I got and I was like why is it so spicy well come to find out habanero pepper have popped which it is part of the culture to cook with habanero peppers, but it is not OK to let it pop in a meal cause then it just ruins the whole dishso I was not able to eat it because because it was so spicy so I was a little scared to say something because I know how Haitians are and stuff but I was like hey I paid 30 something dollars after taxes for this. This is uncalled for I’m gonna see if I can get an exchange.  so I was not able to eat it because because it was so spicy so I was a little scared to say something because I know how Haitians are and stuff but I was like hey I paid 30 something dollars after taxes for this. This is uncalled for I’m gonna see if I can get a change So I proceeded to tell the host it was too spicy. I showed her where I found the habanero pepper that had popped in my food. She tried to tell Miss Didi and Miss didi looked up with an attitude and said what do you want me to do about it I thought that was very disrespectful  even though you owned something customer service is always firsthand. I have worked in customer service for a long time so I said can you fix it so she They didn’t take it out back or anything And she fixed it, and she proceeded to give me legume with no meat in a smaller bowl. As the American Haitian, born and raised in Haiti, been eating this food for a very long time I just feel like it was very disrespected, and if you are a Haitian trying to own a I feel like you should have customer service. Customer service should always be your number one priority because at the end of the day they’re the one putting money on your table. I know it’s not a bad restaurant because they did have a lot of people. I will try to give it a second chance and I will try something else on the and  pray for better, Service and before anybody says anything I do have proof.

This was the best Haitian food I had in a long time!! The food is fresh and definitely tasty!! I had the legume and griot combo Au-Cap Deluxe with diri djon djon (black mushroom rice) and sweet plantains and the pikliz  was good!! A good size portion too!!! thanks to the recommendations of Ms Didi’s son (I forgot his name) who was a great host and made me feel welcomed!  This is my go to spot whenever I’m in NC!!

The food is great but very tiny portions for the price not worth it. Not even Jamaicans charge this much. I paid $32 for two small side off grio that was $10 each and some tiny picklez in tiny ketchup condiments.

I’ll say this loud and clear: ignore the recent 1- and 2-star reviews. Whatever they experienced, I didn’t. Ms. DiDi’s isn’t just serving food—they are serving home.

I ordered the whole snapper with rice and peas and a side of Caribbean mac and cheese, and from the first bite, I knew I was in for something special. The snapper was flawlessly done—crispy skin giving way to tender, seasoned meat. The rice and peas were rich and comforting, and the mac and cheese? Creamy, flavorful, and full of island soul.

What made the experience even better was how seen and welcomed I felt. I asked a few questions before ordering, and the staff answered with genuine care. No rush, no attitude—just warmth, like stepping into a family kitchen.

Ms. DiDi’s brought me back to the flavors and feelings of home.

formatted_address: 224 E 7th St, Charlotte, NC 28202, United States
name: The Market at 7th Street

reviews.text: Cool little market with a bunch of shops. The smell of delicious food hits you the second you walk in. Enough tables to walk around, grab whatever food you’d like to eat then take a seat. You can even order from the table you sit at by scanning the QR code. Neat experience.

Not a ton of food options but what amazing food options they were. Our party got Ethiopian and Italian and the food from both places was spectacular. First time I’ve ever found wild boar pasta in the US.

Hands down my favorite food hall in the city. Each vendor brings something different to the table - literally. It is always so hard to choose what I am going to have when I’m there. Their mission is what sets it apart though! Glad to have this gem in my neighborhood.

Be sure to always check out their upcoming events!

Such a cute place!  Lots of variety and it was easy to park or we could have taken the light rail. Plenty of food and drink options too. We got there a little later, so some places were closing, but i would go back earlier to really enjoy.
They also had a few small shops CLT find was cute and Orman’s cheese shop were both adorable and a fun way to kill some time while waiting on food. There was also a wine bar and Resident Culture brewing.

7th Street Market is such a cool spot in the heart of downtown Charlotte. Great mix of local vendors, good coffee, unique food options, and a laid-back vibe that makes it easy to hang out for a while. It’s a perfect place to grab a bite, support small businesses, and enjoy the city. Definitely worth checking out whether you’re a local or just visiting.

formatted_address: 2233 Matthews Township Pkwy, Matthews, NC 28105, United States
name: Kabab-Je Rotisserie & Grille

reviews.text: We had a family dinner at Kabab-Je Rotisserie & Grille and everything was wonderful. From the fresh-baked pita bread and creamy hummus to the excellent salads, every dish was delicious. We ordered the mixed family platter and the seafood mixed grill—both were outstanding. The service was great, portions are huge, and one entrée is easily enough for two people. We’ll definitely be back!

Placed my first order over the phone. Omar was very kind on the phone and patient. I ordered the Falafel, Hummas, and Basmati Rice. The rice was garnished with dried fruit. It was exceptional! I will be back. Keep up the great work :)

I ordered the mixed meat platter and chicken shawarma. The chicken was okay, but the lamb was undercooked, didn’t taste fresh, and had no spices. The chicken shawarma was horrible; my friend and I couldn’t even finish half of it.

You could visit this place if you have no taste buds at all. However, the servers were good.
Delicious food fresh naan amazing garlic sauce. Need seasoning on chicken kebab. But lamb, lamb shank ,kofta and beef kebabas and shawarma was delicious. Take a note...make chicken better

Very nice place. The shawarma is genuinely tasty and fresh, not greasy, with a well-balanced flavor. But what really stands out is the people behind it. You can feel that the owners are honest and truly care about their guests, not just about making a quick sale.

I always stop by whenever I’m nearby, and every visit leaves a good feeling. A place I can confidently recommend to anyone who appreciates good food and sincere, respectful service.

formatted_address: 200 W Woodlawn Rd Ste D, Charlotte, NC 28217, United States
name: Caribbean Hut

reviews.text: This has been my go-to restaurant for caribbean food for several years now. Unfortunately,  today I had to place an order for delivery since my car is in the shop. I ordered 1 shrimp curry roti and 2 chicken curry roti. I requested the roti be put separately so it isn't delivered soggy. I was sent containers of curry and no roti. Not even 1. That was going to be our dinner for tomorrow

I came from Atlanta for a conference and always look for good Jamaican food since I’m of Nigerian descent and love Caribbean cuisine. This spot did not disappoint! The food was delicious — the meat was tender and falling off the bone, full of rich flavor. The cabbage was soft and well seasoned, and the plantains were perfect. The young gentleman who served me was very kind and accommodating. No complaints at all — keep up the great work! I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in town.

The goat meat in the curry goat roti was very salty. And the next day I'm on the 🚽... So maybe this is a "me" problem, but I probably wouldn't get it again. To their credit, they didn't skimp on the meat, it was loaded up. Just too salty and not enough potato in the curry to balance the meal. And they also had a nice spicy pepper sauce on the side when I asked for it.

I agree the goat is a little salty. Still decent though. Good sorrel and god coco bread. Unpleasant on the phone and in person. Plantain very dry/not fresh zero sweetness, kinda like the customer service. Maybe they should be a food truck or something. Look stressed and uninterested in your money. Ialso never seen or heard of corn in the cabbage at a Jamaican spot but to each its own. Had the food been better I’d suffer the bad attitude and come back again but no thanks

I literally just left there. The man working behind the bar was one of if not the rudest person I've ever encountered in my life. When I walked in with a smile I asked if I may use the restroom before I order. He looked at me with the most angry expression and said nothing. So I repeated myself and he literally said nothing. Then I noticed when I was in the bathroom that the soap dispenser was not working. Of course this is concerning because the employees should wash their hands before leaving the restroom. So when I came out I tried to explain this to him and he said in the most rude way that it works I just didn't know how to use it. But I do know how to use a soap dispenser. It's the kind you motion in front of or underneath. I tried both repeatedly. I explained this to him and he just kept repeating himself in the most angry tone and appearance. So I said I'm going to leave and go somewhere happier. I need to eat at and support places that are nice, appreciative and respectful to their customers. This is not that place. The lady working behind the counter wasn't nice either.

formatted_address: 306 W Franklin St, Chapel Hill, NC 27516, United States
name: Bouquet Garni Foods & Catering

reviews.text: I picked up the chicken yassa plate and bissap juice from the Durham Farmer's market. The owner was so kind to give me a free sample of his curried chicken salad. I was blown away by the flavors of the chicken yassa - the chicken was moist and flavorful, the rice was cooked well, and the plantains added a nice sweet bite :) The bissap juice was also light and refreshing. I had to lick my spoon clean because the food was that good. Will buy again!

Finally there's a reason to go back to Blue Dogwood.  I've been to Bouquet Garni a number of times already, and I plan to keep it in regular rotation.  It's best to call ahead, there's the number on the website and another number on the sign when you go there (photo attached) -- either works.  If nobody picks up (sometimes it's just a one-man show) I leave a message and get a call right back.

My favorite item on the menu is the curry chicken salad, which is also available as a sandwich, but you can't go wrong with the maffe or yassa.  I've also done the Sunday brunch and tried some of the soups, juices, and dessert items as well.  All good stuff.  Git some!

I just attended an event catered by Bouquet Garni. The variety of French and Senegalese dishes was amazing and everything was delicious! Great mafe and yassa and the best bissap juice since my days in Dakar. Most of the guests had never tasted these dishes and they happily cleaned their plates and went back for seconds and thirds! I will be going to Chapel Hill to visit!

Very tasty food.  The location is in a food court at the back of the parking lot and you will miss it from Franklin Street if you don't know it's there.  We had the chicken yassa and tilapia.  Both dishes were flavorful and delicious.   There are also vegetarian soups which were hearty and did not miss having meat.  The juices are the owner's twist on traditional Senegalese juices and are worth stopping to buy on their own.  I have no idea if the dishes are authentic, but we really enjoyed the food and talking with the owner.  He also sells at the Duhram Farmer's Market.

I got the chicken yassa here and it was absolutely amazing. The shop owner was very kind and gave me a free drink and a fruit tart for the food taking a little longer. The fruit tart is delicious and so cute, this is one of the places I’ve been! Highly recommend if I could give it more stars I would and I will definitely be back.

formatted_address: 2200 Thrift Rd #1, Charlotte, NC 28208, United States
name: Mazali

reviews.text:
We ordered Plov, Lagman, Manty, Samsa with pumpkin.  We loved every dish!
Pasta for Lagman is handmade, meat and vegetables are cooked in front of you and this is a show! The seating area is decorated in Uzbek style. We will come back many times, Mazali.

1: Best noodles in the universe!
2: Nicest owners in the universe.

Because of a work opportunity, I was able to watch their team making various dishes a few months ago.  Tonight I finally got to try things: yum!

Manty with pumpkin, samsa with pumpkin & samsa with potatoes, boso lagman & guiru lagman…tasty,  handmade comfort food that’s good for you.

But those noodles: wow!

I took a bite of noodle before combining things.  Flavorful, delightfully chewy, and about a mile long, therefore just fun to eat.  Perhaps criminal but I ate half totally as-is (dare I call them naked?!).

Wishing Mazali continued success!

I visited Mazali yesterday for first time. We were looking for Uzbek food in Charlotte for long and accidentally found about Mazali. The food is great. Very flavorful and tasty. 😍
The plov rice is fluffy and the tase is very rich. Samsas dough is crispy and filling are juicy. Soooooo gooood! 🥰
Chef said they  are moving to the front kitchen in November and they will have some sitting available for 12 people. Will definitely visit again.
Thank you very much!

I have never tried Uzbek food but was craving something cozy for a cold winter night. The plov, achik-chuchuk, and kulcha were delicious! The plov was well seasoned with warm spices and crispy chicken. I did find the bread to be a bit on the drier side but still good. Will definitely be back!

Was in the building buying food from another place and decided to check their menu. I'm glad I did!! Every single item I purchased was GREAT. I ordered the 4 vegan items I saw on the menu and loved them all. The potato and pumpkin Samsas I ordered with hesitation being that I've never had anything like it before, but I'm glad I did. Especially the pumpkin which was super flavorful. The Achik- Chuchuk salad was super refreshing and light on the palate, and the boso lagman was great as well!! I will be back. I just wish I didn't live across town!!

formatted_address: 10210 Berkeley Pl Dr #120, Charlotte, NC 28262, United States
name: Mama’s Halal Kitchen

reviews.text:
We stopped by Mama’s Halal Kitchen on our way back from Washington to Atlanta and had a wonderful experience. Since we were arriving close to closing time, I called ahead around 9:35 PM to ask if dine-in would still be possible. The lady on the phone was extremely kind and even took our order in advance.

When we arrived, everything was hot and fresh—the daal tarka, BBQ mix grill platter, and Hakka noodles were delicious and full of flavor. You could tell the food was prepared with care.

As they were getting ready to close, we ordered tea to-go, and even then the hospitality didn’t stop. Another couple arrived just before closing, and the staff kindly allowed them to dine in as well. To top it off, a young girl at the end gave candies to my children, which really made their night.

Amazing food, genuine hospitality, and a very welcoming attitude—especially so close to closing time. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great halal food in Charlotte!

We went for dine in at around 9:25
We did place an order ahead of reaching there. We got bbq platter for 2, tarka daal, chicken hakka and chai. The food was absolutely delicious. Nothing that I could say was bad. From the service to the food to the girls there and their customer service everything was excellent. Highly recommend if you are looking for halal food in the area.

This is by far my favorite restaurant for South Asian food. The food was absolutely delicious.. it was rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and authentically prepared. The biryani was aromatic and full of depth, and the chicken/lamb karahi was tender with just the right amount of heat. Every bite reminded me of traditional home cooked Pakistani meals. It also feels like home as the owners and the people that work there were very welcoming!

Mama's Halal Kitchen is the best Pakistani restaurant in the area — truly authentic! Their customer service is above and beyond. We've been here twice, and everything has been amazing. The chai and halwa puri are perfect, and Mama's Grill Platter is juicy and delicious. All the food is freshly made and absolutely hits the spot

Mama's Halal Kitchen is a true gem! The food is incredibly flavorful, fresh, and consistently delicious. A must-try for anyone craving authentic halal cuisine. You won't be disappointed!!!
Miss Mahnoor's warmth and dedication shine through in every dish. Her passion for excellent food and service makes Mama's Halal Kitchen a truly special place.

Special thanks to the chef

formatted_address: 2015 E Arbors Dr #270, Charlotte, NC 28262, United States
name: Soma Bistro and Cafe

reviews.text:
Seen the viral butter chicken pizza on TikTok and instantly knew I had to try it…so glad I did the pizza was dang near perfection, doughy and nicely browned with an even coat of toppings, and the butter sauce was the star of the show bring all of the flavor…the only thing it was missing for me is the spice factor although it comes with a packet of red pepper flakes I would love a spicer version of the sauce.
