On this lunch visit, I ordered Jollof rice with fried chicken and goat meat.  It was not too spicy, but everything was seasoned and flavored nicely.  I’m not a big plantain fan, but the plantain was well prepared, and they were delicious.  Also, there are various other sides to order from.  The staff and chef took the greatest concern and care to make sure that the meal was prepared well and that I and the other guests enjoyed our meal.  I highly recommend visiting a couple times or ordering for delivery a couple times to try various dishes.  On my next visit I plan to try Turkey Suya and request some shrimp in my Jollof next time.

formatted_address: 1435 Randolph Street, Detroit, MI 48226, United States
name: Fixins Soul Kitchen

reviews.text: We had an after work team dinner at Fixin’s and it was a resplendent, Engineered to AMAZE experience! While the vibe is cool, the service and the food were over the top. Our server took time to explain the foods, sides, etc. We were interested in sampling sides so everything was arranged so we could pass them around almost family style. I went with fried chicken and the pieces were HUGE! The seasoning and crisp on the chicken was perfect, and the chicken was nice and moist. The collard greens were amazing as well, but we also tried nearly all the others. Oh and you can’t go wrong with the fried deviled eggs! The only disappointment? Didn’t save room for dessert!

I got invited to eat some soul food ( which I have never had before ) When you walk in the restaurant is so clean and nice. The vibe is relaxing and quiet. All the servers was very friendly and polite. The waitress helped me pick my drink and I was impressed with how it looked and taste. I ordered the fried devil eggs and I'm gonna tell you, those were so good
I highly recommend them for you to try. I ordered the oxtail meal and it came with 2 sides but I ordered 3 sides because I couldn't make a decision on just 2. The Oxtail was on a bed of rice with gravy and that was sooo good 👍
My sides was Mac and cheese ( was good ), collard greens ( amazing  👏), yams ( fantastic ), charred ocra ( which I didn't like. It tasted burnt ). I ordered dessert to go of course which was peach cobbler and that was Ok. I would go back to try more of the menu.  I gave a 4 because of the ocra and cobbler

This is a fairly new restaurant of about 1 1/2 years old. We tried this place because it was soul food. The place was very clean and the service was impeccable. For my meal I had the fried chicken which was crispy and super moist. I had the collard greens and they were the best I have had. I also tried the charred okra. Wasn't sure what to think at first but it was excellent. For an appetizer we got deep fried devil eggs. The first time I have had them and will get them again. Then we tried the fried green tomatoes. They were good just not my favorite. My wife had the fried fish which was exceptional also. My brother in law had the smothered porkchop and it was very good. A touch dry on the inside but chops always are. The corn bread was excellent. Will be going again as there wasn't a bad thing on the menu. So many more things to try.

We visited Fixins Soul Kitchen Detroit while in the city over the Thanksgiving holiday, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. From the moment we sat down, the service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming—exactly the kind of hospitality you hope for with soul food.

The fried chicken and waffles were the standout for me. The chicken was perfectly seasoned with a crisp, golden crust and juicy meat inside, paired beautifully with fluffy waffles that struck the right balance between sweet and savory.

Absolute comfort food perfection.
The fried deviled eggs were rich and indulgent, with a creamy filling and a crispy exterior that added great texture. The fried catfish bites were light, flaky, and well-seasoned—no heaviness, just clean, soulful flavor. The shrimp and grits were smooth and comforting, with tender shrimp and deeply flavored grits that felt both hearty and refined.

The sides were just as impressive. The collard greens were slow-cooked, savory, and full of depth, while the black-eyed peas were tender, earthy, and perfectly seasoned—classic soul food done right.
One final note: the hot sauce is incredible and absolutely worth buying to take home. It packs flavor, not just heat.

Everything about this visit—from the food to the service—was outstanding. We’ll definitely be back the next time we’re in Detroit.

Highly recommend Fixins Soul Kitchen if you’re looking for authentic, elevated soul food done with care and pride.

Fixins is a beautiful, immersive celebration of Black culture — from the food to the music to the energy. Located in the heart of downtown Detroit’s vibrant city scene, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming, the service is excellent, and the food is absolutely top-tier.
And please… do yourself a favor and order the red Kool-Aid with your plate. Trust me.
Mac and cheese ✅
Yams ✅
Greens ✅
Fried chicken ✅
Fried fish ✅
Shrimp & grits ✅
Every bite hit. 10/10 — no notes.

formatted_address: 1431 Times Square, Detroit, MI 48226, United States
name: SavannahBlue

reviews.text:
Everything was amazing. The culture, the food and the vibe.
I thoroughly enjoyed the food and the staff was very courteous and nice.
The patrons nicely dressed. My server Chelsea was very attentive and took excellent care in providing superb service.
Highly recommend and will definitely be back.

BEST BREAD PUDDING EVER! The whole snapper was scrumptious and delicious 😋

My husband and I truly enjoyed our dinner experience. The food was delicious and the service was superb. Our waitress Sarah was very informative and truly enhanced our visit. I even got to take a selfie with her lol. The ambiance made us feel like we were the only ones there. And at the same time, it felt Warm and cozy. We will definitely be back. #selfiewithsarah #SavannahBlue

I haven’t been in a few years but it was just as good as ever. Our table got the oxtail, the snapper (my brother ate well!), and the SB salad. It was so good! And special shout out to Stephanie for making my mom’s bday special.

Few things bring me the joy of discovering a great restaurant in my adopted hometown of Detroit.  Savannah Blue was a perfect take on Southern cooking.  Flavorful, high quality, and priced accordingly, the great service only added to my experience.  I will definitely be back.

This restaurant gets a 10 out of 10! Great ambiance! Food was absolutely amazing! Sarah, our waitress was very kind, warm, and attentive! The drinks were also on point! We will definitely be back! We had the whole red snapper and the catfish! Chef’s kiss! Sides: Savannah red rice with sausage, collard greens with smoked turkey, candied yams, and corn muffins! All ten out of 10! For desert we shared the sweet potato cheesecake! Totally delicious! Get here!! They won’t disappoint! Drink…blacker the berry! Amazing!

formatted_address: 22113 W Warren Ave, Dearborn Heights, MI 48127, United States
name: AfriKan Grill

reviews.text:
I'm absolutely blown away by my first experience with African grilled meat! I can't even put into words how incredible it tasted. Every bite was a revelation – I never knew grilled meat could have such amazing flavor.

The chef and owner, Moe, was incredibly welcoming. He took the time to explain the unique blend of seasonings and spices that make their grilled meats so special. I couldn't stop raving about how much I was enjoying the food, and Moe was kind enough to offer me a sample of another meat he was preparing.

This place is an absolute must-try. The flavors are unlike anything I've experienced before. If I could give it more than five stars, I absolutely would. Do yourself a favor and check out this hidden gem – your taste buds will thank you!

The combination of exceptional food and warm, personalized service made for an unforgettable dining experience. I can't wait to go back and explore more of their menu. If you're looking for a new culinary adventure, this is it!
Absolutely delicious food. The hausa sauce beef was so good, tender, flavorful, spicy. I'll absolutely be back. Highly recommended.
Finally, a bbq place in our area that knows what medium means. The meat was tender, not overcooked, fresh, and delicious. I'd definitely recommend it again.

just picked up a meet Shawarma. It was the best meat, Shawarma, ever had fresh and perfect. The best restaurant in the game.
God bless you
great food and great people you will not be disappointed

formatted_address: 2760 Howard Ave Unit 7, Windsor, ON N8X 3X6, Canada
name: Zuleeats

reviews.text:
Did you know that Zuleeats caters events??? Because they do! Zule catered a brunch for my baby shower in Amherstburg, and everyone LOVED it. The food was delicious!!! This video doesn’t do the whole table justice, but she decorated it all to the baby shower colours, and it was just beautiful to look at!! Provided utensils and juices so I didn’t have to worry about any food items for the event, which was a huge stress reliever to me. Thank you again for making our baby shower perfect! 🥰  also, there was a custard/sauce that she provided with the scones that people wanted to pack and take home!!! So yummy!!!!!

Also, if you haven’t had their meat pies and chips, YOU NEED TO! They’re always at markets around town, and you can stop by their store to purchase them if you just can’t wait. The beef pie is our favourite!!!
They have a very unique taste to their chicken and rice, contains a tasty flavour that you don’t get everyday. The chicken specially doesn’t feel bland, and the interior taste as good as the exterior

Fantastic food! Grabbed a beef and a chicken patty as well as some frozen ones to go. I forgot to take a picture before I started eating the patties, but hopefully this will show you how good they are! Will definitely be coming back.

Chicken and jollof rice was delicious.
The Spicy Beef Pie was the best meat pie I've ever had. Was better than any Jamaican, English, or Scotch pie I've ever eaten!
I want to try everything else!

Amazing family own restaurant, great service. Food was good and a reasonable price. Their meat pie is the best meat pie. I’ve had in a long time. (so I don’t want to hear the complaints about price b.)

formatted_address: 914 Erie St E, Windsor, ON N9A 3Y8, Canada
name: NaijaFoodEats Restaurant and Lounge

reviews.text: This restaurant is completely abusing the purpose of the app To Good to Go . What I got was a few scraps of meat floating in spicy water. The meat was so hard it couldn’t even be chewed; I had to give it to my dog. I’d be embarrassed to serve something like that to anyone. Ordering through an app doesn’t mean customers deserve garbage food. The whole point of the app is to connect new people and this place clearly doesn’t care about that.

This place is unbelievable. My new favourite restaurant!!
I didn't know how to describe the food so I said to my wife my mouth feels clean and like it's dancing. She laughed and agreed "that's exactly it." I have never tasted such a wonderful combination of flavor.
We had the:
Suya (it's medium spicy)
Roasted chicken with jollof rice
Beef meat pies
Egusi, my favourite!!!!

They were very friendly and brought us water to wash so we could eat with our hands if we wanted (and I did)!
I can't wait to go back to windsor and try more items!

I’m Jamaica and I’m very familiar with Nigerian food. I had the Egusi with fresh pounded yam and it was so good. The portion was also good.

If you never had Nigerian food this is the place to try it. Ola is also amazing. She’s hard working and likes to please her customers. Bring your friends for a meal, a snack or a drink. Also a good place to meet with clients. Very clean place.

I decided to order some takeout food today from this restaurant. This was first time ordering from here. I called to order and the person on the other end was very pleasant. I ordered Egusi with pounded yam. The portions were good and the food was delicious. I will definetely be ordering grom here again and recommending it to others. Thanks for the great service
They offer Too Good To Go. Have some unique taste to their proteins and fried rice. Love the taste and offer amazing deals in Uber an TGTG and at great price.

formatted_address: 28639 Northwestern Hwy, Southfield, MI 48034, United States
name: Taste of Ethiopia

reviews.text:
Food was delicious, had the vegetarian meal for two and it was my first time and loved it. Kind of reminded me of some of my childhood dishes. The injera was so delicious to swoop every bite of the flavor.

Service the girl who served was just the best, she guided us, was very friendly and was fast on her toes. We had amazing discussion about cruise both Ethiopian and Indian which share a spice pallet.

Atmosphere was amazing, clean, hospitable and beautiful music being played.

Loved it and cannot wait to go back.

I recently went here with a family member, and we finally had the time to go here! We got the veggie combo plate for two, which we liked a lot! I liked the potatoes, and the family member liked the green beans and the yellow lentils! This place is a bit smaller than I thought it would’ve been, though, but there is a private event room for events.

Some of the best vegan Ethiopian food I’ve had. The combo was incredible, with rich flavor and perfectly cooked dishes. Great service and welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone seeking authentic plant-based options.

Place was empty except for another couple. That should've been the red flag for me to leave. Anyway, I love Ethiopian food and I was excited to try this place. Anjera was COLD and soggy. We ordered the platter, everything was cold as if it was microwaved and it tasted like it was cooked a few days ago. I asked the waitress if the dishes were cooked today, she said no. She admitted that they reheat the food and its not made the same day. This is pure disrespect to your customers, we're paying to eat FRESHLY cooked food. NOT reheated old stale food. We literally took only 2 bites and left the rest of the food as it is, paid and left. Never again. I dont know how this place has a 4.5 but its deceiving. I hope they realize the standards of excellent food. Ethiopian food is supposed to be so flavorful, its a shame that they dont have the passion for it.

“Worth the wait” my son said!

Definitely sums up this experience :) Service was a little slow because it was only one girl that was working all the tables, to-gos, and making drinks; however, it wasn’t the worst we’ve had.

We’re from Southern Cali, so it’s great to see food options that aren’t a dime a dozen! That injera bread is tho!!! 👏👏 My son’s fish was 🔥🔥 You can tell it’s hand battered!

Thank you for the experience, and if we’re ever back here in town, we will be back for sure!

formatted_address: 499 University Ave W, Windsor, ON N9A 5P9, Canada
name: Ratal Foods

reviews.text: I had two meals at Ratal Foods and both were delicious. The first was fried fish and yam with a side of fried plantain and the second was beans (ewa agonyi) and fried plantain.  The service was great and the meals were prepared in a timely manner. I had the meals at the restaurant and the atmosphere was super. I highly recommend Ratal Foods.

One day I was particularly missing home and I decided to go try the new Nigerian restaurant I heard about. My plan was to get the jollof rice but last minute, I decided to add the plantain and she was the star of the show. This plantain was so sumptuous and soft - looking like it had its own skincare routine. I got the jollof rice, fried rice and turkey combo. And I really enjoyed it. The customer service was also really good, the owner tried to explain the bill and show me how the tax was added which I felt was cute- it was worth the price especially because I couldn’t finish it in one sitting. I will be back again.
Wonderful dining experience! Food was tasty, highly recommended the Pounded Yam and Egusi Soup. Service was friendly and meals were reasonably priced.

What a beautiful and satisfying restaurant. Meals were on point and exceeded expectations.
Everyone enjoyed their meals. The chicken was OOTW - too sweet to describe 😋
I tried Edikaikong soup for the first time and absolutely loved it.
Thank you for the delicious meals and pleasurable service provided.
Would definitely patronize again and again  😍
The best Nigerian food in Windsor! Every dish I have tried from here did not disappoint! Their Asun is now one of my comfort foods!

formatted_address: 2127 University Ave W, Windsor, ON N9B 1E3, Canada
name: Somali Restaurant

reviews.text: I love place, 10/10. The food makes a tear roll down my eye, the masterpiece of food makes my soul exit my body into another universe where everything sunshine and rainbows, it's an experience I have never felt before, the chicken falls off the bone, the rice mixes with chicken, dancing around in my warm mouth, and the service is awesome, the owner is friendly, atmosphere is good. THANKS LEVON!!!

Somali restaurant for a few years now, primarily for takeout. Both their chicken and beef dishes are consistently yummy, bursting with authentic flavors that keep me coming back. However, I have to note that the price is a bit high compared to other places. Also, while the food is great, it's definitely more suited for takeout than dining in. The dine-in experience isn't really a highlight, but if you're grabbing a delicious meal to enjoy at home, you won't be disappointed.

Good food at a cheap rate only on typical days. The food wasn’t good the next time i had there.

Although the owner was good to me. I would prefer to take-out the next time, as the ambience isn’t good.

To be clear I am a Mexican American from Texas. I raised goats and have consumed more than my fair share. This doesn't taste like Mexican prepared goat, but it's damn good! Cut of met seemed to be off the spine and it was tender and delicious!!

One of the best Somali food in Windsor. I have tried others not only in Windsor but also in Toronto and I can say that this restaurant offers authentic and very tasty food. I'd  just wish that they provided hot sauce and the eating area were more welcoming as the place is more of a joint or take out than an actual restaurant to dine in. The Menu is very limited but whatever they have is excellent.

formatted_address: 5818 N Wayne Rd, Westland, MI 48185, United States
name: Nwanneka's Place 2

reviews.text:
I wish I would have read the reviews before coming here. We just saw the place and decided to try it. First off, our order was almost $60 for three meals, which is not too bad, however, for the portions we received?? Unacceptable. We paid and waited to eat our food. We were waiting, I noticed I kept hearing beeps. Then I realized what it was. She was MICROWAVING our food! Of course it was too late to ask for a refund so I said, many she cooked it earlier and just reheating it. That’s not too bad 🥴

Our food arrived and mine was just warm. My sister’s “jerk” chicken was barely seasoned and undercooked. My brother had egusi and fufu with goat meat. Now, there was hardly any goat meat in there. In ful disclosure, I never had neither egusi or fufu so I have nothing to compare it to, but, the egusi tasted like an elephant at a zoo. I don’t know how else to explain it. I couldn’t even swallow it.

I had Jollof rice with goat meat. Lots of rice but it was wet and mushy and again, just warm. My goat meat portion was small for the price.

I would not go here!

I wish we hadn’t picked this place and read the reviews, but it was a blind choice. I was the only one there and it still took over 45 minutes when they said 20. I was so excited for the egusi because it was my first time, but it was awful and sour. It truly tasted spoiled. The smell gave it away, but the tiny bit I tasted was horrible.  Everything was microwaved, no fresh food. $15 for 4 pieces of dry, flavorless lamb. No refund which was also horrible. Don’t come here.

Edit: As I’ve read other reviews, I truly believe this place needs to be under investigation. It seems that they serve spoiled food often. This is not safe and endangers the public.
Very good I like it. I got meatloaf Mac and cheese and mashed potatoes. Large portions I enjoyed it.

I honestly had a great experience at this restaurant. I ordered over the phone and she was very upfront about how long everything would take and made sure that I was okay with it. Everything was ready when I arrived, and I spoke to the owner for a long time. She works by herself and is a nice little grandma so its wonderful that she is following her passion. The food itself was a bit pricey but I am happy to pay it to support a small local business. Everything tasted very good, and the portion sizes were large. The egusi was great but the cassava leaf soup was even better, with large portions of goat in each. I personally had a great experience and would recommend to others.

No.  So upset drove all the way home for some overpriced egusi that was not even halfway full!! I wished I would have checked my bag before leaving  I'm so upset. 26.00 seriously 😳 horrible service. Never again, I try to support but look at the outcome.

formatted_address: 221 S Washington Square, Lansing, MI 48933, United States
name: Jollof Afro Caribbean lounge

reviews.text:
I had a great meal out with loved ones at Jollof Afro Caribbean Lounge!

When you walk in, the clean environment, warm lighting, and the unique, but practical furniture invite you into the oasis. The music from all over the African continent also helps you feel the vibe!

Our server, Kemba, was great! She checked in often enough for us to have everything we needed, while still giving us space to enjoy our meal.

The jerk chicken was full of “tendernism”, and the generous portion sizes are just what you want when you’re eating good food that you didn’t have to cook!

Their takeout containers are heavy duty enough to carry your leftovers home safely without wimping out on you in transit.

I can’t wait to come back!

Came to tour the Capitol building on a Saturday and found this place for lunch. The food was OUTSTANDING! We had the Jerked Chicken with Jollof & Plantains and Goat with Jollof. A nice amount spice in the sauces and the Jollof rice was really good. Good drink menu as well.

The restaurant is well laid out with multiple TVs on the wall playing sports.  The staff were friendly and attentive. We will be back again!!

The food is very bland. I paid $35 for mac and cheese, but the fish was very bland, very dry, super tough, and still had scales on it. It didn’t look like it had been properly cleaned, despite my request for a new piece of fish. I was told that wasn’t something I could get. I wasn't refunded, only offered an extra side of mac and cheese. So I paid for mac and cheese, which is kind of funny, not funny. I guess I’ll go back to the crack chicken on the boulevard. Which is the second picture a way bigger fish super juicy light seasoning and half the price. Now the place is a vibe very beautiful inside nice music maybe a good bar not a restaurant.

We tried Jollof Afro Caribbean Food and it was absolutely amazing! The oxtail, greens, egusi, and fufu were all full of rich flavor and perfectly cooked. Every bite was seasoned just right — you can really taste the love in the food. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming too, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommend if you’re looking for authentic, flavorful Afro-Caribbean dishes!

We happened upon this restaurant by accident and, oh boy, I'm so glad we did! It's has a cozy and colorful atmosphere. Everyone was very friendly, and the aromas in the air made our mouths water. There was no wait for seating, and our dishes came out pretty quickly. I ordered Jerk Chicken, and my partner ordered a goat dish. The chicken was falling off the bone and blowing my mind 🤯. It was honestly one of the best dishes I've ordered since... well, years, probably. I was skeptical of the goat, but it smelled so good that I had to try it. Holy wow, it was amazing.
I highly recommend this place. It's an example of the types of gems we need in the Lansing area. If you want something unique and delicious, check out Jollof.

formatted_address: 35426 Goddard Rd, Romulus, MI 48174, United States
name: Fork in Nigeria

reviews.text: The fufu and egusi is DELICIOUS And it says a lot when you go there three times in one week. Customer service is good but the person who always makes me smile is soda. atmosphere is pretty decent But at the same time a little sketchy. but the food makes up for it

Came to pick up my door dash order and was told it would be an hour wait because the gas stove wasn’t working. Then they wouldn’t cancel the order even though it was not being made yet. Usually my go to place but there was no sense of urgency, reasoning, or common sense.  I reached out to DoorDash directly to cancel but the business should be willing to accommodate and not withhold the customers money. Mistakes happen but it shouldn’t be the customer who pays.

Sometimes ordering food is a hit or miss especially foreign food, but when I tell you the Egusi Stew w goat meat 🤯 was AMAZING! Didn’t think it would be this good, but it WAS and filling! Great portion, and flavor! The Zobo drink was flavorful never had anything like it!
Had a wonderful time trying the egusi with chicken! The chicken was excellent, it was fall off the bone and juicy! Soda was an amazing person to be helped by.

Food is usually good ! I just never left a review! I like the spice in the rice ! I like the egusi a lot! The young lady at the festival in Ypsilanti who was taking orders yesterday was very pleasant thorough with taking orders! I appreciate them and their efforts to bring is more cultural cuisines!

formatted_address: 55a Whitchurch Rd, Cardiff CF14 3JP, United Kingdom
name: Afro Lounge

reviews.text:
Wonderful food and service. I 100% recommend coming and enjoy this food.
We had fufu and seafood soup plus jolof rice and turkey was soo good😁

Myself and my partner was wondering what African food taste like . Then we google African restaurant with the best rating in wales afro lounge was number on the list so we decided to check them out to my surprise they thick all boxes would defo come back very soon 👏

**Afro Lounge**

Afro Lounge is a hidden gem that I had the pleasure of visiting during my first time in Cardiff, and I must say, it exceeded my expectations! I ordered the poundo and egusi, and it was nothing short of a 10/10. The food was so delicious that it completely won me over—I started eating with a spoon, trying to keep it posh, but eventually gave in and used my hands, which made the experience even more authentic and satisfying.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was absolutely lovely. It had a welcoming and vibrant vibe that made me feel at home, even though I was miles away from it. The staff were attentive, and the service was excellent, which added to the overall great experience.

The only thing I would suggest for improvement is the toilet facilities, as they could use some attention to match the exceptional standards of the food and ambience.

Overall, Afro Lounge is a fantastic spot to enjoy authentic Nigerian cuisine, and I’m truly impressed. I’ll definitely be coming back whenever I’m in Cardiff again. Highly recommended!

First time walking into a Nigerian restaurant. I really wanted to try authentic Nigerian flavours on top was thrilled to know they use halaal meat. I was nervous to try the food…so asked the person serving me what would he recommend…He said Egusi Assorted… OMG! As promised he said it’s full of flavour and boy was he right! Portion size was generous. Friendly & very relaxed atmosphere. Will deffo return again to try something else… thank you for a lovely experience! :-)

I would say Afro Lounge was actually better than I thought it would be. The food didn’t take long to be made, and to my surprise, the Egusi Soup was really delicious and tested really authentic. The pounded yam was good and well made. The atmosphere was comfy, chill, and relaxed. With lots of menu options, I also tried the white soup; it was decent and tasted more like pepper soup.
Great service.
Decent price.
Delicious food.
I recommend.

formatted_address: 221 E Washington St, Ann Arbor, MI 48104, United States
name: Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
The Blue Nile Ethiopian Restaurant in Ann Arbor is an absolute gem. We came for dinner and left completely blown away, not just by the food, but by the incredible service. The waitstaff was fantastic (and I mean FANTASTIC). Huge shoutout to our waiter Promise (yes, his name really is Promise, and he lived up to it) and Netsi, who both went above and beyond to make sure our table was cared for. Warm towels before the meal, constant check-ins, and hospitality that felt Michelin-level, it honestly made the night unforgettable.

The food itself was just as amazing. The dining style is authentic Ethiopian, big trays lined with fresh injera (that soft, spongy bread that they just keep bringing out) topped with colorful vegetarian dishes: lentils, greens, cabbage, split peas, potatoes, and more. Everything was full of flavor, rich with spices but still incredibly light and fresh. In the center of our table we ordered some meat dishes, and wow- the chicken and beef literally fell off the bone, tender and perfectly seasoned. My favorite was the stewed beef, slow-cooked until it melted in your mouth.

One of the best surprises was how healthy everything was. Ethiopian food is naturally low in fat, high in protein and carbs, and packed with flavor, which is seriously perfect fuel after a workout. You leave feeling full, satisfied, but not heavy. This is hands down going to be my go-to spot post-gym.

Between the incredible service, healthy yet filling food, and the family-style experience of sharing everything together, Blue Nile easily deserves more than five stars. If you’re in Ann Arbor, don’t just eat here, experience it.

The food was pretty good. I would recommend only getting the vegetarian tray and don’t add any meat because the price gets expensive very fast. It was very filling and the people were pretty nice. However, the service was a little bit weird where our table sat all the servers stood at the bar and kind of stared in our direction. Additionally, we got different people for every aspect of our meal and we probably dealt with 4 to 5 people during the course of our meal. One person gave us water. Another one took our order another one brought the food another one checked in then the original waiter came back and you weren’t really sure who was waiting on your table. Even different person bringing bread .

I’ve been here a few times and it’s always delicious😋. One dinner plate is enough for three people, the flavors are rich and balanced, not just salty or spicy. Highly recommend the almond cake — I’m obsessed with it, always find room for it no matter how full I am. Service is friendly and the atmosphere is calm and quiet, perfect for conversations

This was a unique eating experience.  Very pleasant environment.  The staff work together so well to accommodate you.  Food was a little bit spicy, but very tasty.  I really loved the entire experience.

I absolutely love the Blue Nile. I am plant based  and this is the only restaurant within a 50 mile radius where I have more than 3 options to choose from, lol
I've been here multiple times, but decided to bring My friend here for his birthday for a different experience.
He loved the decor as well as the food. He tried to use his fork once, but I took it from here because I wanted him to receive the full experience of eating with our hands.😊
The servers are so nice and the bathroom is always clean.
My friend also got a free meal.🥳

I live 45min away from Ann Arbor, but it's always worth the drive.

formatted_address: 6529 Woodward Ave suite a, Detroit, MI 48202, United States
name: The Kitchen by Cooking with Que

reviews.text: I went here for a cooking class recently and the experience was nothing short of amazing! Every dish was delicious, nutritious, and fast! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming.  I praise Jesus for the invite I received to visit this amazing gem.  May the God of heaven and earth keep blessing this young lady Que, her staff, and her building, in Jesus Name!

An absolute anointed environment with Que being unapologetically herself! My sisters and I had an incredible cooking class with her recently on November 17th. The food was phenomenal and I learned so much regarding prepping, cleaning, seasoning dishes etc.. as a new vegetarian. I will be back soon! You will not be disappointed whether you decide to do a private event, a date-night or an outing with your family and friends. Not to mention.. They CATER😮‍💨 I can’t wait to see what God has in store for Que’s establishment, it’s going to be out of this world

After watching them cook their way to the Top 3 on The Great Food Truck Race on the Food Network, I was finally able to grab a bite to eat at The Kitchen by Cooking with Q on Woodward Ave in Detroit. I walked in and was warmly greeted by the staff as well as owner & Chef Quiana herself. The icing on the cake was that there was a DJ playing some really good music behind the counter. 🎶 🎵

Let's get to the food. I ordered the vegan meatballs and vegan macaroni & cheese and I'm not even Vegan. I just heard it was that good and it is. The meatball appetizer had a slight crispy exterior and was tender on the inside with an Italian sauce. They were really good and it tasted like real meat.

The star of the show was the vegan Mac & cheese. I loved that it had a slightly sweet carmelization on top and the same nuttiness that you would get from a really good aged cheese. Although it's vegan, it still maintains it's integrity as a good Southern homestyle macaroni and cheese that earned it's place at the cookout. Be sure to check them out!

Visited for the first time for their Wine Down Fridays and it was amazinggg! Beautiful decor, amazing food, and wonderful service! 10/10! Literally have no complaints, everyone, even the patrons were so nice and welcoming. The DJ was fire too (woman DJ as well 💕)!

I ordered the Wild Mushroom Rigatoni, tiny bit spicy in some spots, but it was phenomenal, literally no complaints. Also, was able to try the vegan Mac and cheese and it was surprisingly very delicious. Not the biggest fan of Mac, especially vegan Mac, but it was delicious!!! Had a smokey, yet interestingly meaty taste? It doesn’t taste like your typical macaroni and cheese, but I’d highly recommend!

Also, ordered the Blueberry Lemonade. Personally okay (to ME). Too tart and wish it was a little sweeter.

Can’t wait to visit again and support another Black business (especially a Black woman) 🥰!

The Kitchen by Cooking with Que, located on Woodward in Detroit, Michigan, unfortunately leaves much to be desired. First and foremost, the space is incredibly small, which contributes to a cramped, uncomfortable dining experience. The loud music that blasts throughout the venue only adds to the discomfort, making it nearly impossible to have a conversation without shouting over the noise.

The food, while overpriced, fails to live up to any expectations. With only a limited selection on the menu, you might hope that the items that are available would be of high quality, but that is not the case. The quality of the food does not justify the steep prices, leaving you feeling disappointed after the meal.

The ambience of the place is also lacking. It feels unprofessional, with little effort put into creating a welcoming, polished environment. To add to the list of frustrations, the staff seems indifferent, providing service that lacks warmth or attention to detail. All in all,  The Kitchen by Cooking with Que falls short in nearly every category, making it hard to recommend to anyone looking for a pleasant dining experience in Detroit. Ps the  cauliflower, This is what I was serve when I came. Also, they charge my card extra fees

formatted_address: 18414 Wyoming Ave, Detroit, MI 48221, United States
name: Faustina's Creole & Soulfood

reviews.text: The Jerk chicken is a bully/ too concentrated 6/10. Mac,pintos,and cornbread are perfect. 7.5/10 overall.

This restaurant recently reopened its doors to the public and I recommend you visit! The food is awesome and reminds me of the cooking back home. I live near this spot so it’s good to know that I can get quality soul food from an acclaimed chef like Anthony. He took care of me with the alligator bites. I highly recommend and will return!
The food is amazing. But it’s hard to reach them to place an order or get correct days that they are open.

Thanks to Chef Anthony this was the most amazing soul food I've had in a really long time. Anthony is very friendly, and sociable. Even though I came in 10 minutes before closing time he was nice enough to explain the culinary history within his family. I had yams, greens, mac n cheese, and cornbread. I never tasted cornbread like this it was so good!

Maaan chef was super confident I'll be back & he was right!! Lol THE BEST meal I've had since being back home. This was my 1st time trying turkey ribs & I've never tasted meat so tender, flavorful, & you get plenty of it. This place a gem within the city y'all go check in

formatted_address: 14300 E Jefferson Ave, Detroit, MI 48215, United States
name: Detroit Soul

reviews.text: My family and I were in there for a special event that my cousin had for Breast Cancer awareness.  The atmosphere was great.  Our server, Ms. Chris was awesome.  The food was great as well!  Thank you for a wonderful experience🩷

I finally got a chance to go & taste the food and I wasn't disappointed 😋.  The restaurant was clean...very laid back atmosphere.  The waitstaff was fast and on point. The food was hot and delicious seasoned to perfection 👌🏿.  I definitely will be coming back for more...

The place is open and spacious.  Clean and a welcoming atmosphere.  The waitstaff was attentive and polite. The food....the catfish fritters are tasty and we're fresh. I had baked chicken with two sides and an extra side. The chicken was good, seemed a bit small. The dressing tasted like they added a pinch of sugar, not my thing. The Mac was cheesy but not flavorful which was odd. The greens were ok. They had alot of stems and a bit sweet for my taste. Overall,  it was ok. Would I go again? Probably not. The entire entree just lacked "soul". Something in the taste was missing.

This restaurant has the potential to be a gem, but unfortunately our experience was overshadowed by poor customer service. Our waitress had a negative attitude and argued with members of our family over how our order was taken. She then stated that we owed her an apology, which was surprising and uncomfortable.
We were visiting with family from out of town after church and expected a welcoming environment. Customer service is extremely important to me, and allowing staff to interact with guests this way reflects poorly on the restaurant. Sadly, this experience makes it a no for me.

I had catfish for the first time here and it was delicious! The chicken was fall off the bone, the yams were hot and savory, the cornbread was authentic, and the strawberry shortcake was sweet and creamy. The owner is very friendly and has done a great job with the place.

formatted_address: 3480 Bloomfield Rd, Windsor, ON N9C 1R6, Canada
name: Iffy’s kitchen

reviews.text: I was planning a party and didn't know which caterer to use. Iffys kitchen came recommended by a close friend. I was a bit skeptical because I had never tasted her food before. She met and exceeded my expectations. Her food is quite tasty and reasonably priced. I would recommend her strongly to anyone who wants good food for an event or for personal use.
Iffy’s Kitchen food is delicious and reasonably priced. The customer service is amazing! I would recommend you try one of her food option on the menu.

Unbeatable experience.
The best ever.
The food is grand mothers delicacies.
The more you eat, the more you want.
A trial will convince you,  no too much grammar just taste and be thankful.
Tasty meals and very professional and courteous customer service. I will recommend
The food from Ify’s kitchen tastes so good and you definitely get your money’s worth with the portions.

formatted_address: 6549 Woodward Ave, Detroit, MI 48202, United States
name: Joe Louis Southern Kitchen

reviews.text:
I stopped by during the winter holiday season with a friend and we were greeted & seated quickly. I enjoyed the Shrimp & Grits - it was flavorful by being well seasoned and balanced, so I got a taste of everything in everybite. The gravy samples the gumbo so it was like a 2-in-1. Very attentive & friendly wait staff - I appreciated hearing what she had favored on the menu and feedback about what the neighboring tables had ordered.
My friend asked for an accommodation on her plate and it was made.
There is a lot of nostalgic decor to take in. We had a short walk with on-street parking, but we'll worth the visit.

Lovely experience with delightful food! Was packed and very busy mid-day Saturday, but despite that the service was still timely and kind. The “Martha’s Seafood Skillet” was perfectly cooked, the shrimps were abundant, and the meal delightfully tasty. Same with the “Gratiot Street” chicken and waffles, literally looks just like the picture and tasted amazing. I also had the southern cheesy grits, which was so yummy and so cheesy!
The restaurant had a nice atmosphere, loved the decor. Staff were friendly and efficient. Would definitely go here again if in Detroit!

🌟 Southern Comfort with Detroit Soul – A Must-Visit! 🌟

Joe Louis Southern Kitchen is truly a breath of fresh air. From the moment you walk in, the nostalgic vibe wraps around you like a cozy family backyard gathering—complete with the aroma of home-cooked southern favorites that beautifully connect Detroit to its southern roots.

👋 Atmosphere & Service
The host and servers were vibrant, friendly, and made us feel right at home. Their energy matched the welcoming ambiance perfectly.

🍽️ Food Highlights
I ordered the Southern Cobbler French Toast with a side of cheese grits, and this combo did not disappoint!
- The French toast was thick, fluffy, and soaked up the syrup, powdered sugar, whipped cream, and cooked peaches like a dream. Every bite was a delightful blend of sweetness and comfort.
- The peaches melted into the toast, adding a soft, fruity richness that elevated the dish.
- The cheese grits were exactly what I hoped for—thick, creamy, and perfectly blended with cheese. Not runny, not bland—just right.

💰 Value
Considering the flavor, portion size, and overall experience, the price was more than reasonable. You get quality and comfort without breaking the bank.

💬 Final Thoughts
Joe Louis Southern Kitchen has earned a permanent spot on my list for southern comfort food. As long as they’re around, I’ll keep coming back for that soulful taste and welcoming atmosphere.

I am so glad the concierge at MGM Detroit recommended Joe Louis Southern Kitchen so highly! We found great parking right in front. Nice greeting when we arrived! Thursday at 10 am place was hopping! I had the second best French Toast of my life. The first was at The Meurice in Paris!  So delicious! I think with hints of cardamom! Thick cut bacon was fab! Real maple syrup! My son loved his shrimp and grits! Folks at the next table having literal platters of food! Delicious and huge portions!

I was greeted when I walked in. The restaurant was clean and the staff was friendly. I appreciated scanning the barcode for the menu. There were food options for everyone including me since I dont eat meat. My food came out hot. The bathrooms were clean. It was easy to find parking.

formatted_address: 1420 Washington Blvd, Detroit, MI 48226, United States
name: Bigg Bites Catering

reviews.text: We used Bigg Bites to cater our 100-person corporate event in July 2024. We were more than happy with their service and their food, both were excellent! We had Bigg Bites provide a breakfast (coffee, tea, juice, water, soda, bagels, pastries) and a lunch (lasagna, alfredo with broccoli and chicken on the side, garlic bread and a garden side salad), arrival and set up were prompt and on-time, everyone loved the food and the total bill was more than reasonably priced. Would definitely recommend and will be using again in the future.

Bigg Bites provided a 3-day dinner for the African World Festival 24 staff and crew and it was great! His communication, professionalism, and overall service was wonderful! Love doing business and would truly recommend to anyone looking for catering needs!

I had Bigg Bites Catering for my wedding and they did an amazing job! I had so many of my guests tell me how delicious the food was. They were professional from start to finish. They even went the extra mile and helped cut the wedding cake after my now husband and I cut the first slice. It truly took some stress off my shoulders. They also provide vegan options which was super important to me to offer to guests with diet restrictions. Thank you so much Bigg Bites Catering. You truly made our day so special!

I could not asked for better service. They were responsive, super respectful, and the food was incredible! They were so thoughtful to be prepared for our event, it was such a relief to be able to trust that Bigg Bites staff would take care of all the food setup so that I could focus on everything else. Darnell was so, so nice and so professional.  He went above and beyond to keep things neat and replenished. If you are looking for catering services,  this is it!

The level of professionalism of Darnell & his BIGG BITES team was unmatched. The food was delicious, served hot, with excellent presentation. I would definitely use their services again for future events. Thank you BIGG BITES LLC!

formatted_address: 725 Wyandotte St E, Windsor, ON N9A 3J5, Canada
name: IQLAS Restaurant - Halal Somali Cuisine

reviews.text: Highly recommend this place 👌 the food was amazing and the place was clean and tidy. The people that work their were so friendly and kind! I will definitely be coming back here. Good food reasonable price and great service!

IQLAS Somali Restaurant has great reviews, so I called to make a large order.  When I got there, the sign on the building didn't say IQLAS, it had a different name and said Nigerian restaurant.  The lady on the phone would not give me my total when I ordered. She said not to worry, a man will give me the price when I get there and "it won't be bad".  OK!  Well it turns out the price I was given was higher than what I was looking to pay.  But the worst part was getting home with my hungry group (all eager to eat Somali food), to find very plain rice and a super small serving of dry, rubbery, bone-in beef (we each only got 2 small pieces!  And one person got a piece of fish, which I didn't order).  My credit card statement shows a charge from HOLA Kitchen Africa.  I really don't understand how the phone number and address are the same as IQLAS restaurant, but they seem to be operating a Nigerian restaurant with a different name (and the phone number on their store sign is different).  I adore Somali food and this didn't resemble Somali food in any way.  Every person in our group was so disappointed.  I was almost in tears.

Really good quality Somali food! Reasonable prices and really flavourful hot sauce. Rice was delicious. Unique salad as well. Highly recommended,the components are homemade. Staff is incredibly friendly and attentive.
Great place to drop into for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

Really welcoming place to get some authentic Somali food. I was short on time and didn’t get to dine in and have that experience, but I got to enjoy their Sambus at home. Definitely would recommend coming here if you’re trying to experience authentic East African food.
Only Problem is most of time store remain close.

formatted_address: 60 University Ave W, Windsor, ON N9A 5N6, Canada
name: World Marathon Ethiopian

reviews.text: Fantastic food and service. I ordered the meat combination - the food was excellent and the portions were impressive. It is definitely more filling than it appears!

First time here. Service was great as the owner and his son took care of us and helped us with questions and suggestions.

This is an authentic restaurant so there are no utensils. You have a form of fluffy crepe that you are to pick up you your food with.

Food was very tasty. I would highly recommend for anyone that is a vegetarian. In fact I honestly enjoyed the vegetarian selections more than the meat. Favourite was the red lentils and the eggplant.

If you are looking for something different and truly authentic for Ethiopian food this is the place.

Been coming here for years! Authentic food - nice place - clean - hasn’t changed in about 15-20 years - nice dim lighting. Love sitting by the window to people watch while we eat.
But the food is the true star. Nothing else like it in Windsor. Lots of veggie options and delish meat options. I recommend the veggie or meat combo dinner for 1. So good. Great spot - couldn’t imagine downtown windsor without it. An absolute must-go with a dedicated group of people who have also been going here for years because it’s just such a staple.

Family owned restaurant. Fun place to share food and eat with your hands. The injera (crepe like bread) is your utensil. The vegetarian combination plate is a great way to try 5 of the vegetarian dishes. Great flavors and you can adjust the spiciness to your liking. Medium spice was enough. The sambosa appetizer was good but didn’t come with any dipping sauce. The drink menu is very basic but Two Oceans Sauvignon Blanc paired nicely with the spicy flavors. Prices are very reasonable.
Overall it’s a fun experience and a must try.

Went to the restaurant on recommendation of a friend. Was very surprised with the food. It was very delicious. We tried the Dora tibs and asked for it to be spicy. The Injera was super soft and a must try. The only problem was the service is very very slow. Would definitely look forward to trying some more dishes.

formatted_address: 26 University Ave E, Windsor, ON N9A 2Y4, Canada
name: Buna Bar

reviews.text:
Cozy Vibes & Quality Coffee – A Hidden Gem in Windsor! .
From the moment you walk in, you're welcomed by a warm, cozy atmosphere that makes it the perfect spot to relax, work, or catch up with friends with top-notch coffee .

During my layover in Adis Ababa I had the fortune to try Ethiopian food and ever since I have been on an hunt to find authentic Ethiopian food in Windsor aaand Buna bar is that place. Absolutely delicious food and perfect Ethiopian coffee along with the best host Salome and chef Lily

Excellent place, nice food and the best coffee ever, people there make the atmosphere from heaven.
A place to visit once and you will be addicted to

If you live in Windsor, or have passed through: how have you not already made this a regular stop during your week? The food is delicious, authentic, made with love. The coffee is all that and more. The owner is passionate about her roots, welcoming, knowledgeable, and humble. Get here already!
Loved this place! Ethiopian coffee served, incense and all! So fun learning about Ethiopian coffee ceremony today. Can’t wait to go back and try the food!

formatted_address: 1366 W Fort St, Detroit, MI 48226, United States
name: Sheeba Express

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Sheeba is truly a hidden gem! The food is absolutely delicious, with authentic Mediterranean flavors that stand out in every dish. The portions are generous, the prices are very reasonable, and the service is warm and welcoming. Everything about this place is exceptional. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and an amazing dining experience!

PLEASE stop premixing your salad with dressing. The salad I just ordered with my meal is soooooo gross and soggy and seems like it’s been soaking in dressing for hours. Just GO BACK to doing salads they way you used to. There was nothing wrong with that! I’m so disappointed cuz I love your salads. Please stop this!

The staff are friendly and very polite, and the food was really delicious. I'm a truck driver, so after dining in, I had to take three days' worth of food from these guys. I wish you were very close to a truck stop so that we could stop by.

Food: 3/5 (Not bad, but okay!)
Service: 5/5 (Kind and great service)
Atmosphere: 3/5 (standard hole in the wall, not bad.)

Great experience at Sheeba Express! Located in Detroit, Michigan, this place offers some decent Mediterranean food! I had a taste for some feta, so I tried it out.

The food was okay. I asked if they could make me some feta fries, and they did! I appreciate trying new things, but there were a lot of menu items to choose from. I tried a wrap with Mediterranean flavors, and it wasn't bad!

The service was awesome! The cashier has great energy, and the cooks compliment het well. The menu was explained well, and they went the extra mile in making sure I had good service.

The atmosphere was a little dull. There were a few seats, but I see this restaurant as more of a take out then dine in.

Great experience altogether! Sheeran Express is a great restaurant to try good Mediterranean food!

Very delicious food! Ordered the lemon oregano deboned chicken with a side of rice. Small place, good for pickups. Be careful with the owner or cook not sure who he is next door @ King Grill , came outside with a rude attitude about parking my car in the back since there was absolutely no street parking in the moment.

formatted_address: 5410 Vernor Hwy, Detroit, MI 48209, United States
name: Nepantla Food Trailer

reviews.text:
Wow! 10/10 a serious must-try!
Ordered this while apartment hunting since my boyfriend and I are relocating from St. Louis, and I’m so glad I did. The food was absolutely delicious, and I can’t wait to come back once we’re officially moved in! Pictured: the quesadilla and fries.

12 out of 10, this is hands down the best food in the land, authentic tacos but plant based, these unpretentious vegan tacos go the hardest and I actually think about them when i wake up sometimes. Chef Rocky is a magician. Huge fan, only hoping for the best for their establishment. My personal faves are cheesy jalapeño chorizo taco, “fish” taco, and fried avocado taco. All the sauces slap. We finally just had the “duck” fries and they were insanely delicious as well. I’ll stop, but do yourself a favor and hit up Nepantla

Had the privilege of having lunch at Neplantla today! This is a vegan authentic Mexican food experience you will not find anywhere else in Michigan (I have been vegan for over 6 years and have not found another place like this).  I got three tacos: the el pastor, brisket, and fish. Rocky is a very talented chef! The way she had figured out a ways to turn mushrooms into beef/ pork like options and a fricken banana blossom as fish is just culinary talent. The flavors with delicious. The presentation was beautiful with all the different colors from various toppings that were used. Sorry I didn’t get a pic because I gobbled it all down it was so good. Also, Rocky was so cool and personable and took the time to chat with me for a bit while I enjoyed my food. I will definitely be back again!

Shalom Shramitarians, It’s been a minute since I’ve enlighten you all on great places to catch a breakfast, lunch, brunch, or dinner vibe on the Shramitarian wild side all over the states and abroad coming to you really soon. Let’s get into it this is one of my favorite taco spots in SW Detroit to be exact, When I say this is NEPANTLA a small business with a large ambition in the kitchen 😂 they cater to Plant Based, Shramitarians, Vegans, and even your brother who likes Taco Bell 😂. Yes this is a food truck but it’s so much more of a experience like dating your food and the relationship with their tacos is on the verges of engagement they have a few new options that I’m sad to say I didn’t get a chance to experience but I’m sure it’s as 🔥 as my usual go to’s to go, That would be a fire 🔥 Fried Avocado 🥑 🌮 Taco Scroll through the pictures and videos I showcase below to check them out, as far as customer service it’s as top tier as the food’s representation very kind ppl I’ve had the pleasure to have conversation with the owner who accommodated me immensely I appreciate you for creating this opportunity to indulge in    a taco lovers dream coming true. I’m excited to tell you they have Mexican street corn and some lemonade that will tantalize your taste buds with the highest quality ingredients, so as always stop by their tell them Shram sent you and also save me some and in-joy

Pictures here is the yummiest Vegan  Lions Mane Brisket Taco with pricklely Pear BBQ Sauce topped with cilantro red onions and pickled red onions!
Prepared with love Chef Rocky

formatted_address: 1245 Griswold St, Detroit, MI 48226, United States
name: Leila

reviews.text:
I love this restaurant so much! It is my go to for upscale Lebanese food.

You really can’t go wrong, but I do love the ribs, the mixed grill, the meat “cigars”, the fattoush salad, the wings, and the fair floss dessert to name a handful of items. The fairy floss sundae was on the 2024 NYT list of best things we ate and is a magical combination of ice cream, rose water fairy floss and pistachios.

Service is about average or average plus but the vibe is incredible and the food itself is to die for. There’s also a very wide selection of Middle Eastern spirits not available many other places and some creative cocktails made with them.

Had an absolutely amazing dinner at Leila for our anniversary. I had heard so many good things, and we love Lebanese food. Leila did not disappoint. Everything was fresh and delicious. A very robust drink menu with creative cocktails - the Anne Hathaway and Don’t Call Me Shirley were so yummy. For food, we tried the bread, hummus, confit garlic, chicken wings and mixed meat platter. The meat was tender and juicy, and the sauces were on point. The service was attentive, and delivered special touches including a card and complimentary sundae for an anniversary treat. and the overall vibes were lively but cozy. Looks like they have an event space downstairs, which just adds to the offerings of the space. Can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend!!

Nice ambiance and staff. Appetizers were pretty good, I really liked them with drinks. They had a nice cocktail selection. I was not too crazy for the main dishes. (Being Middle Eastern, I’m used to this food - I will say that). Dessert was great.

I would be back for drinks and apps.

Great service! Food was good, but a few items just ok...for example: batta harra was recommended- but was nothing spectacular. The mixed grill was good but some of the meats were dry. Spent $300 on the 2 of us...so I expected outstanding on everything

We went to Leila for a girls night out and had the best experience! The food and drinks were absolutely amazing — especially the Anne Hathaway cocktail (a must-try!). But what really made the night unforgettable was the service. Raul was incredible — so attentive, friendly, and genuinely made us feel welcome. Demi was also so sweet and kind! Between the delicious food, fun atmosphere, and top-notch service, we’ll definitely be coming back soon!

formatted_address: 4870 Cass Ave, Detroit, MI 48201, United States
name: Ima Noodles

reviews.text:
I love this place so much.  The food is always amazing and quickly brought out.  You usually have to flag down your server but the quality of the food makes up for it.  My favorite is the pho, but the other dishes are amazing as well.  I would highly recommend coming for happy hour to get bao buns since you can't get them otherwise.

Miso sesame cucumbers, edamame (best item there), chicken karaage bites, togarashi tofu, and the rice chicharrones are all amazing appetizers.  Weekly rotating lemonade and mocktails are beautiful.  Chicken and vegetarian broth are great!  The braised pork is top tier.

Went there on a Friday night. Looooved the vibe and atmosphere! The Karaage chicken was finger licking good, it’s a must try.. I tried their Schezuan noodles before, it’s really good if you are not afraid of spices. The Curry yaki udon and Boombap was great too. Tokyo street fries really good..
The service was great as well. Great for a date night or celebration!

Oct 2025 update: I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve been here. It’s simply a great place with great food. This time I tried dessert — no disappointment. The beef pho is amazing; I still catch myself craving that flavor. The ramen and noodles are excellent too—I can honestly recommend every section of the menu. Also try the local pop and the mocktails, trust, you won’t be disappointed. Tea is also good.

Aug 2025:
The atmosphere and food here make it worth returning downtown every time. Service can be inconsistent, but I appreciate the unique style of the place and the friendliness of some of the wait staff.

Midtown is crawling with unique eateries, and Ima Noodles is definitely unique.  There's a large selection of main dishes like pho and rice bowls, shareable plates, Japanese soups, and more.  For someone like me who was experiencing this cuisine for the first time, I relied on my server, Mirielle, for guidance.  (She was fabulous and worked hard.)  I had the pho with extra chicken and the flavor combination was fantastic.  I wound up bringing half of it home - and enjoyed it later - because there was so much in the bowl.  My friend, who is familiar with Ima, had a udon dish and was very happy with it.  The dining area was comfortable, the clientele was decidely younger with its proximity to Wayne State University, and the place was clean.  I would definitely go back to try other items.

I tried ramen for the first time and ordered the Tori Ramen with pork loin and the pork was amazing, but I wasn’t a fan of the noodles. They were slightly undercooked. I also had a hibiscus refresher during happy hour that was really good, with a nice balance of sweetness and alcohol. Overall, a nice experience and I’d come back to try pho next.

formatted_address: 725 Wyandotte St E, Windsor, ON N9A 3J5, Canada
name: Hola Kitchen African Nigerian Cuisine

reviews.text: don’t usually leave bad reviews, but I have to be honest, this doesn’t feel fair. There was a special on Uber Eats for “buy 1 Jollof rice, get 1 free.” I’m not even concerned about the free one, but I paid $15.99 for a single portion, and the amount I received was shockingly small. My two-year-old finished one of the containers and was still hungry afterward. The portion size is just unreasonable for the price. What’s even more frustrating is that I noticed another reviewer received a much larger portion than I did clearly, the servings aren’t consistent
Burnt puff puff and rice is almost colourless. I couldn’t eat it please do better ok. I also ordered drink but it never came. Be very careful when ordering. Order at your own risk

Waooo, great restaurant , I enjoy myself, the food was delicious and rich with taste. I ordered for fufu and Egusi with assorted meats. It was delicious, the staff and the chef was very nice and pleasant. The meat pie and fish roll was delicious and tasty, my children enjoyed it Ummmm, I give it the chef. Overall the food tasted great.

They are not honest with how the food is prepared, I happened to get meat pies and asked whether they were fresh and made for the day. I was told they were however upon eating I found that they were not fresh. I should have seen it coming when she microwaved the pies before handling them over to me. All in all not pleased with the food and service.

The portion size was way too small for the price. One tiny piece of beef and a piece of chicken that tasted funny, did not finish it. The prepper soup barely had any soup. These portions were terribly small and unrealistic for the price.

formatted_address: 169-171 Spencer Rd, Londonderry BT47 6AH, United Kingdom
name: Sandys African Food Hub

reviews.text: We placed the order at 7.40. Understood the meal would take up to 45 minutes to create. 30£ for a single dish , assumed the portion size would cater for more than one. Had to call the restaurant 3 times as the delivery driver kept getting lost. Order arrived 2 and a half hours later. The 30£ portion wasn't enough to feed one. The onions were raw, the flavours didn't go together. Awful. Half of the meat in the dish was raw. One of the worst tasting things ever, along with the portion size. offered a few different people tasters, they weren't amused . So dissatisfied. Never again.
She is welcoming 🥰 and I ate peppered gizzard with coleslaw and Eguesi soup with pounded yam
Staff were lovely and caring, was really nice trying something new in the city. Would definitely recommend checking it out!

Had a friend tell us about here and not had goat in ages so wanted to try. Got the goat soup  which was amazing. The soups listed as spicy and is really spicy was great. We got the jollof rice and chicken and fish platter too both we're great but if you're funny about bones in fish I wouldn't get it (though it's a shame for you as the fish flavour was great)

First of all it was a friendly welcome in the restaurant and very beautifully decorated!
We ordered Okro with Garri & Porridge yam with fish. It was freshly made, plated up with love and tasted just amazing. Would definitely recommend trying their delicious food! On top of that our wee daughter was treated so friendly, danced with and cared for. We will come back to such a lovely restaurant!

formatted_address: 535 Oxford Rd, Reading RG30 1HJ, United Kingdom
name: Avilah Foods

reviews.text:
Avilah are amazing!!! We had them as our caterers for our wedding at the start of this month, and they were absolutely phenomenal. Everyone was talking about how good the food was, from taste, to presentation, to service, everything was top notch.

Our wedding was quite multicultural as I'm British Ghanaian and my wife is British South African, so we had a mix of West Africans, South Africans and British people at the wedding, with a large amount of them having never tried West African food before. Everyone loved the food and were up for seconds. My uncles and aunties seem to really appreciated the Ghanaian chef that Avila have part of their team, and so there were no complaints about the jollof 😂.

The service was brilliant, my wife and I had waiting staff following us around during the welcome drinks with our canapes making us really feel like royalty.

We also had so much food to take home at the end the night, and Avila provided us with takeaway boxes to ensure nothing went to waste.

We also had a fair few guests with a range of dietary restrictions and Avilah were able to cater for all with no issues.

Thank you Nikki and team for helping make our day so amazing!

Tried this place out with my mate this evening - admittedly after multiple drinks - and we both thought it was pretty good. It was very quiet but it's clearly more of a takeaway place than an eat in venue. We both enjoyed our food but nothing stand out. Service was a bit slow but we were happy in the main. Food was tasty enough but "presentation" could have been bettetr.

I had a lovely experience at Avila yesterday. The service was fantastic, atmosphere friendly and warm, the food was extremely good, far more than I expected. Everything from the meat pie, puff puff and the Ayamashe sauce was a 100% Delicious. I’ll definitely be back soon. Well done to the team👍

Exceptional Food by Avilah Catering (Wedding Event)
​Led by the wonderful Nike, Avilah delivered an outstanding service for our recent wedding. Given it was a mixed wedding, finding a caterer who could expertly manage both palettes and ensure every guest felt catered to was our top priority and Avilah not only met this challenge but excelled at it.
​The Positives: Quality, Quantity, and Care
​The feedback we received from our guests regarding the taste, quality of ingredients and quantity of the food was overwhelmingly positive on all fronts. Nike truly delivered on my primary request: ensuring no guest left hungry!
​The selection throughout the evening was superb, from the canapés right through to the mains and desserts. We went for the Family style option which was the best choice for us. The canapés were a personal highlight; they were inventive, delicious and perfectly sized, making them easy to enjoy despite the pre-weddinh jitters. The mini akara burgers, the large spicy prawns, mini (more like medium sized) Meatpies (5 star!) and the salmon blinis were standout hits and we appreciated that all selections catered to various dietary requirements seamlessly.
​Beyond the food, Nike provided an unexpected and genuinely kind gesture by offering takeaway packs for the guests. This was such a lovely touch that went above and beyond our expectations and was highly appreciated by everyone. Additionally, we must commend Nike's outstanding professionalism and crisis management when she stepped in to calmly resolve a tense moment involving separate bar staff over a misunderstanding about the glasswar. Her swift action diffused the situation and ensured our celebratory atmosphere was maintained.

​Areas for Growth
​While our experience was overwhelmingly positive, there were a few minor points of feedback we received that could elevate the service from excellent to flawless:

​Cutlery Quality: We received comments that the quality of the cutleries provided was not in line with the high standard of the food and presentation. Upgrading this small detail would significantly enhance the dining experience.

​Service Consistency: It was reported that one table was unfortunately skipped during the dessert service and were told they had run out of brownies. While I understand that Nike can't be everywhere at once,  the servers should also ensure consistent service flow across all tables for large events.

​Confirming Preferences: There was an instance where guests interested in the peppersoup were served tomato soup without confirming their preference beforehand. Double-checking guest choices, especially when two cultures are in the mix, would prevent disappointment.

In conclusion,
​Avilah Catering played a crucial role in making our wedding day a success. Their ability to manage diverse culinary, nagging aunties needs with such high quality, coupled with Nike's personal touch and genuine kindness, makes them a highly recommended choice. We are so grateful for their effort and the delicious food they provided.
​We highly recommend Avilah Catering.

Amazing food! Fantastic service! Wonderful presentation!
The Avilah team catered at my wedding a couple of months ago and it was just absolutely fantastic! The food came in abundance, our guests talked and raved about the quality of the ingredients and the variety of yummy food served even after the day!
Nike and team even packed a very hefty and full takeaway pack for both families and ourselves.
From our initial tasting session till the wedding day, Nike was extremely professional, going over every detail to make sure everything will run smoothly and it very much did.
We are super grateful for the attention to detail, professionalism and care that was shown to us throughout the process. I would highly recommend Avilah foods to anyone who wants and expects a high standard of food service on their special day!
Thank you so much Nike & team ❤️❤️❤️

formatted_address: 1539 Plainfield Ave NE, Grand Rapids, MI 49505, United States
name: Mizizi by Street Chef Shaw

reviews.text:
Awesome spot for great African fusion food. We ordered the skewers and shared dumplings.

They were amazing!

Cannot recommend highly enough.

I took off one star for atmosphere only because space is tight. It’s likely folks will want to consider taking out and eating at home. There are two cozy little tables.

Enjoy!

I don't generally write reviews but this place is as good as it gets. Came here for lunch. TO-DIE-FOR Birria tacos, BEST tacos I've ever had, hands down! And I'm from Los Angeles, the Taco City. It is so good that I'm coming back tonight for dinner. This place is WORTH the hype! I can't wait to try everything on the menu. Shoutout to Chef Shaw, working the front. Very friendly and down to earth guy. Fresh ingredients, cook to order. Great rewards program! Highly highly recommend this local small business!

Love their red pepper & cactus tacos! My boyfriend enjoys both the goat and beef tacos. He just recently tried the egg rolls and said they’re dank! We love coming and grabbing take out here. The staff are friendly and hard working. The food is delicious, unique, and prepared with love. The taste of the food is otherworldly and is a must try!

I've eaten here a couple times and each time it's been delightful.
Love the food, it's so flavorful and you can tell it was made with love.
It's a small place with limited seating, built more for take out than dining in, but when the weather is nice, you can eat your meal outside at the picnic tables.
The staff is friendly, the space is clean, all around great experience
Having lived in Kenya for 7 years, this place blew away my expectations. Such flavorful, artfully spiced, and delicious!  No Mama Mboga in East Africa comes close to cooking as well as Chef Shaw!

formatted_address: 339 Lyons Ave, Newark, NJ 07112, United States
name: Asanka Local

reviews.text: Was in the area after work and decided to stop in and get some food. I’ve never had African food before and was excited to try some for the first time! I had the jollof rice with chicken and I can’t describe how amazing it was. Michael and his sister cooked an incredible dish for me with tons of flavor and a large portion. This is definitely a restaurant you’ll want to try out if you’re ever in the area! 5/5 across the board 😀

The service was exceptional, however the food was nasty. It looks good until you taste it. It’s possible that it was stale. I got the peanut soup and Jollof Rice with goat meat but I received chicken. I couldn’t even finish it and unfortunately had to throw it out. So disappointed that I wasted money.

Haven’t even tried the food yet but I had to come on here and rave about Joyce! She was the most pleasant person, she made my son and I feel so welcomed and she explained everything with such kindness. It felt like I was going to a family’s house for dinner. Truly amazing experience so happy we came here!

I had been looking to go and try this place for about a month now and finally decided to do so today. Having grown up on Ghanaian food, I wanted to find a place I could go and Aksana Local is it.

First let me start with their customer service. 10 Stars!  Friendly and welcoming which I absolutely love.

I ordered jollof with fried croaker, plantain and peanut butter soup.  Amazing, flavorful and well prepared. The fish was fried perfectly ( sometimes people I know tend to fry the fish  toooo hard). The jollof was very good and the sauce to accompany it was extremely good. You could taste the ginger which I love.

A must try for anyone looking for Ghanaian food.

My son found egusi on tic tok and wanted to try. We ordered from one place it was ok. Then found this place and been a customer since. Food is great. Usually we order for delivery today I went in and service was welcoming. We ordered beef and 1 chicken egusi with fufu. Food fresh, tasty, filling.

formatted_address: 11 Clinton St, Newark, NJ 07102, United States
name: Ikoyi Restaurant and Lounge

reviews.text: Visited Ikoyi with friends for a birthday and really enjoyed the experience. It’s an upscale African restaurant and lounge with a great vibe that still feels welcoming and comfortable for everyone. The atmosphere is stylish and perfect for pictures (very Insta-worthy), the DJ adds to the lounge feel, and the food is flavorful and well made. Drinks were strong and enjoyable. Service can be a bit slow at times, but the staff is very kind, friendly, and accommodating, which makes up for it. Overall, a great spot for good food, drinks, and vibes.

The food was great and the service was okay, but the pricing structure makes me unlikely to return.

There was an automatic gratuity added to our bill (which brought our total to around $250 for three people), plus an additional $8 fee just for using a card. On top of that, we were still prompted to tip.

I understand the economy is tough, but adding $40+ in mandatory charges and then asking for more is excessive. Experiences like this confirm why I’m selective about where I spend my money. Will not be returning

Food was great!! Service was ok. Definitely a place you dine at earlier in the day, or early evening if you want to avoid the nightlife crowd. Only thing I didn’t like was not being given a receipt, because I didn’t see an automatic gratuity was added to the bill for a table of two, before I added an additional tip. Still remembering the smokey jollof till this day though!

Parking is tough in the area so if you can, take an Uber

I recently visited a modern, upscale West African-inspired restaurant, bar and lounge on a Saturday and had a great overall experience with a few minor issues. The ambiance was vibrant and cozy, with lively Afrobeat music and a smooth transition to classic hip hop/R&B by the DJ, along with live performance from a guy on a saxophone, creating a fun and energetic atmosphere. The food was flavorful if you a person who like spicy, with bold, distinctive flavors. My sister had the rasta pasta and said it was good but the chicken was super dry. She also had me try the Miss Montana frozen style that I personally like. My other sister had jollof rice and was pretty satisfied. The minor issues was the utensils were not clean, just make sure you request another fork and knife with a cup of hot water to disinfect yourself. I ended up eating the Efo Riro (Vegetable Soup) with my hands so when it came down to me going to the restroom to wash my hands, the water pressure was low and lukewarm. Despite these small setbacks, the vibe, music, and food made for a fantastic night out with the family and I would highly recommend it for anyone looking for a great combination of ambiance, entertainment, and tasty food.

Sidenote: They serve Hookah! ($45 cash and $50 card). Major shout outs to security and all the staff there! Most of them very welcoming and friendly.

I’ve been to this African restaurant multiple times, and it never disappoints. The food is delicious, I am obsessed with their chicken suya wings and Ayamase, everything I’ve had was perfectly seasoned.

The ambience is great, and the decor is beautifully done. It creates the perfect vibe for date night or night out with friends and even a large party dinner.

Each time I visit, I’m welcomed with genuine hospitality, which makes the experience even better. Overall, it’s a great spot, highly recommend!

formatted_address: 222 S 6th St #1, Newark, NJ 07103, United States
name: Mamakulu African Cuisine

reviews.text: I’ve been coming to Mamakulu for about a month and have already visited four times — the food never disappoints!
