reviews.text: OMG, I've never left a review before, but this place deserves a 10/5! It's the first Nigerian restaurant I've actually loved. The woman there was super sweet and even wrapped my food in foil to keep it warm (and it was still hot after my hour long drive to work!). I called right before they closed, and she was so nice on the phone and in person. And the food... it was amazing, like home cooked food. I got ogbono with tons of stockfish and assorted meats. It wasn't expensive, and the portions were huge!

O.M.G! It has been YEARS since I have had an experience at a restaurant from the time I call my order in to enjoying the food that was absolutely WONDERFUL!
I called to place my order and the woman who answered the phone was kind and patient.(first time in my life having Nigerian food) she called me sweetheart and that gave the extra feeling like you know who ever is in that kitchen is making your food with love.
I walked in , the place was really clean and welcoming.
Everyone was extremely nice and you can tell they take pride in what they serve. I got the eghusi soup and pounded yam. It was so damn good. I’m an hour away and will gladly make the trip back to try more of their food.
(P.s. the whole damn family could be models. Has nothing to do with the food but they were so beautiful, all of them lol)

I picked my order yesterday at the store after stalling to place an order for about a month. I was attended to by a young lady who was helpful. She even advised I held the bag from the bottom which was smart. I had the Singapore noodles and it was excellent. The taste of sesame oil infused in the mix, the truck load of seafood and chicken. It kinda felt like protein with a side of noodles 😂😂😂
The stew was good too. Everything was tasty and fresh.
I rarely enjoy food from restaurants as they all usually don’t taste home made and they use too much seasoning but this food was exceptional.
I hope their space gets bigger soon to accommodate dine in.

The food here is absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I especially love mama J3’s seafood okra soup.
The service is prompt, and the portions are generous.
Finally found a very good restaurant for ayamase in NJ. Everything was so delicious. Thank you and keep up the great work. Looking forward to catering from you

reviews.text: I ordered from grubhub. The food was not bad. I ordered fufu, egui soup, puff puff and a meat pie. They give really great portions. However, when finishing my fufu, I noticed a small bug deep in the fufu and screamed!! From what it looks like, it might be a baby roach. I was devastated because I already ate majority of the food. I still had a lot of fufu left because there was so much. The bug was really hard to see I thought it was just a speck or apart of it I had to dig it up to the surface. I never experienced anything like this before so I’m still in shock wondering how it was possible for it to get in there. I’m hoping I don’t get sick or have ingested anything. Their food is decent and not bad, especially the eggs I soup and puff puff. However, I will not be ordered again because now I’m scared. So disappointed because they seemed like a decent place and gave me a nice book with the order. Even came in a nice bag.

I called into Ounje Alabeke for a bulk order of Amala-Abula and was seriously impressed! My order was ready in under 30 minutes, and the quality was top-notch. Everyone couldn’t stop raving, there was finger-licking and even bowl-scraping going on with that delicious stew 😆. The portions were generous too. I’ll definitely be recommending Ounje Alabeke to all my NJ people. A true gem!
I ordered from ubereats and in store too. Both times, the food was really amazing and fulfilling. Well worth the price. Will definitely visit again.
I will never order from this place ever again. I ordered through door dash, the jollof rice was manageable but the beans I ordered was stale and had a strong smell.

I’m giving a five star review cus it’s five star or nothing, I tasted her jollof rice and egusi for the first time at a party and it was superb and I said to myself despite the distance from Binghamton NY if we have any event we will be ordering from her. Then I reached out to her about an upcoming event and she did excellently well. Everyone keeps talking about how great the food was. Thank you Ounje Alabeke 🫶🫶🫶

reviews.text: Every order from Twale's kitchen is a culinary adventure. The flavors are vibrant and authentic, transporting me to different parts of the world. The food is consistently delicious. I appreciate the complex blend of spices and the fresh, high-quality ingredients. I'm always impressed by the quality and taste of the food. Not sure how this restaurant has 5 stars. The food is absolutely horrible. I got efo riro and it was nasty, I was given these barely 2 pieces of meat with bones and there was still hair on the meat that wasn’t cleaned. On top of that the Jollof was dry, plantain as you can see appeared and tasted old like it had been made days prior and was microwaved. Absolutely won’t be returning. Do better.

Orders the spaghetti delight with Suya, came hot and well packaged. Guys the flavour is hereeee, so tasty and portion of meat to spaghetti is perfect. However the egg tasted spoiled, so I threw it out. FYI I already ate some in the pic below but the bowl came full.
Delicious food. I've tried most things on the menu and they never miss. My favorites are the spaghetti, punded yam and egusi. They don't miss!

I absolutely love the food at Twale's Kitchen! It's like the tongue in their logo is savoring every bite, just like I do. Their Zobo and Chapman are always a delightful reminder of the flavors of home. Highly recommend!

I don't live in the area but definitely worth the trip. I ended up there to meet up with some friends and was thoroughly impressed - can't wait to try the rest of the menu.

We got the Thieboudienne ( fish w vegetable , had wondeful flavor / excellent ) and  also the fish with acheke (fish w grated cassava , flavorful totally delicious). We also got the bissap ( sorrel juice ). I enjoyed all the flavors and we really enjoyed all our food.

I like the food African very delicious!!
Casa a Leaf Amazing, Joloff rice - OMG! Great price, service and comfortable African comfort food right in Jersey City!

I love the shrimp an oxtail quesadilla just rocking never had anything like it before, just had a lil mix up I went before an paid 26$ for it but went back an they said it was 34$😬 other then that food was great
One of the best meals we've had! Soo delicious! We will definitely be going back! We drove 45 minutes to try this place, but totally worth it!! You must go here!!
Beef, shrimp, chicken & oxtail tacos were great. Each order had a generous side of jollof rice which was also good. Omar took good care of my parents ordering for their first time.

formatted_address: 88 Albany St, New Brunswick, NJ 08901, United States
name: Dashen Ethiopian Cuisine & Bar

reviews.text: The food was really good. Just fyi there is a $10 plate share (if you want to split an entree with someone) which I know very few restaurants do but I wish it wasn’t done here especially since Ethiopian cuisine is not ubiquitous so some people are trying for the first time, like me and may not be comfortable having an entire meal and would rather share. But I won’t take away stars for this since they likely have a business-wise reason. Besides that, the food was really good glad I got a chance to try.

When I say this is *the best* Ethiopian food in a while, I’m not exaggerating. The lamb and the CABBAGE AND POTATOES, and the beef is just so insanely good. The seasoning is amazing and the injera is great.
Only downside is the service - take out is best if you want to just enjoy your food and not deal with the slower service and $10 share fee.
I grew up eating Ethiopian food and this is some of the most well prepared, seasoned, and delicious food I’ve had in a while. Thank you so much for bringing great Ethiopian food to our community, I will always make time to stop by when I’m in town.

I ordered the veggie combo for 2; the food was good. I was not a fan of the plating. Instead of each item placed on the plate twice (one for each person) it was 1 large serving of each item.

The honey wine is served in a traditional berele which I liked, but I did not like the wine at all. Tasted house-made and under fermented. I recommend if you’re into liquid sugar.

They played Spanish music in the Ethiopian restaurant 🙄

The waitress either checked too frequently or barely, no in between.

This is the worst ethiopian spot I’ve ever been to, but it’s decent for take-out/uber eats.

Ideas for improvement:
Better plating
Actual East African staff
Training wait-staff to be appropriately attentive (do they have clean napkins?)
Giving wet-wipes with the check (customary with finger-food dining)
Play  Ethiopian music.

As some people already said the quality changed drastically. I was there in Dec 2025 and was just now looking if  other people also noted the difference or if I just had a bad day tasting. In the past the dishes had a nice complexity of flavour, now everything is more blend and in my opinion not worth the money anymore. Such a pitty, it used to be one of the best restaurants I knew.

Best Ethiopian restaurant!! Food is always delicious, service is great. Highly recommend. Menu could be overwhelming if not use to Ethiopian food, but the staff will help you based on your likes. Everyone we ever took here loved it.

formatted_address: 1027 Dillerville Rd, Lancaster, PA 17603, United States
name: Awash Ethiopian Cuisine

reviews.text: Whether you're a foodie or you just want a fun place to go with friends awash Ethiopian cuisine is a great choice.  I went with a group of friends and it did not disappoint.  The food was flavorful  and there were enough options so that our entire group could find something whether they were vegetarian or had zero spice tolerance.  The ambiance was great with the area decorated up to the gills and creates a really nice vibe and even though it was empty when we went there was great energy.

This is an experience you don’t want to miss. The building is a little humble and in need of some TLC but the food itself, the service, and the experience are really cool and unique. Try the honey wine and lamb tibs.

Lancaster is lucky to have this gem...Very delicious authentic Ethiopian food. The owner was very nice and served us a large sharing platter, as my friend and I ordered differently and could share..the bread was very good, using it to scoop up the food. I ordered lamb tibs, served with cabbage and potatoes,  yellow, green and red lentils, green beans and carrots..a hearty amount of food, my friend ordered the chicken, with similar sides..
There were 2 hand washing stations to wash up before eating..the restaurant is nicely decorated with beautiful items from Ethiopia..I highly recommend this restaurant.

Delicious food. Compared to other Ethiopian restaurants I have been, the food is flavorful and not overly wet or greasy. The restaurant is well set up with hand-wash sinks in the dining area. Recommend asking the waiter for more injera.

I would like to clarify that my favorable assessment is not solely based on my Ethiopian heritage; rather, it stems from my comprehensive understanding of the authentic culinary experience we offer. I was fortunate to be raised with a strong appreciation for quality and tradition. The dishes we serve are not only exceptional but are also prepared with the utmost care and efficiency, ensuring that each meal is packed thoughtfully.

Ethiopian cuisine, known for its rich flavors, indeed requires time to prepare properly, which is essential for achieving the best taste. Under the new management, I have seen significant improvements in our service quality. Each team member is dedicated to upholding the cherished traditions of Ethiopian culture.

I invite you to visit and savor their finest offerings. To the management team, I commend you on your ongoing efforts. Strive for continuous improvement in all aspects, including time management, customer ambiance, and the selection of music. It is important to serve our guests with humility and maintain a clean environment. Excellent work thus far—keep up the great momentum.

formatted_address: 96 Washington St, West Orange, NJ 07052, United States
name: Yeshi's Juice & Mart

reviews.text: If you’re looking for healthy, fresh and tasty takeout, please visit this eatery. I found this place after a hair appointment nearby and was pleasantly surprised. I ordered the Acai Bowl with granola, strawberry, mango, pineapple, peanut butter, nutella and honey along with a Quinoa salad with spinach, tomatoes, red onions, carrots, chickpeas and pumpkin seeds. DELICIOUS!!! Very refreshing and reasonable priced. I expected to pay around $25-30 but it was $18. The eatery was lovely with an area to eat your meal. There were Ethiopian items for purchase as well. Service was great and the space was very clean and well maintained.

I always order the veggie combo on Uber Eats because I’m vegetarian and finding something good, filling, and flavorful isn’t always easy for a good price.

I don’t normally go out of my way to leave reviews but this place is AMAZING!!! EVERY TIME! Just one box is enough to share, AND HAVE LEFTOVERS! Never had any issue with ANY order I’ve placed and that’s mind blowing in a good way. I appreciate these people, and the competitive price point. #1 spot to eat in my opinion.

Healthy, reliable, delicious, clean, great quality and quantity at a fair price, thank u!!!
First time coming here. The food was good. I ordered the Sambusa x 3 and the RESTART 20 Oz. It was delicious.  The service was good, too. I will definitely be back.

I’ve been here several times and I’ve always enjoyed my experience. The food is truly delicious. But today, I had a really unfortunate experience with customer service.I placed the order at 10:20.  When I got there at 10:35, she had no idea I had placed an order and didn’t appear to even know how to access online orders. After having to call her boss, she finally started making my two salads. In the middle of still making the salads, a lady who seemed to be a friend of hers, walked in and wanted to purchase some injera, so she stopped making my salads and rang her up (as opposed to finishing my order first). It was finally ready at 10:55. It just completely defeated the purpose of ordering ahead of time. She didn’t offer any type of discount or gift card. I didn’t even get an apology.
Beautiful new place in west orange. My favorite drink here is the first responder. I can not go a day without it. I truly recommend you visit. This is definitely a healthy option.

formatted_address: 4 Branford Pl, Newark, NJ 07102, United States
name: Taste of the Caribbean Restaurant & Catering

reviews.text:
I work right down the street and always passed by this spot but never tried it. Yesterday, I was craving some Jamaican food and said let me give it a try. I usually order my Jamaican food from Uber Eats because there’s no Jamaican restaurants downtown Newark, but I said let me give this local restaurant a try. The outside of the restaurant is very cute which is what drew my attention but that doesn’t always translates to good food. I know we’ve all been catfished by a cute restaurant with a vibe before, but after reading other reviews I knew I could go wrong.

This spot is a hidden gem! It’s small but super cute and very clean. You can tell they take pride in keeping the place nice and welcoming. From the moment I walked in, the smell alone told me the food was going to be amazing and it did not disappoint. I order the oxtail lunch special which was $20. It comes with rice and peas and 1 side which I chose cabbage. I added a second side, plantains for an additional $2. My total came to $23.46. The oxtails were perfectly cooked: tender, juicy, and seasoned with that rich, deep Jamaican flavor. They were perfectly seasoned and falling right off the bone. The gravy was incredible. It was some of the best oxtails I’ve ever had. I could eat the gravy alone on some rice and peas. That’s how good it was. 😮‍💨

The plantains were sweet and caramelized just right. Just like way I like them. The cabbage had the perfect balance of flavor and crunch. The portions were generous, and everything tasted homemade and authentic. You can tell the chef really knows what they’re doing and takes pride in every dish.

Service was friendly and warm.  They made me feel welcome the second I stepped in. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more of the menu, but those oxtails alone are reason enough to keep me coming back! I’ve found my new favorite Jamaican restaurant. It was definitely love at first bite. 🥰 I will be back again soon!

My only regret is that I did not ask for the gravy on the rice and peas. 🥹 Rookie mistake! Won’t let it happen again! 🤍

Best Jamaican beef patty I’ve ever had. Ordered stewed chicken and WOW, so flavorful and tender. The potatoes in the stew were so good I wish they served that as a side on its own. Will be coming back regularly for siren

I got oxtail It was tender and tasted amazing . Sweet plantains was sweet and juicy ! Rice was a bit dry but had good taste. Mac and cheese was cooked differently . They melt cheese and put bread crumbs irs eatable but I wouldnt but it again . I’m def going back

First time here, walking in off the street of Newark into this little hidden gem brings me back to the caribbean.
Was greeted with warm smile.
I didn't have much time so I got myself some beef and chicken jerk beef patties and a Jamaican ginger beer.  Flavor and texture were perfect. Just the right amount of spice.
Can't wait to come bac
Love this place. They were able to add jerk chicken to my Rasta pasta so that I wouldn’t have to buy to separate meals. Amazing taste and amazing customer service. Definitely coming again.

formatted_address: 641 Montgomery St, Jersey City, NJ 07306, United States
name: Alyce

reviews.text: I enjoyed a scrumptious and cozy ribeye for my frigid January birthday night. The salad, app and dessert hit the spot too, and my husband devoured the Chicken Makhani. Our attentive server made the experience feel so special, and the atmosphere is lowkey. We love it here!

We've passed by this gem far too long. Finally sat down for a Saturday brunch with no reservations and was blown away. They are friendly and the music was just right. I would highly recommend reservations for brunch but we were lucky to be seated. I highly recommend the Southern take on Shashuka. The grits were fluffy and the

Very enjoyable experience. Eclectic menu, with great little tips from the servers. Excellent service (probably the best we’ve received anywhere). No overbooking, no long wait times. Very well, managed with plenty of staff and attention to detail.

Everything on the menu was clearly homemade. From the sauces to the marination of the meats to the dishes, items are prepared in-house. It shows in terms of taste. Nothing was standard and everything was worthy of repeating. Would definitely come back to again.

The owner personally came out to speak with us and explained a bit more about his philosophies. Very authentic and personal experience.

We stopped by this quaint shop with a rustic feel. The bread was nice and warm. The beef was well marinated and mixed with the bell peppers over eggs. The lox was unexpectedly warm with a side of mixed greens salad.
The service was fairly fast - we ended up pouring our own waters

Food was bland. Like, no salt bland. Not to mention both the indoor and outdoor dining environment can only be described as hostile.

We got an NJ Farmer ($24) with eggs, sausage and hashbrown. The hashbrown tasted like boiled potatos, there was not even a hint of flavor or salt. My boyfriend had to add a whole bottle of green hot sauce and ketchup to compensate for the lack of flavor.

The Shakshuka ($21) with sourdough was edible because it at least had some spices to it. But half the Shakshuka was filled with Grit and also came with a side of Grit that tasted like bland congee that had been left out overnight.

We were first seated at the counter right next to the kitchen, but I could not stand the smell of oil and smoke. Also, the lack of ventilation and aircon was suffocating. We requested to move to a different table and were seated outdoors, but we were instead baked outdoors by the blinding sun. Our table had no umbrella and we sat in the 90 degree heat and sun for 30 mins eating our bland hashbrowns and grit. It was an authentic NJ farmer’s experience.

The only decent thing about the restaurant was the server. He was kind enough to check up on us and apologized for the seating environment and the food.

I don’t get why it got such high praise from ratings and reviews.

formatted_address: 772 Springfield Ave, Irvington, NJ 07111, United States
name: JAB AFRICAN RESTAURANT

reviews.text:
Inconsiderate of people time and too expensive. First and last time going.
False advertisement on windows and menu.
And food seemed to be cooked a day or two before serving. Rice hard..chicken under cooked/ chewy. Some pieces over cooked.
Order rice and chicken, simple dish
Would not recommend. And I do try to support my brothers and sisters but this isn't acceptable.

Thank you, blessings too all

formatted_address: Dwight Plaza, 139-157 7th Ave, Newark, NJ 07104, United States
name: Beyond Soul Restaurant

reviews.text: Beyond Soul was BEYOND PERFECT. All food is zabiha halal, flavorful to the max, soft, tender and juicyyyyyy and the owner is super sweet. The spot is inside a supermarket and there is one large table to enjoy your meal albeit a bit low but hey the more hole in the wall a place, the better the food and the food was indeed mindblowingly good. The BBQ ribs were cut up into pieces which made it so easy to consume and the meat was tender and soft. This was a chunky cow thank god because there was plenty of meat on the bone. I usually hate fat and always take it off but I ate it ALL because it was all just too delicious. It was melt in your mouth and I didn’t mind its presence one bit. The BBQ sauce was actually perfect, not too barbecuey and not too sweet. Excellent. Excellent. This Mac and cheese was one of my favorites amongst the plethora of soul food spots I’ve visited in the past and the Rasta pasta was SPICYYYYY and I LOVED IT. Best Rasta pasta I’ve had! Got it with some jerk chicken and it was a flavor overload. Chicken was juicy and there was a generous helping over it overtop. The potato salad was a texture I had never seen before, almost puréed which was so intriguing. Even the parmesan fries were killer. Fantastic flavor on everything. I loved how thoughtfully everything was packaged. To prevent any spillage of my potato salad into my Mac or my ribs, there was a piece of parchment paper placed atop and every container was wrapped with plastic wrap to keep it closed. And as I mentioned before my ribs were cut off for easy eating so the extra little step was absolutely noted and appreciated. Open in NYC!!!! Until then I’ll be dreaming about the day I can return.

Came in with a party of 14 right before closing and they still welcomed us with nothing but kindness. The food was amazing, fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. What stood out even more was the customer service. The owner was incredibly kind, checked on us personally, and genuinely thanked us for choosing to eat there. You could tell they truly appreciate their customers and take pride in what they do. It meant even more knowing this is a Black owned business that deserves support. If you’re looking for great food, real hospitality, and a place that values its community, Beyond Soul is it. I’ll definitely be back.
Beyond Soul is a hidden gem in Newark. The menu has all the souls food classics and the prices are decent.

I was five seconds from ordering wings from Popeyes, but I decided to try something new and boy was I pleasantly surprised!! I got the 10pc buffalo wing dinner with mac and collard greens and it was ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS! Best food I’ve had since moving to jersey I will definitely be a repeat customer.

I’m from New York so moving out to Jersey 4years ago I have never been able to find a good soul food place came across this gem from Instagram raving about it and baybeeee NOT ONE LIE HAS BEEN TOLD. My go to is the fried fish which is well SEASONED, Mac n Cheese, yams and their fried chicken. Pricing is reasonable and they have fish deal Fridays. They been keeping me broke this week due to my laziness but it’s all worth it… they will be catering a few things for me during the holidays….

formatted_address: 677 Bergen St, Newark, NJ 07108, United States
name: AFRICARIB GRILL

reviews.text: Rude, disgusting, biligerant and ignorant service towards customers. Unprofessional, lack of time management: will hurry to cook your food in a rush to meet time restraints and all around a terrible place to order from. Hopefully this reaches someone before somebody gets sick 🤞🏾.

Small portion
But taste is very good
Not to salty but seasoned well
Taste like home cook food

formatted_address: 1253 Springfield Ave, Irvington, NJ 07111, United States
name: CHEFTEEKAY LLC

reviews.text: I have ordered from here at least a handful of times, the food is great and the service is nice. I just wish the prices were consistent. Sometimes I pay a couple extra dollars on the exact same order. Aside from that It would’ve gotten 5 stars.

As I love 2 support new black owned businesses, the excitement is palpable... the disappointment always come in wen u actually patronize the business. Most of the time customer service is always the down fall.. it took the server over 15 mins to acknowledge me & take my order. Once order was placed, I payed & she gave a wait time of 25 minutes as all meals r prepared to order.. I return 35 mins later & u hear chef Teekay ask wat was my order. The server came back out 2 ask take my order again. Like wait wat. So all this time I've been waiting my food wasn't not being made 😡. Chef Teekay came out & apologized asking to give her 10 mins. Which turned into another 30 mins. It took over an hr to get my food. Lawd knows if I hadn't prepaid my $75 order I would've left. Mean while others r walking n & picking up their orders wit no problem.. smh
Food was good but definitely not worth the disrespect nor wait!
I ordered: egusi soup with chicken laps (delicious but not enuff egusi, I had more chicken then anything else)
Fried salmon, jollof rice & seafood salad (salmon delicious, jollof was waayyy too smokey & tasted off, seafood salad was more like mayo salad used waayy to much mayo)
Chicken Shawarma (flavors were good, but it definitely wasn't shawarma, it was loaded with coleslaw).. & didn't have a bit of middle eastern or shawarma flavor. I assume cuz she used shawarma wrap she named it shawarma!

The first time I tasted her food was fried rice,the pastries are nice too. I dont compromise when I cook ,I use herbs and spices so when I eat a good food I know. I know it's not easy to run a business please dont compromise, your crowd would find you! As for the people complaining about price and time order ahead via ubereat or doordash there is always an offer or try buying gift cards from cvs or groupon,use fetch and ibotta for cash back. If u need a referral let me know. A chef is different from a cook!!!

I was at this restaurant a few days ago, ordered the jollof rice and goat meat on the side - delicious!!! I craved that smoky jollof again today with goat meat and peppered fish. The fish was just fried with a small scoop of stew on it:( The rice and meat were the same except I got some pieces of goat meat stewed and some not stewed which is a bit disappointing as the stew is really good. I think they need to work on being consistent.

I ordered the grilled turkey wing also the pepper turkey cuts and the soft delicious coconut doughnuts… Absolutely delicious!!!
I will be ordering from this spot again !!! I give it a 10 out of 10

formatted_address: 55 Park Pl, Newark, NJ 07102, United States
name: The Yard

reviews.text:
Highly recommend this place 100%. The staff here was on top of their service, especially right after a show at the NJPAC theater. Small dining room, but made up for the very nice servers and attentive care they put on their customers. Food was fantastic, sauces are DELISH! Burgers are amazing. Cauliflower tots just as amazing. Very transparent on what they have to offer.
Black owned business as well, love being able to support 🙌🏼
Much love to yall!

Amazing first experience at the yard. Came here with some coworkers for lunch and was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem. Staff were super friendly and helpful when placing our orders.  Also, they would always come check on us and made sure our drinks were always filled. Superb service!

I ordered the seoul sista fried rice. Beautifully plated with a flower in the bowl. The fried rice was made with kimchi that wasn't overly spicy and a large fried egg on top. The Yaya sauce was creamy and paired well with everything. Overall, loved the dish!

My coworkers ordered the oxtail sandwich, the walla chicken and the chopped thigh wrap. Everyone loved their dishes and want to come back to try the other dishes.

Lastly, we ordered the grilled coconut cake. This is definately a MUST try! First time having a grilled cake and I can say I've been missing out!

Had the Fish Fillayyyy with cut-fries, very very tasty. The fish filet sandwich was great and also,  that Walla Sauce I was dunking the cut-fries into was SUPER tasty.

The staff service was excellent. Very attentive and friendly.

Ended up ordering "The Breast" to go and had every intention of having it for dinner but... it's just too damn tasty. Eating it now. 5/5 stars. nom nom nom

Keep up the good work, thank you for existing and also for being open on xmas eve. :)

the warm welcome from the ultra friendly staff set the atmosphere for a meal filled with layers of flavor, spice and the right touch of heat. get the walla sauce and put it on EVERYTHING you will not regret it. save room for the coconut cake, slightly grilled , warm with a moist crumb *chef’s kiss* this is a meal I will say dream about for a long while. can’t wait to come back to Newark, thanks to the yard

If you’re seeing a show at the NJ Performing Arts Center and are looking for a bite, this is the place. Even if you aren’t seeing a show and are nearby, this is the place.

I grabbed their chicken sausage roll before a show. It was so good I had to come back again after—to my memory I don’t think I’ve ever done the same restaurant twice in a day. Their fried chicken sandwich was one of the best I’ve had in recent memory (photo included), and they’ve got *sweet potato tots*—nuff said.

Many thanks to Owner Kai and The Yard staff will definitely be back again🔥🔥🔥

formatted_address: 73 Warwick St, Newark, NJ 07105, United States
name: Casa d'Paco

reviews.text: The food was good and the sangrias were amazing. The service was excellent. Our waiter gave us some recommendations that ended up being our favorite tapas. The crab-vocado and the chipirones were really good. Would definitely recommend for some sangria and tapas.

I really enjoyed my visit here! Every dish was full of flavor, and the presentation showed real care. The menu focused on a smaller selection, yet each item felt thoughtfully crafted and satisfying. The atmosphere added to the experience, making it a great place to relax and enjoy good food with friends.

This is a nice restaurant in a quiet neighborhood. There is a big selection, if you are a meat eater. For vegetarians, it’s mediocre, at best. I have decided to boycott any restaurant that tells me they will just take a dish from the menu, but put in vegetables to make it vegetarian for me. This lacks forethought and usually the dish arrives very bland. So when the waitress said she could remove everything from the paella and just add some vegetables, it was a pass for me. The suggestion of, you could have a salad is an insult. The meat eaters at our table liked the food.

The service was good, and the atmosphere was nice, which made for an enjoyable experience. The food was tasty, but I did expect a bit more variety on the menu. It felt like the tapas were mostly turned into larger plates, which was interesting but not quite what I was hoping for.

Overall, I had a great time, and the food was well-prepared. Even with the menu feeling a bit limited, everything we ordered was delicious.

Hitting all the marks! Clouds of potato croquetas, delicate paprika’d morsels of pulpo, sweet skilled bartenders and what, Maria cookies dessert! Unpretentious fun spot with authentic Spanish food in Newark!

formatted_address: 47 Ferry St, Newark, NJ 07105, United States
name: Fornos of Spain

reviews.text:
Incredible food. The portions serving size is very generous. I loved their spanish yellow rice, the seasoning, in my opinion, is to live for.

Their fried calamari is very crunchy and rich with the sauce they give.

The bread also has a nice unique flavor twist to it, of course the butter is a solid accompanament.

I got the lamb, it is tender (~$45), but I prefer the steak since it was more on the juicy/flavorful side.

Overall, excellent choice for a fancy dinner together with friends and family. I loved the soothing and relaxing atmosphere. They also do free delicious surprise dessert for birthday celebrations.

This is absolutely one of my favorite Spanish restaurants! I have been here more than three times.

The food is always amazing. The fig dessert is delicious, and the complimentary salad is fresh and comes in a huge portion! The main dishes are aromatic and flavorful.

I especially love the complimentary Churros served with hot chocolate sauce at the end—they are so good! The Basque cheesecake is also a must-try.

Last time, a manager noticed how much I enjoyed the churros and kindly brought us an extra portion. I was so touched and grateful for the gesture. Highly recommend this place for the great food and wonderful service!

Amazing Spanish food and great ambience.

Great place to have lesiurely long dinner..
For appetizers had the shishisto peppers and lobster crockets.

For mains has Paella and T Bone steak with home serving of Spanish chips , rice and streamed veggies.

For dessert , we tried the caramel flan and a curtado.

The food , the service and the ambience was top class.

It has been years since I have been at Fornos of Spain. So many changes.  All great. Service is still top notch. Atmosphere is amazing. Food will never disappoint. I had the Veal Osso Buco. Amazing! Resting on a bed of mashed potatoes. Delicious! Their perfectly seasoned vegetables and famous fried potatoes for the table. My wife had the stuffed flounder. I finished with a Pastel de Nata (couldn't wait to take a bite) and espresso. She had the Flan and a capochino. If you visit the Ironbound section of Newark you need to visit. Oh... did I mention the cigar lounge?

The best place ⭐️
The salad and the churros for default are delicious
We went to the restaurant to celebrate my husband’s birthday they charged me a fee for bringing cake but it was worth paying for it because I liked the service too much.
We will definitely return, the sangria is delicious
The chicken is delicious too. Also We got a large portion for each dish however the paella 🥘 was not my favorite.

formatted_address: 683 Springfield Ave, Newark, NJ 07103, United States
name: The Weekend Spot Restaurant

reviews.text:
I was near the area and wanted to give this place a try. I ordered online the southern baked chicken, collard and cabbage mix and yellow rice and it said about 30 to 40 minutes and it came to $14.66. I arrived at the restaurant about 20 minutes later and walked in and a few people were waiting. The nice young man Jay said it wasn't ready. As I waiting the line got longer and longer. I waited about 40 more minutes for my food. The wait was ridiculous and the communication was terrible. Yes the server was very nice but that wait will keep me from returning. When it was done I grabbed my food and uptown and left.

As I drove home I drank some of the uptown and it was ok. When I got home and ate the baked chicken was good and so was the yellow rice.  The collard greens and cabbage was a bit salty. All in all I only had an ok experience.

Communicating with The Weekend Spot about catering my baby shower has been the most unprofessional customer service I’ve encountered. I was introduced to them from a gender reveal where they catered not long before I contacted them. I was emailing catering Director Rachel on scheduling a tasting which I was willing to pay for with the understanding that 15% is credited towards the catering bill. Cool. She said her chef wasn’t available on the days I selected and to provide other days. Once I responded I stopped hearing from Rachel. I followed up again via email a few days later to receive no response once again. Calling them is out of the question because I have been calling and leaving messages to get no response from the very beginning. I even went out of my way to stop by the restaurant during the business hours listed on google not once but twice on a Saturday after communication ceased to see that the gate was down. Before deciding to go with another company I hit them up on Instagram to again receive no response. It is truly a shame that when trying to support a black business I encountered such unprofessional. I was willing to spend over $1000 in catering at the recommendation of someone else. Imagine being pregnant dealing with the stress of planning a baby’s shower and have to deal with this. Everything happens for a reason because I ended up going with Mrs. Tee’s catering where I had a much better experience.

Great Environment, Great Hospitality, Great Food , Food did take some time but great food will take a long time to perfect .. The white rice with the red beans are so delicious. Fried Fish and Fried Shrimp is a must try and make sure you don’t forget to get The Uptown to wash all the food down and finish off with the Strawberry Cheesecake… I’ll be back you’re favorite reviewer Ariii

This place is trash …front girl worker had to be about 16 was very slow on the cash register…counting seemed  little bit hard for her..she moves beyond slow & can’t handle more than one thing at a time.. I stood in line for 10-15 with only 2 other customers in front of me ! Mind you they called me & stated the food was ready 15 mins prior .

Now lemme get started on the FOOD. STAY AWAY ! It’s giving “I just woke up 1 day & decided to open a restaurant” . I’m really curious as to where the cook got their culinary training from ? On paper a Puerto Rican soul food infusion is an amazing idea but there has to be execution & on that note failed miserably. You have to know how to be able to mix & blend flavors correctly & not rely on sofrito sauce to get you buy. Everything was bland tasteless …the MAC & cheese was beyond horrendous…just noodles dried up cheese & pepper! Salt non existent! Why are there over 60 menu items for such a small establishments. Focus on a few menu items & get those to perfection

Overall I would stay away there much better quality of food in the area. The customer service is what really sealed the deal for me Wendy’s drive through at 1am moves faster then this place & that little big child they have working the register
Ordered Shrimp Scampi over Angel hair pasta, with side salad.  Homemade Cannoli for dessert.  Food was perfectly seasoned and delicious.  Professional courteous service.  Will definately be back.

formatted_address: 77 Jefferson St, Newark, NJ 07105, United States
name: Sabor Unido

reviews.text: When the owner plays vinyl and vibes, you know you found a good spot. Bartender Nicolas makes great cocktails and gives the best recommendations. Don’t leave unless you have desert which are delectable!

Great find while looking for someplace new in the Ironbound. I can usually tell how great an establishment is by the cleanliness of the restroom. The restroom was clean and had a vibe. That made me want to eat there. The choices were great. Loved the calamari and garlic shrimp. My friends' chicken, rice and beans, and yuka fries were tasty, too. Wish we had tried the sangria and dessert. Next time!
Wow! Same fresh, delicious cuisine. Completely expanded and renovated dining space. Tastefully decorated and yet still cozy. Gil, our server, was fantastic!

Sabor Unido is a fantastic Portuguese-Brazilian restaurant. We came as a large party of 19, and they were very well organized — they arranged three tables for us seamlessly. As soon as we were seated, they brought out bread and water.

Our server was kind, attentive, and very diligent throughout the meal.

For starters, we ordered the calamari and chicken croquettes — both were delicious. For entrees, our group enjoyed a variety of dishes: roasted chicken with potatoes, rice and beans, hanger steak with sweet plantains, skirt steak with salad, and parmesan chicken with fettuccine. Everything came out correctly and was absolutely delicious. To drink they have my favorite: freshly squeezed orange juice. They also have a variety of drinks and coffee.

For dessert, we shared the tiramisu and tres leches — both were amazing.

The restaurant is clean, has a welcoming atmosphere, and also offers outdoor seating. We definitely recommend Sabor Unido to others!

We stopped by Sabor Unido which is a Brazilian-Portuguese fusion restaurant a bit late in the evening, hoping to grab some dessert and coffee after dinner—since all the nearby cafés had already closed around 8 PM. Even though most guests were still having dinner, the staff welcomed us warmly, and we were seated without any hesitation.

Our waitress, Carole, was absolutely lovely—friendly, attentive, and always with a smile. We ordered the crème brûlée with mixed berries, and it was incredible! Perfectly torched on top and beautifully balanced with the tartness of the berries. The coffee was also surprisingly fresh and full of flavor.

Although we only came for dessert this time, we were so impressed with the service and the atmosphere that we’re already planning to return for a full dinner. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: 1007 Summit Ave, Jersey City, NJ 07307, United States
name: Casa Cubana Catering

reviews.text:
Casa Cubana Catering catered our annual New Year’s Day celebration and our son’s birthday party for the fourth year in a row, and once again everything was absolutely phenomenal. The food was exquisite from start to finish—flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented.

Our menu included plantain chips, chicken cutlets, pork ribs, arroz con pollo, Cuban sandwiches, pinchos, empanadas, Cuban wraps, arroz con leche, and other delicious Cuban specialties—and every single dish was a hit with our guests.

The catering setup and decor were stunning and thoughtfully arranged, adding a special touch to the entire event. Most importantly, the staff was excellent—efficient, professional, and attentive throughout the party.

Casa Cubana continues to exceed our expectations year after year. We can’t recommend them highly enough and will absolutely be using them again for future events.

We booked Casa Cubana Catering for New Year’s Eve, and the booking process was quick and easy. Overall, the food was good. Unfortunately, the chicken and wings were no good, no one ate them, and also the wings were an unusual size it didn’t taste right. That said, the flank steak, maduros, and rice were very good and were enjoyed by our guests.

I  booked Casa Cubana to cater a surprise retirement/birthday celebration for my husband on the rooftop lounge of our condo building. The owner was excellent to collaborate with as she is thoughtful and detail-oriented. Our party was perfectly executed. She and her team were great from arrival to departure, which allowed me to be present and focused on having fun with my guests. The food and desserts were amazing and you could taste the authentic family recipes! The presentation was beautiful as well. Many of our guests had never experienced Cuban food and they could not stop talking about how delicious it was. I would highly recommend for any event!

Cuban food catering service family owned and operated by a Cuban matriarc and her team well put together. Authentic, simple, delicious and affordable food served in the restaurant to go or using various delivery services but they specialized in catering. Super sweet business owner. The decor is superb for such a small place. If you want to stop by there is limited seating and even more limited parking space but if you make it there then you need to invest in dessert amd coffee. Too bad I can't go there at least once a month. It's sooo out of my way.

The food we ordered from Casa Cubana for the surprise 50th Birthday party we hosted was a HIT! Everyone told us the food was delicious. They even provided serving utensils. We had black rice with beans (Moro), pork shoulder (Pernil), chicken and steak skewers, garlic shrimp, chicken and beef empanadas and sweet plantains. And yes, all of it was mouthwatering good. I was sold when I went for a quote and was given a chicken empanada to sample. So juicy! I highly recommend them for your next event, lunch or dinner. The cafe they have is lovely and the customer service is 10/10. You won’t be disappointed.

formatted_address: 77 Ferry St, Newark, NJ 07105, United States
name: Mompou Tapas Bar & Restaurant

reviews.text: Anytime I’m near the airport. I make a point to stop at this place. Their paella is not to be missed. The bartender Benjamin is so nice, informative and attentive.

We walked in on a Tue eve and enjoyed a very good tapas dinner.  It’s a good menu with traditional choices and well presented.  My daughter has brought small business groups to the restaurant and it’s great for small parties as well and regular diners.
Great food. The empanadas were perfect, crisp and delicious. The potato item was wonderful and savory.
Went here on a Friday night. It was nice and peaceful, not too loud. Food was really really good. Imo it’s a must visit place in NJ

Mompu nails the vibe with a sleek, modern dining room, chill back patio, and genuinely friendly staff. The sangria was spot-on, but the papas bravas stole the show—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and utterly delicious. The chicken skewers and house bread with spicy tomato sauce were solid picks. The mussels were just OK, and the tres leches dessert, while clever with its pound-cake base, could’ve used more moisture.

formatted_address: 16 Clinton St, Newark, NJ 07102, United States
name: Konoz Restaurant

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
My new favorite restaurant!! After eating here, my family doesn’t even want me to cook anymore 🥹 That’s how GOOD it is! Hands down the most authentic Spanish food we’ve had in a long time.

Alex treated us like family from the moment we walked in. The food came out hot, fresh, and full of flavor. The appetizers tasted just like my grandma’s—especially the alcapurrias! They were so good I ordered extra to go. The fish fritters were perfectly crispy and delicious.

The portions were HUGE! We loved the roast pork and the shrimp mofongo. My steak and onions were served in the cutest little caldero, and the maduros were sweet and cooked to perfection. And the flan… out of this world!

Do yourself a favor and get a happy passion fruit or mango drink—you’ll be smiling the whole time. And the coquito? The BEST I’ve ever had!

My new go-to spot. Highly, highly recommend! ✨

The food was amazing!! My family and I ate here for my mom’s birthday and loved every minute. With great salsa music playing, and the both the owner and workers being very nice! If you’re looking for authentic Puerto Rican food I would come here! We will definitely love to come back.

The food was amazing evrything was delicious service was beutiful and the athmosphere great lovely place lovely people if am ever again in the area thise will be the spot to go sadly am 3 hours away but thise won't be the last time thank you for great food and awsome service

La comida estaba absolutamente rica todo sabor sabroso lo recommiendo total no se van a repentir

I used to really enjoy this restaurant. The food was consistently good, the atmosphere was welcoming, and I was a frequent customer for quite some time. It was a place I genuinely liked and recommended to others.

Unfortunately, I no longer feel comfortable returning. During one of my visits, the owner, Alex, made an inappropriate sexual pass toward me without my consent. That experience completely changed how I felt about the space and made it impossible for me to continue supporting the business.

It’s disappointing, because the quality of the food and my past experiences as a customer were positive. However, feeling safe and respected matters more, and after that incident, I chose not to return.

I’m sharing this so others can make informed decisions based on the full picture, not just the food.

We stumbled upon this hidden gem!! Food was just like we were walking the strip in PR! Flavorful Fresh and they were not stingy with the portions. We ate and still had food left over which is great because the night still young. We chatted with the owners who were very humble! Place was clean and very welcoming..Music was a whole vibe….I’m happy we don’t need to drive to NY for some authentic PR FOOD… PS ASK FOR A HAPPY PACHA….
Can’t wait to visit the new PLACE same city different area!!! #ironbound GET READY

formatted_address: 5860 Delmar Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63112, United States
name: AFRICANA

reviews.text: Food was excellent. I had fufu & egusi for the first time & it was very flavorful & tender. I got mine with chicken & it paired very well with the okra in the egusi. Mary Jo was very informative with how to eat it as I was a first timer & even came with a handwashing bowl. My girlfriends joloff rice was very fluffy, flavorful, & the beans were on point. Next time we're in the area we will be back!!

I cannot wait to go back! This place is beautiful and food is PHENOMENAL!!!!! Everything was top notch 10/10 would recommend!! The beef suya was so tender I couldn’t stop eating it. You could tell the dough was handmade for the meat pies and they were excellently done meat filled to the brim. I was iffy about the deviled eggs but what was I worried about silly me lol I wanted to dip everything in that sauce. I do wish there were more creative cocktails but that’s not really an issue. Head there now!

Delicious food and excellent service. The Jollof rice and chicken were cooked well, and the plantains were sweet and a great pairing. The Africana Hibiscus tea was spiced and refreshing! Will definitely be back to sample the other dishes.

Loved my meal at AFRICANA. Delicious, flavorful egusi, tender goat meat and one of their cocktails. My server was so friendly and beautiful and helped me through the menu and when I forgot my card (like an idiot) she ran out the door to return it to me. If I lived in St Louis I would be a regular!

Africana Restaurant is a true hidden gem for anyone looking to enjoy authentic African cuisine. The moment you step inside, you're welcomed by the rich aroma of traditional spices and a cozy, inviting atmosphere. I absolutely loved the jollof rice perfectly seasoned, full of flavor, and cooked to perfection. The Red snapper was the best I’ve ever had I ordered it moist and it was perfectly cooked . The fried plantains were another highlight: golden brown, slightly crisp on the outside, and soft and sweet on the inside. Simple, comforting, and absolutely delicious.The staff were friendly and attentive, making the entire experience feel personal and welcoming. I even got to meet the owner she came and introduced herself . Portions are generous, prices are reasonable, and you can really taste the care that goes into each dish.
If you're craving flavorful, home-style African food, Africana Restaurant should be at the top of your list.
Highly recommended! Everything was delicious !!!

formatted_address: 1405 Washington Ave, St. Louis, MO 63103, United States
name: Levels

reviews.text:
Went here last night with my friend. It was a pleasant experience! The staff were all very nice and welcoming, and the server was helpful with giving suggestions also.
Loved the atmosphere and would have loved to try some drinks, they sound yummy! Would be a great place to just come sit and drink and hang out for sure.
We had the party jollof plate, loved the chicken wings on the plate! Best chicken wings I've had honestly. And we had it with the spinach, all of it was great! We also tried the Egusi soup with pounded yam (Fufu). The beef inside it was tender and really good. The over all dish had a fishy smell/flavor that since I've never tried this dish before I didn't know about. So I personally couldn't eat much of it because I'm not huge on that type of flavor, but I still tried it and ate the meat inside it! Was worth the experience! I'm wondering if the Efo Riro is the same or not, I'd like to try it!
Next time I'll definitely try some other things, the flavors were good, and try out the drinks!

Nigerian restaurant I went to while visiting St Louis. The ambiance was cute and modern. The basement where the restrooms are located could use better lighting because it’s dark and kinda spooky down there lol. Overall I would def come here again. The ayamase was really good and spicy but the oil was too much. Portion was very good as well

I heard about Levels through a friend and decided to try it, especially since I’d never had fufu before. The place was really nice different from any restaurant I’ve been to in Illinois. The vibe was laid-back, casual, and fun. The food was great, too.

There were just a couple things that stood out. My friend had her baby with her, but there wasn’t a high chair available. Also, there were four bathroom doors, but only one would open  I was low-key scared to close it because I thought I’d get locked inside 😅. That might be something to work on.

The waitress did mix up our order at first, but she fixed it quickly. Nobody’s perfect mistakes happen. Overall, everything was still great and I’d definitely come back.

This is my first time in town, and as I was exploring the area, I saw this unassuming entrance to Levels. It gave me local small restaurant vibes. I decided to give it a try since it said Nigerian cuisine, and I never had it before.

Wow! The inside is so nice, with a second level featuring works from local artists. Honestly, it kinda gave me a little bit of a speakeasy vibe. The place is decorated in green and white. I see what you did there 🇳🇬!

I was seated at the bar, and the lovely Iffie served me a great cocktail and recommended I get the Party Jollof. It was really good! A good serving of rice accompanied by plantains, spinach, and to her recommendation, chicken. Amazing taste and a little spicy, just how I like it. I highly recommend it.

Overall, the food was really good and the staff was even better. Everyone was super friendly, welcoming, and even gave me a little extra snack since they knew it was my first time trying Nigerian food.

Thank you, Iffie and everyone at Levels!

I made a reservation to visit this establishment on June 14, 2025. My wife and I arrived before our reservation time which was at 6:00 pm and we waited about 15 minutes before someone came to greet and seat us. There were two other parties that I guess made reservations at the same time so the hostess looked really overwhelmed, however she worked it out and started asking us all questions about our reservations and seating. Between ourselves and other party waiting at the same time, we were asked if we would like to be seated downstairs or upstairs. We chose the upstairs because we felt it might be more intimate, and it was okay. The art work was very nice and was a wonderful talking point while we waited for service. The tables could be a bit bigger, or at least longer to support if you would like to order a number of dishes. We waited for about 22 minutes before anyone came to get us drinks. I honestly am the one that is very critical of restaurants because in my experience, well ran restaurants have a system of how they operate to keep the flow of a great dining experience, so I was ready to walk out. She wanted to stay because she really wanted to try this place, so we stayed. Our server, a very upbeat, and knowledgeable young man came to service us and I appreciate him asking how long we had been there. I told him we have been seated for 22 minutes. He promptly apologized and asked us for our drink orders. He hurried and got the drinks, which we had two waters, and I ordered some kind of lemon berry cocktail. It was really good. When he returned, we had questions about some of the dishes and he was very detailed and patient. He even suggested dishes he thought were very good. My wife ordered the whole fish with veggies, and I ordered the goat with veggies. When the food came to the table it looked very good, however, my rice and veggies were ice cold! 🥶 We also had to eat with plastic utensils, because well as the server said, people take the silverware!IDK, just what we were told! 🤦🏿‍♂️ I notified the server about my dish and proceeded to eat just the goat, which was very good. During our meal, I was bit turned off and annoyed because some of the other parties from downstairs came up to view the art work and just to take a look around the upstairs. I was annoyed because I didn't like people walking past my food and drinks. They should direct their customers to come upstairs using only the front staircase to avoid this type of issue because that just didn't sit right with me. My wife's entree was very good though and she enjoyed it. The server accommodated the issue with my entree which I was very pleased because he was very apologetic. All in all, my personal opinion, I would be okay with not returning. My experience wasn't one that so many people post online as spectacular! A lot of them notify these businesses that they are food bloggers in the order to get the spectacular experience. This obviously can't be said for people that spend their hard earned money just to enjoy good food.

formatted_address: 8100 Page Ave, University City, MO 63130, United States
name: FUFU N' SAUCE

reviews.text: Fufu N' Sauce is an absolute gem. I’ve been eating egusi and fufu for years, and this is hands-down some of the best I’ve had in St. Louis. The egusi is rich, deeply seasoned, and comforting in that soul-satisfying way you hope for but don’t always find—perfectly paired with smooth, pillowy fufu. You can taste the care and authenticity in every bite. And don’t skip the hibiscus drink: it’s vibrant, refreshing, and beautifully balanced with just a hint of ginger that elevates the whole experience. If you’re craving real, well-executed African cuisine, this spot delivers every time. The employee who helped me was nice as well.  🌶️✨

The oxtail is melting tender, go very well with fufu, must order.
The beef stew is very good as well, but I am not sure is it suppose to be taste more spices ot no.
20-20 chicken wings taste a bit dry and no flavor. My friends said it was grilled before not fried.

Wonderfully authentic West African cuisine. The fufu had great texture and paired great with the oxtail stew. The stew was perfect, a masterful blend of spicy and savory. The meat was so tender it was falling off the bones in chunks. A generous portion for a fair price. The most surprising thing though was the kelewele. The plantains were stunning. Perfectly cut, seasoned, and fried. I cannot recommend it highly enough. Go, check it out. You absolutely won't be sorry.

I've had FUFU n' Sauce before and have never left disappointed. This time was no different. I'm so happy to now know that they have a brick and mortar. Congrats!!

Things to keep in mind that location parking is limited so be aware if you are in need of close parking in case of physical disabilities. The space inside is decorated uniquely and it feels very personal which is something I truly appreciated.

There is not much seat space inside but LISTEN the food i tried today was soooo flavorful. I had the jollof and beef stew, plantains, and surprisingly my favorite thing was the BLACK EYED PEAS! YUMMMM!

Wishing continued success to FUFU n' Sauce as they embark on their new physical space.

Very good. My husband and I were customers from the food truck and tried the new restaurant. Lovely decorated clean and inviting takeout. The gentleman taking our order was very nice and helpful with great customer service skills. My husband ordered the Oxtaill pepper stew w fufu and said it was superb. I ordered vegetarian egusi with jollof rice and it was well seasoned and delicious. We also ordered the roasted wings although we didnt go with the sauce that was like honey hot sauce that came with it. She made a fabulous pepper sauce and it was perfect. But its not on the menu right now so... We also got the hibiscus mixed with ginger tea. Perfect blend betwèen African and Diasporan hibiscus. African ones arent that sweet and diaspora ones are very sweet. So it was sweet enough to satisfy a diaspora pallet while not too sweet for West Africans. Same for the Plaintain. Africans like hard non sweet plantain while diaspora like over ripe sweet ones. They were somewhere in the middle. Lastly had the cheesecake bites which were a delicious nice suprise . We got banana strawberry and peach cobbler... yeah.. peach cobbler cheesecake! And it was wonderful. Overall great food and apparently on doordash too so ill be ordering from there too.

formatted_address: 503 Paul Ave, Florissant, MO 63031, United States
name: House of Jollof

reviews.text: After I finished my food I was angry, why, because it doesn't make any sense for food to be this good. It's actually insulting that the food was this good. I think I'm angry because there isn't a location in Belleville (where I live). I drove 50 minutes and I was not disappointed. I believe the man that took my order was the owner and he was so nice, you don't see that often above the Mason Dixon line. He gave me a sample of the egusi soup without me asking because I mentioned this was my first time trying authentic African food, which was really thoughtful. The bowl of water definitely through me for a loop at first.(I clearly didn't realize how messy my hands were going to get). They know what they're doing in that kitchen, they deserve a Nobel peace prize for these flavors alone. I highly recommend 10/10.

It was my son, and I's first-time trying House Of Joloff, and I can honestly say we will be back. We did a quick google search for Nigerian food (my 13 year old son likes to try different foods). House of Joloff was the first restaurant to pop up on our good search for Nigerian cuisine. It was a 30-minute drive for us, and it was DEFINITELY worth it. We ordered the Joloff rice with Oxtail and mild spice, Egusi soup with Chicken and side of Fufu, and a delicious meat pie/empanda, which they have a veggie options but we ordered the beef meat pie and it was cooked to perfection, so simple but with so much flavor. Every dish we had was just packed with so much flavor, African spices, oxtail meat falling off the bone, to the egusi soup that was surprisingly delicious! We will definitely be back. Absolutely amazing first time. They did NOT disappoint. The father and daughter were so helpful when we needed to order and understand the menu. Thank you so much for a wonderful meal!

To start with, I have nearly no experience with any Nigerian cuisine, so if it's not authentic, I wouldn't know.  That said, here's my experience with a small group.  They had music playing when we entered. It was a bit loud for such a small space, but it did get a bit quieter after a bit.  There's not a whole lot to say about the atmosphere, but it is clean and taken care of.  The only person we saw ran both the register as well as waited the tables.  That said, he was quite friendly and helpful.  The food seemed fairly reasonably priced if you don't get the expensive meats.  Otherwise, your $10 meal can quickly get up over $20.  When our food arrived, it all looked tasty.  By the time we were wrapping up, everyone seemed more than satisfied with the flavor.  The only weird thing is that the chicken was served whole bone-in, whether it is in soup or on rice.  My wife found it difficult to get the meat off in her soup.  I do plan on coming by here again to try some other dishes.

FINALLY had the pleasure of visiting House Of Jollof to sit down, and enjoy authentic West & East African cuisine. Atmosphere was a laid back vibe. It wasn't packed at all so I took it as an opportunity to dine in with my daughter, who just recently started solids and was just excited as I was! Everything was delicious as usual. Staff was very friendly, and accommodating!

There's so much to love about House of Jollof from the atmosphere to the flavorful African cuisine! Their food is absolutely delicious, from the top to the bottom of the menu you can't go wrong, there are no bad choices! The jollof rice, ox tails, fufu, and goat soup are some of my favorites. Try it ASAP I highly recommend it! 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥

formatted_address: 4005 Seven Hills Dr, Florissant, MO 63033, United States
name: African Palace

reviews.text: I enjoyed the food. The waitress was very nice. It was clean inside. I dont think there is alot of food or soda options though.

Had our team in town for the week and wanted to try something new. Because we have a few Nigerian team members we thought West African would be a cool thing to expose the rest of the team to. So we choose African Palace and it did not disappoint. We did a take out lunch with all kinds of different dishes and all were great. The owner was also very gracious in providing us water bottles and some snacks while we waited for our large order.

honestly the place has always been great but the food used to be better! idk if time of the day matters with different cooks or what, but ive had better, the taste was bland , meat was hard not tender at all, they are quick with making your food tho

The staff was terrible and rude! We were trying to figure out what to order and they were very short and impatient and did not want to answer any of our questions regarding portions or ingredients. We spent over $120 on 4 meals and didn’t finish a single one. The oxtails were a slap in the face. The portions of protein are very small for how much you’re paying and goat was so tough you could barely chew it.
First time coming, from Jefferson City they greeted us kindly, atmosphere was a great vibe, food had flavor. Ordered an extra for Togo. 10/10

formatted_address: 3210 S Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63118, United States
name: Meskerem Ethiopian Restaurant

reviews.text:
First time trying Ethiopian food and I wasn’t really sure what to expect. The inside smells like incense as soon as you walk in and the space is pretty small. Probably seats around 15 people max.
The workers were super nice and helpful, they gave some recommendations and I ended up going with a beef dish that came with the traditional sour dough.
Portion size was big. The beef and sides were good but I personally couldn’t get into the sour flavor of the dough. I mostly just ate everything else on the plate. My friends really enjoyed their meals though.
Would recommend if you’re curious to try something new in the area!
Love Meskerem! The food is always delicious, great spices and flavors. I always get a combo platter. So yummy. Plus it's a neat experience eating!

Having tried 10+ Ethiopian restaurant in 10 different cities, this place is solid when it comes to flavor.

The injera bread though is not good in comparison to what I am used to. Probably the bread is 2/5 while the place itself with the food, ambiance and service is 5/5. Maybe I will order food without injera the next time.

A lovely spot in STL otherwise.

A wonderful experience with Ethiopian food! The dishes were incredibly tasty, each infused with a unique blend of Ethiopian spices. We also had the chance to experience traditional Ethiopian coffee, which was rich and distinctive—unlike any other coffee we’ve tasted. The service and hospitality were fantastic, and the restaurant was clean and beautifully decorated with Ethiopian art and crafts. If you’re in the area, don’t miss this place—every item on the menu is reasonably priced.

POOR SERVICE.   DISGUSTING,  DRY, CARDBOARD TILAPIA.

I ordered the yellow lentils (pictured in two images) and was literally given a teaspoon of lentils.  Seriously.... I was given a teaspoon of lentils.  That teaspoon of lentils was full of hard orange lentils.   The shiro wat tasted old and chalk- like.  The customer service is non existent.   The quality of the food when carry out orders are placed tends to leave alot to be desired.   In this case, I wasn't afforded the option of receiving a fair or full portion of food.  The quality of service and product has diminished significantly.  The food isn't worth the monies paid or the time it takes to travel, struggle to find parking and  to pick the ill tasting, poor proportion food up.

formatted_address: 3445 S Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63118, United States
name: Waaberi

reviews.text: Food is so good, the fish was seasoned very well and perfectly crispy. Workers are really nice and welcoming. They have only a few options, but do them very well.
First time eating here and it was so good! We got two complimentary teas with our meal. Super delicious and friendly service.
We both enjoyed the goat and the basmati rice. The tea was delicious! The servings are huge. I will definitely be going back.

Waaberi is hands down the best Somali restaurant around!
Authentic food that tastes just like home, excellent service, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Every dish was full of flavor and made with care. The staff was friendly and attentive, and you can tell they take pride in what they do. Money well spent — I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!
The best East African restaurant in town hands down and the owner is great guy and knows how treat customers I can’t wait to come back there and eat spaghetti with fish ❤️🇸🇴

formatted_address: 3201 S Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63118, United States
name: Eat Today East African Cuisine .

reviews.text: I REALLY enjoyed eating at this restaurant. It was very open, clean, bright in color and has a great vibe. The service was stellar. I had the lamb soup for an appetizer, and the meat platter. My wife had the fish and veggies. EVERYTHING was amazing. The lamb soup was served with freshly made bread chips and was packed with flavor. The meat platter consists of lamb, beef and chicken cooked in African spices and herbs. We tried the Samosas which were delectable. We also had the spinach and rice which was a 10 out of 10. We tried the sour bread?? Not sure remember the name of it but wasn't a fan of that at all. I WILL BE BACK THIS WEEKEND!!

The food is absolutely delicious. We were looking for a place to eat on a Monday and this restaurant was open! We decided to give it a try.
I ordered a tilapia dish my husband ordered a chicken dish.   The food is well prepared in the portion generous.
We enjoyed viewing EastAfrican music videos as we dined.
We are definitely returning to this place.
I highly recommend👍🏽

I was in St. Louis on a business trip and found this place a 13 min drive from downtown. Parking in the back. We walked in on a  wednesday night around 7 and minimal foot traffic.  The hostess was very kind.  We ordered the veggie and meat platter, beef sambusas and the food was absolutely amazing. Every single morsel was mouth wateringly good. So much so that we ordered it again to go so we could eat it again the next day for brekky and lunch.The hostess was warm, welcoming and kind with great service. The ambience inside is very peaceful. I'd order anything off the menu and would bet a paycheck it's absolutely one of the best things I'd ever tasted.

This restaurant serves excellent ethiopian food. The veggie combo is a really good deal at $17 for a generous serving of several vegan dishes (including gomen, mesir wat, fasolia, and tikil gomen). It also comes with a delicious beet salad and fresh injera. They are generous with giving you more injera if you need it. They also have great dishes besides the veggie combo, including tofu tibs (written on the menu as "spicy tofu") and mushroom tibs (written as "mushrooms"), which are great quality and flavor.

Have had the pleasure of eating here twice (ironically both days being a holiday). The service and the food were amazing both times.
Me and my boyfriend are kind of picky eaters and generally don’t like to try new things but i’m glad we’ve given the items on the menu a chance, the food is so flavorful and fulfilling.
I highly recommend the chili and the lamb soup! I also really enjoyed the french fries and samosas.
You can tell everything is made with care and love.

formatted_address: St. Louis, MO 63110, United States
name: Chez Ali

reviews.text:
Let me start this review by saying that I've eaten at Chez Ali several times.  I've enjoyed Jerk chicken and Curry chicken.  Both flavorful with good ol Jamaican spices and a hint of smoke.  I love that.
Guess that explains why I've eaten there several times.  My complaint, tho ( and I've actually hesitated to complain because I like the food), is the very inconsistent meat portions.
If you look at my plate below, at a glance, you'd swear it was piled high with meat.
In reality, it's mostly rice, rice, and more rice.
The meat is basically leg quarters chopped till you can't chop them anymore.  When I gathered up the choppy meat chunks, I didn't even have two legs in my Jerk chicken plate.
The Curry and Jerk combo plate had probably two chunks more.
By NO MEANS, am I saying the food isn't tasty.  I am saying they have skimped on the meat 95% of the times I've eaten there.
Customer Service is hit or miss also.  A couple folks seem kinda friendly.  I just wish those things would change.  The experience would be better and worth the price.

I was on a school field trip and we stopped at the foundry for lunch little did i know id meet one of the nicest men ever. First of all my friend had braces and couldnt eat the jerk chicken which was amazing and filled with flavor i asked for platains which werent frying yet and he made me some that second. Back to my friend we got oxtail he gave us extra scoops and gave us half off. we tried the oxtail so tender delicous and delectable. He was so nice gave us free sodas and we striked up a conversation about his where he was originally from the best man i have ever met in my life hands down LOVE HIM DA GOATTT!🙏🏼❤️❤️❤️❤️

Very tasty Afro-Caribbean cuisine inside The Foundry. The jerk chicken had so much flavor. I got the sampler which included jerk chicken and curry chicken, cabbage, and white rice or brown rice and beans. The oxtails and plantains looked good too. I’ll definitely be back to try more.

I usually like the food but it’s never hot. Today the food was cold. The jerk Chicken was the only thing that was hot because it had just been cooked. The other. Chicken we had was extremely cold. The cabbage was cold, rice and peas, and the plantains, all cold. I asked them to heat it up and they did but it was not hot all the way through. The server said something about the warmers not working properly. And the cabbage and rice and peas was extremely under seasoned today. Not much flavor at all.

I’ve bought the food a few times. But today’s food wasn’t it at all. The rice and “beans” barely had any beans and the rice was sticky and weird. The curry was tasteless and I wasn’t given any potatoes or veggies apart from celery, very poor quality today compared to what I’ve had before.
I’ve observed that the taste of the food varies depending on the day. If this was my first time going there, I’d probably never go back again

formatted_address: 13951 Manchester Rd, Ballwin, MO 63011, United States
name: The Port of Peri Peri

reviews.text: Another diamond in rough y'all. This place definitely turned my head. It says it's Portuguese cuisine influenced by African cuisine. I bought halal chicken over a bed of yellow rice with spicy sauce. It came with corn with paprika sprinkled on top. I bought a hot cup of adeni chai; it's really good. I would recommend this restaurant to everyone that reads this. I will be back to try it again.
This food is amazing. I ordered the peri combo. The chicken is cooked perfectly. The rice has a great flavor and the small extra side they put with this meal is really good. Fantastic meal!

First time here, and I had excellent service, fresh food, and a fantastic atmosphere. -3 years ago

I came back in 2025, and the same thing holds. The chicken has a great char and smoke flavor, the rice is light and flavorful, and the corn has a great mayo and seasoning combination.

The veggies medley appeared to have a similar flavor as that of frozen veggies and the only thing that was not a great flavor.

If you like spicy food, try their different levels of spice because they still have flavor and are not just spicy and hot.

Lastly, I love that they have activities and items (books and coloring items) for families and their children kids.

Every item on the menu is a slam dunk. All the chicken is fresh and delicious. Pericini is out of this world. Hummus and pita and falafel are all filling and delicious. I even tried their chai tea which is excellent beyond compare. Also lots of kids toys and coloring options to keep entertained.

This Port of Peri Peri is amazing! The food is absolutely delicious.its fresh, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. Every dish we tried was cooked just right, and you can really tell they care about quality and taste.
What truly sets this place apart, though, is the service. The owner/manager is incredibly kind, welcoming, and attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. Honestly, everyone there is so nice and friendly, you feel genuinely welcomed from the moment you walk in.
Great food, great vibes, and even better people. Highly recommend this place.

formatted_address: 3719 W Florissant Ave, St. Louis, MO 63107, United States
name: Baba Asaju

formatted_address: 6665 Olive Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63130, United States
name: Desta Bistro

reviews.text: Warm, inviting, casual dinning atmosphere. Service was amazing and friendly. They have a very limited menu, but everything was well prepared and tasty . I ordered the veggies lentil with gome and tibs salad Injera. My serve said the veggies lentil is the most popular order and she was right. It was so delicious, especially the red lentil, we had to order an extra side dish. I didn’t like the tibs as much as the veggie lentils because it was kinda spicy and a bit chewy for my liking. The berebere wings with sauce on the side was really yummy that I almost ordered the second dish. I”ll definitely come back!!!
