Are you that money hungry that you would risk your business being sued because I am now headed to the emergency room because of this negligence. I have never experience this from any restaurant and it is very disappointing that she could even take accountability for the lies she told just to make a sell. Sick. I will tell everyone to never go here , they are dishonest and can’t be trusted. She never even prepare the food in front of me and the restaurant had a buffet display.  She went in the back to get the food and brought it out wrapped up already. Just dishonest and distractedly. I will be disputing for a full refund and I will be seeking legal counsel as well.

This place is literally the best African restaurant ever, to some, it might be a little bit expensive but you get a large portion. The food tastes like homemade food. They even give samples to try to see if you’ll like it or not and the workers are very friendly and funny.

This food was not it.The jollof rice taste like ravioli from the can the so called stew had no stew just dry meat and the meat taste almost like beef jerky.Mind you I buy food from a lady that is Nigerian and she have a ghost kitchen her food is given authentic African food I don’t know what this is I could’ve went to my African lady that I usually buy from just wanted to give this restaurant a try and they failed me miserably the First picture are from this restaurant.The rest is from my kitchen that I cooked!!!

very disappointed at the food portion.  purchased pounded yam and soup and the bowl was not even half filled with soup. finished the soup and still had pounded yam left to eat with nothing.  the taste was okay. they need to work on their portions and flavor.

The most wonderful and warm greeting when I entered. I asked them to prepare a plate for me that they would make for themselves and they gave me a generous portion of foofoo and veggie soup. The soup is more of a stew with a punch. Super flavorful and delicious. The restaurant isn’t fancy but plain good. I also got the hibiscus drink with ginger. The cuisine is Yoruba Nigerian and I will surely be back. You can’t find home cooking like this and I guarantee they always cook with love.

formatted_address: 319 Fayetteville St Suite 105, Raleigh, NC 27601, United States
name: Flavor Hills

reviews.text:
I must first say, this is a well ran business.
And i absolutely LOVE to see the quality of it being so well run throughout.

Visited with my husband on a weekday, no wait time, staff was great - server was amazing. She made accommodations for me with my protein choice which meant more than she could’ve imagined.

Food, service, experience was so amazing that same week i visited with a girlfriend of mine. She was also impressed for her first time which made me so happy because i take pride in recommending fantastic food choices.

Anyhow - I am so excited to become a regular and just work my through their menu. Looking forward to kissing my slim back goodbye and hello to big backness.

Flavor Hills gave me an amazing experience from start to finish. The drinks were made perfectly, the food was incredible, and the staff was so friendly and welcoming. They were helpful, patient, and answered every question we had about the menu. The Brussels sprouts are truly top tier, and the shrimp and grits were savory, rich, and absolutely delicious. I’ll definitely be returning to try more of their menu—everything was on point!

Ojh yeah, that sweet potato cornbread 😋 magnificent!!

Flavor Hills is AMAZING! From the food to the atmosphere to the service. Darnell was so attentive and professional. All the staff was great. Me and my friend got the fried green tomatoes, lemon pepper wings, bang bang shrimp, two heat plates, one with chicken and one with catfish, and the beignets for dessert. I would highly recommend!

I was excited to try this place for awhile. And it did NOT disappoint. We was greeted with fun energy. I love the vibes in there, the music was great. Also the art in there was A1 🔥🔥🔥. Ketty was a fun time, loved her energy and recommendations, we absolutely would have her again. The drinks were amazing and had me feel good good. And the FOOD… OMG. That Catfish & Grits, I had to take my time on that because it was absolutely Amazing. Definitely will be back and make it regular for sure!!!

I’ll be candid after waiting nearly ten minutes with no acknowledgement, I was just about ready to head out. But, by providence and good timing, a young lady named

Kiya (I hope I’m spelling that correctly) walked by, and I was able to let her know I was ready to order.
From that moment forward, the experience shifted completely.

Kiya was exceptionally helpful, polite, and patient. Though this was my second time dining at the restaurant, I found myself blank on what I wanted. She offered thoughtful, informed recommendations that made the decision easy. Her professionalism elevated the entire moment.
The service was smooth, the hospitality sincere, and the food remarkable. In fact, it was even better than my first visit.

formatted_address: Schwarzbach 84, 42277 Wuppertal, Germany
name: Mama Africa Restaurant

reviews.text: We went for a late lunch and we were absoutely thrilled with mama africa’s food. It was so delicious, spicy and the portiones were more than generous. We tried fried plantain, fufu with meat and jollof rice with turkey. Thank you ♥️

The Lady aka Mama Africa :) It is super nice and welcoming and the food was delicious as I remembered it from my trips.
I took my partner here as he always wanted to try African food and he liked it tons.
There is no alcohol and the restaurant is small and unpretentious, but that was not a problem for us.
Highly recommended it and will for sure return.
The food was unbelievable. It taste so good the service was very nice too and we felt very welcome. We are thankful for the food and will definitely come back.

We were here with the family and everyone was happy. Very good West African food. Freshly prepared and culinary delight. The owners are very friendly and service-oriented.
An absolute recommendation for anyone who loves West African spicy cuisine.

I was at Mama Africa today for the first time and I must say "I am impressed". The price is fair, the atmosphere was pleasant. I enjoyed the food.
😋 ☺️ 😊 😌

formatted_address: 3710 Exchange Glenwood Pl Suite 104, Raleigh, NC 27612, United States
name: Ladyfingers Market & Eatery Raleigh

reviews.text: Really enjoyed my drink and wrap. Decent price for a lunch out. Cool little market inside. Nice stop off the Crabtree trail

Hi, great people----The reviews are true!  This hidden gem 💎 is a go to for early morning breakfast or a lovely lunch on the patio.  The location is quiet and just lovely with the trees offering shade on the patio.

The customer service is simply phenomenal.   You absolutely won't be disappointed.  They offer samples of their deli.  The prices are hard to beat.  There's also a small market with wine and beer.  I appreciate them celebrating 🍾  NC favorites.

I had the pleasure of getting a chicken salad croissant that had arugula and tomatoe on it.  I was very pleased at the party portion. So what are you waiting for?

You'll enjoy this location as much as I did.  Don't forget to smile often, be grateful, and be kind.  They are all contagious.

Dont be fooled by the aesthetics. I’ve given it enough chances and I’m done with the high price point for low quality dishes. The atmosphere and location are nice, but Village Deli and Ish offer far superior quality at a better price point.
The buffalo chicken sandwich is so yummy with the ranch slaw. I’d recommend to pair it with the Thai chili chips!

I’ve given this place too many chances. The food is bland and mediocre at best. They can’t even make a decent coffee, which I thought was a fluke the first time. The second time? Same thing. Weeks later, I tried again-still awful. How do you mess up coffee? In my opinion, this place only survives because it’s convenient for nearby apartments. It’s overly kitschy and offers consistently poor quality. Don’t believe the hype; the positive reviews must be from friends or family, because everyone I’ve talked to agrees with me.

formatted_address: 6274 Glenwood Ave, Raleigh, NC 27612, United States
name: Arepa Culture

reviews.text:
The food here is very Americanized, though the flavor is definitely there. We tried four different arepas from the menu. The presentation was really nice and the prices were reasonable, but the food was served either cold or at room temperature, which my mom and I found odd. The salmon was also a bit too salty. That said, the cilantro sauce was amazing, and I really liked the juice selection, it was authentic (would 100% come back just for the juice).

The arepa combinations were creative, but overall the experience still felt more American than traditional. The staff did not greet us when we came in, which isn’t required but does make the place feel less welcoming. The seating was uncomfortable, and some of the tables were a bit dirty. On the plus side, they recycle, there’s plenty of parking, and they offer outdoor seating.

Fast and delicious food here! I enjoyed learning about Venezuelan cuisine from their very informative menu. The arepas themselves are so fluffy and soft- and the fillings are seasoned to perfection. My friend got a Cachapa- absolutely FILLED with cheese!! Perfection.

They have vegetarian options (vegan too!) and even coffee options. I would recommend to anyone in the area to try from this local spot/ it beats all the chains around it. Perfect for someone who wants to try something different.

Falan  with Offline - Great service. I enjoyed the La Tics arepa. I did not like the La Surena as much as the chicken. The rice and beans were fresh and good. The peach just was okay. It has an acquired taste.

This place was lovely decorated. The food was great and the team members were very helpful and polite however the tables where all dirty and just needed to be wiped down.  Other than that, everything was great, the music was very nice and amazing and I would definitely recommend this place and go back again. :)

I have never had an arepa, but I love Mexican tacos so I thought I might like this Salvadoran/Colombian taco-like specialty.  I like spicy, but the food here, even their salsas, are very VERY mild, bland even, so I was disappointed.   But other folks who avoid spicy will love it.  The arepas are hearty and quite filling, about the size of a hamburger.  The "buns" are made of a tasty cornmeal, with the soft texture of tamale masa. They say you need 2 arepas for a meal, but one filled me up for lunch, and they are reasonably priced at $6.99 each. Their bowl dish was huge, you need to be really be hungry!

formatted_address: 222 S Blount St, Raleigh, NC 27601, United States
name: Bida Manda

reviews.text:
Day one in Raleigh did not disappoint—especially when it came to finding some traditional Laotian comfort food! If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience, Bida Manda is an absolute must-visit.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed, promptly seated at the bar, and treated to irresistible rice chips that set the perfect tone for the evening. For starters, we went with the Lao Beef Jerky paired with charred tomato jeow, and let me tell you—it was a full-on flavor explosion.

I enjoyed the best Laotian cuisine I’ve had in a long time at this stylish and hip downtown spot. The owners were incredibly kind, offering us two complimentary appetizers, drinks, and dessert—Southern hospitality at its finest. The ambiance is unique and inviting, and the service was both friendly and attentive. Generous portions and reasonable prices made the experience even better.

Overall, Bida Manda exceeded my expectations with its vibrant flavors and welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone looking to indulge in exceptional Laotian cuisine!

Had an unforgettable evening thanks to our server, Jake. We’ve been coming to Bida Manda for the past four years—from our first date through marriage, and we just celebrated our first wedding anniversary here.

For appetizers, we had the salmon ceviche and beef jerky. Both were delicious, though the salmon ceviche was certainly my favorite. It was incredibly flavorful with just the right amount of spice. For our entrées, we ordered the chicken curry and the thom khem, which we get every year and they never disappoint.

We also tried the lotus cocktail, toasted rice old fashioned, and a few Lao beers, all recommended by Jake. Every drink was excellent. For dessert, we finished with the coconut ice cream. Simple and perfect.

We’re very grateful to Jake and the entire Bida Manda team for consistently making our dining experiences memorable and positive. Wishing you all a happy holiday!

Mckenzie provided excellent service, and I believe that the success or failure of a restaurant is largely dependent on the quality of its service staff. While food can always be refined over time, achieving exceptional service is a considerably more challenging endeavor.

Based on the evening's selections, the salmon ceviche was the standout dish. Its flavor profile was impeccably balanced, featuring a delightful citrus note.

The chicken wings were unremarkable, with no distinct flavor notes. Furthermore, I was let down by the absence of sweet chili flavor, despite its inclusion in the dish's name.

While the soup was an acceptable option, its flavor consistency was lacking. It began pleasantly but did not sustain interest throughout.

The Pad Thai proved to be a reliable choice, neither exceptional nor disappointing. It served as a predictable and safe option.

The Mango Sticky Rice was highly enjoyable, with the inclusion of coconut flakes providing an excellent textural and flavor complement.

The Thai Tea with ice cream was satisfactory, though the limited quantity of ice cream was a notable drawback. Increasing the ice cream portion would likely enhance the overall enjoyment, particularly when combined with the coconut elements.

The restaurant's ambiance was quite agreeable, characterized by a subdued noise level and a decor that exuded a warm, slightly dim, and inviting atmosphere.

Delicious food and beautiful atmosphere. Staff were friendly too. I ordered chicken curry noodle bowl. Delicious! However, for the price I paid I felt they could've put more noodle in the bowl. The thai tea was ok. Not as sweet as I thought it would be. I would definitely come back. If you are a party of two please make a reservation bc this place stay pack.

This restaurant is absolutely beautiful and perfect for a special night out. The menu offered a refreshing change from my usual go-tos — everything felt new and exciting. We ordered the saffron crepe, pork belly soup, and lettuce wraps, which turned out to be the perfect amount of food for two.

Every dish was delicious, but if I had one critique, it would be the pork belly. I’m not sure if it was meant to be served that way or if we just got an off batch, but it came out cold and extremely tough — we honestly thought we might lose a filling trying to bite into it. That said, the soup itself (without the pork belly) was fantastic: flavorful, well-balanced, and not overly rich.

Overall, I’ll definitely be back — and the service was exceptional: warm, attentive, and genuinely kind.

formatted_address: 301 Glenwood Ave # 100, Raleigh, NC 27603, United States
name: Marian Cocktails & Kitchen

reviews.text:
Marian's has a cool vibe and is an upscale choice for vegan diners. We visited on a Sunday night and they appeared to be understaffed. That led to a delay in getting seated and served.

The restaurant has a short but very well curated wine list. I noticed one of my favorite Pinot Noirs from Patagonia.

Among the craft cocktails tried were the Autumn Orchard Fiz and the Crimson Herb. The Crimson Herb featured gin and cranberry and torched sage. The fiz had pear nectar and elderflower extract along with Prosecco. Both drinks were tasty but the Prosecco was flat.

Entrees included rigatoni with vodka sauce, cedar plank "salmon," Mac and cheese with "brisket" and country fried "steak." I also enjoyed a cup of French onion soup.

The food was outstanding. The mac and cheese was our top choice and the salmon also got plenty of accolades.

This is a totally vegan restaurant, so the dishes are artfully crafted with ingredients in line with this cuisine.

There is a great outdoor seating area, which would be super for people-watching on Glenwood in warmer weather.

We enthusiastically recommend Marian's.

Every part of the experience was amazing—the restaurant’s location and ambiance, the service, and, of course, the food. We ordered the Oshi vegan salmon filet (one as an entrée and another on a salad), and both were fantastic. The French onion soup was among the best we’ve ever had—an opinion shared by both the vegans and non-vegans in our group. We also tried the steak and potatoes and a chick’n sandwich, and every plate was cleaned. Highly recommend.

Excellent experience here! Wonderful cocktails (though sometimes surprisingly savory) and food was very tasty. The breading on the vegan chicken is incredible! Will be going back for sure. Didn’t think I needed a reservation on a Friday though as it wasn’t that busy.

I couldn't give this place more stars. The food was excellent, and the service was spectacular. As soon as we were done with plates, they were off the table. Water was refilled immediately. Food was so fast and came out one right after the other (that's how we ordered it). Went for our anniversary and it was a perfect dinner. Will definitely be going back. Shared the small bread, caviar, blooming onion and ribs.

Update: went back and got the brisket Mac and cheese and salmon. The salmon was so good I thought it was real salmon on the first bite!!

A friend recommended this place for us to check out for weekend brunch because she knows that I am vegan and gluten free. I hadn't heard of it yet but was very excited to check it out. And we were both so happy that we did!

Not only did I get to speak with the owner, Layla, herself but the whole experience was phenomenal! Not only is she a wealth of knowledge and very happy to help with any dietary restrictions. She is very passionate about this restaurant and what they are doing with regards to elevating plant-based food to a whole other level.

The ambiance in the restaurant very cool! She did a great job with everything down to the plates and glassware all the way up to all of the different plants hanging from the ceiling.

While the menu is not labeled with gluten-free options, you can ask your server and they'll tell you which ones can be made gluten-free or what alternatives are, which is very helpful.

Layla spoke to us about this amazing salmon they have that's made out of red algae. So even though it wasn't on the brunch menu, we asked for just a side of it so we could share it and try it. It tastes exactly like delicious salmon! You have definitely got to try this, even if you don't go there for anything else.

I then got the breakfast croissant, but swapped out that croissant for a gluten-free bun. The Bacun they have on the sandwich is also made from red algae. I haven't had bacon in well over 30 years, but my friend said it tastes exactly like really delicious bacon.

I then got the Bananas Foster for dessert, which was adorned with strawberries because they were out of fresh bananas. It is one of the moistest cakes I have ever had. The drinks were also absolutely delicious!

So if you have not come by this place yet, you have definitely got to check it out, whether you are plant-based or not!

formatted_address: 901 W Morgan St, Raleigh, NC 27603, United States
name: Irregardless

reviews.text: Went here for lunch with a buddy of mine. All the food was outstanding and our bartender, forgot her name, was awesome in every aspect. We started with the Spanakopita. These were amazing. A little more soggy than I’m used to, but still really really good and the green goddess sauce was a really nice additive. My main meal was the Black Bean Burger, which I don’t typically go for. The flavoring was extraordinary for a bean burger. I also got the carrot ginger soup, which was perfect for fall weather, it was awesome! I also got the Barbacoa Crunchwrap. This was good. It didn’t blow my mind though because I got it to go and so it wasn’t fresh out the kitchen when I got to have it, but again it was still good! Lastly I got the goat cheese beignets, which were also good. I would definitely recommend this place to people.

This place had a great vibe. Everyone was friendly and the menu had something for everyone. The gingerbread muffins were amazing and we couldn't get enough of those.

We'll definitely be back to try the rest of the menu. Overall an amazing experience!

Excellent restaurant with ample vegetarian and allergy friendly options! I got a gluten free, dairy free, fried catfish and it was fantastic! They also have live music some nights which is quite nice. The parking situation is kind of rough as there are only limited street parking spots. Make sure to carpool, arrive early, or be prepared to hunt for nearby parking. Would recommend for a nice dinner!

First timer. Great experience, nice atmosphere, good drinks, and very good meal! Stopped at Irregardless before going to a comedy show. Started off with drinks and crab dip, both of which were really good. The crab dip was so good and filling that it affected my appetite. I went with a cauliflower dish, which I have never done before. When it arrived, I took one look and thought this is going to be awesome and it was. The dish consisted of harissa roasted cauliflower, cauliflower purée, sautéed spinach, garbanzo beans, and preserved lemon. The flavors were incredible! My wife had eggplant Parmesan, and when it arrived, we looked at it and thought what!?! Although it was like no eggplant I had ever seen it was delicious. In fact, she had eggplant. I ate one of her eggplants, and then she shared with a friend the next day. So good! We will definitely be back.

I love this place. I have been here several times and each time it’s incredible service and delicious food. They have GLUTEN FREE chicken and waffles and I absolutely love it. They even offer mocktails too. It’s a cool artsy environment and very lively. Definitely need a reservation. Everytime I come here it’s packed!

formatted_address: 2200 W Main St, Durham, NC 27705, United States
name: Parizade

reviews.text: Nice spot for dinner with lots of options.   Great for a date night or large gatherings.   The ambiance of the spot was quaint and i loved that they had an open kitchen.   The lamb ribs were tasty and so were the croquettes.   We also ordered the lamb chops and spaghetti.   Over I felt the food was just good.  I would dine here again but I can’t say that I was wow’d.   Our sever provided great recommendations and was really attentive.

Very lovely restaurant! Everything I ate here was amazing. I really enjoyed the linguine with clams, it has a really nice lemony flavor to it! Also highly recommend the phyllo shrimp for an appetizer. I was lucky to be able to try a few of the desserts because I came with a group. My favorite was the creme brulee! But the bananas foster was a close second! Service was also stellar!

The restaurant is very nicely decorated, so cute. It is a little dark- the menu was hard to read without moving the light on the table. The service was exceptional. The cocktails and dessert were really good. The food was good but overpriced for what you get.

Second time here
This time our rating is 4. Overall 4.5
We got the special paella which wasn't crunchy
And the lamb saffron ghnocci was average.
The Rosso red wine is one of my favorites

Had a delicious meal and wonderful time at parizade
We got the lamb chops and the spinach stuffed chicken
Both delicious
The lamb the star
For dessert we got the banana dessert,I wish it had more puff pastry and smaller banana pieces but good still
Our server Alexis was wonderful
Really enjoyed the booth seating
Will be coming back !

Lovely Mediterranean steakhouse. Came as a large party of 35 and were sat in a separated dining area with a separate bar. Inside is dimly lit and there’s an open kitchen style as you walk through the restaurant. Tried many different appetizers but loved the fresh sourdough with oil to start, the Caesar, and the pita bread with dips. I went with a 14 ounce ribeye, cooked medium rare and came out pretty close. Meat was good quality and the mushrooms and potatoes were also solid. Service was great, would highly recommend this spot.

formatted_address: 1000 Social St Suite 150, Raleigh, NC 27609, United States
name: Peregrine Raleigh

reviews.text: I’ve been to Peregrine twice now and tonight the food was exceptional. The seasoning was on point and you can taste the intention behind the layering of flavors. I really enjoyed my dining experience tonight and will def be back. On top of the food being delicious the atmosphere is absolutely stunning. I do recommend this place to anyone in the North hills area.

We came here for a birthday dinner, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in the Triangle! Everything was unique and flavorful- the broccolini and coconut rice sides were some of the favorites- and the service was fantastic! The drinks were great, and the dessert (we had the deconstructed apple pie situation) was so fun. Worth the splurge!

Tried this spot for the first time after being recommended via Offline! The interior is stunning- immaculately decorated and has a great vibe. Perfect place for a date night or dinner with friends.

Drinks were delicious and the food was pretty good! The bread and butter was great but I would skip the tiger salad (our fault for not asking about the dish, but it was a bit strange and far too spicy). The Bengali wedding chicken is a must-try and you can't go wrong with the carne asada. Surprisingly, our favorite thing we tried was the pulao! Really unique & delicious rice despite being an accompaniment.

While we enjoyed most everything we tried, we felt like we got everything on the menu that appealed to us. It's a bit of a small menu, so we would probably wait for some dishes to change before coming back. Price wise, I feel like everything was a bit too expensive for the quality, but they are providing a great space & ambiance. Overall, nice spot!

I just had to share my excitement about the incredible dinner I recently enjoyed! The food was nothing short of immaculate, leaving me absolutely amazed (every bite we took it was a wow). These fall dishes really had me dreaming – it was a culinary delight like no other. To top it off, the decor and atmosphere were simply amazing, creating a perfect dining experience. Every single dollar spent was worth it, and I can't wait to go back for more. Highly recommend giving it a try!

My review; absolutely delicious!  Also the Chef is amazing. If you ever get the chance to hear his story, his travels, his experience, and where he is from.....just take it all in. What is Contemporary American food? I knew he was a New Yorker immediately when he began to explain his story. How passionate, how driven, and this Chef is not stopping anytime soon. May I add the atmospheric experience you receive their, from the host, bartenders, servers, floor management, open kitchen (sit at bar is a must) overall impeccable. Shout out to the Pastry Chef, because the dessert are amazing. The desserts I've tried were so amazing I forgot to snap a photo 📸.  I truly appreciate a Pastry Chef that understands balance, and textures. With ever dessert, he thought of it all....even the aroma...it's light, touches of sweetness and never heavy. Just buy it all ready, it's a delight.

formatted_address: 5275 Six Forks Rd, Raleigh, NC 27609, United States
name: The Honey Baked Ham Company

reviews.text:
We have this tradition every year. Around thanksgiving and Christmas

The Ham run + the Ham Jam. I volunteer this time and the ham is LOVELY

We love their hame. It's gone after 3 days with only 4 PEOPLE

But I was on the news this year!!!

Happy Thanksgiving y'all

I didn’t realize The Honey Baked Ham Company closed at 6p on Saturday and not 6:30p. I got in the door just in time to place a quick order. I really wanted the ham & Swiss sliders, however being I slid in the door minutes before 6p I was only able to place pre-packaged Classic Ham sandwich and I made it a meal by adding a side & drink for an additional $4.

The ham in the sandwich is REALLY delicious. I then added the hickory honey mustard to the sandwich and that took it to another level.
The potato salad didn’t really have any taste. I definitely can do better myself, but I’ll be back for another sandwich.

Next time I’ll get my ham & Swiss sliders.

Unika B. & Co.

Came here for lunch and ended up buying dinner as well. I’ve always been a fan of HBH but after today I might not ever eat it again. My sliders were ok, nothing to be excited about at all. The mac and cheese I would never order again. Also, the customer service was not great. I waited patiently on the person in front of me to be served. When it was my turn I was helped and the teller also helped the next person. There was no line so my order could have easily been filled before moving on to the next person, instead I waited for her to fill my order and the next person’s. He actually got his order before me. Yes, this is a small thing however, it impacted my experience. Based on taste and customer service I will not eat here again.

I just picked up 4 honey backed ham bones priced @ $3.99 each. The store was decorates so nice for the holidays. The bone has so much ham on it. So much so that I can make.sandwiches or season begetsbles with some it as well as make ham fried rice.

The service was putstanding. Those ladies spoke made me aware of the specials.

I ❣️ the Six Forks Store; I will never go back to the Durham-Chapel Hill Store. Their ham bones look sickly.

Keep up the Good work Six Forks HBHS.

Went there for lunch with a co-worker. My company usually orders from HoneyBaked Ham during the holiday. This was my first time having lunch from there. It was good! I had the Classic Ham sandwich and and half Chef Salad. Everything tasted great! Good service and nice atmosphere. They even have a refrigerator filled with their side dishes and desserts that you can purchase for your home.

formatted_address: 2603 - 151 Glenwood Ave, Raleigh, NC 27608, United States
name: Glenwood Grill & GLENWOOD Grill Annex

reviews.text: 9.18.25  Stopped in at Glenwood Grill Annex to peruse their offerings. I purchased the pan-seared salmon, scalloped potatoes and succotash. After cooking at home, I found the caper-enhanced salmon perfectly cooked and tangy (no need for lemon), the 2 ramkin-sized scalloped potatoes were fluffy and creamy and the succotash with baby butter beans and fresh sliced-from-the- cob corn with red peppers was a taste bud delight. Definitely will return for another helping of the salmon.

Food was well prepared. Was offered fresh cracked pepper, but I didn't get to say how much. My dish needed a bit more salt (for me), but there wasn't any on the table nor was it offered. My friend commented about the sausage being changed for the shrimp and grits from Italian sausage to Andouille sausage. While she didn't notice, the waiter rolled his eyes. The chocolate pie was divine, perfection on a plate. My friend enjoyed the bourbon pecan pie.

Had a lovely dinner as usual.  Haven't been here in 5 years and just as good.  Food is fresh & delicious.  Loved, loved, loved the pepper jack grits croutons in the Southern Caesar salad.  It was my husbands birthday & they surprised us with dessert. As I said we haven't been here in 5 years and yet we were treated like neighbors.  Talk about Southern hospitality.

The food was great I had the parsnip and potato mash which was wonderful, the beet salad with pine nuts and goat cheese is great and the French onion mac and cheese is delightful. My wife had the fried oysters and they were perfect. I give this restaurant a 9.5 out of ten. This food was delicious and the cost was more than fair.
Chef Keith
Place rocks the world. Chad and Tony are best of the best. Food is A+ everyday

formatted_address: 18 E Martin St, Raleigh, NC 27601, United States
name: ORO

reviews.text: We have been here several times and it never disappoints. We got several small plates. The ones I loved the most are the grilled Romaine lettuce, the dumplings, and the beef Wellington. The charcuterie tray is always a big hit in my family. Cory, our waiter, is so funny and always does such a great job! He is awesome! The dessert I loved the most is the chocolate dome with caramel and ice cream. I highly recommend ORO!

We chose Oro for our Wedding Anniversary and we chose right! From the top, we were greeted by the lovely staff and Corey came and helped us decide on drinks to get the night started. The drinks are the best in town!!! No skimping here! The food was absolutely AMAZING!!!! No matter what the occasion, this place should be on the top of your list. This is officially my favorite restaurant in Raleigh! P.S. if you’re a fan of the Old fashioned…ask for it Corey’s way!!! THE ORIGINAL SMOKE BOX!!!!!!!!

We had Corey, after reading rebiews about him, I.was happy he was our waiter.

I had been wanting to go for several years. My husband took me for our 10th wedding anniversary.

Food was amazing!!!. We ordered the Brussels sprouts (not spicy even tjough it says chilli), the beef wellington (2 pieces with that) and the pistachio crusted lamb.
